0012d9db69270309.name: show_need_admits_useless_mayor
0012d9db69270309.doc: Need admits he is useless as mayor, and Cedric says he cannot believe him.

0022ab46b3a38f5b.name: play_gaspard_departure_scene
0022ab46b3a38f5b.doc: Cutscene of Gaspard leaving by his airship at night. Used by the debug program and ends by jumping back to d03b01 at entry 503.

002df36a4c2ef545.name: play_ocean_breeze_arrival_scene_at_station
002df36a4c2ef545.doc: Story 400 program: sets up the station map and plays the arrival scene where Monica enjoys the ocean breeze and the workers promise to wait.

003a59de06ff69f4.name: talk_to_man_praising_palm_brinks
003a59de06ff69f4.doc: A townsman says Palm Brinks is a nice town.

003bc6e99d2c5fb8.name: talk_to_monica_about_spheda
003bc6e99d2c5fb8.doc: Talk trigger. Before flag 314, with a Handy Stick it plays the lesson and the instructions, otherwise a hint to find one. Later it asks if the player is giving up, and if so Monica takes over and the prize items are given.

006d7cb3303cdabd.name: run_train_departure_scene_test
006d7cb3303cdabd.doc: Debug entry that plays the train departure scene.

0077d97fe2e73b84.name: start_butterfly_boss_fight
0077d97fe2e73b84.doc: Pins the player in place, places the seven butterflies and the extra 509 monsters around the arena, starts the boss music and fades in.

007addc5227ee1cc.name: open_party_npc_menu
007addc5227ee1cc.doc: Fades out, opens the shop-type menu with menu_arg for a party NPC at the station, then closes the NPC view and fades back in. chara and is_event are passed on to close_party_npc_view.

0096e62721d08a1b.name: play_event_434
0096e62721d08a1b.doc: Cutscene where the Shigura elder gives the active player (Max or Monica) the Secret Dragon Remedy for an injured Shigura. Sets the remedy-given flag, switches to the event BGM if needed, and shows the item-get message for the remedy before ending with the item limit menu.

0098cd53c3410dd2.name: ask_to_go_to_charlotte_station
0098cd53c3410dd2.doc: Asks whether to move to Charlotte Station. If the player agrees the character runs off, the screen fades out and it returns 1; otherwise the character steps back, the message window mode is reset and it returns 0.

0099e27f97f217a2.name: open_spheda_score_view_on_bonus_floor
0099e27f97f217a2.doc: Cleans up the Spheda session, loads map d07f01 with the Map and Magic Crystal items, sets up Spheda hole 7 and opens the Spheda score view menu.

009b012661e6a9c7.name: use_floor_gate
009b012661e6a9c7.doc: Handles the floor exit. If locked it asks for the Key Handle (item 337) from the item menu. If open it asks whether to leave, shows medal messages, and moves to the next floor. Leaving floor 1 before flag 101 goes to the Dining Room scene and leaving floor 5 before flag 9 goes to the Mayor's Office.

00b1a6450bd31d01.name: open_shop_menu
00b1a6450bd31d01.doc: Fades out, opens the shop menu for the given shop and fades back in when it closes.

00bcbb9229fa6cdf.name: play_shot_party_is_surprised
00bcbb9229fa6cdf.doc: Scene shot: the party jumps in surprise.

00d02ae841e9ddd0.name: play_story_468_nova_cannon
00d02ae841e9ddd0.doc: Story entry for event 468: plays the Nova Cannon gift scene.

00d70f6357bea0ec.name: press_panel_1_5
00d70f6357bea0ec.doc: Candle puzzle step for the church candle at row 1, column 5: cuts to a fixed camera, waits 45 frames, toggles that candle and its four neighbours (i01h07_13 pieces), then waits 45 frames.

01005cdffad8f222.name: give_test_items
01005cdffad8f222.doc: Debug event that adds one each of 17 items.

010467e8e979a279.name: play_event_108_then_load_script
010467e8e979a279.doc: Loads monster data 601, plays event 108 and loads the s06_1 event script.

013683b4bcbaa1e8.name: play_red_time_gate_scene
013683b4bcbaa1e8.doc: Time travel cutscene using Max's Atlamillia and the red time gate: the character strikes the time warp pose, the Atlamillia flares and the screen whitens. Flag 612 selects the later-game sound and skips the longer intro, and the caption is shown by show_time_travel_caption afterwards.

0137dd141960b677.name: talk_to_fisherman_for_bait
0137dd141960b677.doc: Talk with the fisherman: if the player has no Mimi bait he gives 5 more, otherwise he tells the player not to worry about it.

0146d3dbb6118a02.name: play_shot_flotsam_commands_elephant
0146d3dbb6118a02.doc: Scene shot: Flotsam commands the elephant to finish them off, the elephant trumpets and the camera shakes.

014b5546c180cbec.name: warp_to_sea_memory_scene_then_s46
014b5546c180cbec.doc: Debug warp for story event 406: loads d04f02, plays the sea memory door scene and continues to map s46.

0154ac34d1de212e.name: leave_to_luna_lab_wing_2
0154ac34d1de212e.doc: Exits to map f03, setting counter 2 to 2.

0172ae59b9f0bb3a.name: play_late_train_arrival_scene
0172ae59b9f0bb3a.doc: Plays the train arriving at the platform with the carriages turning, used in chapters 6 and 7, then Max steps off.

0173ad4586a0ba10.name: ask_to_use_second_entrance
0173ad4586a0ba10.doc: Handles the second entrance. Same flow as the dungeon entrance but with hints about the Fire Squall machine and Ridepod depending on flags 516 and 508. Returns 1 when leaving.

017716009c698efc.name: start_butterfly_boss_battle
017716009c698efc.doc: Locks map movement, places the boss monsters, switches to the boss music (31), puts Max at the fixed start position and fades in.

019b53fbc647d673.name: ask_to_return_to_d07_dungeon
019b53fbc647d673.doc: Exit talk. Ridepod and monster forms only get a message. Otherwise asks the question and on yes clears the monsters, fades out and returns to the d07 dungeon script.

019c30963ecc411b.name: play_first_floor_help_scene
019c30963ecc411b.doc: Event 100: Max enters the first floor and Donny calls on the receiver to explain the Floor Map and the Gate Key, with two help pictures, followed by help messages about clearing floors and medals. Sets flag 100.

01abcdb4da6217be.name: show_town_npc_line
01abcdb4da6217be.doc: Shows the idle line of the resident NPC npc_id (1 to 25) in a Georama town, such as Cedric for 1. In chapter 8 it shows the epilogue message instead. Cedric says a longer first line once, tracked by flag 57, and afterwards a short one.

01c594dcccf30e9f.name: play_turkey_event_317
01c594dcccf30e9f.doc: Story jump to 317: loads Monica's model with equipment and plays event 317.

01cb491600f0eee0.name: play_run_in_from_town
01cb491600f0eee0.doc: Opening shot of the station arrival on this map: fades in on the player character running in from the town side, then stands and gives camera control back.

01cc0233e4528015.name: play_event_438_then_go_to_g03
01cc0233e4528015.doc: Plays event 438 (Gaspard heading for Shigura Village), skips the next music load and jumps to map g03 at event 510.

01d7859fcb59c366.name: play_opening_need_threatened_scene
01d7859fcb59c366.doc: Opening part three: Mayor Need of Palm Brinks is pressed by Pierrots to find a stone, while Max watches. Ends by loading the s43 event script at 152.

01d94e40bc96ae3c.name: show_total_score
01d94e40bc96ae3c.doc: Spheda golf: draws the final score on screen from the omake sprite sheet (a label, the digits of the Spheda score, and a unit sprite) and waits until the player presses the control pad button. Used at the end of the bonus course.

01e2dedd9354e4bf.name: talk_fabio_early
01e2dedd9354e4bf.doc: Fabio's talk before the first quest is cleared: fishing is his hobby and he dreams of catching a Mardan Karayan.

01f97c955c1fde12.name: show_game_over
01f97c955c1fde12.doc: During the Griffon fight (flag 608 set, 612 not) plays one of two voiced game over lines, otherwise the silent game over.

01fdecd46ce0214b.name: setup_station_and_place_player
01fdecd46ce0214b.doc: Sets up the station and places the player depending on where they came from: after loading a save, from a town, from a train car (by the counter) or via the train arrival scene.

01ff4775e2359d0d.name: spawn_station_villagers
01ff4775e2359d0d.doc: Places the station villagers: Cedric (Osmond in chapters 6 and 7) and, until flag 500 is set, Borneo and Erik.

02012407bcbd7427.name: play_firbits_return_deal_scene
02012407bcbd7427.doc: Sets flag 250. The missing Firbit party returns; Conda holds up the Firbits' end of the bargain and asks Max and Monica to find Holly, who is thought to have met the Rainbow Butterfly.

02045af828cda66d.name: setup_lapis_room_on_map_start
02045af828cda66d.doc: Until flag 628 is set it plays the Lapis Garter intro, disables the lapis point and places boss monster 611, with map movement locked. Then places the player at the room entrance and fades in.

020ddaf85a3eee2a.name: ask_to_enter_d01_dungeon
020ddaf85a3eee2a.doc: Dungeon entrance talk. The two non-Max/Monica characters only get a message. Otherwise asks the question and on yes fades out and starts the d01 dungeon script.

021f56b76117804a.name: debug_show_light_rain_effect
021f56b76117804a.doc: Debug entry that plays the E732 light rain effect high above the camera until a button is pressed.

0221f777dd9cd7f9.name: on_save_point
0221f777dd9cd7f9.doc: Disables the e277 function point, sets flag 277 and plays the Himarra badge scene.

0222b726b943404d.name: clean_up_event_230_scene
0222b726b943404d.doc: Reactivates the player's character and deletes the extra scene characters of event 230.

02274c133063a910.name: press_panel_row1_col4
02274c133063a910.doc: Presses the puzzle switch for the panel at row 1, column 4, toggling it and its neighbours.

02278133aedeebb0.name: remove_moonbreak_scene_actors
02278133aedeebb0.doc: Deletes the scene characters of the moon-breaking scene, restores the active character and the player handles and shows the status bar.

0232df989e0213fc.name: ask_to_leave_forest_west
0232df989e0213fc.doc: Asks whether to leave. On yes the character runs west, the camera pulls back, the screen fades out and it returns 1. On no it walks a few steps back and returns 0.

02362b07dd952a56.name: play_potato_pie_memory_scene
02362b07dd952a56.doc: Cutscene of a mother carrying potato pies to the table for her child, with Max remembering the potato pies she made when he was a kid.

024bd5f5e4c2d388.name: ask_to_leave_cape_lighthouse
024bd5f5e4c2d388.doc: Asks whether to leave the Cape Lighthouse. On yes the player runs off and it returns 1; on no he walks back a few steps and it returns 0.

024f55d5f8bf31c0.name: play_voice_only
024f55d5f8bf31c0.doc: Plays voice stream wav number voice on stream 1 once it is ready, lip-syncing for the given number of frames, then closes the stream.

0264bfc593c8f9a5.name: give_auction_money_to_stewart
0264bfc593c8f9a5.doc: Quest 6: Stewart asks for 1000, then 1500, then 2000 Gilda for an auction (counter 9 tracks the step). After you hand over 2000 he leaves, and on the next talk he returns 600, joins the party and the quest is cleared.

0265f9601e5356f7.name: play_mardan_reward_scene
0265f9601e5356f7.doc: Event 245: Mardan thanks them for the Priscleen Fish, turns the three villagers back to normal and leaves. Sets flag 245.

027d5c32ed8ac83b.name: leave_for_s32
027d5c32ed8ac83b.doc: Plays the play_palace_returned_to_present_scene scene and jumps to map s32 at entry 500.

028428483071587e.name: replay_height_warning_scene
028428483071587e.doc: Sets up the Georama characters and plays the Balance Valley height warning scene.

02a460de51025b04.name: place_corinne_during_quest_18
02a460de51025b04.doc: Places Corinne inside when quest 18 is active and counter 11 is 0.

02bb24fd50a54fab.name: play_jurak_greeting_pan
02bb24fd50a54fab.doc: Opening of event 285: fades in on Jurak Mall with a long camera pan and Jurak's voice commenting that the place is back to normal.

02cc763c56694d58.name: play_boss_intro_scene
02cc763c56694d58.doc: Only runs the boss intro cutscene (event 257).

02d29eb7ad8a99fe.name: setup_boss_611_arena
02d29eb7ad8a99fe.doc: Map start for the boss room: if event 628 has not been seen it plays the boss intro, disables the Lapis point and places monster 611, and it blocks map movement until then.

02ea239e7a6eb904.name: play_andrea_calms_sirus_then_enter_d06b01
02ea239e7a6eb904.doc: Plays the Andrea and Sirus scene, then loads map d06b01 and starts event 512.

0301bf5e9e8b8943.name: ask_bridge_jump_from_spot_4
0301bf5e9e8b8943.doc: Sets counter 13 to 4 and asks about jumping to Paznos Bridge.

030353ed1c2b0882.name: ask_to_leave_for_g03
030353ed1c2b0882.doc: Asks whether to leave; if yes jumps to map g03.

030579671d4aa736.name: start_s04_map_event
030579671d4aa736.doc: Map entry. After loading a save places the player at the start. Otherwise picks the start scene by the previous map, flags 283 and 300 and the chapter.

030f82f858d33711.name: play_opening_pierrots_scene_and_jump_to_s42
030f82f858d33711.doc: Plays the opening scene with Pol Curse and the pierrots, then jumps to map s42 at entry 502.

031798725f759ad9.name: play_donny_receiver_tutorial_scene
031798725f759ad9.doc: First visit tutorial on floor 1. Max enters through the door, takes out the Help Receiver and Donny explains the Floor Map, the Gate Key and Key Handle, then help messages explain clearing floors and Medals. Sets flag 100.

031face0da848dc8.name: play_run_beside_departing_train_scene
031face0da848dc8.doc: Test shot: starts the engine animation, sets 7:00 with time flowing, then the player runs along the platform (460 frames) while the train pulls away down the track (260 frames) and the camera pans; ends on a pad press.

03385f68238a7b6d.name: load_e616_scene_characters
03385f68238a7b6d.doc: Loads the Konda, Nomu, Zakku, Whikki, Moguri, Tobo and Rokoko models and the e616 message file.

03537854b3c7b664.name: start_floor_clear_scene
03537854b3c7b664.doc: Runs the shared floor clear scene when every monster is dead.

036b1f933606bc55.name: talk_to_party_borneo
036b1f933606bc55.doc: Talk handler for Borneo. If he is the party NPC he says he gets restless when not moving and comments on the railway by chapter; otherwise it runs the generic party character talk.

03864b64c0b698e1.name: debug_play_time_travel_explanation
03864b64c0b698e1.doc: Debug entry that plays Osmond's time travel explanation.

038bf0755bf01b12.name: play_lin_remembers_lighthouse_scene
038bf0755bf01b12.doc: Event 340 (flag 340): Lin recovers her memory under the tree and says they must go to the lighthouse to save Master Crest; Max and Monica agree.

0399a6a2b75ce995.name: play_moonflower_beam_escape_scene
0399a6a2b75ce995.doc: Osmond catches fire from the Moonflower beam while Griffon's doing is blamed; Max, Monica and Osmond run from the beam, then Max sees Conda and the others and is told to run.

03a1b871d834dcea.name: talk_rosa_after_joining
03a1b871d834dcea.doc: Rosa's chatter after her quest is cleared, doubting she is of any use. Chapter 8 swaps in a wish to see the Ends of the Earth.

03d0298c0901881b.name: jump_to_event_272
03d0298c0901881b.doc: Sets the Georama analyze flags and story flags 270 to 285 so that only event 272 is still pending (its flag cleared to 0), then jumps to map 25 and waits. Debug-style entry for that story point.

03d7e9cba16acfa6.name: preview_twin_intro_scene
03d7e9cba16acfa6.doc: Plays the twin monster intro scene and waits for a button press.

03fe01e47c05fa1c.name: leave_to_luna_lab_wing_4
03fe01e47c05fa1c.doc: Exits to map f03, setting counter 2 to 4.

0431fa4bb50d26f9.name: move_camera_smoothly
0431fa4bb50d26f9.doc: Moves the camera position and look target toward the given values, easing a fraction of the remaining distance each frame, for duration frames.

044c1aa224623011.name: play_enter_from_west_scene
044c1aa224623011.doc: The player runs in from the west edge of the area while the camera follows.

04546b411b4d949d.name: swap_map_part_after_flag_448
04546b411b4d949d.doc: If flag 448 is set, hides map part p06_s0901 and shows p07_s0901.

045666d0e310c5ae.name: play_carpenterion_intro_then_go_to_sindain
045666d0e310c5ae.doc: Plays the Carpenterion intro and jumps to map g01 entry 504.

046381923e38e4f4.name: run_voice_message_window
046381923e38e4f4.doc: Opens a voice stream, shows its message and plays it, waiting for the player to confirm.

046d75783c91e9c4.name: turn_npc_to_yaw
046d75783c91e9c4.doc: Turns the NPC smoothly to the given yaw over 10 frames, using the walk motion when the turn is large.

049e96ad00227c10.name: walk_away_after_thanking_jurak
049e96ad00227c10.doc: Event 285 ending: Max thanks Jurak and both walk off along paths while the screen fades out.

04a70de6ff36368b.name: play_palace_arrival_then_jump_to_g05
04a70de6ff36368b.doc: Plays the Moonflower Palace welcome scene (flag 700) and jumps to map g05 at entry 500 without reloading music or sounds.

04abf44ec3a87ff7.name: enter_interior_f03i0304
04abf44ec3a87ff7.doc: Turns the player, fades out and jumps to map f03i0304.

04b23dc96f4a989d.name: talk_to_argo
04b23dc96f4a989d.doc: Talk to Argo. His urging depends on what is still missing: a doctor, Lao Chao's Bistro, the white wind flower, the miracle dish, or feeding the dumplings to Lin.

04b6e9e9195625a0.name: play_show_intro_then_go_to_repair_shop
04b6e9e9195625a0.doc: Plays the show intro scene and jumps to map s42 (Repair Shop) at event 502.

04db48c5f3cfaace.name: start_boss_615_fight
04db48c5f3cfaace.doc: Switches to BGM 41, loads monsters 615, 618, 619 and 620 and places monster 615 at the arena centre.

04ee05e33035f482.name: play_potato_pie_memory_scene
04ee05e33035f482.doc: Plays event 209, a memory of Max's childhood: his mother Eina serves potato pies and he thinks them the best in the world.

04ee29c3bd9e1e4c.name: play_platform_raise
04ee29c3bd9e1e4c.doc: Cutscene in the first room of the d01 dungeon: the party runs in and a platform piece rises and settles with a sound, then the player is placed back in control. The scene can be skipped.

04fbb16c0156a11b.name: start_georama_map
04fbb16c0156a11b.doc: Map start program: loads the current villager, resets the camera behind the player and fades in.

0502e2fbc179ae5e.name: play_train_scene_then_board_locomotive
0502e2fbc179ae5e.doc: Plays the Blackstone Railroad arrival scene, then jumps to map s08 (Inside of Locomotive) at event 501.

051b6dc61156c989.name: start_dungeon_floor
051b6dc61156c989.doc: Loads whatever the current floor needs. Floor 0 enters edit mode (Balance Valley); floors 8, 15, 18 and 23 load story maps s17, s14, s18 and s56 or d03b01; floor 21 starts the fishing tournament map; floor 2 plays event 307 the first time; the others load d03f01 to d03f03 with a one in eight chance of rain, then place monsters and chests and play the arrival scene.

0529caad666c26ca.name: start_s33_map_event
0529caad666c26ca.doc: Map entry. If flag 600 is set and 604 not, plays the castle approach scene. Otherwise places the player at the start, with the gate doors opened if flag 604 is set.

05397bbfd6a5ff6d.name: show_chapter_8_villager_line
05397bbfd6a5ff6d.doc: Shows the chapter 8 idle line of the party member whose NPC id is party_chara in the given message window. Used by the party member menu instead of the normal message number.

054a072ed66fb367.name: talk_erik_at_station
054a072ed66fb367.doc: Talk handler for Erik at the station. When Erik is the party NPC he gives a chapter-dependent grumble (chapters 2, 3 and 4, until each station event flag is set) before the normal NPC talk; otherwise it opens the party NPC menu for the clicked character. Returns 0.

054d2825232fdadc.name: talk_to_fisherman_for_bait
054d2825232fdadc.doc: Talk to the fisherman: if the player has no bait he gives 5 Mimi, otherwise he just chats.

056432eee5e48e15.name: play_gaspard_intro_start_fight
056432eee5e48e15.doc: Plays the Gaspard confrontation and sword fight scenes, then sets up the boss fight: Monica becomes the active character, character switching and map moves are locked, the player is placed on the battleship and monster 510 appears. Stores the current time of day for later.

056ac858f2a34e7e.name: play_griffon_hatred_vision_midfight
056ac858f2a34e7e.doc: Mid-battle scene: fades out, pauses monster AI, drawing and player status, saves the player and camera, plays play_griffon_hatred_vision_scene, then restores the player, camera and pause state and fades back in.

058694f131a8c20e.name: play_winged_boss_transformation_scene
058694f131a8c20e.doc: Sets flag 720. A winged boss lands, spreads its wings, grabs and glows, then a second form appears with dancing feathers and takes a stance while the camera moves around Max and Monica. Fades out and restores the player at the end.

0596bce7952d3992.name: play_shot_ride_out
0596bce7952d3992.doc: Cutscene shot where the cast walks off from Cedric's house and the screen fades to black. Sets the camera, walks two characters, plays sound snd_id at two points, slowly zooms the projection from 478.9 to 610.9 over 120 frames, then restores the projection. Returns 0.

05b3d2f1202a80e3.name: play_preloaded_voice_message_for
05b3d2f1202a80e3.doc: Opens message mes_no, starts the voice stream already loaded in stream slot 1, lip-syncs for the given number of frames, then closes the window and stops the stream.

05b7a2515c41fd3a.name: start_griffon_fight
05b7a2515c41fd3a.doc: Starts boss music 36, shows the arena map part and places monster 515 (Griffon).

05bc7034857cc71d.name: play_crest_lecture_event
05bc7034857cc71d.doc: Plays event 372 part 2, Crest's lecture on Griffon and the Luna Lab.

05d676d38dd3326d.name: warp_to_s43_event_8000
05d676d38dd3326d.doc: Clears the scene and loads map s43 at event 8000.

05d6df50b78e9990.name: leave_floor_to_edit_mode
05d6df50b78e9990.doc: Fades out the music and screen, switches back from an alternate character, clears the monsters, marks the floor as finished (floor info flag 2) and goes to Georama edit mode with map 62, entry 504.

05dca2ddc56c42be.name: talk_aunt_polly
05dca2ddc56c42be.doc: Dispatches Aunt Polly's talk. Monica gets her own talk, an unfinished first quest gives the early line, then the bread quest (8) picks the offer, the bread hand-in or the recruited line.

06018b525354bb26.name: enter_blue_time_gate_to_balance_valley
06018b525354bb26.doc: Enters the blue time gate and jumps to map g02 (Balance Valley).

060edeb59d427ad0.name: begin_event_scene
060edeb59d427ad0.doc: Switches the Lafrescia room into event mode (set_event_pause(1): weapon drawing paused, party hidden, swapping and map moves blocked), sets the room up for the story flags and plays the run-into-room scene.

0613e9e3f000e027.name: unload_event_372_charas
0613e9e3f000e027.doc: Removes the event 372 scene characters, frames and images, leaving only the active character; a0 also removes the ten worshippers.

0622920b9dffc13b.name: play_shot_party_walks_in
0622920b9dffc13b.doc: Scene shot: fades in and the party walks in toward a spot in the room while the camera swings in.

06282544c5021ca0.name: start_first_phase_fight
06282544c5021ca0.doc: Fades in, starts music 41 and places the first phase boss (monster 615 and helpers 618 to 620).

064f252bdb462a90.name: setup_g03_map_at_start
064f252bdb462a90.doc: Sets up the map objects, places the player at the start position facing away and fades in.

0652b30a669e7f05.name: setup_luna_lab_map
0652b30a669e7f05.doc: Map setup for the lab. Plays the arrival scene if flag 464 is unset, the Ixion scene when flag 444 is set and 448 is not, and sends the player to s53 when flag 540 is set and 600 is not. Otherwise places the player at the entrance given by counter 2.

065fb73e240231f4.name: talk_stewart_early
065fb73e240231f4.doc: Stewart's talk before the first quest is cleared: he tells the player to come to him with any problem.

066dc948df08a286.name: show_chapter_notice
066dc948df08a286.doc: Before chapter 8, shows message 1050 (1051 when can_play_any_story_event is true), plus 10 when the alternate option is set. Returns 0 without a message when only_when_ready is set and can_play_any_story_event is false.

06780ae5522e8bc5.name: play_title_card_and_wait
06780ae5522e8bc5.doc: Plays the title card scene and waits for a button press.

068daba3472e7729.name: play_golem_charge_then_jump_to_f30
068daba3472e7729.doc: Plays the golem slope charge scene, skips the next BGM load and jumps to map f30 at entry 602.

0698e34c978aae45.name: play_password_challenge_scene
0698e34c978aae45.doc: A voice demands the true name of its master. The player enters a name in the name registration menu; the answer SIRUS sets flag 58, opens the door function points and turns the camera to the door. Any other answer ends in a white fade. Returns 1 if the name was right.

06a587c430e7afe7.name: talk_to_boy_who_missed_circus
06a587c430e7afe7.doc: A boy wishes he could have seen the circus.

06ae1e56b8007fea.name: play_voice_message_for
06ae1e56b8007fea.doc: Plays one voiced line: loads and prepares stream 1 for voice, shows the matching message, plays the stream with lip sync for frames frames, then closes the window and stream.

06b8a080bd1c2a1d.name: play_cedric_hint_ending_shot
06b8a080bd1c2a1d.doc: Last shot of the hint scene: Cedric tells Max to bring back some good pictures.

06b9e8bf212c1953.name: show_partner_leaves_message
06b9e8bf212c1953.doc: Shows the system message for the current party partner leaving: message 52 when there is no partner, otherwise 54 if the partner is a town resident (NPC_STATUS_RESIDENT) and 53 if not, with the partner's name filled in. Returns 1.

06bd1f5eb1f727af.name: start_g01c_script
06bd1f5eb1f727af.doc: Program 504: points the camera at a fixed spot, fades out and loads the event script g01/g01c_1.stb.

06c4151e739a1a08.name: start_floor
06c4151e739a1a08.doc: Starts a floor of dungeon d02. Floor 0 returns to Sindain Station, floor 6 goes to the Fish Monster Swamp, floor 12 to map s13, floor 15 to the boss map d02b01 or d02b02, floor 2 plays the crystal gift scene the first time, and the rest load the d02 forest layout (sometimes rainy) with monsters and chests.

06dbad8cd46650b0.name: remove_dark_scene_actors
06dbad8cd46650b0.doc: Cleanup after the e728 dark power scene: deletes the scene characters and images, restores the player handles and status bar.

06e19387b25b5130.name: play_nova_driver_fire_scene
06e19387b25b5130.doc: Event 640 part 3: the crew prepares the Nova Driver, aims and fires. Skippable.

06e7cefd978ba1f6.name: play_need_agrees_to_reopen_railroad_scene
06e7cefd978ba1f6.doc: Story 109b scene: Cedric doubts the story and scolds Need, suggests restarting the railroad and asks why it was closed, and Need agrees to reopen it.

06e94afefb77ef61.name: praise_invention_idea
06e94afefb77ef61.doc: Cedric cheers that Max invented the Energy Pack idea.

06ef8b8955894a3c.name: use_channel_key_on_door
06ef8b8955894a3c.doc: Key door interaction. With Donny in the party he opens it himself; otherwise the player is asked to use the Channel Key (item 338) on it.

06f353f89bfb2116.name: start_floor_cleared_scene
06f353f89bfb2116.doc: Runs the victory pose and gate hint when every monster on the floor is dead.

06f5a695f3177cd9.name: talk_rosa_early
06f5a695f3177cd9.doc: Rosa's talk before the first quest is cleared: she apologizes for being hard of hearing and asks to be spoken to slowly.

06f84b8590933a17.name: play_dinner_scene_then_enter_dungeon
06f84b8590933a17.doc: Plays the dinner scene, then starts the dungeon.

06f8f4a9b3af4657.name: play_voice_only
06f8f4a9b3af4657.doc: Plays a voice stream without showing a message window, running the lip sync for the given frames.

06fc3819fb69dded.name: exit_to_f03_entrance_3
06fc3819fb69dded.doc: Turns and fades out, sets counter 2 to 3 and jumps to map f03.

071b1c0edb2df752.name: enter_house_g01i07
071b1c0edb2df752.doc: before flag 209 is set, plays the knocking scene. Afterwards enters interior g01i07, skipping the music reload and allowing Georama editing in the case where flag 247 is set and 250 is not.

072b8345307b4428.name: play_run_in_entrance
072b8345307b4428.doc: Entrance scene: the player runs in from the south of the map to the center, with footsteps changing partway, then stands.

07375ec26ab9e698.name: show_narration_line
07375ec26ab9e698.doc: Streams the voice clip, shows its text, lip syncs, and closes the window after hold_frames.

0738056d304f3d7d.name: setup_s50_entry
0738056d304f3d7d.doc: Runs the s50 map setup, places the player at the entrance and fades in.

073da64e471c25c6.name: load_defeat_scene_actors
073da64e471c25c6.doc: Loads the actors for the e728 scene: Max and Monica with their e728 motions and equipment, the boss model and a particle model. Switches the player to Max or Monica if a transformed form is active, and stores the character slots in defeat_scene_max_slot and defeat_scene_monica_slot.

07402d14deac7004.name: play_retreat_from_shingala_scene
07402d14deac7004.doc: Sets flag 410. Max and Monica watch Shingala with the device, agree nothing can be done now and to come up with a plan. Skippable.

0750970af119f086.name: talk_ferdinand_chestnuts
0750970af119f086.doc: Ferdinand asks for a Roasted Chestnut and opens the item menu. Cancelling or using the wrong item ends the talk; giving the chestnut recruits him as a party NPC and clears quest 3.

0753feb85a4fc84d.name: play_blue_atlamillia_glow_scene
0753feb85a4fc84d.doc: Sets flag 522. Max looks up as his Atlamillia glows blue and Max says Monica's Atlamillia is lending its power across time.

075b71f2b6f15057.name: play_arrival_run_in_scene
075b71f2b6f15057.doc: Short arrival scene: Max runs along a path toward the platform while the screen fades in.

075da24a1fb66d59.name: place_shot_camera
075da24a1fb66d59.doc: Puts the golf camera 100 units behind the player along the shot direction yaw, a little above and aimed at the player, then turns camera control back on with a limited zoom range.

076c581cbd401587.name: setup_room_or_play_nobb_scene
076c581cbd401587.doc: If flag 400 is set and flag 428 is not, adds the Shell Talkie (item 373) and plays event 428. Otherwise places the player at the entrance, resets the camera and fades in.

0779d8941908f191.name: toggle_sky_walkway
0779d8941908f191.doc: Toggles local flag 5 and the sky drawing, and plays the walkway transition scene between the ground area and the high platform.

077a3526f088b1da.name: show_party_npc_notice
077a3526f088b1da.doc: Shows a system message naming the current party NPC (message 53), or message 52 if there is none. Returns 1.

07806a51b0ecbeb6.name: setup_firbit_house
07806a51b0ecbeb6.doc: Seats the three Firbits at the table before the meeting. If flag 247 is set and 250 is not, plays the Firbit return scene and jumps to Sindain (s47). Otherwise places the player and fades in.

07850617d58f1c55.name: show_e356_title_then_enter_edit_mode
07850617d58f1c55.doc: Shows the E356 title card then goes to edit mode 1 with entry 502.

079951d470a05dd2.name: play_swamp_arrival_scene
079951d470a05dd2.doc: Walk-in cutscene for arriving at the swamp: the active character crosses a log and jumps into the map at the given world coordinates.

079a3ed999812755.name: ask_to_enter_dungeon_d05
079a3ed999812755.doc: Handles the dungeon entrance. Companions only comment. Max is asked whether to enter (no question once flag 516 is set and editing is not blocked); on yes he runs through and the screen fades out. Returns 1 when entering, otherwise 0, optionally with a Ridepod reminder.

07a1a6a80618ce1e.name: use_time_bomb_on_firesquall
07a1a6a80618ce1e.doc: Interaction with the Firesquall. Offers the item menu for the Time Bomb (372); using it plays the battleship attack scene, locks the party to Max, and starts the battleship fight with monsters 517, 518 and 519. Companions just comment.

07a1a924b53c9706.name: talk_rosa_after_joining
07a1a924b53c9706.doc: Rosa's chatter after her quest is cleared, doubting she is of any use. Chapter 8 swaps in a wish to see the Ends of the Earth.

07b658672e37c0d0.name: play_shingala_fight_intro_scene
07b658672e37c0d0.doc: Sets flag 416 and plays event 416: Pau tells Max to put the Electric Fish in Shingala's mouth, then monster 516 (Shingala) is placed for the fight.

07e80fa5f1343cb0.name: talk_milane_early
07e80fa5f1343cb0.doc: Milane's talk before the first quest is cleared: his shop specializes in blades and he has only a few guns.

07f2fb8c01929803.name: interact_with_swamp_plant
07f2fb8c01929803.doc: Runs when the player examines the swamp spot. Check type 1 shows a hint message depending on flags 23 and 24; type 2 opens the item menu, accepting the Lafrescia Seed first (flag 23) and then the Sundrop (flag 24) and playing the matching growth event.

0810794182700ac2.name: play_palace_intro_then_enter_palace
0810794182700ac2.doc: Plays the palace intro and jumps to map g05 (Moon Flower Palace) without reloading BGM or sounds.

0812a30d07b3897a.name: restart_event_328
0812a30d07b3897a.doc: Sets flags 304, 306 and 324, resets 330 and replays the dumpling delivery scene.

081605f596610589.name: start_first_gaspard_fight
081605f596610589.doc: After fading out, plays the Gaspard encounter scene, then spawns the boss monster 512 and places the player facing it.

084eb5a4f94c9fa2.name: play_lin_remembers_scene_after_boss
084eb5a4f94c9fa2.doc: Fades out, clears monsters, unlocks map moves, hides a map piece, plays the Lin remembers scene and places the player.

085e811ed323b764.name: ask_to_leave_and_fade_out
085e811ed323b764.doc: Asks an item question; on yes fades out and returns 1, otherwise returns 0.

08aca170233b3f6d.name: test_late_train_arrival
08aca170233b3f6d.doc: Debug entry that plays the late train arrival scene.

08c23307ad5e6ce2.name: play_bridge_repaired_scene
08c23307ad5e6ce2.doc: Event 448: the train crew tells Max and Monica the bridge repairs were finished long ago and they head for Mt. Gundor.

08d52a43c3290b6c.name: show_floor_caption_scene
08d52a43c3290b6c.doc: Short intro: hides the player, fades in on two characters standing in the room while the d07domari02 caption fades in, holds for 150 frames, then restores the player.

08d81d4cf5e8732d.name: handle_villager_talk
08d81d4cf5e8732d.doc: Villager talk dispatcher for the town: reads the talked-to character and slot, then characters up to number 34 go to the Palm Brinks villager conversations and the rest to the by-kind dialogue.

08f9a999464410c7.name: start_station_map
08f9a999464410c7.doc: Map start: after a memory card load it only places the player; otherwise, coming from maps 18, 23, 120 or 108 with counter 1 equal to 7 the player leaves a train car, and from any other map a train arrival plays.

0903675a573513f5.name: set_idle_motion
0903675a573513f5.doc: Sets the player's standing motion for the active character. Steve (character 2) uses the legs or caterpillar track stand motion depending on his movement type; the others use the plain stand.

093537fcf92364ed.name: play_condor_drops_player_scene
093537fcf92364ed.doc: Opening scene of the area: a condor swoops down from the sky and drops the player onto the nest ledge at (-230, 32, 1200).

09494e517d6e898c.name: unload_event_352_scene
09494e517d6e898c.doc: Ends event 352: reactivates the player's character, deletes the temporary characters, restores the party handles and the status bar, and finishes the event.

09557b9939cc3a27.name: use_west_transfer_gate
09557b9939cc3a27.doc: Transfer gate menu, entered at the west gate.

0959e27919e6d30b.name: spawn_reward_chests
0959e27919e6d30b.doc: When the pack is dead, spawns chests holding the Absorption Coin and Moon Stone if not taken, switches music and marks the floor cleared.

096e1d023112e4be.name: talk_gerald_to_monica
096e1d023112e4be.doc: Gerald's talk when Monica is the active character, asking if she is a friend of Max. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about helping Need and Cedric rebuild the world.

097ae00add20145f.name: on_monsters_cleared
097ae00add20145f.doc: Plays the floor clear scene when the last monster is defeated.

09809e4d2551ed79.name: load_event_or_game_over
09809e4d2551ed79.doc: Used when the floor exit door is tried. If the active character is slot 2 and the channel arena has not been cleared, sets the Ridepod rescue flag and loads event 503 of s06; otherwise runs the silent game over.

0983f69e47100dc9.name: play_opening_max_flees_on_map_start
0983f69e47100dc9.doc: Plays the opening part 4 scene when the map starts.

09969e7b6618e280.name: replay_toryon_plants_trees_scene
09969e7b6618e280.doc: Plays the Toryon tree planting scene.

09b4c7fb1a4c5153.name: play_oz_waits_at_station_scene
09b4c7fb1a4c5153.doc: Event 648 (sets flag 648): the angry party faces Oz at the Moon Flower Palace stop, Oz says he will wait and tells them to get him, and they answer they will. Restores the stop's default BGM.

09cf6ff09b30c842.name: visit_dwarves_house_after_pie
09cf6ff09b30c842.doc: Plays the potato pie memory scene and jumps to g01i07 (Dwarves' House) at entry 502.

09e0c0b7a6859491.name: play_train_arrival_with_steam
09e0c0b7a6859491.doc: Shows the train rolling in with steam puffs and sparks while it slows to a stop, using the given sound bank.

09e1947b236d1ec9.name: play_luna_lab_arrival_scene
09e1947b236d1ec9.doc: Only calls play_luna_lab_arrival_scene, the lab arrival scene.

09fa582c3e2a4a65.name: restart_event_330
09fa582c3e2a4a65.doc: Sets flag 324, resets 330 and replays the scene of Lin waking up.

09fc19a37e42b90f.name: play_rope_floor_intro
09fc19a37e42b90f.doc: Intro for the upper floors 17 to 21. The character hangs from a rope, drops, lands and walks forward, with the same title, map and seal notices as the drop-in intro.

0a086b62f11b34cd.name: play_mardan_hooked_scene
0a086b62f11b34cd.doc: Event 240. While Max and Monica fish, the line snaps and Mardan surfaces with a hook stuck in his lip. He blames them for the Firbits' odd behaviour but asks them to fetch a Priscleen Fish to clean him up. Sets flag 240.

0a0e5a386f6fdb99.name: play_ladder_climb_test_scene
0a0e5a386f6fdb99.doc: Test scene: Max walks in, says he cannot see, runs across a walkway, climbs a ladder and looks to the right with two messages.

0a0fb43f9aa8fa8d.name: play_nova_driver_order_scene
0a0fb43f9aa8fa8d.doc: Event 640 part 2: the Paznos attacks do nothing, so Galen orders the Nova Driver readied and a soldier reports it ready. Skippable.

0a12f542010ec19d.name: draw_aim_guide
0a12f542010ec19d.doc: Draws the dotted aim guide for a golf shot with up to 31 world sprites along the path given by yaw and pitch. The path bounces off walls up to 6 segments, and every sixth dot is also fed to the line point list. Shows the screen caption sprite when the map scale is 0, with its position and crop chosen by language.

0a3cd0ea38a34d7e.name: talk_ferdinand_to_monica
0a3cd0ea38a34d7e.doc: Ferdinand's two-part talk to Monica about food, with a different single line in chapter 8. Uses the talk camera and returns Ferdinand to standing.

0a4e0c3291273719.name: warp_to_s18_event_332
0a4e0c3291273719.doc: Clears the scene and loads map s18 with the event script for event 332.

0a4e81cd50a139ec.name: slide_train_to_stop
0a4e81cd50a139ec.doc: Decelerates the train actor to a halt over 90 frames and waits.

0a510b79b2052040.name: ask_to_travel_to_place
0a510b79b2052040.doc: Asks a yes/no question naming the destination (system message 20000 plus place_name_id). Fades out and returns 1 on yes, otherwise 0.

0a5b6a133739d332.name: ask_to_board_train
0a5b6a133739d332.doc: Interaction with the train at the station. Before flag 202 the train is a house for Erik and Borneo and Max only remarks on it. Afterwards asks to board and jumps to the locomotive (s08), the front or guest cars (s07) or the Ixion maps (s37, s38) depending on the chapter and the car.

0a5d69d5a851688b.name: warp_to_s06_after_story_103
0a5d69d5a851688b.doc: Story 103 program: sets story progress to 3 and warps to map s06, running its script event 500 in s06b_1.

0a618a58b534d5b2.name: setup_shigura_village
0a618a58b534d5b2.doc: Stops the music, places the villager models, and shows the battleship map part only when flag 438 is set and flag 444 is not.

0aacf21d46af2283.name: talk_gerald_after_joining
0aacf21d46af2283.doc: Gerald's chatter after the gun quest is cleared, warning that guns are not toys. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about rebuilding the world.

0ab3b86edb1aa0c5.name: play_pending_town_events
0ab3b86edb1aa0c5.doc: Map entry. Plays event 372, the Lao Chao Bistro scene, the Starglass discussion scene or the Crest reward scene when their story conditions hold. If none played and the player did not come from an interior, places the player at the default start and fades in.

0ac550aa57bb1888.name: lower_rock_in_room_1
0ac550aa57bb1888.doc: Binds map part p11_d06b02-1 and sinks the rock pillar with the player.

0afa3169b1d07134.name: finish_shot
0afa3169b1d07134.doc: Ends a Spheda golf shot. In bonus mode a holed ball scores par + 3 on all holes but the last and loads the next hole, or returns to the course menu after hole 8. In normal mode, holing out on a floor not yet cleared marks it cleared, adds a medal and shows a message; running out of balls shows the failure message (and in bonus mode the total score, then the next hole or the course menu). holed is 1 when the ball went in.

0b077e7b0309ffe4.name: play_palace_falls_then_jump_to_s30
0b077e7b0309ffe4.doc: Plays the falling palace scene and jumps to map s30 at program 640.

0b0dbcd67a9f31a6.name: open_clown_chest
0b0dbcd67a9f31a6.doc: Opens the clown chest: a clown pops out offering a big or a small chest. The two items are swapped at random, so the choice is blind. Picking the big chest gives item_b and the small one item_a, in the counts checked against the bag limit; the clown vanishes and the player may get the bag-full menu.

0b1043e70ad6c4e8.name: track_special_chest_items
0b1043e70ad6c4e8.doc: Opens the treasure chest. If the item inside is 206 it sets bit 4 of counter 17, and if it is 199 it sets bit 8, to remember those finds.

0b159aec847d2bf8.name: offer_chestnut_quest
0b159aec847d2bf8.doc: Ferdinand asks for Chestnuts to try a Castagnaccio sweet because Mayor Need bought them all. Accepts quest 3.

0b15ba2370ee6c1d.name: play_flotsam_orders_elephant_again_shot
0b15ba2370ee6c1d.doc: Flotsam turns and laughs that it is the same every time (voice 1080070), then points and orders Linda to get them (1080075) while the elephant trumpets and the camera pushes in. Max and Steve (characters 0 and 9) are hidden for the shot.

0b2adf5f40e27036.name: warp_to_d06e01_event_608
0b2adf5f40e27036.doc: Clears the scene and starts event 608 on map d06e01.

0b33d8231d35f1e7.name: start_s43b_event_8000
0b33d8231d35f1e7.doc: Locks map movement and the minimap, hides the two partners and loads the s43b event script at 8000.

0b479d42ded53789.name: play_villagers_recovered_scene
0b479d42ded53789.doc: Event 247: the three villagers return to normal with no memory of what happened, Monica explains they were under the Holy One's spell, and the party decides to go back to Sindain to plan. Shows help messages about leaving the dungeon. Sets flag 247.

0b52356cccf2095c.name: play_scene_then_go_to_s30_610
0b52356cccf2095c.doc: Plays play_lapis_beam_scene and jumps to map s30 at event 610.

0b6bcc6a1137f2cb.name: open_boss_door
0b6bcc6a1137f2cb.doc: Rotates the door34 parts apart and swaps in the opened door pieces.

0b79cacb6976d332.name: try_open_item_limit_menu
0b79cacb6976d332.doc: If the item limit is reached or the bag is over capacity, opens the item-over menu (town or dungeon version by game mode) and returns 1; otherwise returns 0.

0b7cb1ca9e76a50e.name: ask_to_leave_area
0b7cb1ca9e76a50e.doc: Asks a yes/no question (message 74). On yes it fades out and returns 1, otherwise 0.

0b87f51f994ec529.name: talk_to_starlight_temple_villager
0b87f51f994ec529.doc: Talk handler for the NPCs of this town, picked by NPC id (Lao Chao and his customers, Starlight Temple residents who mention Crest and Emperor Griffon, shopkeepers). Their lines change with flags 324, 330, 372, 400 and 640, and Pyrion (201) opens shop 5 and Arnhem (204) shop 27.

0b8a313cccc3a201.name: play_osmond_waits_at_train_scene
0b8a313cccc3a201.doc: Event 648 (flag 648): a train part flies in, Max and Monica meet Dr. Osmond, who says he will wait there and tells them to be sure to catch him, and they promise they will. Restores the map music and the hidden villager afterwards. Skippable.

0b9413a56b7feb18.name: talk_to_man_asking_if_anything_wrong
0b9413a56b7feb18.doc: A townsman asks if anything is wrong.

0b98c6b59b12000c.name: test_halloween_intro_scene
0b98c6b59b12000c.doc: Debug entry that plays the long boss intro.

0b9d01745f504116.name: choose_transfer_gate
0b9d01745f504116.doc: Opens the transfer gate destination menu.

0bbb1850893021d4.name: start_dungeon_from_map_menu
0bbb1850893021d4.doc: Opens the dungeon map menu, then loads the map for the chosen floor of this dungeon (floors 1 to 7 d03f01, 9 to 17 d03f02, 19 to 22 d03f03, floor 8 the s17 event map, floor 23 the d03b02 boss map), places chests and monsters and plays the entry scene.

0bbb39634417aff0.name: play_sirus_hug_then_jump_to_d06b03
0bbb39634417aff0.doc: Plays the Sirus hug scene and jumps to map d06b03 at entry 510.

0bc3a9d07d0c2687.name: start_griffon_boss_arena
0bc3a9d07d0c2687.doc: If flag 58 is set, plays the Emperor Griffon appears scene, locks map movement, places the player in the arena and spawns boss 615 with its minions 618 to 620. Then fades in.

0bcde72affd38962.name: play_map_start_arrival
0bcde72affd38962.doc: Map start program: sets Georama editing, plays the arrival that fits the previous map (white fade-in from map 25, run-in otherwise), starts pending story scripts, sets doors and NPCs and shows the event hint message.

0bd6d95fb29e8e79.name: talk_to_clinic_villager
0bd6d95fb29e8e79.doc: Turns the player toward the character talked to and shows a plain greeting.

0be9d5a8ea95dbc7.name: start_event_203_scene
0be9d5a8ea95dbc7.doc: Locks map movement, enables the train function points, places the train crew, plays the world explained scene and starts the train sounds.

0bf39f2bec48b9ae.name: play_gate_bloom_scene
0bf39f2bec48b9ae.doc: Plays the scene in which a moon flower gate blooms open after the Queen's Watering Pot is used: the player's character steps up, five petal parts turn and the flower character plays its out motion. The gate_index (0 to 2) picks which set of map parts is used.

0bf802cfce406719.name: talk_parn_joined_in_studio
0bf802cfce406719.doc: Parn's talk in his studio after he has joined: outside chapter 8 Monica hears that girls cannot understand a man chasing his ideals and Max is offered his painting ability; in chapter 8 he muses on how deep painting is. Then talk_to_npc.

0bf8ca30f07a7fbd.name: talk_to_npc_with_crossfade
0bf8ca30f07a7fbd.doc: Places the player to talk to the NPC, crossfades, shows a bubble message, stands the NPC and ends the event with another crossfade.

0c053bf07f333a8d.name: play_crest_reward_scene
0c053bf07f333a8d.doc: Sets flag 376. Starlight Temple has been restored; the Great Sage thanks the two and hands Max an item (item 52), which Max receives with a get animation. Skippable. Adds the item to the inventory.

0c17b5d8cd9f5ccc.name: cleanup_holly_scene_cast
0c17b5d8cd9f5ccc.doc: Removes the characters, butterfly models and picture sprites loaded for the Holly scene (event 260) and restores the party handles.

0c345138393bb8a8.name: reset_story_312_flags_and_start_map
0c345138393bb8a8.doc: Story trigger for event 312: sets flags 300 and 320, clears flags 312 to 317 and runs the map start.

0c60b7762678b560.name: load_selected_dungeon_floor
0c60b7762678b560.doc: Opens the dungeon map menu and loads the chosen floor. Floor 6 leads to map s05, floor 15 to d02b02 or d02b01 depending on story flag 24, and others to the d02f01 dungeon map with monsters and chests, after the entry cutscene.

0c825f4808d1acf5.name: start_station_map_event
0c825f4808d1acf5.doc: Map entry. After loading a save places the player at the start. Otherwise picks the start scene by the previous map, counter 1, flags 360 and 400 and the chapter.

0c8909ab254eddbd.name: open_sealed_door_with_key
0c8909ab254eddbd.doc: Handles the sealed door. If the party NPC is 4 it opens at once with a comment. Otherwise it asks for item 346 (lower floors) or 347 (upper floors) and opens the door when given.

0c90bd2dbaafec6a.name: test_trentos_intro_scene
0c90bd2dbaafec6a.doc: Debug entry that plays the boss intro.

0cd2a6b7adf94efb.name: load_spheda_bonus_course_5
0cd2a6b7adf94efb.doc: Loads the d05f02 Spheda course (mstage5) with a map and magic crystal, sets up the hole and opens the score view menu.

0cdc812d6248ddca.name: show_chapter_8_villager_line
0cdc812d6248ddca.doc: Shows the chapter 8 idle line of the party member whose NPC id is party_chara in the given message window. Used by the party member menu instead of the normal message number.

0cf5188ff163463f.name: play_chase_toward_sea_scene
0cf5188ff163463f.doc: Event 404 (flag 404): Max and Monica run up to the spot where a Shigura walks away along a path toward the sea and decide to follow it. Starts music 3 and places the player further along the coast. Skippable.

0d0214b68617297f.name: play_floor_arrival_scene
0d0214b68617297f.doc: Arrival cutscene when a floor starts: the active character crosses a log and jumps into the floor, over either the floor transition map (show_map_transition set) or the Dungeon 2 logo, then shows the seal picture and messages if the floor is sealed.

0d05e30a7ef96b2f.name: on_board_train
0d05e30a7ef96b2f.doc: Asks whether to board the train. On yes sets counter 1 to 8 and goes to the Ixion engine room (s37) for the front car or the Ixion guest room (s38) otherwise.

0d2e0578bd538e06.name: run_debug_tests
0d2e0578bd538e06.doc: Debug entry that runs test 0, waits for a pad press and runs test 1.

0d306e90ac637e90.name: play_cedric_hint_shots
0d306e90ac637e90.doc: First half of Cedric's hint scene: he tells Max where to get the Milk Can, the Pipes and the Belt for the Energy Pack, with picture cards crossfading behind him.

0d37f4d062d8810e.name: play_paznos_sighting_scene
0d37f4d062d8810e.doc: Skippable scene where the party looks up at Paznos, built for the struggle against Griffon, then returns to the workshop music. Sets flag 556.

0d503c59e18bacb2.name: play_rococo_scene_then_load
0d503c59e18bacb2.doc: Plays the Rococo house scene, fades in and loads the g01_1 event script.

0d86637676cb5d09.name: ask_board_train
0d86637676cb5d09.doc: Station prompt asking the player to enter or depart. Cancelling returns 0; choosing to depart fades out, opens the world map menu and returns 0; choosing to enter returns 1.

0d872442467036f2.name: play_run_in_arrival_scene
0d872442467036f2.doc: Arrival scene on entering the map: the player runs in from the entrance as the camera eases. Skipped when flag 207 is set and 208 is not, since the story script plays instead.

0dad370c477ebb17.name: show_story_points_and_return
0dad370c477ebb17.doc: Event 501: fades out, runs play_utan_poison_apple_scene, sets counter 3 to 3 if item 302 is owned, shows the story points screen and returns to the map script s05_1.

0dbac117f3bf1914.name: aim_spheda_shot
0dbac117f3bf1914.doc: Lets the player rotate and tilt the aim with the sticks while the aim guide is drawn. Returns 0 when the aim is confirmed (button 32) and 1 when cancelled (button 64).

0dbf614a78d11857.name: warp_to_s19_event_410
0dbf614a78d11857.doc: Clears the scene and starts event 410 on map s19.

0dc2b74c3cc1aaf2.name: setup_spheda
0dc2b74c3cc1aaf2.doc: Sets up the Spheda minigame for the given mode and level: loads the language-specific power bar image, creates the game, loads the ball and pin models in the colors the game picks, and sets their draw distance by dungeon stage.

0dc9982d8c6ec457.name: play_event_324
0dc9982d8c6ec457.doc: Event 324: the party brings a White Windflower to Lao Chao, who agrees to cook the miracle dish. Sets the seen flag at the start, plays the cooking and handover, shows the item get message for Miracle Dumplings, and ends with the party heading off.

0de4a57a0b383893.name: press_panel_row1_col6
0de4a57a0b383893.doc: Presses the puzzle switch for the panel at row 1, column 6, toggling it and its neighbours.

0e06ad20919c4c6b.name: ask_to_enter_georama
0e06ad20919c4c6b.doc: Asks whether to use the Georama (question 6 with item 16). Fades out and returns 1 on yes, otherwise returns 0.

0e0ca9edd676efc1.name: play_beam_escape_scene
0e0ca9edd676efc1.doc: Max, Monica and Conda are horrified by what Griffon has done, burn and run in circles, then flee from the Moonflower beam. Conda's group is spotted ahead and Max is told to run before the scene fades out.

0e154ee3bd9cb605.name: play_train_departure
0e154ee3bd9cb605.doc: Scene of the train leaving the station: fades to black, builds the train and steam clouds, then the train pulls away to the right and the screen fades out. fade_bgm also fades and stops the music; the scene can be skipped.

0e248d9b8d98572e.name: make_epilogue_npc_message
0e248d9b8d98572e.doc: Shows the epilogue line for one of 25 townsfolk, selected by npc_id, in the given message window. Ids outside 1 to 25 show nothing.

0e2d3fa3db57673a.name: clean_up_event_340_scene
0e2d3fa3db57673a.doc: Reactivates the player's character, deletes the event 340 scene characters, shows the party again and ends the event.

0e2e740210b77800.name: restart_edit_event_if_door_1_closed
0e2e740210b77800.doc: Program 205: if the door on side 1 is not open, requests an edit event restart.

0e461d36c1f379ba.name: play_gaspard_encounter_scene
0e461d36c1f379ba.doc: Sets flag 528 and plays the scene where Gaspard rises from beside a collapsed figure, taunts Max and Monica, and leaps in to fight, with a caption sprite. Skippable.

0e4e0d77ddfab2f7.name: show_message_at
0e4e0d77ddfab2f7.doc: Opens message mes_no in a window at the given position, waits until the player dismisses it, closes it and returns the frames waited.

0e62e0522ee568c4.name: start_s13_boss_with_gear
0e62e0522ee568c4.doc: Debug start: sets both characters to 160 max HP and 50 defence, tops item 270 up to 20, equips items 16, 27, 71 and 100, then loads map s13 at the Trentos boss event.

0e66eeb1a0d82e7c.name: leave_s30_after_horn_farewell
0e66eeb1a0d82e7c.doc: Plays the Horn King farewell scene (play_horn_king_farewell_scene) and jumps to map s10 (Heim Rada Stop) at entry 510.

0e6cc29bf254cb11.name: show_need_finishes_confession
0e6cc29bf254cb11.doc: After a fade in, Need says there it is, having told his story.

0e6f9701d97473a3.name: open_dungeon_map_and_enter
0e6f9701d97473a3.doc: Opens the dungeon tree map. Choosing 0 plays the run in from the dungeon, 6 jumps to map s05, and any other floor enters the dungeon at that floor. Skips the next music load for floors 2 (before flag 212) and 14.

0e892ce3afaea8cf.name: play_carpenterion_appears_and_go_to_s26
0e892ce3afaea8cf.doc: Event 501: plays the Carpenterion appears scene and jumps to s26 event 501.

0eb63dc15a85e3a1.name: start_lighthouse_arrival_story
0eb63dc15a85e3a1.doc: Story handler that plays the lighthouse arrival scene.

0ec03fc61e463384.name: reset_player_position_in_house
0ec03fc61e463384.doc: Event 123: places the player at the house entry position again.

0ec3d125ab69e76c.name: talk_mina
0ec3d125ab69e76c.doc: Dispatches Mina's talk by progress. Before the Spheda lesson has been seen she gives the early line, then quest 17 picks the offer, the Spheda check or the recruited line.

0eceabdc1c89e280.name: start_story_737_at_s66
0eceabdc1c89e280.doc: Fades out, sets story progress to 10 and jumps to map s66 with event 17370 (story 737).

0ee8e0d76cdefb66.name: toggle_rev_floor_npc
0ee8e0d76cdefb66.doc: Enables or disables the 'rev_floor' function point. With show set it loads and places an NPC model (p00_26a, slot 8) without a shadow; otherwise it deletes that NPC.

0eead3aaeff8b3bf.name: claim_lapis_after_boss
0eead3aaeff8b3bf.doc: After the boss: for the two non-Max/Monica characters only shows a message, otherwise gives item 366, marks the floor, plays the lapis pickup scene and re-enables map movement. Returns 0 in the early exit case.

0eebffa7f61471ed.name: play_test_camera_and_walk
0eebffa7f61471ed.doc: Holds the camera for 300 frames, then a test actor walks to a point while the camera target slides to it.

0f058e8bd8724749.name: play_condor_drop_off_scene
0f058e8bd8724749.doc: The condor (chara 8, p00_26a) swoops down over 60 frames, then the hidden player appears and lands at (-230, 32.1, 1200) with the d03 landing motion. After a fade out it stands the condor at (-316.7, 71.9, 806.8), resets the camera behind the player and fades back in. Skippable.

0f1ff3040072d674.name: play_opening_vacuum_repair_scene
0f1ff3040072d674.doc: Opening chapter 3: Max repairs the Anbar Type 2 vacuum with the hose attachment, falls asleep, wakes and realises the circus is about to start.

0f2a0742ff24d98a.name: talk_stewart_early
0f2a0742ff24d98a.doc: Stewart's talk before the first quest is cleared: he tells the player to come to him with any problem.

0f35c9074619ecb7.name: leave_for_s31_if_allowed
0f35c9074619ecb7.doc: If the leave check passes, jumps to map s31.

0f3afcb705e44ec9.name: talk_to_race_host
0f3afcb705e44ec9.doc: Talk handler for the fish race host. Only the main character can enter. It offers to enter, explain the rules or check the prizes for each class, then runs fish and class selection (beginner to master) and goes on to choose the aquarium. In extra mode it opens the fish race menu directly.

0f406dec248a91bd.name: talk_blinkhorn_busy_away
0f406dec248a91bd.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk when he is not at his post by the gate: he says he is busy gathering materials for the town's safety and asks Max to come back tomorrow.

0f6abb06f2d063e9.name: show_item_pair_message
0f6abb06f2d063e9.doc: Shows message 20 in the versatile window with item_a and item_b filled in as its two item names. Returns 1.

0f779ba291f0d09b.name: play_opening_empty_house_scene
0f779ba291f0d09b.doc: Opening chapter 5: Max finds nobody at home, says he is gone, opens the door and the screen fades out.

0f8cea1e246a8c4c.name: talk_adel_clothes_done
0f8cea1e246a8c4c.doc: Adel finishes the clothes: she hands over a pair of overalls the player does not own (Green Overalls if missing, otherwise Denim Overalls if missing, otherwise the default), then joins the party as a recruited NPC. Marks quest 7 cleared.

0fac0b1373d38b37.name: show_final_ranking_board
0fac0b1373d38b37.doc: Shows the ranking board of the finished race with rival names and times in three steps and fades back in.

0fbbcadd3e822a0f.name: ask_to_enter_dungeon
0fbbcadd3e822a0f.doc: Event 600: asks the yes/no question 75 (with item 55 named). On yes Max runs to the gate, the screen fades and the dungeon selection map opens; on no he walks a few steps forward and control returns. Returns 1 on yes, 0 on no.

0fc702bfc01c594b.name: talk_aunt_polly_early
0fc702bfc01c594b.doc: Aunt Polly's line before the player has progressed far enough: a short remark about trusting customers, shown in a speech bubble.

0fdeb91e468e8049.name: show_cedric_work_unfinished
0fdeb91e468e8049.doc: Event program that makes Max say he has not finished the work Cedric asked him to do.

0fea9b8083060d04.name: start_bgm_unless_shingala_fight
0fea9b8083060d04.doc: Loads sounds. Starts bgm 167 unless flags 408 and 420 and the electric fish state indicate the Shingala fight.

100b94b07c7c4156.name: play_missed_alarm_and_go_to_palm_brinks
100b94b07c7c4156.doc: Plays the missed alarm scene and jumps to map m08 at program 151, Palm Brinks.

1015c911f96d9f25.name: show_item_count_message
1015c911f96d9f25.doc: Shows the 'you got N of the item' line for a pickup. Picks the message variant from kind (0 or 1), whether value is 1 and whether count is 1 or more, and fills the value, item and count slots. Returns 1 when shown, 0 for a zero count or unknown kind.

1027c268013a8d00.name: load_d02b02_after_event_256
1027c268013a8d00.doc: When the event check type is 1, plays event 256, unpauses the event and loads dungeon map d02b02 with event script 500. A disabled branch for a To be continue screen is left in.

10303983967c3b87.name: ride_elevator_two
10303983967c3b87.doc: Elevator at (-2553.7, 3882.6): asks the floor, then places the player on the chosen floor (heights 0, 1160 or 2320) with the elevator sound. Arriving on the second floor can trigger event 508.

10338eeb2480ef61.name: play_party_looks_up_at_ship_shot
10338eeb2480ef61.doc: Night shot (time 24:00) in which Max, Monica and Pau stand on the shore looking up. The battleship map part is hidden, the camera holds for 60 frames and then pans and orbits for 210 frames, and the battleship is shown again at the end.

104acb430bc2c9cc.name: play_board_train_car_scene
104acb430bc2c9cc.doc: Cutscene of boarding a train car at a station. It positions the world frame by the station map and train id, swings the car doors, runs Max into the car and sets the footstep sound for the floor type.

1054f50a4c1b9a49.name: play_alexandra_farewell_then_enter_d06b01
1054f50a4c1b9a49.doc: Plays Alexandra's farewell scene, then loads map d06b01 and starts event 510.

1057b24eb0b9eed7.name: play_floor_intro_scene
1057b24eb0b9eed7.doc: Opening cutscene of a floor: shows the dungeon logo, the party leader runs in while the d04w10 wall pieces rotate half a turn and a door piece lifts and lowers, then everything is reset and control returns. Skippable.

106513fc35b0d558.name: play_blackstone_departure_then_dungeon
106513fc35b0d558.doc: Hides the villager in slot 2, plays the departure scene and starts the dungeon.

106f556c57853109.name: play_cedric_house_scene
106f556c57853109.doc: Fades out, plays the house scene that sets flag 105, brings Cedric back, places the player and Cedric facing each other and starts the i01h01 event script.

107054ab5041b40a.name: setup_pau_and_shingala_characters
107054ab5041b40a.doc: Map start. Places Pau once flag 500 or 408 is set, and Shingala sitting nearby while flag 420 is set and 444 is not (eyes closed until flag 438). Hides the event_400 point and two map pieces otherwise. Returns 0.

107557fe64f94fd6.name: talk_to_cedric
107557fe64f94fd6.doc: Runs the talk with the seated NPC about the vacuum job.

1084026cd53d1d02.name: play_help_receiver_intro_scene
1084026cd53d1d02.doc: First-visit scene of the first dungeon floor (event e100). The map piece rises, Max runs in, looks around, and a voice over the Help Receiver explains the dungeon and the Help menu, with two picture slides. The scene can be skipped.

10be11f769c269b1.name: restart_second_gaspard_fight
10be11f769c269b1.doc: Restarts the second fight: plays BGM 35 and places monster 511.

10c3d54da54b3d38.name: talk_mina_early
10c3d54da54b3d38.doc: Mina's early conversation: she says she has felt unwell and the doctor found nothing wrong. Two speech bubbles, no choices; ends the event.

10cfaffff3bd1612.name: load_event_205_actors
10cfaffff3bd1612.doc: Loads Cedric, Vorneo and Tom for event 205 together with its message file.

10d3a27ccb165ba5.name: talk_to_seated_stargazer_trigger
10d3a27ccb165ba5.doc: Talk trigger 1: with the ticket, the seated NPC admires the stars; without it, sets flag 2 and asks about the red-headed kid.

10d7742e4edf891a.name: play_elephant_falls_after_boss
10d7742e4edf891a.doc: After the boss is defeated: sets flag 7, switches to Max, hides the floor objects, pauses monsters, plays the elephant falls scene and clears monsters.

10eaffdc1320fc96.name: setup_station_arrival
10eaffdc1320fc96.doc: Sets up the station, places the player and fades in.

10f148ba56c26629.name: play_other_victory
10f148ba56c26629.doc: Victory finish scene for active characters 2 and 3: stops BGM and sound effects, plays a finish banner sprite (language-specific image) that scales in while the camera follows the character, then returns control and crossfades back.

10f84f9f8ce403de.name: play_opening_cutscene_with_music
10f84f9f8ce403de.doc: Stops sound, starts BGM 103, locks map movement and the minimap, and plays the opening cutscene play_opening_elephant_ball_scene.

10fdda818b2edd4e.name: warp_to_d06b01_event_716
10fdda818b2edd4e.doc: Clears the scene and starts event 716 on map d06b01.

11070c7ef43fbc84.name: enter_dungeon_from_menu
11070c7ef43fbc84.doc: Starts the dungeon BGM, opens the dungeon map menu to pick a floor and starts it.

11175a6c2a0013f4.name: pause_monsters_and_fade_in
11175a6c2a0013f4.doc: Pauses monster AI and drawing, runs play_ridepod_steve_debut_scene and fades in.

111bbe3cb67f1b94.name: ask_seated_stargazer_about_kid
111bbe3cb67f1b94.doc: Talks to the seated NPC (slot 9) while the player has no ticket, asking whether a red-headed kid came by; the reply is that he ran toward City Hall. Talking from behind gives a rude-to-do-so remark and returns 0.

111bf27d5013a0d7.name: setup_monster_603_room
111bf27d5013a0d7.doc: Sets flag 728, loads and places monster 603, places the player facing it, sets the camera and fades in.

112b24d941324ed6.name: get_analyze_406
112b24d941324ed6.doc: Returns the analysis flag for analysis entry 406.

112ea7f0583c9138.name: talk_ferdinand_early
112ea7f0583c9138.doc: Ferdinand's talk before the first quest is cleared: he compares his cooking research to Max's machine discoveries.

11310e56a92973f8.name: play_boss_stab_scene
11310e56a92973f8.doc: Event 728 part one. A character stabs with a thud and cries out, the camera pulls up, and the scene fades to white. Used by story 728 and by the boss defeat sequence.

114a8f6b9d6a7566.name: place_six_town_characters
114a8f6b9d6a7566.doc: Places the six town NPC actors at fixed positions.

1152eb793828686d.name: play_griffon_speech_scene
1152eb793828686d.doc: Event 610, sets flag 610 (title card Griffon's side of the story): mid fight Griffon says humans spread suffering and should be wiped out.

1156f66a1e744977.name: play_drop_in_floor_intro
1156f66a1e744977.doc: Intro for the lower floors. The character jumps down from above and lands while either the dungeon title logo (show_map 0) or the floor map (show_map 1) fades, then the Red, Blue or White Seal notices are shown if the floor has one.

1168bf5b6fc6ee1b.name: spin_random_coin
1168bf5b6fc6ee1b.doc: Runs the random coin ring event in a dungeon: a coin appears over the ring and spins until the player presses the button (or about 10 seconds pass), then slows and lands face up or down. Face 0 gives good outcomes (weapon experience items, a Repair Powder chest), face 1 bad ones, each with its message and a brightness fade. If the active character is 2 or 3 it only shows a message and moves the player next to the ring.

11c65fd7bf07183d.name: ask_yes_no_with_system_message
11c65fd7bf07183d.doc: Shows a yes/no question built from system message 70 + message_base with the given argument substituted. Returns the answer.

11d5838f635b11f5.name: warp_to_boss_floor_after_story_532
11d5838f635b11f5.doc: Story 532 program: warps to boss floor d05b01 and runs its story_532 program (15320 = 532*10+10000).

11e8df88a17043b7.name: debug_play_victory_speech
11e8df88a17043b7.doc: Debug entry that sets midnight, freezes time and plays the victory speech scene.

11f39585917d7655.name: remove_defeat_scene_actors
11f39585917d7655.doc: Deletes the extra scene characters and the unused party member copy for the active character, and shows the handles and status bar again.

11fe163a89e491fd.name: play_refuse_motion
11fe163a89e491fd.doc: Plays the no-no head-shake for the active character: loads the miss motion pack for Max or Monica, turns toward the camera over 6 frames, plays the shake and turns back. Does nothing for characters 2 and 3 (returns 0).

12017890f4485e7e.name: play_victory_crowd_cheering_scene
12017890f4485e7e.doc: Event 824 variant with a crowd of forty cheering villagers built from the opening models. Sets flag 824.

1204457a26880efc.name: enter_d03_dungeon
1204457a26880efc.doc: If the player agrees at the exit, advances the floor info and loads the d03 dungeon script.

1209dcad4d6c097e.name: start_trentos_battle
1209dcad4d6c097e.doc: Program boss_trentos: loads Trentos (monster 609) and Kortlenn (610), places Trentos 800 units back, pauses the battle music, starts BGM 190 and fades in.

1212cd7b06440554.name: delete_train_car_npcs
1212cd7b06440554.doc: Deletes the 12 train-car NPC characters and villagers in slots 8 to 19, one per frame.

121ded541947db64.name: choose_floor_from_map_menu
121ded541947db64.doc: Plays the dungeon music and opens the floor map menu, then starts the floor chosen from it.

121e6f6868281076.name: play_luna_lab_advice_scene
121e6f6868281076.doc: Scene where Crest explains that Atlamillia can only travel 100 years, so they need the Luna Lab on the Veniccio Coast, which has vanished. The heroes say goodbye and run off, and a final voice asks someone to look after them.

122bb34537a3fa26.name: play_chase_then_opening_movie
122bb34537a3fa26.doc: Plays the opening part 5 chase, then the OPEN1 movie with Max's captions about that night starting his adventure, and jumps to d01e01 (Channel Entrance) at event 151.

124aadbd3482891d.name: play_farewell_after_boss_fight
124aadbd3482891d.doc: Boss defeated: clears monsters, marks the floor as cleared, plays the farewell scene, takes the Shell Talkie and goes to the Veniccio edit mode.

124b2f5fe3f952a6.name: enter_house_i01h01_after_losing
124b2f5fe3f952a6.doc: Fades out, places the player and camera and goes inside house i01h01 at entrance 510. Debug text says the player lost to the elephant.

1262ef4acc7dc125.name: reset_swamp_story
1262ef4acc7dc125.doc: Resets the story counter and flags 215, 220, 230 and 235 and removes the Fishing Rod, to replay the swamp events.

126cfa82d20c0ccd.name: play_palace_falls_toward_palm_brinks_scene
126cfa82d20c0ccd.doc: Sets flag 640. After the cannon hit, the Moonflower Palace is seen falling toward Palm Brinks while Max and Monica cheer and then panic.

126db062cc31bd38.name: talk_to_party_npc_menu
126db062cc31bd38.doc: Close-up talk menu for a train NPC: option 0 joins the party, option 1 is a chat, and further options open the NPC's shop or repair the party's weapons, depending on the NPC. Returns 1 if the menu was used or the NPC is already in the party.

126f4275a7401a56.name: play_slope_charge_and_jump_to_f30
126f4275a7401a56.doc: Plays the golem slope charge and jumps to map f30 at entry 602.

127dca18361116be.name: warp_to_d06b01_event_511
127dca18361116be.doc: Event 520 handler: plays the Alexandra lament scene, then loads dungeon map d06b01 and runs its event script 511.

129af2cd5514f6ae.name: play_lipsync_until_voice_ends
129af2cd5514f6ae.doc: Runs the lip sync for the voice stream with a frame limit and no early window close.

129eec259557cc1d.name: talk_to_man_saying_circus_started
129eec259557cc1d.doc: A townsman says the circus has already started.

129f037d870e72a3.name: enable_rapis_point_play_bgm
129f037d870e72a3.doc: Clears the monsters, enables the rapis function point and starts BGM 193.

12a8b4d95d10dd5b.name: play_colossus_mode_and_go_to_s32
12a8b4d95d10dd5b.doc: Plays the Colossus Mode scene and jumps to map s32 at event 630.

12e094e0c7fb2579.name: spawn_chest_mimic
12e094e0c7fb2579.doc: Plays the scene of a treasure chest turning out to be a monster. Pauses monster AI and pickups, shows the chest closing and opening, then removes it and places the given monster at the chest's spot at the given level.

130469488acfd020.name: unload_event_254_charas
130469488acfd020.doc: Cleans up the event 254 scene: reactivates whichever of Max or Monica is the active character, deactivates and deletes the other's scene model, motions and helper models, and rebinds handles 2 and 3 to charas 1 and 2.

1308bb04c1b539a4.name: has_pending_event
1308bb04c1b539a4.doc: Returns 1 when any of events 548, 552, 556 or 560 can currently play in the third town, else 0.

131462ee54413ec3.name: start_village_event
131462ee54413ec3.doc: Entry of the village map. After loading a save, only places the player. Otherwise picks the arrival scene, the Gaspard marionette scene with the monster fight, or the walk-in scene from flags 400, 432, 436, 438, 444 and the count of item 373.

131f03b39ffc13ef.name: play_max_scores_spheda_scene
131f03b39ffc13ef.doc: Event 316. Max sinks the shot and Monica praises him. Sets flag 316.

131f59e93039fc9c.name: talk_bruno_joined
131f59e93039fc9c.doc: Bruno's talk after he has joined the party; calls talk_bruno_idle with joined set.

133f13f0640de675.name: play_ending_movie_and_save_chapter_8_start
133f13f0640de675.doc: Plays the letter scene (event 736) and the ending movie END1.PSS, shows a title picture, then sets up the chapter 8 start state (Max alone, flag 736 set, time 6:00) and opens the save menu for the chapter 8 start file before exiting.

1382e0cefc4bf04e.name: talk_fabio_early
1382e0cefc4bf04e.doc: Fabio's talk before the first quest is cleared: fishing is his hobby and he dreams of catching a Mardan Karayan.

13a268b25508e2a2.name: play_dr_nobb_meeting_scene
13a268b25508e2a2.doc: Debug test program; it only plays event 428, in which Dr. Nobb introduces himself as head researcher and talks about the Shigura translation device.

13ae0858fabce34c.name: play_shot_walk_in
13ae0858fabce34c.doc: Voiced shot where the first character walks in and stops while the second looks up. Temporarily changes the projection.

13b44f9519c06f33.name: play_room_music
13b44f9519c06f33.doc: Loads sound set 8694 and plays battle music 190 while either of counter 17 bits 1 and 2 is unset, otherwise the calm track 193.

13c6a00cff868040.name: talk_parn_joined_in_studio
13c6a00cff868040.doc: Parn's talk in his studio after he has joined: outside chapter 8 Monica hears that girls cannot understand a man chasing his ideals and Max is offered his painting ability; in chapter 8 he muses on how deep painting is. Then talk_to_npc.

13c6fbf9385d2351.name: print_map_numbers
13c6fbf9385d2351.doc: Prints the current map and submap numbers for debugging.

13d2e81b6defbee3.name: talk_fabio_after_joining
13d2e81b6defbee3.doc: Fabio's chatter after the fish quest is cleared, asking for fishing tips. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about new fishing spots.

13d76f2f03873ea6.name: start_monster_68_fight
13d76f2f03873ea6.doc: Starts music 190, places monster 68 at the origin and the player at (0, 0, -100) and fades in.

13dd6fe4b49b2271.name: talk_rufio_early
13dd6fe4b49b2271.doc: Rufio's talk before the first quest is cleared: he wonders why he misses the moon and whether he came from there.

14008357e555f9e4.name: open_save_menu_keep_bgm
14008357e555f9e4.doc: Opens the save menu with a fade (open_save_menu_with_fade) while the skip-load-BGM save value is set, so the train music is not reloaded, then clears the value.

140ef692c2d71cbe.name: show_wall_picture
140ef692c2d71cbe.doc: Shows one of eight full-screen wall pictures (heki401 to heki408) until the confirm button is pressed.

14155b577d38f741.name: show_item_kind_message
14155b577d38f741.doc: Shows the item pickup line for kind 1, 2 or 3 with the item name and count, choosing a single or plural message. Returns 1 when shown, 0 for a count of zero or other kinds.

14174328fcbfb6f4.name: play_story_102_then_enter_dungeon
14174328fcbfb6f4.doc: Story entry for event 102: plays the mother crying memory scene, fades to white and goes to dungeon 0.

141a2c7f975f67cb.name: pick_poison_apples
141a2c7f975f67cb.doc: Gives 4 Poison Apples (item 291) if the player has none, then refreshes the story points.

143d2dd2cd7125a5.name: leave_for_s44_map
143d2dd2cd7125a5.doc: Fades out music and screen over 20 frames, clears monsters, switches Steve back to Max or Monica's monster form back to Monica, plays the boss defeat scene (flag 728) and loads map s44 at event 510.

1449fa51419c8843.name: play_paznos_launch_scene
1449fa51419c8843.doc: Skippable scene of Paznos launching: the four launch arms fire, the two jets glow and the camera shakes more and more before fading out. Sets flag 540.

149eb8abfe03c044.name: play_max_meets_galen_scene
149eb8abfe03c044.doc: Plays event 524, in which Max meets Galen Agaris, who recognises Max's mother's eyes.

14acfeb665ec3d4a.name: talk_to_tournament_npc
14acfeb665ec3d4a.doc: Talking to the judge in slot 8 starts the weigh-in; talking to any other villager shows their fishing chat.

14b56f081069d84d.name: start_map_and_count_floor_visit
14b56f081069d84d.doc: Map start program: counts a visit to stage 1 floor 6, shows story points, and places the player (from a save, or by flag 215). Plays event 215 once when flag 209 is set and 215 is not.

14f0257235d5c0f6.name: run_villager_talk_menu
14f0257235d5c0f6.doc: Faces the player and villager, frames the camera and shows the talk menu for the villager. Options include taking them along as the party partner, opening their shop, repair (Cedric), photo scoops (Donny), the monster book (Sheriff Blinkhorn), and a partner hint (Pau).

151a742b20b99b1e.name: play_spheda_shot
151a742b20b99b1e.doc: One Spheda golf shot. Aims, runs the power gauge, then simulates the ball frame by frame with gravity, bounces, water and pin attraction. A hole in one or pin hit spawns a prize chest and the cup-in pose, a ball out shows the no-no pose, and otherwise the player may continue from the nearest spot. Uses a stroke each time through consume_stroke.

153601190e7ed513.name: load_noam_scene_actors
153601190e7ed513.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Noam with his wine, a fishing rod, the item get model and the e220 message file.

153bd52b3ebc5441.name: interact_with_gate_2
153bd52b3ebc5441.doc: Handles the third of the four gates.

1544a3d2082f261a.name: setup_event_230_actors
1544a3d2082f261a.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Master Utan and four poison apples as scene actors for event 230 and its message file. Sets globals max_chara_slot and partner_chara_slot.

15454dd4344c99f4.name: talk_to_npc_and_depart_if_ready
15454dd4344c99f4.doc: Talks to the NPC, and if Cedric asks to leave, plays the departure scene and the train departure, opens the world move menu and jumps to map s10 (Heim Rada Stop).

154b0a0e6597dd39.name: play_train_arrival
154b0a0e6597dd39.doc: Skippable train arrival scene. Hides the station villagers, the smoking train glides into the station, the platform slope parts tilt, a door sounds and the player steps off and walks along the platform. Afterwards it ensures the slope is tilted, places the player on the platform, shows the villagers and fades in.

1554d96637a0f743.name: play_receiver_call_cutscene
1554d96637a0f743.doc: Max comes to his senses after a white flash and takes out a receiver. A caller asks how he is doing and he says he reached the next floor. The caller warns of stronger monsters, explains that weapons need strengthening, says to pick Help on the Main Menu to learn about combat, then he puts the receiver away.

156b4592f7609c8d.name: play_story_516_scene
156b4592f7609c8d.doc: Story 516: plays the battleship attack scene.

157fe127ad0f1883.name: enter_lab_one
157fe127ad0f1883.doc: Enters Lab 1 (f03i0301), keeping the loaded music in one story state.

158eefca068edbc8.name: warp_to_s43_event_8001
158eefca068edbc8.doc: Clears the scene and loads map s43 at event 8001.

15a60e8cd102abda.name: play_ixion_time_leap_shake_scene
15a60e8cd102abda.doc: The Ixion shakes and the screen waves as Max and Monica cry out during the time leap. Sets flag 600.

15b54beef44ff731.name: warp_to_s19_event_420
15b54beef44ff731.doc: Clears the scene and starts event 420 on map s19.

15b912fcec2252f3.name: leave_for_edit_mode_75
15b912fcec2252f3.doc: Fades out, clears monsters, deletes the electric fish and enters edit mode 75 at the map start.

15bfffdb945091ea.name: play_donny_gives_gun_scene
