15bfffdb945091ea.doc: Scene where Max says he is leaving town, Donny hands him the Classic Gun and the Help Receiver and sees him off down the ladder to the channel. Shows both item get messages and a gun tutorial.

15cd90234a176390.name: ask_blinkhorn_race_start
15cd90234a176390.doc: Asks the player whether to start Blinkhorn's race, with the first choice agreeing. Declining shows the wait-for-you reply, sets counter 7 to 0 and returns 0. Accepting shows the start call, starts the on-screen stopwatch and sets counter 7 to 1.

15e9053e9a49e428.name: play_ixion_briefing_only
15e9053e9a49e428.doc: Only plays the Ixion briefing scene.

15f4b8a7f2d8463d.name: update_train_event_point
15f4b8a7f2d8463d.doc: Enables the train event point until flag 202 is set; afterwards disables it and hides the train.

160597eea219594e.name: place_player_in_room
160597eea219594e.doc: Program 201: enables the exit, sets the room for the story flags, places the player at a fixed spot inside it with the camera set and fades in.

16074ef66afa7c94.name: run_message_timed
16074ef66afa7c94.doc: Runs a voiced message with lip sync until the player closes it or max_frames pass, then resets lip sync and closes the window. Returns the frames used.

1614958c0fbf4f17.name: play_launch_camera_shake_scene
1614958c0fbf4f17.doc: Sets flag 540. The Horn King stands as the camera sweeps around him and shakes for 120 frames, then cuts to black. Skippable.

16162361db6554bf.name: play_shot_party_jumps_across_gap
16162361db6554bf.doc: Scene shot: the party jumps to a lower ledge with the camera tracking, then dust effects burst on landing.

1618ed1a0ac4e436.name: play_circus_opening_scenes
1618ed1a0ac4e436.doc: Program 151: plays both circus show scenes, then loads event script i03h02/i03h02_2.stb as program 151.

161f80032b0e91a8.name: talk_parn_joined_in_studio
161f80032b0e91a8.doc: Parn's talk in his studio after he has joined: outside chapter 8 Monica hears that girls cannot understand a man chasing his ideals and Max is offered his painting ability; in chapter 8 he muses on how deep painting is. Then talk_to_npc.

16380754c7411fe3.name: play_train_arrives_by_door_side
16380754c7411fe3.doc: Like the train arrival scene but chosen from counters 0, 15 and the platform side: binds the train's door parts for the side Max uses, then Max runs from the door onto the platform. With counter 0 it just places the player.

164e829f3a82533d.name: play_underground_channel_narration_and_enter_dungeon
164e829f3a82533d.doc: Story 102: stops the music, plays Max's narration about the Underground Channel and his mother, then fades to white and enters the dungeon.

165c7831c93177ee.name: setup_battleship_fight
165c7831c93177ee.doc: Program 600: starts music 32, shows the battleship map part, places the player and loads and places one boss (monster 517), two of 518 and eight of 519.

165eaefe3732464b.name: warp_to_d06b01_event_728
165eaefe3732464b.doc: Clears the scene and starts event 728 on map d06b01.

165fce06c3d77adb.name: play_metal_flotsam_intro_scene
165fce06c3d77adb.doc: Event 808. Max and Monica hear Flotsam's laugh and he flies in as Metal Flotsam, saying he has a new boss who is worse than Griffon. A title telop appears and the scene ends. Sets flag 808.

16650c3e81dfd5cb.name: play_crest_becomes_star_scene
16650c3e81dfd5cb.doc: Event 372 ending: Max and Monica run along a path, Monica says Crest became a star watching over Lin, and the camera follows the run to a shooting star.

166e27b800ec298e.name: play_event_256
166e27b800ec298e.doc: Event 256 in Lafrescia's room: the two characters reach out to touch something while talking, then it reacts and the scene fades out. Sets the seen flag first and swaps the player to Max or Monica if another character is active.

16740a384f869ec2.name: enter_s38_through_door
16740a384f869ec2.doc: Event 202: plays the door sound, fades out, sets counter 0 to 1, moves the player to the door spot and jumps to map s38.

1675942ad46cf9ff.name: play_npc_talk_with_camera
1675942ad46cf9ff.doc: Puts the player in front of the NPC, shows the message between them, then ends the event with a crossfade.

16781fb99a569dd5.name: talk_fabio_early
16781fb99a569dd5.doc: Fabio's talk before he can be recruited: a short speech about fishing and his dream of catching a huge fish, then talk_to_npc.

1695ca01c4613ddb.name: give_adel_clothing_materials
1695ca01c4613ddb.doc: Quest 7: Adel asks for Sturdy Cloth, Thick Hide and a Copper Lump. If you have all three and agree, it takes them, sets counter 8 to 2 and she leaves to make clothes.

1699e66a2bc71dae.name: play_bridge_report_scene
1699e66a2bc71dae.doc: Scene for event 448: Max and Monica run to the workers, who say the bridge was repaired long ago, and Max proposes heading for Mt. Gundor. Skippable; ends by placing the player at the station.

169dc8de51c9e96e.name: get_club_stats
169dc8de51c9e96e.doc: Looks up the equipped club (equipment slot 0 of character 0) and writes its Spheda power, spin and safe level into the three arrays.

16a47a8ced78e1ff.name: talk_generic_villager
16a47a8ced78e1ff.doc: Default talk handler for town villagers. Shop NPCs 1012, 1015 and 1018 open a shop, NPC 50 refuses passage, and in chapter 1 NPCs 2, 63 and 65 talk about the train (depends on whether it is running); in chapter 8 NPCs 61 and 80 talk about Monica (depends on her return flag). Anyone else shows a greeting plus the message-table line for the villager, with the Monica variant when Monica is active.

16ce8abe3eae823d.name: play_sky_walkway_transition_scene
16ce8abe3eae823d.doc: Cutscene of the character running between the ground area and the high walkway at height 3200, fading out and back in while the sound set, lighting and music volume change.

170012bc7c12043e.name: play_opening_then_go_to_m06
170012bc7c12043e.doc: Plays the opening scene, cleans up and jumps to map m06 at event 153.

17194a49de353881.name: play_story_scene_then_enter_d04
17194a49de353881.doc: Plays story scene 520, then loads dungeon d04f02 and starts its event 500. In s45 the scene is the Finny Frenzy announcement, in s46 it is Eina's bedtime story.

17295c61a83445ae.name: move_to_paznos_bridge_from_pad_2
17295c61a83445ae.doc: Sets counter 13 to 2 and asks to move to Paznos Bridge.

1735e90bbff9f2d5.name: ask_to_use_starglass_spot
1735e90bbff9f2d5.doc: Shows a message that going back to the past from here should save Crest; returns 1 if the player opens the menu.

173c1d2948ef0fdf.name: exit_to_f03_map
173c1d2948ef0fdf.doc: Turns the player to face away, plays a door sound, fades out and jumps to map f03.

1745f6c0dc3cebb4.name: handle_locked_chest
1745f6c0dc3cebb4.doc: Asks what to do with a locked chest: have Donny open it (or use the Treasure Chest Key, item 297), force it, or give up. Opening clears the lock bit of chest_type. Forcing applies the chest trap by type bit: 8 poisons the active character and takes 70 percent HP, 16 blows the chest up, 32 breaks both weapons. Returns 1 when cancelled or the chest was destroyed, 0 when it can be opened.

174a50109f3f34db.name: press_panel_1_0
174a50109f3f34db.doc: Candle puzzle step for the church candle at row 1, column 0: cuts to a fixed camera, waits 45 frames, toggles that candle and its four neighbours (i01h07_13 pieces), then waits 45 frames.

174bd646b4243d77.name: choose_dungeon_floor_from_tree_map
174bd646b4243d77.doc: Opens the stage 0 dungeon tree map. Choosing 0 jumps to map d01e01, 8 walks the player forward, any other floor starts the dungeon there.

174dfa913ffc6f16.name: show_cedric_demands_truth
174dfa913ffc6f16.doc: Cedric asks what Need is hiding, bangs the desk and demands to be told everything.

1756bb26930cacae.name: close_message_window
1756bb26930cacae.doc: Closes a message window: hides its cursor, closes it and clears its slot.

17701b637efa30a0.name: play_nobb_shell_talkie_scene
17701b637efa30a0.doc: Plays event 428, the meeting with Dr. Nobb.

177116990d0d83c3.name: place_opening_characters
177116990d0d83c3.doc: Activates and places the opening characters in slots 8 to 18 (Pierrot with his blade frames hidden, the townsfolk and the balloon). When both bystander flags are set and the circus ticket is owned, it hides two frames of the balloon model (himonet and f2--A01C0S1).

1774e61832ac7b6e.name: show_butterfly_split_hint
1774e61832ac7b6e.doc: Shows a hint box that the Rainbow Butterfly has split into seven butterflies that can be taken one by one. Pauses monster AI and player steps while it shows.

1790c813d8e1d009.name: play_opening_pierrot_scene
1790c813d8e1d009.doc: Opening scene: Max looks over a ledge and finds the Pierrots with Polcurse and Need arguing, using many motions and animation changes. Loads the opening/p3 characters and sound bank 1215.

17a4f8a62d835434.name: talk_adel_to_monica
17a4f8a62d835434.doc: Adel's two-part talk to Monica asking her to stop putting Max in danger, with a short prayer for their safety in chapter 8.

17d01e144b22604d.name: test_medusas_tear_use
17d01e144b22604d.doc: Debug event: opens the use-item menu for Medusa's Tear (278) and only prints whether it, another item or nothing was chosen.

17d723fddcba4017.name: play_floor_entrance_scene
17d723fddcba4017.doc: Short scene at the floor entrance: map pieces s19_09 and s19_10 move, the player walks in and control is returned at (-75, -10, 950).

17d7458406d54370.name: enter_dungeon_d06_if_confirmed
17d7458406d54370.doc: If the player confirms, restores the party, weapon drawing and map movement, and loads the d06 dungeon script.

17db339aa03ec13c.name: play_starglass_idea_scene
17db339aa03ec13c.doc: Story event 368. After seeing a Star Items shop, the party talks about using a Starglass to go back into Lin's memory to the time she and Crest were attacked, and decides to find one first. Sets flag 368.

17e0b2b06d0031e9.name: debug_play_lapis_garter_intro
17e0b2b06d0031e9.doc: Debug entry that plays the Lapis Garter intro.

183996ac3fe2b7e4.name: play_geostone_lesson_scene
183996ac3fe2b7e4.doc: An elder explains Geostones, analysis, polin limits and the Help Receiver, then runs the Geostone download in the reactor.

18460055a891d8a2.name: is_swing_clear
18460055a891d8a2.doc: Spheda golf swing check at x, y, z sweeping from start_angle to end_angle (radians): casts lines from the ball to both ends of the swing arc and across it. Returns -1 when a wall is between the ball and either end, 0 when the swing arc is blocked or has no floor under its ends, 1 when it is clear.

18488d48e236cfed.name: play_event_255_light
18488d48e236cfed.doc: Cutscene in the Lafrescia room: Max throws a seed into the water, a light flashes and dazzles both, they tumble, then see the giant flower. Sets the event 255 seen flag, turns on the event 256 point, dims the lighting and ends with the player placed near the entrance.

184ef88cd21498e2.name: play_flythrough_from_debug
184ef88cd21498e2.doc: Debug entry that plays the camera flythrough.

1854a7fa3af2c86a.name: play_slow_camera_pan_scene
1854a7fa3af2c86a.doc: Hides the player, sets noon, and pans the camera slowly for 700 frames, then holds 300 more frames.

1879c8a31a6e1e12.name: play_taxi_ride_scene
1879c8a31a6e1e12.doc: Taxi ride cutscene: a taxi model drives along a camera path with 19 trailing smoke actors, then the scene waits for a button press and cleans up.

188e634c046040a4.name: play_narration_line
188e634c046040a4.doc: Plays a narration voice clip with its subtitle and waits until it finishes.

18910de0866bfbbe.name: show_debug_test_message
18910de0866bfbbe.doc: Debug test program: shows the placeholder message "oshare" (stylish) and waits for it to be dismissed.

1893e69d49d0052c.name: open_star_barrier
1893e69d49d0052c.doc: Handler for the star barrier point: runs the star barrier interaction.

189b3ff2eca1ded0.name: play_train_departure
189b3ff2eca1ded0.doc: Cutscene of the train leaving the station: fades out, shows the train driving off along the track with the scene skippable, then fades out and returns control.

18abc575cd98c127.name: use_time_bomb_on_firesquall
18abc575cd98c127.doc: Interaction with the Fire Squall. Offers the item menu for the Time Bomb (372); using it plays the destruction scene, locks the party to Max, and starts the battleship fight with monsters 517, 518 and 519. Companions just comment.

18b1abfff6d36026.name: play_floor_arrival_scene
18b1abfff6d36026.doc: Cutscene when a floor begins: the active character walks along a log and jumps down to the floor, optionally with the dungeon map piece moving in. Then explains any seal on the floor: Red Seal (Max cannot be switched to), Blue Seal (Monica cannot be switched to) or White Seal (no more recovery).

18b553ee8f8d865a.name: play_event_540_rise
18b553ee8f8d865a.doc: Event 540 on f04: sets the golem army march seen flag, then the scenery part and two jet-model characters rise 9000 units into the sky over 160 frames while the camera shakes, with a fade in and a fade out. The scene can be skipped.

18bcf66db1e49e34.name: unload_event_616_charas
18bcf66db1e49e34.doc: Removes the event 616 scene characters (Osmond), leaving only the active character, and ends the event.

18c47e67ea728f52.name: talk_to_parn_or_town_npc
18c47e67ea728f52.doc: Talking to Parn runs his quest conversation with the camera control stopped. Anyone else gets the standard town NPC talk.

18c7eb3f902376f2.name: play_griffon_confrontation_scene
18c7eb3f902376f2.doc: Event 716 (sets flag 716). Max and Monica walk up to Griffon in the palace; he says he has been waiting, boasts that they cannot conquer him and spreads his arms to show his true power, with a title card.

18d6ffa74e9c49ca.name: start_castle_battle
18d6ffa74e9c49ca.doc: Plays event 50, places four monsters of kind 523, shows the control hints (O attack, R1 block, X lock on, L1+O magic) and starts the fight.

18decf171145871c.name: talk_parn_early
18decf171145871c.doc: Parn's early talk. Monica (active character 1) gets a greeting where he gives his name and says he is a magic painter, then the event ends. Anyone else gets a different greeting and the normal talk handler runs.

18ecf3956031e743.name: start_sea_dragon_fight
18ecf3956031e743.doc: Sets both characters to 160 max HP and 50 defence, tops item 270 up to 20, equips a stronger fixed loadout, then starts the sea dragon boss event on map s15.

18ffcb6db8fe7bac.name: start_spheda_debug_floor
18ffcb6db8fe7bac.doc: Debug entry that loads floor d03f01 at dusk, sets up Spheda, and on Yes places the player at a point near the ball that avoids the pin and treasure boxes.

1904f2b54b324389.name: on_map_start
1904f2b54b324389.doc: On map start, plays the Rococo house scene if flag 207 is set and flag 208 is not yet.

1917b10a1c600648.name: play_palace_fall_then_enter_bridge
1917b10a1c600648.doc: Plays the palace falling scene and jumps to s30 at entry 640.

191fb6a1507bd3c1.name: replay_lava_parting_scene
191fb6a1507bd3c1.doc: Stops the music and plays the lava parting scene.

1926d52213c5785d.name: play_event_50
1926d52213c5785d.doc: Cutscene at the Gaspard time gate: Monica runs through the castle with soldiers behind her, hears monsters are in her father's room, runs on, and is attacked by monsters that crash through a window. Ends in a fade out.

19294f3e0c45b26b.name: show_voiced_message
19294f3e0c45b26b.doc: Shows the message, starts stream 1 once ready and waits for the player to dismiss it.

1933b7cd3c0871e4.name: talk_with_talk_camera
1933b7cd3c0871e4.doc: Plays an automatic NPC talk with the talk camera. Positions the player facing the NPC, crossfades in, shows message mes_no, returns the NPC to standing and crossfades out.

193fb01ac97d32b3.name: is_town_4_complete_scene_pending
193fb01ac97d32b3.doc: Returns 1 if town 4 is 100 percent complete and flag 748 is not set.

1941e65ae81062be.name: play_opening_part_5
1941e65ae81062be.doc: Opening scene part 5 in town: Max is chased along the street and up a pole to a rooftop by Pierrot's clown robots, with voiced lines, music changes and a fall off the roof, then drops down a manhole and leaves the town view. Loads its own models and sounds and cleans them up at the end; skippable.

1943b3e99318cf58.name: exit_to_f03_entrance_2
1943b3e99318cf58.doc: Turns and fades out, sets counter 2 to 2 and jumps to map f03.

195915cf18ba31e9.name: place_two_crew_members
195915cf18ba31e9.doc: Loads and places two crew members and cuts the camera to them.

19595122a875f122.name: show_board_train_thought
19595122a875f122.doc: Shows a thought bubble: that Max must hurry back to Packer, or whether riding without asking would get him told off.

1967203b38f500df.name: play_max_victory
1967203b38f500df.doc: Victory cutscene for Max in the golf-hole minigame: plays the victory pose with the win sound, orbits the camera around him, shows the finish banner sprite (a different image for the Japanese and other languages) and slides it into the corner, then restores music and ends the event. The scene can be skipped.

1969081b3467ed9b.name: run_out_of_floor
1969081b3467ed9b.doc: Floor-exit scene: the player is placed at the exit part facing the opposite way, runs 155 units out of the floor, stands, then the screen fades out.

196b3bb7a4316870.name: play_griffon_second_phase_scene
196b3bb7a4316870.doc: Event 720 (sets flag 720). Griffon lands and grabs, spreads his wings, and the heroes react; leads into the second phase of the boss fight.

1978d7e11aa7b160.name: spawn_villager
1978d7e11aa7b160.doc: Loads the model pack for the villager number into the slot (several villager numbers share a model), places it at the position and yaw, registers it as a villager and activates it.

198f64cd50080c13.name: talk_rufio_after_joining
198f64cd50080c13.doc: Rufio's chatter after the moon photo quest is cleared, thanking the player. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about the Blackstone Railroad.

1997ab5164b6dce5.name: start_gaspard_encounter_story_event
1997ab5164b6dce5.doc: Story event 528: plays the Gaspard encounter scene.

19ab86be60644483.name: play_frenzy_announcement_then_enter_d04
19ab86be60644483.doc: Plays the Finny Frenzy announcement, loads the d04f02 floor and starts d04 at entry 500.

19b293a3dbee1408.name: give_carrot_to_pau
19b293a3dbee1408.doc: Pau asks for the orange food and opens the item menu for a Carrot (item 315). On the right item he joins the party and quest 5 is cleared; other items are refused.

19b43f78b7b0b478.name: setup_b03_start
19b43f78b7b0b478.doc: Places the player at the start of the b03 map, fades in and resets the camera.

19cfd937d1a6c70a.name: offer_bell_trigger_quest
19cfd937d1a6c70a.doc: Gerald gives a Trumpet Gun (item 24) and asks the player to build it up into a Bell Trigger. Accepts quest 11.

19d6f67f0925785e.name: play_wind_gem_get_scene
19d6f67f0925785e.doc: Event 624. After the Lapis Garter is beaten, Max or Monica collects the Wind Gem (item 367) and the item get message shows. Sets flag 628.

19e69776afa0e4af.name: play_find_building_scene
19e69776afa0e4af.doc: Event 456: Max and Monica spot a building ahead and run toward it, then the player is put back on the map.

19fa11bf9b36dd42.name: load_event_256_scene
19fa11bf9b36dd42.doc: Loads Max and Monica with the event 256 motions and its message file.

1a108aa6c3f65f3f.name: play_event_101_then_enter_dungeon
1a108aa6c3f65f3f.doc: Plays event 101 and then enters the dungeon.

1a14d33fb7c491a0.name: wait_object_script
1a14d33fb7c491a0.doc: Waits until the given scene actor has finished its queued motion and movement.

1a16f824b9adf8fa.name: show_medal_messages
1a16f824b9adf8fa.doc: Shows the medal messages after a room clear: a message when the destroy goal was cleared (destroy_cleared 1 or 2), a medal sound with a message, and a practice result message 2700 plus practice_index when practice_status is 2 or 3. When both the destroy goal and the practice are done it shows a two-medals line instead.

1a2f15f2e1113e62.name: play_chapter_8_opening
1a2f15f2e1113e62.doc: Runs the shared play_need_zelmite_request_scene scene, sets progress to 10, shows the chapter 8 title, starts the field music and places the player in the village.

1a351f1df8625355.name: give_circus_ticket_and_play_boy_scene
1a351f1df8625355.doc: Adds the Circus Ticket (item 353), plays the boy scene, then returns to the m06 event script.

1a3ad8afa35f6a5d.name: pan_camera_over_restored_village
1a3ad8afa35f6a5d.doc: Event 285 opening: fades in and pans the camera over the Jurak village while the villager says the place is back to its old self.

1a4da9953ff5d7ee.name: start_sundrop_flower_bloom_scene
1a4da9953ff5d7ee.doc: Story trigger for event 255b: plays the Sundrop flower bloom scene.

1a5b06a6cf87e77b.name: play_paznos_robot_then_jump_to_s30
1a5b06a6cf87e77b.doc: Plays the scene where Paznos turns into a robot and jumps to map s30 at entry 650. Returns 0.

1a6f3e1132610b29.name: play_blackstone_departure_scene
1a6f3e1132610b29.doc: Plays event 109 (sets flags 109 and 9): the crew, Borneo and Tom exchange departure calls, run aboard and Blackstone One leaves, ending with a line from Need.

1a8fe048137b775c.name: warp_to_s31_event_510
1a8fe048137b775c.doc: Fades out, switches back from an alternate character, clears monsters, runs play_griffon_takes_atlamillia_scene, hides Atlamillia and loads map s31 with event script 510.

1a90a813fbcff1fd.name: show_important_book_hint
1a90a813fbcff1fd.doc: Event program that makes Max remark that there may be an important book here but he cannot tell right now.

1a9ab0fc8be0660b.name: finish_flotsam_fight
1a9ab0fc8be0660b.doc: After the boss dies: fades out, switches back from an alternate character, plays the defeated scene, unlocks map moves, opens the boss door and places the player at the room exit.

1ab83c4f995b4f3c.name: pick_up_geostone
1ab83c4f995b4f3c.doc: Cutscene for picking up the geostone in a dungeon room. Only Max and Monica can: for the other two characters a message (22 or 23) is shown and nothing is taken. Otherwise it sets the geostone-picked-up flag, plays the take animation with the stone and an activation effect, shows message 2400, sets the floor flag 256 for this floor and restores control. Returns 0 on the refusal path.

1ac54e1c4a7a93ff.name: use_floor_gate_0
1ac54e1c4a7a93ff.doc: Uses the floor gate with index 0.

1ac75c368b3a452c.name: play_moon_flower_flashback_if_pending
1ac75c368b3a452c.doc: If the analysis flag 505 scene (flag 744) or the town 4 completion scene (flag 748) is pending, sets the flags and jumps to map s44 at program 550, 560 or 570 for the Moon Flower Palace flashback.

1ac9e84c600a254e.name: talk_borneo_at_station
1ac9e84c600a254e.doc: Talk handler for Borneo at the station. When Borneo is the party NPC he comments on needing to keep moving, with extra remarks in chapter 4 (until the Ixion explanation is seen) and chapter 3; otherwise it runs the party-NPC talk for the NPC spoken to. Returns 0.

1add4782e01bafdf.name: play_floor_clear_when_cleared
1add4782e01bafdf.doc: Plays the standard floor clear scene once all monsters are dead.

1aea0c659fdd839d.name: play_eina_farewell_scene
1aea0c659fdd839d.doc: Sets flag 540. At night Max asks his mother Eina to come back to their own time. She says her place is in this time, Max calls it selfish and runs off, and she apologises that no one can exist in two times. Skippable.

1af599a59e302a54.name: enter_central_lab_door_2
1af599a59e302a54.doc: Turns toward the door, sets counter 2 to 2 so the player is placed there on return, and jumps to the Central Lab.

1b0c69cf2a70797f.name: open_menu_faded
1b0c69cf2a70797f.doc: Opens the save menu with a fade out and in around it (open_save_menu_with_fade).

1b116169071bdb48.name: show_message_at
1b116169071bdb48.doc: Opens message mes_no in a window at the given position, waits for the player to dismiss it, closes it and returns the frames waited.

1b169a0b4993a9b0.name: use_floor_exit
1b169a0b4993a9b0.doc: Handles an exit gate. If it is still locked, asks for item 344 (lower floors) or 345 (upper floors) and unlocks it. Once open, asks to leave, shows any medal result for the floor and goes to the next floor.

1b202eb3d34859be.name: finish_cleared_room_event
1b202eb3d34859be.doc: Runs when all monsters in a room are cleared: clears monsters, plays the victory pose, opens the door, shows medal and challenge messages, announces broken seals, and offers a move to the Spheda ball. This copy has the Italian text.

1b526abf367f890b.name: place_villagers
1b526abf367f890b.doc: Places the three villager characters (24, 25 and 26) at fixed spots in Balance Valley station and sets them standing.

1b5c85e7f210f374.name: open_channel_key_door
1b5c85e7f210f374.doc: Opens the channel door: the minimap door opens, the door's map piece lifts with a sound while the camera turns, and the key function point is disabled.

1b5caebf916889a7.name: warp_to_s06_for_linda_boss
1b5caebf916889a7.doc: Boss Linda program: warps to map s06 and runs the Linda boss event in s06_1, skipping the next BGM load.

1b6b29f043266420.name: use_gate_to_sindain
1b6b29f043266420.doc: Enters the blue time gate and jumps to the map for Sindain.

1b7595bea8686911.name: play_tournament_results_scene
1b7595bea8686911.doc: Plays the tournament tally scene and awards the prize, then removes the extra motions.

1b78966b8365affc.name: place_map_objects
1b78966b8365affc.doc: Setup program; it only places the map objects.

1b7fdd82c985cb78.name: replay_control_room_intro_scene
1b7fdd82c985cb78.doc: Event 600: plays the control room intro scene only.

1b9e2a89c28b3da8.name: play_event_748_then_jump_to_g05_560
1b9e2a89c28b3da8.doc: Plays event 748 (a boy is caught in the palace garden) and jumps to map g05 at entry 560. Returns 0.

1b9f63d24dbda1d0.name: play_galen_orbit_camera_scene
1b9f63d24dbda1d0.doc: Event 540. A 120 frame shaking camera orbit around Galen while the Paznos launch begins. Sets flag 540.

1ba61b4d448649dd.name: debug_play_fish_race_intro
1ba61b4d448649dd.doc: Debug entry that plays the fish race intro and starts the race.

1bb16fa63999fcc3.name: reset_story_flags_and_show_points
1bb16fa63999fcc3.doc: Resets counter 3 and flags 215, 220, 230 and 235, removes item 302, shows the story points and waits for a button press.

1bb9c300576c6c8e.name: jump_to_s04_when_ready
1bb9c300576c6c8e.doc: Jumps to map s04 if ask_to_leave_map returns true.

1bc23ab56a064de5.name: open_save_menu_with_fade
1bc23ab56a064de5.doc: Stands the player, fades out, opens the save menu, and fades back in when it closes.

1bc73d43e112fc21.name: play_colossus_mode_scene
1bc73d43e112fc21.doc: Event 640. With the palace about to crash on a town, Paznos is ordered into Colossus Mode, and the crew learn the new time stream created by Max and Monica made it possible. Sets flag 640.

1bc756d47b67cd1e.name: warp_to_d02b01_point_2552
1bc756d47b67cd1e.doc: Clears the scene and loads dungeon d02b01 at event code 2552 plus 10000.

1bea1a4744f9a5a3.name: play_oz_wait_scene_and_place_player
1bea1a4744f9a5a3.doc: Event 500: plays the Oz waits scene, loads the waiting NPCs and places the player on the platform.

1bf46ed0cf15c832.name: open_rusted_door
1bf46ed0cf15c832.doc: Lifts the three pieces of a door up, swaps the door map pieces for the open versions, disables the door's function point and turns the camera toward it.

1bf8962efe64d5a9.name: play_train_arrival_with_smoke_cutscene
1bf8962efe64d5a9.doc: Skippable cutscene of the train with its smoke effect arriving at the station and Max running off it; the cars turn as it stops. Workers 9 and 10 are hidden until flag 448 is set.

1bfe44babfc675fb.name: greet_and_open_shop
1bfe44babfc675fb.doc: Shopkeeper greeting before the shop menu. Reads which NPC is talking and shows a greeting that depends on the NPC and language, setting a first-meeting flag for some of them, then opens the shop.

1c04416cb9679c0f.name: preview_twin_intro_scene
1c04416cb9679c0f.doc: Plays the twin monster intro scene and waits for a button press.

1c0e27a2d7a6060d.name: leave_for_map_s04
1c0e27a2d7a6060d.doc: Refreshes doors and NPCs, runs another event, then jumps to map s04 at entry 501.

1c10f27dad400f22.name: play_carpenterion_control_room_intro_scene
1c10f27dad400f22.doc: Sets flag 43 while the Firbit elder shows Max and Monica the Carpenterion control room, explains the reactor, Geostones and Georama (adds a Help Menu entry) and asks them to find Holly and restore the forest.

1c1f128aad481209.name: play_farewell_and_go_to_heim_rada_stop
1c1f128aad481209.doc: Plays the farewell scene and jumps to map s10 (Heim Rada Stop) at event 510.

1c236ee025946bef.name: enter_gaspard_lava_room
1c236ee025946bef.doc: Map start for the room: fades out, runs the room setup, checks the memory card, places the player facing the lava room and fades in.

1c3fdcce1c364d92.name: load_boss_intro_cast
1c3fdcce1c364d92.doc: Loads the actors for the boss intro scene (event 257): Max and Monica motion sets, the boss model b02a, its sound bank, the title sprite and the message file.

1c48e56d2e601122.name: preview_train_then_place_it
1c48e56d2e601122.doc: Debug event: binds the train map part, prints its position, views it from a fixed camera until button 64 is pressed and then places it at z -1800.

1c51c15a6a7e379b.name: talk_corinne_after_joining
1c51c15a6a7e379b.doc: Corinne's chatter after the hide-and-seek quest is cleared, saying it is for little kids. Chapter 8 swaps in a line asking Max to tell her about his adventures.

1c52594d5d32679c.name: place_player_at_entrance
1c52594d5d32679c.doc: Places the player at the map entrance facing into the room and resets the camera behind them.

1c5cbdc3199223db.name: play_shingala_farewell_scene
1c5cbdc3199223db.doc: Event 444, sets flag 444: after the fight the elder thanks Max and Monica, Gaspard's forces retreat, Pau and Shingala say goodbye and the narration tells how Shingala later brings Luna Stones.

1c640beb2d824c20.name: warp_to_d06e01_event_612
1c640beb2d824c20.doc: Clears the scene and starts event 612 on map d06e01.

1c7146163f916763.name: show_railroad_closure_reason
1c7146163f916763.doc: Need repeats Blackstone Railroad, and Cedric asks if it was shut down so nobody could leave.

1c767676908486ce.name: greet_and_open_shop
1c767676908486ce.doc: Shop talk for the town stall keepers: greets, adds a per-NPC intro (first meeting sets the met flag for the apprentice baker, the sword shop sister and the priest's friend), runs the normal NPC talk, then opens that NPC's shop menu.

1c86f3dbb6fe6c90.name: greet_and_open_shop
1c86f3dbb6fe6c90.doc: Shopkeeper greeting and shop. Shows a welcome and a line depending on the speaker (church, smith, Georama dealer, or three substitute shopkeepers whose first-meeting intro sets a met flag), runs the talk, then opens the matching shop menu for that character.

1c8758ef0ca3287d.name: play_elephant_taunt_scene
1c8758ef0ca3287d.doc: Event 108b. The elephant laughs and taunts Max, then walks off, with sound and shots; sets flag 108.

1cb51d88f9ea2cf0.name: talk_generic_villager
1cb51d88f9ea2cf0.doc: Default talk handler for town villagers. Shop NPCs 1012, 1015 and 1018 open a shop, NPC 50 refuses passage, and in chapter 1 NPCs 2, 63 and 65 talk about the train (depends on whether it is running); in chapter 8 NPCs 61 and 80 talk about Monica (depends on her return flag). Anyone else shows a greeting plus the message-table line for the villager, with the Monica variant when Monica is active.

1cbf5b1f270bae7a.name: play_monster_intro_e40e
1cbf5b1f270bae7a.doc: Monster introduction cutscene: Max and Monica stand while monster e40e drops in and attacks twice, with the caption e728telop04 fading in. Skippable; restores the player afterwards.

1cc177fe60f82429.name: finish_battleship_fight_and_restore_party
1cc177fe60f82429.doc: After the battleship fight, clears monsters, makes Max the active character, returns Monica's items, removes Monica and the other party members from the party and plays the aftermath scene, then re-enables the entrances.

1cc5bcfe053b0799.name: play_event_285_then_fade_in
1cc5bcfe053b0799.doc: Plays story event 285 (play_event_285) and then fades in.

1cc8f5222bbd5ed5.name: play_arena_entry_scene_debug
1cc8f5222bbd5ed5.doc: Debug entry that plays the arena entry scene.

1cd294f51bf35a33.name: play_ending_movie_with_captions
1cd294f51bf35a33.doc: Plays the END2 movie with Spanish captions: a speech by Mayor Need of Palm Brinks about restarting the Blackstone railroad, and narration that the story may have been told by the Moon. Then shows a final image over a darkened screen until a button is pressed.

1cdeebbf33922eb2.name: show_total_score
1cdeebbf33922eb2.doc: Shows the player's total Spheda score on screen as sprites (a label and one or two digits) and waits for the pad press that closes it.

1d218fac6537da7a.name: talk_gerald_early
1d218fac6537da7a.doc: Gerald's talk before the first quest is cleared: he tells Max it is time to learn about mining.

1d2d02bf523140d7.name: finish_event_356
1d2d02bf523140d7.doc: Sets flag 356, shows the debug title of event E356 (Gaspard repelled, farewell to Crest), unlocks map movement, fades out and finishes the event.

1d3d706b33751eb8.name: unload_crest_farewell_actors
1d3d706b33751eb8.doc: Removes the actors used in the Crest farewell scene and restores the handles, function points and status bar, then finishes the event.

1d46339a96f2dbe3.name: party_looks_down_as_rococo_jumps
1d46339a96f2dbe3.doc: Max and Monica look down in turn while Rococo jumps down, for 81 frames.

1d4ee5858dc5d353.name: start_rapis_spot_battle
1d4ee5858dc5d353.doc: Map start: runs setup_rapis_point_sound; while flag 632 (Lapis stone 3 found) is clear it plays the monster title card intro, disables the rapis point, places the Sea Dragon (monster 612) at z -800 and locks map movement. Then places the player at z 1100 facing it and fades in.

1d4ef2c094ef3235.name: talk_olivie_early
1d4ef2c094ef3235.doc: Olivie's talk before the first quest is cleared or before the tournament flag is set: the Firbit people only grant favours to those more skilled than themselves.

1d550f419b5d3df5.name: setup_lapis_sounds
1d550f419b5d3df5.doc: Stops the music, loads sound set 5694 and hides the lapis point once flag 636 is set.

1d5bff7808ca354b.name: play_event_352
1d5bff7808ca354b.doc: Event 352 at the lighthouse: sets the seen flag, then three characters stand and speak while an hourglass glows, they are dazzled, the screen ripples and everything fades to white. The scene can be skipped.

1d5de645c440d4dc.name: play_train_arrives_scene
1d5de645c440d4dc.doc: A train pulls into the station, its doors swing open and Max runs out onto the platform. Afterwards control returns with the camera behind Max.

1d7510f6ff3be3ef.name: talk_to_shopkeeper
1d7510f6ff3be3ef.doc: Talk handler for the NPC: once the story progress is 100 it greets and opens the shop, otherwise it plays the normal villager talk.

1d7674ea0a6314a5.name: start_dark_genie_defeat_story_event
1d7674ea0a6314a5.doc: Story event 820: plays the defeat scene and the ending movie, then sets the exit flag.

1d7dcf6930eddc3d.name: play_door_guardian_turns_player_away_scene
1d7dcf6930eddc3d.doc: Event 712, sets flag 712: the guardian says the player has not earned the right to pass and should return when ready.

1da283f50b54ae10.name: talk_rufio_quest_offer
1da283f50b54ae10.doc: Rufio's quest offer: he declines to come along because there is no moon, then a system message says he no longer trusts humans and suggests photographing the moon for him. Ends the event and sets quest 14 to accepted.

1da30d56b6cb7e70.name: play_far_view_then_jump_to_f30
1da30d56b6cb7e70.doc: Plays the far view shot without the golems, skips the next BGM load and jumps to map f30 at entry 603.

1dad47451e20f64f.name: play_cannon_talk_then_enter_bridge
1dad47451e20f64f.doc: Plays the Nova Driver Cannon talk and jumps to s30 at entry 630.

1db20fb4c124e473.name: preview_villager_scene
1db20fb4c124e473.doc: Debug scene: sets up a villager in a house interior, places the camera and waits for a button press.

1dbd52c11c9bdbc6.name: setup_event_235_actors
1dbd52c11c9bdbc6.doc: Loads the Max and Monica scene actors for event 235 and its message file. Sets globals max_chara_slot and partner_chara_slot.

1dda2b3aec7ad51d.name: load_s43b_event_151
1dda2b3aec7ad51d.doc: Stops the map sounds, starts the circus bgm, hides the partners and loads the s43b event script at 151.

1e0086f125257915.name: ask_blinkhorn_race_start
1e0086f125257915.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's race offer: asks whether to try. Declining sets counter 7 to 0 and returns 0; accepting starts the on-screen stopwatch, sets counter 7 to 1 and ends the talk.

1e169807d9667a83.name: play_palace_returned_to_present_scene
1e169807d9667a83.doc: Sets flag 616. Osmond runs up to Max and Monica on the road to say something terrible has happened. The Moonflower Palace has returned to the present and they wonder what Griffon is planning. Skippable.

1e199dace649a9c5.name: talk_adel_early
1e199dace649a9c5.doc: Adel's talk before the first quest is cleared: she is working as a maid but dreams of being a tailor.

1e2f06851a2d3bc5.name: load_dark_power_scene_actors
1e2f06851a2d3bc5.doc: Loads the models, motions and messages for the dark power scene (event 728), swapping Max or Monica in as the active character, and stores their slots in the globals.

1e323d238fefc85e.name: ask_to_enter_palace_dungeon
1e323d238fefc85e.doc: Asks whether to enter the dungeon, using the item question 5 with item 97. Returns 1 after a fade out if yes.

1e33387b70d64ff0.name: show_message_auto
1e33387b70d64ff0.doc: Opens an automatically placed message, waits for input, closes the window and returns the frames waited.

1e3e1633b8f03638.name: rococo_stands_up_trembling
1e3e1633b8f03638.doc: Rococo stands up and trembles for 70 frames.

1e43ba149fd2ac29.name: play_first_sea_scene
1e43ba149fd2ac29.doc: Event 402 (flag 402): Max and Monica reach the beach and the active character sees the ocean for the first time, then hear a noise from a cave. Sets story progress to 6, shows the chapter 4 title, starts music 3 and places the player on the shore. Skippable.

1e664d20397b2118.name: play_blue_atlamillia_glow_scene
1e664d20397b2118.doc: Sets flag 522. Max looks up as his Atlamillia glows blue and Max says Monica's Atlamillia is lending its power across time.

1e774da83368970e.name: warp_to_d07b01_event_820
1e774da83368970e.doc: Clears the scene and loads dungeon map d07b01 with the event script for event 820.

1e8e0d08100012b1.name: use_key_door
1e8e0d08100012b1.doc: Interaction with a key door. With Donny in the party he opens it himself; otherwise the player uses the Luna Stone Piece (343) from the item menu.

1e8f042ee4a79000.name: run_player_into_station
1e8f042ee4a79000.doc: Map start: Max runs forward from the entrance while the camera tracks him for about 25 frames.

1e914e36e9432bd7.name: play_elena_reunion_scene
1e914e36e9432bd7.doc: Event 540. Elena arrives, saved by the Paznos bombardment, and Max meets his mother. Sets flag 540.

1e9a2d562c4a6cee.name: play_meeting_doctor_chap_scene
1e9a2d562c4a6cee.doc: Placeholder for event 428: sets flag 428 and shows only a debug label naming the event.

1e9ab484dc170f1d.name: start_g01b_script_debug
1e9ab484dc170f1d.doc: Program 610: loads the event script g01/g01b_1.stb to run as the debug_test program.

1e9dcaaa3e0b4b9b.name: play_monica_takes_club_spheda_demo
1e9dcaaa3e0b4b9b.doc: Sets flag 315. Monica walks up and says Max stinks and takes the club, announces how to play Spheda, then sinks a shot with the ball simulation. Max praises her. Skippable.

1ec845ef2afa2b7f.name: start_arrival_at_donnys_base_story
1ec845ef2afa2b7f.doc: Story 7 handler. Stops the music and ambience, hides the memo, sets flag 4 and plays the arrival scene.

1ecd6139dc0d93f5.name: play_monster_pack_intro_and_wait
1ecd6139dc0d93f5.doc: Plays the monster pack intro scene and waits for a button press.

1ee9ed7a9d26e3a0.name: play_defeat_to_edit_mode
1ee9ed7a9d26e3a0.doc: Plays the boss defeat scene, then goes to edit mode 2, event 520.

1eed6d76d65993a4.name: play_run_off_with_star
1eed6d76d65993a4.doc: Closing scene on f02: two characters run along a path, one looks back, then narration plays as the camera rises with the hero standing and a shooting star crosses the sky as the screen fades out.

1f125837f72b5bb0.name: talk_gordon_monica
1f125837f72b5bb0.doc: Gordon's line when Monica speaks to him about a tree, then a system message that Gordon will not listen unless Max talks to him. Ends the event without advancing anything.

1f1379b6034a9501.name: use_east_transfer_gate
1f1379b6034a9501.doc: Transfer gate menu, entered at the east gate.

1f13b57d2ef17d7c.name: show_debug_test_message
1f13b57d2ef17d7c.doc: Debug test program: shows the placeholder message "dodoon" (ta-da) and waits for it to be dismissed.

1f24d34f63c2a0a6.name: play_e105c_picture_talk
1f24d34f63c2a0a6.doc: Cedric's 2D picture talk about turning a finished Invention Card into the real item: fades to a still picture, he tells the player the materials needed for the Energy Pack and to buy them at the item shop, then the picture is removed. Returns 0.

1f5d2afee4c391bf.name: use_moonflower_gate
1f5d2afee4c391bf.doc: Floor gate: while closed asks for the Queen's Watering Pot to open the Moonflower door. Once open, asks whether to leave the floor, shows medal messages if the floor challenge was met and moves to the next floor chosen by the gate number.

1f6245daa5cb56cf.name: start_village_interior
1f6245daa5cb56cf.doc: Fades in and places the player at the starting spot of the interior with the camera behind.

1f707458291a6b56.name: move_asq_in_arc_with_motion
1f707458291a6b56.doc: Moves an animation object along a gravity arc from the start to the end point in the given frames, and starts motion motion_id on it at frame motion_frame.

1f8cf8355a615665.name: show_town_npc_menu
1f8cf8355a615665.doc: Menu shown when talking to a town NPC: faces player and NPC, frames the camera, then offers to bring the NPC into the party, and per NPC their extras (shop, repair all, monster book, scoop report, partner hint). Joining is refused while the party NPC is 26 (Lin) until she is taken to the lighthouse.

1f9cb853ee9cbf61.name: play_monica_joins_scene
1f9cb853ee9cbf61.doc: Plays event 207: the train arrives, Cedric says a rock is blocking the way, and Monica explains time travel, origin points and what Griffon is doing. Monica joins Max's adventure and they decide to start with Sindain.

1fad366de1a2fb79.name: pick_up_notebook
1fad366de1a2fb79.doc: Hides the memo on the map, gives the Notebook (item 386) with an item message and disables the item point.

1fc7b1d70a6ad437.name: play_himarra_badge_scene
1fc7b1d70a6ad437.doc: Plays event 277. Monica shows Max the badge that turns him into a Himarra, so they can mix with the monsters and get a Sundrop, and they head for the forest floor.

1fc92672b5743079.name: show_spheda_bonus_scores
1fc92672b5743079.doc: Loads the d03f01 bonus course with Spheda set up for hole 2, places the player and opens the Spheda score view menu.

1fccfed1b47cdb07.name: can_play_event_560
1fccfed1b47cdb07.doc: Returns 1 when event 560 can play: the third georama is complete, the event has not been seen, and the party can switch characters. Otherwise 0.

1fcf036486b6e3aa.name: show_voiced_message
1fcf036486b6e3aa.doc: Streams the voice file for the message, shows its text and plays it for the given number of frames before closing the window.

1fd2d7700995fcc0.name: open_save_menu
1fd2d7700995fcc0.doc: Opens the save menu, keeping the loaded BGM while story flag 4 is set.

1fd7da7aed41b59c.name: toggle_ball_color
1fd7da7aed41b59c.doc: Switches the golf ball between its two colors, activating one ball model (charas 8 and 9) and hiding the other, and stores the new color.

1fe9e0cd282b175c.name: handle_villager_talk
1fe9e0cd282b175c.doc: Villager talk dispatcher for the town: reads the talked-to character and slot, then characters up to number 34 go to the Palm Brinks villager conversations and the rest to the by-kind dialogue.

1febbd1292e2e40d.name: open_item_chest
1febbd1292e2e40d.doc: Opens an item chest: pauses the dungeon, plays the lid opening, and has the item jump out. With item -1 the chest is empty and a message says so. Otherwise it adds as many as fit under the item limit, shows the get message or a can't-carry message, and opens the bag-full menu on overflow. Item 306 on stage 0 or in the trial version also shows a hint.

1fef3fe55e09340e.name: load_farewell_scene_actors
1fef3fe55e09340e.doc: Loads the actors for event 736: Max, Monica, Elena, two villagers, the Chrono Union models and the vanishing lights. Stores party slots in main_chara_slot and partner_chara_slot.

1ffdb63ccf3fc803.name: play_carpenterion_intro_scene
1ffdb63ccf3fc803.doc: Event 250, sets flag 43: the Firbits show Max and Monica Carpenterion, the Geostone reactor and the Georama builder, and ask them to find Holly. Adds the Georama help entry.

2008eb63da83ff0c.name: play_lapis_beam_scene
2008eb63da83ff0c.doc: Sets flag 640. Max and Monica see Lapis beams fire from Paznos and cheer, then BGM 22 starts.

202b191499e9eb16.name: play_patri_meets_monica_scene
202b191499e9eb16.doc: Scene where Parn, a magic painter, greets Monica and introduces his future wife Julia, whom Monica finds hard to talk to. Ends with a hint to talk to him as the other character.

202f327b83e72639.name: ask_to_leave_area_with_character_check
202f327b83e72639.doc: Exit handle talk. The two non-Max/Monica characters only get a message. Otherwise asks the exit question and returns 1 after a fade out if the player says yes, otherwise 0.

2038ba5bd81b61be.name: ask_to_take_exit_path
2038ba5bd81b61be.doc: Asks whether to take the exit path. On yes Max runs along a path out of view and it returns 1; on no he walks back a few steps. Other characters just get a message.

204ecdd805711172.name: talk_party_chara
204ecdd805711172.doc: Talk menu for a party-joinable character met on the train or at the station. Moves the camera and player in front of the character, then loops on a menu: ask them to join (opens the party select menu, or refuses for the Lin NPC until she is taken to the Cape Lighthouse), hear their advice, use their special service (repair, shop, monster book, hint or a character menu) or leave. Returns 1 if the character is already in the party, joined, or opened a menu, otherwise ends after the talk.

2055d34e5da9a09f.name: give_fire_gem_and_play_scene
2055d34e5da9a09f.doc: Gives the Fire Gem item, marks the floor as done and plays the Lapis get scene, then unlocks map movement.

205d676c3a54ca9a.name: set_night_then_run_s60_2_1
205d676c3a54ca9a.doc: Sets the time of day to 22:00 and stops the clock, waits 30 frames and runs play_need_victory_speech_scene.

2066449a55874205.name: play_finny_frenzy_story_424
2066449a55874205.doc: Story 424: plays the Finny Frenzy announcement scene.

2083b0d59e9d7880.name: play_gaspard_ambush_scene
2083b0d59e9d7880.doc: Sets flag 528. Gaspard appears with Monica collapsed on the ground, mocks Max and draws his sword, ending with the setup for the first Gaspard fight. Forces Max as the lead character.

208bc134eb648e2f.name: press_panel_row0_col4
208bc134eb648e2f.doc: Presses the puzzle switch for the panel at row 0, column 4, toggling it and its neighbours.

209478436f81376c.name: talk_to_jurak_mall_villager
209478436f81376c.doc: Talk handler for the Jurak Mall residents. What each one says depends on the Georama analysis flags and story flags (Jurak's revival at flag 280, the fight with Emperor Griffon at 640). The shopkeepers open their shop menus after talking.

20a68df882d34c8f.name: ask_question_auto
20a68df882d34c8f.doc: Shows a message with a speech bubble from speaker to listener and runs a choice with choice_count options and the starting cursor. Returns the chosen option.

20a6dac47062f1d0.name: go_to_s31_after_second_phase
20a6dac47062f1d0.doc: Fades out and loads map s31 with its script 520.

20acb8856ce802d8.name: play_battleship_sighting_and_go_to_g03
20acb8856ce802d8.doc: Plays the battleship sighting scene and jumps to map g03 at entry 510 (Veniccio).

20b81f454193dfa7.name: talk_osmond_aquarium_hints
20b81f454193dfa7.doc: Osmond's lines when the player knows nothing about Aquariums: he gives hints (a Wooden Box, a Window and a Fountain) and repeats the worm and fish plan.

20ba44daf20c1808.name: talk_adel_early
20ba44daf20c1808.doc: Adel's talk before the first quest is cleared: she is working as a maid but dreams of being a tailor.

20c53b813b2a195f.name: play_finny_frenzy_announcement_scene
20c53b813b2a195f.doc: Skippable scene where Mayor Need announces the Finny Frenzy fish race to follow the fishing contest, with a message about alternating events. Sets the tournament cycle flag.

20c67013732bec83.name: warp_to_s35_event_502
20c67013732bec83.doc: Runs play_griffon_unleashes_power_scene, then loads map s35 with event script 502.

20c9066bee5909b3.name: warp_to_condor_scene_then_s46
20c9066bee5909b3.doc: Debug warp for story event 307: loads d03f01, plays the condor drop-off scene and continues to map s46.

20ce1463fc98524a.name: setup_train_map
20ce1463fc98524a.doc: Map setup for the train. Toggles characters and function points by flags 203 and 204, locks map movement during the event, restores Max's position after a memory card load, places the train crew when the event is active and fades in.

20d10d5dbf734ced.name: play_valley_arrival_story
20d10d5dbf734ced.doc: Story event 300: sets up the station and plays the e300 arrival scene with villagers frozen during it.

20d982d6357989c4.name: play_opening_run_scene
20d982d6357989c4.doc: Plays the scene where Max runs along a path with a camera sweep.

20dac40051f51155.name: play_max_victory_pose
20dac40051f51155.doc: Max's victory pose after clearing a dungeon room: loads c01b_win motions and the finish banner (drawn when show_banner is set, status bar hidden otherwise), follows Max with the camera, plays the victory pose, slides the banner to the corner after 90 frames and plays laughing voice 8500160, then restarts BGM 193. Skippable.

20e6f4a4bce1bf9d.name: interact_with_gate_3
20e6f4a4bce1bf9d.doc: Handles the fourth of the four gates.

20f01b9441b10181.name: play_rock_cleared_scene
20f01b9441b10181.doc: Plays the scene where Borneo and the others clear the rock from the tracks and the train sets off toward Balance Valley (flag 280), then reloads the station at program 504.

20f082b19ad92350.name: play_dark_power_scene
20f082b19ad92350.doc: Event 728 part two. Dark smoke, light and the three Atora monsters appear as a dark power speaks and dismisses its servant. Plays before the map moves on to d06b03.

210fa020d18c3b63.name: board_train_to_ixion
210fa020d18c3b63.doc: After the board prompt sets counter 1 to 7 and goes to Ixion: the engine room (s37) or the guest room (s38).

213041769c937374.name: preview_follow_run_scene
213041769c937374.doc: Debug scene: the camera is attached behind the player who runs along a path to the east.

21306828edf7eeb9.name: play_log_walk_entrance_scene
21306828edf7eeb9.doc: Entrance scene: the player walks along a log, jumps off and walks on, with the camera easing behind. Takes the world origin and yaw of the area as arguments.

21321ad82d05a83d.name: go_to_s34_if_ready
21321ad82d05a83d.doc: Jumps to map s34 when ask_to_leave_and_fade_out(155) holds.

213f31a2a94e1da5.name: use_blue_gate_to_veniccio
213f31a2a94e1da5.doc: Plays the blue gate warp effect and jumps to map g03 (Veniccio).

214c80d3d2123331.name: remove_event_270_actors
214c80d3d2123331.doc: Cleans up after event 270: activates the active character's model, deletes the other party member's scene copy and the extra character 37.

215a505540cb394c.name: play_jurak_reward_blast_scene
215a505540cb394c.doc: Event 285: the villager thanks the party, a nose blast shakes the village and a sparkle floats down to Max and Monica.

2162981b3c21ab90.name: frame_talk_camera
2162981b3c21ab90.doc: Sets up a conversation camera between a party character and an NPC. Turns the player to face the NPC, switches both to standing, turns the NPC toward the player if it is a walking NPC and not facing them, then places the camera 35 units in front of the NPC looking at its head.

216f7b314400b648.name: unload_event_616b_charas
216f7b314400b648.doc: Removes the second set of event 616 scene characters (Osmond, Toryon, beams, rocks, smoke), leaving only the active character.

2179a59c418ecbe5.name: play_advice_scene_in_room
2179a59c418ecbe5.doc: Loads the d01f01 room, monsters and chests and plays the advice scene.

219d1473f2ade820.name: play_shot_camera_pans_across_room
219d1473f2ade820.doc: Scene shot: the camera pans across the room while the party is hidden.

21a0265cddf58a98.name: play_osmond_electric_worm_scene
21a0265cddf58a98.doc: Story 412 program: sets flag 408, sets up the map characters and plays the Dr. Osmond scene about feeding an electric worm to a fish in the Aquarium and then the fish to the Shigura.

21ab2625b886e004.name: play_player_run_in_scene
21ab2625b886e004.doc: Max runs along a short path into view while the screen fades in, then control returns.

21aeedea7a473fdc.name: use_time_gate_jump_gate
21aeedea7a473fdc.doc: Opens the jump gate menu from the spot in front of the time gate.

21b6c00a71ba45e0.name: show_hit_head_hint
21b6c00a71ba45e0.doc: Pauses the monsters and the player and shows a hint to hit the boss's head.

21db5ca3dd812576.name: on_board_train
21db5ca3dd812576.doc: Asks whether to board the train. If yes, plays the boarding scene for the front car and jumps to s37 (Ixion engine room), or for the later cars and jumps to s38 (Ixion guest room).

21e61d16e81f9d46.name: play_game_over_for_final_battle
21e61d16e81f9d46.doc: If the Dark Element fight is on (flag 728 set and 732 not set), plays one of two voiced game over lines at random; otherwise the silent game over.

21f0f111df3e2eb2.name: ask_enter_or_depart
21f0f111df3e2eb2.doc: Asks to go inside or depart at the station. Returns 1 for going inside, 0 for cancelling; departing opens the world-move menu and returns 0 afterwards.

22063431790a3b31.name: cleanup_e254_charas
22063431790a3b31.doc: Tears down the event 254 actors after the scene. Keeps the active player's character, deletes the other character's scene model and extras, and shows the party handles again.

221c21ba0e8f32d6.name: play_run_in_from_hill_scene
221c21ba0e8f32d6.doc: The player runs in along a short path from the hill side while the camera tracks him.

221ed8aac6f2235c.name: turn_player_back_from_blocked_path
221ed8aac6f2235c.doc: Two guards say the path is closed and advise turning back, then the player is faded out and put back at the entrance.

2223f525dd7a23e3.name: play_max_victory_pose
2223f525dd7a23e3.doc: Max's victory pose after clearing a dungeon room: loads his win motions and the finish banner (drawn when show_banner is set), has the camera follow him through the pose with a laughing voice line (8500160), then restores the camera and starts BGM 193. Skippable.

226a472cba0df299.name: ask_to_leave_floor
226a472cba0df299.doc: Exit trigger. For the alternate characters shows a short message; otherwise asks whether to leave. Yes resumes the battle music, clears the monsters and loads the d07 event script. Returns 0 for the alternate characters.

226c404b16cf2fcb.name: play_cannon_scene_then_jump_to_s30
226c404b16cf2fcb.doc: Plays the Nova Driver Cannon scene and jumps to map s30 at program 630.

226cd0d1b4f39f48.name: spawn_fishing_tournament_villagers
226cd0d1b4f39f48.doc: Loads the cup and Race Master models and the tournament number and fish-name label images (into number_image_block and row_name_image_block), then spawns the villagers who watch the fishing tournament.

2280c98f635c907c.name: ask_to_move_to_main_street
2280c98f635c907c.doc: Asks whether to move to Main Street. On yes the player runs off and fades out and it returns 1, otherwise the player walks away from the exit and it returns 0.

228c1b291a4f0c96.name: play_voice_message
228c1b291a4f0c96.doc: Shows the voice message text in the dialog window and runs the voice message window for the same message, so the line is shown while the voice plays.

229b435d801aea66.name: setup_event_340_actors
229b435d801aea66.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Lin, the monster e220a and the fading memory model for event 340 and its message file.

229f3c16030809dc.name: on_map_start
229f3c16030809dc.doc: On entering, plays the request scene if flag 364 is set and flag 320 is not. Otherwise enables the shumai function point once the player has a White Windflower (item 363) and has not yet seen the cooking scene.

22baaa58a1f0480d.name: play_battle_flashback_two_scene
22baaa58a1f0480d.doc: Fades out, pauses the game, shows the battle flashback message e724, then places monster 617 and resumes.

22c954a2bca55c53.name: reload_floor_after_spheda
22c954a2bca55c53.doc: Cleans up Spheda, reloads the d02 forest floor with monsters and chests and plays the floor arrival scene.

22cb5c849ecc172f.name: setup_lapis_room
22cb5c849ecc172f.doc: Map setup. Until flag 636 is set it plays the boss intro, disables the lapis point, places monster 613 and locks map movement; then places the player and fades in.

22cb9199627b382d.name: use_floor_gate
22cb9199627b382d.doc: Handles a gate. If it has not bloomed yet it asks to use an item and opens it with the Queen's Watering Pot (item 348). Once open it asks whether to go to the next floor (refusing if character form 2 or 3 is active, or on a no answer) and, on yes, shows any floor medal messages and moves to the next floor.

22fb085d3256977f.name: talk_mina_before_lesson
22fb085d3256977f.doc: Mina's two-part talk before the Spheda lesson flag is set: she feels unwell and the doctor found nothing wrong.

22ff79ac1745df98.name: play_letter_ending_and_save_chapter_eight
22ff79ac1745df98.doc: Plays the letter to mother scene, the END1 movie and an end card, then announces the chapter 8 start file, resets party and progress flags, and opens the save menu.

23017f4b2b9d7310.name: play_lao_chao_bistro_event
23017f4b2b9d7310.doc: Plays event 364, the Lao Chao's Bistro scene.

2306ab2410e79fbb.name: show_sphida_score_on_d03f01
2306ab2410e79fbb.doc: Sets up the Spheda floor d03f01 (hole 2) with items 305 and 306, places the player and opens the Spheda score view menu.

231a5fb651349562.name: swap_partner_to_lin
231a5fb651349562.doc: Shows the partner message, marks the current party NPC as joined (leaves the party) and puts Lin in the party.

231b712bd64da109.name: ask_to_enter_palace_foyer
231b712bd64da109.doc: Asks to enter the Flower Palace foyer (map d06e01), skipping the BGM load the first time the moon view flag is unset.

2332e0e00e3a385c.name: play_elder_gift_scene_and_go_to_s26
2332e0e00e3a385c.doc: Event 505: plays the elder gift scene and jumps to s26 event 502.

2341b92ef7f17da2.name: say_call_when_ready
2341b92ef7f17da2.doc: Cedric tells Max to call him when he is ready.

23476de8e6839763.name: disable_flagged_event_points
23476de8e6839763.doc: Disables function point e348 if flag 348 is set and function point event if flag 352 is set.

23531b99b41b0ac7.name: play_yorda_tree_arrival_scene
23531b99b41b0ac7.doc: Event 332 (sets flag 332): a creature grabs a piece of meat and leaps past, then Max and Monica reach the huge Yorda Tree, a holy tree thousands of years old. Before flag 330 they decide to stop for now out of worry about Lin.

2361f6495b391ef3.name: ask_to_proceed
2361f6495b391ef3.doc: Asks whether to proceed. Steve and the other non-human character (2 and 3) only get a refusal line and return 0; otherwise asks the item question and returns 1 after a fade out when the player agrees, 0 when not.

23660a1a3ae6606c.name: play_paznos_ascent_then_go_to_battle
23660a1a3ae6606c.doc: Plays the Paznos ascent scene and jumps to the Paznos battle event (s55).

2372b9d98cac3c7b.name: open_menu_and_finish
2372b9d98cac3c7b.doc: Opens the menu with a fade and finishes the event.

23786186dc39e260.name: talk_bruno_idle
23786186dc39e260.doc: Bruno's idle line. Once he has joined and the chapter is 8 he says a closing wish for peace, otherwise a line about acting wisely.

2382342729847f91.name: play_dr_nobb_shell_talkie_scene
2382342729847f91.doc: Sets flag 428. Dr. Nobb, head researcher at the Luna Lab, greets Max and Monica, explains the Luna Stone and the Shigura, and has an assistant bring the Shell Talkie, a translator for Shigura. The party receives the item (373) and leaves with the lab's villager restored.

23828a02a97335fd.name: ask_to_leave_contest_area
23828a02a97335fd.doc: Asks whether to leave the contest area and, if yes, fades out and returns to Palm Brinks Square (s45). Returns 1 if the player stays.

2386c315b752cb19.name: load_s06_monster_and_script
2386c315b752cb19.doc: Loads monster data 614, the event sound and the s06 event script. Returns 0.

23954585ed70d4b2.name: setup_s50_map_state
23954585ed70d4b2.doc: Map setup: if event 708 has been seen hides its marker and shows the opened palace parts; pauses weapon drawing, blocks character change and map movement and hides the party members.

2395d34a327bbeea.name: play_train_arrival
2395d34a327bbeea.doc: Station arrival scene: the train rolls in and stops, a door swings open, the player steps off, runs a few steps and stands, then the camera returns behind the player.

23987a7634e2b99b.name: handle_villager_talk
23987a7634e2b99b.doc: Villager talk dispatcher for the town: reads the talked-to character and slot, then characters up to number 34 go to the Palm Brinks villager conversations and the rest to the by-kind dialogue.

239a39a5c7efb608.name: speak_story_intro
239a39a5c7efb608.doc: Voice lines that open the story: listen up, Max, and fifteen years ago something terrible happened to the world.

23a0de2f43a4b9c5.name: play_train_exterior_pan_scene
23a0de2f43a4b9c5.doc: Slow camera pan of 700 frames at noon with the player hidden, then waits 300 frames and ends. Used to show the train from the outside.

23a8ed0896e32403.name: play_event_600
23a8ed0896e32403.doc: Cutscene unveiling the Ixion: sets the unveiling-seen flag and plays the event BGM. The ground pieces turn and slide in, the train rises with water spray, flies off along an arc and the scene fades out.

23bc1194ac110d28.name: ask_p3000_battle_branch
23bc1194ac110d28.doc: Debug menu for the P-3000 boss fight: shows a Japanese note on how it ends and asks which route to jump to. Yes goes to s03 entry 503 (hit the buggy with bombs five times, event 206), No to entry 502 (train HP runs out, event 205).

23ce25dd8d7c5d11.name: talk_to_moon_watcher
23ce25dd8d7c5d11.doc: A townsperson praises the view of the moon. The first time (flag 32) it also shows the hint to press R2 for the first-person view.

23cfb93c20904f89.name: end_ixion_scene_and_go_to_s09
23cfb93c20904f89.doc: Deletes the scene characters and images after the Ixion scene, restores the active character and jumps to map s09 entrance 500.

23dfabebd54f9248.name: vanish_spiral_rock_3
23dfabebd54f9248.doc: Binds map part p11_d06b02-3 and plays the spiral rock vanish scene.

23e9252e62b5090a.name: play_paznos_launch_preparation_scene
23e9252e62b5090a.doc: Sets flag 540. Galen Agaris, the Horn King, announces all hands on deck to prepare the Paznos launch, and crew members run to their stations. Skippable.

23eb1dc386b19774.name: play_flotsam_taunt_then_go_to_palm_brinks
23eb1dc386b19774.doc: Restores full HP, switches to Max, plays the Flotsam taunt scene and goes to Palm Brinks edit mode 10, entry 531.

23fa996c333a7db5.name: calc_deceleration_for_distance
23fa996c333a7db5.doc: Returns the constant acceleration that covers the distance over the given frames starting at the given speed.

2405ba775e2f43ea.name: ask_to_enter_dungeon_d03
2405ba775e2f43ea.doc: Shows a message if a non-standard character is active; otherwise asks an item question and, if the answer is yes, fades out and loads the d03 event script.

2421fe34a5317993.name: setup_map_at_event_500_entry
2421fe34a5317993.doc: Places the player at the event 500 spot, resets the camera, fades in and shows the Georama hint.

2423174853852469.name: play_notice_something_above_scene
2423174853852469.doc: Skippable short scene where the party leader looks up, spots something and runs off to check. Sets flag 552.

242586d376929c69.name: play_genie_shrink_scene_and_exit
242586d376929c69.doc: Program for story event 820: plays the Dark Genie shrinking scene, then the ending movie and epilogue, and sets the exit flag. Returns 0.

2425be1365d9192e.name: load_utan_boulder_actors
2425be1365d9192e.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Master Utan and the boulder models for the boulder scene and binds the boulder to the map piece.

243dc060f91727e6.name: shake_chest_lid
243dc060f91727e6.doc: Animates a treasure chest lid: it creaks open over six frames, plays the chest sound, then settles back over five frames. The lid_angle parameter is not used.

24408361101a1750.name: talk_to_monster
24408361101a1750.doc: Talk to a friendly monster. Monster 52 gives a Sundrop once (flag 290); other monsters use the shared talk handler.

24456e4881b72115.name: play_need_zelmite_request_scene
24456e4881b72115.doc: Sets flag 800 and plays event 800 with music 193: Need tells Max he will revitalize the area, starting by expanding the Blackstone Railroad, and asks him to find a Zelmite deposit in Palm Mine in the park. Skippable.

24491d8bb12a9083.name: play_ridepod_steve_debut_scene
24491d8bb12a9083.doc: Cutscene (event 104, sets flag 104): Max, frustrated that he cannot win, is cornered by Flotsam and his elephant Linda. Cedric arrives in the Ridepod Steve, throws a rock and beats Linda with punches, then tells Max to hop in. They ride off while Flotsam sends Linda charging after them and is left behind.

244ce06c54b2bc52.name: play_gaspard_transformation_scene
244ce06c54b2bc52.doc: Sets flag 532 and plays the scene where Gaspard, his journey ended, is forced by Emperor Griffon's voice to change into a monster, then starts the second fight music. Skippable.

245880a4a737b05c.name: play_holly_might_be_mother_scene
245880a4a737b05c.doc: Scene at the Firbit table: a quiet reflection that the Holly the Firbits talked about is the speaker's mother, and that finding her was another reason to see the world.

245ccfbc8349b99c.name: exit_house_to_m01
245ccfbc8349b99c.doc: Program 200: starts music 0 once when flag 18 is set and 17 is not, skips the next music load while story flags 105 is set and 109 and 56 are not, then fades and walks outside to map m01.

2463d3cbc3292330.name: play_energy_pack_lesson
2463d3cbc3292330.doc: Plays one stage of Cedric's Energy Pack lesson, then restores the camera. Stage 1 gives a reminder of the Make menu, 2 praises the idea and gives money, 3 does nothing, 4 says to make the item, and 5 shows the finished backpack on Steve.

2486d65149e701ba.name: play_beam_volley_scene
2486d65149e701ba.doc: Skippable scene in which the Moonflower beam fires twice from a high launcher, with trajectory and hit effects, then fades out. Used by program 500 before going to map s70.

24ab5d8b74929e8c.name: start_lab_grounds_map
24ab5d8b74929e8c.doc: Sets up map parts and NPC slots from the analysis flags, plays event 456, 460 or the lab 1 entry (468) when available, and otherwise places the player at the door of the map they came from.

24b55096be959f12.name: talk_mina_before_lesson
24b55096be959f12.doc: Mina's two-part talk before the Spheda lesson flag is set: she feels unwell and the doctor found nothing wrong.

24d49f24fa6e2659.name: return_zero
24d49f24fa6e2659.doc: Returns 0. Used where a function returning an int is expected.

24da7eac03d91f26.name: setup_flotsam_room
24da7eac03d91f26.doc: Map start for the Flotsam room. Runs the sound setup and places the player. If flag 808 is clear it plays the new boss scene and places monster 628; then fades in.

24ea6694d6d3a0ce.name: play_lin_farewell_scene
24ea6694d6d3a0ce.doc: Plays event 356 at 21:00: Lin says the future has changed, that he will become a sage as promised to Master Crest, and thanks Max and Monica before they part.

24eab83838ef3677.name: setup_room_with_two_monsters
24eab83838ef3677.doc: Map setup. Starts the room music; while chests are not all taken it plays the intro once (counter 20 bit 4) and places the two monsters. Then places the player and fades in.

24ead196f150dafd.name: debug_play_letter_scene
24ead196f150dafd.doc: Debug entry that plays the letter to mother ending scene.

24eb55673c7c50b4.name: play_flotsam_orders_attack_shot
24eb55673c7c50b4.doc: Flotsam orders his elephant to finish Max off, with a camera push and shake while it trumpets.

24f7aa03dfb9576c.name: setup_dungeon_floor
24f7aa03dfb9576c.doc: Called whenever a floor starts. Floor 0 goes to the Channel Entrance, floor 3 to Maximilian's Room until flag 102 is set, floor 4 to s06, floor 7 to the d01b01 boss, floor 8 to Channel Reservoir, floor 20 to s51 and floor 21 to s43. Other floors load d01f01 with monsters and chests and play the tutorial or arrival scene.

2501bfdf24802c02.name: can_play_event_275
2501bfdf24802c02.doc: Returns 1 when Sindain's event 275 can play: analysis flag 104 is set, the event has not been seen, and the party can switch to character 1 (Monica). Otherwise 0.

2507a77e2ea6010a.name: take_gate_exit_0
2507a77e2ea6010a.doc: Gate 0 handler: interacts with the first exit.

2510aae7941a6814.name: grant_starter_items
2510aae7941a6814.doc: Gives the starter items: Map and Magic Crystal always, Turkey and Fishing Rod if the player has none. Sets the starter-items-given and Spheda-unlocked flags and clears all monsters.

251b5b217acc3352.name: talk_to_resident
251b5b217acc3352.doc: Talking handler: at progress 100 uses the Claire message, otherwise normal villager talk.

25221607b96cc3b7.name: play_eina_embrace_scene
25221607b96cc3b7.doc: Cutscene in which Max's mother arrives and embraces him as the Golem army march is seen. Sets the seen flag, loads event 540 actors, and swaps in Monica or Max as the second party member.

2523c55c826e4c7b.name: setup_spheda_game
2523c55c826e4c7b.doc: Creates the Spheda game for the course with the bar image in the current language, and loads the ball and pin models in the colors of the ball and pin, then places them.

252d6eea23556ffe.name: talk_to_pau_in_cave
252d6eea23556ffe.doc: Talk handler that runs Pau's dialogue when character 9 is addressed.

253d64b0f7424c15.name: setup_flower_area
253d64b0f7424c15.doc: Applies the map state. On the first visit (flag 704 unset) plays the broken flower scene near the start point; otherwise places the player further along. Fades in.

253ee08da3eda2dd.name: cleanup_boss_intro_cast
253ee08da3eda2dd.doc: Removes the extra characters and sprites loaded for the boss intro scene (event 257), keeping only the active party member.

25471cb9bf4e8af5.name: play_e352_leave_lin_scene
25471cb9bf4e8af5.doc: Sets flag 352. At evening Monica tells Lin to wait here and Max to come along; the two run off and the camera rises. Skippable. Then cleans up and loads d03b02.

254899d3070c149a.name: talk_adel_joined
254899d3070c149a.doc: Talk with Adel after Adel has joined the party: asks how the clothes feel, or in chapter 8 wishes the hero safety. Then talk_to_npc.

25502fe919045fb6.name: play_airship_confrontation_scene
25502fe919045fb6.doc: Sets the edit-blocked save flag. Max and Monica confront the enemy on the airship above; Monica casts fire magic, the fight turns physical, and the ship drops away as Max cries out for Monica. Skippable.

2564950a9382d347.name: use_exit_gate_0
2564950a9382d347.doc: Handles exit gate 0 of the floor.

257058d30c638b39.name: talk_ferdinand_joined
257058d30c638b39.doc: Ferdinand's talk once he has joined: one of two lines depending on whether the chapter is 8 (a line about studying cooking), then the normal NPC talk.

25871e911009b226.name: finish_s47_scene_and_jump_to_g01
25871e911009b226.doc: Plays the Time Gate explanation scene (Monica shows Max the gate) and jumps to map g01 (Sindain).

259d3e6749e93cad.name: run_lip_sync_until_voice_ends
259d3e6749e93cad.doc: Lip syncs the speaking character while the voice stream plays, plays a sound effect at a given motion progress, and returns the number of frames waited once the voice message input is done.

25a556197e326d73.name: play_both_scenes_then_jump_to_g05
25a556197e326d73.doc: Plays the hide and seek scene and then event 748, then jumps to map g05 at entry 560. Returns 0.

25a89bec08ba99f6.name: play_time_gate_explanation_scene
25a89bec08ba99f6.doc: Event 250 follow-up at the Time Gate. Monica explains the Atlamillia stones: red goes to the future and blue to the past. She says Max's red stone chose him after his father, and they resolve to bring back the Great Elder Jurak and restore Sindain. Sets flag 250.

25c0c25bde447c0d.name: talk_olivie_after_joining
25c0c25bde447c0d.doc: Olivie's chatter after the race quest is cleared, hoping to stand on the winner's podium. Chapter 8 swaps in a remark about Fabio's single interest.

25cf68a566c92c4d.name: board_train_or_inspect_it
25cf68a566c92c4d.doc: Before flag 202 the player just comments on the train. Afterwards asks to board and jumps into the front car (Locomotive or the Ixion engine room) or a middle car (Train or the Ixion guest room), depending on the chapter and which door was used.

25dc26f65cae6a0c.name: warp_to_s06_map
25dc26f65cae6a0c.doc: Fades out and loads map s06 at event 500, skipping the next BGM play.

25f493b5d79e0568.name: go_to_stonehenge_ritual_map
25f493b5d79e0568.doc: Fades out and jumps to map s66 at entry 600.

260ae3955b7b2032.name: turn_chara_to_yaw
260ae3955b7b2032.doc: Turns a character in place to target_yaw over a time proportional to the angle, using the walk motion when the turn is larger than 0.5 radian, then returns to stand. The final call only reads the rotation and does not set it.

260db275bfcb4bc5.name: play_stream_message
260db275bfcb4bc5.doc: Opens the stream by id, shows its message and plays it with the player confirming.

261bcb5df54f009a.name: play_nova_driver_cannon_scene
261bcb5df54f009a.doc: Plays part two of event 640: the party watches as Paznos prepares its strongest weapon, the Nova Driver Cannon.

261ee71906161c46.name: vanish_spider_web
261ee71906161c46.doc: Makes the spider web nest vanish by itself (used by Donny and by the other characters) and opens the minimap door.

26235d4f8eeeb710.name: talk_adel_to_monica
26235d4f8eeeb710.doc: Adel's two-part talk to Monica asking her to stop putting Max in danger, with a short prayer for their safety in chapter 8.

263c7e7b30fe5c5b.name: take_item_9_from_branch
263c7e7b30fe5c5b.doc: Disables the "branch" marker, gives item 9 with a message and removes the stick prop in slot 15.

263f315e1cd8920f.name: show_restored_map_part_if_flag_448
263f315e1cd8920f.doc: If flag 448 is set, swaps map part p11_g0301 for p12_g0301.

26473c54675f9e39.name: ask_to_go_to_veniccio
26473c54675f9e39.doc: Asks whether to move to Veniccio. Returns 1 if the player agrees and runs off, otherwise the character walks back and it returns 0.

2656989aafa5d14c.name: press_panel_0_5
2656989aafa5d14c.doc: Candle puzzle step for the church candle at row 0, column 5: cuts to a fixed camera, waits 45 frames, toggles that candle and its four neighbours (i01h07_13 pieces), then waits 45 frames.

266f77fb3a413250.name: run_in_from_exit_64
266f77fb3a413250.doc: Entry cutscene for exit 64: the player runs in from the map edge while the camera tracks their position.

266ff97e4aea64b5.name: play_gate_swing_open_scene
266ff97e4aea64b5.doc: Cutscene of a double door gate opening: the camera turns to the gate, the two door pieces swing open and the lock piece lifts away.

26a07148ef51ff38.name: use_star_key_gate
26a07148ef51ff38.doc: Interaction with the star-shaped gate. Blocked with a message until flag 616 is set, then the player can use the Star Key (362) to remove the gate and see a star key model grow.

26d0d3337e37d7b7.name: ask_to_retry_challenge
26d0d3337e37d7b7.doc: Max says he will challenge Porcus again but needs more preparation. If the player chooses to go it fades the camera out and returns 1.

26d483bfad43097f.name: talk_to_milane_gladius
26d483bfad43097f.doc: Talk handler for Milane. Picks the line by the active character, quest 0 state and quest 10 (power up the Gladius).

26d621f6c6916edd.name: talk_cedric_at_station
26d621f6c6916edd.doc: Talk handler for Cedric at the station. On maps 16, 54 and 83, once the arrival event is seen and the departure not yet, he asks whether to leave and returns 1 if the player picks yes. Otherwise, as party NPC he gives a safety line plus a not-ready line until the arrival flag is set; if he is not the party NPC it opens the party member menu. Returns 0 unless the player chose to leave.

26d8b7ea4966e321.name: start_dungeon_from_map_menu
26d8b7ea4966e321.doc: Clears the local flags, opens the dungeon map menu, sets the stage to 3 and the chosen floor, loads map d05b01 and returns. The code after the return, which loads d04f02, is never reached.

2700eb8cbe20ba6e.name: replay_swamp_villagers_trouble_scene
2700eb8cbe20ba6e.doc: Story event 215: resets the progress and replays the villagers trouble scene.

271174734cd8a1af.name: get_analyze_410
271174734cd8a1af.doc: Returns analysis flag 410, which the third town uses to gate event 556 and to hide a map part.

2717f9afca2960cf.name: report_scoops
2717f9afca2960cf.doc: Scoop reporting talk: asks for a Scoop Memo if the player has none, says there are no more scoops when all are known, otherwise reports newly learned and newly obtained scoops. Ends with check_scoop_reward and returns its result, or 0 when no memo.

273691e56ecb2a6f.name: play_elephant_taunt_then_go_to_palm_brinks
273691e56ecb2a6f.doc: Heals the party, plays the elephant taunt scene and goes to Palm Brinks in Georama edit mode.

27413068c9abd37e.name: play_floor_clear
27413068c9abd37e.doc: Plays the victory pose of the active character after clearing a Spheda floor, then shows the floor clear messages with the camera on the course and goal. Skips the first comment on stage 3.

274adc3c6e2ed51a.name: show_departure_lights_shot
274adc3c6e2ed51a.doc: First shot of the departure: places Max and Steve, fades in and plays sounds while Steve's light frame is switched on.

274c8cc8537710e4.name: talk_borneo_at_station
274c8cc8537710e4.doc: Talk handler for Borneo at the station. When Borneo (party NPC 2) is in the party he says a fixed line plus chapter 3 and 4 lines (chapter 4 only until the Ixion flag is seen), then talk_to_npc; otherwise it opens the party member menu. Returns 0.

275672be4b064a90.name: talk_gerald_early
275672be4b064a90.doc: Gerald's talk before the first quest is cleared: he tells Max it is time to learn about mining.

27613a36a60be1e4.name: talk_milane_to_max
27613a36a60be1e4.doc: Milane's talk when Max is the active character: he mentions the circus. Chapter 8 swaps in a question about tough guys in the mine.

2768e5cbd11815ad.name: play_underground_waterway_door_speech
2768e5cbd11815ad.doc: Cedric says that the door leads to the underground waterway and that Max will go on alone.

27760aa49a4ba1b9.name: use_floor_gate
27760aa49a4ba1b9.doc: Handles a floor gate. If the gate is locked it offers the Luna Stone (item 342) from the item menu to unlock it. If open it asks whether to leave, shows the floor medal messages, and moves to the next floor chosen by the gate index.

277feacb1d2c361b.name: talk_blinkhorn_busy_away
