277feacb1d2c361b.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk when he is not at his post by the gate: he says he is busy gathering materials for the town's safety and asks Max to come back tomorrow.

27a6bd5bf6e72067.name: play_front_golems_march_shot
27a6bd5bf6e72067.doc: Variant of the golem march in which only the first 30 golems march toward the camera.

27a726281a452599.name: open_clown_chest
27a726281a452599.doc: Treasure chest cutscene where a clown pops out holding a big and a small chest. The player picks one; the two items are swapped at random first, so item_a and item_b are not tied to a size. The big chest gives item_b and the small one item_a. If the bag is full a no-room message is shown, and the bag overflow menu opens when needed.

27ac8706de4c67be.name: warp_to_s20_after_story_512
27ac8706de4c67be.doc: Story 512 program: warps to map s20 and runs its story_512 program (15120 = 512*10+10000).

27b5cc7cece9146a.name: play_broken_flower_memory_scene
27b5cc7cece9146a.doc: Cutscene (event 704, sets flag 704): in a garden of flowers two figures talk about a flower with a broken stem, and decide to put the flowers in a room. The party watches and reacts.

27d7dd710e76a31d.name: talk_blinkhorn_joined
27d7dd710e76a31d.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk after he has joined: outside chapter 8 he praises the player's legs, in chapter 8 he offers help.

27e191e745e2ee95.name: play_far_view_and_jump_to_f30
27e191e745e2ee95.doc: Plays the far view shot of the fortress and jumps to map f30 at entry 603.

27e88834ca020fe0.name: setup_spheda
27e88834ca020fe0.doc: Creates the Spheda game, loading the bar image for the language, the ball and pin models in the colors the game picked, and the pin collision. Sets draw distances per dungeon stage.

27f07db0846f3bf2.name: play_arrival_at_donnys_base_scene
27f07db0846f3bf2.doc: Skippable scene where the exhausted Max and Donny talk about escaping Flotsam's Circus Troupe, and Donny shows Max the underground water channel, his secret base. Ends with a tip to talk to Donny and save first.

28166d2db6708675.name: ask_to_leave_via_rapis_point
28166d2db6708675.doc: Rapis point interaction. Characters other than Max and Monica only comment. Before the Water Gem is taken it says the Rapis has not been obtained; afterwards it asks and on yes fades out and loads the d04 dungeon event script.

283549bcd0155953.name: talk_to_party_cedric_or_ask_to_depart
283549bcd0155953.doc: Talk handler for Cedric. On maps 16, 54 and 83 once the chapter task is done he asks whether to set off and returns 1 when the player agrees. Otherwise he gives a farewell or says he cannot leave yet.

283dd26b49dd9930.name: ask_to_leave_and_fade_out
283dd26b49dd9930.doc: Asks the leave-the-area question (item question 55). On yes fades out and returns 1, otherwise returns 0.

2843e8ee757ed9f3.name: play_alexandra_farewell_then_enter_d06b01
2843e8ee757ed9f3.doc: Plays the farewell scene and loads dungeon d06b01 at entry 510.

2846b27e49288791.name: chat_with_pau_after_joining
2846b27e49288791.doc: Pau's chatter after the quest is done, which differs in chapter 8.

284add3a206c6cee.name: show_cedric_work_unfinished
284add3a206c6cee.doc: Event program that makes Max say he has not finished the work Cedric asked him to do.

284eda9c58d72d70.name: setup_station_start
284eda9c58d72d70.doc: Chooses what to play on arrival: the Geostone scene once flag 31 is set, a run-in from a dungeon or town, the train arrival (late-chapter version in chapters 6 and 7), or places the player after a save load.

284fa9d77a62d4e9.name: swap_max_and_monica
284fa9d77a62d4e9.doc: Switches the controlled character between Max's side (0, 2) and Monica's side (1, 3) with a sepia flash: saves each side's position and yaw, loads the other's, swaps the change masks, loads the matching sound set and wipes back in.

2860b3411893a3ef.name: walk_party_toward_roof
2860b3411893a3ef.doc: Crossfades to a new shot, walks Max and Monica forward for 60 frames and starts Rococo's on-the-roof loop.

28684ef9db885366.name: pick_up_wrench
28684ef9db885366.doc: Gives the Wrench (item 382) with an item message and disables the item point.

287db69778ab11db.name: play_opening_need_and_chase_scene
287db69778ab11db.doc: Opening movie part 3. A visitor and his men press Mayor Need to find a stone, boast that they will find it, and then spot the red stone around Max's neck and order him chased.

28815fad948cde45.name: use_jump_gate
28815fad948cde45.doc: Opens the Jump Gate destination menu.

288c11de1545a5e9.name: calc_accel_and_speed
288c11de1545a5e9.doc: Solves constant acceleration for a move of dist units in frames that ends at end_speed, writing the acceleration and the starting speed into the two out arrays.

28967576930a3f9f.name: setup_m06_midnight_start
28967576930a3f9f.doc: Runs the m06 setup, sets midnight, checks the memory card load and puts the player at (2100, 2200) with the camera behind.

28a40a5b52ded689.name: play_walk_to_station_scene
28a40a5b52ded689.doc: Event 201 (flag 201): Max walks along a path while the camera follows and then orbits him, with a train model parked off screen, then fades out and puts the player at the start spot with music 193. Skippable.

28aaa854a8ed06b0.name: board_train_if_confirmed
28aaa854a8ed06b0.doc: Asks whether to board. On yes sets counter 1 to 9 and boards the front car (cars 0 and 1, to s37 the engine room) or another car (jumps to s38 the guest room after the door scene).

28b6d5408b0910a4.name: play_carpenterion_appears_scene
28b6d5408b0910a4.doc: Event 250 (sets flag 250): the Carpenterion arrives with a crowd of Firbits, plants trees on either side of Max and Monica, who dodge and marvel at it, and the elder invites Max aboard.

28b84d54c5e7f0a8.name: play_run_in_arrival_scene
28b84d54c5e7f0a8.doc: Arrival scene on entering the map: the player runs in from the entrance as the camera eases. Skipped when flag 207 is set and 208 is not, since the story script plays instead.

28ba5f16e521cbc7.name: wrap_angle_pi
28ba5f16e521cbc7.doc: Wraps an angle in radians into the range minus PI to PI.

28c215b5d26bdd5e.name: talk_aunt_polly_early
28c215b5d26bdd5e.doc: Aunt Polly's talk before the first quest is cleared: advice on earning customers' trust in business.

28ca546e1836b9fe.name: play_fire_scene_and_go_to_battle_3
28ca546e1836b9fe.doc: Plays Paznos firing and jumps to map s55 at event 603.

28d4c138665ee456.name: run_voice_for
28d4c138665ee456.doc: Runs the voice lip sync for the given window and frame count with the default third argument -1.

28ed2bce9cca794c.name: start_paznos_launch_on_story
28ed2bce9cca794c.doc: Story trigger for event 540: sets flag 536, clears flag 540, places the villagers and plays the Paznos launch.

28f75d1d0ed762b9.name: play_buggy_chase_on_train_roof_scene
28f75d1d0ed762b9.doc: Sets flag 204. Max climbs onto the roof of the train while an armed buggy chases it. Cedric on the roof hands him a bomb to throw back. Ends with the title card shrinking in and then leads into the buggy sub game.

29211dd15017efd1.name: talk_donny_shop_closed
29211dd15017efd1.doc: Donny's talk before the first quest is cleared: his shop is closed and the player is sent to his father's shop at the top of the ladder.

2930de533ab945d5.name: play_crest_farewell_scene
2930de533ab945d5.doc: Event 356, second half. Crest and Lin lie hurt after the shelling; Lin is told to carry on as a sage, Crest dies in her arms and Lin promises to become the legendary sage. Ends with the cleanup in unload_crest_farewell_actors and a camera reset.

294014c6b9e3877d.name: setup_map_and_place_player
294014c6b9e3877d.doc: Map start program: runs the setup, places the player at (0, 0, 170) with the camera behind and fades in.

296e5cf5e8fd0b1e.name: play_balance_valley_arrival_scene
296e5cf5e8fd0b1e.doc: Event 302 (sets flag 302): Max and Monica arrive in Balance Valley and learn the four plateaus change height. They spot houses and decide to look for people.

296ef50f3374954d.name: on_map_start
296ef50f3374954d.doc: Map entry. When coming from the start of the game it fades in on the camera pan, then plays whichever of events 270, 272, 275, 280 and 285 can play now. Event 272 also gives the Lafrescia Seed and Badge Box.

2981c0e27f0d9f22.name: talk_to_woman_who_needs_town_hall
2981c0e27f0d9f22.doc: Moves the camera behind the player and talks to a woman who had business at City Hall but it is closed.

29846675ebde7195.name: walk_party_further
29846675ebde7195.doc: Moves Max and Monica along the path for 45 frames.

298a577475e97b92.name: play_noam_scene_and_advance_story
298a577475e97b92.doc: Event 502: plays the Noam scene and sets the story counter to 2 or 3 depending on whether the player has the Fishing Rod and whether flag 230 is set.

299e5ba7c74cc4cc.name: open_item_chest
299e5ba7c74cc4cc.doc: Dungeon treasure chest opening scene for item: pauses monsters and the player, adds the item, cracks the lid, shows the item popping out with the get effect, shows the item get message, then restores control.

29b158189c9d0ffc.name: cleanup_e204_charas
29b158189c9d0ffc.doc: Deletes the five characters (32 to 36) loaded for event 204.

29db0910899a20ad.name: play_station_pieces_slide_shot
29db0910899a20ad.doc: Slides the two station map pieces 200 units apart over 285 frames while the engine runs. Returns 0.

2a199f8a913d4365.name: talk_to_door_guardian
2a199f8a913d4365.doc: The door: before the password is known runs the turn-away or the password question; afterwards asks to enter and loads d06b01.

2a431114a5797620.name: start_osmond_lab_map
2a431114a5797620.doc: Map entry. With flag 400 set it plays the sleeping Osmond scene (event 414) before flag 408, and the Electric Worm meeting (event 412, giving the worm) after; otherwise it places the player at the door and fades in.

2a46efb6160b6b52.name: face_chara_and_show_message
2a46efb6160b6b52.doc: Turns the player to face the given character if needed, then shows an automatic message.

2a5afd32551f6dca.name: start_blackstone_departure
2a5afd32551f6dca.doc: Plays the Blackstone One departure scene.

2a6111ac8aded5ce.name: show_event_255a_stub
2a6111ac8aded5ce.doc: Placeholder for event 255a: sets the event 255 seen flag and shows a debug message naming the event.

2a85cdff363e832a.name: get_cursor_direction
2a85cdff363e832a.doc: Reads the analog stick for moving a message cursor. Returns -1 or 1 when it is pushed past half range, using the horizontal axis for window mode 5 and the vertical axis otherwise, else 0.

2a8795bdd021895f.name: leave_to_i03h05
2a8795bdd021895f.doc: Leaves the fishing race hall: deletes the scene characters and jumps to map i03h05 (Finny Frenzy Races).

2a982d4640c3a0a4.name: play_osmond_warns_palace_returned_scene
2a982d4640c3a0a4.doc: Sets flag 616. Osmond runs up out of breath and tells Max and Monica the Moonflower Palace has somehow returned to the present. Max wonders what Griffon is planning.

2a9ee6a425471733.name: start_gold_paint_quest
2a9ee6a425471733.doc: Plays the Monica introduction when she is active. Otherwise plays the Gold Paint request and marks quest 1 as accepted.

2aa6654435f48fe5.name: ask_to_return_to_dungeon_d03
2aa6654435f48fe5.doc: Interaction with the exit of the boss room. Companions comment; without flag 628 (the gem) the player is told they do not have the gem yet; otherwise a question offers to leave and returns to dungeon d03.

2ab502b0c589e221.name: play_monica_takes_over_after_giving_up_scene
2ab502b0c589e221.doc: Event 315. Monica demonstrates the shot after the player gives up. Sets flag 315.

2ac511d744b7fce8.name: replay_find_tree_expert_scene
2ac511d744b7fce8.doc: Debug entry: plays the find-tree-expert scene.

2aceb38004329da4.name: load_toryon_rock_charas
2aceb38004329da4.doc: Loads Toryon, the boulder and the thrown rock models as scene actors.

2adab204f1027b83.name: play_e648_osmond_scene
2adab204f1027b83.doc: Plays event e648 with Osmond and sets flag 648.

2aeda0dd1bba0843.name: fade_in_player_at_origin
2aeda0dd1bba0843.doc: Event that places the player at the origin, fades in and finishes.

2af42e494524520c.name: party_looks_up
2af42e494524520c.doc: Max and Monica stop and look up, Monica 10 frames after Max.

2b2292cf7d88ebb2.name: test_shingala_healed_scene
2b2292cf7d88ebb2.doc: Debug entry that plays the healing scene.

2b2956c7f70acfb0.name: restore_player_character
2b2956c7f70acfb0.doc: Cleans up after the scene: reactivates the active character, deletes the other character, equipment and the scene actors.

2b3d57f9d1b19655.name: play_blue_gate_warp
2b3d57f9d1b19655.doc: Plays the blue time gate warp, with Monica if she has joined, preceded by the Atlamillia blue light scene on the first visit when flags allow, then resets the world origin.

2b4427427da72cf7.name: restore_floor_at_story_308
2b4427427da72cf7.doc: Story jump to 308: sets flag 300 and clears 320, then sets up the floor from the flags.

2b6535292aeeca29.name: play_random_crowd_scene
2b6535292aeeca29.doc: Sets flag 824. Same as the faded crowd scene but without the fade-in.

2b715b382540de3a.name: start_s20_map
2b715b382540de3a.doc: Sets up the map, then plays the Fire Squall discovery scene if flag 508 is set and 512 is not, otherwise the arrival run-in scene.

2bb1e89dd4be9696.name: play_geostone_found_scene
2bb1e89dd4be9696.doc: Plays event 254: sets the item board expanded flag, Max and Monica run to a character who says they found a Geostone and leads them away to remake the forest.

2bb669abc02cea64.name: play_miracle_dumplings_delivery_scene
2bb669abc02cea64.doc: Sets flag 328. Max and Monica return to Crest's house with Lao Chao's Miracle Dumplings for Lin while Shiroza warns them to leave them alone.

2bba36b133454a15.name: talk_to_girl_asking_what_you_do
2bba36b133454a15.doc: A girl asks what the player is doing.

2bbdb7cdbce9c528.name: play_event_245_step
2bbdb7cdbce9c528.doc: Final step of event 245: fades out, deletes character 14, disables two function points and hides a map part in the station, plays the scene where the Priscleen fish is delivered, sets counter 3 to 6 and updates the story points.

2bbe45f56e7598fe.name: is_town_1_complete
2bbe45f56e7598fe.doc: Returns 1 when town 1 is 100 percent rebuilt.

2bd8256ec2cd6381.name: start_sea_dragon_fight
2bd8256ec2cd6381.doc: Places monster 612 in the arena, pauses battle music and starts the boss BGM 190.

2bddee067f1f41b2.name: warp_to_s06_after_story_107
2bddee067f1f41b2.doc: Story 107 program: sets story progress to 3 and warps to map s06, running its script event 510 in s06b_1.

2c06c1ffd543abeb.name: start_dark_element_battle_from_story
2c06c1ffd543abeb.doc: Sets up the Dark Element battle.

2c1ba5179fcd314c.name: hide_cedric
2c1ba5179fcd314c.doc: Hides Cedric: stops the villager AI for slot 24 and deactivates the character.

2c209b835d54a666.name: wait_background_load_or_skip
2c209b835d54a666.doc: Waits until the background load ends. Returns 1 if button 32 is pressed first, otherwise 0.

2c33570125b0d947.name: dispatch_talk_event
2c33570125b0d947.doc: Talk program: reads which character was talked to; Cedric (character 1) goes to talk_to_cedric_by_flags, and character -1 with flag 6 set and flag 7 clear starts event 520 in i01h01c.

2c67b50e1a529937.name: start_room_music
2c67b50e1a529937.doc: Plays battle music 190 until both chests are taken, then music 193.

2c69c82eebed0029.name: play_camera_flyover_along_z
2c69c82eebed0029.doc: Hides the player and the battleship, then flies the camera 400 frames from far south of the map to the north end, rising in the second half, before returning control.

2c79df55ddfe1c2f.name: play_paznos_transforms_scene
2c79df55ddfe1c2f.doc: Event 640 cutscene variant with music 115 in which Paznos begins to transform; Max and Monica ask what it is and remark that it looks like Paznos transforming. Used by program 630. Sets flag 640.

2c8afe3f8984e4ae.name: wait_for_cross_press
2c8afe3f8984e4ae.doc: Starts an event, waits one frame and then until the player presses Cross (pad mask 64), then finishes the event.

2c98c6384846ab2b.name: play_room_entry_scene
2c98c6384846ab2b.doc: Program 200: enables the exit, pauses events, sets the room for the story flags and plays the run-into-room scene.

2cb0687444f26805.name: talk_donny_shop_closed
2cb0687444f26805.doc: Donny's talk before the first quest is cleared: his shop is closed and the player is sent to his father's shop at the top of the ladder.

2cbbd7cf989a382a.name: play_story_416_scene
2cbbd7cf989a382a.doc: Sets story flags 400 to 408 and plays event 416 (the Electric Fish and Shingala).

2cc710698580179b.name: lock_map_and_load_s43b_entry_151
2cc710698580179b.doc: Stops the flow of time, hides the status bar, locks map movement, pauses the minimap, runs play_opening_circus_crowd_scene and play_opening_elephant_ball_scene and loads s43/s43b.stb at entry 151.

2cec6f8b53c55d6d.name: play_golem_slope_charge_middle_columns
2cec6f8b53c55d6d.doc: Variant of the slope charge in which only columns 3 to 5 of the golems run up the slope.

2cf64c6fbcd2c81c.name: play_golem_charge_columns
2cf64c6fbcd2c81c.doc: Debug test: waits 30 frames, then plays the golem slope charge for the left, middle and right columns in turn.

2d1942d89fcaf4a5.name: talk_gerald_joined
2d1942d89fcaf4a5.doc: Gerald's line once he has joined. Outside chapter 8 he warns about the danger of guns, in chapter 8 he says something different.

2d235fa3f89962d4.name: talk_to_monster
2d235fa3f89962d4.doc: Runs the shared monster talk handler.

2d5246169d2db625.name: ask_to_go_to_paus_house
2d5246169d2db625.doc: Asks whether to move to Pau's House. On yes the player runs along a path and the screen fades, returning 1; otherwise steps back and returns 0.

2d52618c1a428d97.name: play_key_door_open_scene
2d52618c1a428d97.doc: Cutscene of a key door opening: eight door pieces scale open over 60 frames with the sound effects, the door hides and its trigger is disabled.

2d5d5a62c73d1b01.name: talk_rufio_early
2d5d5a62c73d1b01.doc: Rufio's talk before he can be recruited: a wistful speech about longing for the moon. Then talk_to_npc.

2d6362ee5bf6a6eb.name: place_seated_firbits_debug
2d6362ee5bf6a6eb.doc: Debug scene that places seven Firbits and Monica around the room and waits for a button press.

2d928c6d6e2d0076.name: give_star_key_event_616
2d928c6d6e2d0076.doc: Gives item 362 (the star key used by the d04 door), plays event 616 and jumps to map s37 at event 530.

2d9c4c9858788418.name: replay_lin_wakes_scene
2d9c4c9858788418.doc: Debug entry: sets flag 324, clears 330 and plays the scene where Lin wakes up.

2daaa2c918ff00fb.name: open_treasure_chest
2daaa2c918ff00fb.doc: Opens a treasure chest, its contents and type read from the chest. A mimic chest (bit 256) spawns a mimic, after asking a mimic-sniffing partner (NPC 9) whether to open it. Locked (2) and trapped (4) chests get their own prompts first, and a refusal ends the event. Otherwise it opens a clown chest (128), an empty chest (512) or a normal chest. Returns the first item.

2dd9281fe4deff51.name: talk_to_shopkeeper
2dd9281fe4deff51.doc: Talks to the event character; when story progress is 100 greets the player and opens the shop, otherwise runs the normal villager talk.

2dddc328ac43793c.name: talk_to_shigura_about_shingala
2dddc328ac43793c.doc: Shigura dialogue about Shingala's illness, depending on whether the player has visited the Luna Lab (flag 420), has the Secret Dragon Remedy and has healed Shingala (flags 438 and 444).

2de581d3edc4688c.name: play_departure_into_waterway_shot
2de581d3edc4688c.doc: Closing shot: Max and Steve walk off toward the door while the camera fades out and the projection zooms for 120 frames.

2deb957530ead0d5.name: play_moonflower_beam_scene
2deb957530ead0d5.doc: Cutscene (event 616 part 2): the party reacts angrily to the Moonflower beam (it is Griffon's doing), then Osmond warns Max to run and they retreat.

2e07d7aa04a5dc30.name: play_wind_gem_scene_and_open_room
2e07d7aa04a5dc30.doc: After the boss is cleared: gives the Wind Gem, marks the floor info flag 2, plays the Wind Gem scene and unlocks map movement.

2e0ad28f8bfbef97.name: play_missing_mother_memory_scene
2e0ad28f8bfbef97.doc: Sets flag 102. Over a white-faded flashback of a crying child, Max recalls walking through the Underground Channel and not remembering his mother's face. Time of day is forced to noon during the scene and restored afterwards.

2e2b4b9fc31d5ae0.name: play_opening_pierrots_scene
2e2b4b9fc31d5ae0.doc: Plays the opening scene with Pol Curse and the pierrots.

2e3eb5f3ac8e59b7.name: start_dream_spiral_fight_5
2e3eb5f3ac8e59b7.doc: Applies the debug loadout and starts the fifth dream spiral boss event on map d06b02.

2e4dbaa85b1e910e.name: talk_milane_after_joining
2e4dbaa85b1e910e.doc: Milane's two-part chatter after the sword quest is cleared, about the beauty of a well-made sword. Chapter 8 swaps in a question about tough guys in the mine.

2e51f1608c502aee.name: clear_scene_for_warp
2e51f1608c502aee.doc: Prepares a floor warp: removes the Spheda minigame, fades out at once and waits one frame.

2e9ecb46355b3424.name: play_e105c_laugh_talk
2e9ecb46355b3424.doc: Voiced shot where Cedric laughs and explains how to invent the Energy Pack: open the Make menu, choose Invention Mode, then pick the milk can, pipes and belt pictures. se_bank is passed in by the caller.

2ea3d893a9b80467.name: press_panel_row0_col0
2ea3d893a9b80467.doc: Presses the puzzle switch for the panel at row 0, column 0, toggling it and its neighbours.

2eb162def274b73d.name: setup_boss_arena_entry
2eb162def274b73d.doc: Places the boss and escorts, puts the player at the arena entrance and fades in.

2ebcf11e983acf4e.name: close_stop_hint
2ebcf11e983acf4e.doc: Closes message window 1, the one showing the stop button hint.

2ec993b3236db6ed.name: greet_and_open_shop
2ec993b3236db6ed.doc: Shopkeeper greeting and shop. Shows a welcome and a line depending on the speaker (church, smith, Georama dealer, or three substitute shopkeepers whose first-meeting intro sets a met flag), runs the talk, then opens the matching shop menu for that character.

2ecc65175f5cd4f6.name: play_event_504_then_jump_to_g04
2ecc65175f5cd4f6.doc: Plays event 504 (Max and Monica see Gaspard is angry that they are restoring origin points) and jumps to map g04 at entry 510.

2ee9fb2bde922469.name: play_monster_pack_intro_scene
2ee9fb2bde922469.doc: Introduction to the six monsters of the boss room: they pop in and attack in random order under a title card, then the player is put back.

2eefbdb0623f50a9.name: play_receiver_advice_scene
2eefbdb0623f50a9.doc: Sets up the dungeon entrance stage with Max and the receiver, plays the advice dialogue and hands control back.

2f0a87bbe76473db.name: talk_parn_gold_paint
2f0a87bbe76473db.doc: Parn waits for Gold Paint. The player picks an item from the menu: cancelling ends the talk, a wrong item gets a rebuke, Gold Paint is removed and his painting comes to life. Parn is recruited, Julia is set to join, and quest 1 is marked cleared.

2f13402431c7c332.name: confirm_map_exit
2f13402431c7c332.doc: Asks a yes or no question before leaving the station map. Answering yes fades out and returns 1, anything else returns 0.

2f1ad5a39ae07277.name: play_dark_element_scene_then_load_d06b02
2f1ad5a39ae07277.doc: Hides the party members, plays the Dark Element awakening scene and loads dungeon map d06b02 with its event script.

2f2464b562d7fb23.name: play_camera_flythrough
2f2464b562d7fb23.doc: Hides the player, flies the camera along a long path and waits for a button press before returning control.

2f3ec88df67572a8.name: ask_if_giving_up_spheda
2f3ec88df67572a8.doc: Monica asks whether the player is giving up. Returns 1 for yes, with a fade out, or 0 after she cheers them on.

2f4ee05819e32b88.name: show_message_with_voice
2f4ee05819e32b88.doc: Shows the message text and plays the voice stream with the same id.

2f6081028435d761.name: talk_corinne
2f6081028435d761.doc: Picks Corinne's talk by quest state: before quest 0 is done the early line, then by quest 18 status the quest offer, the found talk, or the joined talk. Returns 0.

2f61fdacbbda343b.name: play_lapis_get_scene
2f61fdacbbda343b.doc: Event 628/624: Max or Monica reaches the Lapis in the boss room and receives item 367, with an item get message and the item limit menu afterwards. Sets flag 628.

2f8625bb5e5475da.name: play_rococo_house_scene
2f8625bb5e5475da.doc: Event 208. Max and Monica find a lone house; a dwarf of the Firbit tribe jumps down from its roof. Monica tugs his beard, he gets angry and runs off without answering their question about Jurak. Sets flag 208.

2f87b92294c9e5c7.name: play_farewell_and_return_to_veniccio
2f87b92294c9e5c7.doc: Plays the Shingala farewell scene and goes to the Veniccio edit mode.

2fab131915afac6b.name: play_halloween_scene_then_go_to_palm_brinks
2fab131915afac6b.doc: Plays the Halloween appearance scene and jumps to map m08 (Palm Brinks) at event 152.

2fdf356bd5c3b1c9.name: play_toryon_rock_throw_scene
2fdf356bd5c3b1c9.doc: Event 616 cutscene: Toryon throws rocks and a moonflower beam charges while Max, Monica and Dr. Osmond run in; a train part is then flung along a hand-integrated arc for 240 frames while the camera follows. Skippable; ends by cleaning up the cast.

2fdf54c703897484.name: play_listen_up_lines
2fdf54c703897484.doc: The crew says they will tell Max what they learned, that it was fifteen years ago when something terrible happened to the world.

2fec2fe7c2671761.name: ask_to_use_second_entrance
2fec2fe7c2671761.doc: Handles the second entrance. Same flow as the dungeon entrance but with hints about the Firesquall machine and Ride Pod depending on flags 516 and 508. Returns 1 when leaving.

2fff47d1ebdcff4e.name: play_workshop_tour_from_debug
2fff47d1ebdcff4e.doc: Debug entry that plays the workshop tour intro scene.

30010c6f26458967.name: turn_and_fade_exit
30010c6f26458967.doc: Turns the player to yaw, plays the standing motion and a door sound (sound 92 when door_sound is set, else 94), then fades out over 30 frames.

3001584f5e9835b9.name: leave_clinic
3001584f5e9835b9.doc: Returns to the g02 town: goes outside when the current map number is 1, otherwise jumps to map g02 at its start.

3023c51ba9430779.name: talk_milane_early
3023c51ba9430779.doc: Milane's talk before the first quest is cleared: his shop specializes in blades and he has only a few guns.

303ce8e2325794e0.name: play_golem_march_and_jump_to_f30
303ce8e2325794e0.doc: Plays the golem army march and jumps to map f30 at entry 601.

3061d145286087b1.name: play_event_612_scene_then_go_to_s31
3061d145286087b1.doc: Plays the event 612 scene, hides Atla Millia and loads map s31 at event 510.

3063795f63db691d.name: start_h01_33_5_event
3063795f63db691d.doc: Initialises the event system and plays the talk_to_cedric_or_trigger_scene scene.

3069fd5b7082dea6.name: talk_to_argo
3069fd5b7082dea6.doc: Talks to Argo, the owl, who hoots and worries about Lin. What it says depends on story flags: asking for a doctor, the Lao Chao Restaurant, the White Windflower, the Miracle Dish or the dumplings, then Lin leaving to study.

3074b1578f0ec5c6.name: open_floor_select_map
3074b1578f0ec5c6.doc: Plays the dungeon BGM, opens the dungeon map menu for dungeon 2, stores the chosen floor and starts it.

3092d1dc656d1234.name: ask_to_leave_village
3092d1dc656d1234.doc: Asks a question; yes fades out and returns 1, no ends the event and returns 0.

3099ec2a54f55a7b.name: ask_to_leave_area
3099ec2a54f55a7b.doc: Asks the exit question (message set 4). Returns 1 after a fade out if the player says yes, otherwise 0.

309bedf3f1f6c14d.name: interact_with_gate_0
309bedf3f1f6c14d.doc: Handles the first of the four gates.

30aa1dfe4fd7b186.name: enter_time_gate_to_heim_rada
30aa1dfe4fd7b186.doc: Enters the blue time gate and jumps to map g04.

30aeb7dc746e7826.name: play_fishing_plan_scene_and_advance_story
30aeb7dc746e7826.doc: Event 502: plays the fishing plan scene, sets the story counter to 4 and returns to the s05 script.

30c4df5a5c98c8b7.name: talk_adel_to_monica
30c4df5a5c98c8b7.doc: Adel's two-part talk to Monica asking her to stop putting Max in danger, with a short prayer for their safety in chapter 8.

30d6987507f95e30.name: start_spheda_stage_4
30d6987507f95e30.doc: Loads the d05f01 Spheda course (mstage4), gives items 305 and 306, sets up Spheda with hole 4, places Max and opens the Spheda score view.

30d74b49a5217b27.name: replay_story_event_372
30d74b49a5217b27.doc: Story program for event 372: sets the Georama analysis flags 0 to 9 and the story event flags 364, 368, 372 and 376 (0 for the one to replay) and jumps to map 26.

30d7aac6c6922b0f.name: show_party_cancel_letter_or_block_demo
30d7aac6c6922b0f.doc: At progress 100 shows the demo message, otherwise shows the party cancel letter.

30e4aeb291f06961.name: show_cedric_doubts_story
30e4aeb291f06961.doc: Cedric stands with arms crossed and doubts what he hears, asking what Need plans to do.

30f98fdbcb033cc9.name: play_rock_throw_scene_then_go_to_s12
30f98fdbcb033cc9.doc: Plays the rock throwing scene (play_rock_throw_scene) and jumps to map s12 entrance 590.

30fa72c3d193bffe.name: play_boss_defeat_scene
30fa72c3d193bffe.doc: Called when the boss is beaten: reopens door01 and hides the barrier piece, unless in the trial version, and plays the defeat scene.

3100dc65a91dc556.name: setup_spheda_area_on_map_start
3100dc65a91dc556.doc: Chooses the area state from flags 300, 320 and 317: the condor scene before event 317, the cleared state after it, the dead end scene before 320, or a plain placement if the story has not started.

310173a60edabd78.name: play_miss_reaction
310173a60edabd78.doc: Miss reaction after a failed shot: Max and Monica turn to the camera and shake their head; Steve and the other non-human character (2 and 3) show nothing.

3106598439e9c564.name: setup_mine_start
3106598439e9c564.doc: Map start: loads sounds, places the player and, if event 804 has not been seen, enables Monica and the Ride Pod change, plays the Monica arrival scene and moves the player to z 800.

314d14bed134c3d5.name: leave_to_luna_lab_wing_1
314d14bed134c3d5.doc: Exits to map f03, setting counter 2 to 1.

315c879b7a35e1f9.name: stop_sounds_leave_for_s42
315c879b7a35e1f9.doc: Stops the BGM and environment sound, waits 6 frames and leaves for s42 (leave_for_s42_entry_500).

316096d75940d194.name: play_startled_look_back_shot
316096d75940d194.doc: Max looks back in surprise as the explosion sound plays.

31833bd12bbcc601.name: give_item_291_show_points
31833bd12bbcc601.doc: Gives four of item 291 with a message if the player has none, then shows the story points screen.

318e53945a025683.name: play_event_205_then_go_to_forest_tunnel
318e53945a025683.doc: Plays the train overloaded scene and jumps to map s03 (Forest Tunnel) at entrance 512.

31b34674abf84237.name: play_scene_then_go_to_s30_640
31b34674abf84237.doc: Plays play_palace_falls_toward_palm_brinks_scene and jumps to map s30 at event 640.

3215d1ce67e1f2b2.name: leave_for_s10
3215d1ce67e1f2b2.doc: If the exit question is answered yes, jumps to map s10.

3216479ccfb0039c.name: ask_board_train
3216479ccfb0039c.doc: Asks whether to go inside the train or leave. Cancelling returns 0; choosing leave fades out, opens the world map move menu and returns 0; choosing go inside returns 1.

321ef37f7870e495.name: show_shingala_killed_game_over
321ef37f7870e495.doc: Custom game over used when Shingala is killed: plays his death scene, shows a message that the future cannot be restored without him, the game over image, and exits the dungeon.

322298bc0195467e.name: play_enter_from_east_scene
322298bc0195467e.doc: The player runs in from the east edge of the area while the camera follows.

322ce22162fe2c4e.name: run_debug_test
322ce22162fe2c4e.doc: Debug program: waits for a button press, shows message 1002 and runs test 0.

323180a39bbdfb9d.name: set_idle_motion
323180a39bbdfb9d.doc: Puts the player model in its standing pose. For active character 2 it picks the legs or caterpillar tread stand motion by movement type; other characters use the normal stand.

323eceb4fb5bcc2e.name: talk_ferdinand_after_joining
323eceb4fb5bcc2e.doc: Ferdinand's chatter after the chestnut quest is cleared, promising Max he will never refuse him. Chapter 8 swaps in his dream of being the best chef.

324866f284ad399e.name: setup_event_209_actors
324866f284ad399e.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Conda, the wine bottle, the item get model, five magic sprites, the flower and the e209 magic effect script for event 209. Sets globals max_scene_slot and monica_scene_slot.

324c5b9fc0ecf47a.name: simulate_spheda_ball_shot
324c5b9fc0ecf47a.doc: Moves the Spheda ball frame by frame after a shot, with gravity, drag, bounces off geometry and rolling on the ground, plays splash and bounce sounds, and drags the camera along. If ball and pin colors differ the pin attracts the ball and catches it when it passes close. Ends when the ball stops, falls below the course or after 300 frames, then plays the goal effect at the pin.

327b2525741c3b4e.name: count_lit_candles
327b2525741c3b4e.doc: Returns how many of the 14 candle parts in the Palm Brinks church (map part p08_i01h07, i01h07_13-m7 to m21) are currently visible; used by Bruno's candle quest.

3290ca7c007eb2c8.name: play_lin_tribute_ending_with_star
3290ca7c007eb2c8.doc: Closing section of event 372 used when analysis flag 207 is set: the camera pulls back as the narration says Lin became a Sage and Crest is a star watching over her, ending on a shooting star and a fade out.

32ccf74afa2b1510.name: talk_to_train_crew
32ccf74afa2b1510.doc: Shows a short line for each of three crew members on the train: one tells Max to hurry up the ladder, one tells him to go see what it looks like outside, and one comments on the size of the bombs by the shocks.

32df059a12205385.name: talk_gordon_early
32df059a12205385.doc: Gordon's early talk while he tends a tree: Monica as active character gets a short remark about the tree, others hear that he is picking bugs off it and that plants need care.

32e1c65aaee8407a.name: enter_room_2_and_fight
32e1c65aaee8407a.doc: Fades out, plays the room 2 intro, disables the entrance point, raises the map parts 2 and 3 by 200, loads monster 604 and places the player; then fades in.

32e558b601a0fb1a.name: play_event_360
32e558b601a0fb1a.doc: Event 360 at Balance Valley station: Starble calls for departure toward the ocean and the scene fades out. Sets the seen flag first and can be skipped.

32ed9b4d49d6ce4e.name: talk_cedric_at_station
32ed9b4d49d6ce4e.doc: Talk handler for Cedric at the station. On maps 16, 54 and 83, once the arrival event is seen and the departure not yet, he asks whether to leave and returns 1 if the player picks yes. Otherwise, as party NPC he gives a safety line plus a not-ready line until the arrival flag is set; if he is not the party NPC it opens the party member menu. Returns 0 unless the player chose to leave.

3302419e69a0d8d9.name: place_swamp_characters_for_story
3302419e69a0d8d9.doc: Places the swamp characters, including the villagers while the story counter is below 7.

330b3bd284bd37c2.name: receive_sun_and_moon_stones
330b3bd284bd37c2.doc: Places the player at the south entry, fades in, waits 30 frames, gives the Sun Stone and Moon Stone (items 198 and 199) with get messages and opens the item limit menu with a fade.

332d2af47b43f451.name: play_farewell_before_ixion_scene
332d2af47b43f451.doc: Event 540. Max and Monica tell the crew that Luna Lab finished the Ixion and they will ride it to the distant past to find Griffon. They are encouraged to bring light back to the world. Sets flag 540.

3333774353148f8a.name: play_station_arrival_and_place_villagers
3333774353148f8a.doc: Sets up the map objects, pauses the AI of villager slots 24 to 26, plays the Balance Valley station arrival scene, places the villagers and turns their AI back on.

33436a593f585189.name: start_s02b_script_502
33436a593f585189.doc: Program 502: starts an event and loads script s02/s02b_1.stb as program 502.

336337c2cb9c10a4.name: talk_facing_each_other
336337c2cb9c10a4.doc: Conversation staging: turns the player and the NPC to face each other (walking if they are not already facing), waits 20 frames, runs the NPC's talk with lip sync, then turns the NPC back to its original facing. Second parameter is unused.

337994e926d384d6.name: start_boss_floor
337994e926d384d6.doc: If flag 58 is set, plays the Griffon confrontation, locks map movement, and places the first boss (monster 615 with helpers 618 to 620); fades in.

338548b367756a62.name: play_crest_time_travel_scene
338548b367756a62.doc: Event 372 scene: Baba Crest explains that Griffon's followers are evil by choice, that he must be stopped in his own time ten thousand years ago, and that the Luna Lab could make the leap.

33a0ebad93274d23.name: enter_central_lab_door_3
33a0ebad93274d23.doc: Turns toward the door, sets counter 2 to 3 and jumps to the Central Lab.

33b208ee6edd0d0a.name: setup_and_play_new_boss_scene
33b208ee6edd0d0a.doc: Runs the room sound setup and plays the new boss scene.

33c5188916598d0f.name: leave_for_gundorada_workshop
33c5188916598d0f.doc: Fades out and jumps to map f04, the Gundorada Workshop.

33cdd97ac3fb2ad6.name: play_shot_doors_slide
33cdd97ac3fb2ad6.doc: Opening-scene shot: hides characters 33 to 35, switches sound effects and slides the two door actors apart over 285 frames. Returns 0.

33fe4bb09c9e879e.name: play_donny_weapon_advice_call
33fe4bb09c9e879e.doc: Cutscene body of event 102: Max comes to his senses, takes out the receiver and Donny asks how it is going and advises strengthening weapons and using the Help menu.

341e72980537c754.name: leave_train_for_s07
341e72980537c754.doc: Unless the flag 203 train event is active, unlocks map movement, sets counter 0 and jumps to map s07.

34238178dbb32b66.name: disable_forest_event_points
34238178dbb32b66.doc: Turns off the event func points for the Spirit Forest story steps and item pickups.

3426ca9aa09dddbb.name: debug_play_osmond_meeting
3426ca9aa09dddbb.doc: Debug entry that plays the Osmond Electric Worm scene.

342fbc2822f8b509.name: start_lava_parting_story_event
342fbc2822f8b509.doc: Story event 526: stops the music and plays the lava parting scene.

3432cbf9c7500ad5.name: setup_map_parts_by_analysis
3432cbf9c7500ad5.doc: Binds the town map part; if analysis 305 is not set it disables the event_400 to event_404 points, otherwise hides the part; hides the p14 to p17 parts without analysis 300; then updates NPC slots.

3461c8f277a2dc2f.name: start_vacuum_repair
3461c8f277a2dc2f.doc: Talk handler for the vacuum: without the Wrench (item 382) Max remembers the tools are in the cabinet; otherwise asks whether to start (or wait if the Notebook, item 386, is not yet found). On the choice to repair it plays the repair scene and jumps to map m06 at program 151, Palm Brinks.

34648cb3fb2071c8.name: set_p03_part_active
34648cb3fb2071c8.doc: Binds the map part p03_i04h01 and sets it visible and its function point enabled together.

3485fe0b0b640e0f.name: play_night_run_to_gerald_scene
3485fe0b0b640e0f.doc: Test scene at 22:00: removes the villagers and charas 8 to 37, hides charas 122 and 123, then the player walks and runs up the plateau toward Gerald (p01_11a) while the camera rises along a path. Ends on a pad press and shows 122 and 123 again.

34a55b17bf9ba194.name: play_holly_thanks_scene
34a55b17bf9ba194.doc: Event 260. The seven butterflies merge back into Holly, who thanks the heroes, explains she was once saved by the Firbits and asks them to deliver a letter (the Teal Envelope). Afterwards Max and Monica decide to head for Jurak. Sets flag 260.

34a8f1615e06d0ff.name: pan_camera_around_view_short_shot
34a8f1615e06d0ff.doc: Shorter version of the camera sweep: 300 frames from a position near the east side of the map.

34adc79e1c4b2867.name: setup_s08_map_locked
34adc79e1c4b2867.doc: Runs the s08 map setup, locks map movement and fades in.

34b999aa6b5e81f3.name: debug_play_boss_intro
34b999aa6b5e81f3.doc: Plays the sea dragon boss intro scene.

34c79cf81b51640e.name: exit_to_f03_entrance_0
34c79cf81b51640e.doc: Turns and fades out, sets counter 2 to 0 and jumps to map f03.

34d6f171bed0e46b.name: play_toryon_arrival_scene
34d6f171bed0e46b.doc: Event 250. Six Firbits run off across the village, then Toryon, a flying machine, drops from the sky and plants two trees with its arms while Max and Monica dodge. A rider invites them to climb aboard because the machine can build whatever they like. Sets flag 250.

34dae0590a495017.name: run_game_over_voiced
34dae0590a495017.doc: Runs the game over sequence with a voice line, passing revive and voice through to the main game over function.

34e103e7c502005f.name: play_galen_gives_fire_horn_scene
34e103e7c502005f.doc: Event 524: Max meets Galen Agaris, who tells him about Gaspard and Monica's father Raybrandt, and gives him the Fire Horn (item 354) to cross lava. Sets flag 524.

34e6e36f03b6ad5b.name: finish_floor_clear_event
34e6e36f03b6ad5b.doc: Runs when a floor is cleared: the character strikes a victory pose, the floor is marked cleared, medal messages are shown and any broken seal messages (Red, Blue, White) appear. If the floor has the Spheda sub game and flag 317 is set it offers to move to the Spheda ball.

34e8bb619e2ec69b.name: start_monica_joins_party
34e8bb619e2ec69b.doc: Plays the Monica scene, then marks Monica and other NPCs as joined, sets story progress 4, adds Monica to the party and gives 5 Armband Repair Powder. Reloads the station.

34fa074fd70fc4c7.name: ask_to_go_to_next_floor
34fa074fd70fc4c7.doc: Asks a yes/no question. On yes it fades out, marks the current floor as done and the next floor as current, then loads the dungeon script d01.stb, or sets the exit flag in the trial version.

351250957208364d.name: start_circus_performance_scene
351250957208364d.doc: Stops the map sounds, starts the circus bgm, locks map moves and the minimap, and plays only the circus performance scene.

35233bbcd46ed416.name: show_sphida_score_on_d07f01
35233bbcd46ed416.doc: Sets up the Spheda floor d07f01 (hole 7) with items 305 and 306, places the player and opens the Spheda score view menu.

352676d875bdd408.name: warp_to_s56_event_348
352676d875bdd408.doc: Clears the scene, resets flag 348 and loads map s56 with the event script for event 348.

35572f0cc0a9dfbd.name: press_panel_row0_col2
35572f0cc0a9dfbd.doc: Presses the puzzle switch for the panel at row 0, column 2, toggling it and its neighbours.

3568dede18f704e2.name: play_vine_scene_and_go_to_next_floor
3568dede18f704e2.doc: Vine trigger. When touched, plays the vine scene and then loads map d02b02 and starts its event script at entry 500.

35716ac4ed78d8db.name: play_walk_in_fade
35716ac4ed78d8db.doc: Cutscene of the player walking through the door into the room and fading out: moves the player to the event part, lets them walk in, fades the camera to black over 60 frames and then binds the door part. Returns 0.

3589739187696b73.name: play_osmond_electric_worm_scene
3589739187696b73.doc: Story event 412. Max and Monica meet Dr. Osmond, a Luna Lab researcher, and ask for help with the mind-controlled sea dragon. He gives them an Electric Worm to shock the device on its head, explains it must be fed to a fish in an Aquarium first, then feeds that fish to the Shigura, and gives hints based on whether the player owns the Aquarium or its plan.

359ce23461e88719.name: setup_station_map
359ce23461e88719.doc: Map setup for the station: sets flag 40, shows the train and station parts for the current chapter (late parts in chapters 6 and 7), hides the train steps, and when flag 9 is set but 202 is not, hides the train and activates character slot 2.

35b714543d55915a.name: play_event_736_letter
35b714543d55915a.doc: Event 736 cutscene: Monica at the desk in her house at night, writing the farewell letter to her mother. Cuts between camera angles with five voiced lines and a sigh, then fades out. The scene can be skipped; the time of day is restored afterwards.

35bb60cc7b30be96.name: unlock_and_play_osmond_scene_then_go_to_s32
35bb60cc7b30be96.doc: Fades out, unlocks map movement, sets flag 616, plays the Osmond scene and jumps to map s32 (Moon Flower Palace vs Paznos) at entry 500.

35d069ef07a616b1.name: show_stop_hint
35d069ef07a616b1.doc: Shows a bottom-window hint that the gauge stops with the O button.

35d1c572e321aced.name: talk_waiting_npc
35d1c572e321aced.doc: Talk with a party NPC who waits at the station. The line changes after the waiting NPC has been released, tracked by flag.

35e3ac6d3c0c208f.name: start_floor_clear_scene
35e3ac6d3c0c208f.doc: Runs the shared floor clear scene when every monster is dead.

35f814041b59ca25.name: load_event_sound
35f814041b59ca25.doc: Loads the event sound bank EV_200_000 into the event sound port.

36148e6439ba6338.name: play_king_scene_then_go_to_palm_brinks
36148e6439ba6338.doc: After the battle, plays the king scene, restores Monica's equipment and the party order, gives starter items and goes to edit mode at Palm Brinks.

36230e57ff3543c5.name: finish_event_356
36230e57ff3543c5.doc: Sets flag 356, shows the event 356 title (Gaspard repelled, parting with Crest), re-enables map moves and fades out.

3637a8585444cb5e.name: finish_npc_talk
3637a8585444cb5e.doc: Ends an NPC conversation: optionally turns the NPC back to orig_yaw, sets it standing, ends the event and optionally starts a short crossfade.

363f05b307654621.name: talk_generic_villager
363f05b307654621.doc: Default talk handler for town villagers. Shop NPCs 1012, 1015 and 1018 open a shop, NPC 50 refuses passage, and in chapter 1 NPCs 2, 63 and 65 talk about the train (depends on whether it is running); in chapter 8 NPCs 61 and 80 talk about Monica (depends on her return flag). Anyone else shows a greeting plus the message-table line for the villager, with the Monica variant when Monica is active.

3653ad6ab75c7f92.name: play_run_in_from_valley
3653ad6ab75c7f92.doc: Max runs up a path onto the station platform with the camera following him.

36565651dab9c55a.name: hide_cedric_fade_in
36565651dab9c55a.doc: Hides Cedric, sets flag 17 when flag 18 is set, and fades the screen back in.

36727f1df2954fa3.name: setup_s21_map_state
36727f1df2954fa3.doc: Map setup: hides the item marker if item 374 is held or flag 708 is set, otherwise shows the p06s21 part; pauses weapon drawing, blocks character change and map movement and hides the party members.

36870422877ddd62.name: load_lighthouse_attack_actors
36870422877ddd62.doc: Loads the models, motions and message file (e352_1.txt) for the lighthouse attack scene: Max or Monica as the second party member, Crest, Lin, Gaspard, Jaming, the battleship and lighthouse map parts and the cannon.

368ab4e9c207a35a.name: setup_s21_entry
368ab4e9c207a35a.doc: Map setup: if event 704 was not seen plays it and places the player in the garden, otherwise places the player at the entrance.

36b7a92e13cb97ea.name: replay_donny_tutorial_scene
36b7a92e13cb97ea.doc: Clears the scene, loads the first floor map and plays Donny's receiver tutorial.

36c92c737dd05b48.name: play_secret_base_arrival_scene
36c92c737dd05b48.doc: Opening scene: Max, out of breath, and Donny climb down the ladder into the underground water channel. Max explains Flotsam's circus troupe is after him and Donny shows him his secret base. Skippable, and ends with a hint to talk to Donny.

36d1e0f3754b2522.name: send_player_to_take_photos
36d1e0f3754b2522.doc: Cedric tells Max to photograph a Milk Can, Pipes and a Belt nearby and wishes him luck.

36d83ae83a3b5412.name: ask_to_enter_dungeon
36d83ae83a3b5412.doc: Asks a question; yes fades out and returns 1, no walks the player a few steps and returns 0.

36df84f26dbd4f6e.name: play_nova_cannon_gift_scene
36df84f26dbd4f6e.doc: Story 468 program: sets up the map characters and plays the scene where Dr. Osmond presents the Nova Cannon, a sun-powered weapon to attach to the Ridepod.

37326c1ab68affd9.name: choose_scene_on_entry
37326c1ab68affd9.doc: Sets up the characters. Coming from map 2: if event 404 is unseen plays the scene where the party meets Pau and Shingala and jumps to g03, otherwise runs in from Veniccio. Coming from map 84: plays the Luna lab suggestion scene until the electric worm request has started, then the Pau asks for medicine scene. Other maps do nothing.

373b12f8128c4775.name: play_miss_reaction
373b12f8128c4775.doc: Max or Monica shake their head at the camera after missing a catch while fishing. Returns 0 at once for the other characters.

3747b3513a57ce67.name: play_train_takeoff_scene
3747b3513a57ce67.doc: Event 648: the train lifts off from the station and flies away while Max, Monica and Osmond watch. Sets flag 648 and then returns the player to the station.

374d5ced5dc8190a.name: open_item_chest
374d5ced5dc8190a.doc: Dungeon treasure chest opening scene for item (count copies): pauses the dungeon, shakes and opens the lid, shows the item popping out, and adds as many as the bag limit allows, or shows a no-room message. Opens the item-over menu if the bag overflows; a negative item shows a plain chest message instead; item 306 shows an extra message in stage 0 or the trial version.

374febf90d6b9c11.name: play_paznos_cannon_charge_scene
374febf90d6b9c11.doc: Sets flag 640. Paznos charges its cannon while the camera sweeps in, then the scene fades out.

375069177c0bb44b.name: start_trentos_fight
375069177c0bb44b.doc: Places Trentos at the room centre, starts the battle music (190) and fades in.

375a648d23cd18d7.name: run_debug_test_pages
375a648d23cd18d7.doc: Runs test page 0, waits for a button press, then runs test page 1.

3760b4cac850a83b.name: talk_blinkhorn_busy_away
3760b4cac850a83b.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk when he is not at his post by the gate: he says he is busy gathering materials for the town's safety and asks Max to come back tomorrow.

37618a14da1a984d.name: talk_stewart_after_joining
37618a14da1a984d.doc: Stewart's chatter after the book auction quest is cleared, about the book he got. Chapter 8 swaps in a warning about Zelmite Mine.

377dd90fc89f2f85.name: start_station_map
377dd90fc89f2f85.doc: Sets up the station and places the player. Arriving from s01 plays the run in; arriving otherwise plays the e300 scene the first time, or the train arrival scene for the chapter.

378768995bd5dd91.name: play_bridge_report_scene_at_station
378768995bd5dd91.doc: Event 500: sets up the station map and plays the scene where Max and Monica run in, workers say the bridge repairs were finished long ago, and the pair decide to head for Mt. Gundor.

37a4446267f1938c.name: play_train_arrival_scene
37a4446267f1938c.doc: The train pulls in, the player steps out and the camera is reset behind him at (-270, 0, 3450).

37a46e22464b26ed.name: start_lapis_garter_fight
37a46e22464b26ed.doc: Program boss_lapis_garter: loads Lapis Garter (monster 611) and places it 800 units back, pauses the battle music, starts BGM 190 and fades in.

37b6a8d9817fc94b.name: setup_dream_spiral_floor
37b6a8d9817fc94b.doc: If flag 728 is set, plays event 728 (the monster introduction scene), loads the sound set, shows the party, places the player and camera and places monster 603 for a Dream Spiral boss room. Always fades in and finishes the event.

37b932329345fe3d.name: play_time_warp_test_scene
37b932329345fe3d.doc: Test scene that shows Monica doing the time warp motion with the Atlamillia glow until a pad button is pressed.

37bb5c43adea4161.name: reset_and_start_wrench_fight
37bb5c43adea4161.doc: Pauses the monsters, fades out, fully heals Max and his weapon, replays the chapter 4 intro scene and then places four monster 600 around Max with battle music for the fight.

37be8c17c5785174.name: talk_blinkhorn_busy
37be8c17c5785174.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's busy reply: he is writing an important town safety document and asks the player to come back tomorrow unless it is urgent.

37c903685eb0eb25.name: leave_for_s31_map
37c903685eb0eb25.doc: Fades out, hides the partners, clears monsters and loads map s31 at event 520.

37d52eae843de8a1.name: leave_swamp_for_station
37d52eae843de8a1.doc: Asks whether to return to the station and if so jumps to map s02 (Sindain Station) with dungeon stage 1, floor 0.

37eb44c260564040.name: start_s02b_script_501_faded
37eb44c260564040.doc: Program 501: starts an event, fades out and loads script s02/s02b_1.stb as program 501.

37f4469395742782.name: open_message_at
37f4469395742782.doc: Shows message mes_no in the window, moves it to slot pos and places its bubble at x, y. Returns the value the message call reports.

380c8054e0040f4d.name: setup_s06_map
380c8054e0040f4d.doc: Map start for s06. Loads sounds, shows or hides the doors and exit points depending on flags 7, 103, 104, 105, 106 and 109, and starts the matching s06b events (500, 510, 520) or the arrival scene. When the Ride Pod is in the party it also places monster 601.

38271d4fdda8a3bf.name: ask_npc_question_with_orientation_restore
38271d4fdda8a3bf.doc: Faces the NPC and player, asks a question with the given number of choices and returns the answer, optionally restoring yaw and crossfading.

382a589319a12ace.name: place_corinne_near_door
382a589319a12ace.doc: Loads Corinne as a resident villager and places her by the door.

3832d507da2bacce.name: play_s06c_scene
3832d507da2bacce.doc: Loads the s06c event script at 500.

3840aaca9c8df953.name: play_building_materials_gift_scene
3840aaca9c8df953.doc: Plays the gift scene: items such as Rolling Log, Sturdy Cloth, Glass Material, Sugar Cane, Scrap of Metal, Fire and Water Elements are handed over and the item bag is enlarged, then the player must press select to call the Carpenterion.

3845ef059c98808e.name: play_rise_scene_and_jump_to_s55
3845ef059c98808e.doc: Plays the event 540 rise scene and jumps to map s55 at entry 600.

3855063c5ceeab2a.name: play_blackstone_railroad_arrival_scene
3855063c5ceeab2a.doc: Sets flag 202. Max watches the Blackstone Railroad roar in, narrating that it was his first sight of it. Cedric steps out and says the railroad is back, inviting Max to hop on and see the world.

38577dde680e9db0.name: hide_forest_villagers
38577dde680e9db0.doc: Deactivates the villagers in slots 9 to 12.

3867a4f8d3347abe.name: setup_g03_map_with_event_404
3867a4f8d3347abe.doc: Sets up the map objects and plays the shared event 404 setup.

3867e334d7bcfc71.name: play_farewell_scene
3867e334d7bcfc71.doc: Sets flag 736. Max says goodbye to Monica, the others and his mother as the Chrono Union closes, with the final remarks that the journey was a dream, then the scene actors are removed.

38698f52a95c6626.name: show_three_items_message
38698f52a95c6626.doc: Shows the message listing three items at once (message 19 with item slots 1 to 3 set). Returns 1.

386f541ec05794eb.name: announce_floor_cleared
386f541ec05794eb.doc: Plays the floor clear scene when all monsters are defeated.

38811ce7f2a44d20.name: play_lao_chao_request_scene
38811ce7f2a44d20.doc: Sets flag 320 and plays the scene where Max and Monica ask Lao Chao to cook his miracle dish for their sick friend. He says he needs a White Windflower, which is said to be extinct, and Max suggests Starlight Canyon. Skippable.

38b248a2969b8b9e.name: set_train_function_points_enabled
38b248a2969b8b9e.doc: Enables or disables the train's flame and func function points and stops the environment sound.

38c6ac06b4334743.name: load_event_616_charas
38c6ac06b4334743.doc: Sets up Max and Monica and Osmond as scene actors and loads the event 616 message file.

38ecde470fcd6d60.name: setup_secret_base_map
38ecde470fcd6d60.doc: Locks map movement until flag 103 is set, runs the opening town flag setup, and places Max depending on whether the game was loaded and which map he came from.

38f7d0890d5f8abd.name: take_gate_exit_0
38f7d0890d5f8abd.doc: Gate 0 handler: interacts with the first exit door via interact_with_exit.

39041870216a15cc.name: walk_player_through_gate
39041870216a15cc.doc: Shows the player walking through the opened gate with a camera fade-out, then rebinds the gate map piece.

3924fef887ada774.name: place_player_by_previous_map
3924fef887ada774.doc: Places the player according to the map they came from: after a memory card load at a fixed spot, from caves and stations at their gates, from Pau's House, and otherwise at the station. Plays event 402 on the first visit once flag 360 is set. Ends by showing the pending story hint.

39251201f4618dea.name: play_griffon_in_the_past_scene
39251201f4618dea.doc: A voice explains that Griffon is 10,000 years in the past, sending a powerful consciousness to the present, and his servants are those in sympathy with it. Switches the bgm if flag 43 was set and clears it. Skippable.

393f9aa31c750e33.name: ask_to_go_to_seaside_cave
393f9aa31c750e33.doc: Asks whether to enter the seaside cave (the Cave of the Tide). On yes the player runs in and the screen fades, returning 1; otherwise steps back and returns 0.

3971f242283a54e2.name: play_boss_intro_and_start_battle
3971f242283a54e2.doc: Runs the boss intro cutscene (event 257), then sets up the boss monsters, places Max at the start position and fades in.

397a528e3a7e92b7.name: enter_house_g01i07
397a528e3a7e92b7.doc: Program 200: before flag 209 is set, plays the knocking scene. Afterwards enters interior g01i07, skipping the music reload and allowing Georama editing in the case where flag 247 is set and 250 is not.

397c884f72013f43.name: show_find_a_stick_hint
397c884f72013f43.doc: Shows Monica's message to find a handy stick and she will show the player how.

39832196c93e116f.name: play_train_steam_and_stop
39832196c93e116f.doc: Plays the train steam release and stops the engine. With fade_music set it fades out and stops the BGM.

3991993fba192419.name: wait_for_cross_press
3991993fba192419.doc: Waits one frame, then until the player presses Cross (pad mask 64).

39b2741e08459f46.name: handle_villager_talk
39b2741e08459f46.doc: Villager talk dispatcher for the town: reads the talked-to character and slot, then characters up to number 34 go to the Palm Brinks villager conversations and the rest to the by-kind dialogue.

39d5ff875297898f.name: get_max
39d5ff875297898f.doc: Returns the larger of two floats.

39e23f804348889d.name: talk_gerald_quest_offer
39e23f804348889d.doc: Gerald's quest offer: doubts the player has finished anything, hands over a Trumpet Gun to build up into the Belt Trigger, shows a help message and accepts quest 11.

39e8b03bc9c00825.name: load_event_616b_charas
39e8b03bc9c00825.doc: Sets up Max and Monica, Osmond, Toryon and the Moonflower beam models and effect for the second part of event 616, and loads the message file.

39f00982027d2f99.name: talk_to_shigura_villager
39f00982027d2f99.doc: Identifies which Shigura villager was talked to from its map part name. Without the Shell Talkie (item 373) the event 436 plays instead, the first elder talk gives the Secret Dragon Remedy and plays event 434, and otherwise the translated conversation plays.

39f453fda1ec5249.name: play_map_start_arrival
39f453fda1ec5249.doc: Map start program: after loading a save it places the player by counter 4, or plays the Need request scene (chapter 8) when flag 736 is set and 800 is not. On a normal arrival it starts the map music and places the player according to the previous map.

39f55683726e5395.name: play_paznos_fires_on_golems_scene
39f55683726e5395.doc: Event 540. Agaris gives the order and Paznos opens fire. Sets flag 540.

39fc97e80c7d9d94.name: open_blocked_passage
39fc97e80c7d9d94.doc: Opens the minimap door and plays the passage opening: the door piece flies away on upper floors, and a white wind effect clears the way on lower floors.

3a16c01ab7711cfa.name: place_camera_test_monsters
3a16c01ab7711cfa.doc: Debug leftover: places six b05a models on a ring around (250, 250), sets the camera and shows the text Camera test.

3a1888b8461d4368.name: ask_to_go_to_heim_rada
3a1888b8461d4368.doc: Asks the item question for leaving the station. On yes Max runs along the path away and the screen fades out and it returns 1; on no he steps back and it returns 0.

3a23c1cc66f9850e.name: warp_to_s31_map
3a23c1cc66f9850e.doc: Hides the partners and loads map s31 at event 520 without a fade.

3a30c1708b079494.name: play_golem_sighted_scene_and_go_to_battle_1
3a30c1708b079494.doc: Plays the golem sighting scene and jumps to map s55 at event 601.

3a376b22da85ab56.name: ask_to_leave_area
3a376b22da85ab56.doc: Asks a yes/no question. On the first answer, the player runs off and the screen fades, returning 0. Otherwise the player is placed back, the camera resets and 1 is returned.

3a47877506623555.name: play_event_708
3a47877506623555.doc: Event 708: sets the Flower of the Sun scene seen flag. Max or Monica, whichever is active, and the partner stand with an old woman and the flower while a long voiced exchange plays in which she forgives the broken flower; the scene ends in a white fade. Loads and removes its own models; skippable.

3a4c355f2cb63e06.name: play_opening_from_story
3a4c355f2cb63e06.doc: Stops the music and ambient sound and starts the opening.

3a564bc6ba7d6f9f.name: play_grape_juice_door_scene
3a564bc6ba7d6f9f.doc: Debug test and event 651 program; it only plays the scene where Max and Monica bring grape juice to a Firbit house and are let in (flag 209).

3a653f31efdc91a4.name: ask_exit_question
3a653f31efdc91a4.doc: Exit prompt for Max or Monica (other characters get a message). Fades out and returns 1 on yes, else 0.

3a99f2990f8e9003.name: play_tournament_announcement_then_enter_d03
3a99f2990f8e9003.doc: Plays the tournament announcement, loads the d03f03 floor and starts d03 at entry 500.

3aa944eaacc1b9de.name: play_train_departs_scene
3aa944eaacc1b9de.doc: Sets flag 648. Max, Monica and Osmond stand on the platform while the train pulls away past the camera, then the player is placed back on the platform.

3aed5e9f7a0a63f6.name: play_event_111_and_return
3aed5e9f7a0a63f6.doc: Event 520: loads monster data 601, plays the scene play_elephant_defeated_scene and returns to the map script s06.

3afc80512b4cd9ac.name: play_gift_scene_then_jump_to_s26
3afc80512b4cd9ac.doc: Plays the gift scene and jumps to map s26 (Carpenterion Outer) at program 502.

3b04ed6e0f74ac52.name: play_eina_nurses_sick_max_scene
3b04ed6e0f74ac52.doc: Sets flag 307. Young Max lies in bed with a fever and fears he will die while Eina cools his head and jokes that the priest is off today.

3b19087318774ec3.name: tell_player_to_find_club
3b19087318774ec3.doc: Monica says (in the Italian text) to come back with a handy branch so she can show how to hit the Sphera, then talks to the player.

3b2f0fa4de02d59e.name: try_play_event_508
3b2f0fa4de02d59e.doc: Gives the Time Bomb and plays event 508 once the analysis flag 403 is set and the Time Bomb has not yet been given. Returns 1 when it played, else 0.

3b4154d90377ce13.name: go_to_s44_for_ready_events
3b4154d90377ce13.doc: Checks the two conditions is_analysis_505_scene_pending and is_town_4_complete_scene_pending. Whichever are met have their flags 744 and 748 set, and the map changes to s44 at entrance 570 (both), 550 (first) or 560 (second).

3b43098d979071e2.name: open_shop_menu
3b43098d979071e2.doc: Fades out, opens shop menu number shop, and fades back in when it closes.

3b6a58a33e69bedc.name: run_race_and_award_prize
3b6a58a33e69bedc.doc: Shows the six-fish results board in three reveals after a race. Placing in time for the stage (first in the qualifier, top two in the main race, top three in the final) shows the podium and gives the prize for the rank. Returns 0 if the player did not place, -1 if cancelled, 1 otherwise.

3b75cc5ee188029c.name: play_farewell_scene
3b75cc5ee188029c.doc: Sets flag 736 and plays event 736 at 21:30: Monica and Max say goodbye, Eina hugs Max and says goodbye, the Chrono Union gate closes and the party talks about the journey being a dream of the ancients.

3b764204d0b199d3.name: place_steve_and_start_event_108b
3b764204d0b199d3.doc: Program 510: hides the memo item, loads and shows Steve (event 105 model) in the house and loads script i01h01/i01h01c_1.stb as program 510.

3ba6fbc9c2c6bf17.name: warp_to_s20_after_story_516
3ba6fbc9c2c6bf17.doc: Story 516 program: warps to map s20 and runs its story_516 program (15160 = 516*10+10000).

3bc6d6aadf3be16b.name: play_toryon_rock_throw_scene
3bc6d6aadf3be16b.doc: Cutscene: Toryon raises a hand and hurls a stream of boulders at the camera from alternating sides, then the screen fades.

3bc75f79d8fe4425.name: choose_transfer_gate_destination
3bc75f79d8fe4425.doc: Asks where to go: transfer gate north, east, west, or in front of the Time Gate. Plays a sun warp effect, stores the choice in counter 18 and jumps to map f04.

3bca98c64f2d7dde.name: talk_to_desoland_villager
3bca98c64f2d7dde.doc: Talk handler for the villagers in this town (ids 400 to 413, French text). The line for Galen Agaris (400) and Garek (401) depends on story flags 640, 616, 540, 536 and the edit blocked save flag. Nithe, Nuwara and Nevel (402 to 404) open shops 30, 28 and 29 after talking.

3bcc0a9d739622ed.name: start_dark_genie_intro_story_event
3bcc0a9d739622ed.doc: Story event 816: plays the Dark Genie intro scene.

3bd2f5fd48c23c8f.name: play_gaspard_airship_sighting_scene
3bd2f5fd48c23c8f.doc: Plays event 504. Max and Monica stand on the battleship deck as a huge shape passes in the sky. They say Gaspard must be angry about the origin points being revived and decide to hurry.

3bda39ba6e9d3e4a.name: play_moon_view_scene
3bda39ba6e9d3e4a.doc: Calls play_event_702, which sets the moon view save flag.

3becb4292cc510d5.name: play_paznos_flight_scene
3becb4292cc510d5.doc: Event 640 cutscene variant with the transformed Paznos, its eyes, jets and smoke. Used by program 640. Sets flag 640.

3bf5f9a6b6874937.name: give_materials_money
3bf5f9a6b6874937.doc: Cedric gives Max money for the materials and a message says 400 Gilda was received.

3bfaa4cebf627e9d.name: play_fishing_idea_then_continue
3bfaa4cebf627e9d.doc: Plays event 235, sets counter 3 to 4 and returns to the s05 script.

3c1a4a87aa013db0.name: talk_facing_each_other
3c1a4a87aa013db0.doc: Turns the player and the NPC to face each other, plays the NPC's talk motion (plain for style 0, flustered for style 1), shows the message and turns the NPC back to its original facing.

3c2504f7bfa7814b.name: play_walk_ahead_and_hint_scene
3c2504f7bfa7814b.doc: The party leader walks 30 units ahead for about 50 frames while the camera follows, then says either to check the last house (flag 304 unset) or that there is no time to lose helping Lin.

3c4a543f1a13da36.name: play_gaspard_marionette_scene
3c4a543f1a13da36.doc: Event 440, sets flag 440: the Shigura turn out to be controlled by Gaspard's Marionette devices, a battleship drops in and Gaspard sets them on Max and Monica, leading to the boss fight.

3c603946f4cbb2e8.name: play_rock_barrage_then_go_to_s12
3c603946f4cbb2e8.doc: Program 532: plays the Toryon rock barrage scene (play_rock_barrage_scene) and jumps to map s12 (Moon Flower Palace Stop) as program 590.

3c6319bda7733fea.name: load_e356_scene_characters
3c6319bda7733fea.doc: Loads the Max, Monica and Lin models, motions and message file for event e356, setting globals 2 and 3 to the two chara slots.

3c707db715319f62.name: start_palace_approach_story_event
3c707db715319f62.doc: Story event 604: plays the palace approach scene.

3c7114edcee0759c.name: load_train_car_npcs
3c7114edcee0759c.doc: Loads the NPCs standing in the current train car: for each NPC 1 to 25 that is in the story (status not 0, hidden bit not set) and assigned to this car, loads its train model into the next slot, places it, records its id in a counter and shows or hides it. Skips Cedric except in chapter 8 at station 1, and NPCs 2 and 13 before chapter 5. Adds NPC 34 in car 3 once the item board is expanded.

3c74af1f046c02ea.name: play_missed_alarm_scene
3c74af1f046c02ea.doc: Night scene: Max realises the circus is about to start and the alarm clock never rang, and runs out of the house. Skippable.

3c85fd3d6a534b41.name: jump_to_event_285
3c85fd3d6a534b41.doc: Sets all Georama analyze flags to 1 and flags 270 to 280 to 1, clears flag 285, then jumps to map 25 and waits.

3c8a0eee796f647d.name: show_message_between_charas
3c8a0eee796f647d.doc: Shows a message positioned between a speaker and a listener, waits until the player dismisses it and closes the window. Returns the frames elapsed.

3c9982f0ac385e57.name: play_temple_restored_event
3c9982f0ac385e57.doc: Plays event 376, the temple restored reward scene.

3c9ebdeeba1d50ee.name: start_cooking_story_event
3c9ebdeeba1d50ee.doc: Story event 324: plays the cooking scene.

3cbc111737d6c4e7.name: restart_edit_event_in_last_car
3cbc111737d6c4e7.doc: Program 208: when in the last car (counter 0 is 3), requests an edit event restart.

3cd4b16a1390eab7.name: place_player_at_entrance
3cd4b16a1390eab7.doc: Runs setup_map_sounds_and_parts, places the player at the entrance, sets the camera and fades in.

3cd520a75071cd63.name: play_firesquall_discovery_scene
3cd520a75071cd63.doc: Story event 512. Max and Monica run in and spot the Fire Squall machine, the cause of the fiery rain, and decide to destroy it. Sets flag 512.

3cf08065339ecf80.name: run_aim_control
3cf08065339ecf80.doc: Spheda golf aiming loop. The analog stick turns the player to aim (blocked when the swing arc is not clear) and the vertical stick sets the angle between 5 and 30, which drives the carry angle, the camera and the on-screen guide. Plays ready or idle stances. Returns 0 when the first button confirms and 1 for the second button; yaw and pitch are updated in place.

3d0339371c753db9.name: talk_stewart_early
3d0339371c753db9.doc: Stewart's early talk: offers to be the first one the young master turns to when in trouble.

3d1f5d4da20e853c.name: talk_rosa_retry
3d1f5d4da20e853c.doc: Rosa's retry talk after the quest was not completed: runs the same talk as her main quest.

3d72a69e5e413785.name: on_map_start
3d72a69e5e413785.doc: Runs the setup. While the treasure is not all taken, shows the caption scene once (bit 4 of counter 20), places two monster 43 and pauses the battle music. Then places the player and fades in.

3d795a846e73dd3b.name: talk_to_seated_stargazer
3d795a846e73dd3b.doc: With the Circus Ticket, the seated NPC (slot 9) comments on the starry sky. Talking from behind gives a rude remark and returns 0.

3d994a84d86c89b5.name: interact_with_exit
3d994a84d86c89b5.doc: Handles an exit of the floor: the first time asks for the Fairy Saw (item 339) to open it. Once open, asks whether to go through and moves to the floor chosen by get_next_floor for this exit.

3d9bcc216da6522c.name: play_villagers_freed_then_continue
3d9bcc216da6522c.doc: Hides the swamp characters, sets counter 3 to 7, plays event 247 and returns to the s05 script.

3db315d0dff64965.name: play_launch_scene_and_jump_to_s30
3db315d0dff64965.doc: Plays the event 540 launch scene and jumps to map s30 at entry 600.

3db6d359796e7d28.name: setup_gaspard_lava_room
3db6d359796e7d28.doc: Map setup for the lava room. If flag 526 is set the lava is already parted and the horn point is disabled; flag 528 hides the Gaspard trigger once it has been seen.

3dbe1a35d0fb503a.name: debug_play_gaspard_departure
3dbe1a35d0fb503a.doc: Debug entry that plays the Gaspard departure scene.

3dcd6689393c543e.name: play_board_middle_car
3dcd6689393c543e.doc: Boarding scene for a middle train car (train id 2 to 7 from the event): picks step heights by map (83, 54) or alt_heights, binds that car's door parts, sets counter 0 to the car number (1 to 3), opens the doors, walks the player in and fades out, then places the player inside the train.

3dd5b55b445414b0.name: talk_need_after_joining
3dd5b55b445414b0.doc: Need's chatter after the safe quest is cleared, about sorting garbage. Chapter 8 swaps in a warning about Zelmite Mine.

3df762eeb33ce521.name: play_ready_to_depart_scene
3df762eeb33ce521.doc: Plays event 372 (sets flag 372): Max and Monica run to Cedric the train driver who says they are just in time and to tell him when they are ready to go.

3dfb851cb8979cf7.name: talk_to_cedric_by_progress
3dfb851cb8979cf7.doc: Cedric's talk handler. After flag 7 he offers to refuel or open the core upgrade shop. Before that he reacts to story progress: starts the Energy Pack events i01h01b/c depending on whether the player has the item or the materials and invention, and otherwise gives hints about the Item Shop or tells Max to try on his own.

3e009ed0fef33b14.name: show_bubble_message_wait
3e009ed0fef33b14.doc: Shows a speech bubble message and waits until the player closes it.

3e017184e4921bd1.name: on_talk_or_dungeon_start
3e017184e4921bd1.doc: Dispatches talking by the NPC slot: the ticket guard (8), the townspeople (10 to 18). Without a ticket, talking to slot 10 records flag 3, and slot 11 loads the m06b program 154 scene once flags 2 and 3 are both set.

3e0fef4c25fc529f.name: vanish_spiral_rock_7
3e0fef4c25fc529f.doc: Binds map part p11_d06b02-7 and plays the spiral rock vanish scene.

3e160376e02b6413.name: use_time_gate_transfer
3e160376e02b6413.doc: Transfer gate menu, entered at the time gate.

3e1d717276ccb6c1.name: use_gate_to_next_floor
3e1d717276ccb6c1.doc: Exit gate interaction. If still locked it asks to use the Fairy Saw (item 339) and opens it with that. Once open it asks whether to go on, then plays the walk-through, shows the medal messages, moves to the next floor and returns to the floor selection.

3e2893b2b4e286c0.name: start_station_event
3e2893b2b4e286c0.doc: Parks the train. If flag 201 is not set, marks floor 8 of stage 0 as visited and plays event 201; otherwise walks the player in. Then updates the train event point.

3e2e40187ed4156f.name: play_light_stream_scene
3e2e40187ed4156f.doc: Sets flag 600. The train travels through spirits of spray, flow and light made of map parts that glide into place while the camera orbits and flies after it.

3e3691b1f74bce6d.name: spin_random_coin
3e3691b1f74bce6d.doc: Dungeon coin-spin event at a random magic circle. Only Max and Monica can use it; the other two get a refusal message and are moved off the circle. Otherwise a coin spins above the circle until the player presses the button (or after ten seconds), then slows to land on one of its two faces. The face decides the outcome: the screen brightens and a good effect applies for one face, or darkens and a bad effect for the other, with a message per effect (weapon experience, a Repair Powder chest and so on). A chance roll can flip the result, and a party member 24 always flips it.

3e3ae96ae8c2b1c3.name: offer_priscleen_to_holy_one
3e3ae96ae8c2b1c3.doc: Function point for the Holy One: shows the hint to give it the Priscleen Fish, and using Priscleen (item 310) plays the step of event 245.

3e537f507bded996.name: play_two_eras_scene_and_go_to_sun_chamber
3e537f507bded996.doc: Plays the two eras scene and jumps to dungeon d06b01 (Sun Chamber) at event 600.

3e575b233a7f2d17.name: play_pendant_conversation
3e575b233a7f2d17.doc: Max and Cedric talk about the circus goons who are after Max's pendant and about Mayor Need. Max says he will not give it up.

3e581a4bd219a583.name: load_event_352_scene
3e581a4bd219a583.doc: Loads Max and Monica with event 352 motions, Lin, the clock characters and light effect, and the event 352 message file.

3e6f9e0bbaedaaba.name: play_voice_message_close_at
3e6f9e0bbaedaaba.doc: Plays a voice message with a frame limit and closes the message window at the given frame.

3e74ada71a9a0b94.name: play_griffon_erases_world_and_go_to_s35
3e74ada71a9a0b94.doc: Plays the world erasing scene and loads map s35 event 502.

3e95c818b2056476.name: rococo_shouts_and_runs_off
3e95c818b2056476.doc: Monica peers at Rococo, who trembles, shouts and runs away.

3e9a6159c99ef79f.name: play_ready_to_depart_scene
3e9a6159c99ef79f.doc: Event 106 (sets flag 106): Cedric asks whether Max is ready and if so plays the departure shots; restores the camera afterwards. Returns 1 if the player chose to go.

3e9d3fda2495b68b.name: play_run_through_gate_scene
3e9d3fda2495b68b.doc: Crossfade scene where the player runs through a gate between the floor and the upper area high above it (y around 3200). Switches sound set, map light and camera for the destination.

3eac8f5a36fb112b.name: hide_map_part_if_flag_209
3eac8f5a36fb112b.doc: Hides map part p09_s0201 once flag 209 is set.

3eb22b3106949ff0.name: play_moon_breaking_then_go_to_s44
3eb22b3106949ff0.doc: Plays event 732 and jumps to s44 (Moon Flower Palace flashback).

3eb3916e04b0023e.name: take_gate_exit_3
3eb3916e04b0023e.doc: Gate 3 handler: interacts with the fourth exit door.

3eb8433083743a5a.name: play_stop_palace_dive_scene
3eb8433083743a5a.doc: Event 640 part 5: Eina points at the screen and orders the dive to stop the palace with Paznos. Skippable; skips the next BGM load.

3ec017795e18fdec.name: play_potato_pie_then_jump_to_g01i07
3ec017795e18fdec.doc: Plays the potato pie scene and jumps to map g01i07 at entry 502.

3ecb4424c15e9976.name: talk_blinkhorn_to_monica
3ecb4424c15e9976.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk when Monica is the active character: a remark about women with swords, or an offer of help in chapter 8.

3ed21ff3b5f6d499.name: trigger_lighthouse_arrival_scene
3ed21ff3b5f6d499.doc: Story event 348 plays the arrival scene.

3ee762bb6e6a3f09.name: talk_mina_after_joining
3ee762bb6e6a3f09.doc: Mina's chatter after the Spheda quest is cleared, asking not to be taken to insect places. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about the Blackstone Railroad.

3f091adadd95c157.name: talk_olivie_early
3f091adadd95c157.doc: Olivie's early talk: says her people only listen to the requests of someone more capable than themselves.

3f0928da19f152a6.name: load_event_247_charas
3f0928da19f152a6.doc: Sets up Max and Monica as scene actors and loads Noam, Zak, Wicky and Mogri with the event 247 message file. a0 is the sound bank for their sound effects.

3f1837ab8de10b72.name: trigger_monster_badge_scene
3f1837ab8de10b72.doc: Disables the e277 trigger, sets flag 277 and plays the scene where Monica tells Max the badge can turn them into monsters.

3f1c8cf7e75e5b4c.name: start_floor_clear_scene
3f1c8cf7e75e5b4c.doc: Runs the shared floor clear scene when every monster is dead.

3f2ebcc1af9d636b.name: setup_hub_entry
3f2ebcc1af9d636b.doc: Places the player when the map loads: after loading a save, at the entrance. The first time (moon view flag unset) it plays the moon view scene. Otherwise the position depends on the previous map type.

3f30a5cb142bf464.name: talk_osmond_aquarium_owned
3f30a5cb142bf464.doc: Osmond's lines when the player already owns an Aquarium: feed the Electric Worm to a fish in it, then feed that fish to the Shigura.

3f30e45c8cd7fe07.name: warp_to_d04b01_event_440
3f30e45c8cd7fe07.doc: Clears the scene and starts event 440 on map d04b01.

3f39a0db5bca4c9a.name: enter_central_lab_main_door
3f39a0db5bca4c9a.doc: Leaves through the main door: sets counter 2 to 0 and jumps to the Central Lab (f03i04).

3f39bbf63fbb5ed7.name: init_map_objects
3f39bbf63fbb5ed7.doc: Initialises the s02 map objects: hides the station props once event 280 has been seen, tilts the train slope parts, hides a part for flag 209 and loads the station villagers.

3f3f8e3982fdde66.name: talk_milane_to_max
3f3f8e3982fdde66.doc: Milane's talk when Max is the active character: he mentions the circus. Chapter 8 swaps in a question about tough guys in the mine.

3f4ffab25729edc5.name: setup_dungeon_floor_start
