3f4ffab25729edc5.doc: Floor start event: loads monsters and treasure boxes, places the player at the floor's way 20 event point, sets the camera behind the player, shows the status bar and fades in.

3f5f0d30b79923a6.name: setup_village_and_play_story_event
3f5f0d30b79923a6.doc: Sets up the village objects, places the player at the entrance when coming from the world map and, depending on story flags, plays the next of events 270, 272 (giving a Lafrescia Seed and Badge Box), 275, 280 and 285 (giving the Jurak Gun).

3f6d80e69a13a5d0.name: ask_enter_dungeon
3f6d80e69a13a5d0.doc: Asks whether to enter the dungeon. On yes the player runs ahead, the screen fades out and it returns 1; on no the player steps back, walks away and it returns 0.

3f7b308e435b72e4.name: start_spheda_debug_on_forest_floor
3f7b308e435b72e4.doc: Debug entry: cleans up Spheda, loads the d02 forest floor, plays the arrival scene and sets up Spheda.

3f825f5227665422.name: play_condor_thanks_scene
3f825f5227665422.doc: Event 317. Mrs. Condor, relieved her chicks are safe, thanks the heroes. She is found to wear the White Windflower on her head and gives it, and the heroes also receive the item that fell from the distortion. Sets flag 317.

3f85f23321c5ef52.name: warp_to_s17_event_312
3f85f23321c5ef52.doc: Clears the scene, resets flag 312 and loads map s17 with the event script for event 312.

3f8c8a3ef13fec92.name: play_circus_crowd_and_ladder_scene
3f8c8a3ef13fec92.doc: Opening scene part 1: Max walks toward a crowd watching a juggling pierrot act in the circus tent, cannot see, runs around and climbs a ladder for a better view. Skippable.

3fa3d306a291c504.name: show_slot_bubble_choice
3fa3d306a291c504.doc: Shows a bubble message in a given window slot and returns the choice the player picks.

3fb61631e04ee356.name: load_rococo_scene_actors
3fb61631e04ee356.doc: Loads the models, motions and message file (e208_1.txt) for the Rococo house scene: Max, Monica, Rococo and the house roof parts.

3fbb4f002f8ea83c.name: fade_in_map
3fbb4f002f8ea83c.doc: Fades the screen in over 30 frames.

3fbb8ca1fcf551e7.name: ask_to_leave_lava_room
3fbb8ca1fcf551e7.doc: Exit handle talk. The two non-Max/Monica characters just get a message. Otherwise asks a question and on the first answer fades out and returns to the main d05 script.

3fd66e4f057558e3.name: play_paznos_dive_to_stop_palace_scene
3fd66e4f057558e3.doc: Event 640. The captain announces they will stop the palace with Paznos and orders a dive. Sets flag 640.

3fdf353a1c9e0391.name: press_panel_1_6
3fdf353a1c9e0391.doc: Candle puzzle step for the church candle at row 1, column 6: cuts to a fixed camera, waits 45 frames, toggles that candle and its four neighbours (i01h07_13 pieces), then waits 45 frames.

3fe6a61859e4ce0a.name: play_walk_through_opening_scene
3fe6a61859e4ce0a.doc: Scene for passing through the opening once it is open: the character jumps and walks forward while the camera pans, then the view fades out and back in.

4015df6f0c1e9755.name: play_shot_walk_off
4015df6f0c1e9755.doc: Cutscene shot where two characters (Max and Steve) walk off to the left while the screen fades to black. Returns 0.

4019ebfc05d32a04.name: resume_buggy_subgame
4019ebfc05d32a04.doc: Sets the engine motion, runs play_buggy_chase_on_train_roof_scene, fades in and starts the buggy subgame.

401f34e98ea32679.name: animate_lip_sync_for_frames
401f34e98ea32679.doc: Runs the talking animation and lip sync, following the voice stream, for a fixed number of frames with the prompt hidden. Returns the frames elapsed.

402bccf9dfc31912.name: play_gundor_arrival_scene
402bccf9dfc31912.doc: Plays event e500 (sets flag 500): the train arrives and the chapter 5 title shows, Max and Monica step off and say the village of Heim Rada should be at the foot of Mt. Gundor and may have been wiped out, and Borneo and Tom say they can now be placed in the Georama. Sets progress to 7.

403673d51e3b6fc5.name: play_give_cover_scene
403673d51e3b6fc5.doc: Event 616: the group sits around the table until the leader calls for cover fire.

40433a2b180692a3.name: clean_up_fishing_tournament_scene
40433a2b180692a3.doc: Resets the enemy, menu and object sound ports, deletes the tournament characters, extra motion and images, and unlocks map movement.

404d6858ead18a4d.name: report_scoop_progress
404d6858ead18a4d.doc: Scoop reporting talk: asks for a Scoop Memo if the player has none, says there are no more scoops when all are known, otherwise reports newly learned and newly obtained scoops. Ends with check_scoop_reward and returns its result, or 0 when no memo.

40530e5ed604e6ce.name: talk_to_need
40530e5ed604e6ce.doc: Talk handler for Mayor Need. Picks the line by quest 0 state and quest 12 (safe code).

4057d4e6f7527601.name: warp_to_s64_map
4057d4e6f7527601.doc: Hides the partners and loads map s64 at event 500 without a fade.

4059d47914854ddd.name: play_train_arrival_scene
4059d47914854ddd.doc: Short entrance scene: a train stands in the station, its doors swing open and the player runs out onto the platform, then control returns.

40627d918cf20598.name: play_blue_gate_warp
40627d918cf20598.doc: Plays the blue time gate warp at the given spot. With Monica in the party it plays the return scene, otherwise it may first play the Atlamillia blue glow scene and then the gate scene for jumping to the future.

4063a00a75c33069.name: talk_to_npc
4063a00a75c33069.doc: Starts a conversation with an NPC, shows one message and ends it.

406c58f2e6a5c929.name: play_robot_scene_then_jump_to_s30
406c58f2e6a5c929.doc: Plays the Paznos robot scene and jumps to map s30 at program 650.

4083896415b01b2f.name: play_griffon_defeat_and_go_to_s31
4083896415b01b2f.doc: After Griffon falls: restores the hero, clears monsters, plays the Star of Oblivion scene, hides the Atlamillia and loads map s31 event 510.

408637043693d21c.name: play_condor_carry_away_scene
408637043693d21c.doc: Cutscene of the condor swooping in, taking the Giant Meat and the character and flying off while the screen fades out.

4095f8101f6219f2.name: park_camera_until_button_press
4095f8101f6219f2.doc: Sets camera position and target to the origin and waits for a button press.

409c685db86f813e.name: play_lin_tribute_ending_short
409c685db86f813e.doc: Shorter closing section of event 372 used when analysis flag 207 is not set: the same narration about Lin and Crest, with the character running off and a fade out.

40a01662d3826fd8.name: talk_adel_monica
40a01662d3826fd8.doc: Adel talks to Monica: asks her to keep the young master out of harm and warns of the consequences, or in chapter 8 wishes the hero safety. Runs as a standalone event with the NPC talk turn.

40ae624e4af80741.name: play_starglass_discussion_scene
40ae624e4af80741.doc: Sets flag 368. Max and Monica talk outside a shop: Starglass reverses time to a moment of deep significance, and could be used to go back into Lin memory, but only if Lin recovers her memory. Skippable.

40c8bdf32b0bdc2c.name: talk_to_jurak
40c8bdf32b0bdc2c.doc: Talk handler for Master Jurak. His hint depends on story progress: wait for time, plant the seed, find a Sundrop from a Himarra, see Crest in Balance Valley, or the Griffon fight.

40d5141e8b2ec7d7.name: talk_to_priscleen_seeker
40d5141e8b2ec7d7.doc: Talk point for the NPC who asks for Priscleen to restore their beauty; using Priscleen (item 310) plays the step of event 245.

40deac2562f280e2.name: show_help_window
40deac2562f280e2.doc: Opens help message 1010 plus help_no in message window 2 as a help window.

410739f87ea8239d.name: play_e107_scene_then_load_script
410739f87ea8239d.doc: Loads monster data 601, plays event e107 and loads the s06_1 event script.

411b753383b0b958.name: finish_battle_and_go_to_palm_brinks
411b753383b0b958.doc: After the ambush is cleared, plays the Battle Wrench scene, gives and equips the Battle Wrench in place of the Wrench and goes to the Palm Brinks map event 153.

41272f1fac33ee79.name: talk_blinkhorn_to_monica
41272f1fac33ee79.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk when Monica is the active character: a remark about women with swords, or an offer of help in chapter 8.

4154b396f3944541.name: run_party_chara_talk
4154b396f3944541.doc: Station conversation with a party-able NPC. talk_mode picks the NPC (1, 2 and 3 select specific ones, 0 reads it from a local counter). Returns 1 if the NPC is already the partner. Otherwise it frames the NPC at a train seat or where they stand, shows a name box and a menu with options to take them along, hear a hint, and per-NPC extras such as shops, repairs or scoop reports. Taking the NPC sets them as in-party and opens the party select menu.

415c375e48a04ac1.name: play_board_train_late
415c375e48a04ac1.doc: Boarding cutscene at a train station. The map and the event position decide the facing and which door set is used; the train id (2 to 7) picks the car and door parts and sets counter 0 to 1, 2 or 3 by pair. The doors open, the player runs in with footsteps chosen by map (metal or stone), the screen fades out and the player is placed inside.

416194f97172fb81.name: ask_to_enter_boss_dungeon
416194f97172fb81.doc: Asks whether to enter the boss dungeon via item question 5 with item 124, unless a non-hero character is active. Returns 1 after a fade out if yes.

4167ba72ef0722cf.name: play_exit_run
4167ba72ef0722cf.doc: Cutscene where the player runs away through the exit, then fades out at the end. Uses the event part position as the origin.

417793d97de2c7de.name: ask_to_enter_square
417793d97de2c7de.doc: Asks whether to go to the Fishing Contest or Finny Frenzy. On yes, Max runs off screen and the view fades out and it returns 1; on no he walks back.

418aa22f667e193d.name: play_event_285
418aa22f667e193d.doc: Event 285 at f01: sets the Sindain event 285 seen flag, then Max and Monica see the restored village, Jurak's reward blast, a gun item get and the walk away after thanking Jurak. Skippable.

41abc79d15ac8be3.name: open_floor_select_menu
41abc79d15ac8be3.doc: Entry from the town: resets Spheda, plays BGM 16, clears the local flags, opens the dungeon map menu and starts the chosen floor.

41b695fd0cab3853.name: offer_hide_and_seek_quest
41b695fd0cab3853.doc: Corinne asks to come along. If you agree, she proposes hide and seek, vanishes, and a hint says she hides in Palm Brinks. Accepts quest 18 and resets counter 11.

41bc89ce3e223d2d.name: setup_s20_map
41bc89ce3e223d2d.doc: Stops BGM, loads sound set 5684, enables the entrance func points and swaps map part p03_s2001 for p04_s2001 after flag 516. When the edit blocked save flag is set it hides the fire squall effects.

41cb7c5fbe07a600.name: play_cedric_appears_scene
41cb7c5fbe07a600.doc: Event e109a: loads the Cedric character model, shows it at a fixed spot while the camera looks at it, waits for a button press, then fades out and returns control.

41e37e174b626e28.name: play_mother_memory_then_enter_dungeon
41e37e174b626e28.doc: Plays the mother crying memory scene, fades to white and enters dungeon 0 floor 3.

41eed58f7f66ee48.name: get_abs
41eed58f7f66ee48.doc: Returns the absolute value of value.

41fe78badebcbb63.name: narrate_adventure_begins
41fe78badebcbb63.doc: Max narrates that this puzzle began his adventure, then a loud noise plays and the camera shakes for 45 frames.

4212ca603d765167.name: show_shingala_fight_tip
4212ca603d765167.doc: Shows a tip: damaging Shingala makes him roar with his mouth open, which is the chance to throw in the Electric Fish.

42154871a9cb39e4.name: hide_memo_if_owned
42154871a9cb39e4.doc: Removes the memo pickup from the map if the player already owns the Notebook (item 386).

421797b79ff402cc.name: start_g01b_script_if_pending
421797b79ff402cc.doc: If flag 207 is set and 208 is not, fades out and loads the event script g01/g01b_1.stb.

421bb4ec50768d67.name: play_lao_chao_bistro_scene
421bb4ec50768d67.doc: Only calls play_lao_chao_bistro_found_scene, the scene where Max and Monica smell Lao Chao's Bistro.

422fe9106e6a2485.name: attach_energy_pack_to_steve
422fe9106e6a2485.doc: Shows the Energy Pack being fitted to Steve and Cedric says he can now handle longer battles. A window explains boarding the ride pod from the Character menu.

423df3d7cc8d0c5f.name: play_nova_driver_cannon_then_jump_to_s30
423df3d7cc8d0c5f.doc: Plays the Nova Driver Cannon scene and jumps to map s30 at entry 630. Returns 0.

4256ec3ecd0093d8.name: play_griffon_curse_scene
4256ec3ecd0093d8.doc: Short scene after Gaspard's death: a voice curses Griffon and says Monica's name, then fades out. Also used as the debug test.

42686b52b65a90e9.name: play_run_off_plain
42686b52b65a90e9.doc: Cutscene of the two characters running off across the plain, then the camera follows Max alone while narration plays and the run continues along a path.

42766e9e9cecce8c.name: show_lift_robomb_hint
42766e9e9cecce8c.doc: Event program in the Halloween boss room that pauses monsters and the player and shows a hint box on lifting the RoBomb by holding the R1 button and pressing the circle button.

427aa58e7a6a4ba5.name: play_ixion_scene_then_s37
427aa58e7a6a4ba5.doc: Plays the Ixion unveiling scene and jumps to map s37 at entry 500 without reloading the BGM. Returns 0.

429a38bb548a6ca8.name: talk_parn_joined_in_studio
429a38bb548a6ca8.doc: Parn's talk in his studio after he has joined: outside chapter 8 Monica hears that girls cannot understand a man chasing his ideals and Max is offered his painting ability; in chapter 8 he muses on how deep painting is. Then talk_to_npc.

42b574f9dadced0f.name: open_clown_chest
42b574f9dadced0f.doc: Clown chest event: the chest opens and a clown pops out holding two boxes, each holding one of item_a and item_b in random order. The player picks left or right with a two-choice prompt and receives the picked item with its get message.

42be3d6261eaf307.name: load_max_monica_and_conda
42be3d6261eaf307.doc: Loads Max, Monica and the Conda model with their event 250 motions.

42cbe9815b0d5d0a.name: play_time_gate_warp_scene
42cbe9815b0d5d0a.doc: Time gate warp cutscene. It builds the red or blue gate rings, places Max (and Monica when with_partner is set) and the party NPC, plays the time warp motion with the Atlamillia light effect, fades to white and shows the time travel caption. Flag 612 selects the sound and whether the light effect shows.

42cd4360e58d5d37.name: talk_ferdinand_after_joining
42cd4360e58d5d37.doc: Ferdinand's chatter after the chestnut quest is cleared, promising Max he will never refuse him. Chapter 8 swaps in his dream of being the best chef.

42e6253b307b6c64.name: start_g01b_script
42e6253b307b6c64.doc: Program 501: loads the event script g01/g01b_1.stb to run as program 501.

42f678d51bcd6e27.name: talk_gerald_after_joining
42f678d51bcd6e27.doc: Gerald's chatter after the gun quest is cleared, warning that guns are not toys. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about rebuilding the world.

43063b2bb3a38d7c.name: play_victory_town_view_scene
43063b2bb3a38d7c.doc: Event 824 variant that hides parts of the town to show the square. Sets flag 824.

43242175f9bda8ae.name: open_menu_faded
43242175f9bda8ae.doc: Opens the save menu with a fade out and in around it (wrapper for open_save_menu_with_fade).

432a54b4df891e28.name: scale_by_club_power
432a54b4df891e28.doc: Multiplies power[0] by the power stat of the equipped club.

432d1d0ebf5286b8.name: play_blackstone_railroad_arrival_scene
432d1d0ebf5286b8.doc: Sets flag 202. Max watches the Blackstone Railroad roar in, narrating that it was his first sight of it. Cedric steps out and says the railroad is back, inviting Max to hop on and see the world.

434626354000e8df.name: play_elephant_ambush_scene
434626354000e8df.doc: Sets flag 107 and plays event 107: Max and Steve cross the room, Flotsam appears and sets his elephant on them. Played by calling the shot functions in order; run before the elephant fight.

4354f786a6f1e8aa.name: setup_g04_map_at_start
4354f786a6f1e8aa.doc: Places the player at the start position, resets the camera behind and fades in.

4365c9f1999e3317.name: exit_to_f03_map
4365c9f1999e3317.doc: Turns the player to face south, plays a door sound, fades out and jumps to map f03.

436c225ac65b8761.name: play_griffon_battle_challenge_scene
436c225ac65b8761.doc: Sets flag 640. Emperor Griffon accepts the challenge from his fortress while the camera pulls in on him and he spreads his wings, then the scene fades out for the fight.

436cd90de553e693.name: warp_to_s44_map
436cd90de553e693.doc: Plays the boss defeat scene (flag 728) and loads map s44 at event 510 without a fade.

4373ba2cb0e9f853.name: set_bridge_func_points
4373ba2cb0e9f853.doc: Enables the bridge function points invent_15-1 and -2 on both bridge parts when is_built is nonzero, and invent_15-0 when it is zero.

438c06df837bed01.name: restart_event_when_train_event_active
438c06df837bed01.doc: Event 208. Requests an edit-mode restart while the flag 203 train event is active.

438dfc08e45d6270.name: play_scene_then_go_to_s70_532
438dfc08e45d6270.doc: Plays the scene play_fire_support_order_scene and jumps to map s70 at event 532.

4391cb1ce732a6a2.name: load_bridge_report_cast
4391cb1ce732a6a2.doc: Loads Max, Monica, workers 38 and 39, the train part and message file for the bridge report scene (event 448).

43b13c4b7bf262c7.name: talk_blinkhorn
43b13c4b7bf262c7.doc: Dispatches Blinkhorn's talk. Monica gets her own talk, an unfinished first quest gives the early line, and he is busy unless standing at his usual spot. Quest 9 then picks the offer, the race result or the recruited line.

43df170f9a47bbd9.name: play_need_stalls_reply
43df170f9a47bbd9.doc: Need stands up, looks down and says it is sometimes better not to know.

43eb41eab7e839d8.name: wrap_up_cleared_floor
43eb41eab7e839d8.doc: Runs the floor cleared wrap up.

43f5249ca649df31.name: use_gate_to_veniccio
43f5249ca649df31.doc: Enters the blue time gate and jumps to the Veniccio map.

440953909901965b.name: play_nova_cannon_gift_scene
440953909901965b.doc: Event 468. Dr. Osmond shows his finished Nova Cannon, a weapon powered by the sun for the Ridepod, and gives it to the party (item 154). Sets flag 468.

440f4d241cec1db1.name: use_gate_floor_exit
440f4d241cec1db1.doc: Gate program of the map: uses the floor exit door.

4424caf4b64f6062.name: play_moonflower_beam_to_s26
4424caf4b64f6062.doc: Plays the Moonflower beam scene and jumps to map s26 at event 550.

442cd8218ca31a19.name: play_paznos_awakens_then_jump_to_s30
442cd8218ca31a19.doc: Plays the first part of event 640 and jumps to map s30 (Paznos bridge) at program 610.

4466f83e2e1211c5.name: preview_ranking_board
4466f83e2e1211c5.doc: Debug entry that shows the race ranking board with placeholder names and times.

448a129f8d440253.name: load_s06c_1_event_500
448a129f8d440253.doc: Program 650: waits a frame and loads the s06/s06c_1.stb event script at entry 500.

448c636be01aa43a.name: play_m06b_event_151
448c636be01aa43a.doc: Loads the m06b event script at 151.

448e00add14bef27.name: start_shingala_fight
448e00add14bef27.doc: Fades in, puts the player at a fixed spot, resumes monster drawing and AI, loads Shingala (monster 516) and the Electric Fish data and places Shingala in the arena.

449550763923f7d6.name: play_argo_and_lin_first_visit_scene
449550763923f7d6.doc: Plays event 304. Max and Monica meet Argo the owl in the clinic, who tells them that Crest is dead and his apprentice Lin lies bedridden. Monica suggests fetching Dr. Dell from Palm Brinks.

449a992185b721d6.name: hide_station_villagers
449a992185b721d6.doc: Hides the three station villagers (character slots 8, 9 and 10).

449c577984dc8a35.name: finish_tournament_and_leave
449c577984dc8a35.doc: Marks the tournament as finished, cleans up and jumps to map s45 (Palm Brinks Square).

449dcc963989d61d.name: play_lin_stays_behind_scene
449dcc963989d61d.doc: Sets flag 352 and plays event 352 at 18:00: Lin is told to wait while Max goes on, then Max and Monica run off. Afterwards it loads dungeon d03b02.

44ab843a7d1b4f8f.name: ask_to_board_train
44ab843a7d1b4f8f.doc: Asks to board. On yes sets counter 1 to 6 and plays the boarding scene, then jumps to s37 (Ixion engine room) for the front car or s38 (Ixion guest room) for other cars.

44b4114639ef7d0c.name: play_alexandra_welcome_scene
44b4114639ef7d0c.doc: Event 700. Max and Monica walk into the Moon Flower Palace garden under the chapter 7 title. Alexandra, ruler of the palace, appears in a halo, asks them not to blame Sirus and says the garden holds memories she and Sirus shared. Sets flag 700.

44beea3ecd896ad7.name: play_firbits_return_deal_then_fade_in
44beea3ecd896ad7.doc: Plays the Firbit return deal scene and fades in.

44ca41f09feb473d.name: unload_toryon_rock_charas
44ca41f09feb473d.doc: Reactivates the player and deletes the Toryon, rock and thrown rock characters.

44da0655cafb0ed4.name: play_time_gate_explanation_scene
44da0655cafb0ed4.doc: Event 250. Max and Monica stand at the Time Gate in Sindain and a friend explains Atlamillia: red goes to the future, blue to the past, and Max's father's stone chose Max. Afterwards a hint says the Carpenterion can be used to rebuild Sindain. Sets flag 250.

44e4eeb56d743e3d.name: show_party_chara_message
44e4eeb56d743e3d.doc: Shows system message 50 with the given party character's name filled in. Always uses message 50, since the partner variant is unreachable. Returns 1.

44ff2e2e8056b559.name: arrive_from_paus_house
44ff2e2e8056b559.doc: The player runs in from Pau's House and the camera follows for 40 frames.

45097c420dac003d.name: start_garden_story_after_andrea_scene
45097c420dac003d.doc: Plays the Andrea scene, sets the story progress to 9, loads sound set 7000 and places the player at the far end of the garden.

4529a56028ea8f67.name: place_player_and_fade_in
4529a56028ea8f67.doc: Places the player at (-380, 104, 0) standing, aims the camera at him and fades in.

4546f3be2fb470e7.name: play_monica_explains_time_travel_scene
4546f3be2fb470e7.doc: Event 207 at the station: Cedric steps off the train, Monica appears and tells Max she came from the future, that Griffon is rewriting history, and asks him to help. Max agrees and Monica joins. Sets flag 207.

4551ae760355b4d5.name: update_item_prop_visibility
4551ae760355b4d5.doc: Shows the map prop p08_i04h03 and its function point while flag 37 is clear, and hides them once the item was taken.

456df9e485e8fd37.name: talk_fabio_after_joining
456df9e485e8fd37.doc: Fabio's chatter after the fish quest is cleared, asking for fishing tips. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about new fishing spots.

4582cac0c1f484c0.name: leave_village_to_station
4582cac0c1f484c0.doc: Asks whether to move to the station and, if the player agrees, jumps to map s02.

4586572f7a30325c.name: play_valley_arrival_with_chapter_items
4586572f7a30325c.doc: Gives the chapter 3 supply items and plays the e300 arrival scene with villagers frozen during it.

45af624c00ec162e.name: show_story_points_by_fishing_rod
45af624c00ec162e.doc: Stands the player, plays the fisherman grape juice scene, then sets counter 3 to 3 (flag 230 set) or 2 (flag 230 clear) if the player owns a Fishing Rod, and shows the story points.

45bfb62bab7e7444.name: replay_fight_intro_scene
45bfb62bab7e7444.doc: Story jump: sets earlier story flags and plays event 416.

45d6a9572b7e17ea.name: play_trentos_intro_scene
45d6a9572b7e17ea.doc: Plays the boss intro: music 190, the boss idles, attacks once and a title telop fades in and out.

45dbee839dfc01f0.name: play_photo_hint_reminder_scene
45dbee839dfc01f0.doc: Plays the hints reminder (event e105b, sets flag 105), repeating where to find the three items to photograph.

45dd22c85223e797.name: play_scene_then_go_to_s70_530
45dd22c85223e797.doc: Plays play_moonflower_beam_fire_scene and jumps to map s70 at event 530.

45f7b9ae49996ffd.name: handle_treasure_chest
45f7b9ae49996ffd.doc: Treasure chest program shared by dungeon maps; it only opens the chest (shared chest routine).

45fa4af810569578.name: play_chrono_union_activation_scene
45fa4af810569578.doc: Sets flag 640. Max and Monica walk in as the Lapis are all gathered and Chrono Union starts, they see Paznos appear and cheer that it worked.

4603961558a111e1.name: walk_player_in_and_resume
4603961558a111e1.doc: Short scene: the player walks into view at the Barnabas dungeon entrance and gains control.

4617086bcda22102.name: replay_mardan_reward_scene
4617086bcda22102.doc: Story event 245: plays the Mardan reward scene.

46171604e38aa743.name: play_majin_shrink_scene
46171604e38aa743.doc: Cutscene where the Dark Genie shrinks away and vanishes. Max and Monica wonder what it was, then decide to tell the Mayor about the Zelmite deposit and return to town. Sets the Dark Genie shrink-seen flag.

4621b2e5e3e1c020.name: open_need_safe_with_code
4621b2e5e3e1c020.doc: Quest 12: Need rambles about his wife's birthday, then you type the 4-digit safe code (1221). A wrong code fails; the right one opens the safe, he recruits himself and the quest is cleared.

4625cc14c4463a9f.name: place_dark_genie_fight
4625cc14c4463a9f.doc: Fades out, shows the boss area, starts the boss music (BGM 40), places monster 629 and the player and fades in.

4640d5e73f7b29cb.name: play_walk_through_gate_scene
4640d5e73f7b29cb.doc: Has the party leader run 155 units forward through the gate and fades out.

4658c8d1aaeebd7a.name: talk_aunt_polly_to_monica
4658c8d1aaeebd7a.doc: Aunt Polly's two-part talk to Monica about Max being a good man, with an offer of bread in chapter 8.

465ce3ae5777919b.name: play_cannon_barrage_then_jump_to_f30
465ce3ae5777919b.doc: Plays the cannon barrage on the golems, skips the next BGM load and jumps to map f30 at entry 604.

465f7a70031ae120.name: setup_station_item_check
465f7a70031ae120.doc: Sets up the station, places the player, opens the item-limit menu if the bag is full and fades in.

4667d4bde0ff2d37.name: play_boarding_train_scene
4667d4bde0ff2d37.doc: Max and Cedric walk up a path to the train while the crowd turns to watch, then the train car moves into place with sounds 12 to 14.

4685aaa4d102b4f2.name: show_stop_hint_message
4685aaa4d102b4f2.doc: Opens a bottom message saying to stop with the O button.

468a334023838c13.name: get_abs_int
468a334023838c13.doc: Returns the absolute value of an integer.

468bb8b26a194fcf.name: replay_monica_curses_griffon
468bb8b26a194fcf.doc: Plays the Monica curses Griffon scene.

469f74837fb0f1e5.name: play_exit_train_car
469f74837fb0f1e5.doc: Exit from a train car. With counter 0 at 0 (no car) it just places the player from the saved counters and fades in. Otherwise it binds the door and step parts of car 1, 2 or 3 for the side stored in counter 15, plays the door sound, then places the player on the platform and puts the camera behind.

46b86e04ee9e91f4.name: talk_to_swamp_master
46b86e04ee9e91f4.doc: Talk to the swamp master Mardan: he reminds the party to catch the Priscleen Fish. In item use mode, giving the Priscleen (item 310) runs event 506.

46c2381be67be5b8.name: start_throw_lafrescia_seed_scene
46c2381be67be5b8.doc: Story trigger for event 255a: plays the Lafrescia seed throwing scene.

46daa6ad06c02846.name: play_train_arrival_scene
46daa6ad06c02846.doc: A train pulls into the station, its carriage doors tilt open and the player runs off onto the platform.

46e4175b8a7628af.name: check_pad_held
46e4175b8a7628af.doc: Returns the currently held pad buttons ANDed with mask, nonzero when any masked button is down.

46eb7020de2e3843.name: play_meat_grab_jump_scene
46eb7020de2e3843.doc: Short scene: a creature grabs the meat and bounds toward the player, landing near Max or Monica, then fades out.

46f0112f7e1f2dfd.name: load_e204_event
46f0112f7e1f2dfd.doc: Loads the actors for event 204: the buggy with two riders seated in it, the extra scene characters, and the train smoke effect with the engine part motion. Starts no playback.

46f097bd8018b98c.name: play_leave_jurak_scene
46f097bd8018b98c.doc: Max and Monica thank Jurak and walk away along a path while the screen fades out.

471524e5aeb82bbc.name: load_mine_sound_set
471524e5aeb82bbc.doc: Stops the BGM and loads sound set 8800.

471ebef5218a57c7.name: ride_elevator_west
471ebef5218a57c7.doc: Elevator control by the first lift: asks for a floor and moves the player to the same spot on floor 0, 1 or 2 (height 0, 1160, 2320). On floor 1 it may play the Time Bomb scene.

47259354fa74b1f0.name: place_star_item_in_socket
47259354fa74b1f0.doc: Place the star item into the star socket. Needs flag 616, otherwise a message says it cannot be used yet. Asks first, then opens the item menu; using item 362 sets local flag 4, hides the socket map pieces and shows a growing star key model with a sound. Cancelling ends the event and the wrong item plays a refuse motion.

472ca654350739e5.name: play_spheda_hole_in_scene
472ca654350739e5.doc: Sets flag 316. Max does a cup-in pose after sinking a shot and Monica says he is good. Skippable.

472f52f9abca552c.name: check_club_equipped
472f52f9abca552c.doc: Checks whether the player can swing. Shows a refusal and returns 1 when the active character is not Max or no golf club item (10 to 14) is equipped, otherwise sets the Spheda club and returns 0.

474288b79a671b30.name: play_lighthouse_arrival_scene
474288b79a671b30.doc: Event 348 (flag 348): the party arrives at the Lighthouse with Max or Monica, sets up the scene characters and plays the arrival.

4765c2b8295840b2.name: play_toryon_plants_trees_scene
4765c2b8295840b2.doc: Event 250: a Toryon floats in carrying a tree and plants one on each side while Max and Monica look up and dodge left and right, then it spins and makes a peace sign.

476d5c8bc96b8538.name: setup_m01_map
476d5c8bc96b8538.doc: On map entry, if the save progress is 100 shows a notice and requests the edit event reset. If flag 304 is set and 305 is not, skips the next bgm load.

47722c10730e08d1.name: fade_in_and_pose_story_listeners
47722c10730e08d1.doc: Fades in event 203 and puts Max, Cedric, Vorneo and Tom in their idle poses while the camera moves in.

477b195e80537dec.name: turn_back_player_at_restricted_area
477b195e80537dec.doc: Two guards tell the player nobody may go beyond this point and the player is moved back.

478e76da57377a89.name: open_system_message
478e76da57377a89.doc: Opens system message 1010 plus index in window 2 near the bottom of the screen without waiting for input.

47938b1d661a5bd4.name: talk_party_cedric
47938b1d661a5bd4.doc: Talking to Cedric when he is in the party, at the three stations where the story hands him back. If the departure event for the current map is ready (Sindain, Balance Valley or Venicchio, set by event flags and not yet seen) he asks whether to leave and returns 1 if the player agrees, else 0. Otherwise, with Cedric as partner, he gives a caution line (plus a not-ready line until the arrival event for the map has been seen) and the normal NPC talk; without him as partner it opens the party NPC menu. Returns 0.

47af031178fa48fa.name: show_flag_tutorial
47af031178fa48fa.doc: Shows the dungeon flag tutorial message once, with monsters and pickups paused, and sets the tutorial-shown flag.

47b21c7d65f9ad5b.name: start_voice_stream
47b21c7d65f9ad5b.doc: Opens voice stream 1 for the given voice, waits until it is ready and starts playing it.

47c37e747f5b0e86.name: setup_station_map
47c37e747f5b0e86.doc: Sets up the station map: shows the late-drawn station parts, tilts the train slope parts and spawns the station NPC.

47da3a5617bb38ad.name: leave_train_by_door_b
47da3a5617bb38ad.doc: Same as door A for the opposite side: sets counter 15 to 0 and jumps to the station map if the door is open.

47e08267d0e6b97a.name: wait_scene_frames
47e08267d0e6b97a.doc: Waits the given number of frames.

47e52eed32fbb766.name: show_bottom_hint_message
47e52eed32fbb766.doc: Shows message 40 in a plain window at the bottom of the screen.

47e84a1ff1b9f73f.name: show_race_result_and_prize
47e84a1ff1b9f73f.doc: Shows the result of a finished heat. Compares the player's rank with the cut-off for the heat (1st, 2nd, 3rd), returning 0 if the fish was eliminated. Otherwise builds a six-row ranking board with random rival names, shows it, and in the final awards the prize for the rank. Returns 1 when a prize was awarded and -1 if the player backed out.

47ed95f40e8d1001.name: setup_yorda_tree_area
47ed95f40e8d1001.doc: If flag 300 is set and 332 is not, plays the arrival scene, otherwise (flag 300 set) the meat grab scene. Places the player and camera and fades in.

47fab01246e8a6bc.name: check_scoop_reward
47fab01246e8a6bc.doc: Checks the photographer's scoop reward state on the shop menu: returns 1 when a reward count is waiting; otherwise shows the 'bring more scoops' reply (state 1) or the explanation of photography levels (state 2) in window, and returns 0. In map 22 the talk uses the NPC's own window, elsewhere a centred one.

47fb17686a7299a4.name: open_clown_chest
47fb17686a7299a4.doc: Opens the clown chest: a clown pops out offering a big or a small chest. The two items are swapped at random, so the choice is blind. Picking the big chest gives item_b and the small one item_a, in the counts checked against the bag limit; the clown vanishes and the player may get the bag-full menu.

47fe278d7b53c27e.name: play_shot_take_out_camera
47fe278d7b53c27e.doc: Voiced shot where Cedric explains inventions and the hint for the Energy Pack, with idea pictures fading in on screen. He then takes out a camera.

480eabf52062b6a9.name: play_stream_message_for
480eabf52062b6a9.doc: Plays a stream with its message for up to the given frames, then stops it.

48214077a796317a.name: play_event_520_scene
48214077a796317a.doc: Story 520: plays event 520 with music 35. Steve or Ruby as the active character is swapped to Max or Monica first.

4829d75fd0885e4e.name: setup_georama_villager
4829d75fd0885e4e.doc: Setup program; only loads the current villager.

483e2037b60266a5.name: play_beam_charge_scene
483e2037b60266a5.doc: Event 640 cutscene variant that starts music 116 and shows the Moonflower beam charging in a loop. Used by program 610, which jumps to map s66 (Kazarov Stonehenge). Sets flag 640.

484105252a7d3df7.name: offer_move_to_ball
484105252a7d3df7.doc: Asks yes or no whether to move to the golf ball (the question differs for Max and Monica). On yes it finds a standing spot near the ball, pushing it away from nearby treasure boxes, and aims the camera at the ball from behind. It does not move the character itself.

484f92ae96d15ed7.name: open_shop_for_member
484f92ae96d15ed7.doc: Fades out, opens the shop menu for the given shop, closes the party member's NPC view and fades back in.

4857142ab3056cd2.name: play_walk_and_jump
4857142ab3056cd2.doc: Cutscene shot where Max and Steve walk up to the cliff edge and jump across the gap to the boss ledge. Walks with the camera tracking, then jumps with the camera following Steve and sand dust effects where they land. The se_bank passes the sounds.

488da1b7a5345ef8.name: go_to_f04
488da1b7a5345ef8.doc: Fades out and jumps to map f04.

4897db343770d697.name: play_electric_fish_plan_scene
4897db343770d697.doc: Sets flag 416. Pau tells Max to put the Electric Fish in Shingala mouth and Max agrees. Then loads monster 516 for the Shingala fight. Skippable.

48a263baf0fc8abe.name: talk_claire_monica
48a263baf0fc8abe.doc: Claire's talk with Monica as the active character: she asks if Monica is Max's girlfriend and admires her hair, comparing it to Erik's.

48afec74732b499b.name: unlock_floor_exit
48afec74732b499b.doc: Unlocks the d07 floor exit by showing the open map piece and hiding the closed one.

48bb06147cb6026b.name: start_time_travel_to_d03b02
48bb06147cb6026b.doc: Story 352: switches to Max, plays the time travel scene and loads dungeon d03b02 at program 502.

48c5747e6ce8858b.name: on_map_start
48c5747e6ce8858b.doc: On entering, resets the camera behind the player.

48d30389bf952dba.name: deliver_gold_paint_to_parn
48d30389bf952dba.doc: Parn asks for the Gold Paint. If the player offers item 376 he paints Julia to life in a cutscene, takes the paint, makes Julia join the party and clears the quest. Another item gets refused.

490cb92b9af71d24.name: play_nobb_scene_story
490cb92b9af71d24.doc: Plays the Dr. Nobb scene as story event 428.

491af98121633362.name: play_hologram_scene_for_debug
491af98121633362.doc: Debug entry that plays the Osmond hologram scene.

491c48c57d4f033c.name: pick_up_handy_stick
491c48c57d4f033c.doc: Gives the Handy Stick, shows the item get message and removes the stick prop.

491d3acd6e45f464.name: play_red_time_gate_scene
491d3acd6e45f464.doc: Plays the warp scene through the red time gate, with Monica in the scene when she is in the party.

493a11228977fea2.name: talk_milane_after_joining
493a11228977fea2.doc: Milane's two-part chatter after the sword quest is cleared, about the beauty of a well-made sword. Chapter 8 swaps in a question about tough guys in the mine.

493d4d926e2b2502.name: play_griffon_account_title_scene
493d4d926e2b2502.doc: Pauses the game, fades a black screen sprite away and shows the title card for event e610, the scene told from Griffon's side.

493eb71fe6ec4996.name: start_metal_flotsam_fight
493eb71fe6ec4996.doc: Starts the battle music and places the Metal Flotsam boss monster 628 with the player at the arena start.

494454399747b140.name: finish_shot
494454399747b140.doc: Ends a golf shot: hides the status panel, deletes the club model, restores the player's stand pose, camera control, status bar and sword trail. When the shot did not go in and no strokes are left, shows a message and puts the camera behind the player.

494d7c078c674114.name: collect_item_374_clear_floor
494d7c078c674114.doc: Dungeon floor pickup: for monster forms only shows a message; otherwise advances to the next floor, gives item 374 with a message, marks floor 6-11 cleared and disables the item marker.

495b526d94c2a7c5.name: load_firbit_return_actors
495b526d94c2a7c5.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Conda, Noam, Rococo, Zak, Wicky, Tobo and Mogri for event 250 and its message file. Stores the party slots in chara_slot_a and chara_slot_b.

49672edc885a57c0.name: play_toryon_rock_throw_then_go_to_s11
49672edc885a57c0.doc: Plays the Toryon rock throw scene and jumps to map s11 at entry 502.

4970296f29c5fc41.name: resume_energy_pack_lesson
4970296f29c5fc41.doc: Story event 105c: like event 520, picks the right lesson stage from what Max holds. With an Energy Pack it plays the finish scene and sets flag 20.

497fd35bea98cb3e.name: ask_to_reset_ball_to_player
497fd35bea98cb3e.doc: Asks yes or no (message 2004). On yes puts the Spheda ball and its two helper charas at the player's position, slightly raised, updates the strokes left and crossfades.

49864249227ded13.name: ask_npc_question
49864249227ded13.doc: Starts a conversation with an NPC, asks a question with choices and ends it. Returns the choice.

4998f25710025f18.name: play_cannon_barrage_on_golems_scene
4998f25710025f18.doc: Event 540 variant: sixteen cannons on the fortress swing around and fire while the camera orbits, then four golems are pierced and explosions go off on the slope.

49ac08e3381adb3c.name: return_to_d02b01_event_12560
49ac08e3381adb3c.doc: Loads dungeon map d02b01 and runs its event script at entry 12560.

49b28fc882b39028.name: setup_map_objects
49b28fc882b39028.doc: Sets up Balance Valley station: shows the normal train parts before chapter 6, the late station parts in chapters 6 and 7, and (after chapter 7) the normal ones again, hides the steps, hides a part when flag 372 is set, and spawns and places the station villagers.

49bf1497e0853a26.name: use_floor_gate_3
49bf1497e0853a26.doc: Uses the floor gate with index 3.

49ccff146fa5b53b.name: set_georama_analysis_three_flags_and_jump
49ccff146fa5b53b.doc: Sets georama analysis flags so only 0, 1 and 2 of group 2 are set, sets flag 456 and clears 460, and jumps to map 82.

49e030f512f091d5.name: choose_jump_gate_destination
49e030f512f091d5.doc: Asks which Jump Gate to use (north, east, west or in front of the Time Gate). A sun warp effect fades the party out, the choice is stored in counter 18 and the game jumps to f04.

49ed13c969864e35.name: trigger_game_over
49ed13c969864e35.doc: Game over handler. While flag 416 is set and 420 is not (the Shingala fight), plays one of two voiced game over lines at random. Otherwise a silent game over.

49ed4c7bffef46b4.name: set_ground_func_points
49ed4c7bffef46b4.doc: Enables or disables the ground function points jimen1 to jimen10 (except 8).

49f8405d2ee05e1f.name: give_shell_talkie_and_enter_shigura
49f8405d2ee05e1f.doc: Sets flag 400 (Veniccio arrival seen), clears the Shigura flags 432, 434, 436 and 438, gives the Shell Talkie (item 373) and enters Shigura Village (edit mode 90), so the with-item arrival plays.

4a0d52b4d61356c2.name: set_idle_motion
4a0d52b4d61356c2.doc: Sets the player's standing motion for the active character. Steve (character 2) uses the legs or caterpillar track stand motion depending on his movement type; the others use the plain stand.

4a1e4d1b1aae4001.name: vanish_spiral_rock_9
4a1e4d1b1aae4001.doc: Binds map part p11_d06b02-9 and plays the spiral rock vanish scene.

4a3a907257412138.name: open_save_menu_keeping_music
4a3a907257412138.doc: Save point program: opens the menu with a fade without reloading the map music.

4a5952b6457f935b.name: leave_square_for_main_street
4a5952b6457f935b.doc: If the player agrees to move to Main Street, jumps to Palm Brinks (m01).

4a61871e7224878d.name: play_voice_message_timeout
4a61871e7224878d.doc: Plays a voice line from a stream with its text shown, for at most the given number of frames, then closes the window and stream.

4a6ab5d4cd06fcb8.name: open_floor_select_menu
4a6ab5d4cd06fcb8.doc: Switches to dungeon music, opens the dungeon map menu, sets the chosen floor and previous floor, and starts that floor.

4a98efef6f8f89b7.name: replay_story_event_364
4a98efef6f8f89b7.doc: Story program for event 364: sets Balance Valley Georama analysis flags 0 to 7 and clears 8 and 9, marks events 368, 372 and 376 seen and 364 unseen, and jumps to map 26 (Starlight Temple).

4a9ee55e60129de3.name: play_cannon_barrage_on_golems_scene
4a9ee55e60129de3.doc: Event 540 variant: sixteen cannons on the fortress swing around and fire while the camera orbits, then four golems are pierced and explosions go off on the slope.

4ab2536efed55bde.name: play_gate_key_open
4ab2536efed55bde.doc: Gate key opening scene: the camera turns to the gate, the key object appears and glows, then the gate piece swings open with a few bounces and the key model is removed.

4ab258ccd6d272a0.name: play_defeat_scene_and_open_boss_door
4ab258ccd6d272a0.doc: After Metal Flotsam is beaten: fades out, plays the defeat scene, unlocks map movement, opens the boss door and puts the player near it.

4ad71d6c4a58a766.name: end_departure_scene_return
4ad71d6c4a58a766.doc: Cleans up the Gaspard departure scene actors, finishes the event and jumps back to map d03b01 at entry 503.

4aebda9b96953837.name: play_confrontation_from_event
4aebda9b96953837.doc: Plays the Cedric and Need confrontation scene.

4aece859e9785ef0.name: talk_donny_to_monica
4aece859e9785ef0.doc: Donny's talk when Monica is the active character: he says he has hardly seen Max since she arrived and hopes she is not using him.

4aff8408f98564bb.name: can_play_event_364
4aff8408f98564bb.doc: Returns 1 when analysis flag 206 is set and story event 364 has not been played.

4b06fc1f0bd0efa4.name: end_spheda_shot_view
4b06fc1f0bd0efa4.doc: Restores the party and camera after a shot. If the course par is used up (result 0) it shows a message and fades out, returning 2. Returns the result.

4b13b59a5abf46c3.name: play_event_105_closing_line
4b13b59a5abf46c3.doc: Last shot of event 105: sets the camera, places Max and Steve standing plus character 25, and plays a laughing voice line telling Max to call when he is ready. snd_id is unused.

4b1750f716f5e3fe.name: play_victory_town_view_alt_scene
4b1750f716f5e3fe.doc: Another event 824 town view variant with parts of the town hidden. Sets flag 824.

4b2167e3ca8a900f.name: talk_mina_after_joining
4b2167e3ca8a900f.doc: Mina's chatter after the Spheda quest is cleared, asking not to be taken to insect places. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about the Blackstone Railroad.

4b36cb9d8c5a439a.name: play_room_5_monster_intro_scene
4b36cb9d8c5a439a.doc: Intro for the fifth room: the two monsters e117g and e117f fall in one after the other under title card 5, then the scene fades out.

4b38baa515dca7c7.name: play_patri_asks_for_gold_paint_scene
4b38baa515dca7c7.doc: Scene where Parn greets the other hero, introduces Julia, who is a painted woman, and asks for Gold Paint, which can give a painting life, in return for the use of his magic painting power.

4b45636e2acec2cd.name: play_boss_landing
4b45636e2acec2cd.doc: Boss landing shot: Steve stands on the left, the boss drops in from the right with a camera shake and sound effects, and the shot waits for its landing motion. Returns 0.

4b8ab78fa194e582.name: run_boss_loss_game_over
4b8ab78fa194e582.doc: Game over after a loss. If flag 608 is set and flag 612 is not, plays one of two random voiced game overs, otherwise a silent one.

4b973d166655e435.name: play_blackstone_railroad_scene
4b973d166655e435.doc: Fades out and plays the Blackstone Railroad arrival scene.

4b9ee534de042416.name: show_locked_door_message
4b9ee534de042416.doc: Shows the message that the door will not open and to try again later.

4ba3bb908af0e254.name: move_asq_in_arc_with_spin
4ba3bb908af0e254.doc: Moves an animation object along a gravity arc while interpolating its rotation from start_rot to end_rot.

4bb95ccb3f7793f8.name: talk_to_blinkhorn
4bb95ccb3f7793f8.doc: Talk handler for Sheriff Blinkhorn. Picks the line by the active character, quest 0 state, whether he stands at his post (x about 1182, z about 210) and quest 9.

4bba2cfba3d7445c.name: show_need_stands_up_shouts_cedric
4bba2cfba3d7445c.doc: Need stands up from his desk and shouts Cedric.

4bca3dee5037583d.name: play_rococo_wake_up_motion
4bca3dee5037583d.doc: Plays Rococo's wake up motion and its loop on actor 2 on the roof, then waits 43 frames.

4bde48b9631c170f.name: start_map_default
4bde48b9631c170f.doc: Debug test program; it only runs the default map start routine.

4be8a6e2411ebe00.name: talk_to_stewart
4be8a6e2411ebe00.doc: Talk handler for Stewart. Picks the line by the active character, quest 0 state and quest 6 (auction money).

4bf1b3f6662d4132.name: setup_monster_604_room
4bf1b3f6662d4132.doc: Sets flag 728, loads and places monster 604, places Max facing it, sets the camera and fades in.

4c33aa1908c882c9.name: setup_house_for_quest_18
4c33aa1908c882c9.doc: Sets the p03 part visible while flag 38 is unset. When quest 18 is active and counter 11 equals 1 it places Corinne.

4c3a7b9035bd8a5b.name: grow_swamp_sprout
4c3a7b9035bd8a5b.doc: Interaction with the swamp at the start of floor d02b01. The first time the player is told to use an item, and using Lafrescia Seed (361) plays the explosion scene and sets flag 23; afterward using Sundrop (356) plays the light scene and sets flag 24, which opens the way to d02b02. A wrong item plays a refusal motion.

4c3c3cf6637a0375.name: replay_meet_pau_scene
4c3c3cf6637a0375.doc: Story jump: clears flags 408, 420, 444, replays event 404 and goes to Veniccio.

4c5e20643b6327c0.name: give_item_243_once
4c5e20643b6327c0.doc: Save point program: the first time (flag 37), gives 20 of item 243, shows the item message, hides the prop and opens the item limit menu.

4c6c3da7790616e8.name: interact_with_star_barrier
4c6c3da7790616e8.doc: Handles the star barrier: when the right item is used it hides the star map piece, disables its function point and plays a short star key scene. Otherwise tells the player the star's power blocks the way.

4c7463c6a6281a56.name: ask_to_return_to_past
4c7463c6a6281a56.doc: Shows the prompt that Max and the others can now help Crest and should head back to the past (with a hint to open the menu with the # button) with two choices. Returns 1 if the first choice was picked, otherwise 0.

4c7f2742197a5aa5.name: debug_unlock_analysis_and_play_lecture
4c7f2742197a5aa5.doc: Debug entry that marks all of town 1's analysis flags, sets story flags 364, 368 and 376, clears 372 and plays the helper-based Griffon lecture scene.

4c84eef8ab48ef5a.name: jump_to_s32_map
4c84eef8ab48ef5a.doc: Plays Emperor Griffon's battle challenge scene (flag 640) and jumps to map s32 (Moon Flower Palace vs Paznos) at event 600. Returns 0.

4ca11babaaed1f27.name: pause_then_run_s03_2_2
4ca11babaaed1f27.doc: Waits 30 frames, then runs the play_taxi_ride_scene scene.

4cabf6ccd4abbce9.name: start_elephant_victory_event
4cabf6ccd4abbce9.doc: Fades out, sets flag 7, makes Max active, hides the s06 objects and plays the elephant victory scene.

4cb427b3dca70187.name: load_event_280_charas
4cb427b3dca70187.doc: Sets up Max and Monica as scene actors (globals 6 and 7) and loads the event 280 message file.

4cb8fa598fde0e71.name: show_message_timed
4cb8fa598fde0e71.doc: Opens a message at the given position and runs it with a frame limit, then returns the message slot to normal. Returns the frames waited.

4cd85978f1b28335.name: debug_play_touch_vine_scene
4cd85978f1b28335.doc: Debug entry that plays the vine touching scene.

4cf23e6e694aa858.name: play_monster_gives_sundrop_scene
4cf23e6e694aa858.doc: A monster complains that it makes too many droplets and hands a Sundrop to the player, with Monica's magic charge effect between them. Sets flag 290 so it happens once.

4cf6c562db1e2d09.name: cleanup_event_charas
4cf6c562db1e2d09.doc: Cleans up the forest event scene: reactivates whichever of Max or Monica is the active character, deletes the other's scene model and motion data, and deletes the extra event characters 34 to 37.

4d1091fc05262e50.name: show_timed_voiced_message
4d1091fc05262e50.doc: Shows the message, starts stream 1 once ready and closes it after a fixed number of frames.

4d1757b8d2e9aa8e.name: play_event_732_then_go_to_s44
4d1757b8d2e9aa8e.doc: Plays event 732 and jumps to map s44 at event 500.

4d211baa76c972ed.name: play_opening_town_walk_scene
4d211baa76c972ed.doc: Test scene from the opening: townsfolk walk and talk while the camera sweeps down the street to Max, who turns around and fixes his hat; ends on a pad press.

4d37fd80907f1cf1.name: play_event_540_to_f04
4d37fd80907f1cf1.doc: Plays event 540 (Galen) and jumps to map f04 at event 601.

4d387d295996afc1.name: replay_late_train_arrival_scene
4d387d295996afc1.doc: Debug entry: plays the late train arrival scene.

4d65cb15aa446eab.name: talk_fabio_after_joining
4d65cb15aa446eab.doc: Fabio's chatter after the fish quest is cleared, asking for fishing tips. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about new fishing spots.

4d7719c35bf5d776.name: show_emperor_griffon_image
4d7719c35bf5d776.doc: Shows the second story image and narrates that the mysterious ruler Emperor Griffon destroyed the world.

4d7a9c9a0c7e1d03.name: play_event_257
4d7a9c9a0c7e1d03.doc: Boss intro for the Rainbow Butterfly in dungeon 2: sets the boss intro flag, fades in on the floor, Monica and Max jump in, spot the butterfly and take a stance with voiced lines while the butterfly circles. Ends by loading the boss music and fading back into the fight.

4d8c77b5ba3e74aa.name: play_gate_arrival_enter_d06e01
4d8c77b5ba3e74aa.doc: Plays the time gate arrival scene, then loads the d06e01 dungeon at event 508.

4d9b51e2f170d29b.name: place_butterfly_boss_monsters
4d9b51e2f170d29b.doc: Loads monster data 501 to 509 for the Rainbow Butterfly boss, places 501 to 508 at their default spots and places six copies of 509 on a ring around the boss room centre, each facing a different way.

4da38722ff5b7676.name: show_npcs_by_analysis_flags
4da38722ff5b7676.doc: Shows or hides NPC slots 101 to 105 from analysis flags. Slots 101 to 103 appear only once event 275 has been seen and analysis flags 106, 104 and 105 are set; slots 104 and 105 follow analysis flags 107 and 103.

4db593d9bc39cdbd.name: play_late_train_arrival_scene
4db593d9bc39cdbd.doc: Plays the train arriving at the platform, with the carriages and ramp moving, used in chapters 6 and 7, then Max steps off.

4dc685f49560b276.name: play_flotsam_demands_red_stone_scene
4dc685f49560b276.doc: Event 103: Max finds a pump room, Flotsam appears and tries to bargain the red stone for news of his mother. Max refuses and Flotsam sends his elephant. Sets flag 103.

4dc84ef205e41b88.name: pick_up_item_382
4dc84ef205e41b88.doc: Program 520: the player turns toward the pickup, receives item 382 and the item1 trigger is disabled.

4ddedf7089e9829d.name: load_event_272_charas
4ddedf7089e9829d.doc: Loads the actors for event 272: Max and Monica with their event motions, extra effect models, and the message file. Puts the inactive character into a spare slot.

4de6dbd86e9881df.name: play_story_414_osmond_asleep
4de6dbd86e9881df.doc: Story entry for event 414: clears flag 408 and plays the sleeping Osmond scene.

4df14ef50b6cd938.name: setup_station_and_run_in_from_town
4df14ef50b6cd938.doc: Sets up the station objects and plays Max running in from town.

4df826106ba522b5.name: play_fire_horn_gift_scene
4df826106ba522b5.doc: Event 524. Max meets Galen Agaris, who knew his mother. After hearing that Monica fell into Mt. Gundor, Galen gives him the Fire Horn to cross the lava and warns about Gaspard.

4dfa0ebae840d5f8.name: get_chest_item_scale
4dfa0ebae840d5f8.doc: Writes into out_scale[0] the scale that fits the chest item model chara into a size of 4.

4e01ac0d48583aec.name: talk_ferdinand_to_monica
4e01ac0d48583aec.doc: Ferdinand's two-part talk to Monica about food, with a different single line in chapter 8. Uses the talk camera and returns Ferdinand to standing.

4e0ae9cf3d6b06f5.name: clean_up_e280_scene_and_jump_to_s02
4e0ae9cf3d6b06f5.doc: Removes the extra characters loaded for event e280 and jumps to map s02 at entry 503.

4e1977de2153433f.name: give_star_key_and_play_hologram_scene
4e1977de2153433f.doc: Adds the Star Key (item 362), plays the Osmond hologram scene and jumps to s37 at entry 530.

4e27c714f4407c8d.name: take_gate_exit_1
4e27c714f4407c8d.doc: Gate 1 handler: interacts with the second exit door.

4e38f82c3cf9917a.name: play_halloween_intro_scene
4e38f82c3cf9917a.doc: Plays the long boss intro (event e110, sets flag 110). Max enters the room, hears something above, and Halloween drops in with Polcurse, who demands the red stone. It then loads the boss monster and shows a tutorial window about grabbing and throwing the boss's nose bombs.

4e776a4ff50b4409.name: talk_ferdinand_early
4e776a4ff50b4409.doc: Ferdinand's talk before the first quest is cleared: he compares his cooking research to Max's machine discoveries.

4e7939642a348db5.name: show_stop_hint
4e7939642a348db5.doc: Opens a plain bottom-screen hint telling the player to stop the spinner with the O button.

4e938ca98b2f01b5.name: setup_fish_race_hall
4e938ca98b2f01b5.doc: Starts the fish race event: clears globals race_sound_id and prize_sound_id, loads the festival villagers, shows map part p07_i03h04, loads the prize setting and places the player.

4eaa6c1f79ce202c.name: play_quake_then_load_s35
4eaa6c1f79ce202c.doc: Plays the sand dust scene then loads map s35 and its script at program 500.

4eacf2422360b8cc.name: block_exit_in_demo_210
4eacf2422360b8cc.doc: At progress 100 (the demo build) shows the demo message. Otherwise does nothing.

4ebca19c0cf03751.name: load_e254_event
4ebca19c0cf03751.doc: Loads the actors for event 254: Max and Monica in swapped slots depending on which is active, a party model for the active one, the Conda character bound to actor 3, and the event message file.

4ecd63bd761574b6.name: load_e364_scene_characters
4ecd63bd761574b6.doc: Loads the Max and Monica models, motions and message file for event e364, setting globals 0 and 1 to the two chara slots.

4ed4b422493a9363.name: finish_npc_talk
4ed4b422493a9363.doc: Ends a conversation: optionally turns the NPC back to its original yaw, stands it, finishes the event and optionally crossfades.

4edaffe1ff5728a3.name: play_firbit_return_then_go_to_sindain
4edaffe1ff5728a3.doc: Story 250: plays the Firbit return scene and jumps to s47 (Sindain event).

4edc69e5ed0f06a3.name: talk_to_swamp_villager
4edc69e5ed0f06a3.doc: Talk handler by NPC slot: slot 8 is Master Utan whose lines depend on flags 240 and 253, and slots 10 to 12 are Zak, Wicky and Mogri who refuse to go back.

4ef98499ed013bfb.name: run_treasure_chest
4ef98499ed013bfb.doc: Starts opening a treasure chest. Crossfades, hides the player, sets the Ridepod standing pose by its move type, then opens an item chest for one item or a clown chest for two.

4efbc7cc18f0f110.name: talk_claire
4efbc7cc18f0f110.doc: Picks Claire's talk by quest state: before quest 0 is done the early line, then by quest 4 status the quest offer, the flower photo talk, or the joined talk. Returns 0.

4f040bd6dcbd1b91.name: go_to_guest_room
4f040bd6dcbd1b91.doc: Fades out and jumps to map s38 (Ixion guest room).

4f0b44b51ea5ab9e.name: setup_progress_9_arrival
4f0b44b51ea5ab9e.doc: Runs play_andrea_garden_clue_scene, sets the story progress save value to 9, loads sound set 7000, places the player and camera and fades in.

4f1eb9baf7128ffd.name: show_aim_for_head_hint
4f1eb9baf7128ffd.doc: Event program in the Halloween boss room that pauses monsters and the player and shows a hint box telling the player to aim for the head. The French text is shown for both language branches.

4f26d078b351c59b.name: play_griffon_reveals_himself_scene
4f26d078b351c59b.doc: Event 608, sets flag 608: the heroes reach Emperor Griffon, who reveals himself as the one the humans fear and invites them to fight, with a title card. Starts boss music 36 at the end.

4f38b7125f3faca3.name: leave_train_by_right_door
4f38b7125f3faca3.doc: If the right-side door is open, unlocks map movement, sets counter 15 to 1 and goes to the station map.

4f42694ae820a9c6.name: offer_ball_reset
4f42694ae820a9c6.doc: Spheda golf: asks whether to reset the ball (yes/no). On yes it puts the ball and its two characters 3 units above the player, rechecks strokes left and crossfades.

4f4a2e14dcf3e36a.name: play_floor_clear_celebration
4f4a2e14dcf3e36a.doc: Plays when all monsters on a floor are cleared. The active character does a victory pose, the door opens, the floor is marked cleared, medal messages show, any broken Red, Blue or White Seal is announced, and the player may be offered the Spheda ball minigame.

4f550a8d51f0379e.name: show_starglass_title_card
4f550a8d51f0379e.doc: Sets flag 352 and shows a title card for event 352 (using the star hourglass), then fades out.

4f66370b285846e7.name: warp_to_d04b01_event_444
4f66370b285846e7.doc: Clears the scene and starts event 444 on map d04b01.

4f6c2e5607fe9ffb.name: talk_milane_early
4f6c2e5607fe9ffb.doc: Milane's talk before the first quest is cleared: his shop specializes in blades and he has only a few guns.

4f826a16890aa609.name: setup_map_charas
4f826a16890aa609.doc: Initialises the map characters and runs the map setup.

4f86756bf3dfe4e9.name: look_at_origin_until_button
4f86756bf3dfe4e9.doc: Program 152: points the camera at the origin and waits for pad button 64.

4f97cf45907228c8.name: play_lighthouse_shelling_scene
4f97cf45907228c8.doc: Event 356, first half. Monica beats Gaspard on the battleship and Gaspard orders the Moon Crystal lighthouse destroyed. The ship's guns fire on the lighthouse, Crest raises a barrier and the lighthouse is hit. Sets flag 356, supports scene skip, and cleans up through unload_lighthouse_shelling_actors.

4f9c2eab59835502.name: finish_race_and_show_outcome
4f9c2eab59835502.doc: After a race, shows the result. If the fish was eliminated, plays a disappointed motion and the host consoles the player, resetting the race counter.

4fa093ee1b6531cc.name: play_valley_arrival_scene
4fa093ee1b6531cc.doc: Cutscene (event 302, sets flag 302): Max and Monica arrive in Balance Valley, comment on the four plateaus whose height changes, spot houses in the distance and head toward them.

4faebc2978fc5b62.name: play_shot_call_from_below
4faebc2978fc5b62.doc: Shot: two characters on top look down while Cedric below looks up and calls out that the door leads to the underground waterway and that the player is going on alone. Sets the projection for the shot and restores it afterwards.

4fb0b25318577e97.name: setup_palm_brinks_arrival
4fb0b25318577e97.doc: Sets up the map objects and places the player. After loading a save it uses the last save point, or starts the Zelmite request scene if flag 736 is set without 800. Otherwise it places the player by the map they came from.

4fb56fec706457f2.name: play_lin_wakes_up_scene
4fb56fec706457f2.doc: Plays event 330. Lin recovers after eating the dumplings but cannot remember Crest's death. Argo explains what happened and Max and Monica take her to the Cape Lighthouse to jog her memory.

4fcafabe92479f8c.name: play_event_270
4fcafabe92479f8c.doc: Event 270: Max and Monica run up to the sleeping Jurak and ask him about Emperor Griffon, but he does not remember. Sets the seen flag first and can be skipped.

4ff5b8696666a339.name: place_player_behind_ball
4ff5b8696666a339.doc: Reads the ball position, aims toward the pin, and picks the nearest clear stance angle if the direct one is blocked. Places Max there in the ready stance.

4ffbe52dc74ba1ef.name: play_floor_clear_with_treasure
4ffbe52dc74ba1ef.doc: Floor clear: spawns a chest with an Absorption Coin (item 206) unless counter 17 bit 4 is set and one with a Moon Stone (item 199) unless bit 8 is set; if either spawned, crossfades to a view of the chests with the player placed in front of them. Then plays BGM 193 and sets the floor info flag to 2.

4ffcfc260a91bad7.name: finish_boss_fight_and_return_to_first_floor
4ffcfc260a91bad7.doc: After the butterflies are defeated: clears the monsters, marks the floor info flag 2, plays Holly's scene, gives the Teal Envelope and returns to d02b01 at event 201.

4ffda59efe09af99.name: show_medal_messages
4ffda59efe09af99.doc: Shows the medal messages after a room clear: a message when the destroy goal was cleared (destroy_cleared 1 or 2), a medal sound with a message, and a practice result message 2700 plus practice_index when practice_status is 2 or 3. When both the destroy goal and the practice are done it shows a two-medals line instead.

5009be28824bebe0.name: warp_to_s56_event_352
5009be28824bebe0.doc: Clears the scene, resets flag 352 and loads map s56 with the event script for event 352.

5014894c8fd9213d.name: run_game_over_with_flotsam_taunt
5014894c8fd9213d.doc: Runs the game over. After the intro and before the defeat scene it plays one of two voiced Flotsam taunts at random, otherwise a silent game over.

5028b84d1dc5d7d8.name: handle_locked_chest
5028b84d1dc5d7d8.doc: Handles the locked-chest prompt. If the partner is Donny he can open it; otherwise it offers the Treasure Chest Key from the item menu. Forcing the lock instead triggers the chest's trap: poison (bit 8), an explosion that destroys the chest (bit 16) or weapon damage (bit 32). Returns 1 when the player gave up or the chest was destroyed, 0 when it is now unlocked.

50295a6deccad48a.name: use_red_time_gate_to_starlight_temple
50295a6deccad48a.doc: Plays the red time gate effect after checking the party and jumps to map f02, Starlight Temple.

502e9fc30b1c7fc2.name: play_lin_wants_to_be_sage_scene
502e9fc30b1c7fc2.doc: Event 336: Lin tells Max and Monica why her master wants to be a sage and about the sage who saved her village. Sets flag 336.

505475f52418f340.name: play_monster_title_card_intro
505475f52418f340.doc: Intro for the guardian fight at the rapis point: stops the music, loads monster e54e and its cry, shows the title card (event 632) with the camera, plays the monster's dodge and attack motions, then fades out and returns control.

506dddceacd0cdb4.name: run_oz_wait_scene_test
506dddceacd0cdb4.doc: Debug entry that plays the Oz waits scene.

5083fe7fc4013d94.name: play_paznos_change_then_go_to_s66_630
5083fe7fc4013d94.doc: Plays play_paznos_transformation_scene (Paznos changing shape, sets flag 640) and jumps to map s66 at event 630.

50905efc392ef85f.name: press_panel_1_2
50905efc392ef85f.doc: Candle puzzle step for the church candle at row 1, column 2: cuts to a fixed camera, waits 45 frames, toggles that candle and its four neighbours (i01h07_13 pieces), then waits 45 frames.

5099d221d254e9a6.name: vanish_spiral_rock_1
5099d221d254e9a6.doc: Binds map part p11_d06b02-1 and plays the spiral rock vanish scene.

50b962b977ebde93.name: play_ixion_explanation_scene
50b962b977ebde93.doc: Sets flag 448. In the Luna Lab, Chap explains the Ixion time locomotive and Dr. Jaming's grandson apologizes. A hologram of Elena then reveals she is Max's mother from the future, tells of the Atlamillia stones and sends Max and Monica to Mt. Gundor to recreate Paznos. Ends via end_ixion_scene_and_go_to_s09.

50d645d7084c1e8d.name: warp_to_s19_event_408
50d645d7084c1e8d.doc: Clears the scene and starts event 408 on map s19.

50db14ffae95fae3.name: show_monster_caption_and_wait
50db14ffae95fae3.doc: Debug style entry that plays the caption scene and waits for a pad button.

50e2d53062eb9f6b.name: ask_to_take_east_exit
50e2d53062eb9f6b.doc: Asks whether to leave by the east path. On yes Max runs off along a path and the screen fades, returning 1; on no he walks a few steps and returns 0.

50eae31fad3f6468.name: play_floor_exit_scene
50eae31fad3f6468.doc: Plays the short scene of Max walking out through the exit while the door pieces slide away, facing whichever way the exit points.

50ebf5c17dde93ed.name: show_aim_for_head_hint
50ebf5c17dde93ed.doc: Event program in the Halloween boss room that pauses monsters and the player and shows a hint box telling the player to aim for the head. The French text is shown for both language branches.

50eefd4f725454d0.name: play_underground_channel_narration_scene
50eefd4f725454d0.doc: Plays event 102, Max's narration about the Underground Channel and his mother, and returns 0.

50fa15d4ced785c0.name: exit_hub_to_next_area
50fa15d4ced785c0.doc: Exit trigger of the d06e01 hub. In game mode 1 it jumps to map g05 when ask_to_leave_area allows it; otherwise, when ask_to_leave_area_with_character_check allows it, it unlocks map moves and enters Georama edit mode 177.

50fca375e52b191d.name: board_train_for_chapter
50fca375e52b191d.doc: Asks to board the train and, on yes, plays the boarding scene and jumps to the front car (s08, or s37 in chapters 6 and 7) or the middle car (s07, or s38 in chapters 6 and 7), depending on which door was used.

50fe38dc39c400d5.name: turn_to_face_each_other
50fe38dc39c400d5.doc: Turns the player and the NPC toward each other with a walk and a gradual rotation. If set_camera is nonzero it also frames a talk camera with a crossfade.

511d44fdc85bd6a2.name: ask_to_leave_floor
511d44fdc85bd6a2.doc: Exit trigger. For the alternate characters shows a short message; otherwise asks whether to leave. Yes fades out, clears the monsters and loads the d07 event script. Returns 0 for the alternate characters.

512468738d9551cd.name: load_current_villager
512468738d9551cd.doc: Resets memory stack 4, loads the current villager's model into character slot 24 at the town start point and activates it.

51333af5508b35e7.name: rotate_chara_to_yaw
51333af5508b35e7.doc: Turns chara smoothly to target_yaw over 10 frames, using the walk motion for a turn of more than half a radian and the stand motion otherwise, then sets the exact yaw.

514348e9c09f7122.name: choose_dungeon_from_gate
514348e9c09f7122.doc: The channel gate: asks to move, shows the dungeon tree map and starts the chosen floor. Option 3 before flag 102 is set goes to Max's room edit mode instead.

514ceb9c0e7ac0ed.name: ask_to_enter_dungeon
514ceb9c0e7ac0ed.doc: Asks the dungeon entry question (set 5, item 97). Returns 1 after a fade out if the player says yes, otherwise 0.

515dbea4a21b9edf.name: play_griffon_in_the_past_and_jump_to_f02
515dbea4a21b9edf.doc: Plays the Griffon in the past scene then jumps to map f02 at entry 510.

51624ad98b8609c4.name: play_voiced_line_with_lipsync
51624ad98b8609c4.doc: Opens the voice stream, shows the message, plays the voice with lip sync for the given frames and closes the window.

516d818a7a3a46a9.name: play_central_lab_arrival_story
516d818a7a3a46a9.doc: Plays the Central Lab arrival scene.

518ad190f9a59235.name: talk_waiting_npc
518ad190f9a59235.doc: Talk to a character who waits at a station: says a line that depends on whether the waiting NPC has been released (flag), then the normal NPC talk.

519b22f39bf5969c.name: use_star_key_on_door
519b22f39bf5969c.doc: Program 340: calls the star key door routine.

51b89778b1918e17.name: play_bridge_repaired_scene_from_program
51b89778b1918e17.doc: Sets up the station and plays the bridge repaired scene.

51ba2a8679f3afef.name: play_flotsam_orders_elephant_shot
51ba2a8679f3afef.doc: Flotsam appears above the elephant, laughs and orders it to tear them to pieces while the elephant trumpets and the title card fades in.

51c66f053a2c8172.name: talk_rosa
51c66f053a2c8172.doc: Granny Rosa's talk dispatcher. Quest 0 not yet at state 2 gives her early talk; after that, quest 19's state picks the quest offer (0), retry (1) or joined talk (2). Returns 0.

52019c5090d0c773.name: place_player_at_station_entrance
52019c5090d0c773.doc: Fades in and has the player walk a few steps into the map, then resets the camera.

520430c431c27ec2.name: end_floor_to_edit_mode
520430c431c27ec2.doc: Fades out, marks the player status, clears monsters, marks floor 5-27 cleared, restores the normal character and goes to edit mode 180, event 500.

520dd220de426dba.name: show_flotsam_image
520dd220de426dba.doc: Shows the fourth story image: Griffon's henchman Flotsam threatened Mayor Need into searching for the stone.

521942833e4cfe99.name: play_water_gem_pickup_scene
521942833e4cfe99.doc: Sets flag 632. Max or Monica picks up the Water Gem (item 366) from the Rapis point after the boss is beaten, with a gasp and the item-get message, then control returns at the Rapis point.

52222c1825e2b8ec.name: play_miracle_dish_request_scene
52222c1825e2b8ec.doc: Cutscene (sets flag 320): Max and Monica ask Lao Chao to cook his miracle dish for their sick friend. He needs a White Windflower, said to be extinct, so they head off to find one.

5227b4da6a8a55ad.name: play_rainbow_butterfly_ambush_scene
5227b4da6a8a55ad.doc: Event 257. Max and Monica land on a high platform and look around, point at the sky, and see the Rainbow Butterfly swoop down at them. Sets flag 257, plays the boss music and shows the telop line.

522eb8538b9807f5.name: play_story_700_palace_intro
522eb8538b9807f5.doc: Story event 700: plays the palace intro and jumps to map g05 (Moon Flower Palace) without reloading the BGM.

523668b7ebf99c4b.name: play_paznos_awakens_scene
523668b7ebf99c4b.doc: Sets flag 640 and plays the first part of event 640: a lapis beam hits and Paznos appears, to the party's delight.

5244071bbeb7365d.name: start_invention_lesson
5244071bbeb7365d.doc: Cedric agrees to let Max do the job and begins to explain that inventing means combining ideas, then the camera fades out.

52453c20afa57614.name: use_item_on_star_door
52453c20afa57614.doc: Interaction with the star door (local flag 4). When the right item is used it hides the star map pieces and plays a short scene showing the key star model growing, otherwise shows a hint or a miss reaction.

528de4197084c408.name: pick_up_purple_paint
528de4197084c408.doc: Once only (flag 37): gives 20 Purple Paint and hides the paint pickup map part.

529a3325a92d4110.name: open_chest_and_record_special_items
529a3325a92d4110.doc: Opens the treasure chest with the shared routine and sets bit 1 or 2 of counter 17 when it held item 207 or 198 respectively.

52af842fe8803595.name: play_boss_intro_from_debug
52af842fe8803595.doc: Debug entry that plays the boss intro scene.

52b6c3bd39d109bc.name: show_chapter_8_villager_line
52b6c3bd39d109bc.doc: Shows the chapter 8 idle line of the party member whose NPC id is party_chara in the given message window. Used by the party member menu instead of the normal message number.

52bdadabc569282e.name: play_voiced_message_with_sound
52bdadabc569282e.doc: Loads and plays the voice stream for the message, shows the text, lip syncs through it and closes the window and stream.

52c422b322ae2e3f.name: frame_talk_camera
52c422b322ae2e3f.doc: Frames a close-up of listener: turns speaker to face listener and deactivates speaker, turns the listener toward speaker over 10 frames when it faces more than 0.4 radian away, and puts the camera 35 units in front of the listener aimed at its head. Waits 4 frames at the end.

52d2586032ad9026.name: warp_to_s64_event_500
52d2586032ad9026.doc: Clears the scene, hides the party members and status bar and starts event 500 on map s64.

52d747d46ba7628e.name: play_vacuum_repair_scene
52d747d46ba7628e.doc: Scene where Max starts repairing the Anbar Type 2 vacuum with a hose attachment and finds the problem, with the screen fading out. Skippable.

52dfe647cd1b7bcb.name: walk_party_to_house_door
52dfe647cd1b7bcb.doc: Walks Max and Monica to the house door over 45 frames.

52e3c78384d64397.name: leave_to_luna_lab_center
52e3c78384d64397.doc: Turns and fades, sets counter 2 to 0 and returns to map f03.

52e3e6985a21ad2f.name: ask_for_circus_ticket
52e3e6985a21ad2f.doc: Runs the ticket check at the circus gate.

52f11c7567dbacf6.name: talk_parn_after_joining
52f11c7567dbacf6.doc: Parn's chatter after the gold paint quest is cleared, about his new power. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about the depth of painting.

52f6dc7dc0044def.name: start_d06b01_event_151_with_loadout
52f6dc7dc0044def.doc: Debug warp: applies the same stats and gear as apply_debug_loadout (240 max HP, 94 defence, 20 Premium Chicken, Grade Zero, Steal Gun, Atlamillia Sword, Goddess Brassard) and starts event 151 on map d06b01.

5315fab42b0429c9.name: handle_energy_pack_request
5315fab42b0429c9.doc: Handles the Energy Pack request. Depending on flags and what the player has, it plays the delivery, the materials reminder, the payment of 400 Gilda or the first request scene.

534a62ca06047614.name: play_e352_leave_lin_scene
534a62ca06047614.doc: Plays the scene where Lin is left waiting while Monica and Max go on.

5358206a4a08c611.name: go_to_next_train_car
5358206a4a08c611.doc: Event 203. Moves to the next car by increasing counter 0, or shakes the player's head at the last car (counter 3).

535f72e33c4ee211.name: play_shot_flotsam_orders_elephant_attack
535f72e33c4ee211.doc: Scene shot: Flotsam laughs, points and orders his elephant to tear them to pieces, while the elephant trumpets and a title sprite fades in.

537041023f11a6ca.name: open_cobweb_door_quick
537041023f11a6ca.doc: Opens a cobweb door at once: the camera turns to the door, the cobweb nest model plays its vanish motion with a sound, then the door pieces are hidden, the key function point is disabled and the minimap door opens.

53866282ece2b9e3.name: leave_station_map
53866282ece2b9e3.doc: Event 200: after the exit confirmation, jumps to map s68 (event 550) when flag 700 is clear, otherwise to map g05.

53899cfbe4f7e481.name: ask_give_white_windflower
53899cfbe4f7e481.doc: Shows a hint box suggesting giving Lao Chao a White Windflower for his miracle dish and asks with a button prompt. Returns 1 if the player picked the menu button, else 0.

539df43a4946ca39.name: open_floor_select_menu
539df43a4946ca39.doc: Entry from the town: plays BGM 19, opens the dungeon map menu and starts the chosen floor.

53a006b9ec37146e.name: start_monster_room
53a006b9ec37146e.doc: Starts the room: with chests not both opened, places five 183 monsters and plays the title card once (counter 20 bit 2), then places the player at the entrance.

53a9f5dda439c833.name: play_shot_crew_runs
53a9f5dda439c833.doc: Cutscene shot of three crew members (characters 33 to 35) running to their spots and standing while the screen fades to black. sound_id is unused.

53b15dd305c1b6de.name: ask_to_leave_lapis_room
53b15dd305c1b6de.doc: Exit trigger. Non-player characters get a message. Without the Wind Gem the player is told the Lapis has not been obtained, otherwise a question offers to leave for dungeon d03.

53b2d1329032293b.name: resume_floor_after_event
53b2d1329032293b.doc: Event 500: fades out, clears monsters, unlocks map movement, hides map piece s18_02-a0, restores the floor music, places the player and fades in with the reverse-floor NPC enabled.

53b6fe0ae24b400c.name: spawn_chests_and_mark_floor_clear
53b6fe0ae24b400c.doc: After the monsters die, spawns the unclaimed Healing Coin (207) and Sun Stone (198) chests, restores the calm music and marks the floor cleared.

53b7c29a70a17b0f.name: play_retry_departure_shot
53b7c29a70a17b0f.doc: Fades in on Max and Steve and plays the workshop door sound before the retry departure.

53eaa8efdf9b4c8b.name: load_firbit_return_actors
53eaa8efdf9b4c8b.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Conda, Noam, Rococo, Zak, Wicky, Tobo and Mogri for event 250 and its message file. Stores the party slots in chara_slot_a and chara_slot_b.

5405c0252ec0190b.name: finish_shot
5405c0252ec0190b.doc: Ends a Spheda shot: removes shot effects and models, restores the player's stand motion, camera and status bar, and crossfades unless result is 1. When result is 0 and no strokes are left it shows a message, fades out and returns 2; otherwise it returns result.

540b593c6b665de6.name: talk_olivie_early
540b593c6b665de6.doc: Olivie's talk before the first quest is cleared or before the tournament flag is set: the Firbit people only grant favours to those more skilled than themselves.

540cc61cb94df3ad.name: run_party_member_menu
540cc61cb94df3ad.doc: Menu for talking to a party NPC on the train. Positions the camera and player, then offers asking them to join, talking, and repairs or a shop for some members. Returns 1 when the NPC is already the party member or the player left to the party menu.

54151d894c52bc96.name: enter_edit_mode_187
54151d894c52bc96.doc: Runs play_griffon_sends_heroes_outside_scene, unlocks map moves and enters Georama edit mode 187.

54168b32f7d2d973.name: play_map_start_arrival
54168b32f7d2d973.doc: Map start: after loading a save places the player at the start. Otherwise picks the arrival from the previous map: walk-in from a dungeon, a fade-in from map 26, the Balance Valley arrival scene when flag 300 is set and 302 is not, or the plain walk-in. Then shows the chapter notice.

54314400404e383f.name: play_star_of_oblivion_scene
54314400404e383f.doc: Event 612, sets flag 612: Griffon is defeated but takes the Atlamillia and explains the legend of the stones and the Star of Oblivion, that he plans to erase the world and himself with it.

543d5f4180144267.name: play_boss_title_intro_scene
543d5f4180144267.doc: Calls play_monster_e117e_intro_scene, the boss intro scene.

54462bdff95dadb6.name: play_event_317
54462bdff95dadb6.doc: Event 317 (Spheda demo): sets the Spheda unlocked flag. Max or Monica and a partner help Mrs. Condor, who gives them the White Windflower growing on her head and then the item passed in, each with the item get jingle and message. Skippable; opens the item limit menu afterwards.

544dcea9a573c512.name: setup_map_objects
544dcea9a573c512.doc: Map setup for the third town: hides one map part (p10_f0401) once analysis flag 410 is set, then refreshes NPC activity.

546c8b1890522561.name: swing_chest_open
