546c8b1890522561.doc: Swings the chest lid open over 11 frames, leaving the final angle in lid_angle[0].

5470cd801a4fe9c6.name: play_shot_cheer
5470cd801a4fe9c6.doc: Voiced shot where Cedric cheers and tells the player to open the Make menu and select the Energy Pack Invention Card. sound_id picks the sound bank.

54725166dec5afe7.name: play_palace_aside_then_go_to_station
54725166dec5afe7.doc: Plays the palace thrown aside scene and jumps to s11 (Kazarov Stonehenge station) at entry 510.

547c771ff73599a4.name: reset_player_motion
547c771ff73599a4.doc: Resets the player's character (slot 0) to its default motion.

5495be906670b979.name: play_eina_farewell_scene
5495be906670b979.doc: Event 540: Eina asks Max about his father and he asks her to come back to their time. She says she must stay in this time, as no one can exist in two times, and Max angrily tells her she shouldn't have come.

54aa863364792d48.name: make_partner_hint_message
54aa863364792d48.doc: Shows the partner's hint line in window 3 for the current point in the story. It checks story flags from the latest (final boss, Griffon's palace, Lapis stones, Gundor volcano and so on) back to the earliest and shows the first that matches, with a generic nudge to explore otherwise. Returns 0.

54b7e98f62887e38.name: start_linda_boss_fight
54b7e98f62887e38.doc: Plays boss music 190, shows the floor objects and places monster 601 in the arena with Max.

54c8e5308432012d.name: setup_s42_start
54c8e5308432012d.doc: Sets up the s42 map (Star Breaker model, item markers), stops the time of day and places the player at the start.

54d6d933d7e78683.name: remove_world_explained_actors
54d6d933d7e78683.doc: Shows Max and removes the scene characters, hides the story sprites and deletes both images.

54e42308f05e33ce.name: wait_stream_standby
54e42308f05e33ce.doc: Waits until the stream is idle, prepares the stream, then waits until it is idle again.

54e93d0e6edb0fcf.name: talk_gerald_after_joining
54e93d0e6edb0fcf.doc: Gerald's chatter after the gun quest is cleared, warning that guns are not toys. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about rebuilding the world.

551397922528451f.name: play_crest_lin_sage_scene
551397922528451f.doc: Only calls play_event_372, the scene where Madame Crest greets Max and Monica and Lin reveals she became a sage.

5530e39b0745bf21.name: start_gaspard_marionette_story
5530e39b0745bf21.doc: Sets flag 438, resets the village and plays the marionette scene.

553eb241928a530a.name: talk_to_woman_who_needs_town_hall
553eb241928a530a.doc: Moves the camera behind the player and talks to a woman who had business at City Hall but it is closed.

5547b9c624e42c8a.name: play_eina_bedtime_story_scene
5547b9c624e42c8a.doc: Sets flag 406. At night Eina finishes a story about Tak the sea turtle and answers young Max's questions about the sea, promising to take him there when he is older.

5551ce39ea01e283.name: talk_gerald_early
5551ce39ea01e283.doc: Gerald's talk before the first quest is cleared: he tells Max it is time to learn about mining.

555553fa3a3816f7.name: spawn_station_npc
555553fa3a3816f7.doc: Places a train station NPC after the Heim Rada arrival has been seen: Cedric normally, a different man during chapters 6 and 7. Returns 0 early when the arrival has not been seen.

5556c91ab8a4c740.name: use_gate_to_next_floor
5556c91ab8a4c740.doc: Gate interaction. If locked it asks to use the Key Handle (item 337) and opens the gate with it. If open it asks whether to go on, then clears the floor, shows medal messages, moves to the next floor and for floors 1 and 5 first plays the Dining Room or Mayor's Office events.

558fa0d69d92ee29.name: ask_exit_then_enter_dungeon_map
558fa0d69d92ee29.doc: Exit trigger (program 210): asks whether to leave toward the dungeon and, if the player agrees, opens the dungeon map and enters it.

55ab1366bc55a896.name: press_panel_row0_col6
55ab1366bc55a896.doc: Presses the puzzle switch for the panel at row 0, column 6, toggling it and its neighbours.

55c2d1cd69e99eaa.name: setup_station_then_ready_scene
55c2d1cd69e99eaa.doc: Sets up the station objects and plays the ready to depart scene.

55c50a8c6634e913.name: talk_to_boy_who_missed_circus
55c50a8c6634e913.doc: A boy wishes he could have seen the circus.

55d15837e6ea78fb.name: talk_to_pau_in_cave
55d15837e6ea78fb.doc: Talk handler that runs Pau's dialogue when Pau is addressed.

55e94b9b570d3c0d.name: get_launch_velocity
55e94b9b570d3c0d.doc: Returns the initial velocity needed to move from start to finish_value in the given frames under the given gravity.

55eb05bf589350b1.name: ask_to_pass_door
55eb05bf589350b1.doc: If the player is in a Ridepod form shows a refusal bubble (message 20 or 21) and returns 0. Otherwise asks the yes/no question 124; on yes fades out and returns 1.

55ecde828217a666.name: enter_next_floor_of_d05
55ecde828217a666.doc: If the player agrees at the second entrance, moves to the next floor and loads dungeon d05.

561066040bf90d13.name: play_monster_intro_e219e
561066040bf90d13.doc: Monster introduction cutscene: Max and Monica stand while monster e219e drops in and attacks, with the caption e728telop03 fading in. Skippable; restores the player afterwards.

5615d5455f202c5c.name: place_sleeping_osmond
5615d5455f202c5c.doc: Until flag 408 is set, replaces the Osmond villager in slot 301 with his sleeping model lying at his desk.

561b18a8fab9d2df.name: talk_milane_to_max
561b18a8fab9d2df.doc: Milane's talk when Max is the active character: he mentions the circus. Chapter 8 swaps in a question about tough guys in the mine.

561e16b777e9f45c.name: ask_to_enter_edit_mode
561e16b777e9f45c.doc: If the active character is 2 or 3 shows a message that they cannot. Otherwise asks a question; yes opens edit mode 16, no walks the player to a spot and pans the camera with it.

5636860b40e7f0cd.name: start_lighthouse_arrival_scene
5636860b40e7f0cd.doc: Story 348: plays the lighthouse arrival scene.

563c1e104fcc9cef.name: play_ladder_climb_from_event
563c1e104fcc9cef.doc: Plays the ladder climb test scene.

5645ab97edc6b38c.name: show_monster_caption_scene
5645ab97edc6b38c.doc: Briefly shows two e212d monsters with a caption image over the floor, fading in and out, then returns control. Skippable.

564a901a17598fe7.name: talk_mina_after_joining
564a901a17598fe7.doc: Mina's chatter after the Spheda quest is cleared, asking not to be taken to insect places. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about the Blackstone Railroad.

56538c3ffc6a25db.name: place_star_item_in_socket
56538c3ffc6a25db.doc: Place the star item into the star socket. Needs flag 616, otherwise a message says it cannot be used yet. Asks first, then opens the item menu; using item 362 sets local flag 4, hides the socket map pieces and shows a growing star key model with a sound. Cancelling ends the event and the wrong item plays a refuse motion.

5659b449a3b42499.name: place_gem_on_altar
5659b449a3b42499.doc: Handles one gem altar. Earth (365), Wind (367), Water (366) and Fire (368) gems each set a bit in counter 16 when used on their altar. Once all four are placed it fades out and jumps to s66.

5662c20ea25d39a2.name: talk_to_cedric_by_flags
5662c20ea25d39a2.doc: Talk handler for Cedric by story flags. Flag 7 offers Steve's refuelling and core upgrade (repairs everything, or opens shop 23); other branches start events in i01h01b and i01h01c, remind Max to buy 20 scrap iron, 2 copper lumps and thick leather from the pumpkin-sign shop, or tell him to try on his own first. Returns 0, or -1 when Max is told not to skip his job.

56b30144117f964c.name: setup_s31_station
56b30144117f964c.doc: Event 500: shows the late station parts, runs play_arrival_ten_thousand_years_ago_scene and loads Osmond.

56d6ef31f0fb053d.name: load_d01b01_floor
56d6ef31f0fb053d.doc: Fades out, selects Max and loads the d01b01 boss floor with its script 500.

56e8a154b075a18f.name: load_d06e01_start_event
56e8a154b075a18f.doc: Loads dungeon map d06e01 with its event script 500.

56f8eacf4e1b0e99.name: load_gaspard_confrontation_actors
56f8eacf4e1b0e99.doc: Loads the models, motions and message file for the Gaspard confrontation scene: Max, Monica, Lin, Crest, Gaspard, Jaming, the warp and fire effect models and the battleship map parts.

57092e73bba361ee.name: ask_move_to_main_street
57092e73bba361ee.doc: Asks whether to move to the main street. On yes the player runs out, fades and 1 is returned, otherwise walks back and 0 is returned.

5711ebc4811d639f.name: play_moon_of_destruction_mural_scene
5711ebc4811d639f.doc: Sets flag 408. Max and Monica find murals called Moon of Destruction. Monica thinks the ancient people were trying to tell them something. Shingala appears with a device on his head and attacks, Pau runs in, and the party flees. Skippable.

5726351be59475bd.name: play_shingala_death_scene
5726351be59475bd.doc: Plays Shingala's death motion and puts the camera and player back.

573506034123a1d6.name: play_give_cover_then_go_to_palace
573506034123a1d6.doc: Plays the give cover scene and jumps to map s70 entry 532.

573d5857892d9ed7.name: get_item_get_scale
573d5857892d9ed7.doc: Writes into out_scale[0] the scale that fits the item model chara into a size of 6, halved for item types 0, 2 and 4, used for the item-get pop-up.

578323a203db0024.name: load_crest_farewell_actors
578323a203db0024.doc: Loads the models, effects and message file for the Crest farewell scene: Max, Monica, Crest, Lin, Gaspard, Jaming, smoke and the warp effect.

57a75d176a99dbb3.name: use_exit_gate_1
57a75d176a99dbb3.doc: Handles exit gate 1 of the floor.

57ab707e6f29ecc8.name: play_crest_star_run_scene
57ab707e6f29ecc8.doc: Alternate event 372 ending: the party runs and turns back, Monica says Crest became a star watching over Lin, then runs off along a path while the screen fades.

57c28dfab17e12e8.name: talk_to_soldier_or_villager
57c28dfab17e12e8.doc: Talking handler. Galen Agaris (character 400), when flag 536 is set and 540 is not, asks if the player is ready for the counterattack and starts the Paznos launch on yes; everyone else gives normal villager talk.

57ec01c577795bfc.name: talk_fabio_early
57ec01c577795bfc.doc: Fabio's talk before the first quest is cleared: fishing is his hobby and he dreams of catching a Mardan Karayan.

5828ccfea1cc0865.name: show_fishing_tournament_records
5828ccfea1cc0865.doc: Shows the fishing tournament top-ten record table in message window 1. Returns 1.

5836da750a6f97c3.name: play_floor_arrival_scene
5836da750a6f97c3.doc: Arrival cutscene of a floor: the character walks in from the entrance (with the dungeon map piece moving in when show_map is set) and the door pieces animate, followed by messages about any Red, Blue or White Seal on the floor.

583c553eef7746c7.name: replay_shingala_healed_scene
583c553eef7746c7.doc: Story jump: sets flags 408 and 420, plays event 438 and goes to map s40.

5851bcf5a185509b.name: setup_map_charas
5851bcf5a185509b.doc: Places the sleeping Osmond in the lab as the map's character setup.

5872bdd83b209837.name: wait_for_button_in_debug_camera
5872bdd83b209837.doc: Debug entry: sets a camera view, waits for button 32 and ends.

5882b6f19b07941c.name: use_door_side_1
5882b6f19b07941c.doc: Faces the door and, if it is open, fades out and jumps to the station map with counter 15 set to 1. Otherwise plays a refusal.

5895d618bfd9324e.name: load_event_254_charas
5895d618bfd9324e.doc: Loads the actors for event 254b: Max and Monica go in left and right speaker slots swapped according to which is active, and handles 2 and 3 are bound and hidden.

58a5a805b5bad67f.name: jump_to_event_275
58a5a805b5bad67f.doc: Sets the Georama analyze flags and story flags 270 to 285 so that only event 275 is still pending (its flag cleared to 0), then jumps to map 25 and waits. Debug-style entry for that story point.

58a9dec066ab62e6.name: show_help_with_hint
58a9dec066ab62e6.doc: Pauses the dungeon and shows a four-part help message about the room mechanic, ending with a pointer to the Help entry in the main menu.

58bb49c12e68f31c.name: ask_to_leave_by_gate
58bb49c12e68f31c.doc: Gate: asks whether to leave, unless a non-hero character is active, and returns to dungeon d07 after clearing monsters.

58be50be3b96d11f.name: play_paznos_ascent_scene
58be50be3b96d11f.doc: Skippable scene of Paznos and its two jets rising 9000 units into the sky with a shaking camera. Sets flag 540.

58c4bfcec8bf85eb.name: play_lin_remembers_lighthouse_scene
58c4bfcec8bf85eb.doc: Event 340: Lin remembers everything and says Crest must be saved at the lighthouse. Max and Monica agree to go.

58e6930c3f1f829f.name: play_workshop_tour_intro_scene
58e6930c3f1f829f.doc: Skippable scene on the first floor where the party reaches the Great Workshop and its name and the rebel stronghold Paznos are explained, ending with them heading to the second floor. Sets flag 548.

58f87caf9c7f0860.name: refuse_without_club
58f87caf9c7f0860.doc: Golf check that returns 1 when play is refused and 0 when it may go on. It refuses with a message when the active character is not Max, or when Max's equipped weapon is not one of the club items 9 to 14. Otherwise it registers the club for the Sphida course and returns 0.

59074e6b337ed0b1.name: take_gate_exit_2
59074e6b337ed0b1.doc: Gate 2 handler: interacts with the third exit.

5941f4ce8e259ed3.name: play_duck_scene_hiding_villager
5941f4ce8e259ed3.doc: Hides Dr. Dell, plays event 305 (Max with a duck and flowers) and shows him again.

5958453376f5effd.name: leave_for_g02
5958453376f5effd.doc: Fades out to white and jumps to map g02.

597e8dd95dafa2f9.name: talk_rufio_after_joining
597e8dd95dafa2f9.doc: Rufio's chatter after the moon photo quest is cleared, thanking the player. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about the Blackstone Railroad.

598ad3faf5e4bac7.name: play_gaspard_defeat_scene_and_leave
598ad3faf5e4bac7.doc: After the first fight, clears monsters, adds Monica and the fourth party member, plays the backstory scene and loads map s49 at program 500.

59952f68e5801a11.name: play_floor_entry_scene
59952f68e5801a11.doc: Entrance scene shown when a floor loads. The map piece rises and Max runs in to his start position. With use_dungeon_map set it fades in the dungeon map from the previous floor, otherwise the dungeon logo.

5996f206681c12e6.name: start_treasure_room
5996f206681c12e6.doc: Map start of the room. If the two Diamond chests are not both taken it plays the intro once (bit 8 of counter 20) and places the monster pack. Then places the player and fades in.

599e94cae2612e17.name: shake_camera_briefly
599e94cae2612e17.doc: Clears the camera sequence and shakes the camera for 16 frames.

59a9ba9d465866ee.name: talk_gerald_monica
59a9ba9d465866ee.doc: Gerald's talk when Monica speaks to him: in chapter 8 a line about helping rebuild the world, otherwise a welcome to Max's friend. Then the normal NPC talk.

59bbf2811f521321.name: play_ambush_scene_then_start_fight
59bbf2811f521321.doc: Plays the ambush scene then sets up the butterfly fight and fades in at the starting position.

59d2988145bd1fbc.name: play_floor_clear_scene
59d2988145bd1fbc.doc: Plays the victory scene for the current character (Max, Monica or another form), then restores the camera and shows the hint that the gate is the yellow point on the map and needs the gate key.

59daaeaef4bf67f4.name: play_shot_backpack_drop
59daaeaef4bf67f4.doc: Shot in Cedric's house: Max walks in carrying the backpack, announces he finished the invention, Cedric cheers and asks whether he understands the Invention process, tells him to find his own building blocks, and suggests finishing with Steve.

59dd40fd1167ec2a.name: reset_camera_behind_player
59dd40fd1167ec2a.doc: Resets the camera behind the player.

59e1817a629c0a23.name: start_swamp_story
59e1817a629c0a23.doc: Event 501: plays the villagers trouble scene, sets the story counter to 1 and enables the first story points.

59ee8d38d09fae42.name: offer_to_make_energy_pack
59ee8d38d09fae42.doc: Cedric says the Energy Pack is the problem to finish for Steve (the Ridepod), and Max offers to invent it.

5a0033fdb05366b0.name: talk_party_erik
5a0033fdb05366b0.doc: Talk with the demolitions party NPC on the train. When he is the current party member, shows his chatter plus chapter-specific remarks until the related events are seen; otherwise opens the party NPC talk.

5a0145fd9a961ba1.name: move_to_paznos_bridge_from_pad_3
5a0145fd9a961ba1.doc: Sets counter 13 to 3 and asks to move to Paznos Bridge.

5a156954d0882812.name: preview_night_talk_scene
5a156954d0882812.doc: Debug scene: at 22:00 the villagers are removed and the player walks to another character who is talking, with the camera rising along a path.

5a1cf910928bdff2.name: play_gate_future_jump_scene
5a1cf910928bdff2.doc: Time gate warp cutscene: the red or blue gate rings appear around Max (and Monica if she is in the party), Atlamillia glows, the screen goes white and a caption says they jumped to the future. a0 to a3 set the world origin, a4 picks the red gate, a5 says Monica is present.

5a235c0a9498c538.name: talk_milane_early
5a235c0a9498c538.doc: Milane's talk before the first quest is cleared: his shop specializes in blades and he has only a few guns.

5a2c49080911e295.name: load_party_and_play_condor_thanks_scene
5a2c49080911e295.doc: Story trigger for event 317: loads Monica and her equipment and plays the condor thanks scene.

5a2d057904c9334b.name: talk_to_jurak
5a2d057904c9334b.doc: Talking to Jurak: his hint depends on story progress, from needing time to remember, to planting the seed and finding a Sundrop, to asking Crest at Balance Valley, and a warning before the Griffon fight.

5a34a90796f0b95c.name: leave_firbit_house
5a34a90796f0b95c.doc: Exits to g01. If flag 250 is unset it jumps to the map start, otherwise it goes outside normally.

5a39594369080624.name: talk_adel_early
5a39594369080624.doc: Adel's talk before the first quest is cleared: she is working as a maid but dreams of being a tailor.

5a4c0503589efb8a.name: use_third_floor_gate
5a4c0503589efb8a.doc: Uses the third exit of the floor.

5a5b727ec0b54fd5.name: play_metal_flotsam_intro_on_story
5a5b727ec0b54fd5.doc: Story trigger for event 808: sets up the room sound and plays the intro scene.

5a5edd59135211a6.name: play_eina_final_chapter_briefing_scene
5a5edd59135211a6.doc: Event 648. Osmond and the heroes board the Ixion, and Eina tells them Griffon's palace is back on the ground and this is the last chance to repair history. Sets flag 648.

5a6e5d07b3ec8439.name: go_to_balance_valley_station_if_confirmed
5a6e5d07b3ec8439.doc: If the player agrees, jumps to map s04 (Balance Valley Station).

5a725fce6ce1c7ab.name: play_circus_opening_scene
5a725fce6ce1c7ab.doc: Plays both parts of the opening and then loads script i03h02_2.stb at entry 151.

5a77dab6f050d3f1.name: show_hint_window_40
5a77dab6f050d3f1.doc: Opens the plain hint window with message 40.

5a8acd8e734ae466.name: start_georama_with_starter_items
5a8acd8e734ae466.doc: Fades out, clears monsters, resets Monica's equipment, makes Max the active character and party member, gives items 353, 311, 268 (5), 294 (3), 298 (3), 425 (3) and 275 (2), sets flag 54 and enters edit mode 19 with event 151.

5aa6c3f2cd2d43e1.name: play_voice_only
5aa6c3f2cd2d43e1.doc: Plays a voiced line with no message window: opens and prepares stream 1 for voice, plays it for frames frames of voice timing and closes it.

5aa902c1196e83b4.name: play_palace_returned_scene
5aa902c1196e83b4.doc: Event 616 cutscene (flag 616): Osmond runs in to Max and Monica saying something terrible has happened and the Moonflower Palace has somehow returned to the present; the pair wonder what Griffon is planning. Skippable.

5aacfdb8368180e9.name: play_event_108_elephant_falls
5aacfdb8368180e9.doc: Cutscene shot for event 108: the elephant is placed at 1.3 times size, the screen fades in and it plays its death animation. snd_id supplies the sound. Returns 0.

5abe7b74d9683094.name: face_and_talk_npc
5abe7b74d9683094.doc: Turns the player to face the NPC and shows the NPC's talk message window.

5aceaf44fee682c8.name: show_pending_event_hint
5aceaf44fee682c8.doc: Shows the town progress hint message. Passes only_pending to the hint display.

5ad6a7f2c4269c6b.name: load_train_car_npcs
5ad6a7f2c4269c6b.doc: Loads the NPCs standing in the current train car: for each NPC 1 to 25 that is in the story (status not 0, hidden bit not set) and assigned to this car, loads its train model into the next slot, places it, records its id and shows or hides it. Adds NPC 34 at a fixed spot in car 3 once the item board is expanded.

5ae17c77c3d4e0bf.name: play_village_arrival_with_item_scene
5ae17c77c3d4e0bf.doc: Sets flag 432. Max and Monica arrive at Shigura Village, say they made it and wonder which Shigura to talk to; Monica suggests trying them all one by one. Skippable. Played when the player holds item 373.

5aedf6242b6882ea.name: walk_in_from_entrance
5aedf6242b6882ea.doc: The player walks into the map from its entrance while the screen fades in.

5af6a79828a31fe9.name: talk_ferdinand_early
5af6a79828a31fe9.doc: Ferdinand's early talk: asks Max how his inventions are going and compares it to his cooking, then the normal NPC talk.

5afd6b183145458a.name: replay_hide_and_seek_scene
5afd6b183145458a.doc: Story 744 handler: plays the hide and seek scene.

5b0206d5e1a49e9e.name: use_star_key_on_door
5b0206d5e1a49e9e.doc: Only calls place_star_item_in_socket, which asks about using the star key item on the star door.

5b180e71beb0ee21.name: start_room_music
5b180e71beb0ee21.doc: Loads the sound set and starts BGM 190, or BGM 193 when bits 256 and 512 of counter 17 are both set (both treasure boxes already taken).

5b197dbb390903d9.name: load_defeat_scene_actors
5b197dbb390903d9.doc: Loads the actors for the e728 scene: Max and Monica with their e728 motions and equipment, the boss model and a particle model. Switches the player to Max or Monica if a transformed form is active, and stores the character slots in defeat_scene_max_slot and defeat_scene_monica_slot.

5b39f663f74042b7.name: talk_adel_after_joining
5b39f663f74042b7.doc: Adel's chatter after the clothing quest is cleared, asking how the garment fits. Chapter 8 swaps in a prayer for safety.

5b5b1155efe300bc.name: start_tournament_announcement
5b5b1155efe300bc.doc: Story event 344, plays the tournament announcement.

5b5b4f33d31dda99.name: load_farewell_scene_actors
5b5b4f33d31dda99.doc: Loads the actors for event 736: Max, Monica, Elena, two villagers, the Chrono Union models and the vanishing lights. Stores party slots in main_chara_slot and partner_chara_slot.

5b609bbe0ed212a9.name: play_event_600_then_s37
5b609bbe0ed212a9.doc: Plays event 600 and jumps to map s37 at entry 510 without reloading the BGM. Returns 0.

5b64462d32a79adc.name: talk_to_waiting_npc
5b64462d32a79adc.doc: If the talked-to character is in slot 8, runs the waiting NPC talk.

5b7e15ad980c9689.name: talk_stewart_after_joining
5b7e15ad980c9689.doc: Stewart's chatter after the book auction quest is cleared, about the book he got. Chapter 8 swaps in a warning about Zelmite Mine.

5b7fe003b48f816d.name: play_first_sight_of_sea_story
5b7fe003b48f816d.doc: Sets up the map objects and plays event 402.

5b9ba680b556a3ec.name: hide_memo_if_owned
5b9ba680b556a3ec.doc: Starts an event and, if the player already owns the Notebook (item 386), disables the pickup point and hides the memo on the map.

5ba54c337a5e34fe.name: play_time_gate_arrival_scene
5ba54c337a5e34fe.doc: Cutscene (event 612 part 2): the time gate appears high above and the party is carried through, then returns to the map.

5bd58c74b846e63c.name: play_grabbed_and_carried
5bd58c74b846e63c.doc: Cutscene in dungeon 3 where the player is lifted and carried off by a large monster holding Giant Meat, then fades out as the pair moves away. Uses the event part position as origin.

5bddbaa2cf80a888.name: play_lipsync_timed
5bddbaa2cf80a888.doc: Runs lip sync and the talk motion for a message window while stream 1 plays, switching mouth animation on when the stream is audible. Ends after frames frames, or when the stream stops if frames is -1, and closes the window at close_frame. Returns the frames elapsed.

5bf0580963c6a439.name: get_stick_vertical_direction
5bf0580963c6a439.doc: Returns -1 if the left stick is pushed up past half, 1 if pushed down past half, otherwise 0.

5c0673693e811452.name: return_to_d02b01_event_12551
5c0673693e811452.doc: Loads dungeon map d02b01 and runs its event script at entry 12551.

5c19806f86134d24.name: ask_return_to_previous_floor
5c19806f86134d24.doc: Asks whether to return to the previous floor. Returns 1 after a fade out if yes, 0 otherwise.

5c1f169d05ab651e.name: show_game_over_screen
5c1f169d05ab651e.doc: Custom game over sequence: pauses the dungeon, plays a sound, shows the game over image with the game over BGM, waits for a button press, then fades out and exits the dungeon (or revives the party when the retry flag is set).

5c219f92cefc72c6.name: setup_boss_floor_4
5c219f92cefc72c6.doc: Fades out over 20 frames, plays the boss intro play_monster_intro_e40e, disables the 4f marker, raises map parts p11_d06b02-6 and -7 by 200, places Uther (monster 606) and the player at their start positions and fades in.

5c26105c94f61d0b.name: load_event_250_actors
5c26105c94f61d0b.doc: Loads the village map part, the party and Conda, and the e250 message file.

5c3492a7502b34f8.name: debug_arrive_from_station
5c3492a7502b34f8.doc: Plays the arrival from the station gate.

5c4462ca84f97081.name: handle_item_overflow
5c4462ca84f97081.doc: Opens the item overflow menu (town or dungeon version by game mode) when the bag is over its limit, with an optional fade out and in around it when use_fade is 1.

5c4d5d4189746fe9.name: warn_area_is_dangerous
5c4d5d4189746fe9.doc: Steps the player back and shows a speech bubble saying it is dangerous beyond here and to take the train.

5c50f54ae1adadb9.name: show_cedric_walks_to_desk
5c50f54ae1adadb9.doc: Cedric walks across the room towards Need.

5c5cf68d0e0ffeee.name: play_griffon_look_outside_scene
5c5cf68d0e0ffeee.doc: Third part of event 612: the heroes realise what happened and Griffon tells them to go and look outside.

5c762746f5548ff3.name: start_s30_map
5c762746f5548ff3.doc: Map start: loads the map villagers, places the player, resets the camera behind him and fades in.

5c85cffd72e4d8b4.name: confirm_floor_exit
5c85cffd72e4d8b4.doc: Asks the player to confirm leaving the floor: question 1 for going to the next floor, question 2 otherwise. Yes fades out and returns 1, no ends the event and returns 0.

5c9f74261b38c9fe.name: play_flotsam_new_boss_scene
5c9f74261b38c9fe.doc: Event 808. Flotsam attacks in the air again. He says he now serves a boss worse than Griffon, and flies at the party. Sets flag 808.

5cb0f4e8904a0252.name: ask_to_go_next_floor
5cb0f4e8904a0252.doc: Asks a yes/no question about going on; on yes fades out and advances to the next floor. Monster forms only get a message.

5ccb440d45b8ea93.name: end_boss_to_edit_mode
5ccb440d45b8ea93.doc: Fades out, clears monsters, marks the floor cleared, plays the boss defeat scene, removes item 373 and goes to edit mode 2, event 520.

5ccda2eda91b5677.name: talk_ferdinand_after_joining
5ccda2eda91b5677.doc: Ferdinand's chatter after the chestnut quest is cleared, promising Max he will never refuse him. Chapter 8 swaps in his dream of being the best chef.

5cda6704c3bfb002.name: setup_clinic_entry
5cda6704c3bfb002.doc: Map start for the clinic. Plays event 304 when flag 300 is set and 304 is not; once 304 is done and Dr. Dell is the party NPC, plays event 306 (Lin's poison diagnosis) and has him join; plays event 328 when 324 is set and 328 is not. Otherwise places the player at the entrance. Returns 0.

5d3bd700387b7713.name: load_d03_if_exit_confirmed
5d3bd700387b7713.doc: Asks the exit path question and, when the player agrees, loads the d03 dungeon event script.

5d4281bffd3a778c.name: show_mysterious_moaning_message
5d4281bffd3a778c.doc: Fades in on a fixed camera, turns the player toward a spot and shows a moaning voice, a shorter moan once flag 306 is set.

5d59a7e6e69d455b.name: play_zelmite_request_scene
5d59a7e6e69d455b.doc: Sets flag 800 and plays the scene in which Need tells Max he will revitalize the area by extending the Blackstone Railroad, and asks him to find a Zelmite deposit in the Palm Mine in the park.

5d88611172c64d50.name: save_at_save_point
5d88611172c64d50.doc: Records which save point was used in counter 4 and opens the save menu.

5d8a20d65e9ab3da.name: show_party_swap_message
5d8a20d65e9ab3da.doc: Shows a system message naming the NPC, and the current party NPC if there is one. Returns 1.

5d92cb00e4c398f8.name: replay_backstory_then_warp_to_s49
5d92cb00e4c398f8.doc: Plays Gaspard's backstory scene and loads map s49 event 500.

5d9e7103c7706d34.name: test_farewell_scene
5d9e7103c7706d34.doc: Debug entry that plays the farewell scene.

5d9fe38e34b7321d.name: play_garek_time_bomb_scene
5d9fe38e34b7321d.doc: Skippable scene where Max and Monica meet Garek, the plant manager, learn that Heim Rada is being burned by the Fire Squall, and are given a Time Bomb to blow it up in the past.

5da91b9b22ee130d.name: reset_opening_town_state
5da91b9b22ee130d.doc: Runs the shared opening town state setup.

5db708696728a005.name: show_lift_robomb_hint
5db708696728a005.doc: Event program in the Halloween boss room that pauses monsters and the player and shows a hint box on lifting the RoBomb by holding the R1 button and pressing the circle button.

5db8f7f42c375c6a.name: play_metal_flotsam_defeat_scene
5db8f7f42c375c6a.doc: Event 812. The beaten Metal Flotsam protests, Max and Monica tease him, and he warns that his boss will deal with them before exploding. Sets flag 812.

5dce2842a4902ebd.name: play_story_201_walk_scene
5dce2842a4902ebd.doc: Sets flag 201. Max walks forward surprised along the road with BGM 111, the camera follows and orbits as the screen fades to white and back, then BGM 193 starts and the player takes control.

5dd7fafe274e29cd.name: show_medal_messages
5dd7fafe274e29cd.doc: Shows the medal award messages after a room challenge. Which messages play depends on whether the destroy challenge was cleared and the practice status, ending with the 2 medals message when both were earned.

5dd999c17b23f2ee.name: wait_message_skip
5dd999c17b23f2ee.doc: Waits until the player closes the message in the slot. Returns the frames waited.

5dda59a2e8313a17.name: setup_boss_floor_5
5dda59a2e8313a17.doc: Fades out over 20 frames, plays the boss intro play_monster_pair_intro_e117, disables the 5f marker, raises map parts p11_d06b02-8 and -9 by 200, places Gaja Ein and Gaja Zwei (monsters 607 and 608) and the player at their start positions and fades in.

5de7a533c836f8da.name: play_lipsync_for
5de7a533c836f8da.doc: Runs play_lipsync_timed for frames frames and leaves closing the window to the caller.

5de8d80f19e320d7.name: play_shot
5de8d80f19e320d7.doc: Plays one Spheda golf shot in the victory minigame: loads the golf motions, aims, runs the power gauge, then simulates the ball flight frame by frame with bounces and the wind-up trail until it is holed or lost. Offers a ball reset (yes/no) when it is lost with strokes left, handles the strokes-left check and cleans up through finish_shot. Returns 0 if cancelled.

5df6c9c14e863fea.name: press_panel_0_3
5df6c9c14e863fea.doc: Candle puzzle step for the church candle at row 0, column 3: cuts to a fixed camera, waits 45 frames, toggles that candle and its four neighbours (i01h07_13 pieces), then waits 45 frames.

5e59876345f9c63e.name: log_map_start
5e59876345f9c63e.doc: Runs the empty setup and prints a debug line for the e109a scene.

5e69c054e05ba99f.name: play_griffon_third_phase_scene
5e69c054e05ba99f.doc: Event 724 (sets flag 724). Griffon thuds down, trembles and then jolts up wreathed in his flame effect, facing the heroes; leads into the third phase of the boss fight.

5e6cf9ea57530622.name: weigh_fish_for_tournament
5e6cf9ea57530622.doc: Talk handler for the tournament judge. It explains the rules, lets the player choose a caught fish to weigh, shows the fish on a scale with its weight and name, and reports how many more can be weighed. It also offers the list of weighed fish and the final tally.

5e6df21f2680df55.name: talk_rufio_early
5e6df21f2680df55.doc: Rufio's talk before the first quest is cleared: he wonders why he misses the moon and whether he came from there.

5e70341352fb091d.name: play_osmond_explains_time_travel_scene
5e70341352fb091d.doc: Event 616. Osmond explains that the Ixion's time travel system can jump to any place in this time or the future, and Max and Monica take the star symbols to mark gem locations.

5e806dfd1e14ac3e.name: setup_rococo_scene_actors
5e806dfd1e14ac3e.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Rococo and two door parts as scene actors depending on which character the player controls, and loads the message file e208. Sets globals max_slot and monica_slot to the Max and Monica slots.

5e84e2290b3b9104.name: ask_for_circus_ticket
5e84e2290b3b9104.doc: Runs the ticket check at the circus gate.

5e927596c02c45c8.name: show_cedric_opens_door
5e927596c02c45c8.doc: Cedric opens the office door and the camera follows.

5e94309b1b85055d.name: play_event_104_and_enter_georama
5e94309b1b85055d.doc: Program 500: fades out, pauses monsters, plays event 104, sets save progress to 3 and enters Georama edit mode on map 10 as program 530.

5e989a89ac11c6d1.name: set_georama_stage_2_enter_map
5e989a89ac11c6d1.doc: Georama analysis flags for area 3: 0-6 on, 7-9 off. Sets flag 548 on, 552 off, 556 on and jumps to map 102.

5ea16e229637541c.name: play_scene_then_go_to_s30_620
5ea16e229637541c.doc: Plays play_paznos_beam_blocked_scene (sets flag 640) and jumps to map s30 at event 620.

5ecb19e62840174d.name: on_player_dead
5ecb19e62840174d.doc: Picks one of two voiced game over lines if the Dark Genie scene has started but it is not yet beaten, otherwise a silent game over.

5ecfd82a8fa6d46b.name: play_floor_exit
5ecfd82a8fa6d46b.doc: Floor exit sequence for the d05 dungeon. On normal floors the player lifts and throws a magma rock into the water, splashes, jumps onto the platform and rides up as the screen fades out. With special_floor set, the player hangs from a rope and is lowered while the screen fades.

5f059990c0aae673.name: ask_to_take_west_exit
5f059990c0aae673.doc: Asks whether to leave by the west path. On yes Max runs off along a path and the screen fades, returning 1; on no he walks a few steps and returns 0.

5f08b66ba4425c44.name: talk_erik_train_member
5f08b66ba4425c44.doc: Talk with Erik, the demolitions expert, at the train. When he is the current party member, shows his chatter plus chapter-specific remarks until the related events are seen; otherwise opens the party member menu for him.

5f63cab27a6dea6b.name: show_stone_image
5f63cab27a6dea6b.doc: Shows the third story image: Palm Brinks was spared because of a stone Griffon believed hidden in the town, the stone Max wears.

5f7395db8b529cd1.name: load_s05b_script
5f7395db8b529cd1.doc: Runs play_mardan_hooked_scene and loads event script s05/s05b_1.stb at entry 504.

5f7c9ac5251796dd.name: wait_for_button_press_event
5f7c9ac5251796dd.doc: Runs a minimal event that waits for pad button mask 32 to be pressed and then ends.

5f81f7a760406b58.name: ask_to_rematch_flotsam
5f81f7a760406b58.doc: Asks whether Max wants to fight Flotsam again. On the first choice it fades out and returns 1.

5f8481859946bf01.name: talk_rosa_early
5f8481859946bf01.doc: Rosa's talk before the first quest is cleared: she apologizes for being hard of hearing and asks to be spoken to slowly.

5fa0f8da71615d08.name: show_medal_messages
5fa0f8da71615d08.doc: Shows the medal messages after a room clear: a message when the destroy goal was cleared (destroy_cleared 1 or 2), a medal sound with a message, and a practice result message 2700 plus practice_index when practice_status is 2 or 3. When both the destroy goal and the practice are done it shows a two-medals line instead.

5fa4b0335373910c.name: spawn_rewards_after_fight
5fa4b0335373910c.doc: After the fight spawns a Diamond chest for each of counter 17 bits 256 and 512 not yet taken, starts BGM 193 and sets floor info flag 2.

5fac0c89fac3d6af.name: show_temporary_event_message
5fac0c89fac3d6af.doc: Places the player and shows a stand-in message that says this is a temporary event until map memory is free.

5fb08442d48bf830.name: play_lafrescia_seed_scene
5fb08442d48bf830.doc: Plays event 272: Max and Monica ask Master Jurak about the Rainbow Butterfly, who likes Lafrescia flowers, and he gives them a Lafrescia Seed and explains that they need Sundrops from a Himarra, with a hint message about Georama development.

5fda7df7aab30529.name: play_andrea_calms_sirus_scene
5fda7df7aab30529.doc: Event 728: Sirus grieves for Alexandra and wants the humans destroyed. Andrea answers that humans also carry something precious that must be passed on, and Sirus cannot accept it. Memory pictures are shown.

5fed1eaf23242bbf.name: talk_ferdinand_to_monica
5fed1eaf23242bbf.doc: Ferdinand's two-part talk to Monica about food, with a different single line in chapter 8. Uses the talk camera and returns Ferdinand to standing.

600344198c544877.name: warp_to_boss_floor_after_story_526
600344198c544877.doc: Story 526 program: warps to boss floor d05b01 and runs its story_526 program (15260 = 526*10+10000).

6007b2d840106009.name: ask_give_up_spheda_trial
6007b2d840106009.doc: Monica asks Max whether to give up. Returns 1 after a yes with a fade out, otherwise she wishes Max luck and it returns 0.

600c770b1f96f2e2.name: debug_play_crest_sage_dream_scene
600c770b1f96f2e2.doc: Debug entry that plays the Crest sage dream scene.

6018c340e6355c11.name: restore_player_and_remove_scene_charas
6018c340e6355c11.doc: Reactivates the player and deletes the scene character models.

602b15920d79aa18.name: return_to_s06
602b15920d79aa18.doc: Fades out and loads map s06 with its script 500.

6045048e23957501.name: play_shot_light_on
6045048e23957501.doc: Cutscene shot in Cedric's house: Max and Steve stand while a light on Steve is switched to light_status (on or off) with sounds.

60493e619803fffe.name: play_flee_scene_then_go_to_s11
60493e619803fffe.doc: Runs the flee scene (play_moonflower_beam_scene) and jumps to map s11 entrance 502.

60812c5ba52c6157.name: use_miracle_dumplings_on_lin
60812c5ba52c6157.doc: Check on Lin, who is in pain, and ask for the Miracle Dumplings item. If given, Lin wakes, the current partner NPC is set resident or joined and Lin joins the party.

6095990161e00b74.name: play_emperor_griffon_reveal_scene
6095990161e00b74.doc: Sets flag 608. Max and Monica enter the hall and meet the hooded figure, who reveals himself as Emperor Griffon, the ruler of darkness, and tells them to get down to it. Ends with BGM 36 and the player placed in the room.

609d155b780c27d1.name: show_event_255b_stub
609d155b780c27d1.doc: Placeholder for event 255b: sets the Lafrescia event 255 seen flag and shows a one-line debug message naming the event.

60a463d4b07fd56d.name: play_boss_defeat_scene
60a463d4b07fd56d.doc: Sets flag 728. The boss cries out as Max and Monica stand angry, the camera rises and a white fade ends the scene. The scene can be skipped, and it ends by calling remove_defeat_scene_actors to clean up.

60a5788745e6f567.name: start_dream_spiral_fight_4
60a5788745e6f567.doc: Applies the debug loadout and starts the fourth dream spiral boss event on map d06b02.

60a96311e7cc9aa1.name: play_event_102_end_then_go_to_g01i07
60a96311e7cc9aa1.doc: Plays the closing part of event 102 and jumps to map g01i07 at event 502.

60ba21708f740d42.name: play_station_opening_shot
60ba21708f740d42.doc: Wipes in on the station roof and pans the camera, then swaps the music for the departure theme. The sound id parameter is unused.

60c42bb6407ab77f.name: take_gate_exit_2
60c42bb6407ab77f.doc: Gate 2 handler: interacts with the third exit.

60d5358276a05f05.name: warp_to_s52_event_804
60d5358276a05f05.doc: Clears the scene and loads map s52 with the event script for event 804.

60f491a3af4f2f89.name: move_to_paznos_bridge_from_pad_4
60f491a3af4f2f89.doc: Sets counter 13 to 4 and asks to move to Paznos Bridge.

60fffcb41d39135c.name: play_run_in_from_town
60fffcb41d39135c.doc: Opening shot of the station arrival on this map: fades in on the player character running in from the town side, then stands and gives camera control back.

61100400aaebd344.name: setup_event_207_actors
61100400aaebd344.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Cedric (starbre), Vorneo and Tom plus the train map part as scene actors for event 207 and loads the e207 message file. Sets globals max_scene_slot and monica_scene_slot to the Max and Monica slots.

6112f2655db66267.name: start_m06b_event_155
6112f2655db66267.doc: Stops the BGM and ambient sound and loads the m06b event script at entry 155.

6148a7a8ce383920.name: start_g03_map
6148a7a8ce383920.doc: Map start program: places the player depending on whether the game was loaded from the memory card or on which map was left (running in from an exit, special arrival spots for maps 82 and 75), starts the first sea scene when flags 402 and 360 say it is due, otherwise the default start, and then shows the event hint.

615efa04455fbedd.name: play_voice_message_hold
615efa04455fbedd.doc: Plays a voiced line: opens the voice stream, shows the message with lip sync for the given frames, holds for hold_frames (scaled from 60 to 50 Hz) and closes the window. Restores the message prompt setting around the lip sync.

6182e094b130134d.name: warp_through_time_gate
6182e094b130134d.doc: Plays the red gate warp to the future at the fixed gate position, then jumps to the Gundorada Workshop (f04), or to the operations room s39 when event 560 can play.

61a1c5583e1c78d6.name: play_event_108_victory_pose
61a1c5583e1c78d6.doc: Shot after the elephant fight: Max (or Monica) and their partner strike a victory pose while the camera pulls in. Returns 0.

61ac1b256b753a0c.name: play_griffon_speech_mid_fight
61ac1b256b753a0c.doc: Fades out, pauses monsters, plays Griffon's speech scene, restores player and camera positions and resumes the fight.

61c1a625ede933c5.name: start_gaspard_boss_fight
61c1a625ede933c5.doc: Plays the confrontation and duel cutscenes, then sets up the battleship fight: saves the time of day, sets it to 18:00, makes Monica the active character, locks character switching and map moves, loads monsters 510, 513 and 602, places Gaspard and shows the boss bar.

61d066ab2ea324fc.name: enter_dungeon_4_if_confirmed
61d066ab2ea324fc.doc: After confirmation, opens the floor selection map for dungeon 4 and starts the chosen floor (or walks back if cancelled).

61f3666fadd08f86.name: play_e640_placeholder_event
61f3666fadd08f86.doc: Placeholder for event 640 (the Lapis are gathered and Chrono Union starts): sets flag 640 and shows a title text instead of the scene.

6214b372d12f6920.name: play_train_leaves_station
6214b372d12f6920.doc: Cutscene of the train pulling out of Sindain station with steam and smoke effects, the train driving off down the track. Cleans up the effects afterward.

621dad757ae3da1a.name: talk_corinne_after_joining
621dad757ae3da1a.doc: Corinne's chatter after the hide-and-seek quest is cleared, saying it is for little kids. Chapter 8 swaps in a line asking Max to tell her about his adventures.

622cc265df5a4f23.name: open_shop_from_talk
622cc265df5a4f23.doc: Opens shop number shop from a talk: fades out, opens the shop menu, closes the talk window when the menu closes and fades back in.

622ecb092c4602f2.name: play_meet_pau_and_shingala_scene
622ecb092c4602f2.doc: Sets flag 404 and plays event 404: the party finds Pau tending the injured Shigura Shingala, Pau asks them to watch him while he fetches medicine, then Shingala runs out of the cave.

6236a797366f800e.name: pause_then_play_mother_farewell
6236a797366f800e.doc: Waits 30 frames, then plays the mother farewell scene.

623a047e93fee6cf.name: talk_to_station_npc
623a047e93fee6cf.doc: Talk handler. Cedric (the train driver) can start the trip to map s04 (Balance Valley Station), Borneo is the mechanic, Erik the demolitionist and Osmond a waiting passenger.

624152e1132a60dd.name: place_player_from_counters
624152e1132a60dd.doc: Places the player at a train station position using counters: counter 1 is the station, counter 0 the train and counter 15 the side. Prints the values to the debug log.

6248c2a895251b07.name: play_floor_entry_scene
6248c2a895251b07.doc: Plays the walk-in scene on arriving at a floor. With 0 it shows the dungeon logo, otherwise a fading dungeon map. Then it explains any seal on the floor: red blocks changing to Max, blue blocks changing to Monica, white blocks healing HP and status.

628dbf3cdedb95f5.name: talk_adel_after_joining
628dbf3cdedb95f5.doc: Adel's chatter after the clothing quest is cleared, asking how the garment fits. Chapter 8 swaps in a prayer for safety.

62a3672ae57aaeda.name: start_firbits_return_scene
62a3672ae57aaeda.doc: Plays the Firbit return scene and fades in.

62bb30f20cdf46d7.name: leave_train_through_door_side_0
62bb30f20cdf46d7.doc: Program 201: if the door on side 0 is open, stores counter 15 = 0, fades out, removes the train car NPCs and jumps to the station map.

62e8b773c8c1aabe.name: start_moonflower_floor
62e8b773c8c1aabe.doc: Sets up a Moonflower Palace floor: picks the map (d06f01 to d06f03), loads monsters and chests, plays music and runs the entry scene. Floors 0, 11, 21 and 27 instead go to the foyer edit mode or maps s21, s50 and s23.

62efdae25b4e0336.name: play_train_departure
62efdae25b4e0336.doc: Train departure scene: fades out, hides the player, drives the train part 6000 units down the track over 210 frames while the camera watches, fades out, and restores the player.

62f41bb01c6c231c.name: play_time_gate_walk_scene
62f41bb01c6c231c.doc: Max and Monica walk down a long path through a time gate while the camera first swings around them in the evening and then pulls back and tilts up at night.

62f99c42e9ee7abf.name: play_jurak_gun_gift_scene
62f99c42e9ee7abf.doc: Plays event 285: with the forest and Jurak restored, Jurak gives Max the Jurak Gun. Sets flag 285.

62fbb46ff23278cb.name: exit_train_through_left_door
62fbb46ff23278cb.doc: Event 201. If the left door is open, plays the door sound, fades out, sets counter 15 to 0 and returns to the station map. Otherwise the player shakes their head.

63008f50452f77bc.name: talk_stewart_quest_offer
63008f50452f77bc.doc: Stewart explains he wants to buy a rare book at auction for about 1000 gilda, shows a help message that he will not join without it and accepts quest 6.

631ae0ba37ac2409.name: ride_lift_up_then_enter_d06
631ae0ba37ac2409.doc: Plays the ascent scene then loads dungeon d06e01 at entry 506.

631ce6b0ec7f23fe.name: ask_to_go_to_next_floor
631ce6b0ec7f23fe.doc: Next-floor door: shut until event 708 has played; afterwards asks and moves the dungeon to the next floor.

6333007bfbf5d0e2.name: play_farewell_to_crest_and_jump_to_g02
6333007bfbf5d0e2.doc: Plays the farewell to Crest scene then jumps to map g02 at entry 502.

633da401dd86daa0.name: play_boss_awakens_with_flame_scene
633da401dd86daa0.doc: Sets flag 724. A boss falls with a thud, trembles, jolts up and breathes the Griffon flame effect while Max and Monica look on, then takes a stance. The scene fades out and the battle music starts.

63664a4e7fe75cf3.name: play_train_scene_then_board_locomotive
63664a4e7fe75cf3.doc: Plays the Blackstone Railroad arrival scene, then jumps to map s08 (Inside of Locomotive) at event 501.

6371cbd773d2b86d.name: play_pending_event_or_enter_map
6371cbd773d2b86d.doc: On map start plays event 524 (giving the Fire Horn) if not seen, or event 560 (giving the Holy Daedalus Blade) when allowed. Otherwise hides the NPC if flag 536 is set and places the player.

63818abe1011f8cc.name: play_train_departure_under_moonflower_beam_scene
63818abe1011f8cc.doc: Event 616 train departure: the party runs along the platform while the Moon Flower beam B effect fires, then the train pulls away with accelerating motion and the scene fades out.

639f342a357c433f.name: show_third_phase_flashback
639f342a357c433f.doc: Fades out, pauses and shows a debug label for the second battle flashback (event 724), and places the third phase boss.

63aacc6fb4085236.name: play_train_departure_scene
63aacc6fb4085236.doc: Plays the scene where the train leaves and Max runs alongside.

63bb8588a0f936b0.name: play_circus_ticket_scene
63bb8588a0f936b0.doc: Plays the opening scene where an old man hands over a ticket and Max tears it, using the opening p1_5 motions and voice lines. Skippable.

63e3a9a5ca705678.name: show_door_opened
63e3a9a5ca705678.doc: Shows door set door_set (0 to 9) of the d05 floor in its opened state: hides the closed door piece and the matching -a and -c pieces, and shows the opened (_3) door piece.

63f755cdccbaf786.name: ask_pau_for_orange_food
63f755cdccbaf786.doc: Pau's first talk: he says he cannot leave yet because he is waiting for Shingala, then asks for a long, orange food. Accepts quest 5.

6400bb1b746a5f09.name: show_shigura_greeting
6400bb1b746a5f09.doc: Turns the player and the villager toward each other, frames them with the camera and shows that villager's line. Children (slots 13 to 15) answer with a random cry.

64167ea3ab141c9c.name: setup_station_arrival
64167ea3ab141c9c.doc: Map setup for the station area. After a memory card load it places Max at the saved spot; otherwise it places the player according to the previous map and counter 1, or falls back to the chapter-specific station setup.

641ea2b63731f380.name: place_gem_in_altar
641ea2b63731f380.doc: Handles one altar. If its gem is already placed it says the lapis is shining. Otherwise it asks for the gem (365 Earth, 367 Wind, 366 Water, 368 Fire) from the item menu, records it in counter 16 and shows the pillar. When all four are placed it goes to the ritual map.

641ead7565516be5.name: animate_projection
641ead7565516be5.doc: Steps the camera projection from from_projection toward to_projection over frames frames scaled by 50/60, using the difference divided by the frame count truncated to an integer step; it does not set the final value. The last parameter is unused.

6426d9a7c49c66fd.name: play_ready_scene_and_enter_dungeon
6426d9a7c49c66fd.doc: Event 500: like event 151 but, after giving Steve's parts and enabling him, leaves for the dungeon with event 520.

642c1b9597fe2eea.name: load_s06c_event_500
642c1b9597fe2eea.doc: Loads the s06c_1 event script at entry 500.

643406f06a916f67.name: play_griffon_appears_scene
643406f06a916f67.doc: Griffon's appearance cutscene in the palace boss room: Max or Monica (whichever is active) and the other party member stand in the hall, Griffon turns around and speaks, they react and he unleashes his power. Sets the appears flag, loads the boss music and ends in a fade into the fight.

6435b9558db4f94c.name: run_boss_game_over
6435b9558db4f94c.doc: Game over handler: if the boss fight started (flag 728) but was not won (flag 732), plays a voiced game over with one of two lines, otherwise a silent one.

6448b0894c691f19.name: use_exit_gate_2
6448b0894c691f19.doc: Handles exit gate 2 of the floor.

646680a61b725181.name: load_event_sound
646680a61b725181.doc: Loads the event sound bank EV_200_000 on the event sound port.

647fd895d433d6d3.name: play_victory_banner
647fd895d433d6d3.doc: Dungeon clear banner: stops BGM and effects, shows the finish banner (language-specific image) scaling in while the camera follows the character (higher for Steve), then restarts BGM 193 and crossfades back.

64ae94904f72a127.name: open_clown_chest
64ae94904f72a127.doc: Plays the clown treasure chest scene: the chest shakes, a clown pops out holding two boxes, and the player chooses one. The two items are swapped at random so the sides are not fixed, and the chosen item is given.

64b7992b13345bbf.name: play_galen_orders_scene
64b7992b13345bbf.doc: Sets the golem army march seen flag. In the Paznos hall Max or Monica, a partner and Galen Agaris (the phorn model) watch the golem army, and Galen orders the soldiers seated around him to arm for the fight. Skippable; loads and removes its own models.

64c29bfb370f34b3.name: play_need_confession_scene
64c29bfb370f34b3.doc: Event e109b in Need office. Need, the mayor, confesses to Cedric that he shut down the Blackstone Railroad so nobody could leave and see the outside world. Cedric scolds him and they resolve to reopen the railroad. Skippable.

64cf4b2c1d7184ff.name: play_crest_farewell_scene
64cf4b2c1d7184ff.doc: Cutscene where the battleship sinks and Crest, mortally wounded, says goodbye to Lin and tells her to carry on his dream.

64de8846c57546eb.name: play_ridepod_departure_and_join
64de8846c57546eb.doc: Plays event 106. On departure gives the Drum Can Body, Cannonball Arm, Iron Leg, Energy Pack and a Core (if not owned), adds Steve as a party member and enables transformation for him (flag 25). Otherwise returns to the house.

64df17ce9fa8d754.name: warp_to_s46_event_520
64df17ce9fa8d754.doc: Loads the d04f02 dungeon map and plays event 406, then loads map s46 and starts event 520 there.

64fbd77f736c66f6.name: play_departure_jump_to_s09
64fbd77f736c66f6.doc: Plays event 360, the train departure, opens the world-move menu and jumps to map s09.

65166353ecff5b80.name: play_run_into_room_scene
65166353ecff5b80.doc: Cuts to a camera and has Max run into the room from the south while the screen fades in.

652d13050f4025d8.name: leave_for_s42_entry_500
652d13050f4025d8.doc: Fades out, sets flag 4, runs play_opening_letter_and_storm_scene and jumps to map s42 at entry 500.

654adb92426ac4b1.name: start_arrival_scene_after_georama
654adb92426ac4b1.doc: Disables the e348 event point, fades out and plays the arrival scene.

6550557e15f87381.name: open_item_chest
6550557e15f87381.doc: Treasure chest opening sequence: camera pushes in, the lid shakes and opens, and the item jumps out (nothing when item is -1). Adds item up to the bag limit and shows the item message, or a no-room message if none fit; with item -1 it shows an empty-chest message instead. Opens the item overflow menu when the bag is over its limit.

655a5aeec37dfa9c.name: setup_event_207_actors
655a5aeec37dfa9c.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Cedric (starbre), Vorneo and Tom plus the train map part as scene actors for event 207 and loads the e207 message file. Sets globals max_scene_slot and monica_scene_slot to the Max and Monica slots.

656b6e5eb35e8670.name: talk_fabio_joined
656b6e5eb35e8670.doc: Fabio's talk after he has joined: outside chapter 8 he asks for fishing tips, in chapter 8 he says he wants to go fishing in new places.

656d3b3d81196c2a.name: open_floor_select_menu
656d3b3d81196c2a.doc: Switches to dungeon music, opens the dungeon map menu, sets the chosen floor and previous floor, and starts that floor.

65a8b97d576401e7.name: fade_out_and_play_elephant_defeated
65a8b97d576401e7.doc: Fades out and plays the elephant defeated scene.

65aad187aea36942.name: test_gift_scene
65aad187aea36942.doc: Debug entry that plays the gift scene.

65c14c28d0a2dfff.name: show_skippable_message_at
65c14c28d0a2dfff.doc: Opens a message at a screen position and runs it until dismissed, with the skip button enabled; a5[0] is set to 1 if the player skipped. Returns the frames elapsed.

65c49918ef0ff2cb.name: warp_to_s54_event_808
65c49918ef0ff2cb.doc: Clears the scene and loads map s54 with the event script for event 808.

65d24eecb6af84a3.name: play_opening_and_go_to_repair_shop
65d24eecb6af84a3.doc: Sets flag 4, plays the opening letter scene and jumps to the Repair Shop map with event 500.

660117b955e9ad01.name: board_train_for_chapter
660117b955e9ad01.doc: Asks to board the train and, on yes, plays the boarding scene and jumps to the front car (s08, or s37 in chapters 6 and 7) or the middle car (s07, or s38 in chapters 6 and 7).

6634603b39488432.name: play_griffon_talk_then_go_to_starlight_temple
6634603b39488432.doc: Plays the Griffon in the past voice scene and jumps to map f02 at program 510, Starlight Temple.

663614e2335ca5af.name: ask_to_leave_by_gate_and_fade_out
663614e2335ca5af.doc: Asks the leave-the-area question (item question 160). On yes fades out and returns 1, otherwise returns 0.

664d9e508c062090.name: place_train_crew_villagers
664d9e508c062090.doc: Loads sound set 2200 into train_sound_id and places the train crew Cedric, Vorneo and Tom as villagers, then starts the train sounds.

666b695b19145acd.name: play_story_202_train_scene_and_board
666b695b19145acd.doc: Fades out, plays the Blackstone Railroad arrival scene and jumps to map s08 (Inside of Locomotive) at event 501.

6670cb245bf75db1.name: examine_sick_shingala
6670cb245bf75db1.doc: Examining Shingala: with the Secret Dragon Remedy it offers the item menu and plays the healing scene; without it Shingala cries out.

668020d607210548.name: talk_gerald_after_joining
668020d607210548.doc: Gerald's chatter after the gun quest is cleared, warning that guns are not toys. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about rebuilding the world.

66a40303b8f91c0c.name: play_back_golems_march_shot
66a40303b8f91c0c.doc: Variant of the golem march in which only golems 60 to 99 march toward the camera.

66b5525f402e4eb9.name: play_event_724_scene
66b5525f402e4eb9.doc: Plays event 724 (sets flag 724), a scene with the Sun character and the train.

66ce2bbdc50d3871.name: delete_crowd_charas
66ce2bbdc50d3871.doc: Deletes the six crowd characters in slots 13 to 18.

66d17f939a5541db.name: find_clear_camera_position
66d17f939a5541db.doc: Sweeps around the camera target in 45 degree steps to either side of the current view, looking for a position at the given radius that has no camera collision. Writes the position to the out arrays and returns 1 if one was found.

66e8be6ba6597ece.name: ask_if_ready_to_leave
66e8be6ba6597ece.doc: Fades in on the workshop and Cedric asks if Max is ready. The player answers yes (voice line then fade out, returns 1) or asks for more time (returns 0).

66f691b0d4aebb98.name: talk_to_town_npc_or_special
66f691b0d4aebb98.doc: Talk handler: characters numbered 34 or below get the town villager conversation, anything else goes to talk_to_regular_villager.

6711d04add34ac28.name: talk_aunt_polly_after_joining
6711d04add34ac28.doc: Aunt Polly's chatter after the bread delivery quest is cleared, asking where to go next. Chapter 8 swaps in an offer of bread.

671e5b81e85b7963.name: play_event_406
671e5b81e85b7963.doc: Event 406 in the d04 dungeon: sets the Eina bedtime story seen flag, switches control to Max, places him at the way-20 event point and plays one long voiced memory line of a story about a turtle on the seven seas while a door part sits in view, then fades out. Skippable.

672c9f1a5f4bd67c.name: replay_eina_farewell_scene
672c9f1a5f4bd67c.doc: Debug entry: plays the Eina farewell scene.

67368932cef0176d.name: start_griffon_boss_floor
67368932cef0176d.doc: Event 500 on entering the Griffon arena: plays the reveal scene, disables exit and item points, locks map movement and places monster 515.

6754885278ecf745.name: check_ticket_at_circus_entrance
6754885278ecf745.doc: Ticket check at the circus gate (the ticket taker). Prompts for a Circus Ticket (item 353) via the item menu; with the ticket, the first time it runs the m06b program 153, afterwards plays the ticket scene, swaps the Wrench for the circus Wrench and enters dungeon 0 floor 21. Other items get sent home.

67667d608d8b15fd.name: play_angry_walk_out_scene
67667d608d8b15fd.doc: Plays event 108 (sets flag 108): an angry Max walks out through the doors, ending with the rematch hint.

678ce8f9155489a4.name: give_camera
678ce8f9155489a4.doc: Max gets the camera item and a window explains equipping it from the item menu and that it only works in dungeons when it is the active item.

678e2702cca07385.name: enter_dungeon_from_menu
678e2702cca07385.doc: Starts the dungeon BGM, resets the local flags, opens the dungeon map menu to pick a floor and starts it.

67989c294b95526f.name: leave_station_to_s12
67989c294b95526f.doc: Runs the station exit scene and jumps to map s12 at event 500.

67ae03c28ffaf267.name: play_board_train_late
67ae03c28ffaf267.doc: Boarding cutscene from a station platform: reads the train id and position from the event, sets the facing and start height by map, swings the station door pieces (s3601_12/14/16/17) for that car open and has the player run aboard, then fades out and places them inside. Sets counter 0 to the car number (1 to 3).

67d68b418c90aa13.name: setup_event_235_actors
67d68b418c90aa13.doc: Loads the Max and Monica scene actors for event 235 and its message file. Sets globals max_chara_slot and partner_chara_slot.

67fa179c83429350.name: use_floor_gate
67fa179c83429350.doc: Handles stepping on a floor exit. If the exit is still locked it asks the player to use item 350 (Trolley Oil) to unlock it. Otherwise it asks whether to go on, shows the floor challenge medal messages, and moves to the next floor chosen by the gate index.

67fb2e1016f0823f.name: play_galen_gives_sword_scene
67fb2e1016f0823f.doc: Event 560: with Gundorada restored, Galen gives Monica her father Raybrandt's sword (item 82). Sets flag 560.

681d6ea1319afe5e.name: play_time_gate_explanation_scene
681d6ea1319afe5e.doc: Monica shows Max the Time Gate and explains that his red Atlamillia leads to the future and her blue one to the past, that Max's father gave him the stone, and that they must get Jurak back.

681d9f9aa06f21c5.name: play_party_walk_and_jump_shot
681d9f9aa06f21c5.doc: Max and Steve walk in, jump down to the arena and land with dust effects, in a single shot.

6826cea625e19140.name: check_scoop_prize
6826cea625e19140.doc: Checks the photographer prize state. Returns 1 when there are prizes to claim; otherwise explains that more scoops are needed or how the photographer level is set, according to the hint kind, and returns 0.

6830ad7be7b08457.name: play_garden_boy_scene_then_jump_to_g05_560
6830ad7be7b08457.doc: Plays the garden boy scene (event 748) and jumps to map g05 at entry 560. Returns 0.

684b29b2b9ff8db1.name: open_chest_and_mark_taken
684b29b2b9ff8db1.doc: Opens the chest and, when the item is a Diamond (189), sets bit 256 of counter 17 for the first chest and bit 512 for the second.

68501ab302aa4c4c.name: play_crystal_gift_scene
68501ab302aa4c4c.doc: Event 212 (sets flag 212): a companion gives the active character 2 Hunter Crystals, 2 Destruction Crystals, 1 Wind Crystal and 1 Sea Dragon Crystal and explains how to Spectrumise and build up the Wrench. The Wrench gains 6 Synthesis Points.

685738adef5a579e.name: walk_to_previous_train_car
685738adef5a579e.doc: Program 202: walks through the rear door into the previous car (counter 0 goes down and the player is placed at its front). From the first car it leaves for map s08.

6873b159c262b088.name: talk_to_shigura_by_progress
6873b159c262b088.doc: Before flag 500 runs the Shigura talk; afterwards runs the Pau talk by quest state.

687c9b53475d328c.name: setup_house_and_reset_camera
687c9b53475d328c.doc: Runs setup_house_for_quest_18 and puts the camera behind the player.

68af8bd4311dedd3.name: debug_play_gordon_idea_scene
68af8bd4311dedd3.doc: Shows the time travel caption and plays the Gordon idea scene.

68b3ae3a2f4b845a.name: play_nova_driver_cannon_talk_scene
68b3ae3a2f4b845a.doc: Sets flag 640. Max and Monica watch the sky as it is explained that Paznos will use its strongest weapon, the Nova Driver Cannon.

68bb008e29644ab5.name: open_clown_chest
68bb008e29644ab5.doc: Plays the clown treasure chest scene: the chest shakes, a clown pops out holding two boxes, and the player chooses one. The two items are swapped at random so the sides are not fixed, and the chosen item is given.

68c4b7441a14bb24.name: play_floor_arrival_scene
68c4b7441a14bb24.doc: Walk-in cutscene when a floor starts: the map piece rises and Max runs in, with either the floor transition map (show_map_transition set) or the dungeon logo, and shows the seal pictures and messages if the floor is red, blue or white sealed.

68d1124147af7223.name: play_broken_flower_scene
68d1124147af7223.doc: Sets flag 708 and plays event 708: one character confesses to breaking a flower and the other forgives them, saying every flower gives something to people. The doors open at the end.

68dd23da34b2096b.name: setup_ball_stance
68dd23da34b2096b.doc: Sets up a golf stance: puts the ball models and the course ball at the player's position (three units up), turns the player toward the pin, then tries yaw offsets in steps of PI/8 on alternating sides until the swing arc is clear, and sets the ready stance. The ball position and final yaw come back in the array parameters.

68e5423b6d9e7b94.name: ask_to_leave_for_dungeon
68e5423b6d9e7b94.doc: If the active character is 2 or 3 shows a message. Otherwise asks; yes makes the player run off and fade out and returns 1, no walks the player a few steps and returns 0.

68e7301ef77c44fc.name: talk_to_station_npc
68e7301ef77c44fc.doc: Runs the talk handler for the NPC being addressed: Cedric the train driver (returns 1 if the player wants to leave), Borneo the mechanic, Erik the demolitionist or Osmond waiting (301). Returns 0 otherwise.

68ee717c6b0b137b.name: go_to_g01_if_ready
68ee717c6b0b137b.doc: When ask_to_exit_toward_town holds, fades out and jumps to map g01, skipping the music play unless flag 208 is set.

69126370ae6bfbf0.name: leave_for_palm_brinks
69126370ae6bfbf0.doc: Waits 10 frames and leaves for map m01.

6925faa11084a813.name: play_boss_defeat_game_over
6925faa11084a813.doc: Game over event after losing a boss fight: pauses the dungeon, fades the music, shows the Monica defeat line and the game over image sliding in, then waits for a button press and exits.

692812397ca56113.name: choose_jump_gate_destination
692812397ca56113.doc: Shows the jump gate destination menu (north, east, west, in front of the time gate, and Paznos Bridge once analysis 410 is done), plays the sun warp effect and moves the player there.

693d439f94818724.name: place_player_at_entrance
693d439f94818724.doc: Places Max just inside the door facing the camera, resets the camera behind him and fades in.

6995aff044ca7274.name: play_opening_circus_ticket_scene
6995aff044ca7274.doc: Opening chapter 2: Max arrives soaked at work, shows the Flotsam's Circus Troupe ticket his father allowed him to take, and mentions the old pendant his father told him to always wear.

69a986f40010b22e.name: load_waiting_npc
69a986f40010b22e.doc: Loads Osmond, who waits at the station, into slot 8 at fixed coordinates facing the map, as slot character id 301.

69d48ab2e674fde8.name: play_run_in_from_entrance_scene
69d48ab2e674fde8.doc: Cuts to a fixed camera and fades in while the player runs from the entrance at (47, -14, 607) into the room at (113, 3, 468).

6a04a56dc6c4d635.name: play_griffon_erases_world_scene
6a04a56dc6c4d635.doc: Second part of event 612: Griffon uses the power of the stones and the palace and the heroes see something happening.

6a07231680f53f69.name: play_event_728
6a07231680f53f69.doc: Boss intro cutscene: sets the final-boss flag, Max and Monica look up, the camera pulls away, a large monster drops in and attacks them, and the scene fades out.

6a088105caf41160.name: play_rooftop_night_scene
6a088105caf41160.doc: Debug scene: characters stand on a rooftop at night while the camera orbits around them.

6a1993222e0b6097.name: open_cleared_room_door
6a1993222e0b6097.doc: Opens the door of the current room after a fight on the minimap and swaps its map pieces. On floors outside 1 to 15 (and floor 8) shows the numbered door parts in their opened state instead.

6a2eff3166d0c3a9.name: choose_dungeon_floor_from_menu
6a2eff3166d0c3a9.doc: Opens the dungeon tree map. Floor 0 jumps to the Channel Entrance map (d01e01), floor 8 returns to the map, any other floor starts that dungeon.

6a38903164a616bc.name: play_happy_clown_chest_scene
6a38903164a616bc.doc: Plays the Happy Clown treasure chest scene: a clown pops out of the chest and offers a red box or a yellow box, each holding one of the two items. The player's choice gives the item in the box, and the two item positions are swapped at random.

6a46aa687aa2a2c2.name: show_cedric_demands_truth
6a46aa687aa2a2c2.doc: Cedric asks what Need is hiding, bangs the desk and demands to be told everything.

6a4b31dc2aab4e77.name: go_to_s64_after_first_phase
6a4b31dc2aab4e77.doc: Fades out and loads map s64 with its script 500.

6a56bfb3261f168d.name: play_rooftop_scene_for_debug
6a56bfb3261f168d.doc: Debug entry that plays the rooftop night test scene.

6a5f0e9e62c4799d.name: show_default_chapter_notice
6a5f0e9e62c4799d.doc: Shows the chapter notice message with both options off.

6a682821ba827816.name: enter_central_lab_door_4
6a682821ba827816.doc: Turns toward the door, sets counter 2 to 4 and jumps to the Central Lab.

6a7bb1f204b0d7e2.name: play_rock_cleared_scene
6a7bb1f204b0d7e2.doc: Sets flag 280 and plays event 280: Borneo and the crew finish clearing the rock from the tracks so the train can move on, and the narration turns to Balance Valley.

6abcb3c10c045766.name: ask_if_ready_to_leave_with_cedric
6abcb3c10c045766.doc: Cedric asks if Max is ready. On yes (first choice) they pump fists and the screen fades out, returning 1; on no he urges Max to hurry and it returns 0.

6ac4fc12c5e0b2b2.name: close_talk_window
6ac4fc12c5e0b2b2.doc: Reactivates the player, closes the talk window and ends the event.

6ac71e4f871da54a.name: play_gordon_idea_scene
6ac71e4f871da54a.doc: Event 254. Max and Monica talk about the Geostone's message: to bring Jurak back they need someone who knows trees to immigrate to Sindain. Monica suggests Gordon, the Palm Brinks gardener, and a hint tells the player to look for him in Max's yard. Sets flag 34.

6ac75378946547f1.name: play_empty_plaza_camera_scene_faded
6ac75378946547f1.doc: Sets flag 824, hides many building map parts and shows a camera sweep over the plaza with a fade-in; skippable.

6ad013a9a59aaef3.name: enter_f03i04_entrance_4
6ad013a9a59aaef3.doc: Event 403: turns to face south-west, fades out, sets map counter 2 to 4 and jumps to map f03i04.

6aecfbf6ddaac1a8.name: setup_emperor_griffon_battle
6aecfbf6ddaac1a8.doc: Map setup for the Emperor Griffon fight in the foyer: plays the Griffon reveal scene, disables the exit and in_dng points and item points, locks map moves, shows map part p05_d06e01-0, places monster 515 and the player at z 600 facing it and fades in over 20 frames.

6aef4820977389c3.name: replay_story_event_368
6aef4820977389c3.doc: Story program for event 368: sets Balance Valley Georama analysis flags 0 to 7 and clears 8 and 9, marks events 364, 372 and 376 seen and 368 unseen, and jumps to map 26 (Starlight Temple).

6af77e1f3f175058.name: place_player_at_station
6af77e1f3f175058.doc: Places the player character on the platform for a station (1 to 9) at the position of train car train_id (0 to 3), with the facing used by that station. side is only printed.

6af91047cf21404a.name: start_gaspard_backstory_story_event
6af91047cf21404a.doc: Story event 532: plays the backstory scene and loads map s49 at program 500.

6b0197512483cc6e.name: handle_floor_clear
6b0197512483cc6e.doc: Floor clear sequence in a dungeon: stops the battle music and monsters, plays the active character's victory pose or banner, marks the floor cleared (flags 2 and 1024), sets up the Spheda minigame when it is unlocked and the floor has it, shows medal messages, and announces any red, blue or white seal that just broke. Ends with message 2130 and returns control.

6b28d9556665daba.name: play_knock_scene_and_enter_house_keep_music
6b28d9556665daba.doc: Plays the knocking-at-the-house scene (event 209), then fades out and jumps to interior map g01i07 without reloading the music.

6b2cc716dc71cb6a.name: play_floor_clear_sequence
6b2cc716dc71cb6a.doc: Floor clear event: pauses pickups, clears monsters, plays the active character's victory pose, marks the floor cleared in the floor info (flags 2 and 1024), restores the camera, shows the medal messages and the Spheda sub-game messages (2100, 2110, 2120), announces any red, blue or white seal that was broken, and shows message 2130.

6b40825bb6564f2b.name: on_map_start
6b40825bb6564f2b.doc: If flag 728 is set, plays the first monster intro, sets up battle sound and the status bar, places the player and puts monster 603 in the first room. Then fades in.

6b490cd2d67b2719.name: walk_in_after_leaving_dungeon
6b490cd2d67b2719.doc: The player walks into the map after returning from a dungeon.

6b534bf57d99c08f.name: play_enter_next_floor_scene
6b534bf57d99c08f.doc: Cutscene of the active character jumping through the gate and walking forward while the camera fades out, played before moving to the next floor.

6b57413d1ea20651.name: play_event_556
6b57413d1ea20651.doc: Heim Rada cutscene: the two heroes look up at the giant machine as the camera tours it and are told it is Paznos, built by the rebels to fight Griffon. Sets the event 556 seen flag and ends with the Gundorada Workshop music.

6b67d36dda2dcb2c.name: warp_to_boss_floor_after_story_111
6b67d36dda2dcb2c.doc: Story 111 program: loads the boss floor map d01b01 with its script event 600 (the Halloween boss clear scene).

6b737dd5fa758873.name: play_andrea_plea_scene
6b737dd5fa758873.doc: Sets flag 700 and plays the scene where Andrea asks Max and Monica to restore the garden so Sirus can recover his memories and to look for a clue in the first room. The time of day is set to noon during the scene and restored afterwards. Skippable.

6b81cc47e9b34214.name: ask_party_npc_to_set_off
6b81cc47e9b34214.doc: In mode 1 asks the NPC whether to set off, returning 1 on yes. Otherwise says the NPC cannot leave yet or opens the NPC talk menu.

6b8284cd36a5b267.name: play_spheda_shot
6b8284cd36a5b267.doc: Runs one Spheda shot with the club: aim control, power gauge, swing animation, then simulates the ball with bounces, water and pin attraction, camera follow, and the hole-in, miss or retry outcomes.

6b852f7438836fa5.name: play_moonflower_beam_scene
6b852f7438836fa5.doc: Event 616 action scene: Max, Monica and Osmond run along the station platform while a floating figure throws rocks and the Moonflower beam is fired at it. The figure floats away and the train part climbs into the sky before a fade out into cleanup_toryon_scene_cast.

6b9358a23d22e02a.name: setup_dungeon_floor_1
6b9358a23d22e02a.doc: Hides the status bar, loads floor d01f01 with the Sewer Rat monster data, places its treasure boxes and monsters, plays the receiver call scene, then resets the floor timer and shows the floor title.

6ba377e45888ce1f.name: toggle_train_charas_122_123
6ba377e45888ce1f.doc: Activates characters 122 and 123 while flag 202 is set and 204 is not, otherwise deactivates them.

6baf80617c495974.name: talk_to_shigura_with_shell_talkie
6baf80617c495974.doc: Plays a conversation with a Shigura villager once the player has the Shell Talkie. Both turn to face each other, the camera frames them and a bubble shows a greeting plus a line specific to that villager; child villagers answer with growls at random.

6bb61f7482f6aaa9.name: toggle_sky_area_and_run_through_gate
6bb61f7482f6aaa9.doc: Program 345: flips local flag 5 and sky drawing, then plays the gate run scene to move to the other area.

6bbaa92f45d9c367.name: load_lighthouse_shelling_actors
6bbaa92f45d9c367.doc: Loads the models and message file (e356_1.txt) for the lighthouse shelling scene: Max, Monica, Crest, Gaspard, Jaming, cannon fire, Moon Crystal beam, barrier and explosion models.

6bec14b192d4b9b4.name: warp_to_s35_event_500
6bec14b192d4b9b4.doc: Event 510: runs play_spikes_rise_scene, then loads map s35 and its script event 500.

6bed402b3f561fd6.name: play_blue_gate_warp
6bed402b3f561fd6.doc: Plays the time gate warp at the given spot. With Monica in the party it plays the blue time gate scene, otherwise it may first play the Atlamillia glow scene and then the red time gate scene.

6bfb333628142d82.name: play_boss_landing
6bfb333628142d82.doc: Boss landing cutscene on the elephant boss map: Steve and Max-side characters stand while the boss lands with a camera shake and sounds from se_bank, and the boss music starts. Returns 0.

6bfd1e93635ffdb6.name: open_party_member_menu
6bfd1e93635ffdb6.doc: Party member menu at a station. mode selects the NPC (1, 2 and 3 pick fixed ones, 0 reads it from a local counter). Returns 1 if that NPC is already the partner. Otherwise it frames the NPC at a train seat or where they stand, shows a name box and the options (take along, hear a hint, per-NPC extras) and starts the party select menu when chosen.

6c0a7485bdd4be66.name: setup_s04_town_villagers
6c0a7485bdd4be66.doc: Event 502: gives the level 3 progress items, places the map objects and villagers with their AI paused, and plays the scene play_balance_valley_station_arrival_scene (flag 300).

6c0cd7e375d3e764.name: start_fish_race
6c0cd7e375d3e764.doc: Plays race music and shows the qualifier, main or final title (match race in extra mode) over a camera pan, then starts the fish race sub game.

6c106131136a703d.name: talk_donny_shop_closed
6c106131136a703d.doc: Donny says his shop is closed and sends the player to his father's shop, marked by a pumpkin, then talks to the NPC.

6c144c5a8d275589.name: init_train_cars
6c144c5a8d275589.doc: Places the train actor and creates actors for twelve train car pieces of the p01_train01 map part, turning each slightly.

6c1d3953d2734a85.name: play_paznos_catch_and_throw_scene
6c1d3953d2734a85.doc: Sets flag 640. Paznos flies up, catches something with its hands, throws it away and descends to land with sand dust, then the scene fades out.

6c355803aceb32ad.name: play_sand_dust_quake_scene
6c355803aceb32ad.doc: Sets flag 612 and plays event 612: the screen shakes and sand dust bursts at several places.

6c4ddd6d47718317.name: setup_floor_start_view
6c4ddd6d47718317.doc: Places the player at the floor start event point standing, aims the camera, loads the floor monsters and treasure boxes and fades in.

6c65b11541756253.name: talk_villager_by_kind
6c65b11541756253.doc: Calls the generic villager talk when the talked-to character number is below 100 or above 1000; other characters are handled elsewhere.

6c687e120bef56ca.name: play_potato_pie_memory_scene
6c687e120bef56ca.doc: Program 600: plays the scene where Max is reminded of the potato pies his mother made.

6c721d6855fc2090.name: enter_i01h01
6c721d6855fc2090.doc: Waits 10 frames and enters interior i01h01.

6c8e1652a20b5d54.name: play_sirus_hugs_andrea_scene
6c8e1652a20b5d54.doc: Event 732. Sirus, crying, walks to Andrea who crouches and hugs him while the camera pulls up.

6cc33d581914e3f9.name: play_monica_rescue_scene
6cc33d581914e3f9.doc: Skippable event 206 scene: the burning boss threatens to blow up the train, Monica arrives and casts her magic, and Max narrates how they met. Sets flag 206.

6cce5f76162d81f8.name: show_notice_message
6cce5f76162d81f8.doc: Stops the player and shows a notice message in the help window, then restores the speech bubble window mode.

6cd1ea55ab2074e0.name: play_train_rush_then_jump_to_s31
6cd1ea55ab2074e0.doc: Plays the train rush scene and jumps to map s31 at entry 500. Returns 0.

6cdd363c1043678f.name: enter_house_i02h01
6cdd363c1043678f.doc: Program 204: at progress 100 shows the notice message and resets the edit event; otherwise jumps to interior i02h01.

6cf43556bfa93235.name: open_floor_menu_and_start
