6cf43556bfa93235.doc: Starts the palace music, opens the dungeon floor menu, sets the chosen floor and previous floor and starts that floor.

6cf965395d53c0cd.name: restart_event_306
6cf965395d53c0cd.doc: Sets flag 304, resets 306, 324 and 330, puts Dr. Dell in the party, plays his diagnosis scene and jumps to Balance Valley.

6d0b6100e5cace16.name: place_galen_after_gaspard
6d0b6100e5cace16.doc: If flag 536 is set, loads and places Galen Agaris (id 400) in slot 8.

6d16be6ec99d526c.name: play_event_552
6d16be6ec99d526c.doc: Event 552: sets the Heim Rada event 552 seen flag, a short voiced scene where the hero notices something and goes to check, a fade out, then the player is reset at a fixed spot and the camera goes behind with a fade in.

6d21eca6f358b210.name: play_opening_part_5
6d21eca6f358b210.doc: Opening part 5: Max is chased by Pierrots, the villain Halloween with Polcurse demands the pendant, Max refuses, and they flee. Voice lines are synced to the streamed audio.

6d27d6ed4d464ec1.name: talk_to_station_npc
6d27d6ed4d464ec1.doc: Talk handler. Cedric offers the train departure question and Osmond is a waiting passenger.

6d3c0eb697217dd3.name: narrate_max_hearing_story
6d3c0eb697217dd3.doc: Max, stunned, narrates how he listened to the story and began to understand what was happening around him.

6d69b8353d2de094.name: play_villagers_freed_scene
6d69b8353d2de094.doc: Skippable event 247: the bewitched villagers return to normal with no memory, Monica explains the Holy One and they decide to go back to Sindain, with a tutorial on leaving the area. Sets flag 247.

6d71c5a981a4ad70.name: talk_borneo_at_station
6d71c5a981a4ad70.doc: Talking to Borneo at the station. If Borneo is the party NPC he says a few lines (extra ones in chapters 3 and 4 before the Ixion is explained) and the conversation proceeds. Otherwise it opens the party member menu for him. Returns 0.

6db8a5d47513de70.name: set_town_buildings_visible
6db8a5d47513de70.doc: Binds about 130 town map parts (houses, signs, bridges, doors, windows, barrels, lamps, plants, tents and the cart) and sets their visibility to the given value.

6debc5e7d661bb6a.name: give_starter_items_and_start_georama
6debc5e7d661bb6a.doc: adds a set of items (210, 214, 216, 220, 224, 235, 231), opens the item-overflow menu if the bag is full, allows editing and starts Georama mode.

6dec4b43293047fe.name: give_white_windflower_for_dumplings
6dec4b43293047fe.doc: Function point program: gives hint, then opens the item menu for the White Windflower. Using it gives Miracle Dumplings, disables the point, and plays event 324 with Lao Chao hidden. A wrong item plays a miss reaction.

6decc311b6e044f9.name: talk_donny_to_monica
6decc311b6e044f9.doc: Donny's talk when Monica is the active character: he says he has hardly seen Max since she arrived and hopes she is not using him.

6e095374144bc6ee.name: load_hologram_scene_actors
6e095374144bc6ee.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Osmond, Eina's hologram, the projector, the item-get effect, train and station parts and five full-screen images for the Osmond hologram scene (e616).

6e0b3b7399bb63f0.name: turn_player_to_chara
6e0b3b7399bb63f0.doc: Turns the player toward chara with a walking turn whose length scales with the angle, then returns to standing. Prints the angle and frame count to the debug log.

6e16e9f603391197.name: ask_to_enter_palace
6e16e9f603391197.doc: Talk handler for the entrance: asks to enter and goes to dungeon 5.

6e21f495eff06ad5.name: talk_adel_early
6e21f495eff06ad5.doc: Adel's early talk: she says she works as a maid now but once dreamed of being a tailor, and that dreams are called that because they don't come true.

6e24d8e882a45294.name: play_shot_laugh_talk
6e24d8e882a45294.doc: Voiced shot where Cedric and Max discuss the elephant and Max offers to make the Energy Pack for Steve. sound_id is passed in by the caller.

6e2775e154a1099e.name: narrate_adventure_begins
6e2775e154a1099e.doc: Fades out the last story image and plays Max's closing narration, then stops the music, plays a sound and shakes the camera for 45 frames.

6e308e32301adb3d.name: hide_lab_map_part_handles
6e308e32301adb3d.doc: Hides both lab map part handles by calling show_lab_map_part_handles(0, 0).

6e31575044fd5445.name: show_stop_hint
6e31575044fd5445.doc: Shows the Spanish hint text that the spinning meter is stopped with the button, in message window 1 at the bottom, without waiting.

6e3b3389a786c8a7.name: receive_notebook_from_table
6e3b3389a786c8a7.doc: The character walks to the memo on the table, shows an item message for the Notebook (386), adds it, handles inventory overflow and hides the memo.

6e43d964b0e35400.name: talk_with_talk_camera
6e43d964b0e35400.doc: Places the player before the NPC, plays a crossfade and shows the message above the NPC, then restores the NPC and ends the event.

6e444397a4fb7827.name: take_gate_exit_2
6e444397a4fb7827.doc: Gate 2 handler: interacts with the third exit.

6e48196e0c921506.name: play_intro_scene_and_go_to_g01
6e48196e0c921506.doc: Event 501: plays the control room intro and jumps to map g01 event 504.

6e8b94dc1f59635e.name: enter_f03i0301
6e8b94dc1f59635e.doc: Event 405: fades out and jumps to map f03i0301 with its map start event, skipping the next BGM load when flag 408 is set and flag 412 is not.

6edc4a5a5a1dc915.name: play_story_108a_victory_scene
6edc4a5a5a1dc915.doc: Story entry for event 108a: pauses monster AI, makes Max active and plays the elephant victory scene, then sets flag 7.

6ee74e8e8287a4c6.name: talk_olivie_after_joining
6ee74e8e8287a4c6.doc: Olivie's chatter after the race quest is cleared, hoping to stand on the winner's podium. Chapter 8 swaps in a remark about Fabio's single interest.

6eebcb2a96d393bc.name: clean_up_e352_scene_and_load_d03b02
6eebcb2a96d393bc.doc: Removes the extra characters loaded for the e352 scene, restores the party handles and status bar, and loads dungeon map d03b02 at entry 503.

6f0b48eefacea7f3.name: play_elephant_lands_shot
6f0b48eefacea7f3.doc: The elephant lands in the arena with a camera shake while Max and Steve stand ready.

6f33398a9510f4d6.name: start_battleship_battle
6f33398a9510f4d6.doc: Moves the player, starts battle music and places the battleship monsters 517, 518 and 519.

6f56049a52ec6d5e.name: pick_up_photo_album
6f56049a52ec6d5e.doc: Interaction with the map's item spot: the first time (flag 38), gives the Photo Album (item 357) and hides the part.

6f598ffa7b0d47f7.name: clear_flag_bits
6f598ffa7b0d47f7.doc: Clears the bits of mask from the first element of flags, one bit at a time over 32 bits.

6f78ec62b92b0b1c.name: use_gate
6f78ec62b92b0b1c.doc: Handles the player interacting with gate 0.

6f8e296e733e410e.name: play_flotsam_flies_away_shot
6f8e296e733e410e.doc: Flotsam shouts that he will remember this and flies up and away along a path while the camera follows.

6f97f45e1208d6c8.name: load_dark_scene_actors
6f97f45e1208d6c8.doc: Loads the actors for the e728 dark power scene: Max and Monica, the sun and smoke models, and the red, blue and yellow Atla models. Stores the party slots in dark_scene_max_slot and dark_scene_monica_slot.

6fa41cbdb6f3bbb2.name: on_monsters_cleared
6fa41cbdb6f3bbb2.doc: After the monsters are defeated, spawns treasure boxes for any of the Experience Coin (209), Poison Coin (203) and Dynamite (173) not taken yet, shows the boxes, plays BGM 193 and marks the floor cleared.

6fa702b6dc5f0950.name: run_power_gauge
6fa702b6dc5f0950.doc: Runs the Spheda power gauge. Returns 1 if the player cancels, 0 once a shot is set. A button press stops the gauge; its accuracy code scales power and shifts yaw (a perfect hit gives 1.1 times power), the analog stick gives curve and spin, and the code is stored in result_code[0].

6fb316c20d6447c5.name: ask_bridge_jump_from_spot_5
6fb316c20d6447c5.doc: Sets counter 13 to 5 and asks about jumping to Paznos Bridge.

6fbc5a88b0ecb223.name: play_floor_arrival_scene
6fbc5a88b0ecb223.doc: Plays the arrival cutscene on a new floor: the player runs in through an opening door piece, with a floor title logo or the dungeon map fading in depending on the argument. Then shows the Red, Blue or White Seal messages when floor_status marks the floor as sealed, forcing Max or Monica and blocking healing.

6fd8bd272bcb9513.name: step_back_from_cave_with_hint
6fd8bd272bcb9513.doc: Used before flag 404: the player steps back from the cave gate and says that the cry they heard earlier is worth checking, so they should try the cave first.

6ff084b4319281e2.name: unload_event_277_charas
6ff084b4319281e2.doc: Removes the event 277 scene characters and badge model, leaving only the active character.

6ff940978a912b88.name: setup_map_after_lab_revival_hint
6ff940978a912b88.doc: Places Max at the start, fades in, and, if analysis 305 has not been done, shows a hint to satisfy the Georama conditions and revive the Central Lab of Luna Lab. Then shows pending event hints.

6ffec04acee9d6bf.name: talk_waiting_npc
6ffec04acee9d6bf.doc: Talk with a party NPC who waits at the station. The line changes after the waiting NPC has been released, tracked by flag.

6fff517c5190e7e6.name: play_beam_then_go_to_paznos_bridge
6fff517c5190e7e6.doc: Plays the first beam scene and jumps to map s30 (Paznos Bridge). Returns 0.

700fe1e4e8550408.name: talk_rosa_after_joining
700fe1e4e8550408.doc: Rosa's chatter after her quest is cleared, doubting she is of any use. Chapter 8 swaps in a wish to see the Ends of the Earth.

70328da3ca771b8a.name: press_panel_0_6
70328da3ca771b8a.doc: Candle puzzle step for the church candle at row 0, column 6: cuts to a fixed camera, waits 45 frames, toggles that candle and its four neighbours (i01h07_13 pieces), then waits 45 frames.

7037780d66ab5cc5.name: start_elephant_floor
7037780d66ab5cc5.doc: Floor entry: sets which doors and objects are active from flags 7, 104, 105, 106, 109, then loads the intro event script s06b 500, 510 or 520 depending on story flags, or places Max and monster 601 directly.

703adda263bec9f0.name: ask_move_to_palm_brinks
703adda263bec9f0.doc: Asks whether to move to Palm Brinks. On yes it fades out and returns 1.

70515ccbea3ce5ce.name: run_game_over_voiced
70515ccbea3ce5ce.doc: Runs run_game_over with the revive setting and a voice id, and returns its result.

7055962b3028ec06.name: pick_flower_of_the_sun
7055962b3028ec06.doc: Used at the flower. Only works for Max or Monica (otherwise shows a message). Advances to the next dungeon floor, plays the pickup motion, hides the flower map part and gives the Flower of the Sun.

7057fb6b6e4df570.name: show_station_villagers
7057fb6b6e4df570.doc: Activates the three station villager characters 8, 9 and 10.

705b1e9745b5cb1f.name: talk_erik_at_station
705b1e9745b5cb1f.doc: Talking to Erik (character slot) at a station. If Erik is the partner he gives a demolition quip and, in chapters 2, 3 and 4 before the chapter's story event, an extra line, then the normal NPC talk. Otherwise it opens the party member menu for him with mode 3. Returns 0.

705ff55c76c6bd8d.name: load_geostone_scene_actors
705ff55c76c6bd8d.doc: Loads the actors and images for event 254: Max and Monica, Conda, a Geostone model and two story images. Stores the party slots in player_slot and partner_slot.

706533896893ae88.name: talk_to_corinne
706533896893ae88.doc: Talk handler for Corinne. Picks the line by quest 0 state and quest 18 (hide and seek).

706fd8be074bada0.name: offer_give_up_hole
706fd8be074bada0.doc: Asks whether to give up the current hole. On the last hole, yes shows the total score and returns to the course menu (returns 0); on others it loads the next hole.

7084826903aa9cd8.name: ask_seated_stargazer_about_kid
7084826903aa9cd8.doc: Talks to the seated NPC (slot 9) while the player has no ticket, asking whether a red-headed kid came by; the reply is that he ran toward City Hall. Talking from behind gives a rude-to-do-so remark and returns 0.

708b0f306625c5ea.name: use_starglass_to_go_to_past
708b0f306625c5ea.doc: Function point program: asks to travel to the past and opens the item menu for the Starglass. Using it fades out, plays the time travel scene and loads dungeon d03b02 at program 502. A wrong item plays a miss reaction.

709746abf88aa839.name: replay_party_withdraws_scene
709746abf88aa839.doc: Story jump: sets earlier story flags and plays event 410.

70ac87ed762ed115.name: play_stream_when_ready
70ac87ed762ed115.doc: Waits until the stream is ready, then plays it.

70b5255eef94a065.name: setup_ball_stance
70b5255eef94a065.doc: Sets up a Spheda shot: moves the ball and its models to the player, aims at the pin, picks the nearest swing direction with room to swing, and plays the ready stance. Writes the ball position and facing to the arrays.

70cae7bc040939bc.name: wait_scene_frames_starting_bgm
70cae7bc040939bc.doc: Waits the given number of frames and starts the BGM at frame 60.

70d5030eec35cef1.name: play_galen_orbit_scene_and_go_to_f04
70d5030eec35cef1.doc: Plays the Galen camera scene and jumps to map f04 at event 601.

70dccc8324c38d5e.name: ask_to_leave_by_east_exit
70dccc8324c38d5e.doc: Asks the leave-the-area question for the east exit. On yes the player runs out along a path and the screen fades; returns 1. On no the player steps back and returns 0.

70e638aaa37e90da.name: play_eina_embrace_to_s29
70e638aaa37e90da.doc: Plays the Eina embrace scene and jumps to map s29 at event 600.

70e9189f8e1e80bb.name: talk_morton_bread
70e9189f8e1e80bb.doc: Morton's talk during Polly's bread errand, driven by counter 12: step 0 he explains the 20 loaves are for a cheese fondue party and asks Max to carry them to his house; step 1 repeats the directions; step 2 (the party is off) asks Max to return the bread to Polly and moves to step 3; step 3 repeats that.

70ef5f8df7ef746d.name: run_spheda_shot
70ef5f8df7ef746d.doc: Runs one complete Spheda shot: aim, power gauge, swing animation and the ball physics with bounces, spin, water splashes, pin attraction and out of bounds. Returns 1 if the ball reaches the pin, 2 if it stops or is lost after a miss, 0 when the player backs out of aiming.

70f4c9355edd158f.name: run_boss_game_over
70f4c9355edd158f.doc: Game over handler for the Gaspard fights. During the second fight (flag 532 set, 536 not) or the first (528 set, 532 not) it plays one of two random voice lines before the game over, otherwise a silent game over.

7100f7382857069f.name: play_shot_train_lights
7100f7382857069f.doc: Opening shot of the train lights flashing as it pulls in: fades in, flashes the headlights, puffs steam and smoke from the train and plays the sounds. Hides the crew characters. Returns 0.

710612e8e8ca6dac.name: ask_choice_question
710612e8e8ca6dac.doc: Asks the menu question 1000 + kind with two options (kind 0) or three (kind 1) and returns the choice.

711398914b239f2b.name: board_train_to_s33
711398914b239f2b.doc: When ask_to_board_train confirms, jumps to map s33.

711a0337589dadaf.name: press_panel_1_1
711a0337589dadaf.doc: Candle puzzle step for the church candle at row 1, column 1: cuts to a fixed camera, waits 45 frames, toggles that candle and its four neighbours (i01h07_13 pieces), then waits 45 frames.

71247637ed05e1da.name: play_dark_power_scene_and_load_d06b03
71247637ed05e1da.doc: Plays the dark power scene, starts music 167 and loads dungeon d06b03 with its script 550.

714923e281ab909d.name: play_scene_then_go_to_s66_650
714923e281ab909d.doc: Plays play_paznos_catch_and_throw_scene (sets flag 640) and jumps to map s66 at event 650.

714bcc4e2455cc98.name: play_gate_open_scene
714bcc4e2455cc98.doc: Cutscene of a gate opening: the gate's key model activates, the gate map piece hides, and a door actor swings down to flat and bounces three times.

71526e7e5e6fd413.name: consume_stroke
71526e7e5e6fd413.doc: Uses up one stroke. When none are left it hides the two ball characters and plays sound 19 unless se_bank is -1.

71788c69d9a6e5bc.name: remind_work_not_done
71788c69d9a6e5bc.doc: Shows a thought that the job Cedric asked for is not finished yet.

7184f5a8b095ddeb.name: play_stop_palace_dive_then_go_to_s32
7184f5a8b095ddeb.doc: Plays play_stop_palace_dive_scene and jumps to map s32 (Moon Flower Palace vs Paznos) at event 640. Returns 0.

719b16363fd3a686.name: play_palace_arrival_then_return_to_g05
719b16363fd3a686.doc: Plays the Moonflower Palace welcome scene and jumps to map g05 at entry 500, reloading sounds.

71b150acbe36272d.name: talk_need_after_joining
71b150acbe36272d.doc: Need's chatter after the safe quest is cleared, about sorting garbage. Chapter 8 swaps in a warning about Zelmite Mine.

71bd49e77210148e.name: enter_starlight_canyon_dungeon
71bd49e77210148e.doc: Before event 306 has played, shows a hint. Otherwise asks to go to Starlight Canyon, opens the dungeon tree map for stage 2 and enters the chosen floor.

71dcd063788a0a1b.name: load_event_254_charas
71dcd063788a0a1b.doc: Loads the scene actors of event 254: Max and Monica (the one not played is loaded as a party member in slot 32 and the slots are stored in max_scene_slot and monica_scene_slot), the Conda, Firbit and Toryon models, and the event message file.

72002922ae26e04c.name: play_palace_returned_then_go_to_s32
72002922ae26e04c.doc: Story 616: plays the palace-returned scene (Osmond reports the Moon Flower Palace is back, flag 616) and jumps to map s32 as program 500.

7206859d6f9e62da.name: warp_to_s19_event_416
7206859d6f9e62da.doc: Clears the scene and starts event 416 on map s19.

720f3021e55c72d3.name: play_sky_floor_arrival_scene
720f3021e55c72d3.doc: Arrival scene for floor 1, which is set high above the ground at height 3200: shows the logo or transition map while the character walks out onto the platform.

720f764e06dee3ea.name: setup_floor_by_flags
720f764e06dee3ea.doc: Sets up the s17 floor from story flags. With the Balance Valley arrival and Lao Chao request seen and Spheda not yet unlocked, plays the Condor time-distortion scene and locks character switching and the weapon draw. If Spheda is unlocked, plays the landing scene and disables the exit, talk and branch points. With only the first flag it plays the dead-end search and advances to the next floor; with none it just places the player and fades in.

721c4a5e3649e002.name: ask_to_enter_dungeon
721c4a5e3649e002.doc: With flag 306 unset it plays the hint scene. Otherwise it asks to enter the dungeon, opens the floor selection map for dungeon 2 and starts the chosen floor, or walks back if the player chose none.

722965437e29863e.name: react_to_crash_sound
722965437e29863e.doc: Max looks back in surprise at the sound while the others stand still.

72300457ba829bd1.name: talk_to_villager
72300457ba829bd1.doc: Runs the villager talk setup, then the villager conversation with choices.

7231045c21efb6ca.name: play_event_372
7231045c21efb6ca.doc: Event 372 in the Starlight Temple: sets its seen flag, switches to BGM 152, and plays Max and Monica finding Lin as Crest the Great Sage, the worshippers at the crystal and her spell calling up a vision, then unloads the scene characters and jumps to map s33 entry 510.

725b58cd79c59720.name: run_geostone_scene_test
725b58cd79c59720.doc: Debug entry that plays the Geostone reactor scene.

7262d8cf50294dc2.name: replay_carpenterion_appears_scene
7262d8cf50294dc2.doc: Event 600: plays the Carpenterion appears scene only.

72672164588d2486.name: talk_rufio
72672164588d2486.doc: Rufio's talk dispatcher. Quest 0 not yet at state 2 gives his early talk; after that, quest 14's state picks the quest offer (0), photo talk (1) or joined talk (2). Returns 0.

72835f51cc718085.name: ask_elevator_floor
72835f51cc718085.doc: Shows the elevator buttons message and a three-way floor menu with the current floor greyed out. Returns the chosen floor, or -1 if cancelled or unchanged.

72a38847199f3b4c.name: talk_claire_quest_offer
72a38847199f3b4c.doc: Claire's quest offer. Monica gets a different talk; for Max she declines to join but asks for a photo of a rare flower, shows a help message and accepts quest 4.

72af39641bd88433.name: wait_message_timed
72af39641bd88433.doc: Waits up to frames frames (scaled 50/60) for the player to dismiss message window, with lip sync running, then closes the window. Returns the frames waited.

72d8f72d8e63c6b3.name: start_d02b02_with_gear
72d8f72d8e63c6b3.doc: Debug start: sets both characters to 64 max HP and 16 defence, adds and equips items 18, 25, 48 and 92, then loads dungeon d02b02.

72d96a9c35378825.name: talk_ferdinand_monica
72d96a9c35378825.doc: Ferdinand's talk when Monica speaks to him: chapters before 8 he asks Monica about favourite foods, in chapter 8 he talks of studying cooking. Ends the event.

72de4aadd35b4238.name: arrive_from_veniccio_station_gate
72de4aadd35b4238.doc: The player runs in from the station side of the map and the camera follows for 30 frames.

72ea1b40d7fc1ae0.name: play_monster_e117e_intro_scene
72ea1b40d7fc1ae0.doc: Boss introduction: music 190, the e117e monster idles then attacks while its title card fades in and out, then the scene fades out.

73194a9a48c8e167.name: load_toryon_scene_cast
73194a9a48c8e167.doc: Loads the actors for event 616: Max and Monica, Dr. Osmond, Toryon, the beam and rock models, the moonflower beam effect and the train map parts.

732045178bed8eeb.name: play_mardan_scene_and_advance_story
732045178bed8eeb.doc: Event 505: plays the Mardan meeting scene, sets the story counter to 5 and refreshes the story points.

732b800b62d9fe92.name: play_ixion_unveiling_scene
732b800b62d9fe92.doc: Event 600. Max and Monica run to the workshop where Dr. Nobb and Osmond unveil the finished Ixion time-travelling train. Monica thinks its looks are gaudy, Osmond defends the design, and Osmond will handle the Ixion's controls as the party sets out. Sets flag 600.

733a613bcf8f42fe.name: disable_item_points
733a613bcf8f42fe.doc: Disables the func points item1 to item22 so the map's item pickups cannot be used.

7343630341b894d1.name: play_lin_wakes_scene
7343630341b894d1.doc: Clinic cutscene where Lin wakes up: Lin's friend Argo is relieved, Lin asks why she is there and where Master Crest is, and it turns out she has lost her memory. Sets the clinic event seen flag and hides NPC slot 24.

734db146f216a7d1.name: play_villagers_recovered_scene_and_advance_story
734db146f216a7d1.doc: Event 503: sets the story counter to 7, plays the villagers recovered scene and returns to the s05 script.

7370dd8c51cf959e.name: setup_and_play_sea_chase_scene
7370dd8c51cf959e.doc: Sets up the map objects and plays event 404.

7376ea00058f2335.name: play_lonely_grief_scene
7376ea00058f2335.doc: Sets flag 724 and plays event 724: a lone figure laments that humans fought over shiny stones and wishes they had never existed.

737b37a34fbafefd.name: play_explosion_reaction_shot
737b37a34fbafefd.doc: The crew react to a blast from outside and tell Max the ladder leads to the roof of the train; Max nods and agrees to check it.

7394849e36584337.name: is_town_2_complete
7394849e36584337.doc: Returns 1 when town 2 is 100 percent rebuilt.

7399cd63b81d6e6e.name: play_ticket_snatched_by_boy_scene
7399cd63b81d6e6e.doc: A man hands over a circus ticket at the entrance; a boy snatches it and runs off, and the man chases him and loses him. Ends with a system message.

73b89b6aa712e875.name: show_aim_for_head_hint
73b89b6aa712e875.doc: Event program in the Halloween boss room that pauses monsters and the player and shows a hint box telling the player to aim for the head. The French text is shown for both language branches.

73c52a61b15f2664.name: ask_to_proceed_to_next_floor
73c52a61b15f2664.doc: Asks whether to proceed to the next floor; yes sends Max running off with a fade out and returns 0, no restores the camera and returns 1.

73c86c6f2a9d9e82.name: place_monster_pack
73c86c6f2a9d9e82.doc: Loads Mandora (monster 55), places six of them in the room and pauses the battle music.

73cecc73c30ffaf8.name: go_to_paus_house
73cecc73c30ffaf8.doc: Asks to go to Pau's House and, if yes, jumps to map s27.

73eff3fbc341ed7c.name: leave_for_g03_after_confirm
73eff3fbc341ed7c.doc: If the player confirms leaving, jumps to map g03.

73f7d6822ee5fda8.name: play_voice_message_with_pause
73f7d6822ee5fda8.doc: Plays the streamed voice for a message while showing it, runs the lip sync for voice_frames, then keeps the message prompt visible for hold_frames before closing the window.

74195de7899874b4.name: tilt_train_slope_parts
74195de7899874b4.doc: Turns the train slope on: shifts the six train07 pieces 56 units sideways (m0 to m2 one way, m3 to m5 the other) and tilts them 0.56 rad, then shows the six train02-a step pieces. reset_train_slope_parts undoes it.

742015f81fb083d6.name: play_story_420_then_enter_georama
742015f81fb083d6.doc: Sets story flags up to 416, plays event 420 (the device is switched off) and re-enters Georama edit mode on map 75 at the map start.

7429e9e2dbfc6c5b.name: ask_to_enter_dungeon
7429e9e2dbfc6c5b.doc: Transformed forms (2 or 3) get a message that they cannot go. Otherwise asks whether to go in and returns 1 after a fade out if yes, otherwise 0.

745cf69488f91f21.name: talk_milane_early
745cf69488f91f21.doc: Milane's talk before she can be recruited: her shop only sells blades and she dislikes guns. Then talk_to_npc.

746243ba141ede20.name: talk_to_firbit_villager
746243ba141ede20.doc: Turns the player toward the villager that was talked to and shows that villager's lines: a greeting, then warnings about the Rainbow Butterfly, a craving for Holly's potato pie, or worry about those who left.

746ae5b441547fb3.name: warp_to_spheda_ball
746ae5b441547fb3.doc: Asks whether to warp the player to the Spheda ball (yes/no, worded for Monica when she is active). On yes it finds the point nearest the ball, moves away from any treasure chest there, places the player facing the ball and resets the camera behind them.

746e83c517db7253.name: play_ixion_briefing_scene
746e83c517db7253.doc: Event 616 cutscene aboard the Ixion: Dr. Osmond explains that, with the Atlamillia stolen, the Ixion's time travel system is the only way to travel through time and can be controlled by remote, and Max and Monica decide to look for gems at the star symbols. Skippable.

747d890b27b92199.name: talk_olivie_early
747d890b27b92199.doc: Olivie's talk before the first quest is cleared or before the tournament flag is set: the Firbit people only grant favours to those more skilled than themselves.

74823c9118d1d84a.name: play_arrival_run_in_scene
74823c9118d1d84a.doc: Fade-in scene where Max runs in from the gate side of the map.

749394616698ee70.name: run_voice_message_window
749394616698ee70.doc: Plays a voice line with a message window: opens the voice wav on stream 1, waits for it to be ready, shows the window while the stream plays through run_voice_message, then closes both.

7498384b7c61f70b.name: hide_cedric_and_exit_to_m01
7498384b7c61f70b.doc: Hides Cedric, sets flag 17 if flag 18 is set and 17 is not, then fades and goes outside to map m01. Returns 0.

74b5626872c80d6a.name: talk_donny_shop_closed
74b5626872c80d6a.doc: Donny's talk before the first quest is cleared: his shop is closed and the player is sent to his father's shop at the top of the ladder.

74bd748ca1538502.name: play_atlamillia_check_scene
74bd748ca1538502.doc: Sets flag 523. Max looks at the Atlamillia on his wrist as it glows, then the scene waits for a button press and fades out.

74d6ebfbff92bd24.name: play_village_entry_scene
74d6ebfbff92bd24.doc: Normal arrival at Shigura Village: the gate map parts move and Max walks in from the entrance at (2040, -740), then control returns.

74d91162d2151042.name: debug_play_train_arrival
74d91162d2151042.doc: Debug entry that plays the late train arrival scene.

75015c3160784f92.name: setup_rapis_point_sound
75015c3160784f92.doc: Stops the music, loads sound set 4694 and hides the rapis point when flag 632 is already set.

750c256159338ee4.name: setup_crowd_charas
750c256159338ee4.doc: Loads, places and starts the motions of the six town crowd characters.

7545700cfab7811f.name: setup_map_objects
7545700cfab7811f.doc: Sets up the m01 map objects from flags and story progress: enables the energy pack invent spot when its flag is set, sets up the bridge parts and function points at progress 2 or 3 (else disables event_550), and at progress 100 disables dun01 and enables event_550.

75508cd58756a659.name: play_paznos_robot_then_enter_bridge
75508cd58756a659.doc: Plays the Paznos robot scene and jumps to s30 at entry 650.

756c17da669ce9c5.name: talk_to_shop_or_party_member
756c17da669ce9c5.doc: Talk handler: if the character's local counter is 34 it greets the player and opens the shop with a translucent message window, otherwise it opens the party member menu.

756ce394a3491455.name: play_shingala_fight_plan_scene
756ce394a3491455.doc: Plays event 416 by calling play_electric_fish_plan_scene, where Pau tells Max to put the Electric Fish in Shingala's mouth before the Shingala fight.

75700ca774bfa50d.name: use_slash_branch_on_web_door
75700ca774bfa50d.doc: Web door interaction. With Donny in the party he clears it himself; otherwise the player is asked to use the Slash Branch (item 340).

757d7f40c64931d2.name: play_jurak_lafrescia_seed_scene
757d7f40c64931d2.doc: Plays event 272. Max and Monica ask Jurak about the Rainbow Butterfly. He gives them a Lafrescia Seed and says they need Sundrops, which a Himarra monster can give, and a hint window explains how to get Himarra Badges.

75989e635d2b5d01.name: talk_gordon_quest_offer
75989e635d2b5d01.doc: Gordon's quest offer to Max: he cannot leave because his tree is sick and holy water from the church would cure it. A system message explains quests and the Notebook, with extra lines if the player has no Notebook (item 386). Ends the event and sets quest 0 to accepted. When Monica is active it calls talk_gordon_monica and returns 0.

75a295d0e4b654b2.name: finish_spheda_shot
75a295d0e4b654b2.doc: Ends a Spheda shot: hides the status panel, restores the normal player model, camera and status bar. When the ball went in and the hole was a first clear, awards a medal and shows message 2010; when a missed shot leaves par at 0 or below, shows message 2003.

75aee336a445122d.name: play_battleship_attack_scene
75aee336a445122d.doc: Cutscene on the airship: the heroes plant a bomb that destroys the Fire Squall, celebrate, then Gaspard's battleship arrives and opens fire with cannons and machine guns. They are told to use the Ridepod. Sets the battleship-attack-seen flag.

75b80d2d8ae71290.name: talk_donny
75b80d2d8ae71290.doc: Dispatches Donny's talk. An unfinished first quest gives the early line, then quest 2 picks the offer, the coin hand-in or the recruited line.

760aeb58408b6340.name: setup_station_and_place_player
760aeb58408b6340.doc: Sets up the station map, places the player at the platform and fades in.

7628466ba83aafd9.name: play_e206_scene_then_jump_to_s02
7628466ba83aafd9.doc: Sets the engine part motion, plays the e206 train scene and jumps to map s02.

7628e5e05df58757.name: take_water_gem
7628e5e05df58757.doc: Adds the Water Gem (item 366), marks the current floor as cleared and plays the pickup scene, then re-enables map movement. Characters other than Max and Monica only comment.

7634497809731ddf.name: talk_to_gerald
7634497809731ddf.doc: Talk handler for Gerald. Picks the line by the active character, quest 0 state and quest 11 (Bell Trigger).

7646cd6be15fe7cb.name: play_max_and_monica_run_in_scene
7646cd6be15fe7cb.doc: Test scene: Max and Monica run into view with a fixed camera; ends on a pad press.

766b69423edd3d82.name: start_lin_remembers_scene
766b69423edd3d82.doc: Story 340: fades out and plays the Lin remembers scene.

76b400e551814149.name: park_train_offscreen
76b400e551814149.doc: Until flag 202 is set, moves the train map part out of view.

76bb6223654eb147.name: talk_to_aunt_polly_at_save_point
76bb6223654eb147.doc: Talk handler for Aunt Polly standing at the save point (slot 24). Once the story progress is 100 it greets and opens the shop, otherwise it plays the normal villager talk.

76c9091496ebb96e.name: remove_farewell_scene_actors
76c9091496ebb96e.doc: Deletes all scene characters of the farewell scene and swaps the handles for the final map parts.

76ce32baf41779b1.name: setup_valley_start
76ce32baf41779b1.doc: Initialises the Georama characters, places the player at the valley start and shows the event hint if an event is ready.

76d3741545cb3851.name: play_return_along_path_scene
76d3741545cb3851.doc: Max runs along the path back toward the station platform, then the player is placed on the platform.

76de2c86a6502d16.name: play_lighthouse_arrival_scene
76de2c86a6502d16.doc: Sets flag 348 and plays the scene where Max, Monica and Lin walk toward the Lighthouse and look up at it; skippable. Ends by placing the player outside it.

76e166083279a39d.name: setup_town_entry
76e166083279a39d.doc: Map setup: plays the story event that is due (456, 460 or the 468 interior), otherwise places the player by the previous map number and fades in.

76f658028a9b37a7.name: start_metal_flotsam_fight
76f658028a9b37a7.doc: Program boss_metal_flotsam: starts BGM 107, loads Metal Flotsam (monster 628) with bomb 1006 and places it 500 units ahead of the player, then fades in.

771909cea7dc6ed6.name: play_arrival_run_in_from_town
771909cea7dc6ed6.doc: Program 504: initialises map objects, plays the run-in from the town entrance and leaves the character standing.

7719b5c02a4be7fe.name: play_badge_shop_opening_scene
7719b5c02a4be7fe.doc: Plays event 275. The camera pans across the new shop as its owner announces that rare monster transforming badges are in stock.

771aa407a23a5d02.name: setup_lighthouse_map_start
771aa407a23a5d02.doc: Map start hook that only runs the lighthouse state reset.

771da89cb81afb5c.name: play_sirus_hug_scene
771da89cb81afb5c.doc: Event 732: Sirus, crying, runs and is embraced. Plays without BGM and skips the next BGM load.

77225da5de626c0d.name: play_time_warp_pose_scene
77225da5de626c0d.doc: Places Monica with the blue Atlamillia and plays the time warp motion, then waits for a button press and cleans up.

7724a519351d75b0.name: get_min
7724a519351d75b0.doc: Returns the smaller of a and b.

77280678e72e570b.name: play_miracle_dumpling_cooking_scene
77280678e72e570b.doc: Sets flag 324 and plays Lao Chao cooking with the White Windflower. He hands over the Miracle Dumplings (item 364) with an item get message and the party thanks him. Skippable.

77405bb311ed3b0e.name: enter_dungeon_d05
77405bb311ed3b0e.doc: If the player agrees at the entrance, loads dungeon d05.

7745f4a2a80b3875.name: talk_to_waiting_npc_or_depart
7745f4a2a80b3875.doc: Talking to Osmond after the Chrono Union (flag 640) and before event 648 asks if the player is ready, and if so goes to s37 at entry 520. Otherwise runs the normal waiting NPC talk.

77472f257895c63c.name: setup_lab_room
77472f257895c63c.doc: If flag 400 is set and 428 is not, gives the Shell Talkie and plays the Dr. Nobb scene; otherwise places the player and fades in.

774da4e4b05b1a21.name: talk_adel_ask_materials
774da4e4b05b1a21.doc: Adel asks Max for the materials to sew a garment again: a sturdy cloth, a copper lump and a thick hide. Ends the event and sets counter 8 to 1.

774e897acd0e973a.name: play_shot_party_stands_silent
774e897acd0e973a.doc: Scene shot: the party stands still and the sound effect stops.

7753d5171b6532e4.name: start_buggy_sub_game
7753d5171b6532e4.doc: Plays the buggy chase scene, fades in and starts the buggy sub game.

77614b61d3fcd725.name: choose_final_tuning_aquarium
77614b61d3fcd725.doc: Shows the host's stage message, then a menu of six tuning aquariums, each with a different effect on the fish. Choosing none retires the race (after confirmation past stage 0). Stores the pick, announces the entry conditions and leaves for the race scene in i03h05. Returns -1 if cancelled.

77974f0f213980ef.name: play_floor_exit
77974f0f213980ef.doc: Floor exit scene for the d07 dungeon: crossfades in, the player walks 200 units out while the two gate pieces slide away in the direction set by the exit's yaw, then the screen fades out.

7797624b4255755f.name: setup_forest_story_points
7797624b4255755f.doc: Sets up the forest's event points from the story counter (counter 3): disables them all, then shows the exit piece and next_floor point at 8 or more, the ear pickup between 2 and 6, the Poison Apple pickups (slots 13, 15 to 17) while the apple is not held, and the one story trigger for the current step (fc_e220 without a fishing rod, fc_e230 until the apple scene, fc_e235 at 3, item_e245 at 5, fc_e247 at 6 which also hides the villagers, fc_e253 at 7 once flag 250 is set).

779aac83b7ad2df3.name: talk_aunt_polly_to_monica
779aac83b7ad2df3.doc: Aunt Polly's two-part talk to Monica about Max being a good man, with an offer of bread in chapter 8.

779da885b0105f83.name: handle_locked_chest
779da885b0105f83.doc: Menu for a locked treasure chest: open it with Donny if he is the party NPC, use the Treasure Chest Key item (297), force it, or give up. Forcing triggers the trap bits of chest_type: bit 8 poisons the active character and cuts HP by 70 percent, bit 16 blows up the chest, bit 32 wrecks both weapons' durability. Clears lock bit 2 when unlocked. Returns 1 when the chest stays closed.

77a2713ea0f4ee7b.name: play_alexandra_farewell_scene
77a2713ea0f4ee7b.doc: Skippable event 720: Sirus urges Queen Alexandra to run, she refuses to leave her country and sends him away. Sets flag 720.

77a504c197fc420e.name: show_spheda_stage_7_scores
77a504c197fc420e.doc: Loads the d07f01 Spheda course (mstage7), gives items 305 and 306, places the player and opens the Spheda score view menu.

77aaa59ac4885e57.name: unload_lighthouse_shelling_actors
77aaa59ac4885e57.doc: Removes everything loaded for the lighthouse shelling scene, restores function points, handles and the status bar, then finishes the event.

77b4643cf69856a8.name: play_knock_scene_and_enter_house_keep_music
77b4643cf69856a8.doc: Plays the knocking-at-the-house scene (event 209), then fades out and jumps to interior map g01i07 without reloading the music.

77c80164fe9a019b.name: unload_event_254_charas
77c80164fe9a019b.doc: Cleans up after event 254: re-activates whichever of Max or Monica is the active character, deactivates and unloads the other and its extra motions, deletes character 38, and rebinds and shows the party handles.

77d8a93c2e19a079.name: play_paznos_launch_then_go_to_bridge
77d8a93c2e19a079.doc: Plays the Paznos launch scene and jumps to Paznos Bridge (s30) with the music kept.

77dcdefbf473064b.name: talk_fabio
77dcdefbf473064b.doc: Fabio's talk dispatcher. Quest 0 not yet at state 2 gives his early talk; after that, quest 15's state picks the quest offer (0), the fish check (1) or the joined talk (2). Returns 0.

77df30a48275489b.name: talk_adel_after_joining
77df30a48275489b.doc: Adel's chatter after the clothing quest is cleared, asking how the garment fits. Chapter 8 swaps in a prayer for safety.

77e56db5171c62eb.name: play_shot_need_watches
77e56db5171c62eb.doc: Opening shot of Mayor Need (character 36, actor 4) watching from above while train actor 10 heads off to z -6000 over 120 frames; after 30 frames the camera orbits for 120 frames, then sound 9 of sound_id is stopped.

77f4e32b1d3c0218.name: play_ocean_breeze_and_bridge_scene
77f4e32b1d3c0218.doc: Event 400 (sets flag 400): Max and Monica step off the train and smell the sea breeze, then the train crew promises to fix the broken bridge.

780222b5dd766990.name: talk_to_starlight_temple_villager
780222b5dd766990.doc: Talk handler for the townspeople of Starlight Temple (npc ids 200 to 214): the cook Lao Chao and his miracle shumai, the item and weapon shops (201 and 204), priests worried about Crest, and an old woman urging them to hurry. Dialogue changes with the story flags 324, 330, 372, 400 and 640.

781a4eb8e3e9b31a.name: warp_to_s06b_1_event_500
781a4eb8e3e9b31a.doc: Clears flag 103 and starts event 500 in s06b_1.

781ae7357b69fdc1.name: show_system_message_zero
781ae7357b69fdc1.doc: Shows system message 60 index 0 and returns 0.

78298416fd3c6069.name: start_castle_battle_as_monica
78298416fd3c6069.doc: Debug and story entry for event 50. It gives Monica the Royal Sword, Princess Orb, Princess Boots and Princess Dress, makes her the player, plays the chase scene and places four monsters of kind 523.

782a1d86025e1d5d.name: ask_to_hand_over_white_windflower
782a1d86025e1d5d.doc: Shows the prompt to give the White Windflower to Lao Chao for the miracle dish (open the menu with the # button). Returns 1 if the first choice was picked, otherwise 0.

78310f6fe25fc58e.name: setup_floor_with_donny_call
78310f6fe25fc58e.doc: Event 500: loads the d01f01 floor with its monsters and chests, plays Donny's second call and finishes the floor setup.

7842ef392cc96992.name: place_four_clown_ambush
7842ef392cc96992.doc: Loads the clown monster (600) and places four of them around the player, plays event sound 0, pauses the battle music, sets counter 5 to 2, then shows the status bar and fades in.

785114b2056656cd.name: play_object_lift
785114b2056656cd.doc: Lift object scene: the camera holds on the platform part while it rises 80 units over 60 frames with a lift sound, then control returns.

7854f49cc6764a00.name: setup_boss_floor_2
7854f49cc6764a00.doc: Fades out over 20 frames, plays the boss intro play_monster_intro_e220e, disables the 2f marker, raises map parts p11_d06b02-2 and -3 by 200, places Nightmare (monster 604) and the player at their start positions and fades in.

785a64e624a1949e.name: examine_sleeping_lin
785a64e624a1949e.doc: Looks at the sleeping Lin, who groans in pain.

785dfe6f16b9f49e.name: play_nova_driver_order_scene
785dfe6f16b9f49e.doc: Event 640. Paznos attacks do nothing to the palace, so the crew prepare to fire the Nova Driver. Sets flag 640.

78719c70f792cf3c.name: play_letter_scene_and_remove_item
78719c70f792cf3c.doc: Program 700: removes item 385 from the bag, plays the scene where a letter is read to the group and fades in.

789114bc8e646aae.name: setup_s01_map
789114bc8e646aae.doc: Parks the train, then plays the story 201 scene on the first visit (flag 201 clear) or just places the player, and updates the train event point.

7897ef6eb99889d1.name: play_event_275
7897ef6eb99889d1.doc: Event 275, the opening of the badge shop in Sindain: sets the seen flag, loads the scene, and pans the camera over the shop (a longer pan if analysis flags 105 and 106 are set), with the shopkeeper's welcome and sales pitch as voiced lines. The scene can be skipped; characters are unloaded and the camera reset at the end.

78a5cc78f2f80a59.name: play_lighthouse_arrival_scene
78a5cc78f2f80a59.doc: Sets flag 348 and plays the scene where Max, Monica and Lin walk toward the Lighthouse and look up at it; skippable. Ends by placing the player outside it.

78b1f698262545a7.name: place_ring_of_monsters_with_boss
78b1f698262545a7.doc: Loads Jaming (522) and Shingala (514), places six Shingala on a ring of radius 450 around (250, 250) facing inward and Jaming at the origin, then shows map part p04_d04b01.

78b461b6734258cf.name: play_another_lab_scene
78b461b6734258cf.doc: Event 460, sets flag 460: the heroes notice that there is another lab now and run to go inside.

78c31fd55e878fab.name: show_station_state
78c31fd55e878fab.doc: Shows the late station parts, toggles the gate by flag 640 and shows station map pieces for each bit set in counter 16.

78c71c3f5896e747.name: cleanup_bridge_report_cast
78c71c3f5896e747.doc: Removes the extra characters loaded for the bridge report scene (event 448), keeps the active party member and places the player at the station.

78cb02fd67e3b03a.name: show_need_sighs_and_admits
78cb02fd67e3b03a.doc: Need sighs and admits that Cedric has realised it too, but sometimes it is better not to know.

78e33375668b79ec.name: talk_gordon_holy_water
78e33375668b79ec.doc: Gordon's Holy Water talk. If Monica is active it runs his Monica talk. Otherwise he asks for a cure for the tree and opens the item menu: cancel ends the talk, a wrong item gets a rebuke, Holy Water (item 276) heals the tree and Gordon joins the party. Shows the party tutorial hints, sets the NPC joined and marks quest 0 cleared.

78e5ca81757c4d34.name: play_swamp_villagers_trouble_scene
78e5ca81757c4d34.doc: Event 215: Max and Monica walk into the swamp looking around while the camera circles them, then notice the villagers behaving strangely and decide to talk to them.

78ff3d2ce8b5a245.name: talk_to_lunar_lab_villager
78ff3d2ce8b5a245.doc: Talk handler for the researchers of the Lunar Research Lab (npc ids 300 to 329), in Spanish in this copy. Their lines change with the story flags 640, 456, 420, 408, 616, 600 and 448 and include hints for the electric fish quest and the gem locations.

78ff992616172c5d.name: play_griffon_account_scene
78ff992616172c5d.doc: Calls play_griffon_hatred_vision_scene, the scene for event 610 about Griffon's side of the story.

790d7d443adf7b4a.name: use_luna_stone_gate
790d7d443adf7b4a.doc: Interaction with a gate that has a socket. The player uses the Luna Stone (342) to open it, then may choose to go to the next floor, which updates floor info and starts it. The companion characters (2 and 3) just comment.

7913b935d12d9ada.name: start_map_update_item_prop
7913b935d12d9ada.doc: Map start program; it only updates the visibility of the item prop.

7915d6de3846f819.name: load_firbit_meeting_actors
7915d6de3846f819.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Rococo, Tobo and Conda for event 209 together with the story images (beauty of the forest, the seven grieving, search party formed). Stores the party slots in chara_slot_a and chara_slot_b.

79401d827ec8fec6.name: ask_to_retry_after_miss
79401d827ec8fec6.doc: Monica sighs at a miss and asks if Max wants to retry. Returns 1 on yes, and 0 when he declines because she takes over with a scolding.

7958c59b5317c9ab.name: play_gaspard_confrontation_scene
7958c59b5317c9ab.doc: Event 352, part two. Max and Monica reach the lighthouse where Crest tells Lin to wait and uses the crystal. Monica recognises Gaspard, accuses him of killing her father and challenges him; fireballs surround the party. Ends through unload_gaspard_confrontation_actors.

795e3bd0cde8dcee.name: setup_train_station_entry
795e3bd0cde8dcee.doc: Map start for the train station. Places the player by save load or by previous map (4, 109, or a train from 18, 23, 108, 120), plays the train arrival or train car exit and loads the waiting NPCs.

7981ce8e8f40aa5c.name: talk_fabio_after_joining
7981ce8e8f40aa5c.doc: Fabio's chatter after the fish quest is cleared, asking for fishing tips. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about new fishing spots.

799c677935a5ce6b.name: show_stop_hint
799c677935a5ce6b.doc: Shows a small hint message on how to stop, using the circle button.

79a3fe79fb2547ec.name: talk_olivie_race_won
79a3fe79fb2547ec.doc: Olivie's talk after the fish race: if the race was not won she scorns the player, otherwise she asks to join, is recruited and quest 16 is cleared. Returns 0 only on the scorn path.

79a75690ce30b4d6.name: play_palace_falls_scene
79a75690ce30b4d6.doc: Part of event 640: the cannon hits, and the party sees Griffon's palace falling toward Palm Brinks.

79b31361d6a95a60.name: play_time_travel_explanation_and_join_party
79b31361d6a95a60.doc: Plays Monica's time travel explanation on the station, adds Cedric, Borneo, Erik and Monica to the party, sets progress to 4, gives 5 Armband Repair Powder and then runs the s02_1 event script.

79cd9ad9fc805f9d.name: play_run_into_room_scene
79cd9ad9fc805f9d.doc: Short scene: the player character runs from the entrance into the room while the screen fades in.

79f00e1b5933def2.name: talk_to_train_passenger
79f00e1b5933def2.doc: If the talked-to passenger has local counter 34 it greets the player and opens the shop, otherwise runs the party NPC talk.

79fbc2a755a8fc98.name: play_all_aboard_scene
79fbc2a755a8fc98.doc: Plays event 283: the train conductor calls all aboard before the train leaves.

79fc254d01a9b1b6.name: play_farewell_scene_from_debug_test
79fc254d01a9b1b6.doc: Debug test entry that plays the palace farewell scene.

7a0d99e491615d5c.name: unload_event_275_charas
7a0d99e491615d5c.doc: Cleans up after event 275: re-activates whichever of Max or Monica is the active character, deactivates and unloads the other and its extra motions, and deletes character 37.

7a190eae5ed46884.name: play_parn_intro_scene_as_monica
7a190eae5ed46884.doc: Cutscene where Parn introduces himself as a magical artist and his wife-to-be Julia. A hint then says Monica is no good at this and the player should try as Max.

7a34770c35289573.name: clear_boss_floor_get_item
7a34770c35289573.doc: Boss floor clear. For the alternate characters only shows a short message; otherwise gives item 367, marks the floor as finished (flag 2), runs play_lapis_get_scene and unlocks map moves. Returns 0.

7a78bb68fcfec6b0.name: ask_to_return_to_previous_floor
7a78bb68fcfec6b0.doc: Talk handler for the exit: asks whether to return to the previous floor and loads d05 if yes. The two-character party members get a short reply instead.

7a7d6650dd5396cd.name: warn_player_at_town_edge
7a7d6650dd5396cd.doc: Walks the player a few steps back from the town edge while the camera follows and shows a reminder: hurry to the circus if the player has a ticket, otherwise that the red-headed kid did not come this way.

7a8765b6f7a52678.name: enter_d01_if_confirmed
7a8765b6f7a52678.doc: Asks the leave-the-area question with a fade out and, if the player agrees, jumps to dungeon map d01e01 (Channel Entrance).

7a90bf49e0c17c9a.name: setup_firbit_house
7a90bf49e0c17c9a.doc: Map setup. If flag 247 is set and 250 is not, plays the Firbit return scene and jumps to s47; otherwise places the player at the door and fades in.

7aa4afcdf4bc6239.name: play_loud_and_clear_reply
7aa4afcdf4bc6239.doc: Max answers loud and clear, Cedric tells him to keep his guard up and Max says to leave it to him.

7ab0dbf149912d7e.name: warp_to_death_ark_with_gear
7ab0dbf149912d7e.doc: Debug warp: tops up Premium Chicken to 20, gives and equips Max's Big Bucks Hammer and Soul Breaker and Monica's Ruler's Sword and Destruction Brassard, then loads map s20 at event 600 with BGM 190.

7ab30d32f71e3f9e.name: play_miss_reaction
7ab30d32f71e3f9e.doc: Miss reaction: Max and Monica turn to the camera and wave off with a no-no gesture, then the extra motions are unloaded; Steve and the other non-human character (2 and 3) show nothing.

7aba8d929fe520bb.name: leave_for_balance_valley
7aba8d929fe520bb.doc: Fades to white and jumps to map g02 (Balance Valley).

7ace58e40fd838d4.name: play_opening_stage_fall_scene
7ace58e40fd838d4.doc: Opening chapter 4-1: after the fight the monsters are cleared and the party is restored; Max drops onto the circus stage among the pierrots, and the troupe falls with him.

7ad64313028f9230.name: finish_e732_scene
7ad64313028f9230.doc: Reactivates the player, deletes the e732 scene actors, shows the status bar and finishes the event.

7b0dafbdcd60fa92.name: play_shot_taunt
7b0dafbdcd60fa92.doc: Voiced shot of the elephant's owner taunting the party for running away, laughing as the camera holds. Returns 0.

7b1355cfebd1af11.name: setup_opening_donnie
7b1355cfebd1af11.doc: Opening town setup: stops time, loads Donnie into slot 8 at a fixed spot standing and starts music track 108. Villager AI is set to mode 8.

7b23a0786d5e8fcc.name: finish_cleared_room
7b23a0786d5e8fcc.doc: Runs the shared cleared-room handling when all monsters are defeated.

7b330ac11f962ac3.name: disable_used_event_points
7b330ac11f962ac3.doc: Disables the function points of events that have already played.

7b37654d2f621f93.name: wait_for_confirm_press
7b37654d2f621f93.doc: Waits a frame, then until the button with mask 32 is pressed.

7b3f5b1c2223b183.name: play_ticket_snatch_then_load_town
7b3f5b1c2223b183.doc: Plays the ticket snatch scene and then loads the m06 town script.

7b4452fd38cf418b.name: play_gate_opening_scene
7b4452fd38cf418b.doc: Plays the Fairy Saw opening the exit gate: the gate lifts open with a swing and bounces while the camera turns toward it.

7b4b92a0229c2b4c.name: preview_camera_fly_scene
7b4b92a0229c2b4c.doc: Debug scene: hides the player and moves the camera slowly over the western hill.

7b56b542aed5aa71.name: play_event_352_enter_d03b02
7b56b542aed5aa71.doc: Switches to Max, plays event 352 and loads dungeon d03b02 with event script 502.

7b5b09ea335ae613.name: run_game_over_for_boss_loss
7b5b09ea335ae613.doc: If the boss fight started (flag 716) and flag 728 is not set, plays a voiced game over, picking one of two lines at random. Otherwise plays the silent game over.

7b5da6a502e6adf3.name: start_train_subgame_after_retry_choice
7b5da6a502e6adf3.doc: Plays the defeat scene, asks to retry and starts the train subgame with the answer.

7b64948fb394bb2c.name: play_retry_hint_shot
7b64948fb394bb2c.doc: Closing shot of event 108: Steve stops, the camera fades out and back in, and a message says to access Steve with the O button to challenge Porcus again (retry the fight).

7b6e2969f8edf5ee.name: run_door_map_jump
7b6e2969f8edf5ee.doc: Starts door mode, waits ten frames, then runs the pending map jump.

7b88919fa120ffd1.name: play_train_takeoff_and_go_to_s12
7b88919fa120ffd1.doc: Plays the train takeoff scene and jumps to s12, the Moonflower Palace stop.

7b8d6e63a3fb47f9.name: play_gate_opening_scene
7b8d6e63a3fb47f9.doc: Raises the exit gate's map piece with a sound while the camera turns toward it. Used after the Key Handle is used.

7b975b5a2564eb11.name: load_epilogue_scene_cast
7b975b5a2564eb11.doc: Loads Max and Monica with their equipment and the event 732 motion sets and message file, hides the map part p06_d06b03-0, and first switches the player from the Ridepod forms (characters 2 and 3) back to Max or Monica.

7b9b01aca1fae993.name: talk_milane_after_joining
7b9b01aca1fae993.doc: Milane's two-part chatter after the sword quest is cleared, about the beauty of a well-made sword. Chapter 8 swaps in a question about tough guys in the mine.

7ba4f4e38665bce2.name: talk_milane_max
7ba4f4e38665bce2.doc: Milane's line to Max. Before chapter 8 he talks about being seen at the circus, in chapter 8 he asks about the mine.

7bb4c6873588ac2d.name: talk_blinkhorn_after_joining
7bb4c6873588ac2d.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's chatter after he has joined the party, praising Max's speed. Chapter 8 swaps in an offer of help.

7bc1fd7deb9c6a84.name: load_event_270_actors
7bc1fd7deb9c6a84.doc: Loads the actors for event 270: Max and Monica with their e270 motions and the message file, storing the party slots in event_270_max_slot and event_270_monica_slot.

7bc324d7d42b22ca.name: wait_camera_script
7bc324d7d42b22ca.doc: Waits frame by frame until the camera path script has finished.

7bc3b23ec94517d9.name: play_monica_teaches_spheda_scene
7bc3b23ec94517d9.doc: Event 314. After the player finds a Handy Stick, Monica explains how to hit the Sphere, repeating the lesson until the player says they understand. Sets flag 314.

7be93dc95c7df4d5.name: talk_parn_after_joining
7be93dc95c7df4d5.doc: Parn's chatter after the gold paint quest is cleared, about his new power. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about the depth of painting.

7bee8798fe1ef8a5.name: start_chapter_8_after_request_scene
7bee8798fe1ef8a5.doc: Plays the Zelmite request scene, sets progress to 10, shows chapter title 8 and puts the player at the park entrance.

7bf18bb4d3f89f9d.name: play_story_410_scene
7bf18bb4d3f89f9d.doc: Sets story flags 400 to 408 and clears 410, then plays event 410 (Shingala).

7bf32bc21e5cd9a5.name: play_cedric_gets_off_train
7bf32bc21e5cd9a5.doc: Swings the train door parts (train11-m1, train12-m1, train12-m3) open over 30 frames, then Cedric (actor 2) walks out over 75 frames, turns and jumps down to the platform with a landing motion.

7bfdd6154352d43e.name: leave_lighthouse_if_confirmed
7bfdd6154352d43e.doc: Asks about leaving and loads the d03 dungeon script if confirmed.

7c04d5a1b1595a76.name: start_timed_boss_battle
7c04d5a1b1595a76.doc: Starts the timed boss fight: starts boss music 39, saves the time of day in counter 10 and sets it to 24 with time frozen, loads and places monsters 621 and 622, starts a 5 minute stopwatch and fades in.

7c33c74bce68fdd3.name: talk_to_monster
7c33c74bce68fdd3.doc: Monster talk handler: reads the monster's talk data and runs the shared talk camera and conversation helper with the id offset by 1000.

7c405e08e2863c94.name: play_andrea_finds_sirus_scene
7c405e08e2863c94.doc: Sets flag 744. At noon Andrea plays hide and seek with the Sun spirit Sirus, finds him, they wrestle and laugh together.

7c5868b22756002c.name: play_time_gate_scene_and_go_to_g01
7c5868b22756002c.doc: Event 502: plays the Time Gate explanation and jumps to g01.

7c70c0153da0ed5a.name: talk_milane_quest_offer
7c70c0153da0ed5a.doc: Milane's quest offer to Monica: she says Monica must build up a sword twice before she is taken seriously and hands her a Gladius, shows the item message and opens the overflow menu if needed. A system message explains the requirement. Ends the event and sets quest 10 to accepted.

7c76924f70945378.name: show_game_over_message
7c76924f70945378.doc: Shows game-over system message 60 plus index in the second message window (run_game_over passes the active character: 0 Maximilian, 1 Monica, 2 ride pod, 4 for the monster form when Monica can take over). Returns 1.

7c932258cc4a0bcc.name: play_osmond_hologram_scene
7c932258cc4a0bcc.doc: Event 616: the party arrives at Kazarov Stonehenge, and a projector plays a hologram message that explains that Griffon has come to their time, that Paznos can be brought through a Chrono Union at Stonehenge, and that the four coloured gems and a key are needed.

7c98652468f6da15.name: leave_for_g02_if_confirmed
7c98652468f6da15.doc: Event 500: runs the exit question and, if the player agrees, jumps to map g02 with its map start event.

7caf9c4325ddd263.name: start_dungeon_from_map_menu
7caf9c4325ddd263.doc: Opens the dungeon map menu, sets stage and floor from the result, and loads d04f01 or d04f02 with treasure boxes and monsters and plays the intro scene. Floor 3 loads d05b01 instead.

7ce2816fbb4e6fa3.name: show_protect_lin_hint
7ce2816fbb4e6fa3.doc: Swaps between Max and Monica (switch_main_unit) and on first use (flag 64) pauses the game to show the hint to protect Lin from the evil flames.

7ce8394c6fc1e104.name: lock_map_movement
7ce8394c6fc1e104.doc: Sets the no-map-move bit control flag.

7ceb5ad322c32ea8.name: talk_to_station_people
7ceb5ad322c32ea8.doc: Dispatches talking to station people: Cedric offers train departure to Balance Valley, Borneo is the mechanic, Erik the bomber, Osmond a waiting passenger.

7cf9a263ea7e8b22.name: press_panel_row1_col2
7cf9a263ea7e8b22.doc: Presses the puzzle switch for the panel at row 1, column 2, toggling it and its neighbours.

7cfadb13b8e710cf.name: on_save_point
7cfadb13b8e710cf.doc: Opens the save menu with a short fade.

7d0c8bcbaef844d6.name: enter_f03i04_entrance_1
7d0c8bcbaef844d6.doc: Event 402: turns to face south-east, fades out, sets map counter 2 to 1 and jumps to map f03i04.

7d0ca0dac0a516b3.name: play_train_arrival_cutscene
7d0ca0dac0a516b3.doc: The train with smoke rolls in from behind, stops, tilts its slope parts, and the player runs off it to the platform before the screen fades and control returns.

7d15560bffdb05bd.name: play_story_202_train_scene_and_board
7d15560bffdb05bd.doc: Fades out, plays the Blackstone Railroad arrival scene and jumps to map s08 (Inside of Locomotive) at event 501.

7d63539c00d2eaea.name: hide_rapis_point
7d63539c00d2eaea.doc: Disables the Rapis event point and hides its map piece.

7d698f26c4cad258.name: talk_claire_monica
7d698f26c4cad258.doc: Claire talks to Monica: asks if she is Max's girlfriend and compliments her unusual hair color.

7d71a66d31a53027.name: play_gordon_idea_scene_on_story
7d71a66d31a53027.doc: Story trigger for event 254b: plays the Gordon idea scene.

7d887bc413f6fa16.name: open_menu_keeping_bgm
7d887bc413f6fa16.doc: Opens the menu with a fade. While flag 4 is set the BGM reload is skipped so the music keeps playing.

7d8ea0a3d7ebd80e.name: take_shell_talkie_and_enter_shigura
7d8ea0a3d7ebd80e.doc: Sets flag 400 (Veniccio arrival seen), clears the Shigura flags 432, 436 and 438, removes all Shell Talkies (item 373) and enters Shigura Village (edit mode 90), so the without-item arrival plays.

7d93fc3f4c5fc13a.name: play_event_336_scene
7d93fc3f4c5fc13a.doc: Debug test program: plays event 336, the scene where a master asks Lin why he wants to be a sage.

7d971407ac1ea422.name: run_game_over_silent
7d971407ac1ea422.doc: Runs the game over sequence with no message (-1) and returns its result. revive is passed through.

7db19ed9d40ea1c4.name: play_beam_volley_then_go_to_s70
7db19ed9d40ea1c4.doc: Plays the beam volley scene and jumps to map s70 (Moonflower Palace).

7db486701ff45178.name: play_halloween_collapse_scene
7db486701ff45178.doc: Cutscene after the first dungeon boss: Halloween collapses and explodes while a mourning character rushes in, and the player's character is shown in disbelief. The trial version plays a shortened version that ends the event. The normal version continues with voiced dialogue, fragments flying and the characters carried away, then restores the party and the camera.

7dbc3784f8cb7d5d.name: play_fields_scene_after_init
7dbc3784f8cb7d5d.doc: Initialises the Georama characters and plays the Balance Valley fields explanation scene.

7dc18472173931de.name: show_town_hall_closed_message
7dc18472173931de.doc: Shows a message that City Hall is closed.

7dcc3877a4c638c1.name: enter_dungeon_d05
7dcc3877a4c638c1.doc: If the player agrees at the entrance, loads dungeon d05.

7ddae63fe604dd9c.name: place_seated_firbits_before_meeting
7ddae63fe604dd9c.doc: Places the seated Firbits only while flags 250 and 247 are both unset.

7deee8390db20334.name: show_georama_progress_1_title
7deee8390db20334.doc: Shows the caption card for Georama progress 1, the flower bed restored.

7def4bf2c717ff05.name: play_shot_touch_atlamillia
7def4bf2c717ff05.doc: Shot in Cedric's house: Max asks Cedric why the circus goons want his pendant, Cedric says Mayor Need probably knows and he will question him, and Max touches the Atlamillia pendant and promises not to give it up.

7dfabe241e1054bc.name: play_farewell_then_jump_to_flashback_room
7dfabe241e1054bc.doc: Plays the farewell scene and jumps to map s46 (Max's room, flashback) at program 530.

7e0563fd304b731b.name: play_elephant_victory_scene
7e0563fd304b731b.doc: Event 108a. After the elephant falls, Max strikes a victory pose and a line plays, a flotsam flies off and narration about the outside world follows, then the Ridepod tutorial. Sets flag 108, then Steve the Ridepod becomes the active character at the platform.

7e0c909c20781294.name: ask_to_start_counterattack
7e0c909c20781294.doc: Turns the player and the NPC toward each other and has him announce the counterattack on Griffon. Asks if the heroes are ready. Returns 1 for yes, 0 for no after a warning about the golem troops.

7e146665e75a0410.name: go_to_floor_d06b03
7e146665e75a0410.doc: Fades out and loads dungeon map d06b03.

7e1bb7ed60cf0cba.name: ask_blinkhorn_race_start
7e1bb7ed60cf0cba.doc: Asks whether to start Blinkhorn's race. Declining ends the talk and sets counter 7 to 0; accepting starts the stopwatch and sets counter 7 to 1.

7e2a996e6636f7d4.name: play_floor_clear_scene
7e2a996e6636f7d4.doc: Monsters-cleared program of the dungeon system script; it only plays the floor clear jingle and message.

7e2acefe87c8fca6.name: leave_for_s09
7e2acefe87c8fca6.doc: If the exit question is answered yes, jumps to map s09.

7e2d6233927e796c.name: start_npc_talk
7e2d6233927e796c.doc: Starts a talk by turning the player and the NPC to face each other (camera set when set_camera is nonzero). If restore is set it first reads the NPC's current yaw and returns it; otherwise the returned value is unset.

7e3c58868107db09.name: shake_head_at_closed_door
7e3c58868107db09.doc: The player turns to the camera, shakes their head (no no) and turns back. Used when a train door cannot be used.

7e4534846924ecc3.name: play_event_240_and_advance_story
7e4534846924ecc3.doc: Plays event 240, sets counter 3 to 5 and refreshes the story point objects.

7e5b047bd43f9097.name: play_finny_frenzy_announcement_scene
7e5b047bd43f9097.doc: Event 424: Mayor Need and Morton walk through town talking about the Finny Frenzy fish race that follows the fishing contest, and a help window explains that the two events alternate in the square.

7e6bcd9708aa101b.name: setup_station_arrival
7e6bcd9708aa101b.doc: Map setup. After a memory card load or from map 77 it loads Osmond and places the player at fixed spots; arriving from certain maps with counter 1 equal to 8 it plays the train arrival; otherwise it plays the default train scene.

7e94ba5e9935595c.name: clean_up_e364_scene
7e94ba5e9935595c.doc: Removes the extra characters loaded for event e364 and restores the active character.

7e957856b2540bc8.name: play_train_overloaded_scene
7e957856b2540bc8.doc: Event 205. Sets flag 205 and shows Cedric shouting that the train can take no more, Vorneo fainted and Tom in a panic.

7e9b2653f87c8296.name: warp_to_s43_event_8002
7e9b2653f87c8296.doc: Clears the scene and loads map s43 at event 8002.

7ea3e03410e6481e.name: talk_rosa_quest
7ea3e03410e6481e.doc: Granny Rosa's recruiting talk: she asks the player to speak slower, marks quest 19 accepted and opens a text entry that must read 'let's adventure together'. If entered correctly she joins and quest 19 is cleared; otherwise she does not understand, and cancelling leaves quietly. Returns 0 unless she joins.

7ea5d0cbbe862566.name: talk_mina_check_spheda
7ea5d0cbbe862566.doc: Mina's check on the Spheda minigame. If Max has cleared fewer than 10 Spheda floors since counter 19 was recorded she repeats that she is still unwell and the event ends (returns 0). Otherwise she is cured, joins up through recruit_talk_npc and quest 17 is set to cleared.

7ea65cc5065d9257.name: play_ending_movie_and_epilogue
7ea65cc5065d9257.doc: Plays the ending movie END2.PSS with Spanish subtitles for non-English languages, then shows the epilogue still image until a button is pressed and fades out.

7eae5483eac109a9.name: check_pad_control
7eae5483eac109a9.doc: Returns whether the given pad button is pressed; a thin wrapper over check_pad_button.

7eaf2f7531419c80.name: play_opening_town_run_scene
7eaf2f7531419c80.doc: Opening scene: the player runs along a long fixed path through the town for 430 frames while the camera pans, then fades out and jumps to map m06 at entry 152.

7ebac5548e9b425f.name: setup_event_235_actors
7ebac5548e9b425f.doc: Loads the Max and Monica scene actors for event 235 and its message file. Sets globals max_chara_slot and partner_chara_slot.

7ebb20f58a76dcfc.name: start_lapis_room
7ebb20f58a76dcfc.doc: Sets up the room. If the Earth Gem is not yet taken it plays the boss intro, disables the rapis point, blocks map exit and places Trentos.

7ec32d7f238150c6.name: play_red_time_gate_with_party_check
7ec32d7f238150c6.doc: Plays the red time gate scene with both characters shown if Monica is in the party, then resets the world coordinates.

7ee9dacbc5c5f13f.name: wait_for_press_with_fixed_camera
7ee9dacbc5c5f13f.doc: Sets a fixed camera target and waits for pad button 64.

7eee6d128ded9e8e.name: talk_claire_flower_photo
7eee6d128ded9e8e.doc: Claire's flower photo talk. Monica gets a different talk. If no flower photo has been taken she reminds the player; otherwise she joins the party and quest 4 is cleared.

7ef7af3f608db725.name: leave_for_i02h01
7ef7af3f608db725.doc: Hides character 8, plays the Need confession scene, shows it again and jumps to map i02h01 at entrance 500.

7efe3f22c38dbe54.name: replay_freed_scene
7efe3f22c38dbe54.doc: Story jump: sets earlier story flags, plays event 420 and opens Pau's House in Georama.

7f0f7dc884441f5c.name: pick_up_memo_item
7f0f7dc884441f5c.doc: Player walks to the memo on the wall, turns to it, the memo is hidden and item 386 is added with a get message. Opens the item limit menu if the bag is full.

7f1075bfbeecf178.name: use_moon_clock_hand_on_key_door
7f1075bfbeecf178.doc: Key door: with the NPC party member 4 it opens at once, otherwise it asks for the Moon Clock Hand item.

7f18cb07ba263242.name: start_train_subgame
7f18cb07ba263242.doc: Starts the train buggy sub-game unless cancel is set: with cancel 0 the engine moves, the screen fades in and the buggy game starts; otherwise sets the exit flag and fades in, returning 0.

7f1b6cc92bd23e7c.name: play_train_pass_by_cutscene
7f1b6cc92bd23e7c.doc: Flashes the train light, then the train rushes past the camera with sound effects and the screen fades out.

7f2a6ebd84ec43bc.name: report_scoop_progress
7f2a6ebd84ec43bc.doc: Scoop dealer's progress report. With no Inside Scoop Memo he tells the player to fetch one (returns 0). Otherwise reports new scoops figured out and new ones obtained, or that none are left, then runs the photo reward check and returns its result. In map 22 the talk uses the NPC's own window, elsewhere a centred one.

7f2e666aec3381e7.name: play_paznos_robot_scene
7f2e666aec3381e7.doc: Part of event 640: the party is surprised that Paznos turned into a robot.

7f37076b26ae4c8a.name: is_georama_3_complete
7f37076b26ae4c8a.doc: Returns 1 when town 3 (Georama) is 100 percent complete, otherwise 0.

7f39542b2554f6a2.name: play_shot_elephant_laugh
7f39542b2554f6a2.doc: Voiced shot of the elephant trumpeting while its owner laughs and mocks the party. snd_id is the sound bank.

7f3bc1d0dd3684a9.name: talk_waiting_npc
7f3bc1d0dd3684a9.doc: Talk with the NPC who waits at the station: says to wait here, with a different closing line once the waiting-NPC-released flag is set (telling the player to beat Griffon). Then talk_to_npc.

7f3bf9a16a876ea0.name: play_geostone_found_scene
7f3bf9a16a876ea0.doc: Plays event e254: sets the item board expanded flag, and Max and Monica run in to meet someone who says they found some Geostones and invites them to use the Carpenterion to rebuild the forest.

7f3cb4e56775fce4.name: play_angry_return_scene_and_resume
7f3cb4e56775fce4.doc: Event 510: plays the angry return scene, removes Steve from the party, enables the e108c function point and returns to the map script.

7f43c638af6d0862.name: ride_elevator_one
7f43c638af6d0862.doc: Elevator at (684.8, 6024.3): asks the floor, then places the player on the chosen floor (heights 0, 1160 or 2320) with the elevator sound. Arriving on the second floor can trigger event 508.

7f470179e50df485.name: place_two_sphinxes
7f470179e50df485.doc: Loads the Sphinx (monster 43, model e212d), places two of them at (256.8, 0, 230.3) and (-147.9, 0, 624.8) facing -3.06, and pauses the battle music.

7f59c05ad8162f5b.name: talk_aunt_polly_after_joining
7f59c05ad8162f5b.doc: Aunt Polly's chatter after the bread delivery quest is cleared, asking where to go next. Chapter 8 swaps in an offer of bread.

7f665f49c934688d.name: set_georama_analysis_two_flags_and_jump
7f665f49c934688d.doc: Sets georama analysis flags so only 0 and 1 of group 2 are set, sets flag 460 and clears 456, and jumps to map 82.

7f680bf5efd17f20.name: use_dynamite_on_rock
7f680bf5efd17f20.doc: Talk handler for the rock blocking the path: after confirming, opens the item menu and, if Dynamite (item 173) is used, plays the Dark Genie intro scene and starts the boss fight with monster 629. Other items make the character refuse.

7f71b99a7cf644ec.name: play_holly_scene_then_go_to_station
7f71b99a7cf644ec.doc: Plays the Holly reflection scene and jumps to s02 (Sindain Station).

7fa1846d903a0426.name: play_event_616
7fa1846d903a0426.doc: Event 616 at Kazarov Stonehenge: a ship lands with a shake and the party steps out and places a device that projects a figure. It tells Max that Griffon has appeared in his time and that a Chrono Union must be made at the stone pillars to bring Paznos across, using four gems, and that the key to find them is in the centre of the Stonehenge. Long cutscene with voiced lines, skippable.

7fb57bc59d75c81e.name: ask_to_travel_to_palace_stop
7fb57bc59d75c81e.doc: Asks to travel to the Moon Flower Palace stop (map s34).

7fbceede44aeb498.name: play_ancient_past_arrival_scene
7fbceede44aeb498.doc: Sets flag 600 and plays event 600: the train lands in the past, Max and Monica jump down and talk about the strange sky, Griffon's palace and what lies ahead.

7ffe9716d7bdec44.name: play_fade_scene_then_go_to_s46_530
7ffe9716d7bdec44.doc: Fades out, plays play_farewell_scene and jumps to map s46 at event 530.

80248f119d36a1f4.name: open_cleared_room_door
80248f119d36a1f4.doc: Opens the floor's exit door: opens it on the minimap, lifts the two door panels (d07d05_1-m0 and m1) 100 units, swaps the closed d07da05a/d07dv05a pieces for the open 05b ones and disables the door01 function point. Returns 0 if there is no visible door.

80255715b9f195a6.name: play_ixion_plan_story_and_go_to_s09
80255715b9f195a6.doc: Plays the Ixion plan scene and jumps to map s09 (Veniccio Station).

802d9f194c1eb0da.name: setup_forest_charas
802d9f194c1eb0da.doc: Loads the Spirit Forest characters. When requested it loads the fisherman Noam, Wicky, Mogri, Zak and four hidden poison apples; always loads Master Utan and places him depending on flag 253, enables the matching func points and shows the boss when event 240 has been seen and 245 has not.

80497a74b0b621d7.name: play_elephant_defeated_scene
80497a74b0b621d7.doc: Event 108: after the elephant boss is defeated Max and Steve strike a victory pose and Max narrates about heading to the Outside World. Sets flag 108.

807d91fdf6c9b4ba.name: leave_for_i02h01
807d91fdf6c9b4ba.doc: Hides character 8, plays the scene where Need agrees to reopen the railroad, shows character 8 again and jumps to the Station map i02h01 entrance 500 without reloading the music.

808f96ea0f04b175.name: play_materials_and_money_scene
808f96ea0f04b175.doc: Event 521: plays lesson stage 2, the praise and money scene.

808fd9764416f350.name: show_timed_message_at
808fd9764416f350.doc: Opens a message at a screen position, runs it for a limited number of frames with voice and resets the message slot. Returns the frames elapsed.

80a001208ed590c2.name: talk_osmond_aquarium_plan_owned
80a001208ed590c2.doc: Osmond's lines when the player has the Aquarium plan but not the item: build it, feed the worm to a fish, then feed the fish to the Shigura.

80a3873b78915ab9.name: play_train_leaves_shot
80a3873b78915ab9.doc: Follows the train as it runs off down the track.

80b7844d23085d49.name: open_treasure_chest
80b7844d23085d49.doc: Opens a dungeon treasure chest according to its type bits. A mimic chest (256) spawns a mimic, after party NPC 9 warns and asks whether to open it anyway. Locked (2) and trapped (4) chests run their handlers first and may abort. Empty (512), clown (128) and plain chests then open with the right sequence. Returns the first item id when opened, else 0.

80e20b34c32fd4f1.name: play_event_307_enter_s46
80e20b34c32fd4f1.doc: Leaves the dungeon floor d03f01, plays event 307, then loads map s46 with event script 510.

81023363f2ea12c9.name: play_flotsam_rematch_hint_scene
81023363f2ea12c9.doc: Shows Steve and Max in the room and a message telling the player to talk to Steve with the O button to fight Flotsam again.

8106baa334aeb346.name: talk_milane_to_max
8106baa334aeb346.doc: Milane's talk when Max is the active character: he mentions the circus. Chapter 8 swaps in a question about tough guys in the mine.

810af4b26685c7b6.name: show_need_agrees_to_reopen
810af4b26685c7b6.doc: Need agrees to re-open the railroad.

8118415f97d764fa.name: play_floor_clear_scene
8118415f97d764fa.doc: Dungeon floor clear event: removes monsters, plays the active character's victory pose, opens the exit door, marks the floor as cleared, shows the medal messages, announces any broken seals (Red, Blue, White) and, if the Spheda sub game is available, asks whether to move to the Spheda ball.

8132c64b29d5d272.name: play_griffon_in_the_past_scene
8132c64b29d5d272.doc: Plays a short scene with only voices: Griffon is ten thousand years in the past and sends a powerful consciousness to the present, which his servants sympathise with. Resumes BGM 59 if flag 43 was set. Skippable.

8139ebebbee980bb.name: enter_inside_of_train
8139ebebbee980bb.doc: Does nothing while event 203 is running. Otherwise unlocks map movement, sets counter 0 to 1 and jumps to map s07, Inside of Train.

81558b7796d0e86f.name: show_spheda_score_view
81558b7796d0e86f.doc: Loads the d04f01 floor, sets up Spheda, puts the player on the course and opens the Spheda score view menu.

8177eaa2bc3725db.name: setup_s04_map
8177eaa2bc3725db.doc: Event 501: places the map objects and plays the scene play_borneo_ready_to_depart_scene (flag 372).

819ea95f9e69af76.name: open_door_with_luna_stone_piece
819ea95f9e69af76.doc: Opens the key door right away if Donny is with the player. Otherwise asks for the Luna Stone Piece (item 343) from the item menu.

819ebc87a6b9c21d.name: show_fixed_camera_until_button_press
819ebc87a6b9c21d.doc: Sets a fixed camera view and waits for a button press before clearing effects and finishing the event.

81a4f74ea6a13631.name: setup_lighthouse_cape_events
81a4f74ea6a13631.doc: Starts music 17 and sound set 3682, and disables the event points and map part of events 348 and 352 once those have been seen.

81b0fc0f32a178b5.name: play_dark_genie_intro_scene
81b0fc0f32a178b5.doc: Sets flag 816 and plays the scene where Max and Monica find Zelmite Ore, a buggy explodes and the Dark Genie appears, mentions Flotsam and threatens to eat them. Skippable; starts the boss music (BGM 40) afterwards.

81b8814e5c587ee0.name: start_lighthouse_arrival_scene
81b8814e5c587ee0.doc: Disables the e348 event point, fades out and plays the arrival scene.

81c96e44f23e4f3d.name: play_alexandra_welcome_scene
81c96e44f23e4f3d.doc: Cutscene (event 700, sets flag 700): in the Moonflower Palace Alexandra welcomes Max and Monica, asks them not to blame Sirus (Griffon) and says the palace garden holds shared memories. A light ends the scene.

81d4691f2d6ccece.name: ask_to_enter_starlight_canyon
81d4691f2d6ccece.doc: Asks whether to move to Starlight Canyon. Returns 1 if the player agrees and runs off, otherwise the character walks back and it returns 0.

81d874095988abc1.name: play_backstory_then_warp_to_s49
81d874095988abc1.doc: After the first fight: clears monsters, makes Monica and the fourth character selectable, plays Gaspard's backstory scene and loads map s49 event 500.

81ded71c83373ae4.name: play_ringmaster_show_opening_scene
81ded71c83373ae4.doc: Opening scene at night: the ringmaster and four pierrots announce a show in a wonder-themed night, strike poses and run off. Uses a voice stream and is skippable.

8205416351bb5815.name: talk_stewart_after_joining
8205416351bb5815.doc: Stewart's chatter after the book auction quest is cleared, about the book he got. Chapter 8 swaps in a warning about Zelmite Mine.

822dd8c58677ca67.name: turn_player_to_chara
822dd8c58677ca67.doc: Turns the player on the spot to face the given character, with a turn time based on the angle, then returns to standing.

8230c2216928db11.name: load_spheda_bonus_course_4
