8230c2216928db11.doc: Loads the d05f01 Spheda course (mstage4) with a map and magic crystal, sets up the hole and opens the score view menu.

824ba506805dd140.name: show_item_obtained
824ba506805dd140.doc: Shows the 'obtained item' message for item in window 3 with the system sound and waits for it to be dismissed.

824e85bcfc8c2003.name: play_elena_reunion_and_go_to_observatory
824e85bcfc8c2003.doc: Plays the Elena reunion and jumps to map s29 (Paznos Observatory) at event 600.

82567cabb30460fc.name: play_alexandra_farewell_scene
82567cabb30460fc.doc: Sets flag 720. Sirus begs Queen Alexandra to flee from the approaching enemies, but she refuses, saying she must live and die with her country, and he cries out as the scene fades.

8263dce7a72b1ea3.name: exit_to_next_d04_floor
8263dce7a72b1ea3.doc: Like program 200 but moves on to the next floor of d04 first, restarting the dungeon music before loading the d04 script.

826e1d316f28e803.name: load_d06b02_map
826e1d316f28e803.doc: Loads dungeon d06b02 and runs its map start event.

828885d1ed9e0fec.name: ask_to_return_to_d02_with_gem
828885d1ed9e0fec.doc: Exit point of the Lapis room. Ridepod and monster forms only get a message. Without the gem (flag 624) it says so. Otherwise asks to leave and loads the d02 dungeon script.

829a505e0211b59f.name: setup_room_for_story_flags
829a505e0211b59f.doc: Stops the music and shows the room in the state matching story flags 23, 24 and 260 (before the flower scene, flower grown, vines grown), enabling the matching event triggers e255 and e256.

829c2d0f6defa5cf.name: ask_move_to_dungeon_entrance
829c2d0f6defa5cf.doc: Asks the yes or no question for moving to the dungeon (item 160). Fades out and returns 1 on yes, otherwise returns 0.

82a68b3a1038367a.name: give_photo_hints
82a68b3a1038367a.doc: Cedric gives hints, with pictures, on where to find the Milk Can (the bakery across the way), the Pipes (the shop roof) and the Belt (Officer Blinkhorn).

82ad486934471d94.name: load_event_209_charas
82ad486934471d94.doc: Sets up Max and Monica as scene actors, loads Rococo, two edit part models and the event 209 message file.

82b54a90bde07641.name: talk_need_safe_code
82b54a90bde07641.doc: Need's safe code puzzle. He gives three riddle clues; the player can hear them again or enter a four-digit code in the name entry menu (the answer is 1221). A wrong code leaves the safe shut; the right one opens it, he joins the party via recruit_talk_npc and quest 12 is cleared. Returns 0 if the player cancels or the code is wrong.

82d1a3bd79c900bb.name: restore_player_after_hologram_scene
82d1a3bd79c900bb.doc: Cleans up after the hologram scene: reactivates the active character, deletes the other one, hides the hologram props and puts the player back on the station platform.

82e31f0348613b6f.name: unload_mardan_hooked_actors
82e31f0348613b6f.doc: Removes the models used by the Mardan hooked scene, keeping the active character.

82f857627c0da220.name: play_event_105_camera_scene
82f857627c0da220.doc: Cutscene in which Cedric gives Max the Camera. It sets flag 105, loads the cast, plays the shots and restores the camera afterwards.

8306dd527f93d6c1.name: show_rooftop_camera_orbit
8306dd527f93d6c1.doc: Loads the rooftop roof models and Donny at night (time 24.0), orbits the camera around them, waits for a button press, then removes the extra models.

830b48a1941702e3.name: leave_for_s64_map
830b48a1941702e3.doc: Fades out, hides the partners, clears monsters and loads map s64 at event 500.

832185026e072f29.name: unload_lafrescia_explosion_scene
832185026e072f29.doc: Ends the Lafrescia explosion scene: reactivates the player's character, deletes the temporary actors and the other party member, and clears effect scripts.

83294c1aea3c04c9.name: play_golem_slope_charge_middle_columns
83294c1aea3c04c9.doc: Variant of the slope charge in which only columns 3 to 5 of the golems run up the slope.

8341eaacf4aa1d2d.name: play_opening_max_flees_scene
8341eaacf4aa1d2d.doc: Opening movie part 4, chapter 1. Max, hanging from a swing and then in battle stance, gets away across the rooftops, then it loads the s43 script at event 152.

8343ca33a100ca14.name: party_walks_off
8343ca33a100ca14.doc: Monica turns and walks toward a spot 20 frames away while Max stands.

8345c6354b3bf01d.name: ask_question_at
8345c6354b3bf01d.doc: Opens message mes_no at the given position, runs a choice list of choice_count entries starting on the cursor entry, clears the window slot and returns the chosen index.

8348e9d4093d28f3.name: play_gundor_departure_and_leave_for_heim_rada
8348e9d4093d28f3.doc: Story 452 handler: sets up the station, plays the Mt. Gundor departure scene and the train steam, then opens the world move menu and jumps to map s10 (Heim Rada Stop).

834d3986a268fe7a.name: play_circus_performance_scene
834d3986a268fe7a.doc: Opening scene (chapter 2): the circus show with the elephant, juggling clown and strongman, with a ball act, that Max watches.

8353e0be7b7a2c80.name: play_palace_beam_flee_scene
8353e0be7b7a2c80.doc: Cutscene: the pair realise Griffon is behind the attack, a burning figure runs in circles, a moonflower beam is fired at them, they run off and spot Conda and the others while a voice shouts at Max to run. Skippable; ends with the s70 map setup.

8357faa95bec2fa2.name: lerp_by_step
8357faa95bec2fa2.doc: Interpolates from start to finish_value at step out of steps.

835c3bcd50f46e07.name: restart_metal_flotsam_fight
835c3bcd50f46e07.doc: Starts the Metal Flotsam fight again.

835d1547288d10cc.name: send_max_to_train_roof
835d1547288d10cc.doc: A crash startles the crew ("It came from outside!") and one tells Max the ladder leads to the train roof. Max nods and answers "Got'cha!" once his nod is about a quarter through.

835fe7f73acc53ae.name: warp_to_luna_lab
835fe7f73acc53ae.doc: Plays the red gate warp and jumps to map f03 (Luna Lab).

8362b40dcfa2d7bb.name: setup_house_start
8362b40dcfa2d7bb.doc: Runs the shared house setup and places the player at (0, 9, 171) facing into the room.

83698ba9696c57ce.name: setup_dark_genie_fight
83698ba9696c57ce.doc: Boss setup: fades out, shows map part p06, starts music 40, loads and places the boss monster (629), places the player and camera, and fades in.

8379c3d53b2ed0ba.name: play_halloween_appears_scene
8379c3d53b2ed0ba.doc: Pierrots and the villain Halloween with the Pol Curse staff land in front of the camera, and he challenges Max. Fades out.

838376f9f96bbbef.name: play_osmond_report_scene
838376f9f96bbbef.doc: Cutscene (event 616, sets flag 616): Osmond runs up to Max and Monica to report that the Moonflower Palace has somehow returned to the present, and they wonder what Griffon is planning.

83adf1bfba565f65.name: start_station_map
83adf1bfba565f65.doc: Places the player on arrival. If flag 31 is set and the item board is not yet expanded it plays the Geostone scene and jumps to s47. Otherwise it picks an arrival scene from the previous map: from a dungeon, from town, or by train depending on chapter.

83b440b4a46903d6.name: play_flotsam_taunt_after_boss
83b440b4a46903d6.doc: Restores full HP, switches to Max, plays the Flotsam taunt scene and goes to Palm Brinks edit mode 10, entry 531.

83b636d40e8940db.name: place_max_and_wait_for_button
83b636d40e8940db.doc: Places Max at (-240.84, 50, -5.32) and waits for a pad press.

83bbea2881b6bd37.name: run_message_choice
83bbea2881b6bd37.doc: Runs a choice cursor in a message window: starting at cursor, moves it with the stick or d-pad within choice_count rows, plays cursor sounds, confirms on the confirm button and closes the window. Returns the chosen row, or -1 when cancelled unless no_cancel is set.

83c06803006c0aa0.name: open_spheda_menu_and_start_course
83c06803006c0aa0.doc: Fades out, makes sure the Spheda music (193) plays and opens the Spheda menu. If the chosen entry is not 18 it leaves extra mode, otherwise it loads the d01f01 floor with the mstage0 layout, gives the Map and Magic Crystal, sets up hole 0 and opens the score view.

83d8b00faebc7f5f.name: talk_need_after_joining
83d8b00faebc7f5f.doc: Need's chatter after the safe quest is cleared, about sorting garbage. Chapter 8 swaps in a warning about Zelmite Mine.

83da5c9464f66db4.name: play_gaspard_death_scene_and_leave
83da5c9464f66db4.doc: After the second fight, plays Gaspard's farewell, sets a floor flag and loads map s49 at program 510.

83de634970acc030.name: start_shingala_boss_fight
83de634970acc030.doc: Starts the boss music and places six 514 monsters in a ring around (250, 250) plus the 522 boss (Shingala under Gaspard's control).

83fe6ec025454c5a.name: reset_flag_215_and_refresh
83fe6ec025454c5a.doc: Clears flag 215 and counter 3, then runs setup_forest_charas(1) and play_odd_villagers_notice_scene.

840c9a0266eb178a.name: talk_aunt_polly_to_monica
840c9a0266eb178a.doc: Aunt Polly's two-part talk to Monica about Max being a good man, with an offer of bread in chapter 8.

8410756b7e62e0f3.name: play_flotsam_rematch_scene
8410756b7e62e0f3.doc: Plays the rematch offer. If accepted it plays the ride-out cutscene on Steve and sets flag 56; returns 1 on accept, 0 otherwise.

841e27cdc6c615aa.name: open_floor_select_map
841e27cdc6c615aa.doc: Plays the dungeon BGM, opens the dungeon map menu, stores the chosen floor and starts it.

84203e1553a236bb.name: talk_parn_after_joining
84203e1553a236bb.doc: Parn's chatter after the gold paint quest is cleared, about his new power. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about the depth of painting.

84401a6703a1032d.name: play_event_732
84401a6703a1032d.doc: Event 732 after the boss fight at the end of the moon dungeon: sets the boss-event flag, the beaten enemy gloats and collapses, then Sirus recalls he is the Guardian of the Stars, destroys the moon in a rain of light and says goodbye to Alexandra. Long voiced cutscene with music changes; skippable.

84425d52f3b1bbc7.name: ask_to_go_back_a_floor
84425d52f3b1bbc7.doc: Previous-floor exit: blocked during the fight with a hint to feed the fish to Shingala; otherwise asks and loads the d04 script on yes.

844d8ff1e185a8de.name: add_event_250_motions
844d8ff1e185a8de.doc: Adds the event 250 motion sets to Max and Monica.

8483a72167367f22.name: play_time_gate_activation_scene
8483a72167367f22.doc: Cutscene (event 612 part 1, sets flag 612): smoke pours from the lid, a ring rises into the sky and the time gate opens.

8497e592e35a8556.name: talk_to_villager_about_claire
8497e592e35a8556.doc: Used when the save progress value is 100. A villager turns toward the player and says either that Claire has found something interesting and asks Maximilian to come to the usual place (Erik, once flag 22 is set), or that they have no idea where Claire is.

84c00f1b196c8e1b.name: reset_heim_rada_georama_for_story_548
84c00f1b196c8e1b.doc: Story 548: resets the Heim Rada georama analysis flags, sets the 552 and 556 flags and returns to the workshop map.

84cbca8b8ba84e1b.name: on_map_start
84cbca8b8ba84e1b.doc: On map start, plays the approach scene if flag 600 is set and flag 604 is not. Otherwise opens the gate parts if flag 604 is set and places the player at the entrance.

84eacfaff18530e2.name: go_to_rear_car
84eacfaff18530e2.doc: Rear door. Moves to the next car and reloads its NPCs, except in the last car (car 3) where the player shakes their head.

84fa8df5e6c1c6d6.name: jump_to_event_270
84fa8df5e6c1c6d6.doc: Sets the Georama analyze flags and story flags 270 to 285 so that only event 270 is still pending (its flag cleared to 0), then jumps to map 25 and waits. Debug-style entry for that story point.

85038cd700f7af48.name: replay_yorda_tree_arrival_scene
85038cd700f7af48.doc: Story 332 handler: fades out and plays the Yorda Tree arrival scene.

850d51dc59738ad8.name: play_grape_juice_knock_scene
850d51dc59738ad8.doc: Cutscene (event 209, sets flag 209): Max and Monica knock at a house and talk about bringing grape juice for the Firbits; the door opens and they go in.

852018db118a3fbb.name: replay_first_floor_help_scene
852018db118a3fbb.doc: Story event 100: loads d01f01 and plays the first-floor help scene.

852024a31198940b.name: show_important_book_hint
852024a31198940b.doc: Event program that makes Max remark that there may be an important book here but he cannot tell right now.

853b6c4924dcda52.name: play_race_result_scene
853b6c4924dcda52.doc: After a race, loads sounds and runs the results. On a loss the character is disappointed and the host consoles the player, and the race number resets.

853bce54d71d69fb.name: load_geostone_scene_actors
853bce54d71d69fb.doc: Loads the actors and images for event 254: Max and Monica, Conda, a Geostone model and two story images. Stores the party slots in player_slot and partner_slot.

8540ca8ba5d63e64.name: play_train_arrival_late
8540ca8ba5d63e64.doc: Train arrival scene at the station: the train slides in, the door opens, the player runs out of the train and is placed on the platform. Hides the shadow at night and hides and restores the station villagers.

8558a3b546d1d272.name: play_train_departure_under_moonflower_beam_scene
8558a3b546d1d272.doc: Event 616: the party runs along the platform to the train while the Moon Flower beam B effect fires and the doors are worked, then the train pulls away with accelerating motion. Ends by fading out and resetting the camera.

8561e13fdc4f3f01.name: show_message_auto_button2
8561e13fdc4f3f01.doc: Opens an automatically placed message, waits for input with the second button check on, closes the window and returns the frames waited. Writes whether the extra button was pressed to extra_pressed.

856c4e624f306850.name: start_griffon_third_phase
856c4e624f306850.doc: Plays the third phase scene, puts the player at the room center and places the third phase boss (monster 617).

85738c189476dbbb.name: play_fishing_announcement_from_debug
85738c189476dbbb.doc: Debug entry that plays the fishing tournament announcement.

85746e095e897c42.name: play_middle_golems_march_shot
85746e095e897c42.doc: Variant of the golem march in which only golems 31 to 59 march toward the camera.

858e101365483496.name: give_priscleen_to_mardan
858e101365483496.doc: Event 506: removes Mardan's character, plays the reward scene, sets the story counter to 6 and refreshes the story points.

859b24ff486011f6.name: clear_village_charas
859b24ff486011f6.doc: Deletes character slots 8 to 25 and resets the memory stack.

85d85bec30290d4e.name: talk_to_monster_npc
85d85bec30290d4e.doc: Monster talk handler. Before the story is finished, the monster with talk id 52 gives a Sundrop once (flag 290); all other monsters use the standard monster talk.

85e50a49ec457f10.name: play_floor_exit_walk_scene
85e50a49ec457f10.doc: Walks the player's character away from the camera and fades out, before the next floor loads.

85fb6ca7aca4fd10.name: play_shot_train_leaves
85fb6ca7aca4fd10.doc: Opening shot of the train pulling out of the station: moves train actor 10 from z -1690 to -3050 over 90 frames with the camera fixed, and waits for it.

860fa79740bceaad.name: play_try_fishing_holy_one_scene
860fa79740bceaad.doc: Skippable event 235: they decide to fish the Holy One out with a fishing rod and Poison Apples as bait, followed by a fishing tutorial message. Sets flag 235.

861e363a12360710.name: restore_floor_at_story_312
861e363a12360710.doc: Story jump to 312: sets flags 300 and 320 and clears flags 312 and 314 to 317, then sets up the floor from the flags.

862b3ddb3c732a13.name: leave_for_palm_brinks
862b3ddb3c732a13.doc: Exit to Palm Brinks. Until flag 103 is set, Max says Flotsam may still be looking for him and refuses; afterwards it asks and jumps to map m01.

862cf9104cb0c849.name: can_play_event_460
862cf9104cb0c849.doc: Returns 1 when event 460 (finding the new lab) can play in the second town: analysis flag 302 is set, the event has not been seen, and the party can switch to character 1 (Monica). Otherwise 0.

8631032eea375f53.name: start_villager_talk
8631032eea375f53.doc: Greets the villager with a speech bubble, shows their idle line, and lets the villager talk to the player.

863e0830d3952c9a.name: play_nova_driver_fires_scene
863e0830d3952c9a.doc: Event 640. The Nova Driver is readied, aimed and fired at the palace. Sets flag 640.

86552b0b2ddf8d9e.name: play_ridepod_departure_then_enter_dungeon
86552b0b2ddf8d9e.doc: Same as play_ridepod_departure_and_join, but on departure goes straight to dungeon 0, floor 4 with event 520.

86606ee16d8ae76e.name: play_max_and_monica_run_along_road_scene
86606ee16d8ae76e.doc: Test scene: Max and Monica run along the road with the camera following a path; ends on a pad press.

866571a8bc1fd1ec.name: start_morning_scene
866571a8bc1fd1ec.doc: Resets counter 5 and plays the morning ticket scene.

86695d77c60ab89e.name: restart_edit_event_if_door_0_closed
86695d77c60ab89e.doc: Program 206: if the door on side 0 is not open, requests an edit event restart.

866ff3edac34d732.name: ask_system_question
866ff3edac34d732.doc: Asks system question 1000 plus question in message window 1 and returns the chosen option: question 0 offers two options, question 1 offers three.

86b28c1dd4a2b258.name: go_to_heim_rada
86b28c1dd4a2b258.doc: Warps through the blue gate to Heim Rada (g04).

86b93ecf538d5550.name: go_to_channel_entrance
86b93ecf538d5550.doc: If the player agrees, jumps to d01e01, the Underground Channel entrance.

86d9b3bbf98bf646.name: talk_need_after_joining
86d9b3bbf98bf646.doc: Need's chatter after the safe quest is cleared, about sorting garbage. Chapter 8 swaps in a warning about Zelmite Mine.

870556ae30c819bc.name: warp_to_boss_floor_after_story_536
870556ae30c819bc.doc: Story 536 program: warps to boss floor d05b01 and runs its story_536 program (15360 = 536*10+10000).

871763fead4cf739.name: talk_stewart
871763fead4cf739.doc: Stewart's talk dispatcher. Monica gets her own talk. Otherwise quest 0 not yet at state 2 gives his early talk; after that quest 6's state picks the quest offer (0), the auction talk (1) or the joined talk (2). Returns 0.

87183103a939c202.name: talk_to_station_npc
87183103a939c202.doc: Cedric is the train driver and Osmond is a waiting passenger.

871844bff53c3399.name: reset_lighthouse_state_globals
871844bff53c3399.doc: Disables the e348 function point if flag 348 is set and resets the scene globals (vector max_saved_x, max_saved_y, max_saved_z with max_saved_z = 30, vector monica_saved_x, monica_saved_y, monica_saved_z) used by the Gaspard events.

872c46d6c7a89a4f.name: test_arrival_sound
872c46d6c7a89a4f.doc: Debug entry that plays a sound from the e300 sound set after button presses.

8738cdcb1d63255b.name: talk_claire_early
8738cdcb1d63255b.doc: Claire's line before the player has progressed far enough: she teases that he has been going outside the town. Monica gets her own talk.

875ad6305ec78072.name: play_golem_army_sighted_scene
875ad6305ec78072.doc: Event 540. The crew see Griffon's golem army, which was made by destroying a mountain, and prepare weapons. Sets flag 540.

8782745ff57af062.name: open_item_limit_menu
8782745ff57af062.doc: If the item limit is reached or the bag overflows, opens the item-over menu (town or dungeon version by game mode); with use_fade set it fades out before and in after.

87abc664baddfabc.name: talk_ferdinand_early
87abc664baddfabc.doc: Ferdinand's talk before the first quest is cleared: he compares his cooking research to Max's machine discoveries.

87bfb4899f85e4af.name: continue_energy_pack_lesson
87bfb4899f85e4af.doc: Event 520: picks the next lesson stage from what Max has done. With the pack made it plays the finish scene; with enough materials it tells him to build; with the Energy Pack idea card it gives him money and materials advice; otherwise it replays the idea lesson or returns to the shop script.

87c18f2ef9e0c8f8.name: play_paznos_crew_stations_scene
87c18f2ef9e0c8f8.doc: Event 540. Galen orders all hands to prepare the Paznos launch and the crew rush to their stations. Sets flag 540.

87c5c69dd971093c.name: handle_locked_chest
87c5c69dd971093c.doc: Handles the locked-chest prompt. If the partner is Donny he can open it; otherwise it offers the Treasure Chest Key from the item menu. Forcing the lock instead triggers the chest's trap: poison (bit 8), an explosion that destroys the chest (bit 16) or weapon damage (bit 32). Returns 1 when the player gave up or the chest was destroyed, 0 when it is now unlocked.

87ccd3ed023dc63f.name: leave_for_s47
87ccd3ed023dc63f.doc: Plays the scene where the Firbits return and Conda asks Max and Monica to find Holly, then jumps to map s47 (Sindain event) at entry 501 without reloading the music.

87d1e83643e7a2ed.name: play_briefing_and_go_to_kazarov_stonehenge
87d1e83643e7a2ed.doc: Plays Eina's briefing and jumps to map s11 (Kazarov Stonehenge) at entry 520.

87d6acd83fe876c1.name: show_slot_bubble_message_wait
87d6acd83fe876c1.doc: Shows a bubble message in a window slot and waits until the player closes it.

87e6436152048a8f.name: run_boss_loss_game_over
87e6436152048a8f.doc: Game over after a loss. If flag 808 is set and 812 is not, plays one of two random voiced game overs, otherwise a silent one.

87e99abae527985b.name: play_nova_driver_order_and_go_to_s32
87e99abae527985b.doc: Plays the Nova Driver order and jumps to map s32 at event 610.

87ebc7ec6ed17adf.name: play_blue_gate_warp
87ebc7ec6ed17adf.doc: Blue time gate warp. With Monica in the party it plays the return scene; otherwise it may first play the blue Atlamillia glow scene (once) and then plays the jump to the future.

880209d98f25c8a0.name: crack_open_chest
880209d98f25c8a0.doc: Cracks the chest open a little: the lid lifts for six frames, the chest-open sound plays, then the lid eases partly back over five frames.

88087c3ad272b0e9.name: talk_donny_to_monica
88087c3ad272b0e9.doc: Donny's talk when Monica is the active character: he says he has hardly seen Max since she arrived and hopes she is not using him.

8811c7c821750c0c.name: play_shot_opening_pan
8811c7c821750c0c.doc: Opening shot: wipes in with a slow camera pan, then stops the music and loads BGM 193.

881238d68a2057ce.name: talk_corinne_after_joining
881238d68a2057ce.doc: Corinne's chatter after the hide-and-seek quest is cleared, saying it is for little kids. Chapter 8 swaps in a line asking Max to tell her about his adventures.

88140d5ec203ea5a.name: talk_donny_quest_offer
88140d5ec203ea5a.doc: Donny's quest offer: Monica's version is handed to talk_donny_monica. For Max he first refuses, then offers to help if the player finds the Iron Wall and Dark coins he collects, and marks quest 2 accepted. Returns 0.

883125cb59cc8c17.name: slide_train_to
883125cb59cc8c17.doc: Eases actor 2 (the train) to z = -1000 + z_offset over the given frames.

883d58b9326dc0c4.name: refresh_pond_by_counter
883d58b9326dc0c4.doc: Runs the setup_forest_charas pond update with 1 while counter 3 is below 7 and with 0 once it reaches 7.

884b675d37612396.name: run_silent_game_over
884b675d37612396.doc: Player-dead handler: runs the silent game over.

8850bdd97f9a91d6.name: run_message_until_dismissed
8850bdd97f9a91d6.doc: Runs a message with talking animation and voice until the player dismisses it. a1 allows skipping, and a2[0] is set to 1 if the player skipped. Returns the frames elapsed.

88530a3f719826a1.name: talk_gerald_to_monica
88530a3f719826a1.doc: Gerald's talk when Monica is the active character, asking if she is a friend of Max. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about helping Need and Cedric rebuild the world.

88805bed45f468d3.name: ask_girl_about_kid
88805bed45f468d3.doc: Talks to a girl, asking about the red-headed kid, and gets a reply that she does not know.

888332ae857e4567.name: fade_out_and_play_e348_scene
888332ae857e4567.doc: Disables the e348 function point, fades out and plays the e348 scene.

88a9d7e8744fc467.name: go_to_previous_train_car
88a9d7e8744fc467.doc: Event 202. Fades out and moves to the previous car by decreasing counter 0, or leaves for map s37 from the first car.

88aa6fa27b14bec8.name: wait_for_press_with_blank_camera
88aa6fa27b14bec8.doc: Moves the camera to the origin and waits for pad button 64 to be pressed.

8911a3f18a0eee7a.name: press_panel_row0_col1
8911a3f18a0eee7a.doc: Presses the puzzle switch for the panel at row 0, column 1, toggling it and its neighbours.

891663581f343e22.name: talk_to_villager
891663581f343e22.doc: Runs the generic villager talk handler for the station NPCs (shopkeepers and villagers with chapter dependent lines).

893c8c9ce93bc637.name: talk_to_man_saying_circus_started
893c8c9ce93bc637.doc: A townsman says the circus has already started.

894709be682673d5.name: open_door_with_channel_key
894709be682673d5.doc: Opens the locked door right away if Donny is with the player. Otherwise asks for the Channel Key (item 338) from the item menu.

894f6893bbf032c9.name: show_important_book_hint
894f6893bbf032c9.doc: Event program that makes Max remark that there may be an important book here but he cannot tell right now.

89544b4857ff75f7.name: play_atlamillia_blue_glow_scene
89544b4857ff75f7.doc: Cutscene (event 522, sets flag 522): Max looks up as his Atlamillia shines blue, narrating that the blue light reached to the past and Monica's Atlamillia may be lending its power. a0 to a3 set the world origin.

8961573926dd5464.name: place_player_with_white_fade_in
8961573926dd5464.doc: Places the player at a fixed spot with the camera behind and fades in from white.

8964647a537d5c92.name: unload_holly_scene
8964647a537d5c92.doc: Ends event 260: reactivates the player's character and deletes the temporary actors, sprites and image.

896d67232c08b2e1.name: start_floor
896d67232c08b2e1.doc: Sets up the chosen floor. Floor 0 returns to Balance Valley, floors 8, 15, 18 and 23 load special maps (s17, s14, s18, s56 or d03b01), floor 21 starts the fishing tournament (s45) and floor 2 plays event 307 (s46). Other floors pick d03f01, d03f02 or d03f03 by range, with a 1 in 8 chance of rain, and place monsters and chests.

8987a01ac213b3fb.name: play_dungeon_entry
8987a01ac213b3fb.doc: Dungeon entry scene for d04: the player walks in from high up while either the floor map (show_map set) or the dungeon title logo fades in and out. Monsters are paused until the camera is reset behind the player.

89898b543cf429f2.name: start_dream_spiral_fight_3
89898b543cf429f2.doc: Applies the debug loadout and starts the third dream spiral boss event on map d06b02.

899d977d66fac2f2.name: fade_in_on_map_start
899d977d66fac2f2.doc: Resets the camera behind the player and fades in.

89ab24e5fb2796f9.name: play_king_collapsed_scene
89ab24e5fb2796f9.doc: Plays the second part of event 50. Monica opens the door, sees the king collapsed and Guiltoni escaping through a time gate. She staggers away.

89af5624debf8d3b.name: talk_mina_quest_offer
89af5624debf8d3b.doc: Mina's quest offer: she feels unwell from the warped space. If Monica is active she recognises it and the player is told to restore the Spheda. Accepts quest 17 and records the player's Spheda clears in counter 19.

89b06030cf980c75.name: warp_to_metal_flotsam_boss
89b06030cf980c75.doc: Debug warp: sets Max and Monica to 240 HP and 94 defence, gives and equips a fixed loadout and loads map s54 with the Metal Flotsam boss event.

89bdda20e713f27e.name: finish_floor_when_monsters_cleared
89bdda20e713f27e.doc: Plays the floor clear scene when all monsters on the floor are dead.

89d41e882d14471d.name: play_palace_arrival_scene
89d41e882d14471d.doc: Plays the Moonflower Palace welcome scene.

89d60a729bf60e4a.name: use_priscleen_on_swamp_master
89d60a729bf60e4a.doc: Item use point: asks whether to give the swamp master the Priscleen (item 310) and runs event 506 if the player gives it, otherwise plays a miss reaction.

89ef76773521ad93.name: load_e732_scene_actors
89ef76773521ad93.doc: Loads the e732 scene actors (Sirus, Andrea, the memory frame) and the message file.

89f6af6ee4c966af.name: play_middle_golems_march_shot
89f6af6ee4c966af.doc: Variant of the golem march in which only golems 31 to 59 march toward the camera.

89fa69bb343ab54b.name: start_floor
89fa69bb343ab54b.doc: Starts a floor of dungeon d05. Floor 0 returns to Heim Rada, floors 8 and 16 load maps s16 and s20, floor 22 loads boss map d05b01, floors 1 to 15 and 17 to 21 load the dungeon layouts with monsters and chests and play the matching arrival scene.

8a1e1e5a978f6885.name: play_room_music
8a1e1e5a978f6885.doc: Loads sound set 8694 and plays battle music 190 while any of counter 17 bits 16, 32 and 64 is unset, otherwise the calm track 193.

8a244c4a078b1b26.name: show_griffon_story_title_card
8a244c4a078b1b26.doc: Fades in with a black card reading the title of event 610 and pauses the game while it shows.

8a25e021445bd15f.name: play_boss_death_scene
8a25e021445bd15f.doc: Pauses monster AI, clears monsters, and plays the death animation of the b07a model with a sound. Then places the player and ends the event.

8a35470e24721105.name: replay_station_event_504
8a35470e24721105.doc: Resets the slope parts and hides the villagers, runs play_train_cleared_toward_balance_valley_scene, restores both and loads event script s02_1 with event 504.

8a3f02449d7658a7.name: set_flag_42_and_play_gordon_idea_scene
8a3f02449d7658a7.doc: Sets flag 42 and plays the Gordon idea scene.

8a4cec59929e1d8c.name: run_aim_control
8a4cec59929e1d8c.doc: Golf aim loop: the stick turns the player left or right (only where the swing is clear) and sets the pitch between 5 and 30, the camera follows behind and the aim guide is redrawn each frame. One button returns 0 (take the shot), another returns 1 (leave aim). The yaw and pitch come back in the array parameters.

8a54ebd2f51cb3eb.name: play_story_412_osmond_meeting
8a54ebd2f51cb3eb.doc: Story entry for event 412: sets flag 408 and plays the Osmond Electric Worm scene.

8a66e51845e8647a.name: talk_blinkhorn_busy_away
8a66e51845e8647a.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk when he is not at his post by the gate: he says he is busy gathering materials for the town's safety and asks Max to come back tomorrow.

8a71d832f12e2012.name: play_camera_flythrough
8a71d832f12e2012.doc: Hides the player, flies the camera along a long path and waits for a button press before returning control.

8a7aded0db3c793e.name: open_cobweb_door
8a7aded0db3c793e.doc: Cutscene of the player clearing a cobweb from a locked door in dungeon 2. Turns the player to the door, holds the camera behind, plays the web-removal animation with a sound (different key models for Max and Monica) and the web vanishing, then opens the door on the minimap, hides its door pieces and disables its key point.

8ab033c9d05fbf23.name: clear_floor_after_monsters_defeated
8ab033c9d05fbf23.doc: Runs the floor clear sequence when all monsters are defeated.

8ab1db5cda0a2796.name: setup_station_arrival
8ab1db5cda0a2796.doc: Station start: runs play_conda_grape_juice_scene, gives item 370, opens the item limit menu if needed, hides map part p09_s0201, loads the station villagers, tilts the train slope parts and loads event script s02_1.

8ac489443bb7835f.name: wait_frames
8ac489443bb7835f.doc: Waits frames plus one frame (the loop runs while the counter is 0 or more).

8acb11a4c1f9137e.name: play_train_arrival
8acb11a4c1f9137e.doc: Cutscene of the train arriving at the station and the party stepping out at the platform: train slides in, doors swing open and the player appears.

8acc2a56337cd037.name: play_golem_slope_charge_scene
8acc2a56337cd037.doc: Event 540 variant: all hundred golems run up the slope toward the fortress from a fixed camera, with the lead golem ending at a set point.

8ad7ce37186813e7.name: start_second_gaspard_fight
8ad7ce37186813e7.doc: Plays the transformation scene, shows the boss platform, spawns monster 511 and places the player for the second fight.

8ae7a2f96a558356.name: play_paznos_appears_scene
8ae7a2f96a558356.doc: Part of event 640: the Chrono Union takes effect and Paznos appears over the stones.

8b0cf0592e8f5e3f.name: play_shot
8b0cf0592e8f5e3f.doc: Runs one full Spheda golf shot: checks the club, loops aim and power gauge, then simulates the ball flight with gravity, spin, wall and ground bounces, water splashes and the pin attraction. A hole-in sets the clear count, spawns the prize chest and shows the finish banner or bonus score; a lost ball or leaving the aim returns the ball and uses a stroke. Always ends through finish_shot.

8b230c0679c9ad5a.name: setup_house_entry
8b230c0679c9ad5a.doc: Fades in over 20 frames, puts the player at the room's entrance and resets the camera behind them.

8b2440c14f60d9ee.name: use_floor_gate_1
8b2440c14f60d9ee.doc: Uses the floor gate with index 1.

8b4dfd02aabb79b0.name: enter_georama_map_17
8b4dfd02aabb79b0.doc: Enters Georama edit mode on map 17 at event 153.

8b5e308bf59d8022.name: warp_to_d02b02_point_2570
8b5e308bf59d8022.doc: Clears the scene and loads dungeon d02b02 at event code 2570 plus 10000.

8b764938fcf52c31.name: play_griffon_hatred_vision_scene
8b764938fcf52c31.doc: Sets flag 610. A dark vision with Griffon's voice about humans not valuing existence; a flower bursts into light in front of Max and Monica and the voice says humans should be wiped out.

8b8d8cce4d0bd488.name: use_fire_horn_on_lava
8b8d8cce4d0bd488.doc: Talk handler for the lava: after confirming, opens the item menu and, if the Fire Horn (item 354) is used, hides the lava piece and plays the lava parting scene. Other items make the character refuse.

8b9a2eb23954f740.name: play_farewell_to_crest_scene
8b9a2eb23954f740.doc: Max and Monica tell Lin they could not save Crest. Lin says the future changed and he will become a sage as he promised Master Crest, and thanks them. Skippable.

8ba6bfbec4bce624.name: play_hide_and_seek_scene
8ba6bfbec4bce624.doc: Event 744 (sets flag 744, BGM 113): a game of hide and seek in the palace garden where Sirus is found and both laugh.

8bb6ffff19d5946e.name: talk_fabio_early
8bb6ffff19d5946e.doc: Fabio's talk before the first quest is cleared: fishing is his hobby and he dreams of catching a Mardan Karayan.

8bc460eb1b033963.name: play_party_jump_down_shot
8bc460eb1b033963.doc: Max and Steve jump down into the arena with a following camera and dust effects at the landing.

8bc9b248a4df591c.name: ask_to_leave_for_d02
8bc9b248a4df591c.doc: Exit prompt: only Max or Monica can use it. Without the gem (flag 624) it says so; otherwise it asks and on yes loads dungeon d02.

8bc9d13405d0aa73.name: ask_to_leave_and_run_out
8bc9d13405d0aa73.doc: Asks the leave-the-area question (item question 2). On yes the player runs out and the screen fades; returns 1. On no he steps back and returns 0.

8bccfcca93b4a00b.name: handle_villager_talk
8bccfcca93b4a00b.doc: Villager talk dispatcher for the town: reads the talked-to character and slot, then characters up to number 34 go to the Palm Brinks villager conversations and the rest to the by-kind dialogue.

8bec87f82ca206b9.name: report_new_scoops
8bec87f82ca206b9.doc: Scoop reporting talk: asks for a Scoop Memo if the player has none, says there are no more scoops when all are known, otherwise reports newly learned and newly obtained scoops. Ends with check_scoop_reward and returns its result, or 0 when no memo.

8c0ff24a262d1e29.name: pick_up_notebook
8c0ff24a262d1e29.doc: Max walks to the memo, hides it, and receives the Notebook item.

8c117af13b8a0536.name: play_ending_and_go_to_stonehenge
8c117af13b8a0536.doc: Plays the ending scene, sets the story progress to 10 and jumps to map s66 (Kazarov Stonehenge) at entry 520.

8c2f3a9acc88157a.name: play_circus_crowd_opening_scene
8c2f3a9acc88157a.doc: Opening scene (chapter 1): Max in a circus crowd cannot see over the people in front of him and tries to get a view of the act.

8c2f91911b1e5809.name: play_opening_letter_scene
8c2f91911b1e5809.doc: Plays the opening: black screen with Max's letter narration, then the rainy night run along the path and Max opening a door, with the skip option enabled.

8c4ebbc238c658bd.name: play_train_arrival
8c4ebbc238c658bd.doc: Cutscene of the train arriving at the station and the party stepping out at the platform: train slides in, doors swing open and the player appears.

8c6d9024b6f784cf.name: show_bubble_message_with_anim
8c6d9024b6f784cf.doc: Shows a speech bubble message and waits for it to be closed while an actor plays a talk animation.

8c7281a01ae6114a.name: play_floor_clear_scene
8c7281a01ae6114a.doc: Event that runs when all monsters on a dungeon floor are dead. Plays the character's victory pose, marks the floor as cleared (floor info flags 2 and 1024), shows the fast-clear and floor challenge medal messages, the Spheda and flag 317 hint messages, and announces any broken red, blue or white seals before returning control.

8c7c45d38a739e1b.name: wait_for_button_at_origin
8c7c45d38a739e1b.doc: Points the camera at the origin and waits for a pad button press.

8ca595b279c3e4b7.name: setup_monster_601_boss_arena
8ca595b279c3e4b7.doc: Boss room start: plays BGM 190, places the player, shows the room objects and places monster 601.

8cbad019bd859bee.name: start_luna_lab_suggestion_scene
8cbad019bd859bee.doc: Sets up the characters and plays the Luna Lab suggestion scene.

8cd074d1b7b9ec33.name: confirm_map_exit
8cd074d1b7b9ec33.doc: Asks whether to leave the map. On yes it fades out and returns 1; otherwise returns 0.

8d2bf9529d59e8b7.name: start_s43b_event_151
8d2bf9529d59e8b7.doc: Starts BGM 103, locks map movement and the minimap, hides the two partners and loads the s43b event script at 151.

8d3d0b3e303faf52.name: use_item_on_lin
8d3d0b3e303faf52.doc: Runs the interaction with Lin's bed.

8d4b51fe6c0787c2.name: party_inspects_rococo
8d4b51fe6c0787c2.doc: Max and Monica look down at Rococo, Monica peers in, and then Monica pulls Rococo's beard. Moves the actors and camera between several shots.

8d4ec7d9e607fe2a.name: play_baru_gives_remedy_scene
8d4ec7d9e607fe2a.doc: Event 434, sets flag 434: elder Baru hears about the injured Shigura on the far shore and gives Max and Monica the Shigura medicine.

8d53c594ec77bfdc.name: play_lapis_garter_intro_scene
8d53c594ec77bfdc.doc: Event 628 intro. Plays the boss music, shows the Lapis Garter (monster e253e) attacking in the empty room with a title telop, then fades out.

8d67e9d71fc8aceb.name: talk_fabio_after_joining
8d67e9d71fc8aceb.doc: Fabio's chatter after the fish quest is cleared, asking for fishing tips. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about new fishing spots.

8d69f2822c06f1cf.name: unload_priscleen_actors
8d69f2822c06f1cf.doc: Removes the models used by the Priscleen Fish delivery scene.

8d6d71da5708995b.name: debug_setup_spheda_course
8d6d71da5708995b.doc: Debug entry that sets up the Spheda course in mode 1.

8d6f9c16761b1719.name: talk_to_station_npc
8d6f9c16761b1719.doc: Talk handler for Osmond, waiting at the station. When flags allow it asks about departing and jumps to s37 if ready, otherwise says they will wait.

8d8504e9af2b465b.name: start_m06b_event_152
8d8504e9af2b465b.doc: Clears flags 1 to 3, gives item 353 and loads the m06b event script at entry 152.

8d8cace20b5c5aa3.name: play_sick_in_bed_then_enter_d03
8d8cace20b5c5aa3.doc: Plays the sick-in-bed scene, then loads dungeon d03f01 and starts its event 500.

8da05f34fa6d422f.name: place_player_at_func3_point
8da05f34fa6d422f.doc: Initialises the Georama characters, plays a sound and places the player at the func3 point facing away from it.

8dc644f4091489c4.name: show_stop_prompt
8dc644f4091489c4.doc: Opens a plain bottom-screen hint telling the player to stop the spinner with the O button, in Japanese or English by language.

8dd12b5ca20e9cce.name: leave_for_i02h01_entry_500
8dd12b5ca20e9cce.doc: Runs the play_need_confession_scene scene, then jumps to map i02h01 at entry 500 without reloading the BGM.

8ddfd901b86e678c.name: talk_to_girl_asking_what_you_do
8ddfd901b86e678c.doc: A girl asks what the player is doing.

8e0da0b9a9c77cab.name: play_story_408_then_enter_georama
8e0da0b9a9c77cab.doc: Sets story flags, plays event 408 (the Moon of Destruction murals) and enters Georama edit mode on map 75 at event 500.

8e22da9c698b09b8.name: load_e376_scene_characters
8e22da9c698b09b8.doc: Loads the Max, Monica, Crest and item models and message file for event e376, setting globals 0 and 1 to the two chara slots.

8e25d0d538c80ef7.name: use_star_key_gate
8e25d0d538c80ef7.doc: Interaction with the star-shaped gate. Blocked with a message until flag 616 is set, then the player can use the Star Key (362) to remove it.

8e53209a3523e424.name: choose_dungeon_floor_from_village
8e53209a3523e424.doc: The village exit: asks to go back, shows the dungeon tree map and jumps to Veniccio or the chosen floor of dungeon 3.

8e572a28fa33317e.name: play_spheda_demo_with_fade_scene
8e572a28fa33317e.doc: Sets flag 315. Monica takes the club from Max, a fade, then she demonstrates a Spheda shot with club sounds and sinks it. Skippable.

8e603d097f213689.name: play_blackstone_railroad_scene
8e603d097f213689.doc: Fades out and plays the Blackstone Railroad arrival scene.

8e665444dcb8be74.name: play_opening_letter_and_storm_scene
8e665444dcb8be74.doc: Opening scene. Narration of a letter to Mother over a dark screen, then on a stormy night Max runs along the road while townspeople and Donny walk by, until he opens a door.

8e703a7c5c8126a2.name: talk_to_villager
8e703a7c5c8126a2.doc: Runs the villager talk handler unless the progress is exactly 100.

8e7ad277c64229b9.name: talk_rosa_after_joining
8e7ad277c64229b9.doc: Rosa's chatter after her quest is cleared, doubting she is of any use. Chapter 8 swaps in a wish to see the Ends of the Earth.

8e95cb124a09f949.name: bounce_chest_lid
8e95cb124a09f949.doc: Animates the chest lid opening wide then bouncing back and settling through several diminishing swings, updating lid_angle[0] each frame.

8ea5cae32f4ce612.name: ask_to_go_to_volcano_foot
8ea5cae32f4ce612.doc: Asks whether to move to Gundor Volcano foot. On yes Max runs off, the screen fades and the game goes to edit mode 3 (Heim Rada); on no the player is placed back in the room.

8ec381a8aa144ea7.name: play_receive_jurak_gun
8ec381a8aa144ea7.doc: Plays the gun item get: Max takes the Jurak Gun (item 31) from the sparkle and the item message shows.

8ecd5d5415649275.name: play_key_door_open_scene
8ecd5d5415649275.doc: Plays the key door opening: the key is inserted and turned, the door pieces swap and spin, and the door's function point is disabled.

8edbf85033a42a08.name: play_voice_stream_message
8edbf85033a42a08.doc: Opens the voice stream, waits until it is ready, then opens the message window, plays the stream with lip sync and closes it.

8ededbbe03953e5c.name: move_to_paznos_bridge_from_pad_5
8ededbbe03953e5c.doc: Sets counter 13 to 5 and asks to move to Paznos Bridge.

8ef096dc80adb262.name: talk_blinkhorn_to_monica
8ef096dc80adb262.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk when Monica is the active character: a remark about women with swords, or an offer of help in chapter 8.

8ef5ed311a62f263.name: play_run_back_from_dungeon_scene
8ef5ed311a62f263.doc: Fade-in scene where Max runs back in from the dungeon entrance.

8ef79be9c1e67a54.name: replay_mother_farewell_flashback
8ef79be9c1e67a54.doc: Waits 30 frames and plays the mother's farewell flashback.

8ef7e9074828e49a.name: use_star_key_on_door
8ef7e9074828e49a.doc: Door interaction: without flag 616 only a hint message shows. Otherwise asks whether to use an item, opens the item menu and, if item 362 is chosen, plays the star key unlocking the door and sets local flag 4. Any other item gives the refuse motion.

8f00525b3b8c2e69.name: play_robot_breakdown
8f00525b3b8c2e69.doc: Scene in which the Ridepod breaks down: plays the breakdown motion and effect, swaps the music, shows a message, then opens the character change menu for slots 2 and 3. Other characters end the demo build or continue.

8f4e16fa5eeafb24.name: talk_ferdinand
8f4e16fa5eeafb24.doc: Picks Ferdinand's talk: Monica gets her own version; for Max, before quest 0 is done the early line, then by quest 3 status the quest offer, the chestnuts talk, or the joined talk. Returns 0.

8f4f1c1d6f4fd79c.name: replay_arrival_scene
8f4f1c1d6f4fd79c.doc: Hides the memo, sets counter 5 to 3 and plays the arrival scene.

8f5b2abd2e160916.name: play_event_107_and_return
8f5b2abd2e160916.doc: Event 510: loads monster data 601, plays the scene play_elephant_boss_intro_scene (flag 107) and returns to the map script s06.

8f6146aa8ad78da9.name: play_monster_intro_scene
8f6146aa8ad78da9.doc: Only calls play_lapis_guardian_intro_scene, the monster introduction scene.

8f6e9c544ac82f7b.name: leave_fish_race_to_i03h04_502
8f6e9c544ac82f7b.doc: Fades out the music and jumps to map i03h04 at entry 502.

8f7d22cd7b1797c9.name: leave_village_to_s02
8f7d22cd7b1797c9.doc: Program 201: if the player confirms leaving, jumps to map s02.

8faa60d65fa6f9ea.name: play_event_109_then_go_to_mayors_office
8faa60d65fa6f9ea.doc: Plays event 109 and jumps to the Mayor's Office i03h01a at entry 500.

8faf2ed18c7827e1.name: play_map_start_arrival
8faf2ed18c7827e1.doc: Map start program: sets Georama editing, plays the arrival that fits the previous map (white fade-in from map 25, run-in otherwise), starts pending story scripts, sets doors and NPCs and shows the event hint message.

8fb8d51f68fd6fbe.name: run_game_over
8fb8d51f68fd6fbe.doc: Dungeon defeat sequence. Stops the battle music, plays the character's defeat animation and the game over music, and shows either the game over banner (with an optional boss-loss voice line when voice is not negative) or a system message when another party member can take over. In debug mode it restores weapon health, if a party member can switch it opens the character change menu, otherwise it fades out and either refills HP and returns 1 when revive is 1 or sets the exit flag and returns 0. After a switch or debug restore it brings back the saved music and pauses and returns 0.

8fc245389415e5db.name: setup_station_map
8fc245389415e5db.doc: Places the waiting NPCs and the player. After a save load the player stands on the platform; arriving from the Ixion (counter 1 equal to 7) plays the exit-train-car scene, otherwise the train arrival scene.

8fc311e8e2d66a19.name: talk_to_cedric_about_vacuum_job
8fc311e8e2d66a19.doc: Talks to the seated NPC (slot 9): he says the part is on the desk below and asks Max to take care of it.

8fcb105f5af77fcc.name: show_voice_after_stream
8fcb105f5af77fcc.doc: Waits for the audio stream to be idle, shows the message, plays stream 1 and waits for the player to dismiss it.

902d517f512a2586.name: start_halloween_boss_fight
902d517f512a2586.doc: Starts the Halloween boss fight: loads the boss music, places Max in battle stance, loads the boss and its bomb monsters, places the boss and unpauses the monsters.

90507d9d170b0464.name: talk_aunt_polly_early
90507d9d170b0464.doc: Aunt Polly's talk before the first quest is cleared: advice on earning customers' trust in business.

908153ba5a404ac0.name: run_aim_control
908153ba5a404ac0.doc: Spheda golf aiming loop. The analog stick turns the player to aim (blocked when the swing arc is not clear) and the vertical stick sets the angle between 5 and 30, which drives the carry angle, the camera and the on-screen guide. Plays ready or idle stances. Returns 0 when the first button confirms and 1 for the second button; yaw and pitch are updated in place.

9088f00d74663d38.name: play_board_front_car
9088f00d74663d38.doc: Boarding scene for the front car: binds the train car parts by train id (0 or 1) and sets counter 0 to 0, the player walks into the door on the side given by train parity, the screen fades out, and the player is placed inside the train and fades back in.

90a11518c04e859c.name: interact_with_gate
90a11518c04e859c.doc: Handles a gate (local flag gate_index). A closed gate asks the player to use item 342 (Luna Stone) and opens it. An open gate asks whether to go down: yes marks the current floor as visited, moves to the next floor and restarts the dungeon load. Characters 2 and 3 only comment.

90bc502b7155733a.name: can_play_event_372
90bc502b7155733a.doc: Returns 1 when analysis flag 209 is set, event 372 has not been played and the party can switch characters.

90c2043adfebe42a.name: on_map_start
90c2043adfebe42a.doc: Map entry. Plays event 304, 306 or 328 depending on the story flags, otherwise places the player at the door.

90c2f6618cb8ea90.name: talk_gerald_early
90c2f6618cb8ea90.doc: Gerald's line before the player has progressed far enough: suggests studying the mine instead of tinkering with machines.

90d3dc666d861e9f.name: show_partner_status_message
90d3dc666d861e9f.doc: Shows a system message about the party partner in window 1: message 55 when there is no partner, otherwise the partner's name is inserted and message 56 is shown, or 57 when the partner's status has bit 4 set. Returns 1.

90d63cc6eff66fd9.name: play_farewell_and_return_to_d03b01
90d63cc6eff66fd9.doc: Restores the saved time of day, plays the shelling and Crest farewell scenes and jumps back to d03b01.

90e145056437f4ff.name: warp_to_lapis_garter_boss
90e145056437f4ff.doc: Debug warp: sets Max and Monica to 160 HP and 50 defence, gives them a fixed loadout (20 of item 270, weapons 16, 27, 71 and 100) and loads map s14 with the Lapis Garter boss event.

910f24b40a0121b5.name: show_timed_voice_after_stream
910f24b40a0121b5.doc: Waits for the audio stream to be idle, shows the message, plays stream 1 and closes it after a fixed number of frames.

91282a37939e5895.name: check_scoop_reward
91282a37939e5895.doc: Checks the photographer's scoop reward state on the shop menu: returns 1 when a reward count is waiting; otherwise shows the 'bring more scoops' reply (state 1) or the explanation of photography levels (state 2) in window, and returns 0. In map 22 the talk uses the NPC's own window, elsewhere a centred one.

9134a35e42db0c5b.name: unload_event_250_charas
9134a35e42db0c5b.doc: Unloads the characters of event 250: reactivates the active hero (Max or Monica), deletes the other and character slot 37, and removes the sprite and image.

914627f4aaffce90.name: talk_to_judge_or_contestant
914627f4aaffce90.doc: Runs the judge talk when the talked-to character is in slot 8, otherwise the contestant talk.

91591dafe11f6562.name: talk_to_donny_or_leave_for_dungeon
91591dafe11f6562.doc: If flag 4 is set, talks to Donny and when Max chooses to leave gives the Classic Gun and Help Receiver, sets progress 2, shows chapter title 1 and goes to the dungeon. Otherwise runs the ordinary villager talk.

91761308c9d0b2dd.name: warp_to_dark_genie_boss
91761308c9d0b2dd.doc: Debug warp: sets Max and Monica to 240 HP and 94 defence, gives and equips a fixed loadout and loads map d07b01 with the Dark Genie boss event.

918314cdba8345e6.name: enter_dungeon_d06_if_ready
918314cdba8345e6.doc: If ask_to_enter_dungeon reports ready, restores the party, weapon drawing and map movement, and loads the d06 dungeon script.

91b74867fcec1df9.name: setup_room_with_two_monsters
91b74867fcec1df9.doc: Map setup. Starts the room music; while chests are not both taken it plays the intro once (counter 20 bit 1) and places the two monsters. Then places the player and fades in.

91b8143ce67d46fa.name: setup_event_235_actors
91b8143ce67d46fa.doc: Loads the Max and Monica scene actors for event 235 and its message file. Sets globals max_scene_slot and monica_scene_slot.

91c302ce47114996.name: play_stream_message_for
91c302ce47114996.doc: Plays a voiced stream with its text shown and the lip sync running for at most the given frames, then stops it and closes the window.

91ca65a085908586.name: trigger_game_over_by_character
91ca65a085908586.doc: If Monica is the active character (1 or 3), plays one of two voiced game over lines at random; otherwise the silent game over.

91d686becfddb978.name: talk_need_after_joining
91d686becfddb978.doc: Need's chatter after the safe quest is cleared, about sorting garbage. Chapter 8 swaps in a warning about Zelmite Mine.

91e5a37aba53f034.name: reset_camera_on_entry
91e5a37aba53f034.doc: Resets the camera behind the player when the map starts.

91f82ec24bfe8913.name: talk_milane_after_joining
91f82ec24bfe8913.doc: Milane's two-part chatter after the sword quest is cleared, about the beauty of a well-made sword. Chapter 8 swaps in a question about tough guys in the mine.

9256a48ff8651144.name: talk_to_host_or_spectator
9256a48ff8651144.doc: Runs the host talk when the talked-to character is in slot 24, otherwise the spectator talk.

9256a71baab8b4f3.name: run_game_over_by_flags
9256a71baab8b4f3.doc: Game over handler. When flag 716 is set and 728 is not, it plays a voiced game over line (8560060 or 8560070, chosen at random). Otherwise the game over is silent.

92659afc654be86c.name: play_monica_joins_scene
92659afc654be86c.doc: Sets flag 207 and plays the long scene where the Blackstone train is stopped by a rock near the Spirit Forest and Monica explains time travel, origin points and Emperor Griffon erasing the past. Max agrees to help and Monica joins the party, with tutorial messages about changing characters and train travel.

9275901e37511cda.name: hide_status_bar_until_button
9275901e37511cda.doc: Hides the status bar and waits for a pad press before continuing.

92888f43ee12ca7b.name: play_scripted_spheda_demo_shot
92888f43ee12ca7b.doc: Scripted Spheda shot used by Monica's demonstration: a fixed aim and power with the same ball physics, ending with the hole effect.

929e48aedb396093.name: talk_to_moon_watcher
929e48aedb396093.doc: A townsperson praises the view of the moon. The first time (flag 32) it also shows the hint to press R2 for the first-person view.

92a5b5b05fad3515.name: place_player_or_play_train_stop_scene
92a5b5b05fad3515.doc: If counter 0 is zero just places the player and fades in, otherwise plays the train stopping scene at one of three carriage positions (counter 2 or 3 pick the other two) and places the player from the counters. Returns 0 in the simple case.

92af5e87ebcf3201.name: play_empty_plaza_camera_scene
92af5e87ebcf3201.doc: Sets flag 824, hides many building map parts and plays the same camera sweep as the faded version without the fade-in.

92c4eacce1db7372.name: delete_event_charas
92c4eacce1db7372.doc: Deletes the 16 character slots from 8 to 23.

92d274aa7e8774fb.name: start_floor_music
92d274aa7e8774fb.doc: Loads the sound set and starts music 167, unless the Shingala fight is in progress (event 408 done, 420 not, Electric Fish held).

92d80a8a683148ed.name: place_seated_firbits
92d80a8a683148ed.doc: Loads Conda, Rococo and Tobo and places them seated at the table.

92ddc7d3e9cdcc71.name: play_homecoming_then_enter_d05b01
92ddc7d3e9cdcc71.doc: Plays the homecoming flashback and loads dungeon map d05b01 at event 571.

92f143fc0b3a4d95.name: update_npc_slots_by_analysis
92f143fc0b3a4d95.doc: Activates or hides the NPC slots 307, 308 and 311 to 314 according to analysis flags 305, 301, 302, 303 and 304.

92f23303be7a4c9e.name: ask_to_leave_map
92f23303be7a4c9e.doc: Asks the exit question (set 5, item 54). On yes the player runs out and the screen fades; returns 1. On no the player walks a few steps back and it returns 0.

92f32ec2389b982a.name: play_crest_greeting_scene_and_go_to_moon_flower_palace
92f32ec2389b982a.doc: Event 372. Lin, now a sage, greets Max and Monica at the temple crystal where worshippers bow, Crest the Great Sage appears and casts a spell, and the scene leads to the Moonflower Palace (map s33, event 510). Sets flag 372.

92f36e5f160f936f.name: play_voice_message_close_at
92f36e5f160f936f.doc: Plays a voiced line with its text window: loads and prepares stream 1, shows message voice, plays the stream with lip sync for frames frames, closes the window at close_frame, then closes the stream.

92f880a82652c89f.name: talk_mina_before_lesson
92f880a82652c89f.doc: Mina's two-part talk before the Spheda lesson flag is set: she feels unwell and the doctor found nothing wrong.

931e667d3ea598ee.name: setup_floor_start
931e667d3ea598ee.doc: Disables event points already used and plays the walk-in entrance scene.

93221f102c7dfcc5.name: get_event_part_pos
93221f102c7dfcc5.doc: Writes the position of the event's map part into out_x, out_y and out_z, and the event's rotation into out_data[0].

933a4e1b0467e7f1.name: show_camera_overview_scene
933a4e1b0467e7f1.doc: Pauses monsters and player steps, holds a fixed overview camera for 300 frames, then resumes.

93419b31d39dbaf1.name: talk_to_villager
93419b31d39dbaf1.doc: Greets the villager and opens their talk menu.

93546ec152292bd4.name: show_demo_version_message
93546ec152292bd4.doc: Shows the message that the player cannot enter here in the demo version.

9356780d870b86d2.name: end_spheda_shot_scene
9356780d870b86d2.doc: Resets the camera and player after a Spheda shot, restores Max's stand motion and, when the ball is not in the hole and no strokes remain, shows message 2003 before ending the event.

935ed85821e66941.name: lower_rock_in_room_2
935ed85821e66941.doc: Binds map part p11_d06b02-3 and sinks the rock pillar with the player.

935ff3cd5756994b.name: play_story_206_scene
935ff3cd5756994b.doc: Story 206: plays the scene where Max meets Monica on the train.

9376ec6931b6ba82.name: play_angry_return_scene
9376ec6931b6ba82.doc: Event 108 (sets flag 108): Max returns to the workshop looking angry, with the walk-in shot and the retry hint, then the camera and map pieces are restored.

93a99f9e07f3ec2b.name: talk_milane_early
93a99f9e07f3ec2b.doc: Milane's talk before the first quest is cleared: his shop specializes in blades and he has only a few guns.

93bb760924b0c97f.name: play_preloaded_voice_message
93bb760924b0c97f.doc: Shows a message with an already opened stream and plays it with the player confirming.

93c03fc136de2273.name: on_treasure_chest
93c03fc136de2273.doc: Opens a treasure chest. With one item it plays the normal chest opening; with two items it plays the Happy Clown choice scene.

93d41063e598ebc7.name: play_shop_arrival_scene
93d41063e598ebc7.doc: Fades in on the inventor's shop. Max walks in toward Cedric, who is looking up.

93da1933640b3ae3.name: play_door_piece_opening
93da1933640b3ae3.doc: Plays the opening animation of the exit door map piece d05w10_1 (animated for upper floors, shown opened otherwise).

93e4f1edf609e6b5.name: play_starlight_temple_restored_scene
93e4f1edf609e6b5.doc: Only calls play_crest_reward_scene, the scene where it is noticed that Starlight Temple has been restored.

93f0a6fa01e37356.name: run_empty_event
93f0a6fa01e37356.doc: Starts an event, waits one frame and finishes it. Does nothing visible.

93fbeca0198327a2.name: start_story_105b_script
93fbeca0198327a2.doc: Story 105b: sets up the house, shows Steve and loads script i01h01/i01h01b_1.stb as program 510.

941403f553e5d8ea.name: play_dark_element_battle_intro_scene
941403f553e5d8ea.doc: Short intro to the final battle: sets flag 728, shows the E728 title card, plays the Dark Element's flurry attack animation and fades out into the boss music.

94149a492ae3223f.name: start_inferno_boss_fight
94149a492ae3223f.doc: Loads and places the Inferno boss (613), starts the boss music (190) and pauses the battle music.

9420cd3920da141b.name: play_room_1_monster_intro_scene
9420cd3920da141b.doc: Intro for the first monster room: Max and Monica look up angrily, the rock pillar shakes, and monster e214e drops in and attacks under the first title card (e728telop01), then the scene fades out. Only runs on the first visit, controlled by flag 728.

9425bc96b837599d.name: leave_for_s02_after_confirm
9425bc96b837599d.doc: Program 600: after the player confirms, sets the dungeon to stage 1 floor 0, disables dungeon map movement and jumps to map s02.

94459a542307e5d2.name: wait_message_input
94459a542307e5d2.doc: Waits for message input with lip sync on, and returns the frames waited. extra_pressed[0] is set to 1 when the optional extra button (1 or 2) is what ended the message.

9448d10b9ab8dbfa.name: handle_locked_chest
9448d10b9ab8dbfa.doc: Handles a locked chest. Asks whether to have Donny open it (when Donny is in the party) or use a Treasure Chest Key, or to force it. A successful unlock clears bit 2 of chest_type. Forcing triggers the trap bits (8 poison, 16 explosion that destroys the chest, 32 weapon damage). Returns 1 when the player gave up or the chest was destroyed, otherwise 0.

944a11aebb846170.name: show_pending_event_notice
944a11aebb846170.doc: Does nothing from chapter 8. Otherwise shows message 1051 when an event is pending, or message 1050 when not (skipped if only_when_event_pending is set); use_alt_text adds 10 to the message number.

945384c43a58a56e.name: start_monica_gear_battle
945384c43a58a56e.doc: Gives and equips items 110, 127, 133 and 266 on Monica, switches the player to Monica, plays event 50 and places four monster 523 for a fight, then fades in.

9454f6029b370c7b.name: brief_on_ixion_then_go_s11
9454f6029b370c7b.doc: Plays the Ixion briefing scene, then jumps to map s11 event 599.

946e0e7b6790288f.name: ask_to_go_to_heim_rada_stop
946e0e7b6790288f.doc: Asks the question for leaving the map. On yes Max runs off along a path and fades out (returns 1); on no he walks back a few steps.

947330c27c8f8547.name: play_palace_beam_flee_only
947330c27c8f8547.doc: Debug test program: plays the palace beam flee scene (as program 530 does) without jumping to another map.

948ce300f7670b12.name: board_train_if_confirmed
948ce300f7670b12.doc: Asks whether to board. On yes sets counter 1 to 9 and boards the front car (to s37, the engine room) or a rear car (to s38, the guest room), each with its own boarding scene.

94b3d4ee434c2731.name: play_exit_train_car
94b3d4ee434c2731.doc: Exit from a train car. With counter 0 at 0 (no car) it just places the player from the saved counters and fades in. Otherwise it binds the door and step parts of car 1, 2 or 3 for the side stored in counter 15, plays the door sound, then places the player on the platform and puts the camera behind.

94b8906a563e9417.name: wait_message_with_talk_anim
94b8906a563e9417.doc: Waits for the player to close the message while an actor talk animation plays during the text and stops at page ends. Returns the frames waited.

94c5ddb7ce20ef79.name: talk_to_villager
94c5ddb7ce20ef79.doc: Starts an event and runs the villager conversation handler.

94cecec7a19bb1cd.name: play_ask_donny_first_hint
94cecec7a19bb1cd.doc: Max steps back 30 units from the entrance and remarks that he should ask Donny where the channel goes. Used when the player tries to enter the dungeon before the story scene is done.

94d8e10ed242c276.name: talk_parn_quest_offer
94d8e10ed242c276.doc: Parn's quest offer. Monica gets his introduction, his fiancee's portrait and a system message that she dislikes his type and Max should talk to him instead; the event ends. Max hears that Parn needs golden paint to bring a painted woman to life, a request for it, and quest 1 is set to accepted.

94e60c521c64dbdd.name: talk_fabio_quest_offer
94e60c521c64dbdd.doc: Fabio's quest offer: he only listens to someone who has caught a fish bigger than his best, a 60 cm Nonky. Shows tutorial hints to fish at the Palm Brinks pond and marks quest 15 accepted.

9514ca5cbf1e35ab.name: play_world_explained_scene
9514ca5cbf1e35ab.doc: Event 203. Sets flag 203 and plays the crew explaining the ruined world, Emperor Griffon, the stone and Flotsam, with story images, ending in a blast outside the train.

9517bd1c8c7e71b8.name: play_central_lab_arrival_scene
9517bd1c8c7e71b8.doc: Event 464 (sets flag 464). Max and Monica walk into the Central Lab, marvel at the research facility and say it could send them back ten thousand years.

9520231b11820f1d.name: play_event_328_from_flags
9520231b11820f1d.doc: Debug entry: sets flags 304, 306 and 324, clears 330 and plays event 328.

95392dcaae2ae9da.name: play_train_departure
95392dcaae2ae9da.doc: Cutscene of the train leaving Balance Valley station with steam and smoke effects, driving off down the track. Hides a map part if flag 372 is set.

953a5f0bc097a178.name: show_town_hall_closed_message
953a5f0bc097a178.doc: Shows a message that City Hall is closed.

9553aee7a4d8e55d.name: talk_ferdinand_after_joining
9553aee7a4d8e55d.doc: Ferdinand's chatter after the chestnut quest is cleared, promising Max he will never refuse him. Chapter 8 swaps in his dream of being the best chef.

956b4376d583fb31.name: hide_station_props
956b4376d583fb31.doc: Hides the five station prop pieces of part p01_s0201 (s0208-m0 to m3 and s0213-m0).

9589277103fdc7f3.name: play_train_defeat_scene_and_ask_retry
9589277103fdc7f3.doc: Event 205 scene when the train is lost, then asks whether to fight again or return to the title. Returns the choice. Sets flag 205.

958fb6424c8f5c1d.name: show_message_timed
958fb6424c8f5c1d.doc: Opens a message window and waits up to the given number of frames for it to close, then clears the message slot. Returns the frames waited.

959a7e6dd3cb981b.name: open_overflow_menu_if_full
959a7e6dd3cb981b.doc: Opens the town or dungeon item-overflow menu when the item limit or the bag capacity is exceeded; does nothing otherwise.

95a3583741dd23a8.name: lower_rock_in_room_4
95a3583741dd23a8.doc: Binds map part p11_d06b02-7 and sinks the rock pillar with the player.

95a7650ba5d3ed6b.name: talk_to_pau
95a7650ba5d3ed6b.doc: Talk handler: before flag 500 it runs Pau's cave dialogue, afterwards the carrot quest dialogue (Pau joins the party when given a Carrot).

95abe22ed8b5f9c4.name: play_opening_part_four_scene
95abe22ed8b5f9c4.doc: Calls play_opening_stage_fall_scene: pauses the game, fades out, clears monsters, restores HP and weapon durability and plays the opening chapter one scene.

95afd8d3b252920c.name: start_story_106_script
95afd8d3b252920c.doc: Story 106: sets up the house, shows Steve and loads script i01h01/i01h01c_1.stb as program 500.

95b80ac056c27d37.name: wait_for_chara_motion_end
95b80ac056c27d37.doc: Waits until the motion of the character ends.

95b829ba3451f326.name: place_player_in_house
95b829ba3451f326.doc: Places the player at (43.5, 0, 135) facing back toward the door.

95c10a424c7d7a90.name: play_farewell_then_return_to_g02
95c10a424c7d7a90.doc: Plays the farewell with Lin and returns to map g02 (Balance Valley).

95c239ac0e7114cb.name: restore_player_after_farewell
95c239ac0e7114cb.doc: Reactivates the active character, deletes the other character, the NPCs and the effect models used in the farewell scene and hides the part with handle 14.

95d09b211091a117.name: ask_blinkhorn_race_start
95d09b211091a117.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's race offer: asks whether to try. Declining sets counter 7 to 0 and returns 0; accepting starts the on-screen stopwatch, sets counter 7 to 1 and ends the talk.

95e48aeaeca4c67e.name: talk_parn_after_joining
95e48aeaeca4c67e.doc: Parn's chatter after the gold paint quest is cleared, about his new power. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about the depth of painting.

95ef4c81fcf65cf4.name: play_camera_pan_at_village
95ef4c81fcf65cf4.doc: Hides the player and the battleship and pans the camera's look-at point in an arc from a fixed spot for 300 frames before returning control.

95f31e8ed28429d6.name: play_boy_returns_scene
95f31e8ed28429d6.doc: Voiced scene between the boy and the other character that runs after the snatch, with BGM changes and camera attachment; fades out and places the player. Called after the Circus Ticket (item 353) is added.

95f55b6cde124dfd.name: talk_to_workshop_villager
95f55b6cde124dfd.doc: Talk handler for the people of the Gundorada workshop. Lines change with story flags 640, 616, 540, 536 and the save flag, Nithe, Nuwara and Nevel (402, 403 and 404) open shops 30, 28 and 29, and the rest of the numbers say fixed lines.

9609b5c6bbfa986a.name: play_potato_pie_then_go_to_dwarves_house
9609b5c6bbfa986a.doc: Plays the potato pie memory scene and jumps to map g01i07 (Dwarves' House).

960e72f0ccc1bc48.name: enter_d06_dungeon_if_confirmed
960e72f0ccc1bc48.doc: Asks the leave question (prompt 109) and fades out; on yes jumps to d06e01 (Flower Palace Foyer), skipping the next music load while the Gekka view save flag is unset.

9614b6331c19d8ab.name: setup_station_entry
9614b6331c19d8ab.doc: Places the player by where they came from: after loading a save at the platform, from maps 4 and 109 at the entrance, from the train cars after a ride (with the exit scene), otherwise plays the train arrival.

963d12ec792e20c1.name: talk_milane_joined
963d12ec792e20c1.doc: Milane's line once he has joined. Before chapter 8 he talks about swords, in chapter 8 he asks about the mine.

964731e68409093c.name: talk_waiting_npc
964731e68409093c.doc: Talk with the NPC who waits at the station (Spanish text): says they will wait here, with a different closing line once the waiting-NPC-released flag is set. Then talk_to_npc.

9647dc5022de0843.name: play_pau_asks_for_medicine_scene
9647dc5022de0843.doc: Sets flag 420 and plays event 420: Pau asks Max and Monica to bring back a medicine from the beach where the other Shigura are, and they decide to ask Luna Lab for a way to talk to the sea dragons.

9670439e9ac0fbda.name: delete_event_charas
9670439e9ac0fbda.doc: Cleans up after event 247: re-activates whichever of Max or his partner slot is the active character, deactivates and unloads the other and its extra motions, and deletes characters 34 to 38.

9674bf8d96315a71.name: play_opening_halloween_scene
9674bf8d96315a71.doc: Opening scene on a night road. Max and pierrots run towards the camera, then a Halloween figure holding Pol Curse jumps in and says shall we begin, then. Skippable.

96797a30ffdeffc9.name: ask_blinkhorn_race_start
96797a30ffdeffc9.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's race offer: asks whether to try. Declining sets counter 7 to 0 and returns 0; accepting starts the on-screen stopwatch, sets counter 7 to 1 and ends the talk.

96aacce5569d21f4.name: resume_energy_pack_request
96aacce5569d21f4.doc: Story hook. Chooses the scene to play from what Max holds: an Energy Pack, the 20 Scrap of Metal, Thick Hide and 2 Hunk of Copper, or the invention idea.

96d4109ed60feaf3.name: finish_cleared_room_event
96d4109ed60feaf3.doc: Runs when all monsters in a room are cleared: clears monsters, plays the victory pose, opens the door, shows medal and challenge messages, announces broken red, blue and white seals, and the Spheda messages.

96d527bdf626855c.name: play_atlamillia_glow_scene
96d527bdf626855c.doc: Sets flag 523. Max watches his Atlamillia activate and glow, then the scene waits for a button press and fades out. The world coordinate frame is set from the four parameters.

96ed16f7c537fa2a.name: show_lab_map_part_handles
96ed16f7c537fa2a.doc: Binds handles to map parts p07 and p05 and sets whether each is visible.

9705a762b8d12d73.name: go_to_s03_during_train_event
9705a762b8d12d73.doc: While the flag 203 train event is active, unlocks map movement, fades in, stops the train sounds and jumps to map s03 entrance 501.

9719790151105207.name: play_arrive_in_village_scene
9719790151105207.doc: Event 432, sets flag 432: Max and Monica arrive in Shigura Village with the Shell Talkie, look around and decide to talk to every Shigura. The non-active hero is loaded as a party member.

971c919693de64b0.name: place_player_at_entrance
971c919693de64b0.doc: Places the player at (-75, -7.7, 936), resets the camera and fades in.

971fab1ced769534.name: show_event_hint_message
971fab1ced769534.doc: Program 310: shows the map's event hint message.

973a2fd19396fe24.name: play_time_gate_explanation_scene
973a2fd19396fe24.doc: Skippable scene: Monica points out the Time Gate, explains the Red and Blue Atlamillia, Max wonders why his father had one, and they set out to bring back Jurak. Ends with Carpentrion and Charlotte tutorial messages.

973b419c4b5bbd6c.name: setup_spheda_course
973b419c4b5bbd6c.doc: Creates the Spheda game and loads the ball and pin models in the colors the game picked, with the pin collision. Places them at the ball and pin positions.

974031ea33b69476.name: give_sun_stone_and_moon_stone
974031ea33b69476.doc: Places the player at the south entry and gives the Sun Stone (item 198) and Moon Stone (item 199) with item get messages, then handles a full bag.

974f2974e5261d32.name: start_buggy_sub_game
974f2974e5261d32.doc: Plays the buggy chase scene, fades in and starts the buggy sub game.

974f336e2d32bd4b.name: activate_chara_slot
974f336e2d32bd4b.doc: Finds the scene character with number chara_no and activates it when slot is nonzero or deactivates it when slot is 0 (the second parameter is an on/off flag, not a slot).

9753a24f42f97e77.name: give_grape_juice_after_conda_scene
9753a24f42f97e77.doc: Plays the scene where Conda warns about the forest and the rainbow butterfly and hands over Grape Juice (item 370), then restores the station.

97544627d21a4c2e.name: play_holly_rainbow_butterfly_scene
97544627d21a4c2e.doc: Plays the scene where the Rainbow Butterfly, who lived as Holly among the Firbits, thanks Max and Monica.

9771511899658e42.name: record_diamond_chest_taken
9771511899658e42.doc: When a Diamond (item 189) chest is opened, sets bit 256 of counter 17 for the first chest and bit 512 for the second. Those bits switch the room's music and stop the chests from spawning again.

979a5993ab09fa44.name: talk_adel_early
979a5993ab09fa44.doc: Adel's talk before the first quest is cleared: she is working as a maid but dreams of being a tailor.

979b1eb9f330eea1.name: resume_buggy_subgame
979b1eb9f330eea1.doc: Sets the engine motion, runs play_buggy_chase_on_train_roof_scene, fades in and starts the buggy subgame.

97aa6fe7dba84ab9.name: setup_dungeon_floor
97aa6fe7dba84ab9.doc: Called whenever a floor starts. Floor 0 goes back to Veniccio, floor 9 to s19, floor 14 to s15, floor 17 to s45 unless the tournament cycle flag is set, floor 20 to the d04b01 boss or Shigura Village, and floor 2 plays event 406 the first time and goes to s46. Other floors load their d04f map with monsters and chests and play the arrival scene.

97b421e58668505a.name: play_battleship_heads_for_village_scene
97b421e58668505a.doc: Sets flag 438. The battleship flies off toward Shigura Village. Monica and Max decide to defend it and send Pau and the Shigura back home.

97c4ee5a2697ed0c.name: ask_to_exit_toward_dungeon
97c4ee5a2697ed0c.doc: Asks the player whether to leave through the dungeon exit. On yes the character runs off, the screen fades out and it returns 1. On no it walks a few steps back and returns 0.

97c913316501f9f4.name: start_time_gate_walk_scene
97c913316501f9f4.doc: Plays the time gate walk scene.

97d1662009ac46ca.name: play_return_to_present
97d1662009ac46ca.doc: Plays the time gate travel scene back to the present at x, y, z, yaw. When Monica is in the party it uses her blue gate scene; otherwise Max's red one, preceded by the Atlamillia glow scene if the edit-blocked flag is set, the Gaspard backstory has not been seen and the glow has not played. Resets the world coordinate afterwards.

97d74cd3ab9e11df.name: play_shot_depart_call
97d74cd3ab9e11df.doc: Opening shot: Cedric, in the train, shouts that Blackstone One is departing. Starts BGM 1.

97da44f59cdf745d.name: warp_to_memo_eater_boss
97da44f59cdf745d.doc: Debug warp: sets Max and Monica to 64 HP and 16 defence, gives them a fixed loadout (20 of item 270, weapons 18, 28, 48 and 92) and loads map s18 with the Memo Eater boss event.

97e7432b2c694a1a.name: leave_for_s27
97e7432b2c694a1a.doc: If the exit question is answered yes, jumps to map s27, skipping the BGM load when flag 404 is not set.

97e813a56eb33648.name: restart_second_gaspard_fight
97e813a56eb33648.doc: Retry hook: restarts the second fight music (BGM 35) and places boss monster 511 at the origin.

97ee1824bc4e626d.name: setup_door_and_npcs_for_flags
97ee1824bc4e626d.doc: Enables the door of part p01_g010701 once flag 209 is set, and shows characters 120 and 121 only when flag 250 is set.

97f18ca68e74cbfd.name: play_look_outside_then_go_to_palace
97f18ca68e74cbfd.doc: Plays the look outside scene, unlocks map movement and goes to edit mode 187.

98255353cb609753.name: play_villager_crowd_a_scene
98255353cb609753.doc: Sets flag 824. Shows a crowd of ten named villagers watching while the camera sweeps over the plaza; skippable.

982e5308618f774f.name: play_palace_thrown_aside_scene
982e5308618f774f.doc: Part of event 640: Paznos throws the palace aside and the party decides to get inside it.

982fb6c9dda117e2.name: pick_up_memo_item_386
982fb6c9dda117e2.doc: Program 521: the player turns toward the pickup, the memo map part is hidden, item 386 is received and the item2 trigger is disabled.

983336786acdc21a.name: play_event_109a_start_dungeon
983336786acdc21a.doc: Plays event 109a and then starts dungeon 0 from the talk handler.

983844a982e6eb6c.name: ask_to_board_train
983844a982e6eb6c.doc: Asks yes or no about boarding. On yes fades out and returns 1, otherwise returns 0.

984717d77bf8ae57.name: press_panel_row0_col3
984717d77bf8ae57.doc: Presses the puzzle switch for the panel at row 0, column 3, toggling it and its neighbours.

9847d99a2b852196.name: play_opening_run_scene
9847d99a2b852196.doc: Max runs along a path through the town with the camera cutting around, then the screen fades and the game jumps to map m06 (Palm Brinks) event 152.

98659458a7101156.name: use_flower_of_the_sun_on_vase
98659458a7101156.doc: Inspect the strange flower vase. Character forms 2 and 3 refuse. Using the Flower of the Sun (item 374) shows the hidden map part with a white flash, plays event 708 and enables the exit to the next floor.

987223146df0ee57.name: rococo_stands_idle
987223146df0ee57.doc: Rococo stands idle while the scene waits 45 frames.

9896d374c5cb98f2.name: load_map_villagers
9896d374c5cb98f2.doc: Loads the map's villagers by placing Galen after Gaspard.

98a5ece98e3d1d1f.name: show_message_auto
98a5ece98e3d1d1f.doc: Shows a message above the speaker's head with an automatic position, waits for input and closes the window. Returns the input result.

98a9dd23ba54c6c3.name: play_balance_valley_arrival_scene
98a9dd23ba54c6c3.doc: Story 302: plays the scene where Max and Monica arrive at Balance Valley.

98aab19534fa406a.name: ride_elevator_east
98aab19534fa406a.doc: Elevator control by the second lift: asks for a floor and moves the player to the same spot on floor 0, 1 or 2. On floor 1 it may play the Time Bomb scene.

98ad954e890550ee.name: play_run_in_scene
98ad954e890550ee.doc: The player runs in from the entrance while the camera tracks him.

98b1edbb54781d74.name: start_d06e01_event_151_with_loadout
98b1edbb54781d74.doc: Debug warp: sets both characters to 200 max HP and 70 defence, tops Premium Chicken up to 20, equips Max with Sigma Breaker and Steal Gun and Monica with Ama no Murakumo and Goddess Brassard, then starts event 151 on map d06e01.

98b9509f53d0607a.name: play_utan_meeting_then_continue
98b9509f53d0607a.doc: Plays event 230. If the player already has a Fishing Rod, sets counter 3 to 3. Then returns to the s05 script.

98c47b27f90bbc23.name: wait_chara_motion_time
98c47b27f90bbc23.doc: Waits up to max_frames frames until the motion progress of chara is within tolerance (default 0.01 when -1) of time. Returns 0 when reached, 1 on timeout.

98cc4411be0455c2.name: play_golem_slope_charge_left_columns
98cc4411be0455c2.doc: Variant of the slope charge in which only columns 0 to 2 of the golems run up the slope.

98ce31928ef5cfdc.name: preview_party_arrival_scene
98ce31928ef5cfdc.doc: Debug scene: the player and a party member run in from the east to a fixed camera shot.

98ce34c78dc09634.name: wait_for_pad_press
