98ce34c78dc09634.doc: Waits until any button in mask is newly pressed.

98f615e6a1e16517.name: play_event_708_hidden_party
98f615e6a1e16517.doc: Hides the two party members and the status bar, then plays event 708.

98fb535e4220809a.name: talk_stewart_monica
98fb535e4220809a.doc: Stewart's talk with Monica as the active character: outside chapter 8 he says she resembles Lady Eina, in chapter 8 he warns her about the Zelmite mine.

99064681163f6488.name: go_back_to_palm_brinks
99064681163f6488.doc: Exit trigger to Palm Brinks. Until flag 103 is set Max refuses because Porcus may still be searching; afterwards it asks and jumps to map m01.

991e11055573c60b.name: check_pad_pressed
991e11055573c60b.doc: Returns the buttons from mask that were pressed this frame.

992519118537cab5.name: load_test_characters
992519118537cab5.doc: Loads four test characters (c002a, c005a, sraim and a_ku) in a row at the origin. This is the map start of the r01 test map.

994f4c51d65b0fbd.name: play_train_arrival_cutscene
994f4c51d65b0fbd.doc: The train rolls in and the player runs out of it to the station platform, then control returns; hides some villagers while it plays.

9960bdd1e1b7bec2.name: enter_boss_room_d06b03
9960bdd1e1b7bec2.doc: Fades out and loads the d06b03 boss room.

99774664c9b55709.name: show_npcs_by_story_progress
99774664c9b55709.doc: Shows or hides the NPC slots 203, 205, 206, 213 and 214 depending on story progress checks.

99982115ba274140.name: play_griffon_castle_approach_scene
99982115ba274140.doc: Sets flag 604. Max and Monica walk towards the castle talking about what Emperor Griffon is like, that he controls followers from the past and has great magical power, and vow to stop him. The gate doors swing open and they go in. Skippable.

9998f60562e091e1.name: play_dark_power_emerges_scene
9998f60562e091e1.doc: The boss turns on its helper, dismisses it and stabs, a dark power rises with red, blue and yellow Atla shapes, and Max and Monica are dragged into a halo of light. Loads a new set of effect models mid-scene and ends with a white fade and cleanup through remove_dark_scene_actors.

99a191885a0e65cc.name: ask_give_white_windflower
99a191885a0e65cc.doc: Shows a hint box suggesting giving Lao Chao a White Windflower for his miracle dish and asks with a button prompt. Returns 1 if the player picked the menu button, else 0.

99b0434cd70b7f8b.name: show_boss_game_over_screen
99b0434cd70b7f8b.doc: Pauses the dungeon and shows the game over image with its music. After a button press it exits the dungeon (the continue branch is never taken).

99e5633f6475431b.name: play_jump_down_arrival_scene
99e5633f6475431b.doc: Arrival cutscene for the upper floors: the character jumps down to the floor start, optionally with the dungeon map piece moving in, followed by messages about any Red, Blue or White Seal on the floor.

99f1257069d446ee.name: inspect_egg
99f1257069d446ee.doc: Gives Gold Paint the first time; afterwards says what might hatch from the egg.

99f6bb59c8b3d5fc.name: take_gate_exit_1
99f6bb59c8b3d5fc.doc: Gate 1 handler: interacts with the second exit.

9a0b81d8ecdfde19.name: start_spheda_bonus_course
9a0b81d8ecdfde19.doc: Loads the d01f01 floor with the mstage8 layout, gives the Map and Magic Crystal, sets up Spheda hole 8 and opens the score view.

9a11357c9c3bcd58.name: draw_aim_guide
9a11357c9c3bcd58.doc: Draws the dotted golf aim guide with world sprites along the shot given by yaw and pitch, bouncing off walls, feeding every sixth dot to the line point list. Shows a screen caption sprite when the map scale is 0 and dims the dots at scale 2.

9a1ab343c518cc60.name: play_shot_player_faces_big_elephant
9a1ab343c518cc60.doc: Scene shot: the player's character stands facing a scaled-up elephant.

9a324f6d62979116.name: talk_generic_villager
9a324f6d62979116.doc: Default villager talk. Shopkeeper substitutes (characters 1012, 1015, 1018) go to the shop greeting. Character 50 blocks the way. In chapter 1 (characters 2, 63, 65, depending on whether the train has run) and chapter 8 (characters 61 and 80, depending on whether Monica is back) there are special lines. Anyone else gets a stock greeting then the line looked up from the villager message table, with a Monica variant when she is active. Returns 0 on special paths.

9a6b6b730aa6fe5f.name: go_to_s70_entrance_520
9a6b6b730aa6fe5f.doc: Fades out, unlocks map movement, sets flag 616 and jumps to map s70 entrance 520.

9a727ce7ad458196.name: play_firesquall_destroyed_scene
9a727ce7ad458196.doc: Story event 516. The Time Bomb destroys the Fire Squall in a chain of explosions and the fire rain stops. Gaspard then appears with his battleship, attacks, and Max is told to use the Ridepod. Sets flag 516.

9a9024c42858236e.name: play_dark_ruler_moon_fall_scene
9a9024c42858236e.doc: Event 728 cutscene (flag 728) before the final boss: the dark ruler gloats as the moon starts to fall, Max and Monica are startled, and he strikes them down with a thrown staff. Monica urges Max to go after him, and the boss music (37) starts. Skippable.

9a909751ffe58136.name: talk_party_borneo
9a909751ffe58136.doc: Talk handler for Borneo at the station. When Borneo is the party NPC he comments on needing to keep moving, with extra remarks in chapter 4 (until the Ixion explanation is seen) and chapter 3; otherwise it runs the party-NPC talk for the NPC spoken to. Returns 0.

9a986589aa60252d.name: exit_to_d04_start
9a986589aa60252d.doc: Exit event. While map movement is locked it reminds the player to feed the fish to Shingala. Otherwise it confirms the exit and loads the d04 dungeon script.

9aa7af0fd91b4f35.name: unlock_balance_valley_and_play_luna_lab_scene
9aa7af0fd91b4f35.doc: Marks all ten Balance Valley georama analysis flags, sets story flags 364, 368 and 376 and clears 372, then plays the Luna Lab advice scene.

9aaa4672032a98c7.name: show_light_rain_effect_preview
9aaa4672032a98c7.doc: Debug event: shows the E732 light rain effect above a fixed camera until pad button 64 is pressed.

9ab46ff7707ce6cd.name: turn_to_face_each_other
9ab46ff7707ce6cd.doc: Turns the player and the NPC toward each other over a number of frames proportional to the angle, using walk or talk motions, optionally setting a conversation camera.

9ac2af83d6a2cfff.name: play_ticket_scene_and_return
9ac2af83d6a2cfff.doc: Event 154: gives item 353, plays the circus ticket scene, resets the camera ids and returns to the map script m06.

9ad7d5579fadfe60.name: setup_train_engine_deck
9ad7d5579fadfe60.doc: Sets the train engine motion, places the player on the deck and sets the camera behind.

9adefc01053d2a32.name: talk_corinne_after_joining
9adefc01053d2a32.doc: Corinne's chatter after the hide-and-seek quest is cleared, saying it is for little kids. Chapter 8 swaps in a line asking Max to tell her about his adventures.

9aef2c3837b3033e.name: play_voice_message_auto
9aef2c3837b3033e.doc: Plays a voice line from a stream with its text shown, for the given frames, then closes the window and stream.

9aefefd5c0945d2d.name: ask_to_go_next_floor
9aefefd5c0945d2d.doc: Asks a yes/no question; on yes, fades out, marks the current floor cleared and the next one entered, then loads the d01 dungeon script (or ends the trial version).

9b009875b025c81a.name: go_to_palm_brinks_main_street
9b009875b025c81a.doc: If the player agrees, jumps to map m01 (Palm Brinks).

9b04b25780e47c11.name: on_random_circle
9b04b25780e47c11.doc: Flips the random circle coin. The player stops the spinning coin with the O button. Angel gives a bonus such as weapon ABS, full HP and status recovery, full WHP or a treasure box; Devil gives a penalty such as poison, halved HP, halved WHP on a weapon or all monsters revived. It cannot be used in the Ridepod or a monster form.

9b1da30fa66e2819.name: play_preloaded_voice_message
9b1da30fa66e2819.doc: Opens message mes_no, plays the already loaded stream 1 when ready, runs the voice message with lip sync and closes the window.

9b252b301c6b5e40.name: enter_square_if_confirmed
9b252b301c6b5e40.doc: If the player agrees, jumps to s45 (Palm Brinks Square).

9b30726661780c2e.name: play_dell_joins_party_scene
9b30726661780c2e.doc: Skippable scene: Max asks Dr. Dell to come with him for a sick girl and Dell agrees. Afterwards Dr. Dell is set as joining and in the party. Sets flag 305.

9b454cffaee325de.name: start_dungeon_floor
9b454cffaee325de.doc: Loads the current floor of Dungeon 2. Floor 0 goes to Sindain Station, 6 to the fish monster swamp, 12 to the s13 boss map and 15 to a boss room d02b01 or d02b02. Other floors load d02f01 (the rainy variant one time in eight), the swamp variant on floors 9 to 11, and floor 2 plays the crystal gift scene on the first visit.

9b88b1ea67377c27.name: select_floor_and_enter_dungeon
9b88b1ea67377c27.doc: Opens the dungeon map menu and loads the chosen floor. Special floors send Max elsewhere: floor 0 and 21 to s43, floor 4 to s06, floor 7 to d01b01, floor 8 to edit mode, and floor 2 plays Maximilian's room once (flag 4). Floor 1 plays the receiver intro on the first visit (flag 2), later visits and other floors play the entry scene.

9b8bba73b98ab43c.name: reset_fisherman_scene_flags
9b8bba73b98ab43c.doc: Clears flags 220 and 28 so the fisherman scene can play again.

9ba70dd9233942c6.name: reset_georama_enter_map_102
9ba70dd9233942c6.doc: Georama analysis flags for area 3: 0-2 on, 3-9 off. Clears flag 508 and jumps to map 102 at entry 151.

9bb5c8566bd94480.name: depart_ixion_for_s59
9bb5c8566bd94480.doc: Plays the Ixion departure scene, then jumps to map s59 event 500.

9bec28908fbd8bd1.name: leave_for_s39
9bec28908fbd8bd1.doc: Stops the event, fades out and jumps to map s39.

9c04b2ac76048617.name: talk_to_resident_milane
9c04b2ac76048617.doc: Sets the event character to Milane and talks to the resident (or says where Claire is at progress 100).

9c2ef5c99505c6e2.name: talk_to_town_npc
9c2ef5c99505c6e2.doc: Talk handler for town NPCs: greets, shows the NPC's idle line and lets the villager walk again.

9c40c400382e7072.name: play_lipsync_for
9c40c400382e7072.doc: Animates lip sync and talking motion while a stream plays, hiding the window prompt. Returns after the stream ends (frames is -1) or the frame count elapses, and returns the frames waited.

9c437ff2dd9ddef6.name: choose_dungeon_from_tree_map
9c437ff2dd9ddef6.doc: If flag 800 is set and the dungeon is ready, opens the stage 6 dungeon tree map. Choosing 0 cancels, any other floor starts the dungeon there.

9c5043717df3bfef.name: play_mother_memory_event
9c5043717df3bfef.doc: Plays the mother crying memory scene. Returns 0.

9c5e0954b1311c55.name: talk_stewart_to_monica
9c5e0954b1311c55.doc: Stewart's talk when Monica is the active character: he says she reminds him of Elena. Chapter 8 swaps in a warning about Zelmite Mine.

9c9257fb1f0721c9.name: play_victory_pose_at_map_start
9c9257fb1f0721c9.doc: Plays the first character's victory pose when the map starts.

9c981fd398a77f92.name: give_test_items
9c981fd398a77f92.doc: Debug event that adds one each of 17 items.

9ca8da97a6c0c9a1.name: play_monster_pair_intro_e117
9ca8da97a6c0c9a1.doc: Monster introduction cutscene: two monsters, e117g and e117f, drop in one after the other and attack, with the caption e728telop05. Skippable; restores the player afterwards.

9ccb0e56ad24fc15.name: play_metal_flotsam_defeat_on_story
9ccb0e56ad24fc15.doc: Story trigger for event 812: sets up the room sound and plays the defeat scene.

9ccc56f2f0605bb6.name: open_treasure_chest
9ccc56f2f0605bb6.doc: Opens a dungeon treasure chest according to its type bits. A mimic chest (256) spawns a mimic, after party NPC 9 warns and asks whether to open it anyway. Locked (2) and trapped (4) chests run their handlers first and may abort. Empty (512), clown (128) and plain chests then open with the right sequence. Returns the first item id when opened, else 0.

9ccd1841eced6e5f.name: play_e109a_placeholder_scene
9ccd1841eced6e5f.doc: Shows the Cedric model at a spot on the map until a pad button is pressed, then fades out and returns control. Looks like a debug stand-in for event e109a.

9cd9aca915c6d3a1.name: ask_to_go_to_next_floor
9cd9aca915c6d3a1.doc: Ridepod forms get a refusal bubble (message 20 or 21). Otherwise asks the yes/no question 10; on yes, marks the current floor cleared (flag 2) and the next floor entered (flag 1) and loads the d07 script's dungeon start.

9cdf58dd04ec337f.name: play_luna_lab_suggestion_scene
9cdf58dd04ec337f.doc: Sets flag 408 and plays event 408: Pau realises a device is controlling Shingala and the party decides to ask Luna Lab.

9cf6dc8210b70a91.name: load_ixion_plan_scene_actors
9cf6dc8210b70a91.doc: Loads the models, motions, map parts, picture slides and messages for event 448, placing Max or Monica in the other party slot and storing the slots in the globals.

9d091263c2a5c832.name: run_party_npc_menu
9d091263c2a5c832.doc: Menu for talking to a party NPC on the train. Positions the camera and player, then offers asking them to join, talking, and repairs or a shop for some members. Returns 1 when the NPC is already the party member or the player left to the party menu.

9d29731f02116d55.name: talk_to_station_npc_or_depart
9d29731f02116d55.doc: Talks to the station NPC. If the player agrees to depart, plays the Mt. Gundor departure and jumps to map s10 (Heim Rada Stop).

9d2f8e121f6ce5e6.name: load_firbit_meeting_actors
9d2f8e121f6ce5e6.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Rococo, Tobo and Conda for event 209 together with the story images (beauty of the forest, the seven grieving, search party formed). Stores the party slots in chara_slot_a and chara_slot_b.

9d5b91dbc706977e.name: preview_run_along_path_scene
9d5b91dbc706977e.doc: Debug scene: two party characters run along a path to the east while the camera follows, until a button is pressed.

9d6205ac07c18e54.name: use_floor_exit_gate
9d6205ac07c18e54.doc: Handles the exit gate of the floor using local flag 0.

9d81412c5e58a381.name: wait_for_pad_press_and_finish
9d81412c5e58a381.doc: Program 151: waits for pad button 64, then finishes the event.

9d841c3accbeb198.name: play_rope_arrival_scene
9d841c3accbeb198.doc: Arrival cutscene for the lower floors: the character hangs from a rope and drops to the floor start, then the seal messages are shown if the floor has seals.

9d8569aee47a1dc8.name: wait_message_ready
9d8569aee47a1dc8.doc: Waits frame by frame while the message window state is 0 or 1, until the message is ready.

9d86725b75e76241.name: jump_to_event_277
9d86725b75e76241.doc: Sets the Georama analyze flags and story flags 270 to 285 so that only event 277 is still pending (its flag cleared to 0), then jumps to map 25 and waits. Also sets save value badge 52 and arrives at the save point instead of the map start.

9d8861bfe31d30d6.name: setup_event_209_actors
9d8861bfe31d30d6.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Conda, the wine bottle, the item get model, five magic sprites, the flower and the e209 magic effect script for event 209. Sets globals max_scene_slot and monica_scene_slot.

9d90c971e93e035b.name: on_gate
9d90c971e93e035b.doc: Plays the blue gate warp and jumps to map g01 (Sindain).

9daa8f759c55432c.name: show_cedric_work_unfinished
9daa8f759c55432c.doc: Event program that makes Max say he has not finished the work Cedric asked him to do.

9dab0cc70e6c465e.name: start_s02b_script_if_flag_207_clear
9dab0cc70e6c465e.doc: If flag 207 is not set, loads script s02/s02b_1.stb as program 501 and returns 0.

9dc379e54d214c54.name: talk_rufio_early
9dc379e54d214c54.doc: Rufio's talk before the first quest is cleared: he wonders why he misses the moon and whether he came from there.

9dfce1c8396d1464.name: set_crystal_worshippers_active
9dfce1c8396d1464.doc: Activates (a0 = 1) ten worshipper characters around the crystal, bowing, or deactivates them.

9e275cbfc98c400c.name: play_farewell_scene
9e275cbfc98c400c.doc: Sets flag 736. At night Max says goodbye to Monica, Eina and the others as the Chrono Union closes: Eina tells Max she is proud of him, they embrace, and the party fades away. Afterwards a few people on a platform wonder if it was a dream.

9e2ba0097404dec0.name: wait_scaled_frames_then_start_bgm
9e2ba0097404dec0.doc: Waits frames scaled from 60 to 50 frames per second and starts the background music after 50 of them.

9e42ad1df9dde3a1.name: warp_to_s18_event_340
9e42ad1df9dde3a1.doc: Clears the scene and loads map s18 with the event script for event 340.

9e5609c00ffdcff3.name: enter_dungeon_d06_if_confirmed
9e5609c00ffdcff3.doc: If the player confirms, restores the party, weapon drawing and map movement, and loads the d06 dungeon script.

9e61315dd6e5b3b9.name: play_world_explained_on_train_scene
9e61315dd6e5b3b9.doc: Sets flag 203. On the train, the crew tells Max what they learned about the world being laid to waste fifteen years ago, with only Palm Brinks left, Emperor Griffon, the stone and Flotsam. A noise from outside sends Max to the roof ladder.

9e65eb3df9424010.name: setup_s56_with_entry_walk
9e65eb3df9424010.doc: Runs the s56 map setup, then walks the player in from the entrance.

9e68388c4be9c1e6.name: play_train_arrival_scene
9e68388c4be9c1e6.doc: The train slides into the station, a car door opens and the player runs out onto the platform, which is then set up as the normal view.

9e68f7cb91222397.name: play_soldier_turns_to_s55
9e68f7cb91222397.doc: Plays the soldier turns scene and jumps to map s55 at event 602.

9e6dfd1de12e3dbf.name: talk_stewart_to_monica
9e6dfd1de12e3dbf.doc: Stewart's talk when Monica is the active character: he says she reminds him of Elena. Chapter 8 swaps in a warning about Zelmite Mine.

9e7609291cd47a95.name: play_firbits_ask_for_help_scene
9e7609291cd47a95.doc: Sets flag 209. Max and Monica meet Rococo, Tobo and Conda in the Firbit house. Conda tells the story of Holly, the woman who vanished in Rainbow Butterfly Wood, and asks for a deal; Max reacts to the potato pies.

9e7986e8bf15377c.name: can_play_event_368
9e7986e8bf15377c.doc: Returns 1 when analysis flag 207 is set, event 368 has not been played and the party can switch characters.

9e8fa2e648362d33.name: talk_corinne_early
9e8fa2e648362d33.doc: Corinne's talk before she joins: she says (calling the player big brother or big sister by the active character) that the player goes out of town and asks to be taken along. Then ends the event.

9e9528ffa3135d68.name: ask_question_auto
9e9528ffa3135d68.doc: Shows message mes_no in window as a bubble from speaker to listener and runs the choice menu with choice_count options and the cursor on cursor. Returns the chosen index.

9eb1eb6937732e86.name: take_gate_exit_2
9eb1eb6937732e86.doc: Gate 2 handler: interacts with the third exit door.

9eb2d41fd694d0d8.name: set_midnight_without_street_lamps
9eb2d41fd694d0d8.doc: Hides street lamps 14 and 15, sets the time of day to 24:00 and stops time from flowing.

9eb5b787113559b8.name: play_train_vanishes_shot
9eb5b787113559b8.doc: Shot of Need looking ahead from the train as it speeds away, with the camera orbiting.

9ed13839a3309589.name: play_event_101
9ed13839a3309589.doc: Dinner cutscene at Max's house: Max asks his father where his mother is, gets a brush-off, storms out, and Stewart offers to go after him but his father says to leave him. Sets the scene-seen flag and temporarily sets the time of day to noon.

9eda758b38cc5b6d.name: play_train_arrival_scene
9eda758b38cc5b6d.doc: Calls play_train_arrival_scene, the scene of the player running off the arrived train.

9ee8431d5b2a86f1.name: setup_lighthouse_cape_and_walk_in
9ee8431d5b2a86f1.doc: Runs the setup and plays the short walk-in entrance scene.

9eeae30420721364.name: talk_olivie_joined
9eeae30420721364.doc: Olivie's line once she has joined. The text depends on whether the chapter is 8.

9f11a52f268f7bd1.name: load_e202_event
9f11a52f268f7bd1.doc: Loads event 202: cleans up old event characters, sets the message window, loads Max's 202 motions, the star breaker and pika models, the train map parts and cars, a train smoke effect and the 202 message file.

9f18188b82b9343c.name: play_two_eras_boy_scene
9f18188b82b9343c.doc: Event 640 (flag 640) part 1 in the Paznos command room: Eina and Galen say the pair have done it and that a boy with blood from two eras may be able to save them, ending with a call to strike back. Skippable.

9f352b34be993854.name: play_elephant_boss_intro_scene
9f352b34be993854.doc: Event 107: Max and Steve meet the elephant and Flotsam, shown with a title card. Afterwards the player switches to the Ride Pod and monster 601 is placed. Sets flag 107.

9f35af0d75da14db.name: show_buggy_help
9f35af0d75da14db.doc: Shows the help message for the buggy part's controls (accelerate and brake, steering, quick turn) and returns control. Dungeon monsters and pickups are paused while it shows.

9f4e94f18180b2c3.name: play_watch_battleship_overhead_scene
9f4e94f18180b2c3.doc: Midnight scene: Max, Monica and Pau stand looking up while the camera orbits and rises. The battleship map part is hidden during the shot.

9f5733b7ecc22ed2.name: replay_boss_title_intro_scene
9f5733b7ecc22ed2.doc: Debug test program: plays the boss title intro scene (play_boss_title_intro_scene).

9f6cb4eb41d23288.name: setup_central_lab_entry
9f6cb4eb41d23288.doc: Plays the arrival scene the first time, and the Ixion plan scene when flag 444 is set but 448 is not, then jumps to s09. Jumps to s53 when flag 540 is set and 600 is not. Otherwise places the player at the entrance chosen by counter 2 (0 is the center, 1 to 4 are the four wings).

9f7e1e05ba01521a.name: leave_for_s08_entry_502
9f7e1e05ba01521a.doc: Skips the BGM reload and jumps to map s08 at entry 502.

9f84e04607ea9596.name: play_lighthouse_shelling_scene
9f84e04607ea9596.doc: Cutscene after the boss fight: Gaspard, beaten by Monica, orders the battleship to flatten the lighthouse and Crest shields everyone with a barrier as the shells land. Sets flag 356.

9f9d77512de06fd3.name: play_night_of_wonder_show_intro_scene
9f9d77512de06fd3.doc: Opening scene at night: the ringmaster (Pol Curse, as the staff-twirling showman) and four pierrots announce the night's show, strike a pose and run off. Fades out at the end.

9fc1d3bd2aa6b5d9.name: play_condor_time_distortion_scene
9fc1d3bd2aa6b5d9.doc: Event 312. Max and Monica ask the condor about the White Windflower. It cannot get to its chicks because of a time distortion; Monica explains distortions and the Sphere fragment that must be hit into it with a stick. Sets flag 312.

9fcb9ab372a996a2.name: fade_in_and_pose_listeners
9fcb9ab372a996a2.doc: Fades in, sets the idle poses of Max and the crew and moves the camera in.

9ff031dd067be521.name: play_rock_throw_scene
9ff031dd067be521.doc: Toryon on the palace throws a volley of rocks that fly through the air toward the camera, then the scene fades out.

9ffd67b6f34de161.name: play_mother_farewell_then_d05b01
9ffd67b6f34de161.doc: Plays the mother farewell scene and loads dungeon d05b01 with event 561 without reloading the BGM.

a0148ab1aedacb73.name: enter_next_floor_of_d05
a0148ab1aedacb73.doc: If the player agrees at the second entrance, moves to the next floor and loads dungeon d05.

a016741975a36a30.name: enter_central_lab_door_1
a016741975a36a30.doc: Turns toward the door, sets counter 2 to 1 and jumps to the Central Lab.

a01f736723a461b7.name: warp_to_d02b01_point_2560
a01f736723a461b7.doc: Clears the scene and loads dungeon d02b01 at event code 2560 plus 10000.

a020b2a874f48619.name: play_griffon_curse_then_edit_mode
a020b2a874f48619.doc: Re-enables map movement, plays Monica's curse scene and goes to edit mode 3, event 500.

a055582c3f696ae0.name: show_two_items_message
a055582c3f696ae0.doc: Shows system message 20 in the second window with the names of two items filled in. Returns 1.

a06a5abce0b5dc8b.name: play_paznos_robot_scene
a06a5abce0b5dc8b.doc: Sets flag 640. Max and Monica look up in surprise as Paznos transforms into a robot.

a06a763c8e261c55.name: start_rush_g01_script
a06a763c8e261c55.doc: Program 650: loads the event script g01/rush_g01_1.stb as program 500.

a06dd7fad725931f.name: play_circus_elephant_pierrot_show_scene
a06dd7fad725931f.doc: Opening scene part 2: the circus show with an elephant, a juggling strongman and four pierrots, a bicycle-kick catch, trapeze clowns and a final wink from the performer. Skippable.

a075f21d2672a7ff.name: play_flotsam_defeated_scene
a075f21d2672a7ff.doc: Event 812. After the fight Flotsam is beaten, says someone else will deal with them, and vanishes in an explosion. Max and Monica wonder who he meant. Sets flag 812.

a07ed21003e7e95c.name: play_moonflower_beam_fire_scene
a07ed21003e7e95c.doc: Fires the Moonflower beam effect twice at two positions with trajectory and hit models, then fades out, calls end_beam_scene_restore_player, restores the projection and fades in.

a084e08af0c912e4.name: run_voice_with_machine_noise
a084e08af0c912e4.doc: Runs a message window with talking animation and voice until dismissed, playing sound effects 17 and 18 from the given bank every 12 frames. Returns the frames elapsed.

a08a566621bc8b3d.name: show_wall_picture
a08a566621bc8b3d.doc: Shows one of eight full-screen pictures (heki401 to heki408) fading in, waits for a button press (pad mask 64), then fades it out and frees the image.

a0a2a6ea0493096f.name: play_boss_intro_on_entry
a0a2a6ea0493096f.doc: Boss room trigger. The first time (flag 10 unset) it closes the door, shows the floor piece and plays the intro scene, otherwise it plays the platform raise.

a0aa281d3ced627e.name: cleanup_event_charas
a0aa281d3ced627e.doc: Tears down the geostone scene actors. Keeps the active player's character, deletes the other's scene model and extras, restores the party handles and removes the scene images and sprites.

a0aa81a71deba0ac.name: play_ready_scene_and_receive_parts
a0aa81a71deba0ac.doc: Plays the ready-to-depart scene. If the player goes, gives Steve's parts (Drum Can Body, Cannonball Arm, Iron Leg, Energy Pack and Core if missing), adds Steve as the third party member, enables character change and sets flag 25. Otherwise returns to the normal map script.

a0bad91cb7b0f629.name: play_chase_then_start_castle_battle
a0bad91cb7b0f629.doc: Plays the chase scene, places four monsters (kind 523), shows the control hints and starts the fight.

a0c62313e30701bf.name: meet_pau_and_shingala_then_leave
a0c62313e30701bf.doc: Story 404: clears flags 408, 420 and 444, sets up the map characters, plays the scene where Max meets Pau and Shingala, then jumps to Veniccio (g03) entrance 500 without reloading the music.

a0c87055ff82ebd8.name: replay_monster_pack_intro_scene
a0c87055ff82ebd8.doc: Plays the monster pack intro scene and waits for button 32.

a0d638a5c5f936b6.name: show_medal_messages
a0d638a5c5f936b6.doc: Shows the medal messages after a room clear: a message when the destroy goal was cleared (destroy_cleared 1 or 2), a medal sound with a message, and a practice result message 2700 plus practice_index when practice_status is 2 or 3. When both the destroy goal and the practice are done it shows a two-medals line instead.

a0eae278e2b5a104.name: reset_floor_timer_and_show_title
a0eae278e2b5a104.doc: Resets the floor timer and shows the floor title card.

a0f71cdd3181c072.name: open_door_with_key
a0f71cdd3181c072.doc: Handles a locked door. If Donny is in the party he opens it himself. Otherwise the player is asked to use item 351 (Rusted Key), and the door opens if they do.

a0f7f829993dbbad.name: play_fireworks_crowd_scene
a0f7f829993dbbad.doc: Plays the night fireworks (star mine) over a crowd of 100 characters with Max, Monica and Need in front; skippable.

a0fa430c596f47f8.name: play_halloween_boss_intro_scene
a0fa430c596f47f8.doc: Skippable intro: the hero walks through the cave and looks up at a sound, Halloween drops in with its partner who demands the red stone, the hero refuses, and the partner flies off before the fight begins. Then loads the boss (monster 500), shows the RoBomb tip message and unpauses the monsters.

a11fc17fa2e0133b.name: play_embers_rain_scene
a11fc17fa2e0133b.doc: Event 500, sets flag 500: at the station Max and Monica see embers raining and note Heim Rada at the foot of Mt. Gundor was wiped out too, then decide to ride the train.

a145ba47939e3cba.name: setup_map_arrival
a145ba47939e3cba.doc: On entering, places the player depending on whether a save was loaded, a dungeon was left or another map was left, and shows the Georama hint.

a14712ecccb5ae1f.name: play_spheda_lesson_scene
a14712ecccb5ae1f.doc: Event 314. Monica teaches Max Spheda: she demonstrates a shot, then asks whether to watch again, repeating until the player answers yes. Ends with her telling Max to try it, then starts Spheda play with the party placed at the course. Sets flag 314.

a1483632afed2b47.name: talk_to_npc_with_orientation_restore
a1483632afed2b47.doc: Turns the NPC and player to face each other, shows a bubble message, then optionally restores the NPC's original yaw and crossfades.

a17bab2680a4a52a.name: run_dinner_scene_test
a17bab2680a4a52a.doc: Debug entry that plays the dinner scene.

a17f723debf2fcb6.name: play_time_gate_return_scene
a17f723debf2fcb6.doc: Time gate warp cutscene for the way back to the present: the gate rings appear, Atlamillia glows, the screen fades to white and a caption says they returned to the present. Parameters are as for the jump scene.

a1bbcb317014d126.name: talk_gerald_check_gun
a1bbcb317014d126.doc: Gerald checks whether the player has the Bell Trigger gun (item 25). Without it he dismisses them; with it he joins the party and quest 11 is marked cleared.

a1ca5bf472d16f7e.name: interact_with_rock_blocking_path
a1ca5bf472d16f7e.doc: Examining the rock says it blocks the way. If the player picks item 173 in the use item menu, the rock is removed, the new area parts p05/p06 are shown and monsters 629 and 630 are loaded for the fight. Ride Pod characters only get a refusal message.

a1d5e12689c4d2c0.name: poll_message_skip
a1d5e12689c4d2c0.doc: Returns 1 once the confirm button closes the message in the given slot; advances pages or speeds the text on the way, 0 otherwise.

a1f13433e2645696.name: show_chapter_8_villager_line
a1f13433e2645696.doc: Shows the chapter 8 idle line of the party member whose NPC id is party_chara in the given message window. Used by the party member menu instead of the normal message number.

a20aedae4b97d52a.name: talk_adel_early
a20aedae4b97d52a.doc: Adel's talk before the first quest is cleared: she is working as a maid but dreams of being a tailor.

a20d5b7801741e43.name: open_cobweb_door_with_slash_branch
a20d5b7801741e43.doc: Cobweb door: with a party NPC of type 4 it opens at once with a line of dialogue; otherwise the player must use the Slash Branch (item 340) to cut it open.

a21800ac243b0cc4.name: set_flag_107_then_warp_to_s06b_1
a21800ac243b0cc4.doc: Sets flag 107 and starts event 510 in s06b_1.

a23a6d755a90555b.name: open_treasure_chest
a23a6d755a90555b.doc: Opens a treasure chest in a dungeon room. Chests flagged 256 are mimics, with a warning from the party NPC in slot 9 when present, then spawn the monster. Otherwise it handles the locked (2) and trapped (4) bits, then opens an item chest or a clown chest (128). Returns the first item id, or 0 if the player backed out or a mimic appeared.

a24abc2aa0c6952a.name: load_s43b_script
a24abc2aa0c6952a.doc: Runs an empty event and loads event script s43/s43b.stb at the map start.

a24c2ce151354b9c.name: play_condor_drop_floor_intro
a24c2ce151354b9c.doc: Intro for every floor. The character is dropped by a condor holding Giant Meat, falls, lands and walks forward, with the dungeon logo (show_map 0) or floor map (show_map 1) fading, then the Red, Blue or White Seal notices when the floor has a seal.

a26d15d1fcab6c53.name: choose_transfer_gate_destination
a26d15d1fcab6c53.doc: Shows the list of transfer gate destinations (north, east, west, in front of the time gate, and Paznos Bridge once analysis flag 410 is set) and warps the player there with the sun warp effect.

a28c9cf532027d9c.name: show_event_hint_from_event_310
a28c9cf532027d9c.doc: Event 310 program; it only shows the pending event hint.

a299d2df34d0a08d.name: setup_map_objects
a299d2df34d0a08d.doc: Sets up the f01 map: disables the e277 function point, hides map part p11_f0101 when analysis flag 104 or 105 is set, updates NPC activity and places the player at a fixed spot.

a29d270462689d09.name: play_e103_scene_then_load_script
a29d270462689d09.doc: Loads monster data 614, plays event e103 and loads the s06_1 event script.

a2a03c4c2255b122.name: finish_fight_and_return_to_pau_house
a2a03c4c2255b122.doc: After the fight, removes the Electric Fish, unblocks map moves, plays the freed scene and opens Georama edit mode for Pau's House.

a2a61a53d487896f.name: vanish_spiral_rock_5
a2a61a53d487896f.doc: Binds map part p11_d06b02-5 and plays the spiral rock vanish scene.

a2af29b56e03f666.name: load_event_277_charas
a2af29b56e03f666.doc: Sets up Max and Monica as scene actors, loads the badge model (slot 35) and the event 277 message file.

a2b1af246fac5c30.name: recruit_talk_npc
a2b1af246fac5c30.doc: Marks the talked-to NPC as joining the party and shows the party character message with their name.

a2ba296785ef4b5e.name: setup_opening_town_entry
a2ba296785ef4b5e.doc: Map start for the opening town. Locks map moves unless flag 103 is set, and after loading a save places the player. Otherwise plays the run-in entrance when coming from map 15 or map types 7 and 8, else the default entrance.

a2cc6f54f360b1ac.name: play_light_stream_then_enter_ixion
a2cc6f54f360b1ac.doc: Plays the light stream scene and jumps to map s37 (Ixion engine room) at entry 510.

a2d1ed7052214531.name: play_golem_slope_charge_scene
a2d1ed7052214531.doc: Event 540 variant: all hundred golems run up the slope toward the fortress from a fixed camera.

a2d5a1d821a401ad.name: load_priscleen_actors
a2d5a1d821a401ad.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Mardan, his frog form, the ripple, wink and pink effects and the e245 message file.

a2d9fba6fbcf821d.name: start_osmond_asleep_scene
a2d9fba6fbcf821d.doc: Story 414 program: clears flag 408 (electric worm request started), sets up the map characters and plays play_osmond_asleep_scene, the short scene of Osmond sound asleep.

a2e36ab4f1091249.name: setup_event_230_actors
a2e36ab4f1091249.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Master Utan and four poison apples as scene actors for event 230 and its message file. Sets globals max_chara_slot and partner_chara_slot.

a2e509609831959e.name: play_donny_gives_gun_scene
a2e509609831959e.doc: Skippable scene where Max explains why he wants to leave the town and Donny gives him the Classic Gun and the Help Receiver, with item get messages and a tip on attacking.

a2ee872b4841d4cd.name: play_train_cleared_toward_balance_valley_scene
a2ee872b4841d4cd.doc: Sets flag 280 and plays event 280: Borneo and the others clear a rock off the tracks, the train moves on and the party sets its sights on Balance Valley. Skippable; forces night-time lighting at 23:30 if it is dark.

a2f8ae8ac96272d7.name: talk_villager_by_kind
a2f8ae8ac96272d7.doc: Calls the generic villager talk when the talked-to character number is below 100 or above 1000; other characters are handled elsewhere.

a2fbb8b10c1ea4c0.name: play_lava_parting_scene
a2fbb8b10c1ea4c0.doc: Sets flag 526 and plays the scene where Max blows the Fire Horn and the lava parts (voice: the lava is parting). Switches the player to Max first and leaves the party handles visible again at the end.

a32e1d3799bde7e7.name: enter_i01h01_event_500
a32e1d3799bde7e7.doc: Enables an invention func point, positions the camera and player and goes inside house i01h01 at entry 500.

a3386f16f0e14264.name: play_ocean_breeze_arrival_scene
a3386f16f0e14264.doc: Event 400 (flag 400): a train with smoke pulls in, Monica enjoys the sea air and learns Max has never been to the ocean, workers say they will wait, and the pair leave. Villagers are restored and the player placed at the station. Skippable.

a33f1c885c8a59f8.name: place_player
a33f1c885c8a59f8.doc: Places the player at the given spot and facing, standing.

a34866b935082a3d.name: talk_blinkhorn_race_result
a34866b935082a3d.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk about the boat race against the clock: stops the stopwatch and, by counter 7 and the result, either offers the race (first time), scolds for not reaching the boat or cheating, reports a too-slow time, or on a time under 2:01 recruits him and clears quest 9. Returns 0 except on the recruit path.

a34a58e74c12d27c.name: offer_last_ball_reset
a34a58e74c12d27c.doc: Spheda golf: tells the player this is the last time the ball can be moved to their feet and asks (yes/no). On yes it moves the ball and its two characters 3 units above the player, marks the last challenge and crossfades.

a34c9a6b360795d0.name: show_message_auto_button2
a34c9a6b360795d0.doc: Like show_message_auto but also reports an extra button press in the array.

a358da7ed416670c.name: sink_rock_pillar_and_player
a358da7ed416670c.doc: Turns the camera toward the bound rock part, makes the spiral rock vanish with a sound and lowers the player 260 units down the shaft.

a36d1fd0b851f85b.name: set_room_objects
a36d1fd0b851f85b.doc: Shows the Lafrescia room map parts for a stage. Stage 0 the plain room, 1 the room with the tongue parts, 2 the same plus the slime, 3 the plain room again.

a36e6b18d824db48.name: flee_palace_beam_to_s26
a36e6b18d824db48.doc: Program 530: plays the palace beam flee scene and jumps to map s26 (Carpenterion Outer) at entrance 550.

a3979f9b6ce21dce.name: play_mother_crying_memory_scene
a3979f9b6ce21dce.doc: Story event 102. White-washed memory of a crying mother and child, with Max's narration about the Underground Channel and no longer remembering his mother's face. Sets flag 102 and restores the time of day afterward.

a39fac96048890fc.name: play_first_sight_of_sea_scene
a39fac96048890fc.doc: Event 402 (sets flag 402). Max sees the ocean for the first time and frolics in the surf, then hears a cry and points to the nearby cave.

a3a6c4cdb15f2024.name: talk_aunt_polly_after_joining
a3a6c4cdb15f2024.doc: Aunt Polly's chatter after the bread delivery quest is cleared, asking where to go next. Chapter 8 swaps in an offer of bread.

a3ba7b36972efba8.name: ask_to_leave_for_d06
a3ba7b36972efba8.doc: Asks the exit question and, on yes, restores controls and loads the d06 dungeon script.

a3d2739e52e23f72.name: play_nova_driver_cannon_scene
a3d2739e52e23f72.doc: Sets flag 640. Max and Monica look up and learn that Paznos will use its strongest weapon, the Nova Driver Cannon.

a3dc88dab5222dca.name: play_event_205_to_s03
a3dc88dab5222dca.doc: Plays event 205, then jumps to map s03 at event 512 without reloading the BGM.

a3e01f0d04cf14eb.name: open_floor_select_menu
a3e01f0d04cf14eb.doc: Entry from the town: plays BGM 22, opens the dungeon map menu and starts the chosen floor.

a3e3a964b2872c57.name: play_osmond_asleep_scene
a3e3a964b2872c57.doc: Story event 414. Osmond is fast asleep at his desk and the party remarks on it. Sets flag 414.

a3f4cdfc2314cb64.name: play_run_in_from_path
a3f4cdfc2314cb64.doc: The player runs in along a short path, the screen fades out and in, and he is placed at (2358, 0, 1357.7) with the camera behind.

a407fa30e2345934.name: play_borneo_ready_to_depart_scene
a407fa30e2345934.doc: Sets flag 372 and plays event 372: Max and Monica run to the station and the villager there tells them they are just in time and to say when they are ready to go. Skippable.

a420e2f842a68d13.name: play_train_departure_scene
a420e2f842a68d13.doc: The train pulls away from the platform with steam puffs and fades out.

a4389a2998c1dbe3.name: test_departure_and_event_616
a4389a2998c1dbe3.doc: Debug entry that runs the departure question and then event 616.

a451cd5d42d2ade3.name: setup_e336_point
a451cd5d42d2ade3.doc: Prepares the s18 map for event 336: stops the music, loads its sounds, hides a map piece, and enables the event point only when the clinic event was seen and the Lin lighthouse memory has not.

a480960fcafb2879.name: enter_room_5_and_fight
a480960fcafb2879.doc: Fades out, plays the room 5 intro, raises map parts 8 and 9, loads monsters 607 and 608 and places the player; then fades in.

a4994f19392f9f5b.name: set_train_door_angles
a4994f19392f9f5b.doc: Tilts the train's door and step map pieces (s3601_16, 17 and 12 variants) by plus or minus 30 or 90 degrees to open pose, and hides the s3601_14 pieces 2 to 5.

a4b7806d81b79c26.name: talk_parn_joined_in_studio
a4b7806d81b79c26.doc: Parn's talk in his studio after he has joined: outside chapter 8 Monica hears that girls cannot understand a man chasing his ideals and Max is offered his painting ability; in chapter 8 he muses on how deep painting is. Then talk_to_npc.

a4baec42f7b10ff3.name: open_cleared_room_door
a4baec42f7b10ff3.doc: Opens the door of the current room after a fight: opens it on the minimap, swaps the door map pieces, rotates and scales the door parts and disables its function points. Does nothing if there is no visible door.

a4c7af11c67a089a.name: show_stream_message_auto
a4c7af11c67a089a.doc: Shows message mes while a voice stream plays, runs the voice for the given frames and closes the window.

a4f2c89d3e18e3cf.name: talk_olivie_after_joining
a4f2c89d3e18e3cf.doc: Olivie's chatter after the race quest is cleared, hoping to stand on the winner's podium. Chapter 8 swaps in a remark about Fabio's single interest.

a4f57e8dcc7fbb30.name: talk_corinne_quest_offer
a4f57e8dcc7fbb30.doc: Corinne asks to come along. Declining gets insults and returns 0. Accepting starts a hide-and-seek: she vanishes, a hint says to find her in Palm Brinks, quest 18 is marked accepted and counter 11 is set to 0.

a50b746c7a860b9f.name: play_train_rush_scene
a50b746c7a860b9f.doc: Sets flag 600, shows a train racing through a screen-shaking tunnel scene with sound, hides the party, sets story progress to 8 and shows chapter title 6.

a537173396990e45.name: get_chest_open_se
a537173396990e45.doc: Returns the chest opening sound id for the current dungeon stage: 110 for stages 0 and 1, 112 for stages 2 to 5, otherwise 0.

a53c3a9ca87f88cb.name: play_shingala_freed_scene
a53c3a9ca87f88cb.doc: Sets flag 420 and plays event 420: the device is turned off, Shingala is exhausted and the party takes him back to the water.

a540efd0d6583a9d.name: ask_move_to_channel_entrance
a540efd0d6583a9d.doc: Asks whether to move to the Underground Channel entrance. Fades out and returns 1 on yes, otherwise returns 0.

a547cdde99c54675.name: play_battleship_flies_over_scene
a547cdde99c54675.doc: Noon scene: Max, Monica and Pau run across the field while the camera follows and the battleship map part swings across the sky above them over 450 frames.

a567625ed70a4905.name: play_monica_curses_griffon_scene
a567625ed70a4905.doc: Short scene after Gaspard's death: Monica rages at Griffon and Max says her name. Sets flag 536.

a567de1703b8dd82.name: play_temple_restored_reward_scene
a567de1703b8dd82.doc: Story event 376. Crest thanks Max and Monica for fully restoring Starlight Temple and gives them a Serpent Slicer. Sets flag 376.

a56933cddf33112b.name: show_cedric_suggests_restarting_railroad
a56933cddf33112b.doc: Cedric says Need should just start the Blackstone Railroad again.

a56ad53c4a8a8d4d.name: press_panel_0_2
a56ad53c4a8a8d4d.doc: Candle puzzle step for the church candle at row 0, column 2: cuts to a fixed camera, waits 45 frames, toggles that candle and its four neighbours (i01h07_13 pieces), then waits 45 frames.

a578916827b706b0.name: enter_palm_brinks_square
a578916827b706b0.doc: Asks whether to move to the square venue, and on yes jumps to map s45, Palm Brinks Square.

a58bd5a971ea66a0.name: talk_to_milane
a58bd5a971ea66a0.doc: Talk handler for Milane. When the saved progress is 100 it does nothing, otherwise it sets the event data to that character's slot and runs the villager talk handler.

a5c86444311220a4.name: talk_rosa_early
a5c86444311220a4.doc: Rosa's talk before the first quest is cleared: she apologizes for being hard of hearing and asks to be spoken to slowly.

a5cbf60d68798423.name: play_shot_party_looks_around
a5cbf60d68798423.doc: Scene shot: the party looks around in confusion.

a5cbf88df86cb9af.name: play_floor_arrival_scene
a5cbf88df86cb9af.doc: Plays the arrival cutscene on a floor: the player runs in through a door piece while either the dungeon map or the d00 logo fades. Then shows the Red, Blue or White Seal messages if the floor is sealed.

a5cf10c1c1b958f5.name: setup_station
a5cf10c1c1b958f5.doc: Shows the station state and places the player. After loading a save the player appears at the platform. Arriving from the train maps with counter 1 equal to 6 plays the leave-the-train scene, otherwise the train arrival scene.

a5db3d6539c80719.name: play_spheda_shot
a5db3d6539c80719.doc: One Spheda (mini golf) stroke: loads the golf models, runs the aim and power gauge, then simulates the ball with gravity, bounces, water and spin until it stops, holes out or leaves the course. On a hole-in it spawns a prize treasure box and counts the clear, on a stop with par 2 or more it offers to place the player at the ball, otherwise shows the miss animation. Returns 0.

a5e793aa159511c6.name: warp_to_s20_after_story_520
a5e793aa159511c6.doc: Story 520 program: warps to map s20 and runs its story_520 program (15200 = 520*10+10000).

a5e8d9cbf92b7222.name: start_emperor_griffon_fight
a5e8d9cbf92b7222.doc: Starts the Emperor Griffon fight without its reveal scene: switches to BGM 36, shows map part p05_d06e01-0, fades in over 30 frames and places monster 515.

a608e372b3ec26de.name: talk_mina_after_joining
a608e372b3ec26de.doc: Mina's chatter after the Spheda quest is cleared, asking not to be taken to insect places. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about the Blackstone Railroad.

a626a909062c4cbf.name: show_spheda_instructions
a626a909062c4cbf.doc: Shows the Spheda tutorial messages: aiming, the power gauge, the impact zone, spin by direction and how to pull the ball back, then notes the Guide entry was added.

a63a621dccd5d208.name: enter_i01h01_event_105_2
a63a621dccd5d208.doc: Clears flag 105, sets progress to 3 and goes inside house i01h01 at event 105 variant 2.

a63e460b2c82c60f.name: step_back_with_channel_hint
a63e460b2c82c60f.doc: Used while story flag 4 is set: Max walks back from the gate and thinks that he should ask Donny where the water channel leads.

a6515a9e8e1fd60c.name: start_yorda_tree_arrival_scene
a6515a9e8e1fd60c.doc: Story 332: fades out and plays the arrival scene.

a668398da4a06ba6.name: show_need_sitting_at_desk
a668398da4a06ba6.doc: Opening shot of Need sitting at his desk, with a camera pull-back after a fade in.

a676abf49eff8ba9.name: run_monster_talk
a676abf49eff8ba9.doc: Runs a monster talking in a dungeon room: reads the monster and message from the monster talk data (returns 0 if none), pauses enemies, loads the talk file and message, shows the line and talks to the monster, then unpauses.

a67dd3a62cfd0c10.name: play_fire_gem_get_scene
a67dd3a62cfd0c10.doc: Plays event e624 (sets flag 636): the player picks up the Lapis, shows the Fire Gem item message, and returns the player to the lower room.

a6b644de00d63162.name: replay_balance_valley_arrival_scene
a6b644de00d63162.doc: Story 302 handler: plays the Balance Valley arrival scene.

a6b868f8b5bcb545.name: tell_player_to_get_to_work
a6b868f8b5bcb545.doc: Cedric, the character in slot 9, turns toward the player if needed and says the job is on the desk downstairs and to get to work.

a6caa66e0cdd53dc.name: unload_monica_vs_gaspard_actors
a6caa66e0cdd53dc.doc: Removes the actors loaded for the Monica versus Gaspard sword fight, reshows the handles and status bar, then finishes the event.

a6ea96f751b615c1.name: place_corinne_inside_hut
a6ea96f751b615c1.doc: Loads Corinne as a resident villager and places her inside the hut.

a6fe8733fdd06d2b.name: play_monica_gaspard_sword_fight
a6fe8733fdd06d2b.doc: Cutscene of Monica and Gaspard crossing swords, with sword trails and hit sparks timed per frame while the camera follows a camera model's frames. Ends with a fade and cleanup through unload_monica_vs_gaspard_actors.

a71206d1d5303ec4.name: play_lift_arrival_warp_scene
a71206d1d5303ec4.doc: Sets flag 612. At the top a warp effect appears around the platform, then Max and his partner are placed back at the start with the camera behind them.

a717fe9d76b37b52.name: play_ridepod_departure_then_enter_dungeon
a717fe9d76b37b52.doc: Same as play_ridepod_departure_and_join, but on departure goes straight to dungeon 0, floor 4 with event 520.

a7292d5a557f1a5f.name: play_cedric_walk_away_scene
a7292d5a557f1a5f.doc: A short scene: the character walks up a path across the field while the camera sweeps and fades out, then control returns.

a742df2c7aa44bce.name: play_arrival_ten_thousand_years_ago_scene
a742df2c7aa44bce.doc: Sets flag 600. The train lands in the past, Max and Monica step out with Osmond and note there is only one moon in the sky. They sense Emperor Griffon inside the palace ahead and set off while Osmond says he will wait. Ends with the player placed at the palace approach.

a74573a9a706c1f9.name: on_map_start
a74573a9a706c1f9.doc: Loads the mine sound set and places the player. If flag 804 is not set, adds Monica and the fourth party member, plays the arrival scene and moves the player to the mine entrance.

a75e806bb9a86827.name: show_item_get_message
a75e806bb9a86827.doc: Shows the item received message: message 10 for one, message 11 with the count for more, with the item name filled in and the system jingle. Returns 0 without showing anything when count is not positive, otherwise 1.

a774ea5d04ff530f.name: show_emperor_griffon_image
a774ea5d04ff530f.doc: Shows the second story image and the line naming Emperor Griffon as the enemy who destroyed everything.

a77ec4efb022cb1c.name: receive_adel_garment_and_recruit
a77ec4efb022cb1c.doc: Quest 7 finish: Adel gives you a finished garment (258, 259 or 260, the first one you do not own), joins the party and the quest is cleared.

a7d0ca8784e3aed9.name: talk_about_blinkhorn_errand
a7d0ca8784e3aed9.doc: Dialogue of a character about the errand for Sheriff Blinkhorn. If Max is the active character and counter 7 is 1, it sets counter 7 to 2 and tells them to hurry back to Blinkhorn.

a7faeed951dbca8e.name: play_circus_opening_part_one
a7faeed951dbca8e.doc: Sets up the first part of the circus opening: loads the audience and performer characters, the circus tent map parts and sounds, and runs the crowd, clown and acrobat acts.

a800f40066d0c162.name: talk_stewart_early
a800f40066d0c162.doc: Stewart's talk before the first quest is cleared: he tells the player to come to him with any problem.

a80267c570175464.name: play_floor_clear_scene
a80267c570175464.doc: Floor clear event: the active character plays a victory pose, the floor is marked cleared (flags 2 and 1024), medal and challenge messages show, and Spheda or seal messages appear when conditions are met. Seals broken (red, blue, white) are announced and lifted from the floor status.

a80361d11be5de9d.name: play_osmond_asleep_scene
a80361d11be5de9d.doc: Event 414. Max and Monica walk into the lab and find Dr. Osmond fast asleep, remarking he is a sound sleeper. Sets flag 414.

a80e2c593b36539e.name: play_holly_thanks_scene
a80e2c593b36539e.doc: Cutscene after the Rainbow Butterfly boss (flag 260, event 260): the seven butterflies gather into a light and Holly appears. She tells Max and Monica how the Firbits saved her, why she vanished, and hands over a letter for her old friends, then Max answers that they will try to reach Jurak. Skippable.

a80fb2a52f48e0a5.name: use_station_door_side_0
a80fb2a52f48e0a5.doc: Event 201: if door side 0 is open, plays the door sound, fades out, sets counter 15 to 0 and jumps to the station map; otherwise plays the refuse sound and motion.

a8142b0e8c31731f.name: play_holly_letter_scene
a8142b0e8c31731f.doc: The villagers gather as Holly letter is read: she says she must leave, and that the time together was wonderful. They cry, say Holly is Holly to them, and ask to go along with Max and Monica. Ends with narration that the forest adventure came to an end. Skippable.

a821a31be45586c9.name: can_play_event_456
a821a31be45586c9.doc: Returns 1 when event 456 can play: analysis flag 301 is set, the Lunar Lab-found flag is not set yet, and the character can be switched to Monica.

a844f0a3c01852f9.name: play_event_109a
a844f0a3c01852f9.doc: Event 109a: Cedric comes in through the door and presses Need at his desk for the truth, and Need begins to explain. Sets the train departure seen flag first and can be skipped.

a853378fcf05858c.name: place_station_villagers
a853378fcf05858c.doc: Places the station villagers: Cedric is replaced by Osmond during chapters 6 and 7, and Borneo and Erik are only added while flag 500 is clear.

a869e59beb96a460.name: ask_to_enter_dungeon_with_gem
a869e59beb96a460.doc: Entrance prompt: only Max or Monica can use it (the other characters get a message). Without the gem (flag 632) it says so; otherwise it asks, and on yes fades out, clears monsters and loads dungeon d04.

a86b80777d433fb0.name: play_sick_child_scene_then_start_dungeon_3
a86b80777d433fb0.doc: Plays the sick child scene and starts dungeon d03 on floor 1.

a8728db7b4b91446.name: press_panel_row1_col3
a8728db7b4b91446.doc: Presses the puzzle switch for the panel at row 1, column 3, toggling it and its neighbours.

a8795ba5cd904c29.name: open_save_menu_with_fade
a8795ba5cd904c29.doc: Sets the player to stand, fades out, opens the save menu and fades back in when it closes.

a879a32010095706.name: talk_to_regular_villager
a879a32010095706.doc: Runs the villager talk handler for villager numbers below 100 or above 1000; others do nothing here.

a8803e533fd451bd.name: animate_projection
a8803e533fd451bd.doc: Steps the camera projection from from_projection toward to_projection over frames frames, using the difference divided by frames truncated to an integer step; it does not set the final value. The last parameter is unused.

a89ce433f4786b93.name: open_npc_shop_faded
a89ce433f4786b93.doc: Fades out, opens the shop menu for shop_id, then closes the NPC windows and fades back in.

a8aed4aa2e083b11.name: show_cedric_work_unfinished
a8aed4aa2e083b11.doc: Event program that makes Max say he has not finished the work Cedric asked him to do.

a8d3221a1daa1657.name: play_hide_and_seek_then_jump_to_g05_550
a8d3221a1daa1657.doc: Plays the hide and seek scene and jumps to map g05 at entry 550. Returns 0.

a8d384f86088a1f9.name: play_fisherman_grape_juice_scene
a8d384f86088a1f9.doc: Event 220: the group's fisherman complains the fish aren't biting and the others have gone strange, and asks for something to drink. If the player gives Grape Juice (item 370) he hands over a Fishing Rod and Mimi bait and the fishing tutorial is shown.

a8e693da3a3773fb.name: place_rare_jacket_pack
a8e693da3a3773fb.doc: Loads the Rare Jacket (monster 183) and places five of them around the room, then pauses the battle music.

a8f487ffc148246b.name: go_to_sindain_if_confirmed
a8f487ffc148246b.doc: Asks about moving to Sindain and jumps to map g01 if confirmed.

a8fc95f5a316e3c8.name: talk_fabio_check_fish
a8fc95f5a316e3c8.doc: Fabio's check of the fish record (fish 322, Nonky). With none caught he mocks Max; under 0.6 he mocks the size in centimetres; otherwise he is impressed, joins via recruit_talk_npc and quest 15 is set to cleared. Returns 0 when he refuses.

a9063c51334b8ab6.name: choose_floor_and_enter_dungeon
a9063c51334b8ab6.doc: After the entry question, opens the stage 4 dungeon tree map. Floor 0 returns to the map entrance, any other choice starts the dungeon on that floor (skipping BGM load for floor 21).

a90ef36278c9f85c.name: warp_to_boss_floor_after_story_528
a90ef36278c9f85c.doc: Story 528 program: warps to boss floor d05b01 and runs its story_528 program (15280 = 528*10+10000).

a9135a35c1679391.name: play_victory_crowd_back_scene
a9135a35c1679391.doc: Event 824 variant showing a second row of ten villagers. Sets flag 824.

a91b3d041fe5b6f1.name: play_event_436
a91b3d041fe5b6f1.doc: Shigura village cutscene: Max and Monica look up at the villagers, can't understand them and wonder what to do, then fade out. The chara argument is the character whose position anchors the scene.

a9219a8dd1b013ff.name: show_cedric_work_unfinished
a9219a8dd1b013ff.doc: Event program that makes Max say he has not finished the work Cedric asked him to do.

a935681653313739.name: interact_with_gate_1
a935681653313739.doc: Handles the second of the four gates.

a93ba1de4f9de103.name: ask_to_enter_dungeon
a93ba1de4f9de103.doc: If the player is in a transformed form (2 or 3) a message says they cannot go in. Otherwise asks whether to enter, and on yes fades out and loads the d07 dungeon script.

a94f55fa6f70f06b.name: explain_new_invention_menu
a94f55fa6f70f06b.doc: Cedric explains choosing Make, Invention Mode and New Invention in the main menu, and picking the three pictures to invent the Energy Pack.

a95e4df7b442f971.name: play_lift_ascent_scene
a95e4df7b442f971.doc: Sets flag 612. Smoke billows, a platform with a ring effect rises high into the sky and a ring appears and fades while the camera follows.

a95ed595411d2687.name: use_starglass_to_go_to_past
a95ed595411d2687.doc: Function point program: asks to travel to the past and opens the item menu for the Starglass. Using it fades out, plays event 352 and loads dungeon d03b02 at program 502. A wrong item plays a miss reaction.

a96a023a17297f66.name: place_two_nail_bursts
a96a023a17297f66.doc: Loads Nail Burst (monster 7), places two of them facing the entrance and pauses the battle music.

a9764cdbe6e6ecad.name: warp_to_s06_after_story_108b
a9764cdbe6e6ecad.doc: Story 108b program: sets story progress to 3 and warps to map s06, running its story_108b program (11082 = 108*10+2+10000) in s06_1.

a97c7cc7193c7fbb.name: play_gaspard_backstory_scene
a97c7cc7193c7fbb.doc: Sets flag 532 and plays the scene after the first Gaspard fight: he tells Max and Monica about his changeling father, human mother and their hard life, with still images. Skippable.

a97dd7025dd1391f.name: setup_timed_boss_floor
a97dd7025dd1391f.doc: Entry setup of the d06b03 boss floor. With flag 728 set it switches Ride Pod or monster forms back to Max or Monica, plays the Dark Ruler flurry scene, places the Dark Element and Moon monsters (621 and 622) and starts a 5 minute stopwatch; it always places the player at z -400 and fades in.

a9a1de993ec923e3.name: show_final_ranking_board
a9a1de993ec923e3.doc: Shows the three-step ranking board for the race with the final fish names and times.

a9a3db74490a5e7f.name: load_event_sound
a9a3db74490a5e7f.doc: Loads sound set 1683 for the event.

a9af6e00c583a375.name: wait_frames
a9af6e00c583a375.doc: Waits frames frames scaled by 50/60 (PAL rate), plus one wait.

a9b7c2d54d7524f6.name: wait_for_button_press
a9b7c2d54d7524f6.doc: Debug event that waits for the confirm button and ends.

a9b8f3e4d02ba0d0.name: load_moonflower_beam_actors
a9b8f3e4d02ba0d0.doc: Loads the Moonflower beam models, the beam effect script and the palace map part for the beam scenes.

a9bff63193e1dcd3.name: play_opening_circus_scenes
a9bff63193e1dcd3.doc: Stops time and map moves, hides the status bar and plays the two circus scenes, then loads the s43b event script at 151.

a9cb177adee1cede.name: play_atlamillia_blue_light_scene
a9cb177adee1cede.doc: Sets flag 522. Max looks up and touches his Atlamillia as it glows blue, and thinks that Monica's Atlamillia is lending its power across time. The world coordinate frame is set from the four parameters.

a9cd4a82226b5a6c.name: load_mardan_hooked_actors
a9cd4a82226b5a6c.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Mardan, the fishing line, wink and splash effects and the e240 message file.

a9e325c73e2acb2a.name: increment_floor_visit_count
a9e325c73e2acb2a.doc: Adds one to the visit count stored for the given dungeon stage and floor.

a9eb4d290d723d2d.name: play_train_arrival_scene
a9eb4d290d723d2d.doc: Plays the steam train arriving with smoke, then Max steps off the train and runs to the platform.

a9f7639d69eebfc9.name: exit_to_map_s45
a9f7639d69eebfc9.doc: Ends the tour: sets the finish-tour menu value, fades out music and screen, cleans up and jumps to map s45, Palm Brinks Square.

a9f9183b086142da.name: start_night_town_event
a9f9183b086142da.doc: Runs the shared night town event (time of day set to 22:00, villagers removed).

aa0f35c681c1c600.name: play_monster_badge_plan_scene
aa0f35c681c1c600.doc: Cutscene (event 277, sets flag 277): Monica shows Max a monster-transforming badge and explains they can pose as Himarra monsters to get the Sundrop; Max cheers and they set off for the forest floor.

aa173cda48ceb458.name: start_arrival_scene_event
aa173cda48ceb458.doc: Hides the memo if owned, sets counter 5 to 3 and plays the arrival scene.

aa174ae6fdb9e1d4.name: talk_to_pau_by_quest_state
aa174ae6fdb9e1d4.doc: Runs the Pau talk that matches quest 5's state: not accepted, accepted, or cleared.

aa42afb0fdd6f5fb.name: play_dungeon_return_walk
aa42afb0fdd6f5fb.doc: Short cutscene of the player walking back out of the dungeon entrance in the georama.

aa4e2d6edb773055.name: jump_to_s66_after_boss
aa4e2d6edb773055.doc: Plays the boss ending scene, sets save progress to 10 and jumps to map s66 at event 520.

aa56b1f5a3826232.name: play_ancient_past_arrival_on_start
aa56b1f5a3826232.doc: Shows the late station parts, plays the ancient past arrival scene and loads the waiting villager.

aa5a983617c091ef.name: play_need_agrees_to_tell
aa5a983617c091ef.doc: Cedric presses Need as a friend and Need says he cannot hide it any longer.

aa5d9a347f51d2e5.name: play_cedric_walks_away_then_go_to_mayors_office
aa5d9a347f51d2e5.doc: Plays Cedric's walk-away scene (event 109), skips the villager load and jumps to map i03h01a (Mayor's Office) at entry 500.

aa641c804077ace3.name: play_dungeon_entry_scene
aa641c804077ace3.doc: Plays the dungeon entry scene: the title logo fades in as the character walks forward from the entrance while the camera orbits, then control returns.

aa6c749db6ef59ba.name: start_finny_frenzy_announcement
aa6c749db6ef59ba.doc: Story event 424, plays the Finny Frenzy announcement.

aa795f370d1045ff.name: play_blue_time_gate_scene
aa795f370d1045ff.doc: Plays the warp scene through the blue time gate. With Monica it uses the shared scene variant; otherwise it first plays the Atlamillia blue light scene when the edit-blocked save flag is set and flags 532 and 522 are not.

aa7e28f4fa70f69f.name: play_ridepod_departure_then_enter_dungeon
aa7e28f4fa70f69f.doc: Same as play_ridepod_departure_and_join, but on departure goes straight to dungeon 0, floor 4 with event 520.

aa86e6f1f1b27aa9.name: talk_adel_give_materials
aa86e6f1f1b27aa9.doc: Adel's materials talk: needs a Sturdy Cloth, Thick Hide and Hunk of Copper in the bag and explains if any is missing. If all are held she asks and, on yes, takes them, sets counter 8 to 2 and walks off with a fade (the villager is removed). Returns 0.

aa878b2adcd762c0.name: warn_player_at_town_edge
aa878b2adcd762c0.doc: Walks the player a few steps back from the town edge while the camera follows and shows a reminder: hurry to the circus if the player has a ticket, otherwise that the red-headed kid did not come this way.

aa9f048d2de63fd0.name: ask_to_enter_palace_dungeon
aa9f048d2de63fd0.doc: Asks whether to enter the dungeon ahead (question 7, place name 97). On yes fades out and returns 1; on no the camera follows the player for 30 frames and it returns 0.

aaa212651baa5f66.name: hide_aim_guide
aaa212651baa5f66.doc: Hides the aim guide by turning off sprites 0 to 47.

aaa3f26403a4707d.name: enter_f03i04_entrance_3
aaa3f26403a4707d.doc: Event 404: turns to face north-west, fades out, sets map counter 2 to 3 and jumps to map f03i04.

aaed4a6d29cba770.name: claim_earth_gem_after_boss
aaed4a6d29cba770.doc: After the boss, adds the Earth Gem, marks the floor info and plays the gem pickup scene.

ab0d869c97fc3037.name: set_story_308_flags_and_start_map
ab0d869c97fc3037.doc: Story trigger for event 308: sets flag 300, clears 320 and runs the map start.

ab2f4cbac32bd82d.name: wait_camera_path_or_skip
ab2f4cbac32bd82d.doc: Waits until the camera path ends. Returns 1 if button 32 is pressed first, otherwise 0.

ab348f3ebb7888e4.name: play_room_title_card_scene
ab348f3ebb7888e4.doc: Hides the player, shows the d07domari02 title card and two heroes standing, then restores the player.

ab52c176be7a6b2b.name: give_white_windflower_to_lao_chao
ab52c176be7a6b2b.doc: Talk handler for the shumai point: after confirming, opens the item menu and, if the White Windflower (item 363) is used, adds the Miracle Dumplings (item 364) and plays the cooking scene. Other items get a miss reaction.

ab66721445709ae8.name: can_play_any_story_event
ab66721445709ae8.doc: Returns 1 if any of the story events 364, 368, 372 or 376 can be played.

ab7a2eef5566fb4d.name: play_mardan_meeting_scene
ab7a2eef5566fb4d.doc: Event 240: Mardan, the swamp master, appears with a hook in his lip. Monica demands he undo what he did to the Firbits and he agrees if they catch him a Priscleen Fish to clean him. Sets flag 240.

ab8b0532ad0f32eb.name: play_farewell_story_scene
ab8b0532ad0f32eb.doc: Story event 737: fades out, plays the farewell scene and jumps to Maximilian's Room i04h01 at entry 530.

ab8dcdc1e00ff78d.name: talk_donny_to_monica
ab8dcdc1e00ff78d.doc: Donny's talk when Monica is the active character: he says he has hardly seen Max since she arrived and hopes she is not using him.

ab8deea1afd28b88.name: play_event_215_scene_and_show_story_points
ab8deea1afd28b88.doc: Program 501: plays event 215 (a crowd of strange villagers is spotted), sets counter 3 to 1 and shows the story points.

ab94de58760773ba.name: load_event_332_cast
ab94de58760773ba.doc: Loads the actors for event 332: Max and Monica (switching from the Ridepod forms if needed), the NPC model p00_26a and the message file.

abb433f08af8e757.name: load_event_372_scene
abb433f08af8e757.doc: Loads Max and Monica with the event 372 motions, a station villager model and the event 372 messages, and marks them as no-distance-fade.

abb6aa75a6458b42.name: open_cleared_room_door
abb6aa75a6458b42.doc: Opens the door of the current room after a fight (called from the room-clear event): opens it on the minimap, swaps the d06d00 door pieces, stops the d06d00_2-m part motion, hides the door's collision pieces and disables the key1 marker. Returns 0 if the marker is hidden.

abbd866849677bd3.name: play_holly_letter_scene
abbd866849677bd3.doc: Removes the Teal Envelope item, plays Holly's goodbye and fades in.

abca566ad8bca3df.name: play_murals_and_shingala_scene
abca566ad8bca3df.doc: Sets flag 408 and plays event 408: the party looks at the Moon of Destruction murals, then Shingala charges in with a device on his head and attacks, and they run.

abcac1bdd873983c.name: play_geostone_scene_and_go_to_s47
abcac1bdd873983c.doc: Story event 254a: marks floor 7 of stage 1 with flag 256, plays the Geostone scene and jumps to map s47 (Sindain).

abd3aba8d3faa162.name: play_throw_lafrescia_seed_scene
abd3aba8d3faa162.doc: Event 255 part 1. Max or Monica throws the Lafrescia Seed into the pond, it splashes, a Lafrescia sapling appears and grows over 30 frames. Sets flag 255 and sets the room to its stage 3 look before the scene and stage 0 after.

abd71e356206a426.name: talk_to_villager
abd71e356206a426.doc: Runs the shared villager talk handler unless the saved progress is 100.

abd7df27731358fa.name: ask_to_leave_for_palace_stop
abd7df27731358fa.doc: Talk handler for the exit: asks to leave the area and jumps to map s31, the Moon Flower Palace stop.

abed437c7db328d1.name: leave_train_through_door_side_1
abed437c7db328d1.doc: Program 200: if the door on side 1 is open, stores counter 15 = 1, fades out, removes the train car NPCs and jumps to the station map.

abf5a496fc5043f8.name: depart_by_train_to_dungeon
abf5a496fc5043f8.doc: Removes Borneo from the station, plays the train departure event and enters the dungeon.

ac0e130c84fb47ad.name: play_monica_victory_pose
ac0e130c84fb47ad.doc: Monica's victory pose for clearing a dungeon floor: loads her win motion and the finish banner, has the camera follow her, plays the pose, scales the banner in (drawn when show_banner is set) and restarts BGM 193.

ac17afac3cb83ad0.name: start_villager_conversation
ac17afac3cb83ad0.doc: Starts a conversation with the villager the player is facing.

ac1acbb384e2363b.name: test_palace_intro_scene
ac1acbb384e2363b.doc: Debug entry that plays the palace intro.

ac2b5a888cc2ce18.name: start_i01h01c_script_151
ac2b5a888cc2ce18.doc: Debug test program: loads event script i01h01/i01h01c_1.stb as program 151.

ac3209b9888bafae.name: talk_olivie_quest_offer
ac3209b9888bafae.doc: Olivie's quest offer: she says she is confident about fish, shows a help message about the fish race, and accepts quest 16.

ac5c3ea0f4205c7a.name: load_event_270_actors
ac5c3ea0f4205c7a.doc: Loads the actors for event 270: Max and Monica with their e270 motions and the message file, storing the party slots in event_270_max_slot and event_270_monica_slot.

ac634d25b22a5f7f.name: play_dead_end_search_scene
ac634d25b22a5f7f.doc: Sets flag 308 and plays event 308: Max and Monica find a dead end and feel something should be there. An object falls from above in front of them.

ac655c48bf48b203.name: play_flotsam_pump_room_scene
ac655c48bf48b203.doc: Sets flag 103 and plays event 103: Max talks to Donny from the pump room, Flotsam appears, offers information about Max's mother for the red stone, and Max refuses. Skippable.

ac7d890395b9a388.name: warp_to_s21_event_704
ac7d890395b9a388.doc: Clears the scene and starts event 704 on map s21.

ac94386cd425e2f3.name: play_red_gate_warp
ac94386cd425e2f3.doc: Plays the red time gate warp to the future at (x, y, z, yaw), telling the scene whether Monica is in the party, then resets the world coordinate.

ac977714b8068f4d.name: ask_to_return_to_dungeon
ac977714b8068f4d.doc: Talk handler for the exit: asks via the item question whether to leave and loads d07 if yes. Non-main characters get a short reply instead.

ac9b36d5a1de2352.name: play_potato_pie_memory_scene
ac9b36d5a1de2352.doc: A mother serves potato pies to her child who is delighted, followed by Max's remark that it reminded him of the potato pies his mother made.

acb23b1273331743.name: play_train_arrival_scene
acb23b1273331743.doc: Plays the steam train arriving with smoke and the carriages swinging round, then Max steps off. It hides and restores the station villagers.

acb41f8d4e995981.name: play_victory_pose
acb41f8d4e995981.doc: Plays the first character's victory pose.

acfaa48aad70608c.name: ask_enter_water_channel
acfaa48aad70608c.doc: Asks whether to move to the underground water channel. On yes Max runs forward and the screen fades out (returns 1); on no he steps back and the camera follows.

ad0bb2f9644cacc4.name: play_random_circle_coin_event
ad0bb2f9644cacc4.doc: Event for stepping on a random circle: a coin spins above the circle until the player presses a button, then lands on one of two sides. One side brightens the dungeon and gives a good result (weapon experience items, a treasure box), the other darkens it and applies a bad result, each with its own message. For the two other playable characters it only shows a message and moves the player next to the circle.

ad1419f722d44c63.name: play_train_arrival_scene
ad1419f722d44c63.doc: Train arrival cutscene for the other chapters: the steam locomotive with train smoke pulls in and stops. Flag 448 changes the details.

ad35f37a7e37414c.name: press_panel_1_3
ad35f37a7e37414c.doc: Candle puzzle step for the church candle at row 1, column 3: cuts to a fixed camera, waits 45 frames, toggles that candle and its four neighbours (i01h07_13 pieces), then waits 45 frames.

ad41f181a2cccc78.name: play_board_front_car
ad41f181a2cccc78.doc: Cutscene of Max boarding the front car of a train. The train id (event argument 1) selects the car parts, the direction follows whether the id is odd or even, Max walks into the car and the screen fades, then he is placed inside. Sets counter 0 to 0.

ad573a4da68d6242.name: start_broken_flower_scene
ad573a4da68d6242.doc: Story 704: plays the broken flower scene.

ad58f567e1c33c3d.name: replay_death_scene_then_warp_to_s49
ad58f567e1c33c3d.doc: Plays Gaspard's death scene and loads map s49 event 510.

ad6d2cce982ccd12.name: use_blue_time_gate
ad6d2cce982ccd12.doc: Uses a blue time gate at the given position. If Monica has joined, plays the blue gate scene with both characters. Otherwise plays the red gate scene for Max alone, preceded by the blue Atlamillia glow scene when its flags allow. Resets the world coordinates afterwards.

ad7662b0b8d3d149.name: use_flower_of_the_sun_on_vase
ad7662b0b8d3d149.doc: Examining the vase offers the item menu; using the Flower of the Sun flashes white, shows the opened palace part and plays event 708.

ad9080d454234634.name: place_player_and_fade_in
ad9080d454234634.doc: Places the player at (0, 2721, -500), resets the camera behind and fades in.

adb2c3d26304c25f.name: play_luna_lab_arrival_scene
adb2c3d26304c25f.doc: Sets flag 464. Max and Monica arrive in the Central Lab of the Lunatic Wisdom Laboratory and talk about how it could send them ten thousand years into the past.

adbfd7dedd85bd97.name: play_ixion_time_leap_departure_scene
adbfd7dedd85bd97.doc: Event 600. In the Ixion engine room Osmond runs the controls and the heroes sit in, grumble about the design, and are told to get ready for ten thousand years in the past. Sets flag 600.

adc50146b2a743b8.name: play_crest_reunion_event
adc50146b2a743b8.doc: Plays event 372 part 1, the reunion with Crest.

adf6791c60e209d9.name: play_holly_scene_then_go_to_s02
adf6791c60e209d9.doc: Plays the Holly may be his mother scene and jumps to map s02 entrance 502.

adfb51a4cca47716.name: play_balance_valley_station_arrival_scene
adfb51a4cca47716.doc: Sets flag 300 and plays event 300: the train pulls into Balance Valley Station, Max and Monica step off, and Borneo tells them to take their time while he and the crew take care of things at this end. Skippable.

ae03cafd411df832.name: talk_borneo_at_station
ae03cafd411df832.doc: Talk handler for Borneo at the station. When Borneo is the party NPC he comments on needing to keep moving, with extra remarks in chapter 4 (until the Ixion explanation is seen) and chapter 3; otherwise it opens the party member menu for the NPC spoken to with Borneo as the reference. Returns 0.

ae1aba9caa059521.name: get_abs_float
ae1aba9caa059521.doc: Returns the absolute value of value.

ae20c8fe1283d143.name: show_objects_and_start_s06c_1
ae20c8fe1283d143.doc: Shows the s06 map objects and starts event 600 in s06c_1.

ae25b85011018c55.name: show_spheda_stage_scores
ae25b85011018c55.doc: Event that loads Spheda stage floor d02f01 (map mstage1), gives items 305 and 306, sets up the Spheda course with hole 1, places Max and opens the Spheda score view menu.

ae2a34382d089f1f.name: play_circus_ticket_thief_scene
ae2a34382d089f1f.doc: Opening scene at the circus. Max asks about a red-haired boy, notices a boy sneaking away with a ticket, chases and catches him. The boy asks to see the circus just once, Max gives him the ticket, and the boy runs off. Max is then pulled into a strange place where a voice tells him he passed and the first door is waiting. Skippable.

ae3fec695fa62046.name: play_chase_then_opening_movie
ae3fec695fa62046.doc: Plays the opening part 5 chase, then the OPEN1 movie with Max's captions about that night starting his adventure, and jumps to d01e01 (Channel Entrance) at event 151.

ae45aba5c1dc30f8.name: take_gate_exit_3
ae45aba5c1dc30f8.doc: Gate 3 handler: interacts with the fourth exit.

ae625bc34ba26dea.name: show_event_hint_message
ae625bc34ba26dea.doc: Shows the map hint message unconditionally.

ae64cf0d15070049.name: talk_generic_villager
ae64cf0d15070049.doc: Talk handler for town villagers. Stops the camera control and the villager's AI, then picks the line by character number: the shop assistants greet and open their shop, the guard blocks the way, some villagers have different lines in chapter 1 depending on whether the train runs and in chapter 8 depending on whether Monica is back, and everyone else shows their default line from the villager message table. It then talks to the NPC and resumes its AI.

ae6dddef49d7975f.name: show_event_hint_message
ae6dddef49d7975f.doc: Shows a hint message (1050, or 1051 when an event is pending, plus 10 if alt_message) unless the chapter is 8 or later. With only_pending set it shows nothing unless an event is pending.

ae7526f2e78587d6.name: is_town_4_complete
ae7526f2e78587d6.doc: Returns 1 if town 4 is at 100 percent.

ae77dc637225bc6b.name: greet_and_open_shop
ae77dc637225bc6b.doc: Shopkeeper talk for the town shop villagers. Says a greeting that depends on the character number (the church priest, the shop owners, and the stand-in baker, Milane's sister and Bruno's friend, whose first meeting sets a met flag), talks to the NPC slot, then opens that shopkeeper's shop menu.

ae963887f5a40cdb.name: wait_frames_or_skip
ae963887f5a40cdb.doc: Waits the given number of frames. Returns 1 if button 32 is pressed first, otherwise 0.

ae9e72a7d1629a85.name: talk_corinne_joined
ae9e72a7d1629a85.doc: Corinne's line once she has joined. The text depends on whether the chapter is 8.

aedbe3913d501ea7.name: start_spheda_debug_hole
aedbe3913d501ea7.doc: Debug entry for Spheda mini golf on d03f01: sets evening light, gives a Map, and on yes places the character near the ball away from the pin and from treasure chests.

aeed330eba3a6c7c.name: reset_train_slope_parts
aeed330eba3a6c7c.doc: Turns the train slope off: shifts the six train07 map parts sideways by 56 units (three one way, three the other) and then hides the train steps.

aeedc0e0eb895e7a.name: play_battleship_sighting_scene
aeedc0e0eb895e7a.doc: Event 438 (sets flag 438). Max and Monica arrive running and see Gaspard's battleship heading for Shigura Village. Pau and Shingala appear; Max tells them to go home while he and Monica defend the village.

aef146e07019c89c.name: play_event_307
aef146e07019c89c.doc: Event 307 in the d03 dungeon: sets the Eina nurses Max seen flag, switches control to Max and shows a big bird carrying Giant Meat flying forward while Max falls to the ground. Two voiced lines of reflection follow, then a fade out, camera reset and unpause. Skippable.

aef231b2cb3feafb.name: play_letter_to_mother_ending_scene
aef231b2cb3feafb.doc: Ending cutscene (event 736). Max writes a farewell letter to his future mother, narrated line by line, signs it Maximilian and sighs, then the scene fades out.

aef957a15637ea82.name: play_cedric_walks_away_scene
aef957a15637ea82.doc: Event 109: Cedric (starbre model) walks away across the map while the camera pulls back and fades out. Skippable.

af0163c6b9e2ded7.name: talk_waiting_npc
af0163c6b9e2ded7.doc: Talk to a character who waits at a station: says a line that depends on whether the waiting NPC has been released (flag), then the normal NPC talk.

af2a425510478a0a.name: wait_actor_or_skip
af2a425510478a0a.doc: Waits until the actor script ends. Returns 1 if button 32 is pressed first, otherwise 0.

af2a647de725565b.name: setup_train_car
