af2a647de725565b.doc: Starts the event, loads the NPCs of the current train car, applies the NPC-name message preset, resets the camera behind the player and fades in over 30 frames.

af2c82cb8bd167e9.name: play_knock_on_door_scene
af2c82cb8bd167e9.doc: Event 209 (sets flag 209): Max and Monica knock at the house and, after voices from inside, are invited in; the Firbits' love of grape juice is mentioned.

af3e7cb1c368e149.name: play_jurak_remembers_griffon_scene
af3e7cb1c368e149.doc: Plays event 280. Jurak remembers that Griffon lived in ancient times and advises asking Crest, whose origin point was erased too. Max and Monica decide to revive it with the Carpenterion and leave for map s26.

af4aa51c5587a628.name: choose_palace_dungeon_floor
af4aa51c5587a628.doc: Asks to enter the dungeon, shows the dungeon tree map of stage 5 and starts the chosen floor.

af4d526006c2bca2.name: load_event_275_charas
af4d526006c2bca2.doc: Sets up Max and Monica as scene actors (the inactive one is loaded as a party member) and loads the event 275 message file.

af50d0e21a237f4a.name: give_photo_album_once
af50d0e21a237f4a.doc: If flag 38 is unset, sets it, gives the Photo Album (item 357) with a get message, hides the p03 part and its func point, and opens the item limit menu with a fade.

af5238383a1047e7.name: play_train_return_arrival
af5238383a1047e7.doc: Places the player at the train door they used, according to counters 0 and 15, with the arrival sound.

af5434e86df09b25.name: explain_hints_and_hand_over_camera
af5434e86df09b25.doc: Cedric lists the hints (Milk Can, Pipes, Belt) on screen, takes out a camera and explains how to use it to capture pictures.

af770575e8a82c84.name: ask_to_return_to_station
af770575e8a82c84.doc: Asks whether to return to the station. Fades out and returns 1 on yes, otherwise 0.

af77fd07829d0d80.name: play_bedtime_story_then_enter_d04
af77fd07829d0d80.doc: Plays the bedtime story scene, then loads dungeon d04f02 and starts its event 500.

af80193a7852cbba.name: play_max_run_along_path_scene
af80193a7852cbba.doc: Test scene: Max runs along a path with an orbiting camera attached to him; ends on a pad press.

af84a98b9b781da7.name: finish_e728_scene
af84a98b9b781da7.doc: Reactivates the player, deletes the e728 scene actors and image, shows the status bar and finishes the event.

af8a94e5ff11ec6f.name: talk_to_party_erik
af8a94e5ff11ec6f.doc: Talk handler for Erik. If he is the party NPC he talks about loving gunpowder and comments on the current chapter's task; otherwise it runs the generic party character talk.

af93d3b1e0d92986.name: play_front_golems_march_shot
af93d3b1e0d92986.doc: Variant of the golem march in which only the first 30 golems march toward the camera.

af99402d89ea7c94.name: talk_town_villager
af99402d89ea7c94.doc: Main talk dispatcher for the town villagers: the character number picks the specific talk (Gordon, Parn, Donny, Claire, Stewart, Adel, Aunt Polly, Blinkhorn, Milane, Gerald, Need, Bruno, Rufio, Fabio, Olivie, Mina, Corinne, Rosa, Morton). Donny opens the shop until Steve's debut flag is set. Polly, Milane, Bruno and Morton first offer a join-me choice when their recruit quest is open and open their shop in their own submap. Cedric, Borneo and a few others give a fixed remark that changes in chapter 8. Villager AI is restored at the end; returns 0.

afa44d92c0a4664a.name: go_to_moon_flower_palace_if_confirmed
afa44d92c0a4664a.doc: Asks the exit question and jumps to map s33 (Moon Flower Palace) if confirmed.

afa48bb612ef2cae.name: talk_mina_joined
afa48bb612ef2cae.doc: Mina's line once she has joined. The text depends on whether the chapter is 8.

afaa8fac6740af8e.name: ask_system_question
afaa8fac6740af8e.doc: Asks a system question in window 1: kind 0 asks the two-choice question 1000, kind 1 the three-choice question 1001. Returns the answer; other kinds return nothing.

afbb12a954105ee0.name: give_time_bomb_if_ready
afbb12a954105ee0.doc: If analysis flag 403 is set and flag 508 is not, adds the Time Bomb and plays the Garek scene. Returns 1 if the scene played.

afc4a38d2f2575da.name: play_geostone_scene_and_go_to_g01
afc4a38d2f2575da.doc: Event 502: plays the Geostone reactor scene and jumps to map g01 event 506.

afc4c19b9f0f64b7.name: depart_station_for_heim_rada
afc4c19b9f0f64b7.doc: Story 452 program: sets up the station map, plays the departure call and train departure, opens the world move menu and jumps to map s10 without reloading the BGM.

afc6a3e11d13541e.name: talk_villager_by_kind
afc6a3e11d13541e.doc: Villager talk by character number: numbers below 100 or above 1000 go to talk_generic_villager, numbers 100 to 1000 do nothing.

afdf3a14c76cedcf.name: play_ixion_scene_and_go_to_s09
afdf3a14c76cedcf.doc: Plays the Ixion explanation scene and jumps to map s09 entrance 500.

afdf65b0565c8c03.name: board_train_if_confirmed
afdf65b0565c8c03.doc: Asks whether to board. On yes sets counter 1 to 7 and either boards the front car and jumps to s37 (Ixion engine room) or plays the car scene and jumps to s38 (Ixion guest room), by the train id.

affa78409caa0485.name: play_paznos_launch_movies_and_go_to_observatory
affa78409caa0485.doc: Sets flag 540 and plays the crew scene, the Paznos launch caption, four battle movies (E54001 to E54004) with the golem scenes between, then jumps to map s29 (Paznos Observatory).

b000a9ff5bcdea91.name: play_valley_arrival_scene
b000a9ff5bcdea91.doc: Plays event e300 (sets flag 300): the train arrives, Max and Monica step off at Balance Valley Station, Cedric remarks the valley has been hit too, Borneo and Tom work in the distance, and the two run off.

b009170a8bbef38b.name: play_ridepod_steve_debut_scene
b009170a8bbef38b.doc: Cutscene (event 104, sets flag 104): Max, angry at losing, is challenged by Cedric's Ridepod Steve and an elephant monster, gets beaten, then Cedric tells him to climb aboard and they escape as Linda and her elephant are left behind.

b00999e5fc828409.name: play_shingala_death_game_over
b00999e5fc828409.doc: Plays when Shingala dies: shows the line that the future needed him to be set right, plays the game over screen and, after a button press, sets the exit flag.

b00fd909bf129406.name: play_dungeon_entry_scene
b00fd909bf129406.doc: Opening cutscene of dungeon d02: the dungeon logo fades in while the active character (Max or Monica) walks across a log, jumps off and stops at the start point. Skippable; the skip path places the character and camera directly.

b021259707603509.name: play_train_subgame_game_over_scene
b021259707603509.doc: Sets flag 205, pulls the train to a halt with a fade to black and asks whether to try again or return to the title screen. Returns the answer, 0 to retry.

b0326d2062e318cf.name: play_event_648_then_go_s11
b0326d2062e318cf.doc: Plays event 648 (Dr. Osmond waits for the pair), then jumps to map s11 event 520.

b04a0d1c68613f65.name: ask_woman_about_kid
b04a0d1c68613f65.doc: Talks to a woman, asking about the red-headed kid, and gets directions. Talking from behind gives a rude remark and returns 0.

b06614edaf369c9e.name: start_s19_event_151_with_loadout
b06614edaf369c9e.doc: Sets both characters to 80 max HP and 22 defence, tops item 270 up to 20, equips a fixed set of weapons and items, then starts event 151 on map s19.

b089c8aadf9fa47f.name: play_floor_cleared_wrapup
b089c8aadf9fa47f.doc: Runs after a dungeon floor is cleared: victory pose, floor flags, medal and challenge messages, messages for broken seals, and the offer to go to the Spheda ball. Sets floor info flags 2 and 1024.

b08a8f9618218f6f.name: talk_rosa_after_joining
b08a8f9618218f6f.doc: Rosa's chatter after her quest is cleared, doubting she is of any use. Chapter 8 swaps in a wish to see the Ends of the Earth.

b08c1e91303b462a.name: play_utan_moves_boulder_scene
b08c1e91303b462a.doc: Event 253. Max and Monica ask Master Utan to move a boulder blocking the way. He lifts it, throws it aside and hurts his back, telling them to go on without him. Sets flag 253.

b08f2bac2e9c3972.name: play_gate_open_scene
b08f2bac2e9c3972.doc: Plays the sound and rotates the d04w10 wall pieces half a turn, then raises the door piece 80 units. Used when a gate is opened.

b0a116e693a2824e.name: play_run_in_from_dungeon
b0a116e693a2824e.doc: Short scene: the player runs in from the dungeon side to the station while the camera eases to follow, then stands.

b0a418e82b59f00d.name: enter_lab_2_if_unlocked
b0a418e82b59f00d.doc: Enters Lab 2 (f03i0302) unless the story flags say the door is still locked, in which case it shows the locked message.

b0b0ebaaf522d2c0.name: show_medal_messages
b0b0ebaaf522d2c0.doc: Shows the medal award messages after a room challenge. Which messages play depends on whether the destroy challenge was cleared and the practice status, ending with the 2 medals message when both were earned.

b0b2b518c127f9b2.name: play_run_through_crowd_event
b0b2b518c127f9b2.doc: Plays the crowd run scene with the opening characters loaded, then returns to the m06 event script.

b0b4e31197b98f8f.name: show_absorb_sword_help
b0b4e31197b98f8f.doc: Tutorial for the absorb magic sword: pauses the dungeon and shows an unlock notice followed by four help pages (absorbing elemental attacks while guarding, chaining the same element, absorb capacity by weapon durability, releasing with guard plus the L1 button).

b0b8ab809bdfe8af.name: play_event_255_explode
b0b8ab809bdfe8af.doc: Event 255 in the Rafflesia's room: sets the seen flag, makes the player Max or Monica if another character was active, and shows Max throwing a seed into the water and the plant exploding with a growing map part. Skippable; fades out and restores the camera at the end.

b0bd815a4bac07a6.name: show_e356_title_card
b0bd815a4bac07a6.doc: Fades in a title card for E356, defeating Gilttoni and farewell to Crest, then fades out.

b0c2a94e5dd95fc7.name: play_train_arrival
b0c2a94e5dd95fc7.doc: Train arrival scene at the s02 station: the train slides in with smoke, the slope parts tilt, doors open and the player runs out and is placed on the platform. Hides the shadow at night, hides and restores the station villagers, and tracks the slope in a flag.

b0caec8bc8ea885b.name: show_need_sitting_at_desk
b0caec8bc8ea885b.doc: Opening shot of Need sitting at his desk, with a camera pull-back after a fade in.

b0cc3a2fbfc70dfe.name: play_palace_thrown_aside_then_jump_to_s11
b0cc3a2fbfc70dfe.doc: Plays the scene where Paznos throws the palace aside and jumps to map s11 at entry 510. Returns 0.

b0cdd2279f393139.name: play_gaspard_backstory_scene
b0cdd2279f393139.doc: Sets flag 532. After the first fight Gaspard, wounded, tells the story of his childhood as a changeling's son with a human mother, shown with picture panels, and says he and Max are the same.

b0f3aefaea5be26d.name: arrive_from_seaside_cave
b0f3aefaea5be26d.doc: The player runs out of the seaside cave entrance and the camera follows for 40 frames.

b0f9c0e7310d642f.name: talk_ferdinand_early
b0f9c0e7310d642f.doc: Ferdinand's talk before the first quest is cleared: he compares his cooking research to Max's machine discoveries.

b10a4d2de88d79a3.name: setup_sea_dragon_room
b10a4d2de88d79a3.doc: If the Water Gem has not been taken (flag 632 clear), plays the boss intro, disables the Rapis point, places monster 612 and blocks map movement. Then places the player at the entrance and fades in.

b1131748e327d9a8.name: talk_villager_or_claire_dialogue
b1131748e327d9a8.doc: When the save progress value is 100 the Claire dialogue is used; otherwise the shared villager talk handler runs.

b121217369f1ce31.name: show_important_book_hint
b121217369f1ce31.doc: Event program that makes Max remark that there may be an important book here but he cannot tell right now.

b12626b6332260bb.name: play_gaspard_mother_farewell_scene
b12626b6332260bb.doc: Event 532. Gaspard's dying mother tells him not to hate anyone and to keep searching for something he wants to protect. She dies as he calls out to her. Sets flag 532 and sets the time to noon during the scene.

b1303a1a6069a6aa.name: go_to_station
b1303a1a6069a6aa.doc: Jumps to the station map i02h01. At progress 100 it shows the demo message instead.

b1467f2ad1c241ae.name: play_train_arrival_scene
b1467f2ad1c241ae.doc: Program 499: plays the train arrival scene.

b15721c1985770cc.name: start_workshop_map
b15721c1985770cc.doc: Map start of the Gundorada Workshop: fades in, resets the elevator counter when arriving from map 3, sets up the map objects and elevator platforms, plays events 548, 552 and 556 when their analysis flags are set and unseen, then places the player according to the map they came from (3, 105 by entrance counter 18, or 107 on the top floor) and resets the camera behind.

b15f57f78cbb4751.name: play_griffon_takes_atlamillia_scene
b15f57f78cbb4751.doc: Sets flag 612. After the fight the defeated Griffon collapses, then snatches the Atlamillia stones from Max and Monica and transforms in a burst of light. He explains the legend of the stones and the Star of Oblivion, says he will erase the world, and the scene ends as Monica shouts at him.

b169a9fa1194c089.name: show_flower_bed_restored_message
b169a9fa1194c089.doc: Shows a Georama progress message, flower bed restored, between fades.

b16eaad1f43fe8ee.name: play_eina_farewell_and_jump_to_s30
b16eaad1f43fe8ee.doc: Plays the Eina farewell scene and then jumps to map s30 at entry 605.

b16f7dc93c122707.name: animate_lip_sync_until_confirmed
b16f7dc93c122707.doc: Runs the talking animation and lip sync, following the voice stream, until the player dismisses the message. Returns the frames elapsed.

b1709e2821ad700b.name: replay_photo_hints
b1709e2821ad700b.doc: Event 510: fades out and plays the photo hint reminder, putting Max and Cedric back in place afterwards.

b17330c8e6a74389.name: talk_gerald_early
b17330c8e6a74389.doc: Gerald's talk before the first quest is cleared: he tells Max it is time to learn about mining.

b1737e1f4ef9eb0c.name: play_priscleen_fish_delivered_scene
b1737e1f4ef9eb0c.doc: Event 245. The party brings the Priscleen Fish; Mardan laughs, undoes his spell on the three Firbits and leaves. Sets flag 245.

b17a931279a8ea78.name: clear_monsters_and_play_e420_scene
b17a931279a8ea78.doc: Pauses monster AI, fades out and in, removes all monsters and plays event 420.

b181d9bfaf71ea97.name: play_wrench_becomes_battle_wrench_scene
b181d9bfaf71ea97.doc: Max raises his wrench and it becomes the Battle Wrench, four enemies drop in, and Max grumbles that it will have to do before running for the exit and leaping over the audience.

b1ae749f11601b37.name: talk_to_monica_spheda_trial
b1ae749f11601b37.doc: Talk handler at the Spheda trial. Before flag 314 it plays the lesson if Max has the club (item 9) and shows the instructions, otherwise tells him to find one. Afterwards, if he gives up, it awards items 10 and 363, plays event 317 and advances the floor.

b1c4be7697e7ea29.name: play_moonflower_palace_welcome_scene
b1c4be7697e7ea29.doc: Sets flag 700. Max and Monica walk angrily to the Moonflower Palace gate, where a glowing figure appears and welcomes them. The ruler Alexandra speaks of Sirus and his role, and a flash of light follows.

b20af2ac1a461c0c.name: use_star_key_door
b20af2ac1a461c0c.doc: Handles the star key door of the floor.

b21d32b72d7f4685.name: spawn_room_reward_chests
b21d32b72d7f4685.doc: After the fight, spawns treasure chests with items 207 and 198 for the bits of counter 17 not yet set, plays the calm music and marks the floor info flag 2.

b2249456a36109bc.name: play_ambush_scene_on_map_start
b2249456a36109bc.doc: Plays the Rainbow Butterfly ambush scene when the map starts.

b22a4ca50c706903.name: play_tournament_announcement_scene
b22a4ca50c706903.doc: Event 344: at noon in the square Mayor Need tells Morton he has decided to hold a fishing tournament, fireworks go off and a help window explains the tournament cycle.

b237026c86d11cbf.name: record_opened_chest
b237026c86d11cbf.doc: Sets counter 17 bit 4 when the Absorption Coin is taken and bit 8 for the Moon Stone.

b2420f0e31df03a9.name: start_station_map_event
b2420f0e31df03a9.doc: Map entry. After loading a save places the player at the start. Otherwise picks the start scene by the previous map, counter 1, flags 360 and 400 and the chapter: running in, the ocean breeze scene, or a train arrival scene.

b249c1d3f64d0b7e.name: play_cannon_barrage_and_jump_to_f30
b249c1d3f64d0b7e.doc: Plays the cannon barrage on the golems and jumps to map f30 at entry 604.

b278e944d0b60e5c.name: show_party_chara_late_line
b278e944d0b60e5c.doc: Shows the late-game remark of NPC chara 1 to 25 in window, each a short line about the railroad, the Zelmite mine, their trade or their hopes. Does nothing for other values.

b28142251734e4f0.name: is_analysis_505_scene_pending
b28142251734e4f0.doc: Returns 1 if analysis flag 505 is set and flag 744 is not.

b297b07d582af175.name: play_event_504
b297b07d582af175.doc: Event 504 at Heim Rada: Max and Monica are on the dock when a battleship appears; they say Gaspard must be trying to stop them restoring the origin points and hurry off. Sets the seen flag and uses the active character for the speaker mix. Skippable.

b29f19d50588fe09.name: choose_scene_on_entry
b29f19d50588fe09.doc: Picks what to play on entry: event 408 then Pau's House if not seen, the fight intro (with map exit blocked) if the Electric Fish is held, otherwise event 410 and the d04 script, or the normal floor entrance.

b2a4ad81dc55f183.name: setup_and_play_defeated_scene
b2a4ad81dc55f183.doc: Runs the room sound setup and plays the defeated scene.

b2ac1143cf9ee88e.name: play_event_648
b2ac1143cf9ee88e.doc: Cutscene on the hidden-base bridge: Max and Monica sit at the monitors while Eina, on screen, tells them Griffon's palace is back on the ground and this is the last chance to stop him. They nod and head out. Sets the waiting-NPC-released flag.

b2c45caf18fae143.name: restart_train_subgame_after_game_over
b2c45caf18fae143.doc: Plays the game over scene and restarts the train subgame according to the answer.

b2e81a445e6c437d.name: play_battleship_fight_aftermath_scene
b2e81a445e6c437d.doc: Story event 520. After the fight with Gaspard's battleship the ship goes down and Monica falls, Max shouting her name. Sets the edit-blocked save flag.

b2f8a1ec042f965d.name: take_geostone
b2f8a1ec042f965d.doc: Picks up a geostone in the dungeon. Ridepod characters (slots 2 and 3) only get a message. Max and Monica play a pickup pose with the stone and the item get message.

b2fdbdb32da86bb9.name: play_castle_chase_scene
b2fdbdb32da86bb9.doc: Plays the first part of event 50. Monica runs through the castle with soldiers, learns that monsters are in her father's room and fights through to the door.

b302cebe96a44483.name: play_ending_epilogue_scene
b302cebe96a44483.doc: Epilogue cutscene (flag 732, music 53): Max and Monica look up at the single moon, talk about Sirus and say Emperor Griffon never really existed, and wonder how long people will remember the two moons. Fades out, then restores the party.

b3112fb7847cc03a.name: play_monster_intro_e220e
b3112fb7847cc03a.doc: Monster introduction cutscene: Max and Monica stand while monster e220e drops in and attacks, with the caption e728telop02 fading in. Skippable; restores the player afterwards.

b324a49599c82f26.name: report_scoop_progress
b324a49599c82f26.doc: Scoop reporter's progress talk (German text): with no Inside Scoop Memo in the bag he asks for one; when all scoops are found he says none are left; otherwise he reports how many scoops were figured out and how many new ones were obtained. Ends with check_photo_rewards and returns its result, or 0 when no memo is held. Uses a talk camera on map 22.

b324c53d70c7144f.name: start_dark_genie_fight
b324c53d70c7144f.doc: Program 151: runs the Dark Genie fight setup.

b32981c6dff9f957.name: talk_to_donny_or_villager
b32981c6dff9f957.doc: While flag 4 is set, talking starts the Donny conversation, and when Max leaves it grants the Classic Gun and Help Receiver, shows the chapter title and starts dungeon 0. Otherwise it handles villager talk.

b332248585ae0c36.name: ask_to_enter_water_channel
b332248585ae0c36.doc: Asks whether to go to the underground water channel and loads the d01 script if yes. If characters 2 or 3 are active, shows a speech bubble instead.

b363a374da2c67db.name: play_coin_flip_circle_event
b363a374da2c67db.doc: Coin flip on a random circle: a coin spins and the player presses (O) to stop it. Angel faces give a bonus such as ABS, full recovery, full WHP or a treasure box, devil faces a penalty such as poison or halved HP and WHP. Ridepod and monster forms are pushed back with a message.

b3774133bf53d07b.name: play_shot_nod_reply
b3774133bf53d07b.doc: Shot in event 105: the instructor tells Max to take photographs of a milk can, pipes and a belt nearby and wishes him luck, then Max nods. sound_id is unused.

b37971979ddd0c3f.name: ask_to_leave_by_hill_path
b37971979ddd0c3f.doc: Asks the leave-the-area question (item question 1). On yes the player runs up the hill path and the screen fades; returns 1. On no he steps back and returns 0.

b384c7767831f9d3.name: start_griffon_second_phase
b384c7767831f9d3.doc: Plays the second phase scene, puts the player at the room center and places the second phase boss (monster 616).

b398523335bb81f7.name: use_star_key_on_door
b398523335bb81f7.doc: Star door interaction. Needs flag 616, then asks to use the Star Key (item 362) and plays a growing star effect while the door's map piece is hidden.

b3a749aa93c6c28c.name: play_game_over_by_fight_state
b3a749aa93c6c28c.doc: During the Shingala fight it picks one of two voiced game overs; otherwise a silent one.

b3ab41cb3ff6b208.name: shake_camera_ref
b3ab41cb3ff6b208.doc: Shakes the camera target up and down around the reference point, with amplitude shrinking by decay each step until it reaches zero.

b3ad638176441d23.name: play_preloaded_voice_message_for
b3ad638176441d23.doc: Plays a message whose stream is already loaded for up to the given frames.

b3e24296e0604595.name: load_firbit_actors
b3e24296e0604595.doc: Loads the six Firbit models (Noam, Rococo, Zak, Wicky, Tobo, Mogri) as inactive actors.

b3e9ce9c1669e67b.name: play_crest_sage_dream_scene
b3e9ce9c1669e67b.doc: Event 336 (flag 336): Lin screams and Lin and Crest talk. Crest explains why he wants to be a sage, with the story of the robed man who defended his village from thieves. Used before the Memo Eater fight.

b3f3a25505180eb0.name: delete_spheda_charas
b3f3a25505180eb0.doc: Deletes the 16 Spheda characters in slots 8 to 23, removes image 0 and resets the Spheda game.

b40635ad015c3bd9.name: play_holy_daedalus_blade_scene
b40635ad015c3bd9.doc: Event 560. Galen thanks the party for restoring Gundorada and hands Monica the sword her father Raybrandt left, the Holy Daedalus Blade.

b4071f9379509bdf.name: leave_for_moon_flower_palace
b4071f9379509bdf.doc: Program 520: fades out, re-enables map movement, sets flag 616 and jumps to map s70 as program 520.

b40e313a7a18bfdc.name: talk_to_woman_about_lively_circus
b40e313a7a18bfdc.doc: A woman says the circus makes the town lively.

b4233cb204a9ae71.name: start_floor
b4233cb204a9ae71.doc: Starts a floor of dungeon d07. Floor 0 returns to Palm Brinks (or to the Palm Brinks Park), floors 5, 10, 16, 21, 26 and 27 load maps s52, s61, s62, s63, s69 and s54, floor 38 loads boss map d07b01, and the other floors load the d07 layout with the arrival scene.

b42b9d03219c5bac.name: heal_or_look_at_shingala
b42b9d03219c5bac.doc: Interaction with Shingala. If the player holds the Secret Dragon Remedy it asks to use it and, on use, plays the healing scene and jumps to s40; otherwise the player's character walks up to him and he cries out.

b42f8c7600ce2302.name: play_lighthouse_attack_scene
b42f8c7600ce2302.doc: Event 352. Crest and Lin stand on the lighthouse talking about the Moon Crystal. Gaspard's battleship appears, Gaspard orders Jaming to destroy the lighthouse, its cannon fires and Crest and Lin are thrown down. Ends through end_lighthouse_scene_load_dungeon.

b45070f3e1d0df03.name: enter_i01h01_or_show_notice
b45070f3e1d0df03.doc: Program 200, the door to i01h01: at story progress 100 shows the notice message and resets the edit event; otherwise turns the player to yaw 0 and enters interior i01h01.

b46bcc3954597012.name: play_fire_order_to_s55
b46bcc3954597012.doc: Plays the fire order scene and jumps to map s55 at event 603.

b46be5b641be5c0c.name: talk_to_swamp_villager
b46be5b641be5c0c.doc: Talk handler for the swamp's villagers by slot: Master Utan (8) warns not to fish up the swamp master, and the three villagers Zak, Wicky and Mogri (10 to 12) say they are happy and will not go back.

b474dc20d41be1eb.name: enter_house_i01h01
b474dc20d41be1eb.doc: Goes inside house i01h01. At progress 100 (the demo build) it shows the demo message instead.

b487eaee0d3d4d50.name: play_victory_pose_at_map_start
b487eaee0d3d4d50.doc: Plays the second character's victory pose when the map starts.

b49f0ddcf4b4a24a.name: run_choice_menu
b49f0ddcf4b4a24a.doc: Lets the player move a cursor through option_count choices with the stick or d-pad and confirm. Returns the chosen index.

b4e453f7eae6a199.name: play_opening_pierrot_fight
b4e453f7eae6a199.doc: Opening scene part 4 at the circus tent: Max hangs from a swing by a chain while three Pierrot clowns chase him, he leaps toward the light, falls through smoke and lands. Ends by putting him in battle stand and starting event script s43/s43.stb entry 152. Skippable.

b4e76ae3b4d3f38c.name: play_osmond_story_then_go_to_s32
b4e76ae3b4d3f38c.doc: Story jump to 616: plays the Osmond scene and jumps to map s32 (Moon Flower Palace vs Paznos) at entry 500.

b4f23a08fcb1ca15.name: get_analyze_301
b4f23a08fcb1ca15.doc: Returns analysis flag 301, which gates event 456 (can_play_event_456).

b4f9f17f49d7bf84.name: talk_to_ferdinand
b4f9f17f49d7bf84.doc: Talk handler for Ferdinand. Picks the line by the active character, quest 0 state and quest 3 (chestnuts).

b4ffe306f1e81266.name: open_message_auto
b4ffe306f1e81266.doc: Waits two frames, clears the window slot, shows the message and places the speech bubble pointing from speaker to listener.

b5093ed728920c60.name: setup_spheda_game
b5093ed728920c60.doc: Loads the Spheda bar image, creates the Spheda game for the course, and loads and places the ball and the goal pin models in the colours the game reports.

b519119ef24ed25a.name: start_dream_spiral_fight_2
b519119ef24ed25a.doc: Applies the debug loadout and starts the second dream spiral boss event on map d06b02.

b5222e0199c791af.name: walk_back_and_hint_next_step
b5222e0199c791af.doc: Walks the character back, then shows a hint: before flag 304 that someone may be in the house just visited, afterwards that Lin must be saved quickly. Returns 0.

b52bc87dce4ca2f7.name: ask_to_drop_ball_here
b52bc87dce4ca2f7.doc: Asks yes or no (message 2004). On yes the Spheda ball is placed at the player's feet and a stroke is used unless the debug flag is on.

b52da2301aab6a00.name: setup_boss_fight_after_event_336
b52da2301aab6a00.doc: Program 510: plays event 336, then fades in at the arena with music 190 and monster 68 placed. Disables map movement and the e336 trigger.

b538a3cdbf06bc29.name: finish_wrench_fight_and_go_to_palm_brinks
b538a3cdbf06bc29.doc: After the four monsters are beaten: plays the Battle Wrench scene, gives and equips the Battle Wrench in place of the Wrench, restores map moves and enters edit mode 17 (Palm Brinks).

b53c581b30312dcc.name: on_map_start
b53c581b30312dcc.doc: Map entry. After loading a save it places the player at the start, otherwise it runs in from whichever exit the previous map came from, then shows the Georama hint.

b5507374306b1c8f.name: play_m06b_event_155
b5507374306b1c8f.doc: Fades out and loads the m06b event script at 155.

b55ccd0e0150cde6.name: play_halloween_defeat_scene
b55ccd0e0150cde6.doc: Plays the boss defeat scene (event e111, sets flag 111). Halloween collapses and explodes, Polcurse laments, and Max watches two pierrots carry Polcurse away before the way out opens. In the trial version it plays a short version and sets the exit flag.

b5687f14638e3557.name: read_book_hint
b5687f14638e3557.doc: Shows Max's idea search hint (a weapon, a Moon Column and deer antlers) or Monica's monster research note, depending on who is active.

b576b92e913623fb.name: run_game_over
b576b92e913623fb.doc: Game over sequence: stops the music, plays the character's defeat pose, and shows a game over screen with the optional voice line. If another character can take over it opens the character change menu and returns. Otherwise returns 1 after reviving at full health (when revive is 1) or 0 after setting the exit flag.

b58a338e357f6555.name: play_knock_scene_and_enter_house
b58a338e357f6555.doc: Plays the knocking-at-the-house scene (event 209), then fades out and jumps to interior map g01i07.

b597520e592c2345.name: play_cedric_steps_off_train
b597520e592c2345.doc: Cedric walks along the train, turns and jumps down onto the platform.

b5a916f12bf5e938.name: show_slot_bubble_message_limited
b5a916f12bf5e938.doc: Shows a bubble message in a window slot and waits up to max_frames for the player to close it.

b5bcbf0f6dfba607.name: talk_blinkhorn_early
b5bcbf0f6dfba607.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk before the first quest is cleared: he complains that the town is too peaceful to give him any work.

b5c34e5aac8edac2.name: play_boss_midfight_scenes
b5c34e5aac8edac2.doc: Sets flag 438 and plays the two boss mid-fight scenes.

b5d3f5c6a234f584.name: setup_station_parts
b5d3f5c6a234f584.doc: Only calls setup_station_map, which sets the station or train parts by chapter.

b5dbdb63500e1205.name: play_zelmite_ore_boss_appears_scene
b5dbdb63500e1205.doc: Sets flag 816. Max and Monica find Zelmite Ore, which can fuel the Blackstone rail trains, when a demon dropped by Flotsam's rival falls in and says he will eat them. Ends with BGM 40 and the boss fight starting.

b5dce950e9433533.name: ask_to_retry_spheda_after_miss
b5dce950e9433533.doc: Monica says the attempt failed and asks to try again. Returns 1 to retry, or 0 after she asks to take over.

b5dd2c3da4b04a53.name: talk_aunt_polly_monica
b5dd2c3da4b04a53.doc: Aunt Polly talks to Monica: in chapters before 8 she remarks that Monica now travels with Max and approves, otherwise she invites the player to come for bread.

b6055e30cbaa12da.name: show_hint_if_event_ready
b6055e30cbaa12da.doc: Shows the map hint message only when a story event is ready (a0 set) or always (a0 clear).

b60bb2358718a654.name: play_meet_pau_and_shingala_scene
b60bb2358718a654.doc: Sets flag 404 and plays event 404: in a cave Max and Monica meet Pau, who is tending a hurt young Shigura he calls Shingala. Pau leaves to find medicine and Shingala heads outside. Skippable.

b61226cf6ddef089.name: start_temple_map_and_story_events
b61226cf6ddef089.doc: Map entry. Sets up the doors and NPCs by analysis flags, then plays whichever of events 372, 364, 368 and 376 is due. If none played and the player did not come from an interior map, places the player at the start and fades in.

b62ad68554118bf5.name: play_narration_then_enter_dungeon_3
b62ad68554118bf5.doc: Plays event 102, skips the loading screen, fades to white and enters dungeon 3 at event 500.

b630a4486a409a78.name: talk_rufio_joined
b630a4486a409a78.doc: Rufio's talk after joining: chapters before 8 thank Max for the moon photo, chapter 8 a line about the railway reaching the world. Then the normal NPC talk.

b63e910284b816de.name: setup_s56_events
b63e910284b816de.doc: Map setup: plays BGM 17 if not already playing, and disables the e348 and event markers once flags 348 and 352 are set.

b63fe2ef9c651ee6.name: check_door_side_open
b63fe2ef9c651ee6.doc: Decides whether the train door on the given side opens at the current station (counter 1). Returns 0 while the world is explained but the train fight has not been seen; stations 2, 3, 7 and 9 open the right side, the others the left.

b64e0c5156859b42.name: wait_frame_count
b64e0c5156859b42.doc: Waits frames frames (no PAL scaling, unlike wait_frames). The second parameter is unused.

b66bee473d1b3d03.name: play_time_gate_scene_then_return_to_g01
b66bee473d1b3d03.doc: Fades out, plays the Time Gate explanation scene and then continues with the g01 event script.

b67c72e1545ef544.name: turn_and_fade_out
b67c72e1545ef544.doc: Turns the player to the given yaw, plays a door sound (92 if alt_se is set, else 94) and fades out.

b68b0065c344ccac.name: play_monica_explains_spheda_shot
b68b0065c344ccac.doc: Monica explains Spheda to Max: how to hit the Sphere, how colours change when it bumps into walls, the shot limit and why the game exists, with screen sprites showing each rule.

b69ebd0242cecdaf.name: play_lapis_beam_then_jump_to_s30_610
b69ebd0242cecdaf.doc: Plays the Lapis beam scene and jumps to map s30 at entry 610. Returns 0.

b6b2f03e0de79cec.name: setup_opening_town_flags
b6b2f03e0de79cec.doc: Sets flag 40, creates Donny's opening setup when flag 4 is set, and hides the memo if the player has it.

b6c7fc51e1c79048.name: place_player_at_south_entry
b6c7fc51e1c79048.doc: Places the player at (0, -1100) facing north, sets the camera and fades in.

b6cff107dfdb579e.name: play_event_320_hiding_lao_chao
b6cff107dfdb579e.doc: Hides Lao Chao, plays event 320 (Max and Monica with Lao Chao) and shows him again.

b6d43a7d6197ebac.name: use_horn_on_lava
b6d43a7d6197ebac.doc: Check handler for the lava. After an optional question (message 2507) opens the item menu; using item 354 (the horn) disables the lava point and plays the lava parting scene, any other item makes the player refuse.

b6dacb6a80a47530.name: load_event_207_images
b6dacb6a80a47530.doc: Loads the event 207 image and sets up its four screen sprites (e20701 to e20704) with their sprite actors, all hidden.

b6eecdda27bf6777.name: play_blue_time_gate
b6eecdda27bf6777.doc: Plays the blue time gate warp at (x, y, z, yaw). With Monica in the party it plays the blue gate scene for both; without her it may first play the blue glow scene (when the edit-blocked flag is set, the Gaspard backstory flag is not, and the glow flag is unset) and then the red gate scene. Resets the world coordinate.

b6f1c20942964c37.name: use_door_side_0
b6f1c20942964c37.doc: Faces the door and, if it is open, fades out and jumps to the station map with counter 15 set to 0. Otherwise plays a refusal.

b7070cfba24fb8d7.name: join_dr_dell_play_event_306
b7070cfba24fb8d7.doc: Debug entry: sets flag 304, clears 306, 324 and 330, makes Dr. Dell join the party, plays event 306 and jumps to map g02 at entry 503.

b7126ff86f46595d.name: play_train_arrival_late
b7126ff86f46595d.doc: Cutscene of a train arriving at a station late in the game: the train eases in, doors open and the player runs out. Hides station villagers during the scene and returns them. Dark hours switch off the player's shadow.

b722a9de45f37cdd.name: show_lift_robomb_hint
b722a9de45f37cdd.doc: Event program in the Halloween boss room that pauses monsters and the player and shows a hint box on lifting the RoBomb by holding the R1 button and pressing the circle button.

b72f3413f7e21b85.name: leave_to_luna_lab_wing_3
b72f3413f7e21b85.doc: Exits to map f03, setting counter 2 to 3.

b73298debd4dce46.name: place_chara_before_npc
b73298debd4dce46.doc: Starts an event, puts the character 30 units in front of the NPC, turns them to face it and sets the talk camera on the pair. a2 is not used.

b73e94f8ef4f1813.name: ask_to_enter_dungeon
b73e94f8ef4f1813.doc: Asks whether to proceed (item question 2). Returns 1 on yes after a fade out, 0 otherwise; monster forms only get a message.

b751a1f9ec10dc2d.name: delete_toryon_models
b751a1f9ec10dc2d.doc: Deletes the Toryon, tree, leaf and focus line models.

b75c94c6a140c5f8.name: wait_scaled_frames
b75c94c6a140c5f8.doc: Waits frames frames scaled by 50/60 (PAL rate). The second parameter is unused.

b76a462665385a9f.name: leave_fish_race_for_finny_frenzy
b76a462665385a9f.doc: After a fish race ends, fades out the music and jumps back to map i03h04 (Finny Frenzy Races) as program 502.

b76b6ad25df43a96.name: play_taxi_ride_scene
b76b6ad25df43a96.doc: Taxi ride cutscene: a taxi model drives along a camera path with 19 trailing smoke actors, then the scene waits for a button press and cleans up.

b7729fa82aecc521.name: enter_boss_arena_d06b02
b7729fa82aecc521.doc: Hides the status bar and characters 1 and 2, plays the Dark Ruler moon-fall scene and loads the d06b02 boss arena without reloading the BGM.

b77973564149f471.name: play_camera_pan_over_plateau_scene
b77973564149f471.doc: Test scene: hides the player and pans the camera over the plateau; ends on a pad press.

b77a3073356c2154.name: talk_to_race_host
b77a3073356c2154.doc: The Finny Frenzy host. Monica is turned away. In extra mode the race menu opens directly. Otherwise the host ends the tournament after three races, or offers to join, explain the rules and show the prizes per class. Joining picks a fish from the aquarium that has not won a prize, then a class (Beginner to Master) and moves on to choose a tank.

b782c8d972960759.name: play_ridepod_departure_then_enter_dungeon
b782c8d972960759.doc: Same as play_ridepod_departure_and_join, but on departure goes straight to dungeon 0, floor 4 with event 520.

b784c432c17929bb.name: load_room_music
b784c432c17929bb.doc: Loads the room music: the battle theme if either chest is still unclaimed, otherwise the calm theme.

b78d6a4913d97927.name: jump_through_door
b78d6a4913d97927.doc: Event 200 program; it only runs the shared door map jump and returns 0.

b793de23b2bc908a.name: shake_ixion_and_go_to_s58
b793de23b2bc908a.doc: Plays the time travel shake scene, then jumps to map s58 event 500.

b7a2ca12b6a5d984.name: start_spheda_debug_on_floor
b7a2ca12b6a5d984.doc: Debug entry: loads the d04f02 map, plays the arrival scene and starts Spheda.

b7a7642d8d679e55.name: play_gaspard_farewell_scene
b7a7642d8d679e55.doc: Sets flag 536 and plays Gaspard's death: he speaks of meeting his mother again and fades out in light. Skippable.

b7aa83dace2bf1e7.name: enter_lab_two
b7aa83dace2bf1e7.doc: Enters Lab 2 (f03i0302). Before flag 420 is set it says the door will not open.

b7bd6d51f03a44ef.name: play_scene_then_go_to_s30_650
b7bd6d51f03a44ef.doc: Plays play_paznos_robot_scene and jumps to map s30 at event 650.

b7c3d8375fd2ff02.name: play_voice_message_timed
b7c3d8375fd2ff02.doc: Plays voice number voice with its message text, waiting at most the given number of frames, then closes the window and stream.

b7d28f33d2d5ca54.name: play_dive_scene_and_go_to_s32
b7d28f33d2d5ca54.doc: Plays the Paznos dive scene and jumps to map s32 at event 640.

b7d2cbbbf3104ae8.name: add_party_member_and_start_script_520
b7d2cbbbf3104ae8.doc: Story 108c: adds party member 2, sets flags 25, 103, 107 and 6, clears flags 108 and 7 and loads script i01h01/i01h01c_1.stb as program 520.

b7f39fd955226957.name: play_camera_scene_and_give_items
b7f39fd955226957.doc: Hides Cedric, sets flags 18 and 21, plays the camera scene, positions the cast, sets progress 3 and gives the Camera and Inside Scoop Memo.

b802fa8aff50420c.name: play_halloween_walk_scene
b802fa8aff50420c.doc: Debug scene: the Halloween character turns and walks away while two lines of dialogue show over a camera path.

b8046b2ea2cd5254.name: show_party_cancel_letter
b8046b2ea2cd5254.doc: While the bread quest (8) is in progress, shows the note on the door that cancels the party and resets the edit event. Moves counter 12 from 1 to 2.

b80fe273422c7ed7.name: ask_to_go_to_balance_valley_station
b80fe273422c7ed7.doc: Asks whether to move to the Balance Valley station. Returns 1 if the player agrees and runs off, otherwise the character walks back and it returns 0.

b80fe3bb920d42dc.name: setup_map_sounds_and_parts
b80fe3bb920d42dc.doc: Stops the music, loads sound set 8693 and, once flag 820 is set, hides map part p04 and disables its function point.

b81b92d98d7e6ec5.name: finish_boss_and_return_to_dungeon
b81b92d98d7e6ec5.doc: After the boss falls: clears all monsters, sets the floor info flag to 2, plays the Holly scene, gives item 385, opens the item limit menu and loads dungeon map d02b01 event 201.

b81db25ea22a9869.name: show_spheda_bonus_score_menu
b81db25ea22a9869.doc: Loads the d06 floor with the Map and Magic Crystal items, sets up Spheda hole 6 with the player placed in the field, then opens the Spheda score view and returns the camera.

b82c4433557bb02f.name: show_second_phase_flashback
b82c4433557bb02f.doc: Fades out, pauses and shows a debug label for the first battle flashback (event 720), and places the second phase boss.

b843fc3c8be12f27.name: open_spheda_stage_7_score
b843fc3c8be12f27.doc: Sets up Spheda stage 7 on the fixed floor map mstage7 with the Map and Magic Crystal items, then opens the Spheda score view.

b84fd6ac4e567bec.name: warp_to_boss_room_d01b01
b84fd6ac4e567bec.doc: Fades out and loads the d01b01 boss room at event 500 for the first character.

b852d7bb86e831c7.name: play_eina_potato_pie_scene
b852d7bb86e831c7.doc: At noon Eina brings Max a potato pie. He eats and recalls the potato pies she made when he was a kid, the most delicious in the world.

b853c877056774c0.name: enter_d06b03_with_boss_music
b853c877056774c0.doc: Plays the dark power emerges scene, starts BGM 167 unless it is already playing and loads dungeon d06b03 at event 550.

b85b4f338ae5d0fa.name: enter_room_4_and_fight
b85b4f338ae5d0fa.doc: Fades out, plays the room 4 intro, raises map parts 6 and 7, loads monster 606 and places the player; then fades in.

b8820d90a34f59be.name: play_pol_curse_and_pierrots_test_scene
b8820d90a34f59be.doc: Test scene on the i03h02 map: Max peeks at Pol Curse and Need talking, Pol Curse notices him and orders four pierrots to chase, and they jump up the rocks.

b88fd0437172292d.name: collect_earth_gem_clear_floor
b88fd0437172292d.doc: Dungeon floor pickup. For the monster forms (characters 2 and 3) it only shows a message. Otherwise it gives the Earth Gem (item 365), marks the floor cleared, plays the lapis pickup scene and unlocks map movement.

b89e8aa3c98af624.name: close_party_npc_view
b89e8aa3c98af624.doc: Closes the party NPC view: restores the message window options, either closes window 1 (is_event) or sets the NPC name preset, ends the event, and for a non-event view puts the NPC back in its train seat with place_train_npc.

b8a7a2dba545c3e7.name: ask_item_question
b8a7a2dba545c3e7.doc: Asks a yes/no question with message question + 70 and the item name filled in. Returns the choice, with the cursor starting on the second option.

b8cd3deda20fc749.name: start_d03_dungeon_if_player_agrees
b8cd3deda20fc749.doc: Asks whether to go; if yes loads event script d03/d03.stb.

b8d35c61cc0a85a3.name: play_night_scene_then_go_to_m08
b8d35c61cc0a85a3.doc: Plays the midnight scene play_opening_empty_house_scene and jumps to map m08 at event 151.

b8db1377a82e6f66.name: open_locked_door
b8db1377a82e6f66.doc: Locked door opening scene in d04: the camera turns to face the door, the door halves swing open (rotation chosen from the door's angle) and the lock piece lifts away.

b8dbde142d2c51c6.name: start_i01h01c_script_520
b8dbde142d2c51c6.doc: Program 520: hides the memo item and loads script i01h01/i01h01c_1.stb as program 520.

b8e8287f77bdc068.name: remove_firbit_return_actors
b8e8287f77bdc068.doc: Removes the Firbit characters used in the return scene and restores the active character.

b8f05f7dec116cd3.name: warp_to_boss_floor_for_halloween_boss
b8f05f7dec116cd3.doc: Boss Halloween program: warps to the boss floor map d01b01 and runs the Halloween boss event, skipping the next BGM load.

b8fc8335e9f230f8.name: play_ixion_completion_scene
b8fc8335e9f230f8.doc: Event 600 (sets flag 600). The party visits the Central Lab and sees the finished Ixion. Dr. Nobb's team explains its flashy design, the party agrees to go ten thousand years into the past, and Osmond is named to handle the Ixion's controls.

b90cfede69924b6f.name: play_ending_after_final_boss
b90cfede69924b6f.doc: Clears monsters, switches Ride Pod characters back, hides map parts p05/p06, plays the majin shrink scene and then the ending movie and epilogue, and sets the exit flag.

b90e8440fb4c14f0.name: run_in_from_exit_79
b90e8440fb4c14f0.doc: Entry cutscene for exit 79: the player runs in from the map edge along a path while the camera fades in.

b9100eef8719633f.name: play_voice_line
b9100eef8719633f.doc: Opens a voice stream, shows the message window and plays the voice for the given number of frames, then closes both.

b910fe5467ab224b.name: enter_dungeon_from_village
b910fe5467ab224b.doc: Before flag 404 shows the cave hint. Otherwise asks to go out, opens the dungeon tree map for stage 3 and enters the chosen floor; floor 20 loads boss map d04b01 unless flags 438 and 444 say the dungeon run is in progress.

b91c61424f1975d6.name: leave_swamp_for_next_floor
b91c61424f1975d6.doc: Asks whether to go on. On yes marks floor 6 cleared and starts floor 4 of dungeon 1.

b9290f644e1f2d4f.name: face_chara_and_npc_together
b9290f644e1f2d4f.doc: Starts an event and smoothly turns the character and the NPC toward each other, with walk motions while turning and the talk motion at the end. a3 first cuts the camera to the talk view with a crossfade; a2 is not used.

b92aa7f5c9296a55.name: play_ixion_departure_scene
b92aa7f5c9296a55.doc: Event 600 cutscene (flag 600): Max and Monica board the Ixion, Dr. Osmond runs the startup, Monica grumbles about the design, and they set off for ten thousand years in the past. Skippable.

b93709aee119b9c3.name: warp_to_s51_event_10500
b93709aee119b9c3.doc: Clears the scene, stops the BGM and loads map s51 at event 10500.

b95ae8a29e522682.name: setup_analysis_doors_and_npcs
b95ae8a29e522682.doc: Enables the door02 and door03 function points from analysis flags 206 and 207, then updates the NPCs.

b97022435ad61ab8.name: play_shot_mayor_need_line
b97022435ad61ab8.doc: Opening shot of the mayor's line to Cedric: the camera looks at actor 4, who looks ahead and speaks one voiced line asking Cedric to take over, then the screen fades out over 100 frames.

b9713b20ae2eab06.name: play_noam_fishing_rod_scene
b9713b20ae2eab06.doc: Event 220: the fisherman Noam complains the fish are not biting and that his three friends are acting strange. On the second visit he asks for a drink; giving him Grape Juice (item 370) earns the Fishing Rod and bait (Mimi) and a fishing tutorial.

b9a207f885c2cecc.name: show_e640_placeholder_title
b9a207f885c2cecc.doc: Placeholder for event 640: sets flag 640 and shows a title text saying the lapis are gathered and the Chrono Union starts.

b9a5ce03eb401a1f.name: talk_stewart_early
b9a5ce03eb401a1f.doc: Stewart's talk before the first quest is cleared: he tells the player to come to him with any problem.

b9b45279dc768f7f.name: load_train_rock_scene_actors
b9b45279dc768f7f.doc: Loads the actors for event 280 (Borneo and the train crew, the train map part, a worker), hides some rock pieces and loads the event 280 message file.

b9b7dbdd842eb5b6.name: talk_claire_monica
b9b7dbdd842eb5b6.doc: Claire's greeting to Monica, who she takes for Max's girlfriend, with a remark about Monica's hair. Two speech bubbles, no choices; ends the event.

b9d2ffa620204f53.name: remove_firbit_meeting_actors
b9d2ffa620204f53.doc: Removes the scene characters, sprites and images of the Firbit meeting and restores the active character.

b9e21ece9fd95a15.name: play_find_tree_expert_scene
b9e21ece9fd95a15.doc: Event 254 (sets flag 34): Monica explains that the Geostone shows a person who knows trees must be relocated to this village to revive Jurak. Max suggests Grin the gardener, and a hint tells the player to return to Palm Brinks and look for him in front of Max's house.

b9ec1969855335ba.name: play_victory_speech_scene
b9ec1969855335ba.doc: Event 824. A speaker addresses the citizens of Palm Brinks, saying that despite the hardships ahead they will pull through together and that today's victory belongs to them. Sets flag 824.

b9ee4136d26653d3.name: lower_rock_in_room_5
b9ee4136d26653d3.doc: Binds map part p11_d06b02-9 and sinks the rock pillar with the player.

b9f8668ea16a3cd9.name: remove_event_250_motions
b9f8668ea16a3cd9.doc: Removes the event 250 motion sets from Max and Monica.

ba23ca13f295ad30.name: load_moonbreak_scene_actors
ba23ca13f295ad30.doc: Loads the actors for event 732: Max and Monica with equipment, the sun and dark models, Andrea, the moon-break models and the light rain effect. Stores party slots in max_slot and monica_slot.

ba2ee1d46ea3fbaf.name: play_sighting_scene_then_go_to_heim_rada
ba2ee1d46ea3fbaf.doc: Plays event 504 and jumps to g04 (Heim Rada) at entry 510.

ba40539aed740958.name: talk_adel_to_monica
ba40539aed740958.doc: Adel's two-part talk to Monica asking her to stop putting Max in danger, with a short prayer for their safety in chapter 8.

ba4ea3d725c7a631.name: play_event_540_launch
ba4ea3d725c7a631.doc: Cutscene of the golem army launch: sets the march-seen flag and BGM 116. Four launcher arms fire one after another as the camera pans over them, two jet characters fade in, the camera shakes with growing force and the scene fades out.

ba507c742a49352b.name: board_train_for_chapter
ba507c742a49352b.doc: Asks to board the train and, on yes, plays the boarding scene and jumps to the front car (s08, or s37 in chapters 6 and 7) or the middle car (s07, or s38 in chapters 6 and 7).

ba571679af132a79.name: play_train_start_shot
ba571679af132a79.doc: Shot of the train: headlight flash, steam puffs and engine sound. Returns 0.

ba5a62116ddbb83d.name: show_need_helpless_reply
ba5a62116ddbb83d.doc: Need says there is nothing he can do.

ba623c3105196d4b.name: play_odd_villagers_notice_scene
ba623c3105196d4b.doc: Event 215. Max and Monica walk toward the Firbit village with the camera circling them, spot the villagers acting strangely and decide to talk to them. Sets flag 215.

ba76f7229df8a690.name: play_lao_chao_bistro_scene
ba76f7229df8a690.doc: Story event 364. Max and Monica notice that Lao Chao's Bistro has opened in the temple town and comment on the smell. Sets flag 364.

ba7ea345e839cbfd.name: start_dungeon_floor
ba7ea345e839cbfd.doc: Starts a floor: counts the visit, then loads the right dungeon map for the floor number (d06f01, d06f02, d06f03), the Flower Palace Foyer edit mode for floor 0 and other maps for floors 11, 21 and 27. Places monsters and treasure, plays the music and runs the floor intro.

ba90af9d8df0736b.name: ask_to_move_to_paznos_bridge
ba90af9d8df0736b.doc: Asks whether to move to Paznos Bridge. On yes plays the sun warp effect and jumps to map s30.

bab1d6252cd45c05.name: talk_rufio_after_joining
bab1d6252cd45c05.doc: Rufio's chatter after the moon photo quest is cleared, thanking the player. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about the Blackstone Railroad.

bab827edcd2de5da.name: ask_to_give_up_hole
bab827edcd2de5da.doc: Asks whether to give up the current Spheda hole (or the whole round on the last hole); on yes shows the score and returns to the course menu, or loads the next hole.

bac9f1e2a69832ff.name: interact_with_exit
bac9f1e2a69832ff.doc: Handles an exit: the first time asks for the Trolley Oil (item 350) to open it. Once open, asks whether to go through and moves to the floor chosen by get_next_floor for this exit.

bad0135d853aba57.name: play_paznos_transformation_scene
bad0135d853aba57.doc: Sets flag 640. Max and Monica watch Paznos transform: joints combine, it unfolds and its eyes glow. They say it looks like Paznos is transforming. Fades out and returns control at the end.

baddf0a5deee5729.name: play_m06b_event_154_at_midnight
baddf0a5deee5729.doc: Sets midnight and loads the m06b event script at 154.

baf0012fe5e1832c.name: play_victory_pose
baf0012fe5e1832c.doc: Plays victory pose B for the player.

bb059a060cc68cc3.name: open_chest_lid
bb059a060cc68cc3.doc: Opens the treasure chest lid over eleven frames, updating lid_angle.

bb12b06e9a08fb56.name: play_boss_room_entry_short
bb12b06e9a08fb56.doc: Short version of the boss room entry, used when the long intro has already been seen. Max walks in as the floor piece rises and then the player gets control; the scene can be skipped.

bb19383572d56a1d.name: check_ticket_at_circus_entrance
bb19383572d56a1d.doc: Ticket check at the circus gate (the ticket taker). Prompts for a Circus Ticket (item 353) via the item menu; with the ticket, the first time it runs the m06b program 153, afterwards plays the ticket scene, swaps the Wrench for the circus Wrench and enters dungeon 0 floor 21. Other items get sent home.

bb2218def42992db.name: place_train_npc
bb2218def42992db.doc: Places NPC npc_id's model chara in its train seat from the NPC train table: seat position, side by the sign of the seat x, and an idle motion.

bb524c3cfb92dbdf.name: enter_house_g02i02
bb524c3cfb92dbdf.doc: Enters the g02i02 interior, using a map jump instead (keeping the BGM unless flag 324 is set and 328 is not) when story flags 300, 304, 306, 324, 328 or 330 call for a scene there.

bb5d5401d0e42a1e.name: setup_station_map
bb5d5401d0e42a1e.doc: Station map start: shows the station parts and, on a fresh load, plays the train arrival scene or the stop scene depending on the previous map and counter 1. After loading a save it only places the player.

bb6dca8de7f9b1a6.name: talk_to_race_host_or_spectator
bb6dca8de7f9b1a6.doc: Slot 24 is the race host, handled by talk_to_race_host. Everyone else is a spectator with a comment that depends on chapter and extra mode.

bb6e468467181b26.name: play_event_748
bb6e468467181b26.doc: Event 748, a flashback in the palace garden. Soldiers bring a boy caught in the flower bed to the queen (Andrea), who has him freed and gives him the garden to look after, naming him Sirus. Sets the seen flag, fixes the time at noon while it plays and restores it afterwards. Skippable.

bb8d5eca7f34ea1a.name: play_flotsam_taunts_party_scene
bb8d5eca7f34ea1a.doc: Event 108b, sets flag 108: Flotsam and the elephant laugh at Max and Steve (the Ridepod) for running away and they jump off and walk out of view.

bb93d3dab6e9457d.name: play_time_leap_scene_and_go_to_subdimension
bb93d3dab6e9457d.doc: Plays the time leap scene and jumps to map s58 (Subdimension).

bb97fa1eee68421a.name: reset_arena_and_play_freed_scene
bb97fa1eee68421a.doc: Fades out and back in, clears monsters and plays the freed scene.

bb9f246980d1271f.name: hide_train_steps
bb9f246980d1271f.doc: Hides the six step pieces of the train (train02-a0 to a5).

bbb0980a0bdd9fd9.name: unlock_floor_exit
bbb0980a0bdd9fd9.doc: Unlocks the d05 floor exit. When special_floor is 0 the lift piece rises with a sound while the camera turns, otherwise the piece appears with a different sound and a crossfade.

bbb792d191026936.name: talk_ferdinand_to_monica
bbb792d191026936.doc: Ferdinand's two-part talk to Monica about food, with a different single line in chapter 8. Uses the talk camera and returns Ferdinand to standing.

bbb90901ff662ab1.name: play_retry_scene_and_enter_dungeon
bbb90901ff662ab1.doc: Event 520: offers the retry. If accepted, sets flag 25, adds Steve to the party and goes back to the dungeon; otherwise sets flag 29 and returns to the map script.

bbc788a33eab4346.name: go_to_veniccio_station
bbc788a33eab4346.doc: Asks to go to Veniccio Station and, if yes, jumps to map s09.

bbc80a14c974edd2.name: play_crest_reunion_scene_with_helpers
bbc80a14c974edd2.doc: Same scene as the first Crest reunion but written using the shared scene-loading helpers; ends with a jump to map s33 (Moonflower Palace).

bbce7b81c281aa38.name: ask_to_go_to_veniccio_station
bbce7b81c281aa38.doc: Asks whether to move to Veniccio Station. On yes the player runs off and the screen fades, returning 1; on no he steps back from the gate. Returns 0 if declined.

bbd2d44d064ee40e.name: run_voice_message
bbd2d44d064ee40e.doc: Lip syncs a playing voice stream while polling the message window, until the player confirms the last page. Returns the frames waited.

bbd6d1a31a5b5b32.name: talk_milane_to_max
bbd6d1a31a5b5b32.doc: Milane's talk when Max is the active character: he mentions the circus. Chapter 8 swaps in a question about tough guys in the mine.

bbecc421c9746479.name: play_buggy_chase_scene
bbecc421c9746479.doc: Skippable event 204 scene: Flotsam's gang chases the train in a buggy, Cedric hands Max a bomb and tells him to throw it. Sets flag 204.

bbf066302af966c4.name: play_floor_entry_in_room
bbf066302af966c4.doc: Loads the d01f01 room, monsters and chests and plays the floor entry scene.

bc478eddfafa1a6f.name: do_nothing_arg
bc478eddfafa1a6f.doc: Takes one int argument and does nothing; used as a placeholder callback.

bc4a3447ca458b4d.name: show_game_over_screen
bc4a3447ca458b4d.doc: Pauses the dungeon, plays the game over stream, and shows the game over image until a button is pressed, then fades out and sets the exit flag.

bc85228eef4928a7.name: finish_event_207_at_station
bc85228eef4928a7.doc: After event 207, tilts the train parts, sets progress 4, makes Cedric, Borneo and Erik join, enables the second party member and character switching, gives 5 Armband Repair Powder and returns to the s02 script.

bcaa21f57750042e.name: enter_g01_i07_building
bcaa21f57750042e.doc: Plays the knock-on-door scene, fades out and jumps to map g01i07 (Dwarves' House) at entrance 501.

bcc13172dd3d9e2b.name: play_shot_fade_in_on_steve
bcc13172dd3d9e2b.doc: Cutscene shot in Cedric's house: fades in on Max and Steve standing, plays a sound and holds. Returns 0.

bcc1f23009d89e6a.name: remove_potato_pie_scene_actors
bcc1f23009d89e6a.doc: Deletes the five scene characters used by the potato pie scene and shows the player again.

bcc71bd52c432c8c.name: play_dinner_argument_scene
bcc71bd52c432c8c.doc: Sets flag 101 and plays event 101 at noon: black-screen narration, then Max at dinner asks his father about his mother, gets a brush-off, and storms out of the house.

bcd8be3ac4e6ac9f.name: place_sitting_cedric_and_hide_taken_items
bcd8be3ac4e6ac9f.doc: Places Cedric sitting and disables the item1 point and the memo part once the player already owns items 382 and 386.

bce39c9487d8862f.name: can_play_any_story_event
bce39c9487d8862f.doc: Returns 1 if any of the story events 456, 460, 448 or 468 can be played.

bce9a7d80fd24747.name: leave_fish_race_to_i03h04_503
bce9a7d80fd24747.doc: Fades out the music and jumps to map i03h04 at entry 503.

bd232546be6a49c0.name: use_item_on_obstacle
bd232546be6a49c0.doc: Asks for an item on the obstacle. The first time, using Giant Meat (341) sets local flag 0 and plays the swinging map piece scene; afterwards it plays the walk-through scene. Any other item plays the refusal gesture.

bd2ba777e648280f.name: play_all_aboard_scene
bd2ba777e648280f.doc: Plays event e360 (sets flag 360): Cedric calls all aboard, announcing they are heading to the ocean.

bd3d008d92167c42.name: pan_camera_around_view_shot
bd3d008d92167c42.doc: Noon shot with the player hidden. The camera stays still and its target sweeps around a circle for 600 frames.

bd49947d7370e4a6.name: clean_up_e376_scene
bd49947d7370e4a6.doc: Removes the extra characters and models loaded for event e376 and restores the active character.

bd5fceaad7b7ab49.name: talk_blinkhorn_monica
bd5fceaad7b7ab49.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk with Monica as the active character: outside chapter 8 he says he dislikes girls swinging swords and prefers gentle women, in chapter 8 he offers help.

bd64708c5d3dc7d5.name: play_horn_orders_to_s55
bd64708c5d3dc7d5.doc: Plays the Horn orders scene and jumps to map s55 at event 601.

bd66515ed5bd33be.name: talk_to_woman_about_lively_circus
bd66515ed5bd33be.doc: A woman says the circus makes the town lively.

bd7f91b89f327ea7.name: handle_palace_door_password
bd7f91b89f327ea7.doc: Door handler. If the password flag (58) is not set it plays either an intro scene or the password challenge, and kicks the player to edit mode 109 on failure. Once the flag is set it loads dungeon d06b01.

bd9786fb769bd5bd.name: play_twin_e212d_intro_scene
bd9786fb769bd5bd.doc: Two e212d monsters attack with a title card fading in and out, then the scene fades out.

bda9962c73e7c458.name: on_gate
bda9962c73e7c458.doc: Plays the red time gate with a party check, then jumps to s39 (Operations Room) if event 560 can play, otherwise to f04 (Gundorada Workshop).

bdb3e94d578fcaab.name: play_event_205
bdb3e94d578fcaab.doc: Event 205: after a failed train fight one character has fainted and another is in a frenzy, while a companion tells Max she can't take any more. Sets the train fight retry seen flag first and can be skipped.

bdb4e4aaa22c0ce1.name: preview_camera_pan_then_run_scene
bdb4e4aaa22c0ce1.doc: Debug scene: a high camera pans down toward two standing characters, who then run along the same path.

bdb6d4f0b37329f3.name: play_first_arrival_on_map_start
bdb6d4f0b37329f3.doc: Map start: plays the jump-down arrival scene without the map piece.

bdc859cce70ff73b.name: play_floor_intro_scene
bdc859cce70ff73b.doc: Plays the floor entry scene: five door parts swing as the player walks in, with the floor logo (same floor as before) or the dungeon map piece (new floor). If the floor carries a red, blue or white seal it shows the seal picture and a message that a character cannot transform or that healing is disabled.

bdd5b5bfc627bf94.name: ask_to_leave_for_d05
bdd5b5bfc627bf94.doc: Exit event. Refuses with a hint if the Lapis has not been taken, otherwise asks whether to leave and loads the d05 dungeon script.

bddd0b8b5a8483b0.name: talk_to_aunt_polly
bddd0b8b5a8483b0.doc: Talk handler for Aunt Polly. Picks the line by the active character (Max or Monica), whether quest 0 is cleared, and quest 8 (deliver 20 loaves to Morton).

bdf229a4da9bf409.name: play_run_in_from_veniccio
bdf229a4da9bf409.doc: Fades in on the player running into the cave from the Veniccio side.

be0221ffafa4ad10.name: leave_for_s41_or_g04
be0221ffafa4ad10.doc: If the player confirms leaving, jumps to map s41 as program 501 when flag 504 is clear, otherwise to map g04.

be04369fc8356e65.name: unload_event_272_charas
be04369fc8356e65.doc: Cleans up the event 272 scene: reactivates whichever of Max or Monica is the active character, deletes the other's scene model and motion data plus helper models 35 to 40, and sets the village map part back to its blink motion.

be08d5f62832f1e6.name: poll_voice_message_input
be08d5f62832f1e6.doc: Polls the buttons while a voice message window is open. Confirm or cancel plays the matching sound; on a finished page (state 5) it advances, at the end (state 3) it returns 1, and during playback it speeds the text up and sets lip_state[0] to 2. Returns 0 otherwise.

be1a585ab46621f1.name: play_event_109
be1a585ab46621f1.doc: Short scene on the tour map: Cedric walks along while the camera eases back, then the screen fades out and the player returns.

be340915c9303e32.name: setup_monsters_607_608_room
be340915c9303e32.doc: Sets flag 728, loads monsters 607 and 608 (only 607 is loaded as the main one), places both, places Max, sets the camera and fades in.

be5de40174250876.name: talk_ferdinand_to_monica
be5de40174250876.doc: Ferdinand's two-part talk to Monica about food, with a different single line in chapter 8. Uses the talk camera and returns Ferdinand to standing.

be72a2c74e0e2761.name: open_door_instantly
be72a2c74e0e2761.doc: Opens a dungeon door at once when its key marker is visible: opens the minimap door, moves and hides the door pieces, and disables the key point. Returns 0 early when there is no door or no key shown.

be77a2a59656fe2a.name: toggle_sky_area
be77a2a59656fe2a.doc: Flips local flag 5 and the sky drawing, then plays the transition between the main area and the sky area.

be7a46e3f63b0f85.name: start_gold_paint_quest
be7a46e3f63b0f85.doc: As Monica it plays the intro scene only. As Max it plays the quest offer and sets the quest to accepted.

be8b7455238542bd.name: ask_to_leave_dungeon
be8b7455238542bd.doc: Exit trigger. If the active character is a non-party character it shows a message and sends the player back. Otherwise it asks whether to leave. Yes plays the run-out scene and goes to Sindain Station (edit mode 16), no walks the player a few steps back from the door.

be90bd63897bfe69.name: play_walk_in_entrance_scene
be90bd63897bfe69.doc: Entrance scene: the player walks a short way into the map while fading in, then control returns.

be96c574de6715ff.name: play_time_travel_shake_scene
be96c574de6715ff.doc: Event 600 second part: the Ixion shakes and the screen waves as the pair cry out during the time jump, then fades out. Skippable.

bebaaa2acf6f3ee4.name: play_shot_train_pulls_out
bebaaa2acf6f3ee4.doc: Opening shot of the train pulling out: cuts the camera behind the train, then moves train actor 10 from z -1690 to -2100 over 45 frames while the camera eases back, and waits for it.

bed9936f7cbfbcdd.name: load_moon_break_scene_actors
bed9936f7cbfbcdd.doc: Sets up Max and Monica as scene actors, plus the sun and dark figures, Andrea, the moon break effects and the E732 light rain effect script, and loads the event 732 messages.

bee8dfa54b882a21.name: play_elephant_falls_story
bee8dfa54b882a21.doc: Pauses monsters, switches to Max and plays the elephant falls scene, then sets flag 7.

befb83d37c30ebe0.name: play_arena_entry_scene
befb83d37c30ebe0.doc: Fades in on Max in the arena, he runs in a few steps while the s06_08-m1 map piece hops into place, then the camera and control reset.

bf08a5b611967c05.name: place_swamp_characters
bf08a5b611967c05.doc: Loads and places the swamp's characters for the current story step: Noam fishing, the villagers (Wicky, Mogri and Zak in slot 10) when include_villagers is set, Master Utan, and the swamp master monster b04a between events 240 and 245. Also switches Master Utan's func points and map pieces depending on flag 253.

bf099744d482e8e2.name: start_second_gaspard_fight
bf099744d482e8e2.doc: Plays the transformation scene, disables the e528 and lava func points, enables invent_2023-1, shows piece d05ba03-a and pushes the two lava fall parts (takil, takir) 330 units apart, then loads monster 511 (giant Gaspard) and places the player facing it.

bf1193b39f921528.name: play_fire_support_order_scene
bf1193b39f921528.doc: The villagers sit in a circle as the camera sweeps around them; the leader orders them to give cover and fire. Skippable.

bf477ef1abd1e897.name: ask_board_train
bf477ef1abd1e897.doc: Station prompt asking the player to enter or depart. Cancelling returns 0; choosing to depart fades out, opens the world map menu and returns 0; choosing to enter returns 1.

bf564a35f6ab603e.name: start_story_105a_script
bf564a35f6ab603e.doc: Story 105a: loads script i01h01/i01h01b_1.stb as program 500.

bf621237cdaa9119.name: use_floor_exit_door
bf621237cdaa9119.doc: Door at the end of the floor. Before flag 7 it only shows a refusal. After that it refuses Ride Pod characters, otherwise asks to go on. On yes it marks the floor cleared and enters the next floor (or starts Georama edit mode 12 the first time).

bf643fe5a1c89309.name: play_event_105c_scene
bf643fe5a1c89309.doc: Runs variant 1 to 5 of event 105c, the follow-up scenes about the Energy Pack backpack invention. Saves and restores the camera and player position around it.

bf8fae321a963df8.name: play_ending_movie_and_exit
bf8fae321a963df8.doc: Plays the ending movie and end card and then sets the exit flag. Returns 0.

bfc4be86f2395ed9.name: play_angry_walk_out_and_resume
bfc4be86f2395ed9.doc: Plays the angry walk-out scene, reattaches Steve to the party leader's back, removes him from the party and enables the Steve event trigger.

bfc9e07d876d374c.name: talk_to_race_spectator
bfc9e07d876d374c.doc: Talk handler for the spectators and rival owners at the Finny Frenzy. Their lines depend on the chapter, on extra mode and on whether Max or Monica is leading, followed by the normal NPC conversation.

bfcb7d696b1cb50b.name: play_train_pull_out_shot
bfcb7d696b1cb50b.doc: Starts the engine motion and eases the train forward out of the station.

bfcc4b90b48716d9.name: debug_play_camera_shots
bfcc4b90b48716d9.doc: Plays the ship flyover shot and the party looks up shot.

bfd076b33ffe58c8.name: give_nova_cannon_and_play_scene
bfd076b33ffe58c8.doc: Adds the Nova Cannon (item 154) and plays the Nova Cannon scene.

bfd7b2061e28792e.name: leave_village_via_dungeon_map
bfd7b2061e28792e.doc: After the leave question is accepted, opens the dungeon tree map for stage 3. Choosing floor 0 jumps to map g03, another floor starts the dungeon there, and 20 cancels.

bfe64bcdb7abab7f.name: talk_corinne_after_joining
bfe64bcdb7abab7f.doc: Corinne's chatter after the hide-and-seek quest is cleared, saying it is for little kids. Chapter 8 swaps in a line asking Max to tell her about his adventures.

bfedcb5b3bde36b1.name: setup_monster_605_room
bfedcb5b3bde36b1.doc: Sets flag 728, loads and places monster 605, places Max facing it, sets the camera and fades in.

bff9eaf5158fa025.name: play_lipsync_timed
bff9eaf5158fa025.doc: Runs the voice lip sync on the message window until the voice stream stops or the frame limit passes, optionally closing the window at close_frame. Returns the frames elapsed.

c0052c572bb38ddf.name: load_moonflower_beam_actors
c0052c572bb38ddf.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Osmond, Toryon, the beam, shot and rock models, the beam effect script and the train parts for the Moonflower beam scene.

c005d4fb1e7cfe94.name: enter_red_time_gate_to_jurak_mall
c005d4fb1e7cfe94.doc: Enters the red time gate and jumps to map f01 (Jurak Mall). Skips the next music load when a pending event 270 or 280 will play there.

c00d59f2cd40bc8e.name: replay_noam_fishing_rod_scene
c00d59f2cd40bc8e.doc: Story event 220: resets flags 220 and 28, shows the villagers and replays the Noam fishing rod scene.

c00dcbb2bb5a0796.name: play_battle_flashback_one_scene
c00dcbb2bb5a0796.doc: Fades out, pauses the game, shows the battle flashback message e720, then places monster 616 and resumes.

c021c120c65b1f2e.name: play_train_arrival_scene_late
c021c120c65b1f2e.doc: Chapter 6 and 7 version: the player's character runs in from the right as the train pieces open up.

c02f5e2ee093f8e1.name: delete_firbit_models
c02f5e2ee093f8e1.doc: Deactivates and deletes the six Firbit models (Noam, Rococo, Wicky, Zak, Mogri, Tobo) loaded for event 250.

c03e813383ea30cd.name: start_dungeon_floor
c03e813383ea30cd.doc: Loads whatever the current floor needs. Floor 0 enters edit mode (Veniccio); floor 9 loads story map s19, floor 14 map s15, floor 17 a tournament map s45, floor 20 d04b01 or Shigura Village, floor 1 the high platform floor d04f00, and the others d04f01 or d04f02 with a one in eight chance of rain. Floor 2 plays event 406 the first time.

c042f2c476e75738.name: play_garden_clue_scene
c042f2c476e75738.doc: Event 702: Max and Monica work out from the pictures in the hall that they must restore the Palace Garden to what it used to be, to uncover the secret of Griffon and the palace.

c08190e41cba7c79.name: run_power_gauge
c08190e41cba7c79.doc: Runs the Spheda power gauge. Returns 1 if the player backs out. Otherwise the gauge result scales the power and shifts the yaw, curve and spin for mis-hits, which are written back to the arrays.

c0a2895758720ba4.name: start_circus_evening_story_event
c0a2895758720ba4.doc: Story event 6: stops the music and ambience and loads the m06b program 155.

c0af9d3d71b2aab2.name: go_to_palace_terrace_edit
c0af9d3d71b2aab2.doc: Fades out, flags the active character, clears monsters, marks the floor info and enters edit mode 180 (Palace Terrace) with program 500.

c0b63c735beb2f16.name: ask_to_exit_toward_town
c0b63c735beb2f16.doc: Asks the player whether to leave through the town exit. On yes the character runs off, the screen fades out and it returns 1. On no it walks a few steps back and returns 0.

c0c6f0a98f0e148a.name: play_late_train_arrival_scene
c0c6f0a98f0e148a.doc: Train arrival cutscene used in chapters 6 and 7: the late train model pulls into the station. Flag 448 changes the details.

c0e16595ed577c28.name: run_party_npc_talk
c0e16595ed577c28.doc: Talk menu with a train-car NPC (a fixed one for Cedric, Borneo or Erik when fixed_npc is 1, 2 or 3): returns 1 at once if they are already the party NPC. Otherwise it puts the camera in front of the NPC and offers: take them along (opens the party select menu, refused while Lin is the party NPC), talk, and per-NPC extras such as repairs, shops, menus or hints. Returns 1 when something was done.

c10021037a1c0983.name: ask_give_white_windflower
c10021037a1c0983.doc: Shows a hint box suggesting giving Lao Chao a White Windflower for his miracle dish and asks with a button prompt. Returns 1 if the player picked the menu button, else 0.

c10493276621a442.name: play_departure_and_go_to_balance_valley
c10493276621a442.doc: Plays the all aboard scene and train departure, opens the world map and jumps to Balance Valley Station (s04).

c104ea6116badc57.name: play_wrong_item_reaction
c104ea6116badc57.doc: Plays the character's refusal gesture (no, no) facing the camera. Used when the wrong item is picked in the use-item menu; Ridepod and monster forms just finish.

c105af9d9b226ada.name: play_ask_jurak_about_griffon_scene
c105af9d9b226ada.doc: Plays event 270. Max and Monica walk up to Jurak, wake him with a snore and ask about Emperor Griffon, who has been altering time. Jurak does not remember anything.

c11160f56ed6f001.name: give_starter_items_and_start_georama
c11160f56ed6f001.doc: Program 506: adds a set of items (210, 214, 216, 220, 224, 235, 231), opens the item-overflow menu if the bag is full, allows editing and starts Georama mode.

c13cdd20d38aa73c.name: play_floor_clear_scene
c13cdd20d38aa73c.doc: Floor clear sequence: clears monsters, plays the character's victory pose, opens the key door, marks the floor cleared, then shows medal, broken seal and Spheda bonus messages.

c14fd3e06db56eb8.name: open_menu_from_party_talk
c14fd3e06db56eb8.doc: Fades out, opens the shop menu with the given menu number from a party NPC conversation, then finishes the party talk for npc and fixed_chara and fades back in.

c15b01dbe507cea9.name: finish_s47_scene_and_jump_to_s26
c15b01dbe507cea9.doc: Runs the s47 scene and jumps to map s26 at entry 501.

c162be348ef84d45.name: play_e105c_guts_pose
c162be348ef84d45.doc: Shot in Cedric's house: Max watches as Cedric does a fist pump and cheers that Max did it.

c164004cdf04ac51.name: enter_blue_time_gate
c164004cdf04ac51.doc: Time travel through the blue time gate at the given spot. With Monica in the party she warps with both characters shown (play_blue_time_gate_scene). Otherwise Max warps alone through the same gate (play_red_time_gate_scene with the blue gate), first playing the blue Atlamillia glow scene once (flag 522) when flag 520 is set and flag 532 is not.

c16873efe2e4061b.name: play_starglass_time_travel_scene
c16873efe2e4061b.doc: Event 352: the party gets ready and travels back in time with the Starglass.

c16df9f5d70d7e85.name: talk_bruno_check_candles
c16df9f5d70d7e85.doc: Priest Bruno's candle check: if any candle is still lit he says the time has not come and leaves; if all are out he joins the party and quest 13 is cleared. Returns 0 on the refusal.

c17bcb966f7df877.name: run_spheda_trial_turn
c17bcb966f7df877.doc: Runs one trial shot. On a hole-in it gives items 11 and 363 and advances the floor. On a miss it counts attempts and after 10, or when the retry is refused, gives items 10 and 363 and advances; otherwise it resets the ball for another try.

c1822cfafbd36fdb.name: spawn_room_reward_chests
c1822cfafbd36fdb.doc: After the fight, spawns treasure chests with items 209, 203 and 173 for the bits of counter 17 (16, 32, 64) not yet set, plays the calm music and marks the floor info flag 2.

c19991647aa7395a.name: setup_s12_start
c19991647aa7395a.doc: Runs play_osmond_waits_at_train_scene, loads the waiting NPC, places the player, puts the camera behind and fades in.

c1a12dc6d975ed19.name: play_board_middle_car
c1a12dc6d975ed19.doc: Cutscene of Max boarding a middle train car. Reads the train and position from the event data, picks the car parts and heights for the train id and map (alt_heights selects the other set), sets counter 0 to the train type and walks Max in.

c1c004c6b24efd17.name: play_firbit_meeting_scene
c1c004c6b24efd17.doc: Sets flag 209. Max and Monica walk into the Firbit house in Rainbow Butterfly Wood and meet Conda, Rococo and Tobo. They ask the Firbits to use their building power to rebuild towns; the Firbits refuse until they tell the story of Holly, a woman who vanished a year ago, and of the party of four sent after her.

c1e2ab9e70cd8cd5.name: play_rapis_water_get_scene
c1e2ab9e70cd8cd5.doc: Event 632 (flag 632): Max or Monica gasps at the rapis point, the surrounding map piece is hidden, and the item get jingle plays for item 366 (the lapis water model). Then restores the music and opens the item limit menu.

c1e75c13c505d5ca.name: leave_for_jurak_mall
c1e75c13c505d5ca.doc: Plays the red gate warp, skips the next BGM load when event 270 or 280 is about to play, and jumps to map f01 (Jurak Mall).

c2074acf8024c748.name: turn_chara_to_point
c2074acf8024c748.doc: Turns a character in place to face the point x, z, using turn_chara_to_yaw.

c237b97f4c0bc215.name: wait_for_button_then_place_train
c237b97f4c0bc215.doc: Test event: hides the party and waits for a pad press, then restores them and puts the train back at its station position.

c23c72c38a6fb8bc.name: play_moon_breaking_scene
c23c72c38a6fb8bc.doc: Plays event 732. The dark foe dies laughing about the falling moon, Sirus remembers how to stop the Star of Oblivion, destroys the moon with his hand, and fades away to be with Alexandra.

c23cacb2c20e1949.name: restart_event_304
c23cacb2c20e1949.doc: Resets flags 304, 306, 324 and 330 and replays Argo and Lin's first visit scene.

c2539adea0b78816.name: open_sealed_door
c2539adea0b78816.doc: Opens the sealed door in dungeon 5. When use_wind is 0 the camera holds while the door flies off with sounds and shaking, and the door pieces and effect are hidden or disabled.

c255223dd713bcb6.name: start_lin_stays_behind_scene
c255223dd713bcb6.doc: Plays the scene where Lin stays behind.

c262b58e792e6446.name: is_swing_clear
c262b58e792e6446.doc: Checks whether the golf swing arc from start_angle to end_angle is free around (x, y, z): returns -1 when a wall blocks the sweep near either end, 0 when a wall crosses the arc or there is no ground under it, and 1 when it is clear.

c2634d08683968c3.name: unload_event_285_charas
c2634d08683968c3.doc: Removes the event 285 scene characters and effects, leaving only the active character.

c2662b38d89de061.name: play_story_108b_taunt_then_palm_brinks
c2662b38d89de061.doc: Story entry for event 108b: restores HP to full, plays the elephant taunt scene and goes to Palm Brinks in Georama edit mode.

c27af4650a009a5c.name: play_gilda_payment_shot
c27af4650a009a5c.doc: Shot of the other character paying Max 400 Gilda for the invention, with voice line and message.

c27b50b3715af799.name: play_yorda_tree_arrival_scene
c27b50b3715af799.doc: Event 332 (flag 332): Max and Monica reach the huge holy Yorda Tree. If flag 330 is set they remark on it; otherwise they worry about Lin and decide not to go further.

c27bcf9cecaa1282.name: load_e250_scene_characters
c27bcf9cecaa1282.doc: Loads Max, Monica and Conda models, a screen image and the message file for event e250, setting globals 0 and 1.
