c2a092e7a4ee59aa.name: ask_npc_question
c2a092e7a4ee59aa.doc: Starts a talk with npc, shows question mes_no with choice_count options and the cursor on cursor, then ends the talk and returns the choice. set_camera and restore control the camera and turning back.

c2a1071909c1ca4a.name: play_map_start_scene_for_previous_map
c2a1071909c1ca4a.doc: Map start program: coming from map 2 it plays event 404 (first visit, then goes to g03) or the run-in; coming from map 84 it plays event 408 or event 420 depending on flag 408.

c2a1456252f4361b.name: play_stream_message_auto
c2a1456252f4361b.doc: Plays a voice stream with its message text in a window for up to the given number of frames, then closes the window. The stream is not closed here.

c2ab7bb4f0666be5.name: play_controlled_shingala_scene
c2ab7bb4f0666be5.doc: Sets flag 408 and plays event 408: Shingala no longer recognises Pau because of a strange device on his head, and the group decides to ask Luna Lab for help.

c2be29ab568705eb.name: ask_blinkhorn_race_start
c2be29ab568705eb.doc: Asks whether to start Blinkhorn's race. Declining ends the talk and sets counter 7 to 0; accepting starts the stopwatch and sets counter 7 to 1.

c2c380d204a66eed.name: enter_room_3_and_fight
c2c380d204a66eed.doc: Fades out, plays the room 3 intro, raises map parts 4 and 5, loads monster 605 and places the player; then fades in.

c2f7b093836a70e0.name: start_swamp_map
c2f7b093836a70e0.doc: Counts the visit to floor 6, enables map movement, places the characters and story points, and plays the arrival scene (or places the player after loading a save). Event 501 starts if flag 209 is set and flag 215 is not.

c2fae677d6344da4.name: talk_olivie_early
c2fae677d6344da4.doc: Olivie's talk before the first quest is cleared or before the tournament flag is set: the Firbit people only grant favours to those more skilled than themselves.

c30a9998a60e8235.name: talk_blinkhorn_to_monica
c30a9998a60e8235.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk when Monica is the active character: a remark about women with swords, or an offer of help in chapter 8.

c30ba8c358994b73.name: use_floor_gate
c30ba8c358994b73.doc: Handles a gate. If still locked, the player is told so and can use the Fairy Saw (item 339) to open it with the gate-open cutscene. Once open, the player is asked whether to go to the next floor; yes updates the floor info and reloads the dungeon. Companion characters just comment.

c30e7019830c0380.name: play_shigu_revival_placeholder
c30e7019830c0380.doc: Event 438 (flag 438): an unfinished placeholder that shows a debug line (Shigu revival, just exit) and ends.

c311ab8590aa82ef.name: play_griffon_unleashes_power_scene
c311ab8590aa82ef.doc: Sets flag 612. Griffon, pleased with the stones' power, tells Max and Monica to watch as he raises his hands and the palace shakes and changes.

c311b134100a06ac.name: load_holly_scene
c311b134100a06ac.doc: Loads Max and Monica, the item get and Holly actors, the seven butterfly actors b02a1 to b02a7, the light actors, the event 260 image and message file.

c31d5678a5a693e1.name: setup_gaspard_boss_fight
c31d5678a5a693e1.doc: Sets up the Gaspard fight on the battleship: fixed HP, defence and equipment for Max and Monica, forces Monica to be the active character, places the player and monsters 510 and 602, locks character switching and map moves.

c3200b3056ab06de.name: play_crest_griffon_lecture_scene
c3200b3056ab06de.doc: Event 372, part 2. After casting a spell, Crest explains that Griffon's followers sold their souls, that a leap ten thousand years back is needed, and that the Luna Lab on the Veniccio Coast may hold the answer. Max and Monica thank her and leave, and one of two endings plays.

c32528afa7704607.name: toggle_panel_part
c32528afa7704607.doc: Toggles the visibility of one part of the i01h07 panel puzzle, addressed by row 0 to 1 and col 0 to 6; out of range returns 0.

c32cea635b8d2f57.name: ask_to_return_to_d07_dungeon
c32cea635b8d2f57.doc: Exit talk. The two non-Max/Monica characters only get a message. Otherwise asks the question and on yes clears the monsters, fades out and returns to the d07 dungeon script.

c336c9241e1f92a1.name: play_event_640_to_d06b01
c336c9241e1f92a1.doc: Plays event 640 (Eina, Galen and Puzzhei) and jumps to the d06b01 dungeon at event 600.

c33d823e562fe6e7.name: print_map_init
c33d823e562fe6e7.doc: Prints a map init marker to the debug log.

c349e4058c57d52d.name: play_cedric_confronts_need_scene
c349e4058c57d52d.doc: Story 109a scene: Cedric bursts in on Need at the mayor's house and demands the truth, and Need begins to explain. Sets flag 109.

c34b56222091f474.name: show_aim_for_head_hint
c34b56222091f474.doc: Event program in the Halloween boss room that pauses monsters and the player and shows a hint box telling the player to aim for the head. The French text is shown for both language branches.

c35469839b51e15a.name: talk_gerald_to_monica
c35469839b51e15a.doc: Gerald's talk when Monica is the active character, asking if she is a friend of Max. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about helping Need and Cedric rebuild the world.

c35eb48e2af59761.name: play_board_train_late
c35eb48e2af59761.doc: Boarding cutscene at a train station. The map and the event position decide the facing and which door set is used; the train id (2 to 7) picks the car and door parts and sets counter 0 to 1, 2 or 3 by pair. The doors open, the player runs in with footsteps chosen by map (metal or stone), the screen fades out and the player is placed inside.

c365c177acd5c609.name: play_flotsam_orders_elephant_again_shot
c365c177acd5c609.doc: Flotsam appears above the standing elephant, scolds Max that it is always the same and orders Linda to attack.

c36a6043c0b02a53.name: show_ridepod_tutorial
c36a6043c0b02a53.doc: Shows a series of help messages on using the Ridepod from the main menu, refuelling and upgrading the Core through Cedric, with the Ridepod Steve standing in view.

c3978c0c464323c3.name: choose_floor_and_start
c3978c0c464323c3.doc: Starts music 18, opens the dungeon floor select menu, stores the chosen floor and previous floor, and starts that floor.

c3aa58e0566932a3.name: setup_ball_stance
c3aa58e0566932a3.doc: Reads the Spheda ball and pin positions into ball_x, ball_y and ball_z, aims yaw at the pin, widens the aim in steps of an eighth of pi on alternating sides until the swing is clear of obstacles, then places the player at the ball in the ready stance.

c3b996238a7d85b4.name: place_player_on_map_start
c3b996238a7d85b4.doc: Locks map movement, places the player at (50, 140.7, -800) after loading from a memory card or at (0, 140.7, -900) otherwise, resets the camera behind the player and fades in.

c3dfba5104bd4268.name: play_lapis_guardian_intro_scene
c3dfba5104bd4268.doc: Boss introduction: the camera sweeps over the guardian monster (e205e), which rises and attacks, with a title card shown over it.

c3ecc1466bfca887.name: replay_carpenterion_intro
c3ecc1466bfca887.doc: Replays the Carpenterion intro and fades in.

c401c9f3f7d4c50c.name: place_player_hide_lin
c401c9f3f7d4c50c.doc: Starts an event, puts the player at the valley start, fades in and hides Lin.

c404edaf310ff921.name: apply_message_window_mode
c404edaf310ff921.doc: Sets the message window mode of the given window.

c40c7191f09954ad.name: leave_palace_hall
c40c7191f09954ad.doc: Exit trigger: asks to leave the area and jumps to map g05, or goes to edit mode 177.

c40efe54ef05c310.name: warp_to_s17_event_317
c40efe54ef05c310.doc: Clears the scene, resets flag 317 and loads map s17 with the event script for event 317.

c42633308c1454bf.name: play_event_305_hiding_dell
c42633308c1454bf.doc: Story event 305: hides Dr. Dell's town villager and freezes its AI, plays the scene where Max asks Dr. Dell to come along for a sick girl, then shows the villager again and restores its AI.

c4375f1d7ff6a175.name: setup_palace_hall_map
c4375f1d7ff6a175.doc: On entry plays the garden clue scene when it has not been seen (SAVE_FLAG_GEKKA_VIEW), otherwise places the player depending on the previous map.

c43ec9a4ed6712fb.name: play_toryon_plants_trees_scene
c43ec9a4ed6712fb.doc: Cutscene (event 250 replay): Toryon flies in and plants a tree on each side of Max and Monica, who dodge, then spins into a peace sign. Waits for Cross (pad mask 64) at the end and deletes the scene characters.

c443e57b323943a6.name: play_victory_and_gate_hint
c443e57b323943a6.doc: Plays the victory pose of the current character, and outside the E3 build sets up the Spheda game and shows message 2100. Then shows the hint that the yellow point on the map is the gate and needs a gate key.

c4499e76b211f318.name: warp_to_s06_after_story_108a
c4499e76b211f318.doc: Story 108a program: sets story progress to 3 and warps to map s06, running its story_108a program (11081 = 108*10+1+10000) in s06_1.

c450b14fec3aca15.name: leave_for_edit_mode_10
c450b14fec3aca15.doc: Fades out, pauses monsters, runs play_ridepod_steve_debut_scene, sets story progress to 3 and enters edit mode 10 at entrance 530.

c456a28b961ddbbe.name: retry_wrench_fight
c456a28b961ddbbe.doc: On defeat restarts the wrench fight.

c456bddc76e37b48.name: run_voice_message_auto
c456bddc76e37b48.doc: Plays a voiced message with a speech bubble from speaker toward listener: loads and prepares stream 1, plays it with the voice message handling, then closes the window and stream.

c4578533fb9334ad.name: enter_room_with_run_in_scene
c4578533fb9334ad.doc: Enables the exit, sets the room for the story flags and plays the run-in scene.

c45928e8d4de6479.name: talk_cedric_train_member
c45928e8d4de6479.doc: Talking to Cedric when he is a train member, at the three stations where the story hands him back. If the departure event for the current map is ready (Sindain, Balance Valley or Venicchio, set by event flags and not yet seen) he asks whether to leave and returns 1 if the player agrees, else 0. Otherwise, with Cedric as partner, he gives a caution line (plus a not-ready line until the arrival event for the map has been seen) and the normal NPC talk; without him as partner it opens the party member menu. Returns 0.

c467cf1aded9f735.name: get_chest_se_id
c467cf1aded9f735.doc: Returns the chest-open sound id for the dungeon stage: 110 for stages 0, 1 and 6, 111 for stage 5, 112 for stages 2, 3 and 4.

c48460f68e35a740.name: exit_train_through_right_door
c48460f68e35a740.doc: Event 200. If the right door is open, plays the door sound, fades out, sets counter 15 to 1 and returns to the station map. Otherwise the player shakes their head.

c4905e79e614c988.name: debug_show_ranking_board
c4905e79e614c988.doc: Debug version of the ranking board with placeholder names and times.

c4cba9f1eb86d7a7.name: enter_dungeon_5_if_agreed
c4cba9f1eb86d7a7.doc: If the player agrees, starts dungeon stage 5 at entry 500.

c4e0500e604f8828.name: walk_player_forward_after_fade_in
c4e0500e604f8828.doc: Fades in and walks the player a short way forward, then resets the camera.

c4e3474377d25b23.name: play_nova_driver_fire_then_go_to_s32
c4e3474377d25b23.doc: Plays play_nova_driver_fire_scene and jumps to map s32 (Moon Flower Palace vs Paznos) at event 620. Returns 0.

c4e69f125345dd72.name: play_run_in_from_dungeon
c4e69f125345dd72.doc: Cutscene of the player running in from the dungeon exit across the s02 map, ending with the camera reset.

c50676de69e4abe6.name: celebrate_energy_pack_made
c50676de69e4abe6.doc: Max returns with the finished Energy Pack in a backpack. Cedric congratulates him and tells him to keep looking for building blocks in town.

c51a67b050e63b93.name: play_golems_approach_scene
c51a67b050e63b93.doc: Sets the golem army march seen flag. In the Paznos hall a soldier reports the golems coming, another calls out to Lord Agaris (Galen Agaris, the phorn model), and Galen says to wait and lure them closer. Skippable; loads and removes its own models.

c51f002e1d23418c.name: ask_woman_about_kid
c51f002e1d23418c.doc: Talks to a woman, asking about the red-headed kid, and gets directions. Talking from behind gives a rude remark and returns 0.

c520fc00f80c3631.name: play_sick_child_memory_scene
c520fc00f80c3631.doc: Plays event 307, a memory of Max as a sick child in bed while his mother jokes with him.

c52683c9a8c18403.name: offer_move_to_spheda_ball
c52683c9a8c18403.doc: Asks whether to move the player to the Spheda ball (yes/no, worded for Monica when she is active). On yes it finds the point nearest the ball, moves away from any treasure chest there, places the player facing the ball and resets the camera behind them.

c54a7508ae7df60c.name: play_ixion_plan_scene
c54a7508ae7df60c.doc: Event 448 (sets flag 448). Chap thanks the party for restoring the lab and explains the plan to send them ten thousand years back to Griffon on Ixion, the time-travelling locomotive, and then sends them to Mt. Gundor to recover Paznos.

c5628365dece85ba.name: play_exit_door_scene
c5628365dece85ba.doc: Cutscene for passing through an exit. On upper floors the character lifts and throws a magma rock with a water splash and jumps; on lower floors the character hangs from a rope.

c57181bad342e33a.name: play_time_travel_explanation_and_go_to_kazarov_stonehenge
c57181bad342e33a.doc: Plays Osmond's time travel explanation and jumps to map s11 at entry 599.

c583a001fb415edb.name: use_exit_gate_3
c583a001fb415edb.doc: Handles exit gate 3 of the floor.

c583e36de20dd4d4.name: show_spheda_course_8_score
c583e36de20dd4d4.doc: Loads d01f01 stage 8, places Max, sets up Spheda hole 8 and opens the Spheda score view.

c5928991e1aa9534.name: play_griffon_sends_heroes_outside_scene
c5928991e1aa9534.doc: Sets flag 612. Max and Monica ask what happened; Griffon laughs and tells them to go look outside, and they run out of the hall.

c59e82750129cb34.name: on_talk_or_dungeon_start
c59e82750129cb34.doc: Talk handler for the station NPCs: Cedric the train driver can start event 360 and the departure to Veniccio Station (s09), Borneo is the mechanic, Erik the demolitionist and Osmond a waiting NPC.

c5b68aee7474241e.name: talk_to_npc
c5b68aee7474241e.doc: Runs a full NPC talk: starts the talk (turning the NPC and optionally the camera), shows the message mes_no with a bubble between NPC and player, and finishes the talk, restoring the NPC's facing.

c5bcdecf2ae3d763.name: setup_train_car_scene
c5bcdecf2ae3d763.doc: Loads the train car NPCs, resets the camera behind the player and fades in on map start.

c5cfed688bfb9a1e.name: play_hide_and_seek_then_jump_to_g05_550
c5cfed688bfb9a1e.doc: Plays the hide and seek scene and jumps to map g05 at entry 550. Returns 0.

c5d9b1c6cf5fbfc6.name: talk_donny_shop_closed
c5d9b1c6cf5fbfc6.doc: Donny's talk before the first quest is cleared: his shop is closed and the player is sent to his father's shop at the top of the ladder.

c5de040ff4e49949.name: play_gaspard_time_gate_scene
c5de040ff4e49949.doc: Event 50. Monica runs angrily into a room with a statue, a door opens and she finds Gaspard with a collapsed king. A Time Gate opens, Gaspard slips into it and the gate shrinks away. Monica staggers off.

c5e6c46d81a763de.name: talk_need_joined
c5e6c46d81a763de.doc: Need's line once he has joined. Outside chapter 8 he says something about sorting garbage, in chapter 8 he warns about the mine.

c5edace731bdcb3e.name: enable_lapis_point_and_play_music
c5edace731bdcb3e.doc: Clears the monsters, enables the rapis function point and starts music 193.

c5eeac6b70322e76.name: show_victory_message_scene
c5eeac6b70322e76.doc: Fades in and shows the 'victory' message at the bottom of the screen.

c5f1092e2b702b86.name: talk_to_adel
c5f1092e2b702b86.doc: Talk handler for Adel. Picks the line by the active character, quest 0 state, quest 7 and its counter 8 (ask for materials, hand them over, receive the garment).

c5f3d7d4f75afed3.name: ask_enter_or_depart
c5f3d7d4f75afed3.doc: Asks whether to go inside or leave (Spanish text). Cancel returns 0, leave opens the world map move menu with fades and returns 0, going inside returns 1.

c6098d9e5db22c60.name: play_pau_medicine_request_scene
c6098d9e5db22c60.doc: Sets flag 420 and plays event 420: Pau scolds Shingala for following, asks Max and Monica to fetch medicine from the Shigura beach, and they decide Luna Lab could build a device to talk to the sea dragons.

c60cc6e97b7c31d0.name: interact_with_exit
c60cc6e97b7c31d0.doc: Handles an exit: the first time the player must use the required item to open the door (a different one for upper and lower floors). Once open, asks whether to go through, plays the exit scene and moves to the floor chosen by get_next_floor for this exit.

c6150616028e64cf.name: go_through_door_to_moonflower_palace
c6150616028e64cf.doc: If the door was opened (flag 708) it asks and moves to the next dungeon floor (d06). Otherwise says the door is shut tight.

c61bb6670e702d6b.name: run_power_gauge
c61bb6670e702d6b.doc: Spheda golf power gauge. Moves the camera behind the shot, lets the stick set spin, and runs the gauge with the confirm button. The gauge result code scales the power and bends the aim: an excellent press adds 10 percent, mild misses add small random yaw error, big misses cut power to 40 percent and swing the aim far off, and result 4 gives no power. Writes power, yaw, curve and spin back, stores the code in result_code[0] and returns 0; returns 1 when cancelled (button 64, or code 5).

c61ebed472a1aa9c.name: return_to_d02b01_event_12552
c61ebed472a1aa9c.doc: Loads dungeon map d02b01 and runs its event script at entry 12552.

c6218e8006122a3e.name: play_gundorada_restored_scene
c6218e8006122a3e.doc: Plays event 560: Gundorada has been fully restored and Galen has something to give Monica.

c62aebdde828dc71.name: talk_aunt_polly_early
c62aebdde828dc71.doc: Aunt Polly's talk before the first quest is cleared: advice on earning customers' trust in business.

c62f202383ada614.name: talk_donny_to_monica
c62f202383ada614.doc: Donny's talk when Monica is the active character: he says he has hardly seen Max since she arrived and hopes she is not using him.

c630e48b998c7247.name: talk_villager_by_kind
c630e48b998c7247.doc: Calls the generic villager talk when the talked-to character number is below 100 or above 1000; other characters are handled elsewhere.

c634e9f2f541696f.name: play_ixion_completion_and_go_to_s37
c634e9f2f541696f.doc: Plays the Ixion completion scene and jumps to map s37 (Ixion engine room) at entry 500.

c63cdbe8b208d7da.name: fade_out_and_play_event_108
c63cdbe8b208d7da.doc: Fades out and plays the event 108 scene that ends with the boss arena monster placed.

c63d349df5d8320f.name: go_to_lighthouse_georama_edit
c63d349df5d8320f.doc: Fades out, switches the player to Max or Monica as needed, clears monsters, marks the floor info and enters edit mode 62 with program 504.

c6428f33e3b89b5a.name: delete_forest_charas
c6428f33e3b89b5a.doc: Deletes the characters in slots 8 to 12 and 14 to 17.

c647b8f0106ce069.name: talk_olivie_early
c647b8f0106ce069.doc: Olivie's talk before the first quest is cleared or before the tournament flag is set: the Firbit people only grant favours to those more skilled than themselves.

c649946f5c179736.name: load_event_285_charas
c649946f5c179736.doc: Sets up Max and Monica as scene actors, loads the gun item model, effects and the event 285 message file.

c64f3c35cd91a6b9.name: run_game_over_silent
c64f3c35cd91a6b9.doc: Runs the game over sequence with no voice line.

c64fb9e535ca2105.name: setup_station_arrival
c64fb9e535ca2105.doc: Chooses how the station map starts: the embers scene when flag 452 is set and 500 not, running in from the path, placing the player after a train ride, or the train arrival cutscene. Chapters 6 and 7 use the late arrival.

c65849c340a7b415.name: talk_blinkhorn_early
c65849c340a7b415.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk before the first quest is cleared: he complains that the town is too peaceful to give him any work.

c658dcad8a9ced9c.name: warp_to_gaspard_boss_fight
c658dcad8a9ced9c.doc: Clears the scene and loads dungeon map d03b02 with the Gaspard and fire boss event script.

c65cfc627d779083.name: play_gaspard_departure_scene
c65cfc627d779083.doc: Short scene of Gaspard and Jaming on the battleship with the camera orbiting while the ship turns away. Fades out and cleans up through end_departure_scene_return.

c68e2c9b84de9077.name: show_three_item_counts
c68e2c9b84de9077.doc: Shows message 9 listing three items with a count for each. Returns 1.

c6a06d57e9a6913a.name: jump_player_forward
c6a06d57e9a6913a.doc: Places Max at the origin and makes him jump 40 units forward.

c6a2296d90aceb7a.name: fade_status_bar
c6a2296d90aceb7a.doc: Fades the status bar out (fade_in_value 0) or in (nonzero) one step per frame over the given frames.

c6b276bec2e441f9.name: play_gate_activation_enter_d06e01
c6b276bec2e441f9.doc: Plays the time gate activation scene, then loads the d06e01 dungeon at event 506.

c6d0773c6e1aadf1.name: start_nova_cannon_event
c6d0773c6e1aadf1.doc: Sets up the map characters, gives the Nova Cannon (item 154) and plays the Nova Cannon scene.

c6d4e1eebb8da2f2.name: play_room_4_monster_intro_scene
c6d4e1eebb8da2f2.doc: Intro for the fourth room: monster e40e (sound EN_289) falls in under title card 4, then the scene fades out.

c6e5b52249c22b60.name: play_condor_time_distortion_scene
c6e5b52249c22b60.doc: Sets flag 312 and plays event 312: Max and Monica ask Condor about the White Windflower, learn that time distortions are caused by Griffon and are shown a distortion fragment (the Sphere) that must be hit back with a stick. Starts the Spheda tutorial.

c6ffcc8cd597a1a8.name: play_departure_call_scene
c6ffcc8cd597a1a8.doc: Departure scene at the station before the Mt. Gundor trip: Cedric, standing before the train, calls out that they are leaving, then the screen fades out. Sets the departure-seen flag.

c7088003eaadd2cd.name: setup_final_floor
c7088003eaadd2cd.doc: If flag 728 is set, plays the battle intro and sets up the Dark Element fight with its stopwatch. Otherwise just places the player and fades in.

c70e91bff79521a6.name: play_event_512_scene
c70e91bff79521a6.doc: Story 512: plays event 512, a scene with Max, Monica and a fire squall.

c70edaebec33bc73.name: lock_map_movement
c70edaebec33bc73.doc: Sets the no-map-move bit in both branches of the flag 203 and 204 check, so map movement is always locked.

c713dc4b893bc82f.name: load_next_hole
c713dc4b893bc82f.doc: Resets the Spheda camera and loads the event script for the next hole, picked by the current Spheda hole number. Returns 0.

c7260d26f7c142dc.name: run_in_from_channel_gate
c7260d26f7c142dc.doc: Scene where Max runs in from the channel gate side, with foot sounds and a fade in.

c7294509f72c8e56.name: setup_clinic_charas
c7294509f72c8e56.doc: Sets up the clinic: depending on the Lin ill, clinic event and Lao Chao cooking flags it loads Argo as a villager (id 250), places Lin and a bed in the sleeping pose with a pained face, enables or disables the syumai and event_550 function points and hides a wall piece.

c761b01a4a4fc1a9.name: play_village_arrival_without_item_scene
c761b01a4a4fc1a9.doc: Sets flag 436. Max and Monica arrive at Shigura Village, and wonder how they will find the medicine. Skippable. Played when the player lacks item 373.

c76a07f2b5545cf4.name: use_main_floor_gate
c76a07f2b5545cf4.doc: Uses the first exit of the floor.

c76ceed499e4c320.name: play_scene_then_go_to_s66_610
c76ceed499e4c320.doc: Plays play_paznos_cannon_charge_scene (sets flag 640) and jumps to map s66 at event 610.

c775d9d76dc5894c.name: warn_area_is_dangerous
c775d9d76dc5894c.doc: Steps the player back and shows a speech bubble saying it is dangerous beyond here and to take the train.

c78162e76059edb2.name: play_swinging_map_piece_scene
c78162e76059edb2.doc: Scene played after the right item is used: a gate key effect fires and a map piece (way38) swings up 90 degrees, bouncing back and forth three times. The floor is then reloaded.

c78c77d28e989a40.name: clean_up_opening_scene
c78c77d28e989a40.doc: Deletes the characters loaded for the opening scene, stops music and environment sound and skips the next music and sound loads.

c78da5f5b5962a5a.name: warp_to_s06_after_story_104
c78da5f5b5962a5a.doc: Story 104 program: sets story progress to 3 and warps to map s06, running event 500 of the s06c_1 script.

c791685686ed45d3.name: unload_event_256_scene
c791685686ed45d3.doc: Ends event 256: reactivates the player's character, deletes the temporary character and shows the party handles again.

c7a3f39cd098a66b.name: play_event_324_hiding_lao_chao
c7a3f39cd098a66b.doc: Hides Lao Chao, plays event 324 and shows him again.

c7a651cb87634e17.name: init_map_charas
c7a651cb87634e17.doc: Map character setup for the Shingala healing scenes: places Pau and Shigura.

c7ab8b2f0d478860.name: play_griffon_defeat_story
c7ab8b2f0d478860.doc: Plays the Star of Oblivion scene, hides the Atlamillia and loads map s31 event 510.

c7c9b0fdd503a15d.name: play_train_rush_scene
c7c9b0fdd503a15d.doc: Sets flag 600. A train and station part rush toward the camera with a screen wave effect, then the chapter 6 title is shown and progress is set to 8.

c7e3993dd3ab7b51.name: play_andrea_garden_clue_scene
c7e3993dd3ab7b51.doc: Sets flag 700 and plays event 700: Andrea appears in the garden, asks Max and Monica to win back Sirus's memories and says there is a clue in the first room of the castle. Skippable.

c7f4307d5fab27c5.name: load_monica_vs_gaspard_actors
c7f4307d5fab27c5.doc: Loads Monica, Gaspard, the camera model, the sword trail textures and the title caption image for the Monica versus Gaspard sword fight.

c80eeebf80243d64.name: play_shot_engine_start
c80eeebf80243d64.doc: Opening shot: starts the engine motion on the p01_train01 kikan-m0 part, hides characters 33 to 35, plays sound 13 and eases train actor 10 to (-120, 0, -2100) over 60 frames.

c8117a10aabcbbbd.name: play_floor_clear_scene
c8117a10aabcbbbd.doc: Dungeon floor clear event: removes monsters, plays the active character's victory pose, opens the exit door, marks the floor cleared, shows medal messages, announces broken seals (Red, Blue, White) and Spheda sub game hints.

c811d00fef7ff223.name: replay_ocean_breeze_scene
c811d00fef7ff223.doc: Story 400 handler: sets up the station and plays the ocean breeze scene.

c817e94c791722fc.name: play_event_280
c817e94c791722fc.doc: Event 280 at Sindain: Jurak's voice announces he has remembered Griffon while Max and Monica look up, and they ask him to tell what he knows. Sets the seen flag first and can be skipped.

c81f6084f1480380.name: talk_claire_monica
c81f6084f1480380.doc: Claire talks to Monica (Spanish text): asks if she is Max's girlfriend and compliments her unusual hair color.

c82796be685a245f.name: play_time_gate_warp_scene
c82796be685a245f.doc: Time gate warp cutscene. use_red_gate selects the red or blue gate models; show_both_chars shows Max and Monica together instead of Monica alone. The character plays the time warp motion holding the glowing atoramiria model, whose placement depends on the accessory equipped (items 263 to 267), then the screen whites out. Skippable.

c839010c9ce1dcaa.name: play_train_arrival_scene
c839010c9ce1dcaa.doc: Normal version: the train doors open and the player's character runs in and stops at the platform.

c83c5316e3a6c853.name: ask_p3000_battle_branch
c83c5316e3a6c853.doc: Debug menu for the P-3000 boss fight: shows a Japanese note on how it ends and asks which route to jump to. Yes goes to s03 entry 503 (hit the buggy with bombs five times, event 206), No to entry 502 (train HP runs out, event 205).

c85a194fe07d086d.name: play_palace_falls_toward_palm_brinks_scene
c85a194fe07d086d.doc: Sets flag 640. The Moonflower Palace drops out of the sky and Max and Monica realise it is falling toward Palm Brinks.

c85e31d7499f74f6.name: load_event_372_charas
c85e31d7499f74f6.doc: Loads the event 372 sounds, party actors, Baba Crest and the other scene models, two screen images and the message file. a0[0] receives the sound bank; a1 also loads the ten worshippers.

c86b5fe2e8b3d1e8.name: start_station_map
c86b5fe2e8b3d1e8.doc: Sets up the station and places the player. After a memory card load it just places the player; coming from s03 plays the path return; with flag 452 set and 500 clear it plays the Mt. Gundor arrival scene; otherwise it plays the train arrival for the chapter.

c8aaeec0958e2b04.name: start_gaspard_death_story_event
c8aaeec0958e2b04.doc: Story event 536: plays Gaspard's farewell and loads map s49 at program 510.

c8b0ffa285bd71a2.name: play_geostone_lesson_debug
c8b0ffa285bd71a2.doc: Debug entry that plays the Geostone lesson.

c8c76afcfd4211e7.name: on_player_dead
c8c76afcfd4211e7.doc: Chooses a voiced game over line by progress: one of two lines during the second fight, one of two during the first, otherwise a silent game over.

c8d941934ba22058.name: enter_palm_mine
c8d941934ba22058.doc: Only works after flag 800. Asks to enter the dungeon, opens the floor tree map for stage 6 and starts the chosen floor.

c8d94a8acc2fb062.name: play_boss_title_intro_scene
c8d94a8acc2fb062.doc: Boss intro for the s14 fight: the boss (e253e) idles and then attacks while the camera pulls in and the event 628 title card fades in and out.

c8df8f5a1b958298.name: start_sea_dragon_boss_fight
c8df8f5a1b958298.doc: Loads and places monster 612, turns on battle music (BGM 190) and fades in.

c8ec2e672d35b2f1.name: play_beam_escape_scene_then_go_to_s26
c8ec2e672d35b2f1.doc: Plays the scene of Max, Monica and Conda fleeing the Moonflower beam and jumps to map s26 (Carpenterion Outer) entrance 550.

c909027219ebe68d.name: set_party_visible
c909027219ebe68d.doc: Shows or hides the two party character handles and the status bar together, for the Lafrescia room scenes.

c920a2e54d26bb23.name: open_locked_door
c920a2e54d26bb23.doc: Binds the door's key point and, if the door part exists and its handle is visible, opens the door on the minimap, hides its map pieces and disables the key point. Returns 0 when there is no door to open.

c93c3c57006fe951.name: poll_message_input
c93c3c57006fe951.doc: Reads one frame of message input. Returns 0 while nothing happens, 1 when confirm or cancel ends a finished message, and 2 or 3 when the optional extra button (1 for Square, 2 for Select) ends it. Pressing on a page waiting for input turns the page; pressing during text printing skips the printing. Also toggles the lip sync when no voice is playing.

c953ba6b72f87c2b.name: play_voice_message_for
c953ba6b72f87c2b.doc: Opens a voice stream, shows its message in window 0, plays it with lip sync and closes it after the stream ends or the frame limit.

c95d61a6c58cdd07.name: reset_party_to_max_only
c95d61a6c58cdd07.doc: Fades out, clears monsters, switches to Max, returns Monica's items, disables switching to party members 1 and 3, runs play_airship_confrontation_scene, unlocks map moves and re-enables the dungeon entrance function points.

c96f0185cccb9606.name: debug_play_village_arrival_scene
c96f0185cccb9606.doc: Debug entry that plays the Shigura Village arrival scene (event 432) by calling play_village_arrival_with_item_scene.

c972a70c2b61b8d4.name: choose_prerace_tank
c972a70c2b61b8d4.doc: Lets the player pick one of six preparation tanks for the next heat. Cancelling at the first heat just backs out; cancelling later asks for confirmation and retires from the race. Then it announces the heat's qualifying rule and leaves for the race map i03h05. Returns -1 if no tank was chosen.

c983a58ab25f5536.name: play_eina_farewell_and_jump_to_s30
c983a58ab25f5536.doc: Plays the Eina farewell scene then jumps to map s30 at entry 605.

c9c7ea438075aea2.name: is_any_scene_pending
c9c7ea438075aea2.doc: Returns 1 if either the analysis scene or the town completion scene is pending.

c9cc8c4ace059a80.name: take_gate_exit_1
c9cc8c4ace059a80.doc: Gate 1 handler: interacts with the second exit.

c9cef80ef102d2c0.name: talk_aunt_polly_early
c9cef80ef102d2c0.doc: Aunt Polly's talk before the first quest is cleared: advice on earning customers' trust in business.

c9e6482fe5db59de.name: talk_blinkhorn_early
c9e6482fe5db59de.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk before the first quest is cleared: he complains that the town is too peaceful to give him any work.

c9e6618ebf22c25a.name: pick_up_geostone
c9e6618ebf22c25a.doc: Picks up a geostone in the dungeon. Ridepod characters (slots 2 and 3) only get a message. Max and Monica set the picked up flag and play a pose with the stone. Returns 0 for the Ridepod.

c9eea764e3f83c41.name: place_player_at_default_arrival
c9eea764e3f83c41.doc: Places the player at (200, 0, -20.8), the default arrival spot.

c9f62500dce5471a.name: start_jaming_and_shingala_fight
c9f62500dce5471a.doc: Sets both characters to 80 max HP and 22 defence, tops item 270 up to 20, equips a fixed loadout, then starts the Jaming and Shingala boss event on map d04b01.

ca01be4398afd49b.name: talk_to_palm_brinks_villager
ca01be4398afd49b.doc: Main talk handler for the town's villagers, dispatching on the NPC id: recruitable villagers (Ferdinand, Stewart, Adel, Aunt Polly, Milane, Gerald, Need, Corinne and others), shopkeepers, and plain chatter that changes in chapter 8.

ca055ecf7b21bb8b.name: start_crest_sage_dream_scene
ca055ecf7b21bb8b.doc: Story 336: fades out and plays the Crest sage dream scene.

ca06d0a580377719.name: setup_floor_start_with_monsters
ca06d0a580377719.doc: Floor start: starts the music, and while the two treasure bits of counter 17 are not both set places the monsters and plays the caption once (tracked in bit 2 of counter 20). Places the player and fades in.

ca0fe435af329b23.name: show_chapter_8_villager_line
ca0fe435af329b23.doc: Shows the chapter 8 idle line of the party member whose NPC id is party_chara in the given message window. Used by the party member menu instead of the normal message number.

ca1728f142e6420b.name: choose_floor_from_dungeon_map
ca1728f142e6420b.doc: Plays the dungeon music, opens the floor selection map, stores the chosen floor and starts it.

ca1ac256297fddc8.name: poll_voiced_message_input
ca1ac256297fddc8.doc: Per-frame message input with voice: confirm or cancel advances pages and ends the message, and if a1 is set the square button skips (returns 2). Returns 1 when the final page is dismissed, 0 otherwise.

ca29ba85cc3f7be2.name: talk_to_seated_stargazer_trigger
ca29ba85cc3f7be2.doc: Talk trigger 1: with the ticket, the seated NPC admires the stars; without it, sets flag 2 and asks about the red-headed kid.

ca2e6d497821907d.name: load_station_villager
ca2e6d497821907d.doc: Loads Osmond (model p00_31a) as the station villager at a fixed spot facing back, with character id 301.

ca40f8192b5c3985.name: ask_to_board_train
ca40f8192b5c3985.doc: Asks whether to board the train and sets counter 1 to 4. Jumps to the locomotive (s08), the carriage (s07), or the Ixion maps (s37, s38) in chapters 6 and 7.

ca432779cbdebc69.name: play_battle_wrench_get_scene
ca432779cbdebc69.doc: Scene after the fight: Max holds up the wrench and a message says the Wrench became the Battle Wrench.

ca514e36ea7c1940.name: show_map_hint_message
ca514e36ea7c1940.doc: Shows a hint at the bottom of the screen (message 1050, or 1051 when a story event is ready, plus 10 when a1 is set). Skipped from chapter 8 on; with a0 set it shows nothing unless an event is ready.

ca66692b68681ae2.name: fade_osmond_report_to_s32
ca66692b68681ae2.doc: Fades out, unlocks map movement, sets flag 616, plays the Osmond report scene and jumps to map s32 at event 500.

ca6c82671e26e7f3.name: board_train_by_car
ca6c82671e26e7f3.doc: Asks whether to board; sets counter 1 to 8 and jumps to Ixion's engine room (s37) or guest room (s38) depending on the door used.

ca6e7ca0e72f7e68.name: setup_lao_chao_restaurant
ca6e7ca0e72f7e68.doc: Map setup: if flag 364 is set and flag 320 is not, plays the Lao Chao request scene; otherwise enables the "syumai" counter when the player holds item 363 and has not finished flag 324. Then resets the camera.

ca79768895ef7060.name: play_monica_arrives_scene
ca79768895ef7060.doc: Sets flag 804 and plays the scene in the Palm Brinks mine where Monica appears in a flash of light, explains she used a Starglass from Crest to travel to this time, and offers to help look for Zelmite for the Blackstone Railroad. Skippable; restores the mine's default BGM afterwards.

ca79c5f78695fa3f.name: play_circus_crowd_walk_scene
ca79c5f78695fa3f.doc: Night scene in the circus grounds: crowd characters stand and walk about while the player's character runs forward and the screen fades out; then the player is placed and control returns.

ca7b0a7b3f788117.name: handle_trapped_chest
ca7b0a7b3f788117.doc: Handles the trapped-chest prompt: the player picks one of three guesses at the trap type, or gives up. A correct guess shows the disarmed message and the chest opens. A wrong guess sets off an actual trap: poison (bit 8), an explosion that destroys the chest (bit 16) or heavy weapon damage (bit 32). Returns 1 when the player gave up or the chest is spent, else 0.

ca864798712e07e6.name: setup_palace_gate_map
ca864798712e07e6.doc: Blocks map movement and places the player at the gate; when the game was loaded from a memory card it also restarts BGM 166.

ca98f28dcf0adc98.name: play_grief_scene_then_load_d06b01
ca98f28dcf0adc98.doc: Plays the grief scene then loads dungeon floor d06b01 at program 511.

ca9a5c07f423d44b.name: start_story_105c_script
ca9a5c07f423d44b.doc: Story 105c: sets up the house, clears flag 20, shows Steve and loads script i01h01/i01h01b_1.stb as program 10 * 105 + 10003.

ca9e974666cbc1ff.name: talk_to_town_npcs
ca9e974666cbc1ff.doc: Talk or dungeon-start program; it only runs the town's NPC talk handler, which picks lines by story progress (Gaspard, Griffon, the Atelier).

caaaae31b908672d.name: play_rematch_and_enter_dungeon
caaaae31b908672d.doc: Plays the rematch offer. If accepted adds Steve to the party and goes to dungeon 0, floor 4; otherwise sets flag 29 and returns to the house.

cab8f2e560bcc067.name: walk_forward_and_hint_cave
cab8f2e560bcc067.doc: Walks the character a short way ahead with the camera following, then says the crying sound must be investigated, starting with the cave. Used before flag 404 is set.

cabbd45570d30047.name: warp_to_d07b01_event_816
cabbd45570d30047.doc: Clears the scene and loads dungeon map d07b01 with the event script for event 816.

cac03bb9b40793fd.name: play_debug_sound_test
cac03bb9b40793fd.doc: Debug program: waits for a button, plays sound 8 from sound set 3200, waits for another button.

cac3c752a8072b2d.name: show_lift_bomb_hint
cac3c752a8072b2d.doc: Pauses the monsters and the player and shows the hint about holding R1 and pressing the O button to lift the nose bomb.

cac667535f565995.name: talk_to_seated_stargazer
cac667535f565995.doc: With the Circus Ticket, the seated NPC (slot 9) comments on the starry sky. Talking from behind gives a rude remark and returns 0.

caeb46fc8ca0e835.name: play_defeat_story_and_load_s44
caeb46fc8ca0e835.doc: Plays the stab scene and loads map s44 with its script 510.

caff85bc606b1173.name: play_palace_approach_scene
caff85bc606b1173.doc: Sets flag 604 and plays the scene where Max and Monica walk up to the palace gates talking about Emperor Griffon, and are invited in as the gates open. Skippable.

cb111823ab15dd8b.name: on_talk_or_dungeon_start
cb111823ab15dd8b.doc: Dispatches talking by the NPC slot: the ticket guard (8), the townspeople (10 to 18). Without a ticket, talking to slot 10 records flag 3, and slot 11 loads the m06b program 154 scene once flags 2 and 3 are both set.

cb2e2cab19e8fde2.name: set_georama_stage_3_enter_map
cb2e2cab19e8fde2.doc: Georama analysis flags for area 3: 0-10 on. Sets flags 548 and 552 on, 556 off and jumps to map 102.

cb33e1b069bd3bd2.name: play_event_700_then_g05
cb33e1b069bd3bd2.doc: Story 700: plays event 700 (the garden scene), then jumps to map g05 as program 500 without reloading music.

cb360ce7e9cea82c.name: start_event_105a_script
cb360ce7e9cea82c.doc: Program 500: hides the memo item, disables the e108c trigger and loads script i01h01/i01h01b_1.stb as program 500.

cb4077070e668877.name: restart_outside_train_scene_window
cb4077070e668877.doc: Event 209. Does nothing when flag 203 (world explained) is set and flag 204 (train fight scene) is not; otherwise requests an edit-mode restart.

cb532748463f072f.name: take_gate_exit_3
cb532748463f072f.doc: Gate 3 handler: interacts with the fourth exit.

cb5c08ffcc1e5b79.name: enter_f03i04_entrance_2
cb5c08ffcc1e5b79.doc: Event 401: turns to face north-east, fades out, sets map counter 2 to 2 and jumps to map f03i04.

cb6271733a5ac9b3.name: talk_gerald_to_monica
cb6271733a5ac9b3.doc: Gerald's talk when Monica is the active character, asking if she is a friend of Max. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about helping Need and Cedric rebuild the world.

cbbd0679b85ac94a.name: play_train_pass_by_scene
cbbd0679b85ac94a.doc: Train pass-by shot: the train car actors turn, the headlight flashes, the train accelerates away with sounds 15 and 16 while the camera cuts between three views and fades out.

cbc07f01702ba7b2.name: ask_to_leave_palace_hall
cbc07f01702ba7b2.doc: Asks whether to leave the hall, unless a non-hero character is active and speaks instead. Returns 1 after a fade out if yes.

cbcde38e87754a92.name: play_beam_charge_then_go_to_stonehenge
cbcde38e87754a92.doc: Plays the beam charge scene and jumps to map s66 (Kazarov Stonehenge). Returns 0.

cbd5334246ae2145.name: play_get_lapis_scene
cbd5334246ae2145.doc: Sets flag 636. The player picks up the Lapis (item 368) with the item-get glow and a short reaction, then control returns with the item limit menu.

cbeef6c80d146e89.name: talk_donny_coins
cbeef6c80d146e89.doc: Donny's coin talk. Monica gets her own talk. Otherwise, if the player lacks the Dark Coin or the Indestructible Coin, he explains about the coins. With both he asks for them: yes removes the coins, Donny joins the party and quest 2 is marked cleared; no leaves him unwilling.

cbf86aabf58a8bbc.name: show_message_at_button3
cbf86aabf58a8bbc.doc: Shows a message at the given position and waits for input with the third button check on, then closes it. Writes whether the extra button was pressed to extra_pressed and returns the frames waited.

cc0abba80baa98d4.name: talk_to_monster
cc0abba80baa98d4.doc: Monster-talk program: reads which monster the player talked to and runs the shared monster talk routine with its id plus 1000.

cc0b1f093253d64f.name: play_monica_arrives_in_mine_scene
cc0b1f093253d64f.doc: Event 804: in the Palm Brinks mine a light appears and Monica arrives using a Starglass. Max says he is looking for Zelmite for the Blackstone Railroad and Monica offers to help. Sets flag 804.

cc1ce8b96edc879f.name: talk_to_town_villager
cc1ce8b96edc879f.doc: Villager talk handler. Valle, Chitral and Lawtin (1012, 1015, 1018) open a shop, the clown (50) blocks the way, and in chapter 1 Borneo, the stationmaster Aswan and his daughter Lucca, and in chapter 8 (Monica's absence, flag 804) Eisen and Geoffrey have special lines. Everyone else says a default greeting.

cc25dce4183182ea.name: play_m06b_event_152
cc25dce4183182ea.doc: Sets counter 5 to 1 and loads the m06b event script at 152.

cc42c24a1e4daa93.name: talk_cedric_at_station
cc42c24a1e4daa93.doc: Talk handler for Cedric at the station (French text). On maps 16, 54 and 83, once the arrival event is seen and the departure not yet, he asks whether to leave and returns 1 if the player picks yes. Otherwise, as party NPC he gives a safety line plus a not-ready line until the arrival flag is set; if he is not the party NPC it opens the party member menu. Returns 0 unless the player chose to leave.

cc4a958efc208898.name: talk_party_cedric
cc4a958efc208898.doc: Talking to Cedric when he is in the party, at the three stations where the story hands him back. If the departure event for the current map is ready (Sindain, Balance Valley or Venicchio, set by event flags and not yet seen) he asks whether to leave and returns 1 if the player agrees, else 0. Otherwise, with Cedric as partner, he gives a caution line (plus a not-ready line until the arrival event for the map has been seen) and the normal NPC talk; without him as partner it opens the party NPC menu. Returns 0.

cc4ebf35bd53cd51.name: play_opening_chapter_2_scene
cc4ebf35bd53cd51.doc: Program 500: sets counter 5 to 0 and plays the chapter 2 opening scene.

cc5e1046c9784e7e.name: press_panel_1_4
cc5e1046c9784e7e.doc: Candle puzzle step for the church candle at row 1, column 4: cuts to a fixed camera, waits 45 frames, toggles that candle and its four neighbours (i01h07_13 pieces), then waits 45 frames.

cc69504ae0d06182.name: play_scene_then_go_to_s30_630
cc69504ae0d06182.doc: Plays play_nova_driver_cannon_scene and jumps to map s30 at event 630.

cc6d8cebb531ec46.name: debug_play_slope_charge_shots
cc6d8cebb531ec46.doc: Waits 30 frames, then plays the three slope charge column shots in turn.

cc7a143579c2191a.name: can_play_event_376
cc7a143579c2191a.doc: Returns 1 when town 1 is complete, event 376 has not been played and the party can switch characters.

cc7a6e0917115ec1.name: play_andrea_calms_sirus_then_enter_d06b01
cc7a6e0917115ec1.doc: Plays the Andrea and Sirus scene, then loads map d06b01 and starts event 512.

cc7e81667634f646.name: play_miracle_dumplings_delivery_scene
cc7e81667634f646.doc: Plays event 328. The party returns to the clinic with the Miracle Dumplings that Lao Chao made and hurries to give them to Lin.

cc7f47c6a3cbc9f6.name: ask_to_go_to_next_floor
cc7f47c6a3cbc9f6.doc: Asks whether to go on to the next floor. On yes the player runs off to the left and the camera fades out (returns 1); on no he walks back a few steps (returns 0).

cc979c9359e63a42.name: show_town_3_npcs_by_analysis
cc979c9359e63a42.doc: Shows or hides town 3 characters by analysis flags: character 401 is active only while flag 403 is set, character 406 is deactivated until flag 400 is set and character 407 until flag 406 is set.

cca73b466bdbcc84.name: start_lapis_map
cca73b466bdbcc84.doc: Places the player. If the Lapis has not been taken (flag 636 clear) it plays the intro, disables the Lapis point, locks map movement and places the Inferno boss monster (613).

ccab0617715636da.name: open_locked_door
ccab0617715636da.doc: Opens a locked door in dungeon 1: the minimap door opens, the door piece slides up with a sound while the camera looks back, and the key point is disabled.

ccbe312331062c7c.name: talk_gordon
ccbe312331062c7c.doc: Picks Gordon's conversation: the early talk until the Geostone plan scene is done, then by quest 0 state the quest offer, the holy water reminder (accepted) or the joined talk (cleared). Returns 0.

ccbf7899498351a3.name: load_event_or_game_over
ccbf7899498351a3.doc: Called when the player falls on the elephant boss map. If the active character is 2 (Steve) and the channel arena is not cleared, sets the Ridepod rescue pending flag and starts event script s06 entry 503; otherwise runs a silent game over.

ccc6321ec92cb374.name: play_heal_shingala_scene
ccc6321ec92cb374.doc: Cutscene mid-fight with Shingala (Shigura boss): Max or Monica heals the injured Shingala with medicine, the healing effect appears and the bird cries out. Sets the seen flag, changes the music and sound set, and is skippable.

ccec9221cb0a505a.name: talk_need
ccec9221cb0a505a.doc: Mayor Need's talk dispatcher. Quest 0 not yet at state 2 gives his early talk; after that quest 12's state picks the quest offer (0), the safe code talk (1) or the joined talk (2). Returns 0.

cd0b2c105869b6d7.name: setup_boss_616_arena
cd0b2c105869b6d7.doc: Plays the winged boss transformation scene (flag 720), then puts the player at (0, 0, -200) with the camera behind, shows the partners and status bar, loads and places Emperor Griffon form 616 at (0, 0, 150) facing the player and fades in.

cd29e6e06c5c0f37.name: talk_to_man_asking_if_anything_wrong
cd29e6e06c5c0f37.doc: A townsman asks if anything is wrong.

cd3f1b506539d7ef.name: open_lift_door
cd3f1b506539d7ef.doc: Opens the lift door in dungeon 7: the three door pieces rise with a sound while the camera looks back, then the closed pieces are swapped for the open ones and the door point is disabled.

cd4c1a97801e9019.name: talk_need_quest_offer
cd4c1a97801e9019.doc: Mayor Need's quest offer: he mutters, lets slip that he forgot the four digit safe code (set to Claire's birthday) and asks for help, then a hint says to work it out from stories about her birthday. Marks quest 12 accepted.

cd4ef9d279fe9c57.name: play_spheda_trial_shot
cd4ef9d279fe9c57.doc: One stroke of the Spheda trial: checks the club, runs the aim and power gauges and simulates the ball with gravity, bounces, water and spin. Ends through finish_shot with 0 if aborted, 1 if holed and 2 if missed.

cd57ac44bfe43e84.name: load_farewell_scene_actors
cd57ac44bfe43e84.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Eina, Tom, Vorneo, Cedric, the Chrono Union ring and the light effects for the farewell scene.

cd59d66f5639184b.name: play_party_jumps_away_shot
cd59d66f5639184b.doc: Shot where Max and Steve (the Ridepod) tremble, then jump up and away to a ledge.

cd5b27d2ec11f81c.name: play_dr_dell_recruit_scene_on_entry
cd5b27d2ec11f81c.doc: Map start: when flag 304 is set and 305 is not, hides the Dr. Dell villager, plays the scene where Max asks Dr. Dell to come help a sick girl, restores the villager and walks outside to map m05.

cd7bfaa802f4d1b6.name: start_buggy_subgame
cd7bfaa802f4d1b6.doc: Places the player on the train roof and starts the buggy subgame.

cd7ee334d93dc7a3.name: play_defeat_scene_and_load_s44
cd7ee334d93dc7a3.doc: Fades out, resets the character, plays the stab scene and loads map s44 with its script 510.

cd89051cb5153d39.name: talk_corinne_found
cd89051cb5153d39.doc: Corinne's hide and seek. The first time Max finds her she says she was found and her counter 11 goes up; she is removed from the town for the next round. The second time she joins via recruit_talk_npc and quest 18 is set to cleared. Returns 0 on the first find.

cdaa922c5d429158.name: warp_to_s06b_1_event_510
cdaa922c5d429158.doc: Fades out, sets flag 6 and starts event 510 in s06b_1.

cdd97824c18737f7.name: press_panel_0_0
cdd97824c18737f7.doc: Candle puzzle step for the church candle at row 0, column 0: cuts to a fixed camera, waits 45 frames, toggles that candle and its four neighbours (i01h07_13 pieces), then waits 45 frames.

cde95f216c9fb3d7.name: play_event_108
cde95f216c9fb3d7.doc: Elephant boss scene: Max and Steve walk in and jump, the boss lands and the elephant trumpets, then the player is switched to Steve with the boss music and monster 601 is placed to start the fight. Sets the elephant-boss flag at the start. Returns 0.

cdf104b94c56e20a.name: trigger_rococo_scene_if_ready
cdf104b94c56e20a.doc: If flag 207 is set and flag 208 is not, plays the Rococo house scene.

cdf40b5f08948579.name: go_to_balance_valley_if_confirmed
cdf40b5f08948579.doc: Asks whether to go to Balance Valley, and jumps to map g02 if confirmed.

cdffc3dda84c1ddc.name: finish_gaspard_chapter
cdffc3dda84c1ddc.doc: Clears the no-map-move bit, plays the Griffon curse scene and goes to edit mode 3 (Heim Rada) at entry 500.

ce11eb365c7d1e7b.name: setup_s39_map_start
ce11eb365c7d1e7b.doc: Map start. Gives item 354 and plays play_galen_gives_fire_horn_scene while flag 524 is clear, gives item 82 and plays play_galen_gives_sword_scene when event 560 can play, otherwise hides the slot 400 character if flag 536 is set and places the player. Returns 0 after a scene.

ce47f7ef7009d6b6.name: go_to_front_car_or_engine_room
ce47f7ef7009d6b6.doc: Front door. From the first car it jumps to the Ixion engine room (s37), otherwise it moves to the previous car and reloads its NPCs.

ce5a86108123c12a.name: preview_opening_town_scene
ce5a86108123c12a.doc: Debug scene: villagers walk and talk in the opening-movie town set at noon while the camera flies along a long path and one character turns around and fixes his hat.

ce6600cb215611f1.name: wait_stream_standby_counted
ce6600cb215611f1.doc: Waits until the stream is no longer busy, prepares it, and waits again. Returns the total frames waited.

ce70f8e167c06569.name: talk_donny_shop_closed
ce70f8e167c06569.doc: Donny's talk before the first quest is cleared: his shop is closed and the player is sent to his father's shop at the top of the ladder.

ce8061f14d752132.name: choose_floor_and_start
ce8061f14d752132.doc: Starts music 15, opens the dungeon floor select menu, stores the chosen floor and previous floor, and starts that floor.

ce8c9bedf79359fb.name: talk_to_contestant
ce8c9bedf79359fb.doc: Talk handler for the fishing contest spectators and entrants. Each contestant says a line about the contest, a few address Max or Monica by name, then the normal NPC conversation follows.

ce8d78e2f2714efa.name: place_player_on_start
ce8d78e2f2714efa.doc: Places Max 320 units back from the origin when the map starts.

ce9263ce7799578c.name: load_gaspard_departure_actors
ce9263ce7799578c.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Gaspard, Jaming and smoke models and the e356 message file for the Gaspard departure scene.

ce99cb9ced13e462.name: talk_rufio_early
ce99cb9ced13e462.doc: Rufio's talk before the first quest is cleared: he wonders why he misses the moon and whether he came from there.

cea16ca9aeb24278.name: play_palace_thrown_aside_scene
cea16ca9aeb24278.doc: Sets flag 640. Max and Monica cheer as Paznos throws the Moonflower Palace aside, and decide to go inside the grounded palace.

ceb1e3e73c724c93.name: open_menu_for_game_object
ceb1e3e73c724c93.doc: Stores the game object number in counter 4 and opens the menu with a fade.

cebe19dbaf6e79e7.name: talk_need_early
cebe19dbaf6e79e7.doc: Mayor Need's talk before his quest: he mutters guesses at the safe code without noticing the player, and a hint says to come back later to help him.

ced90606b332c5c2.name: play_camera_descent_then_run_scene
ced90606b332c5c2.doc: Test scene: the camera descends along a path to Max and Monica, who then run along the road; ends on a pad press.

cefa18d930a14b3f.name: load_lafrescia_light_scene
cefa18d930a14b3f.doc: Loads Max and Monica with the event 255 motions, the sun, light and shadow actors for the Lafrescia flower light scene, the water splash effect script and the event 255 message file.

cf04021784b14249.name: play_get_lapis_scene
cf04021784b14249.doc: Sets flag 624. The character picks up the Lapis (item 365) in a flash of light, shows the item get message and opens the item limit menu if needed.

cf0bb653e1787373.name: show_ridepod_tutorial_messages
cf0bb653e1787373.doc: Places Max and Steve standing and shows four help windows explaining how to get in and out of the Ridepod, fuel it at Cedric's, and raise the core capacity with EXP.

cf101c54d1951b9d.name: ask_to_leave_race_hall
cf101c54d1951b9d.doc: Asks whether to leave the fish race hall, warning that the tournament ends when leaving. Yes goes to map s45 (Palm Brinks Square), or sets the exit flag in extra mode.

cf213349c6a067ae.name: play_fish_race_intro_and_start_race
cf213349c6a067ae.doc: Shows the race title card (qualifier, main or final, or the match race in extra mode) over a camera sweep with race music, then starts the fish race minigame.

cf2a600c6471cb54.name: play_opening_circus_crowd_scene
cf2a600c6471cb54.doc: Opening chapter 8: Max walks through the circus crowd, cannot see over it, climbs a ladder and gasps at the show.

cf32ef230aeda517.name: urge_player_to_bring_photos
cf32ef230aeda517.doc: Cedric tells Max that is all the hints he can give and to bring back good shots.

cf3daf5bf6bb4dbf.name: play_garden_boy_caught_scene
cf3daf5bf6bb4dbf.doc: Event 748 (sets flag 748, BGM 113): a boy caught in the palace garden says he only wanted to look at the flowers. The Queen has him released, makes him the gardener of the flower bed and names him Sirus.

cf5d6b47504c4c9b.name: play_shot_elephant_lands
cf5d6b47504c4c9b.doc: Scene shot: music starts, the party stands and the elephant lands with a camera shake.

cf73dd854c85f635.name: play_griffon_servants_talk_scene
cf73dd854c85f635.doc: Only calls play_crest_time_travel_scene, the scene discussing how Griffon's servants chose the darkness and that Griffon must be stopped in his own time.

cf77dfca399dd0cc.name: run_spheda_swing_gauge
cf77dfca399dd0cc.doc: Runs the swing gauge: the player moves the spin mark and presses to stop the gauge. Scales the shot power and nudges the aim yaw by how far off the gauge result was. Returns 1 when cancelled, 0 after a swing.

cf9b9f72e1c593ce.name: start_s19_story_event
cf9b9f72e1c593ce.doc: Map entry. With flag 400 set, plays the mural scene then edit mode 75 first; then the Electric Fish plan scene if the fish is held, or the retreat scene and the d04 dungeon if not. Otherwise plays the plain gate walk-in scene.

cfa83e7cdc7e1408.name: talk_rufio_after_joining
cfa83e7cdc7e1408.doc: Rufio's chatter after the moon photo quest is cleared, thanking the player. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about the Blackstone Railroad.

cfb1c926bfd3b538.name: setup_flotsam_room_on_map_start
cfb1c926bfd3b538.doc: Sets up the room sound and, if flag 808 is not set, plays the intro scene, locks map movement and places Metal Flotsam. Then fades in.

cfb3b336f633b051.name: play_potato_pie_scene_only
cfb3b336f633b051.doc: Plays the potato pie scene without moving to another map.

cfc117a3dff2a3ca.name: place_shot_camera
cfc117a3dff2a3ca.doc: Places the Spheda shot camera 100 units behind the player along yaw and 25 above, looking at the player, then hands control to the control camera with its range limits.

cfc54e324240c3c9.name: place_quest_18_villager
cfc54e324240c3c9.doc: If quest 0 is in state 2 and quest 18 has not started, places the villager Corinne in slot 28 at her fixed spot. Returns 0 otherwise.

cfe905d08044cf65.name: finish_party_chara_talk
cfe905d08044cf65.doc: Ends a party character talk at the station: clears the eye-view parts, closes the name window (fixed_chara) or restores the NPC-name preset, finishes the event, and for a non-fixed NPC puts the train NPC back from its local counter.

cfee55f7d0e1de29.name: play_farewell_scene
cfee55f7d0e1de29.doc: Sets flag 736. At night Max says goodbye to Monica and her mother-in-spirit Elena says farewell; the party members vanish in light and the Chrono Union closes. Tom, Vorneo and Cedric then say it was all a long dream and that there was always one moon.

d01206d5ae908bc9.name: ask_door_guardian_password
d01206d5ae908bc9.doc: Event 712 variant: the guardian asks for the master's true name using the name entry menu, answer San. If right sets flag 58, opens the doors and returns 1. Otherwise dismisses the player with a white fade.

d012a063c9d0f9d7.name: start_s70_map
d012a063c9d0f9d7.doc: Locks map movement and places the player. After loading from a memory card it restarts BGM 166 and uses a starting spot at x=50, otherwise a spot at x=0. The camera is reset behind the player and the screen fades in.

d021a2af3c03c9a5.name: fade_and_play_farewell_scene
d021a2af3c03c9a5.doc: Fades out, plays the farewell scene and jumps to Maximilian's Room i04h01 at entry 530.

d023f79f1e0bf962.name: setup_map_without_party_changes
d023f79f1e0bf962.doc: Setup program: stops the music, pauses weapon drawing, hides two party characters, blocks switching to characters 2 and 3 and disables map movement. Before progress 10 it enables doors 01 and 02 when flag 58 is set; later it disables the e712 trigger.

d02671a4d65f8965.name: play_railroad_reopen_then_go_to_station
d02671a4d65f8965.doc: Plays the railroad reopen scene and jumps to the Station (i02h01), keeping the music.

d03246eb117e6433.name: restore_time_and_play_gaspard_defeat_scenes
d03246eb117e6433.doc: Program 504 after the Gaspard boss: blacks out, stops the music, restores the time of day saved before the fight, plays the lighthouse shelling and Crest farewell scenes and returns to d03b01 entry 503.

d0379d7fa92a8722.name: play_long_camera_flyover_shot
d0379d7fa92a8722.doc: Noon shot with the player hidden. The camera glides 400 frames from far south of the map to far north, rising and tilting up, with the battleship hidden.

d044ab6d59a07aba.name: play_event_736_letter_scene
d044ab6d59a07aba.doc: Debug test program: plays the event 736 letter scene.

d05ef3c71d5041d7.name: exit_to_f03_entrance_4
d05ef3c71d5041d7.doc: Turns and fades out, sets counter 2 to 4 and jumps to map f03.

d05ff5d8692c9c8e.name: play_palace_intro_scene
d05ff5d8692c9c8e.doc: Plays event e700 (sets flag 700): Max and Monica reach the Moon Flower Palace and a light appears. Alexandra, the ruler of the palace, welcomes them and talks about Sirus and the memories hidden in the garden.

d0672923214985cf.name: wait_scaled_frames
d0672923214985cf.doc: Waits frames scaled from 60 to 50 frames per second.

d088518aced1e23f.name: run_boss_game_over
d088518aced1e23f.doc: Game over handler: if the boss fight started (flag 440) but was not won (flag 444), plays a voiced game over with one of two lines, otherwise a silent one.

d0919edbcd959575.name: play_paznos_beam_blocked_scene
d0919edbcd959575.doc: Sets flag 640. Paznos fires a Moonflower beam that bursts at the end of its flight and a barrier rises in front of Max and Monica's target, then the scene fades out.

d09b919eaf8f1ec8.name: play_gaspard_defeat_scenes
d09b919eaf8f1ec8.doc: After the boss is beaten: stops the music, plays the battleship shelling scene and the farewell scene, then returns to d03b01.

d0a596f7f3b12b8d.name: start_monica_arrives_story_event
d0a596f7f3b12b8d.doc: Story event 804: plays the Monica arrival scene.

d0c97134afd2c49c.name: play_shingala_freed_scene
d0c97134afd2c49c.doc: Sets flag 420. The Electric Fish shuts off the device on Shingala head and he collapses. Pau runs to him, Max and Monica say it worked and decide to take him back to the water. Skippable.

d0d109cfd6005fce.name: end_event_280_to_s26
d0d109cfd6005fce.doc: Unloads the event 280 scene characters (using globals 6 and 7) and jumps to map s26 at event 700.

d0d61b57adf1cf54.name: restart_dark_genie_fight
d0d61b57adf1cf54.doc: Runs the Dark Genie fight setup again.

d0e157e0fdb2ffdf.name: start_lao_chao_request_story_event
d0e157e0fdb2ffdf.doc: Story event 320: plays the request scene.

d0fc183c9fb94303.name: play_stream_with_machine_noise
d0fc183c9fb94303.doc: Loads voice stream a0, shows message a0 and runs it with the machine noise sound effects from bank a1, then closes the stream.

d0fd55d1fc842f76.name: step_through_camera_positions
d0fd55d1fc842f76.doc: Test routine that waits for a confirm press, then jumps the camera to a series of fixed viewpoints one by one.

d1071903bc04ef39.name: go_to_heim_rada_stop_if_confirmed
d1071903bc04ef39.doc: Asks about leaving and jumps to map s10 (Heim Rada Stop) if confirmed.

d107dba1d9488019.name: enter_interior_f03i0303
d107dba1d9488019.doc: Turns the player, fades out and jumps to map f03i0303.

d111a3062ccc32b8.name: play_dawn_camera_pan
d111a3062ccc32b8.doc: Dawn shot: with a fixed camera advances the time of day from 6.5 to 6.8 (0.004 per frame), then flies the camera along a 250-frame path that fades out over 60 frames after a 190-frame delay. Returns 0.

d14c0c5c58906d6e.name: play_mother_farewell_then_enter_d05b01
d14c0c5c58906d6e.doc: Plays the farewell flashback and loads dungeon map d05b01 at event 561.

d1519bfb645c78eb.name: load_six_town_characters
d1519bfb645c78eb.doc: Loads six NPC models (p03_37a, 38a, 39a, 20a, 22a, 24a), activates them and sets them up as actors 5 to 10.

d16a201ef58b68e2.name: get_analyze_401
d16a201ef58b68e2.doc: Returns the analysis flag for analysis entry 401.

d171bc7724d5ec4a.name: remove_event_205_actors
d171bc7724d5ec4a.doc: Deletes the event 205 scene characters and shows Max.

d175cbe9b3dbf92c.name: play_golem_army_march_scene
d175cbe9b3dbf92c.doc: Event 540: a hundred golems are placed in ten rows at night and then all march toward the camera over the p03_s55 map part. Sets flag 540.

d1876d7b40c76cf4.name: play_firbits_return_deal_scene
d1876d7b40c76cf4.doc: Sets flag 250. The seven Firbits are back in their house and Conda asks Max and Monica to find Holly in exchange for their help, mentioning the Rainbow Butterfly. They agree and the Firbits cheer, then the scene fades out.

d18b61031c12ee96.name: hold_camera_until_button
d18b61031c12ee96.doc: Aims the camera at (-33, 3.9, 763.5) and waits for a pad button.

d1a3ec4d4bf32a64.name: replay_event_548_enter_map_102
d1a3ec4d4bf32a64.doc: Georama analysis flags for area 3: 0-2 on, 3-9 off. Sets flag 548 off, 552 and 556 on, plays event 548 and jumps to map 102.

d1b100f8d455827b.name: load_lafrescia_explosion_scene
d1b100f8d455827b.doc: Loads Max and Monica with the event 255 motions (the one who is not the active character is loaded as a party member), the flower seed and explosion actors, and the water splash effect script.

d1b449f8c1339c44.name: play_lao_chao_bistro_found_scene
d1b449f8c1339c44.doc: Sets flag 364. Max and Monica look around angrily, spot Lao Chao Bistro, run to it and say it smells good. Skippable.

d1bea5c54be6d5e4.name: talk_bruno_quest_offer
d1bea5c54be6d5e4.doc: Priest Bruno's quest offer: he sets a candle puzzle in which toggling one candle also toggles its neighbours, and promises to join if all are put out. Hints say leaving and re-entering the church resets the candles. Marks quest 13 accepted.

d1c20affc4d6d976.name: play_event_203_scene
d1c20affc4d6d976.doc: Places the train crew as villagers and plays the world explained scene with the train sounds.

d1d999f9e2799f49.name: switch_player_to_steve
d1d999f9e2799f49.doc: Switches the player to Steve the Ridepod at the position the current character stood.

d1dc1cfdbdb8783d.name: talk_party_erik
d1dc1cfdbdb8783d.doc: Talking to Erik at a station. If Erik is the partner he gives a demolition quip and, in chapters 2, 3 and 4 before the chapter's story event, an extra line, then the normal NPC talk. Otherwise it opens the party NPC menu for him with mode 3. Returns 0.

d1e0cb2f2d7035a3.name: play_victory_crowd_front_scene
d1e0cb2f2d7035a3.doc: Event 824 variant showing a row of ten villagers standing in the square. Sets flag 824.

d1ea05af2c7743a0.name: consume_stroke
d1ea05af2c7743a0.doc: Uses up one stroke. When none are left it deletes the four ball and pin characters, stops the Spheda game and plays sound 19 unless se_bank is -1.

d1f4f33296d4b0f6.name: dispatch_villager_talk_by_chara_no
d1f4f33296d4b0f6.doc: Reads the talked-to character number and slot. Numbers up to 34 go to talk_town_villager with the slot and player, any other number goes to talk_villager_by_kind.

d2106eec6b12121b.name: start_dark_element_fight
d2106eec6b12121b.doc: Debug warp: applies the same stats and gear as apply_debug_loadout (240 max HP, 94 defence, 20 Premium Chicken, Grade Zero, Steal Gun, Atlamillia Sword, Goddess Brassard) and starts the dark element boss event on map d06b03.

d21563766d1e18f2.name: turn_and_speak_with_npc
d21563766d1e18f2.doc: Turns the player and the NPC to face each other, plays the NPC's talk motion (flustered if flagged) for the pending message, then turns the NPC back.

d21ec753f9fde5a4.name: play_ship_flyover_shot
d21ec753f9fde5a4.doc: Max, Monica and Pau run on the spot while the battleship map part flies past overhead along a path over 450 frames with a rocking pitch and the camera follows.

d226daee1a141e9e.name: go_to_heim_rada_if_confirmed
d226daee1a141e9e.doc: Asks whether to leave the station and, if so, jumps to the Heim Rada event map s41 the first time (flag 504 clear) or to Heim Rada g04 after.

d22d99abddcf284a.name: warp_to_inferno_with_gear
d22d99abddcf284a.doc: Debug warp: tops up Premium Chicken, gives and equips Max's Big Bucks Hammer and Soul Breaker, Monica's Claymore and Athena's Armlet, then loads map s16 at the Inferno event.

d232bac308d5bbfb.name: play_toryon_rock_throw_scene
d232bac308d5bbfb.doc: Toryon hovers and throws a series of boulders that hit the ground, then the screen fades out.

d24174dba231b7c2.name: leave_for_veniccio_after_confirm
d24174dba231b7c2.doc: If the player agrees, jumps to map g03 (Veniccio).

d252f9527ab7d4de.name: load_s05b_event_504
d252f9527ab7d4de.doc: Initialises the event and loads event script s05b_1 with event 504.

d25ffba8d1572417.name: talk_ferdinand_after_joining
d25ffba8d1572417.doc: Ferdinand's chatter after the chestnut quest is cleared, promising Max he will never refuse him. Chapter 8 swaps in his dream of being the best chef.

d277e3f2eaa8357d.name: call_do_nothing
d277e3f2eaa8357d.doc: Calls the native that ignores program 500, so the call does nothing.

d2877ad27f860a7b.name: setup_monster_606_room
d2877ad27f860a7b.doc: Sets flag 728, loads and places monster 606, places Max facing it, sets the camera and fades in.

d28b4af3aae73217.name: play_random_crowd_scene_faded
d28b4af3aae73217.doc: Sets flag 824. Fills the plaza with 40 townsfolk copied at random from six models while the camera sweeps over it, fading in; skippable.

d2a0d9286330b1a7.name: press_panel_and_neighbors
d2a0d9286330b1a7.doc: Cuts to the puzzle camera and toggles the panel at the given row and column and the four panels around it, with 45 frame pauses.

d2bd3b7e34d95910.name: ask_to_leave_spheda_area
d2bd3b7e34d95910.doc: Exit trigger. Non-player characters get a message, otherwise it asks whether to leave and returns to the dungeon on yes.

d2be0c6482e10289.name: play_utan_moves_boulder_then_continue
d2be0c6482e10289.doc: Removes the forest characters, plays the scene where Utan moves the boulder, sets counter 3 to 8 and returns to the s05 script.

d2c299eba9a2a128.name: orbit_camera_around_crying_mother
d2c299eba9a2a128.doc: Places two crying figures and slowly orbits the camera target around the room for 700 frames. Not called by any entry point.

d2cec7bac7386903.name: play_shot_fist_pump
d2cec7bac7386903.doc: Opening shot: the inventor Starble gives Max the job and starts explaining inventing, with Max fist-pumping and nodding; effect sounds come from sound_id. Ends with a fade to black over 50 frames.

d2cfab3a88b8ead2.name: heal_shingala_jump_to_s40
d2cfab3a88b8ead2.doc: Sets flags 408 and 420, clears 444, plays the Shingala healing scene and jumps to map s40 at event 500.

d2d9d9e5e59143bb.name: play_party_walk_in_shot
d2d9d9e5e59143bb.doc: Shot of Max and Steve walking into view with a camera move. The sound bank is not used.

d2e012e478f6a5c0.name: press_panel_0_4
d2e012e478f6a5c0.doc: Candle puzzle step for the church candle at row 0, column 4: cuts to a fixed camera, waits 45 frames, toggles that candle and its four neighbours (i01h07_13 pieces), then waits 45 frames.

d2e6057e9a4bba72.name: lower_rock_in_room_3
d2e6057e9a4bba72.doc: Binds map part p11_d06b02-5 and sinks the rock pillar with the player.

d2e6f47ec578e9d1.name: start_dungeon_floor
d2e6f47ec578e9d1.doc: Loads the current floor of the Underground Channel. Special floors go to other maps (floor 0 channel entrance, 4 and 20 to other towns, 7 to the d01b01 boss room, 8 the reservoir, 3 Max's room before the call). Normal floors load d01f01 with its monsters and chests and play the help intro on the first visit.

d2ee3ac226dfc12f.name: load_time_gate_scene_actors
d2ee3ac226dfc12f.doc: Loads Max, Monica, a 2D picture (e250_2d) and the e250 message file for the Time Gate explanation.

d2f03305bc547159.name: start_floor_bgm_by_counter
d2f03305bc547159.doc: Stops the music and loads sound set 8694. Plays BGM 190 unless counter 17 has both bits 4 and 8 set, in which case plays BGM 193.

d2f3989257db7f75.name: talk_mina_before_lesson
d2f3989257db7f75.doc: Mina's two-part talk before the Spheda lesson flag is set: she feels unwell and the doctor found nothing wrong.

d2f7887dc6d3e9f1.name: play_event_700_then_g05_skipping_loads
d2f7887dc6d3e9f1.doc: Program 550: plays event 700 (the garden scene), then jumps to map g05 as program 500 without reloading music or sound.

d2f9d16afd3e1df1.name: play_shelling_and_farewell_scenes
d2f9d16afd3e1df1.doc: Story 356: plays the shelling and Crest farewell scenes and jumps back to d03b01.

d30b09ff3c5c2601.name: talk_parn
d30b09ff3c5c2601.doc: Picks Parn's conversation by quest state: the early talk until quest 0 is done, then by quest 1 status the quest offer, the golden paint reminder (accepted) or the joined talk (done). Returns 0.

d30b76e51dbf9329.name: walk_party_to_train_door
d30b76e51dbf9329.doc: Moves Max and his companion toward the train door while the passengers turn to face them, then the train door handle opens.

d315320a757094ec.name: play_event_304_from_reset
d315320a757094ec.doc: Debug entry: clears flags 304, 306, 324 and 330 and plays event 304.

d34cf48f16999e94.name: show_caption_wait_for_button
d34cf48f16999e94.doc: Plays the caption scene and waits for a button press.

d37b9cd60675baf5.name: setup_floor_for_event_101
d37b9cd60675baf5.doc: Event 101: loads the d02f01 floor with its monsters and chests and plays the arrival scene.

d38fe1e1e9bcc6ad.name: disable_used_event_points_and_walk_in
d38fe1e1e9bcc6ad.doc: Disables used function points and plays the walk-in scene.

d3998c4c00ea79a5.name: ask_to_leave_and_run_out
d3998c4c00ea79a5.doc: Asks the leave-the-area question (item question 3). On yes the player runs out along a path and the screen fades; returns 1. On no he steps back and returns 0.

d3a3fc5a06c6c9ad.name: show_hidden_stone_image
d3a3fc5a06c6c9ad.doc: Shows the third story image and the line that Palm Brinks was spared because of the stone believed to be hidden there.

d3b6d74b85f18002.name: run_map_debug_test
d3b6d74b85f18002.doc: Debug entry that waits for a pad press, shows a message and runs test 0.

d3bfbe489495f62f.name: turn_player_to_yaw
d3bfbe489495f62f.doc: Turns the player to target_yaw with the walk motion, taking longer for bigger turns, then stands. Runs as its own short event.

d3c8ccf90b81c216.name: start_memo_eater_boss
d3c8ccf90b81c216.doc: Fades out, starts boss music and places the Memo Eater (monster 68) with the player.

d3d4d7fa38eaa364.name: play_shingala_healed_scene
d3d4d7fa38eaa364.doc: Sets flag 438 and plays event 438: the remedy heals Shingala and Pau is overjoyed.

d3e9f55fcad1c197.name: can_play_event_270
d3e9f55fcad1c197.doc: Returns 1 when event 270 can play: analysis flag 103 is set, the event has not been seen, and the party can switch characters. Otherwise 0.

d3ec72f5dfc980d4.name: play_rainbow_butterfly_warning_scene
d3ec72f5dfc980d4.doc: Plays event 209 (flag 209): the guide warns about monsters and the legendary Rainbow Butterfly, gives Max grape juice for the Firbit, and casts a magic effect.

d40fdfe38ea5dd31.name: setup_event_336_actors
d40fdfe38ea5dd31.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Lin and other scene actors plus the sprites for event 336, switching a Ride Pod character back first.

d4121c61b8f79cc6.name: give_progress_items
d4121c61b8f79cc6.doc: Gives starting items by story progress: from level 2 items 296 and 388, from level 3 Monica joins the party (can switch characters) with more items, and more copies of 296, 388 and 389 at levels 4 to 7.

d41c23fa1862a62a.name: set_flag_42_and_play_find_tree_expert_scene
d41c23fa1862a62a.doc: Sets flag 42 and plays the find-tree-expert scene.

d424ebb7409773c8.name: compare_angle
d424ebb7409773c8.doc: Wrapper for compare_angles: returns 0 when angle_a and angle_b differ by no more than tolerance (radians), 1 when a is larger and -1 when smaller.

d4381fd9a910fecb.name: play_streamed_voice_message
d4381fd9a910fecb.doc: Plays the streamed voice of a message, shows its text with lip sync and closes the window when done.

d451f4139063fe50.name: load_rock_scene_actors
d451f4139063fe50.doc: Loads the Toryon model and the rock models (with a copy) for the rock throwing scene.

d46f2cb4e67659e1.name: open_door_with_rusted_key
d46f2cb4e67659e1.doc: Locked door: with Donny in the party he opens it, otherwise the player must use the Rusted Key (item 351).

d47cc000c3a6892e.name: feed_dumplings_to_lin
d47cc000c3a6892e.doc: Interaction with Lin's bed: opens the use-item menu for the Miracle Dumplings (364). If used, plays Lin's recovery scene and puts Lin in the party; any other item plays a refusal reaction.

d49b9bd79cc3a30a.name: play_monica_takes_over_after_declined_retry_scene
d49b9bd79cc3a30a.doc: Event 315. Monica demonstrates the shot after the player declines to retry. Sets flag 315.

d4b3470bae0515c8.name: take_gate_exit_0
d4b3470bae0515c8.doc: Gate 0 handler: interacts with the first exit.

d4d1ef7f95d7a97a.name: go_to_i04h01_event_530
d4d1ef7f95d7a97a.doc: Fades out, runs play_farewell_scene and jumps to map i04h01 with event 530.

d4d26709b91d1058.name: play_sky_area_transition_scene
d4d26709b91d1058.doc: Moves the party leader between the main area and the high sky area at height 3200: running scene with fades, a new ambient sound (141 up, 140 down), map light and camera. going_up is 0 when going to the sky area.

d4dd16ede45bf51e.name: show_notice_if_progress_100
d4dd16ede45bf51e.doc: Program 210: at progress 100 shows the notice message and resets the edit event.

d4e04a65f76df303.name: play_key_door_unlock
d4e04a65f76df303.doc: Cutscene of unlocking a key door in dungeon 6: the minimap door opens, the key goes into the lock and turns, the door's pieces change and the lock spins, then the door pieces are hidden and the key point disabled. The camera stays behind the player and is reset at the end.

d4e53649bd48837f.name: play_spiral_rock_vanish_scene
d4e53649bd48837f.doc: Cutscene: the camera turns behind the player while the spiral rock in front of them (map part bound to handle 0) sinks away with a sound effect.

d5038f92d7fb4cdd.name: return_to_heim_rada_blocked
d5038f92d7fb4cdd.doc: Story 522: blocks the georama editor, removes the second party member and warps to Heim Rada (g04).

d50c1f7fd63128ec.name: play_skippable_train_arrival_cutscene
d50c1f7fd63128ec.doc: Skippable version of the train arrival: the train with smoke pulls in, the player runs onto the platform and control returns.

d510da14e68177ec.name: start_memo_eater_fight
d510da14e68177ec.doc: Plays the Crest sage dream scene, locks map moves, shows the map piece, starts boss music (190) and places the Memo Eater (monster 68).

d5250f7af3ba7b45.name: play_master_utan_poison_apple_scene
d5250f7af3ba7b45.doc: Skippable event 230: Max and Monica find Master Utan frozen after eating the Forbidden Fruit, he tells them of the Holy One who lives in the swamp, and they decide to go there. Sets flag 230.

d5260d7fb638c697.name: talk_stewart_to_monica
d5260d7fb638c697.doc: Stewart's talk when Monica is the active character: he says she reminds him of Elena. Chapter 8 swaps in a warning about Zelmite Mine.

d5416702f408e678.name: make_actors_tremble_and_jump_away
d5416702f408e678.doc: Two actors at the same spot tremble for 50 frames, then both jump to a far point while the camera follows. Used in the event 108b scene.

d54196eae26460f5.name: ask_to_enter_moon_flower_palace
d54196eae26460f5.doc: Asks the yes/no exit question and fades out on yes (returns 1).

d55777e8532a35fa.name: talk_aunt_polly_early
d55777e8532a35fa.doc: Aunt Polly's talk before the first quest is cleared: advice on earning customers' trust in business.

d5647863c17501b9.name: play_blue_time_gate_scene
d5647863c17501b9.doc: Time travel cutscene using Monica's Atlamillia and the blue time gate (or the red one when the gate argument is set). The Atlamillia position is adjusted for the equipped head item, then the glare grows and the screen whitens.

d57c0a96e226de9c.name: play_event_108_victory_line
