d57c0a96e226de9c.doc: Shot after the elephant fight: both heroes strike a victory pose and shout a line, then sound effect 0 is stopped.

d590a110cc997bf2.name: play_voice_for_message
d590a110cc997bf2.doc: Plays a voice line from a stream with the message window open and lip sync running for at most the given frames, then closes the window and stream.

d592a3e92e069c9f.name: show_spheda_bonus_score_view
d592a3e92e069c9f.doc: Resets Spheda, loads the d04f01 floor with the mstage3 course, adds the Map and Magic Crystal items, sets up Spheda on hole 3 and places the player at the tee, then opens the Spheda score view.

d59b552479541851.name: walk_player_into_opened_gate
d59b552479541851.doc: Shows the active character jumping to the gate and walking through it, then fading the camera out.

d5adcf0fc6c1694e.name: run_message_choice
d5adcf0fc6c1694e.doc: Runs a choice cursor in a message window: starting at cursor, moves it with the stick or d-pad within choice_count rows, plays cursor sounds, confirms on the confirm button and closes the window. Returns the chosen row, or -1 when cancelled unless no_cancel is set.

d5b0ac3e5a8ef686.name: talk_to_man_praising_palm_brinks
d5b0ac3e5a8ef686.doc: A townsman says Palm Brinks is a nice town.

d5b1d07336169e51.name: ask_question_at
d5b1d07336169e51.doc: Opens message mes_no in window at the given position, runs the choice menu with choice_count options and the cursor on cursor, clears the message slot and returns the chosen index.

d5c1ed66fb74ec1c.name: cut_spider_web_with_slash_branch
d5c1ed66fb74ec1c.doc: The active character turns to the web door and cuts the spider web with the Slash Branch, the nest vanishes and the minimap door opens.

d5ccea77b5293a75.name: ask_to_enter_house_i01h01
d5ccea77b5293a75.doc: Program 500: shows a help window and asks whether to enter interior i01h01; goes there on yes.

d5efba083685a7c3.name: talk_adel_quest_offer
d5efba083685a7c3.doc: Adel's quest offer: she declines because she never finishes anything. A hint says to get her to make clothes again, and quest 7 is marked accepted.

d5f13258fc5d6019.name: play_nova_driver_order_then_go_to_s32
d5f13258fc5d6019.doc: Plays play_nova_driver_order_scene and jumps to map s32 (Moon Flower Palace vs Paznos) at event 610. Returns 0.

d60ec73b3e08700a.name: open_exit_and_play_halloween_defeat
d60ec73b3e08700a.doc: Story program 520 of the d01 boss room: enables the exit door and hides its map piece (except in the trial version), releases the map-move lock, then plays the Halloween collapse cutscene after the boss defeat.

d60fa3e999eb0146.name: ask_to_leave_station
d60fa3e999eb0146.doc: Asks the yes/no question 75 with item 2. On yes Max runs down the exit path, the screen fades and it returns 1; on no he walks a few steps back and it returns 0.

d612f8bd845bd2e3.name: play_welcome_scene_then_go_to_palace
d612f8bd845bd2e3.doc: Plays the palace welcome scene and jumps to map g05 (Moon Flower Palace) at entry 500.

d616663327719582.name: talk_mina_after_joining
d616663327719582.doc: Mina's chatter after the Spheda quest is cleared, asking not to be taken to insect places. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about the Blackstone Railroad.

d6286991ba2989a9.name: debug_play_winged_creature_scene
d6286991ba2989a9.doc: Debug entry that plays the winged creature night scene.

d6376cff79a16acc.name: play_nova_cannon_gift_scene
d6376cff79a16acc.doc: Story event 468. Osmond shows the party his latest invention, the Nova Cannon, and says to attach it to the Ridepod. Sets flag 468.

d64132b1b30ef1ec.name: end_beam_scene_restore_player
d64132b1b30ef1ec.doc: Shows Max, places him at the Moonflower Palace gate, deletes the beam characters and finishes the event.

d644507c2b8e80f5.name: walk_in_from_entrance
d644507c2b8e80f5.doc: The player walks into the map from its entrance.

d649792defae38c3.name: unload_event_250_charas
d649792defae38c3.doc: Tears down the event 250 actors. Keeps the active player's character, deletes the other's scene model and extras, and removes the sprite and image.

d654e89e0d2c64d3.name: play_homecoming_flashback
d654e89e0d2c64d3.doc: Event 536. Gaspard comes home and tells his mother he did not find what she asked, but that he met two odd companions. The scene fades to white with her voice welcoming him home.

d65ce8c6fac35bec.name: talk_to_villager
d65ce8c6fac35bec.doc: Runs the Jurak Mall villager talk handler.

d65ee2a371b832d4.name: talk_to_donny
d65ee2a371b832d4.doc: Conversation with Donny after the arrival scene. Asking what Max will do offers a choice; the leave option plays the gun scene and returns 1, the stay option plays two lines and returns 0.

d66074133ae8ccac.name: play_story_201_with_starter_items
d66074133ae8ccac.doc: Gives the starter items for story progress 2 and plays the story 201 scene.

d66dfbbc2bdae92f.name: test_inferno_intro_scene
d66dfbbc2bdae92f.doc: Debug entry that plays the boss intro.

d6a2cbafbd56052f.name: clear_floor_when_monsters_cleared
d6a2cbafbd56052f.doc: Runs the shared floor-clear handling when every monster on the floor is defeated.

d6a76f837b5e5768.name: play_stream_message
d6a76f837b5e5768.doc: Plays a voiced message: opens stream stream_id, waits until ready, shows the message with that id, plays the stream with the voice message handling and closes the window.

d6a9f0d32b04a145.name: explain_making_energy_pack
d6a9f0d32b04a145.doc: Cedric tells Max to go to Make in the main menu and select the Energy Pack Invention Card to build it.

d6af1d7a1f797dad.name: warp_to_balance_valley
d6af1d7a1f797dad.doc: Plays the blue gate warp and jumps to map g02 (Balance Valley).

d6da8626ececa5a8.name: check_photo_rewards
d6da8626ececa5a8.doc: Checks the photographer's reward state on the shop menu: returns 1 when a reward count is waiting; otherwise shows the 'bring more scoops' reply (state 1) or the explanation of photography levels (state 2) in window, and returns 0. In map 22 the talk uses the NPC's own window, elsewhere a centred one.

d6ed0350c2e73643.name: play_toryon_rocks_to_s71
d6ed0350c2e73643.doc: Plays the Toryon rock throwing scene and jumps to map s71 at event 590.

d6ed0914184dbf2b.name: play_spheda_shot
d6ed0914184dbf2b.doc: Plays a whole Spheda shot: checks the equipped club, lets the player aim and swing, then simulates the ball flying, bouncing and rolling frame by frame with sounds and camera, handling the pin pull and hole-in-one result, then ends the scene.

d6f49cea61118560.name: play_villager_crowd_b_scene
d6f49cea61118560.doc: Sets flag 824. Shows a second crowd of named villagers watching while the camera sweeps over the plaza; skippable.

d70204bf4ee88144.name: show_streamed_voice_message
d70204bf4ee88144.doc: Opens the voice stream for the message, waits until it is ready, shows the text, plays the voice with lip sync until it ends and closes the stream.

d707974920e74ec5.name: replay_train_rush_scene
d707974920e74ec5.doc: Debug entry that plays the train rush scene.

d70cb33895919d31.name: explain_materials_needed
d70cb33895919d31.doc: Cedric explains the materials for the Energy Pack: 20 Scraps of Metal, 1 Thick Hide and 2 Hunks of Copper, from the item shop across the street. Returns 0.

d716c802a45d0f58.name: talk_parn_joined_in_studio
d716c802a45d0f58.doc: Parn's talk in his studio after he has joined: outside chapter 8 Monica hears that girls cannot understand a man chasing his ideals and Max is offered his painting ability; in chapter 8 he muses on how deep painting is. Then talk_to_npc.

d71fe5729ee2c86e.name: play_dead_end_scene
d71fe5729ee2c86e.doc: Event 308. Max and Monica reach a dead end that feels like something should be there. Sets flag 308.

d729ebde3a02571d.name: play_dark_genie_defeat_scene
d729ebde3a02571d.doc: Sets flag 820 and plays the scene after the Dark Genie vanishes: Max and Monica decide to tell Mayor Need about the Zelmite deposit for the Blackstone Railroad.

d73771918933e696.name: play_dr_dell_joins_scene
d73771918933e696.doc: Sets flag 305. Max asks Dr. Dell, who is looking at flowers, to help a sick girl and he agrees. Dr. Dell joins the party and the current partner NPC is marked resident or joined.

d74fd895cab08d42.name: talk_rufio_photo
d74fd895cab08d42.doc: Rufio's photo check: counts photos of subject 193 (the moon). Without one he is disappointed; with one he joins the party and quest 14 is marked cleared.

d7855e01176a4d2a.name: show_help_message
d7855e01176a4d2a.doc: Pauses the dungeon and shows a single help message, waiting for a button press before resuming.

d785bfa66a61e95e.name: play_balance_valley_fields_scene
d785bfa66a61e95e.doc: Cutscene (event 306, sets flag 306): a character explains that Balance Valley has four fields whose height depends on the weight of the buildings placed on them, and that all four must be level for a big building. Shows explanatory images.

d79be3b867ec03a4.name: play_horn_king_farewell_scene
d79be3b867ec03a4.doc: Sets flag 540. The Horn King asks if both are leaving. Max and Monica say they will ride Ixion into the distant past to find Griffon. He asks about Elena, wishes them luck and asks them to bring light back to the world. Skippable.

d7c6f5cf9f9fbe0c.name: setup_bridge_map_parts
d7c6f5cf9f9fbe0c.doc: Binds and rotates or hides the pieces of the two bridge map parts (e01a04) to show the bridge in its current shape.

d7d58b65b1eb8549.name: play_need_victory_speech_scene
d7d58b65b1eb8549.doc: Sets flag 824 and plays event 824 at night: Need gives a speech to the citizens of Palm Brinks about facing hardships together and the victory belonging to everyone. Skippable.

d7de748dae0b2ace.name: play_locked_door_warning_scene
d7de748dae0b2ace.doc: Event 712 (flag 712): a voice says the player has not earned the right to pass through this door and to return when ready.

d7fac5217ea5dfb9.name: show_cedric_opens_door
d7fac5217ea5dfb9.doc: Cedric opens the office door and the camera follows.

d80730c5bef8869d.name: start_gaspard_departure_event
d80730c5bef8869d.doc: Runs the scene where Gaspard's battleship departs.

d82c4a3f388af928.name: use_item_on_lafrescia_pond
d82c4a3f388af928.doc: The pond interaction spot. It describes the pond, then opens the item menu: with flag 23 set it asks for a Sundrop (356) and plays the bloom scene setting flag 24, otherwise it asks for a Lafrescia Seed (361) and plays the seed scene setting flag 23. Other items are refused.

d84181226d5cf048.name: play_flotsam_flees_shot
d84181226d5cf048.doc: Shot where Max and Steve (the Ridepod) look up as an angry Flotsam threatens revenge and flies up and away along a path over 90 frames.

d841db6f6ae2dfc1.name: toggle_panel_cross
d841db6f6ae2dfc1.doc: Panel puzzle step: shows a fixed camera, then toggles the chosen panel and its four neighbours.

d84927bdbdb6900b.name: play_player_leaves_train_scene
d84927bdbdb6900b.doc: If counter 0 is 0 just places the player. Otherwise the train is already at the platform and the player steps out of the car chosen by counter 0 (1, 2 or 3).

d850a207f3ac4378.name: show_cedric_walks_to_desk
d850a207f3ac4378.doc: Cedric walks across the room towards Need.

d872ea5ead822952.name: walk_party_toward_house
d872ea5ead822952.doc: Fades in and walks Max and Monica toward the house over 75 frames.

d87e819e19b871e5.name: use_key_door
d87e819e19b871e5.doc: If Donny is in the party he opens the door with a line of dialogue. Otherwise asks to use the Moon Clock Hand (item 349) and plays the key door scene if it is used.

d897c175a919271e.name: talk_gerald
d897c175a919271e.doc: Picks Gerald's talk: Monica gets her own version; for Max, before quest 0 is done the early line, then by quest 11 status the quest offer, the gun check, or the joined talk. Returns 0.

d8a3bd122781d876.name: play_event_702
d8a3bd122781d876.doc: Event 702 in the palace hall: sets the Gekka view flag, then Max and Monica look around for Griffon and realise that Alexandra's clue means restoring the Palace Garden to match the hall's pictures. Skippable.

d8a97efa64631275.name: check_aim_turn_clear
d8a97efa64631275.doc: Tests whether the player can turn from one aim angle to another at the point (x, y, z) without a wall in the way or a drop-off. Returns 1 when clear, -1 when blocked by a wall and 0 when there is no ground.

d8abb104d2185286.name: play_knock_at_house_scene
d8abb104d2185286.doc: Program 651 and debug test: plays the knocking-at-the-house scene (event 209).

d8b2fe848e6c176c.name: fade_out_then_play_lighthouse_arrival
d8b2fe848e6c176c.doc: Disables event 348 and its map part, fades out and plays the lighthouse arrival scene.

d8cf843d4d5a3090.name: load_e352_scene_characters
d8cf843d4d5a3090.doc: Loads the Max, Monica and Lin models, motions and message file for event e352, setting globals 0 and 1 to the two chara slots.

d8e7857450abdfb1.name: talk_adel_to_monica
d8e7857450abdfb1.doc: Adel's two-part talk to Monica asking her to stop putting Max in danger, with a short prayer for their safety in chapter 8.

d8f5745ac26fd75e.name: load_opening_characters
d8f5745ac26fd75e.doc: Loads the opening-scene characters (Pierrot, villagers, balloon and others) into slots 8 to 18.

d8fbfe350d984e6b.name: play_monica_vs_gaspard_duel_scene
d8fbfe350d984e6b.doc: Short cutscene of Monica and Gaspard crossing swords with scripted camera cuts, sword trails and hit sparks.

d92eecd744543048.name: play_rooftop_night_scene
d92eecd744543048.doc: Runs the m08 night scene: sets the time of day to 24 and plays the rooftop scene with the opening Halloween characters and Donny.

d9399c43af7a8502.name: play_village_walk_in_scene
d9399c43af7a8502.doc: Short scene: the player walks in through the village door while its map part moves. Skippable. Used when no story scene is due.

d93c2144789a356c.name: talk_adel_after_joining
d93c2144789a356c.doc: Adel's chatter after the clothing quest is cleared, asking how the garment fits. Chapter 8 swaps in a prayer for safety.

d952afe42e99d69e.name: play_elephant_falls_and_ridepod_tutorial_scene
d952afe42e99d69e.doc: Event 108a, sets flag 108: the elephant falls, Max strikes a victory pose and Flotsam flees, then the Ridepod tutorial plays and control passes to Steve the Ridepod with the field music.

d974d11196a215e5.name: talk_villager_by_kind
d974d11196a215e5.doc: Calls the generic villager talk when the talked-to character number is below 100 or above 1000; other characters are handled elsewhere.

d9779b461b4e80e7.name: show_item_received_message
d9779b461b4e80e7.doc: Shows a system message about receiving an item with its count after playing sound 18. Kind 0 picks message 14 for a count of 1 and 15 otherwise, kind 1 picks 18. Returns 0 for other kinds.

d97d3f6c2d0f5047.name: play_letter_and_storm_scene_only
d97d3f6c2d0f5047.doc: Plays play_opening_letter_and_storm_scene without jumping to another map.

d98b139340720ca3.name: end_lighthouse_scene_load_dungeon
d98b139340720ca3.doc: Cleans up the actors of the lighthouse attack scene for the active character, restores the handles and status bar, finishes the event and loads dungeon d03b01 with event script 504.

d995830bbd9048f4.name: on_treasure_chest
d995830bbd9048f4.doc: Opens the chest and sets bit 16, 32 or 64 of counter 17 depending on whether it held the Experience Coin, Poison Coin or Dynamite.

d99a80476d4965f9.name: play_gaspard_marionette_scene
d99a80476d4965f9.doc: Sets flag 440. Shigura in the village show red eyes and act strangely. Gaspard appears floating and boasts of his Marionette device that controls them, admits he did the same to Shingala, and has the Shigura toy with Max and Monica. A telop image fades in during his speech. Skippable.

d9aea3ea0d90942f.name: use_east_jump_gate
d9aea3ea0d90942f.doc: Opens the jump gate menu from the east gate.

d9c46ede94b4b3ad.name: start_first_gaspard_fight
d9c46ede94b4b3ad.doc: Trigger event: fades out, plays the ambush scene, then loads monster 512 (the first Gaspard fight) and puts the player in the arena.

d9c939519f7390f0.name: play_outside_world_narration_shot
d9c939519f7390f0.doc: Shot with narration about heading into the outside world, the camera easing across Max and Steve.

d9caf4b6b8a81ecc.name: play_flower_scene_from_story
d9caf4b6b8a81ecc.doc: Hides the party members and plays event 708.

d9cbfb5737862023.name: show_important_book_hint
d9cbfb5737862023.doc: Event program that makes Max remark that there may be an important book here but he cannot tell right now.

d9d82e2c4b4e59f2.name: show_need_finishes_confession
d9d82e2c4b4e59f2.doc: After a fade in, Need says there it is, having told his story.

d9dd4679a5ddc5bd.name: replay_jurak_gun_gift_scene
d9dd4679a5ddc5bd.doc: Plays the Jurak Gun gift scene again and fades in.

d9ea1df38449f52c.name: play_two_monsters_intro_scene
d9ea1df38449f52c.doc: Shows the two monsters facing the camera with a title image, an attack pose each, then fades out.

d9ee9dbe76c6ca71.name: setup_map_objects
d9ee9dbe76c6ca71.doc: Sets up the map objects: hides characters 120 and 121 unless the Veniccio event 404 was seen or debug is on, and shows a restored map part depending on flag 448.

da241e48c8ce5dbe.name: warp_to_s54_event_812
da241e48c8ce5dbe.doc: Clears the scene and loads map s54 with the event script for event 812.

da274f2cf3f78349.name: setup_valley_entry
da274f2cf3f78349.doc: Map setup for Balance Valley: after a memory card load places the player at a fixed spot; otherwise depends on the previous map (dungeon return walk, map 26 spot, event 302 if flag 300 is set and 302 is not, or the default). Ends by showing the event hint if an event is ready.

da420be456a25393.name: talk_rosa_early
da420be456a25393.doc: Rosa's talk before the first quest is cleared: she apologizes for being hard of hearing and asks to be spoken to slowly.

da4284b4ad4a36b3.name: take_fire_gem_and_clear_floor
da4284b4ad4a36b3.doc: Gives the Fire Gem (item 368), marks the floor cleared, plays the Lapis scene and unblocks map movement. Ridepod characters only see a message.

da5c729e71daa6bd.name: play_firbits_scene_then_go_to_s46
da5c729e71daa6bd.doc: Plays the Firbit help scene, fades out and jumps to map s46 entrance 501.

da604d9d0843010a.name: talk_claire_joined
da604d9d0843010a.doc: Claire's talk after she joined: Monica gets her own version; otherwise a plea not to go to dangerous places, or in chapter 8 a remark about the railroad spreading. Then talk_to_npc.

da8e562d9aa4ca89.name: reset_georama_play_event_548
da8e562d9aa4ca89.doc: Georama analysis flags for area 3: 0-2 on, 3-9 off. Sets flag 548 off, 552 and 556 on, then plays event 548.

da9dc70976084809.name: play_crest_is_dead_scene
da9dc70976084809.doc: Sets flag 304. Max and Monica wake Shiroza the owl in Crest's house, ask after Crest and learn he is dead and that his apprentice Lin lies ill. They decide to fetch Dr. Dell from Palm Brinks.

dacd72c737abde46.name: place_player_at_station
dacd72c737abde46.doc: Setup program: initialises map objects and places the player at (-368, 0, -57.9) with the camera behind, then fades in.

dad60a04d840fb40.name: can_play_event_272
dad60a04d840fb40.doc: Returns 1 when Sindain's event 272 can play: analysis flag 103 is set, event 270 has been seen, event 272 has not, and the party can switch to character 1 (Monica). Otherwise 0.

dade5f673e1bb815.name: play_inferno_intro_scene
dade5f673e1bb815.doc: Plays the boss intro: the Inferno monster (e117e) appears in the dark room, idles, attacks and plays, with a caption image fading in and out.

dae427ba01572b45.name: start_floor
dae427ba01572b45.doc: Sets up the chosen floor. Floor 0 returns to Heim Rada, floors 8, 16 and 22 load the maps s16, s20 and d05b01, other floors load d05f01 or d05f02 with monsters and chests and play the matching intro.

db05c265e2aba747.name: play_crest_griffon_lecture_scene_with_helpers
db05c265e2aba747.doc: Same as the Griffon and Luna Lab lecture scene but written with the shared scene-loading helpers. Used by the debug program 160.

db297385bd0c3750.name: ask_to_enter_d07_dungeon
db297385bd0c3750.doc: Transformed forms (2 or 3) get a message that they cannot go. Otherwise asks whether to enter and on yes clears monsters, fades out and loads the d07 dungeon script.

db2b8684e1b678e7.name: record_opened_chest
db2b8684e1b678e7.doc: Opens the chest and sets a bit in counter 17 for what it held: 16 for item 209 (Experience Coin), 32 for item 203 (Poison Coin), 64 for item 173 (Dynamite).

db30af159f3d8c8f.name: talk_parn_joined
db30af159f3d8c8f.doc: Parn's talk after he has joined: outside chapter 8 he offers his painting ability, in chapter 8 he muses about the depth of painting.

db5e6daa3ef2aa87.name: stop_party_standing
db5e6daa3ef2aa87.doc: Snaps Max and Monica to the stand motion and waits 45 frames.

db93dadbdcb7f1a9.name: can_play_event_468
db93dadbdcb7f1a9.doc: Returns 1 when event 468 can play: the second town is complete, the event has not been seen, and the party can switch characters. Otherwise 0.

db9778966b470c50.name: talk_party_borneo
db9778966b470c50.doc: Talk handler for Borneo at the station (Spanish text). When Borneo (party NPC 2) is in the party he says a fixed line plus chapter 3 and 4 lines (chapter 4 only until the Ixion flag is seen), then talk_to_npc; otherwise it opens the party NPC menu. Returns 0.

dbba6132afb3c1ed.name: setup_station_start
dbba6132afb3c1ed.doc: Places the player after a save load, a return from map 77, a return from the train (using counters) or the normal train arrival, and loads the waiting villager.

dbcce4d4092b9b5d.name: show_title_card_then_open_georama
dbcce4d4092b9b5d.doc: Shows the event 356 title card and then enters Georama edit mode for the Balance Valley map.

dbcecd819e9766f6.name: talk_blinkhorn_after_joining
dbcecd819e9766f6.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's chatter after he has joined the party, praising Max's speed. Chapter 8 swaps in an offer of help.

dbd5faf9640766ff.name: play_run_forward_and_fade_out_scene
dbd5faf9640766ff.doc: Short scene where the character runs forward through the gate and the screen fades out, played before moving to the next floor.

dbe4b8f1017a66d6.name: play_train_departure_and_go_to_stonehenge
dbe4b8f1017a66d6.doc: Event 590: plays the train departure scene and jumps to s11 (Kazarov Stonehenge) event 502.

dbe80e673005fff4.name: start_spheda_debug_on_floor
dbe80e673005fff4.doc: Debug entry: cleans up Spheda, loads the d05 floor layout, plays the arrival scene and sets up Spheda.

dbec8a692b6072f0.name: start_spheda_stage_6
dbec8a692b6072f0.doc: Loads the d06f01 Spheda course (mstage6), gives items 305 and 306, sets up Spheda with hole 6, places Max and opens the Spheda score view.

dbfb16092a2aa71d.name: play_event_104_scene
dbfb16092a2aa71d.doc: Program 600: pauses monsters, plays event 104 (Flotsam and the elephant after the fight) and fades in.

dbfb95b208774f07.name: play_monica_victory
dbfb95b208774f07.doc: Victory cutscene for Monica in the golf-hole minigame: plays her victory pose and afterglow with the win sound, flies the camera around her, shows the finish banner sprite (a different image for the Japanese and other languages) and slides it into the corner, then restores music and ends the event. The scene can be skipped.

dc03886a47efc24d.name: talk_to_patri
dc03886a47efc24d.doc: Picks Parn's conversation from the quest states: first meeting, Gold Paint request, hand-in or the joined talk.

dc0d703dc9e2a093.name: play_elder_gift_and_carpenterion_call_scene
dc0d703dc9e2a093.doc: The elder gives Max a stock of Georama materials (Rolling Logs, cloth, glass, sugar cane, scrap metal, fire and water elements) and tells him to press the select button to call the Carpenterion, waiting until he does.

dc139462eb3e32fc.name: run_train_arrival_scene
dc139462eb3e32fc.doc: Debug test program; it only plays the train arrival scene.

dc3267a65b35badd.name: play_osmond_report_to_s32
dc3267a65b35badd.doc: Plays the Osmond report scene and jumps to map s32 at event 500.

dc3d13aea865b41c.name: play_train_pulls_in_scene
dc3d13aea865b41c.doc: Part of event 207: the train rolls into the station with smoke, sparks and a burst of steam.

dc4c10b21ee2d159.name: remove_palace_return_actors
dc4c10b21ee2d159.doc: Restores the active character and deletes the extra scene character of the palace return scene.

dc6bb4e29acb37e6.name: debug_play_beam_escape_scene
dc6bb4e29acb37e6.doc: Plays the scene of Max, Monica and Conda fleeing the Moonflower beam.

dc7bf378b2dc2568.name: wait_for_chara_motion_progress
dc7bf378b2dc2568.doc: Waits until the motion of the character is within tolerance of the given progress. Returns 0 if reached, 1 if max_frames pass first. A tolerance of -1 means 0.01, and max_frames is scaled from 60 to 50 frames per second.

dc9e01fd971498f1.name: play_gaspard_transforms_scene
dc9e01fd971498f1.doc: Sets flag 532. Gaspard reflects on his journey and gives Max his blessing, then opens a time gate that corrupts him: Griffon's voice speaks through him and he grows into a giant. Max and Monica realise they must fight him, and the boss music (35) starts.

dca1a4aa861a49a2.name: ask_to_leave_by_exit_64
dca1a4aa861a49a2.doc: Asks the leave-the-area question for exit 64. On yes the player runs out along a path and the screen fades; returns 1. On no the player steps back with the camera following and returns 0.

dcb2936ae835d3dd.name: wait_message_skip_limited
dcb2936ae835d3dd.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the message in the slot to be closed by the player, then closes message 0. Returns the frames waited.

dcb8e182f23644ab.name: show_debug_test_message
dcb8e182f23644ab.doc: Debug test program: shows a placeholder "kita" message with button-icon tokens and waits for it to be dismissed.

dcbe5cac4eb1d2f0.name: play_shigura_rescue_and_farewell_scene
dcbe5cac4eb1d2f0.doc: Sets flag 444. Gaspard falls after being beaten, the freed Shigura wake, and Gilttoni orders a withdrawal. The Elder thanks Max and Monica, Emperor Griffon and the dark forces are explained, and the Elder gives Pau back. The scene ends with Max and Monica saying goodbye to Shingala and narration about the Lunatic Wisdom Laboratory being completed. Skippable.

dcca0973b2febda0.name: unload_event_332_charas
dcca0973b2febda0.doc: Unloads the characters of event 332: reactivates the active hero (Max or Monica), deletes the other and slots 11 and 13, rebinds and shows handles 2 and 3, restores the status bar and ends the event.

dccedb2a98e4083d.name: play_balance_valley_height_warning_scene
dccedb2a98e4083d.doc: Event 306 (sets flag 306, plays BGM 2): at the start of Starlight Canyon Monica or Max explains that the four fields of Balance Valley change height with the weight of the buildings on them and must all be the same height for a big building.

dcd396c557e3f84a.name: play_sundrop_flower_bloom_scene
dcd396c557e3f84a.doc: Event 255 part 2. Max or Monica throws a Sundrop at the sapling, which blooms in a flash of light and grows into a huge flower with vines. The pair tumble back, look up, and say it is a Lafrescia. Sets flag 255, enables the e256 trigger, and leaves the room in stage 2.

dce0f1bbe52bc00a.name: record_opened_chest
dce0f1bbe52bc00a.doc: Marks in counter 17 which of the two chests (Healing Coin bit 1, Sun Stone bit 2) was opened.

dcfe3c23d2fcbf4b.name: return_to_dungeon_next_floor
dcfe3c23d2fcbf4b.doc: Marks this floor cleared and the next one entered, removes the Spheda actors, restores dungeon controls and music and returns to the d03 dungeon script.

dd0553d28f035150.name: start_dungeon_floor
dd0553d28f035150.doc: Sets up a floor. Certain floor numbers load story maps instead (s52, s54, s61, s62, s63, s69 and the boss map d07b01, and floor 0 returns to Palm Brinks). Any other floor loads the d07f01 map with monsters and chests, and plays the entry scene.

dd0acecdde856f5c.name: setup_circus_scene_and_reload_script
dd0acecdde856f5c.doc: Loads the circus character models, sets up the circus scene and loads the m06 event script.

dd11f9e6e7135921.name: talk_gerald_to_monica
dd11f9e6e7135921.doc: Gerald's talk when Monica is the active character, asking if she is a friend of Max. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about helping Need and Cedric rebuild the world.

dd183ab07c6d864f.name: run_in_from_exit_87
dd183ab07c6d864f.doc: Entry cutscene for exit 87: the player runs in from the map edge and stops, then the camera is reset.

dd2d2df3620fd18e.name: play_board_train_car_scene
dd2d2df3620fd18e.doc: Scene of Max running through the train car door at the station. It binds the car's door map parts for the car id, opens the door, runs to the door and fades out. The camera, stance and footsteps depend on which station map the train is at.

dd44803d0a792428.name: fade_out_jump_to_s66
dd44803d0a792428.doc: Fades out and jumps to map s66 at event 600.

dd4a68f8f766d302.name: leave_station_for_g05
dd4a68f8f766d302.doc: Jumps to map g05 when the player confirms leaving.

dd70d9893868f525.name: play_lighthouse_arrival_scene
dd70d9893868f525.doc: Sets flag 348 and plays event 348: Max, Monica and Lin walk in and look up, with the line about the Lighthouse, then the scene fades out and control returns near the entrance.

dd96490c089368a1.name: send_player_through_gate_alone
dd96490c089368a1.doc: Blocks Georama editing, drops Monica from the party and goes through the blue time gate to Heim Rada (g04).

ddb7b045042e976f.name: play_departure_scene_and_go_to_luna_lab
ddb7b045042e976f.doc: Plays the Ixion departure scene and jumps to map s59 (Luna Lab).

dde41b041506faa1.name: open_party_member_menu
dde41b041506faa1.doc: Talk menu with a train-car NPC (a fixed one for Cedric, Borneo or Erik when mode is 1, 2 or 3): returns 1 at once if they are already the party NPC. Otherwise it puts the camera in front of the NPC and offers: take them along (opens the party select menu, refused while Lin is the party NPC), talk, and per-NPC extras such as repairs, shops, menus or hints. Returns 1 when something was done.

ddef3f2159c7d1cb.name: tally_tournament_and_award_prize
ddef3f2159c7d1cb.doc: Reads the top weight of the tournament, invents four rival weights and shows the ranking list one rank at a time. Then it places Max on the podium for 1st to 3rd or shows him disappointed, gives the prize item for a top-three finish and ends the tournament.

de04a377f948e2eb.name: init_georama_charas
de04a377f948e2eb.doc: Georama map setup: deactivates characters 120 and 121 until event 306 (the clinic) has been seen, unless the debug flag is on, then runs Georama command 2.

de206ed4566ca7b5.name: set_s06_objects_visible
de206ed4566ca7b5.doc: Shows or hides the two s06 map parts s06_02-a0 and s06_03-a0 depending on visible.

de4f5ef28fca8313.name: ask_to_enter_forest
de4f5ef28fca8313.doc: Asks whether to move to the forest (Rainbow Butterfly area). On yes Max runs off and fades out (returns 1); on no he walks back a few steps and it returns 0.

de59e86e3fdf330a.name: spawn_fish_race_hall_villagers
de59e86e3fdf330a.doc: Loads the fish race hall: Max's event motions, the Race Master (slot 24) and the cup, then spawns the hall's villagers, whose models and places depend on the chapter and on extra mode.

de660f6be6b1e4a4.name: use_north_jump_gate
de660f6be6b1e4a4.doc: Opens the jump gate menu from the north gate.

de855db9d5af8265.name: show_need_begins_explaining
de855db9d5af8265.doc: Camera pushes in on Need as he starts to explain what is going on in the town and world.

de87c576ccae4660.name: start_georama_edit_mode_540
de87c576ccae4660.doc: Enters Georama edit mode on map 12 at event 540.

dea6d5b51472b102.name: board_train_by_chapter
dea6d5b51472b102.doc: Asks to board the train, then jumps to the locomotive (s08) or Ixion engine room (s37 in chapters 6 and 7) for the front car, or to the train (s07) or Ixion guest room (s38) for other cars. Returns 0 if declined.

deb74a9897008c53.name: start_paznos_launch_from_story
deb74a9897008c53.doc: Story 540: sets flag 536 and clears 540, loads the villagers and plays the Paznos launch.

debef771130b4a94.name: load_holly_scene_cast
debef771130b4a94.doc: Loads the actors for the Holly scene (event 260): Max and Monica motion sets, Holly, the letter, the seven butterfly models b02a1 to b02a7, light effects, the flashback pictures and the message file.

dec05f0c9ff08f4d.name: warp_to_gaspard_first_fight_with_gear
dec05f0c9ff08f4d.doc: Debug warp: sets both characters to 160 max HP and 50 defence, tops up Premium Chicken to 20 and equips the standard boss weapons, loads boss map d05b01 with BGM 190 and runs its boss_gaspard_2 hook, which restarts the first Gaspard fight (monster 512).

dec6066c6d1bc539.name: show_help_message
dec6066c6d1bc539.doc: Pauses the dungeon and shows a single help message, waiting for a button press before resuming.

dec7c5e1e8bf2c89.name: warp_to_boss_floor_after_story_110
dec7c5e1e8bf2c89.doc: Story 110 program: clears flag 10 and loads the boss floor map d01b01 with its script event 500, skipping the next BGM load.

dedae64abda51f33.name: play_opening_ticket_scene
dedae64abda51f33.doc: Opening ticket scene: Max appears with a ticket and a short voiced exchange about hurrying because it is starting, then the music fades and the screen fades out. Skippable; cleans up its models.

dee27d97daba313a.name: play_need_admits_useless_mayor
dee27d97daba313a.doc: Need admits he is useless as mayor and Cedric says he cannot believe it.

df2c78bb88e63e09.name: play_monica_crystal_gift_scene
df2c78bb88e63e09.doc: Event 212: on the first visit to floor 2 Monica gives Max crystals (2 Hunter, 2 Destruction, 1 Wind, 1 Sea Dragon) and explains how to synthesize them into a weapon, with two help pictures. Adds 6 synthesis points to the wrench, sets flag 212 and places the floor's monsters and chests.

df3a7bb0cce616b3.name: setup_station_parts
df3a7bb0cce616b3.doc: Prints a debug line and shows the late-game station parts.

df4211e36a99cfe3.name: load_event_372_charas
df4211e36a99cfe3.doc: Loads the actors for event 372 in the Starlight Temple: sound set 3511 (its sound bank is written to out_se_bank[0]), Max and Monica, Madame Crest, the star and frame characters and two picture sprites, with ten extra copies of character 35 when add_clones is set. Max and Monica go in the slot of whichever one is not the active character.

df457effebf51a0b.name: setup_osmond_lab_entry
df457effebf51a0b.doc: Map start for Osmond's lab. With flag 400 set and flag 408 clear it plays the sleeping scene (flag 414); with 408 set and 412 clear it gives item 360 and plays the Electric Worm scene; otherwise places the player at the entrance. Returns 0.

df470ca1fb99f5b0.name: talk_blinkhorn_quest_offer
df470ca1fb99f5b0.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's quest offer: he challenges the player to run to the pond boat and back faster than his time of 2:01. Marks quest 9 accepted and asks whether to start the race.

df56d39638362ec2.name: load_station_villagers
df56d39638362ec2.doc: Loads and places the station villagers: Cedric in slot 8, or Osmond during chapters 6 and 7, plus Borneo (slot 9) and Erik (slot 10) until the Heim Rada arrival (flag 500) has been seen.

df5e65a00fe5979a.name: show_item_get_message
df5e65a00fe5979a.doc: Shows the item get message with the system sound: message 10 for one item, message 11 with the count for more. Returns 1, or 0 when count is not above zero.

df664e9839f353c8.name: talk_to_station_npc
df664e9839f353c8.doc: Talk handler. Cedric can start the trip to Veniccio Station (s09), Borneo is the mechanic, Erik the bomber and Osmond a waiting passenger.

df6d8bb40a094a6f.name: advance_to_next_floor
df6d8bb40a094a6f.doc: Advances the dungeon to the next floor: sets the current floor's flag to cleared and the next floor's to entered, deletes the Spheda characters, restores weapon drawing and character switching, switches music (track 17, sound set 3601) and loads the next floor's script.

df7d6bc2f5010c45.name: play_death_scene_then_warp_to_s49
df7d6bc2f5010c45.doc: After the second fight: fades out, clears monsters, plays Gaspard's death scene, marks floor 22 of stage 4 and loads map s49 event 510.

df84346174df9f03.name: interact_with_exit
df84346174df9f03.doc: Handles an exit door: the first time asks for the Luna Stone (item 342) to open it and plays the opening scene. Once open, asks whether to go through, walks the player in and moves to the next floor chosen by get_next_floor for this exit.

df972bcc78b76e0c.name: play_cedric_urges_leaving_town
df972bcc78b76e0c.doc: Cedric says they should leave town and see the outside world. Need thinks it over. Returns 0.

df98be131b303976.name: play_pol_curse_scene_from_debug
df98be131b303976.doc: Debug entry that plays the Pol Curse and pierrots test scene.

dfaf85e4818032b0.name: show_cedric_presses_need
dfaf85e4818032b0.doc: Cedric complains that Need hides things from a friend, and Need agrees to tell everything.

dfb21fc2438a3b0c.name: play_arrive_in_village_scene_debug
dfb21fc2438a3b0c.doc: Debug entry that plays the arrival scene.

dfbe8ec83c31a773.name: finish_spheda_shot
dfbe8ec83c31a773.doc: Resets the character and camera after a Spheda shot; in bonus mode a hole in one (a0 = 1) records par plus 3 as the score.

dfe7700f5e86e7f4.name: talk_stewart_to_monica
dfe7700f5e86e7f4.doc: Stewart's talk when Monica is the active character: he says she reminds him of Elena. Chapter 8 swaps in a warning about Zelmite Mine.

dff42e70656ca357.name: enter_i01h01_event_106
dff42e70656ca357.doc: Sets flag 103, clears flags 106 and 107, sets progress to 3 and goes inside house i01h01 at event 106.

e002712572fa43d7.name: play_gun_item_get_scene
e002712572fa43d7.doc: Event 285: Max takes the gun (item 31) with the item get fanfare and message.

e00ec02fb195a77e.name: setup_georama_editing_by_flag
e00ec02fb195a77e.doc: Setup program: Georama editing is allowed only once flag 250 is set.

e0193164769bc757.name: ask_to_enter_dungeon
e0193164769bc757.doc: Asks whether to enter the dungeon. On yes Max runs off along a path and fades out (returns 1); on no he walks back a few steps.

e03c6f34b501c4c5.name: open_moonflower_door
e03c6f34b501c4c5.doc: Moonflower door opening in d06: the player steps forward in front of the door while the camera holds, the five petal parts swing open (door parts chosen by variant), the key point is cleared and the lock pieces are hidden.

e0412fd9d2940565.name: play_fishing_announcement_then_enter_d03
e0412fd9d2940565.doc: Plays the fishing tournament announcement and loads the d03 script at entry 500.

e04197ff4bf6a944.name: play_monica_victory_pose
e04197ff4bf6a944.doc: Plays Monica's victory pose after clearing a room, with a finish banner whose picture depends on the language. The banner shows only when show_banner is nonzero. Ends with the dungeon music restarted.

e04696aff789f053.name: play_fishing_tournament_announcement_scene
e04696aff789f053.doc: Skippable scene where Mayor Need announces the fishing tournament, with a message that contests will be held at fixed intervals in the town square. Sets the tournament started flag.

e05599c542e25fdd.name: play_victory_finale_scene
e05599c542e25fdd.doc: Final event 824 shot with Max and Monica standing in front of the crowd, the Need character and the fireworks model.

e06fe0194d183d8c.name: talk_adel
e06fe0194d183d8c.doc: Picks Adel's talk: Monica gets her own version; for Max, before quest 0 is done the early line, then by quest 7 status the quest offer; while it is accepted counter 8 chooses asking for materials, handing them over or the clothes-done talk; after it the joined talk. Returns 0.

e074ee1ad75abaf2.name: setup_flotsam_room_sound
e074ee1ad75abaf2.doc: Stops the music, loads sound set 8684 and, once flag 808 is set, opens the boss door.

e081e78625d5ffed.name: play_shot_nod_and_agree
e081e78625d5ffed.doc: Cutscene shot in Cedric's house: Max and Steve nod and agree with spoken lines, and Cedric tells them to keep their guard up. snd_id is unused.

e090a2a50e441dd6.name: talk_blinkhorn_early
e090a2a50e441dd6.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk before the first quest is cleared: he complains that the town is too peaceful to give him any work.

e099ca0781215a5e.name: play_lava_parting_scene
e099ca0781215a5e.doc: Sets flag 526. Max blows the horn at the lava (item 354 in use_horn_on_lava) and the lava splits to open a path. Afterwards the player is placed back at the lava's edge with control restored.

e0a6e4e55d5afb95.name: play_potato_pie_event
e0a6e4e55d5afb95.doc: Plays the potato pie memory scene.

e0a84cd3324e64c7.name: enter_dungeon_floor_4_after_confirm
e0a84cd3324e64c7.doc: Program 551: after the player confirms, marks stage 1 floors (flag 2 on floor 6, flag 1 on floor 4), disables the next_floor point and enters the dungeon at floor 4.

e0b1ae4076082045.name: setup_lapis_room
e0b1ae4076082045.doc: Stops the music and loads the sound set; hides the lapis point once flag 624 shows it was collected.

e0b8fcad562ef533.name: talk_rufio_early
e0b8fcad562ef533.doc: Rufio's talk before the first quest is cleared: he wonders why he misses the moon and whether he came from there.

e0c1a1ce96493b6a.name: setup_boss_613_arena
e0c1a1ce96493b6a.doc: Loads and places monster 613 at the boss room, enables battle music, switches to BGM 190 and fades in.

e0c92b73093cb4a7.name: run_in_from_entrance
e0c92b73093cb4a7.doc: The player runs into the station from the entrance.

e0df800ee67ab192.name: start_room_music
e0df800ee67ab192.doc: Loads the sound set and starts BGM 190, or BGM 193 when bits 256 and 512 of counter 17 are both set (both chests already taken).

e0e096f52658c6b9.name: play_return_walk_in_shot
e0e096f52658c6b9.doc: Shot for event 108: Max and Steve walk back in through the workshop door.

e0ea2b5494fd241b.name: unload_event_209_charas
e0ea2b5494fd241b.doc: Removes the event 209 scene characters, leaving only the active character.

e0ee1aae12e4df90.name: ask_bridge_jump_from_spot_3
e0ee1aae12e4df90.doc: Sets counter 13 to 3 and asks about jumping to Paznos Bridge.

e1057704fd41074a.name: ask_to_leave_by_west_exit
e1057704fd41074a.doc: Asks the leave-the-area question for the west exit. On yes the player runs out and the screen fades; returns 1. On no the player steps back and returns 0.

e13344451c510125.name: replay_andrea_finds_sirus_scene
e13344451c510125.doc: Plays the Andrea finds Sirus scene.

e1409fab405f8916.name: warp_to_s18_event_336
e1409fab405f8916.doc: Clears the scene and loads map s18 with the event script for event 336.

e158d9ab82524e40.name: press_panel_0_1
e158d9ab82524e40.doc: Candle puzzle step for the church candle at row 0, column 1: cuts to a fixed camera, waits 45 frames, toggles that candle and its four neighbours (i01h07_13 pieces), then waits 45 frames.

e17d5803ea1cd5ac.name: apply_debug_loadout
e17d5803ea1cd5ac.doc: Debug loadout: sets both heroes' max HP to 240 and defence to 94, tops Premium Chicken up to 20, and equips Max with Grade Zero and Steal Gun, Monica with the Atlamillia Sword and Goddess Brassard.

e17d639058213135.name: setup_dark_element_battle
e17d639058213135.doc: Starts the boss music, sets the time of day to 24:00 frozen, places the Dark Element monsters 621 and 622 and starts a 5 minute stopwatch.

e19d3f7531d91576.name: play_event_250_scene
e19d3f7531d91576.doc: Program 690: replays the event 250 Toryon scene (play_toryon_plants_trees_scene): Toryon flies in and plants a tree on each side of Max and Monica, who dodge.

e1a14d77c152f2d0.name: play_ending_movie_and_wait_for_button
e1a14d77c152f2d0.doc: Stops all sound, plays the movie END2.PSS, then shows a still image over a darkened screen until a pad button is pressed and fades out.

e1a4b7f6ac526516.name: play_colossus_mode_scene
e1a4b7f6ac526516.doc: Event 640 part 4: the crew debates how to stop the falling palace, Eina orders Colossus Mode, explains that history changed after Max and Monica went back in time, and Paznos enters Colossus Mode. Skippable.

e1ae7dc45a517ec8.name: walk_party_into_view
e1ae7dc45a517ec8.doc: Fades in on Max and Monica walking toward the camera for 75 frames.

e1ba7ac8a1a20282.name: ask_to_enter_next_floor
e1ba7ac8a1a20282.doc: Asks whether to go to the next floor. On yes it marks the floor cleared, enters the next floor and loads the d07 event script. Ride Pod characters only get a message.

e1c6ad97bf49b881.name: play_run_through_crowd_scene
e1c6ad97bf49b881.doc: Camera pan over a street crowd, then the player character runs toward the circus along a path while fading out; ends by placing the player and the opening characters and fading in.

e1c6e3a0fc0df5f2.name: talk_donny_monica
e1c6e3a0fc0df5f2.doc: Donny's line when Monica is the active character: he complains that Max has been less sociable since she arrived.

e1c97a84683ad111.name: start_spheda_debug_floor
e1c97a84683ad111.doc: Debug entry for Spheda mini golf: loads d04f02 and arrival scene, then sets up Spheda.

e1df811d96343f58.name: play_gundor_arrival_story
e1df811d96343f58.doc: Story event 500: clears flag 500, sets up the station and plays the Mt. Gundor arrival scene again.

e1e8f094ea1376a0.name: play_outside_world_narration_shot
e1e8f094ea1376a0.doc: Max and Steve look up, then return to standing while Max narrates about the Outside World.

e2283aed5e9df323.name: set_tour_map_part_visibility
e2283aed5e9df323.doc: Shows map part p07_e03h03-0 when the saved tour type is 1, otherwise p06_e03h03-0.

e22c0b460c0a807b.name: start_embers_rain_story
e22c0b460c0a807b.doc: Clears flag 500, sets up the station map and plays the embers scene.

e232640205411c8f.name: show_cedric_urges_leaving_town
e232640205411c8f.doc: Cedric says hiding it is no longer needed and they must leave town to see the outside world and find a way around it.

e2421b25ac47fe7c.name: run_boss_loss_game_over
e2421b25ac47fe7c.doc: Starts the game over. When Monica or her alternate form is active it plays one of two random voice lines, otherwise a silent game over.

e245ec0e222a0d80.name: spawn_fishing_tournament_villagers
e245ec0e222a0d80.doc: Loads the cup model and number and row-name images into globals number_image_block and row_name_image_block and spawns the villagers who watch the fishing tournament.

e24cb607df7cc278.name: play_monica_rescue_story_206
e24cb607df7cc278.doc: Story 206: plays the Monica rescue scene.

e258b5e50b13ff04.name: talk_aunt_polly_after_joining
e258b5e50b13ff04.doc: Aunt Polly's chatter after the bread delivery quest is cleared, asking where to go next. Chapter 8 swaps in an offer of bread.

e26c2a90f389b641.name: play_spheda_demo_shot_scene
e26c2a90f389b641.doc: Sets flag 315. Monica announces how to play Spheda and sinks a demonstration shot with the ball simulation, then Max praises her. Skippable.

e26dffc3515826ab.name: play_lure_scene_and_go_to_battle_2
e26dffc3515826ab.doc: Plays the lure scene and jumps to map s55 at event 602.

e2728dd7131e61b5.name: setup_s45_entry_point
e2728dd7131e61b5.doc: Map start: sets the tour map parts, then places the player by the previous map (99 or 95, none, or other) and fades in.

e2aa2701564526c8.name: ask_to_enter_d03_dungeon
e2aa2701564526c8.doc: Exit point toward dungeon d03. Ridepod and monster forms only get a message. With flag 340 asks to go (returns 1 on yes); otherwise the character steps back and says it worries about Lin or wants to rest by the Yorda Tree.

e2b50c31d51ff448.name: play_victory_banner
e2b50c31d51ff448.doc: Shows the finish banner after a fight: stops the music, plays the victory sound, and has the camera follow the player (higher when chr_no is 2) while the banner sprite grows, then restores camera control and music. Skippable.

e2dbecd6bc3d73e9.name: play_ending_movie_and_end_card
e2dbecd6bc3d73e9.doc: Plays the END2 movie and then shows the end card image on a black screen.

e2fa6e3c71837b44.name: play_jump_to_next_floor
e2fa6e3c71837b44.doc: Cutscene of the player jumping down into the next floor from a gate in dungeon 1: loads the jump motions for Max or Monica, jumps to the landing, walks forward and fades out.

e30defcf82a5b00c.name: load_event_250_charas
e30defcf82a5b00c.doc: Loads the actors for event 250: Max and Monica in swapped slots depending on which is active, a party model for the active one, a full-screen sprite image and the event message file.

e317ada7da4aa0a8.name: play_condor_drop_off_scene
e317ada7da4aa0a8.doc: Story event 307 cutscene. Max drops from a condor carrying Giant Meat and lands, then voice lines about Lin suffering and Max remembering being nursed play. Sets flag 307 and forces Max as the active character.

e31f1aa445668f1a.name: clean_up_e356_scene
e31f1aa445668f1a.doc: Removes the extra characters loaded for the e356 scene and restores the party handles and status bar.

e3221947469b91ca.name: play_floor_entry_scene
e3221947469b91ca.doc: Entry cutscene of a Moonflower Palace floor: shows the floor title logo (same floor) or the dungeon map piece (new floor), turns the door parts and walks the hero in. Then shows the Red, Blue or White Seal help messages when the floor status has those seals.

e3591476630e8fcc.name: talk_generic_villager
e3591476630e8fcc.doc: Generic villager talk. Looks up the villager's message group, then handles the shop keepers (1012, 1015, 1018) with the shop greeting, a guard (50) with a refusal, and chapter-specific lines for others.

e35a972d9d78160a.name: talk_to_pau_about_shingala
e35a972d9d78160a.doc: Pau's line while Shingala is sick: ask Luna Lab about the device, bring the Secret Dragon Remedy (item 375) from the beach, or that Shingala has left.

e36da0f4d19e8dc3.name: start_boss_battle
e36da0f4d19e8dc3.doc: Starts the boss BGM, loads monsters 514 and 522, places six 514 minions in a ring of radius 450 around the room centre and 522 near the middle.

e37364a0d0dc6418.name: on_setup
e37364a0d0dc6418.doc: Loads sound set 8694 and starts BGM 190 while any of the three treasure bits (16, 32, 64) of counter 17 is still unset, otherwise plays the reward BGM 193.

e38e465ff258b9f0.name: show_protect_lin_hint
e38e465ff258b9f0.doc: Swaps between Max and Monica, and the first time (flag 64 unset) pauses the monsters and shows a hint to protect Lin from the approaching Evil Flame.

e3b96de66ff3176e.name: play_preloaded_voice_message_for
e3b96de66ff3176e.doc: Shows a message with an already opened stream and plays it for at most the given number of frames.

e3bbb7006f41ae2f.name: play_paznos_flight_then_go_to_stonehenge
e3bbb7006f41ae2f.doc: Plays the Paznos flight scene and jumps to map s66 (Kazarov Stonehenge). Returns 0.

e3c3dd1b70ba789b.name: talk_gerald_early
e3c3dd1b70ba789b.doc: Gerald's talk before the first quest is cleared: he tells Max it is time to learn about mining.

e3de1d9507408063.name: open_treasure_chest
e3de1d9507408063.doc: Treasure chest opening logic, by the chest type bits: bit 256 is a mimic (with Pau as party NPC he warns and asks to open anyway), bit 2 runs the locked chest menu, bit 4 the trapped chest menu, bit 512 opens an empty chest, bit 128 the clown chest, otherwise the normal item chest. Returns the first item.

e3e1c7591cfbdc25.name: go_to_veniccio_if_confirmed
e3e1c7591cfbdc25.doc: Asks about moving to Veniccio and jumps to map g03 if confirmed.

e3f05360649b6231.name: show_npc_until_button_press
e3f05360649b6231.doc: Places the player and an idle NPC (tp01_16a) at fixed positions and waits for a button press.

e3f739461ec2d9c3.name: rococo_runs_home_and_shuts_door
e3f739461ec2d9c3.doc: Rococo runs a seven-point path up to his door and plays his close-door motion, while the two door pieces (actors 10 and 11, edit parts g010707-m and g010708-m) are held at -90 degrees and then swing shut to 0 over 10 frames.

e4098efdaa69737e.name: play_platform_arrival_scene
e4098efdaa69737e.doc: Arrival scene: Max runs in while a map piece (actor 10) rises and bounces three times, then control returns to the player.

e439135a1a8f5b4c.name: exit_to_f03_entrance_1
e439135a1a8f5b4c.doc: Turns and fades out, sets counter 2 to 1 and jumps to map f03.

e43a743a0527e70c.name: play_opening_elephant_ball_scene
e43a743a0527e70c.doc: Opening circus performance: an elephant throws and lifts a ball while a performer and Max watch.

e46138479932ca9f.name: play_event_428
e46138479932ca9f.doc: Event 428 in the lab: sets the Shell Talkie given flag and hides villager 303. Dr. Nobb introduces himself, runs an analysis of what the party needs and gives the Shell Talkie for talking to sea dragons, with a pickup jingle. Skippable.

e466dca2e11f30ed.name: clean_up_event_336_scene
e466dca2e11f30ed.doc: Reactivates the player's character, deletes the event 336 scene characters and images, shows the party again and ends the event.

e46dbddf96607507.name: play_golem_march_then_jump_to_f30
e46dbddf96607507.doc: Plays the golem army march scene, skips the next BGM load and jumps to map f30 at entry 601.

e46dd110fe5d88d8.name: talk_milane_check_sword
e46dd110fe5d88d8.doc: Milane checks the player's sword: without a Sand Breaker (67) or Chopper (69) she dismisses them; with one she agrees to fight alongside, joins the party and quest 10 is marked cleared.

e479fe58f96a6b3e.name: enter_i01h01_event_105_3
e479fe58f96a6b3e.doc: Clears flag 105, sets progress to 3 and goes inside house i01h01 at event 105 variant 3.

e47b0d019ee40bf2.name: talk_olivie_after_joining
e47b0d019ee40bf2.doc: Olivie's chatter after the race quest is cleared, hoping to stand on the winner's podium. Chapter 8 swaps in a remark about Fabio's single interest.

e48e091fce14e99c.name: play_rococo_scene_then_load_g01
e48e091fce14e99c.doc: Fades in, plays the Rococo encounter and loads the g01 event script.

e4a2fc32465926f3.name: play_clown_two_chest_scene
e4a2fc32465926f3.doc: Treasure chest holding two items: the Happy Clown appears and lets the player pick the red or yellow box, each holding one of the items in random order, then gives the chosen item.

e4ae344edd222530.name: place_player_on_platform_after_event
e4ae344edd222530.doc: Sets up the station state and villager, places the player on the platform and fades in.

e4b955ef62f9dcf1.name: talk_to_town_npc_unless_demo
e4b955ef62f9dcf1.doc: Does nothing at progress 100. Otherwise runs the shared town NPC and special talk handler.

e4b9d3cdcefba85c.name: play_ticket_snatch_event
e4b9d3cdcefba85c.doc: Plays the ticket snatch scene, then returns to the m06 event script.

e4bb276df6cfe092.name: ask_move_to_spheda_ball
e4bb276df6cfe092.doc: Asks whether to move the character to the Spheda ball. On yes, finds a standing spot near the ball that is clear of treasure chests, places the player facing the ball and resets the follow camera.

e4c22012040f457e.name: show_wrong_item_debug_message
e4c22012040f457e.doc: Shows the placeholder debug message "wrong item" and waits for it to be dismissed.

e4c2a68d522860d7.name: play_halloween_walk_scene
e4c2a68d522860d7.doc: Night scene using the p5_halloween model: it stands, then walks off across the town while two cameras pan and four timed messages (950 to 980) show. Ends on a button press.

e4c621ac21880be8.name: leave_bonus_fish_race_for_finny_frenzy
e4c621ac21880be8.doc: After a bonus fish race ends, fades out the music and jumps back to map i03h04 (Finny Frenzy Races) as program 503.

e4ca0b9bfd86579a.name: close_npc_talk_windows
e4ca0b9bfd86579a.doc: Makes character 0 active, resets message window 1 options, closes it and finishes the event.

e4d0819a36ad5616.name: play_ridepod_departure_then_enter_dungeon
e4d0819a36ad5616.doc: Same as play_ridepod_departure_and_join, but on departure goes straight to dungeon 0, floor 4 with event 520.

e4e8d80163d96ba4.name: start_arrival_story
e4e8d80163d96ba4.doc: Stops music and ambience, hides the memo, sets flag 4 and plays the arrival scene.

e4ea55d2f1576218.name: enter_dungeon_d05_with_gem
e4ea55d2f1576218.doc: Door to dungeon d05. Character forms 2 and 3 refuse to go in. Without the gem (flag 636) the player is told they do not have it yet; otherwise asks and, on yes, fades out, clears monsters and loads d05.

e4eb0d26e5d9402e.name: play_gundor_departure_scene
e4eb0d26e5d9402e.doc: Event 452 (sets flag 452): Max and Monica board for the trip to Mt. Gundor with the Cedric character present.

e4ec5c58ec1d0a6e.name: show_georama_hint
e4ec5c58ec1d0a6e.doc: Shows the Georama hint: unless the edit-blocked flag is set it runs Georama command 3 and reads whether it completed, then shows the pending event notice. only_if_event is passed through.

e4f8e0e296d0282a.name: play_beam_to_paznos_bridge_scene
e4f8e0e296d0282a.doc: Event 640 cutscene variant: the Moonflower beam is fired and bursts with a barrier effect. Used by program 600, which then jumps to map s30 (Paznos Bridge). Sets flag 640.

e50bfe14a3bffb40.name: use_north_transfer_gate
e50bfe14a3bffb40.doc: Transfer gate menu, entered at the north gate.

e50e4ea424cc41f6.name: wake_lin
e50e4ea424cc41f6.doc: Event 500: tries to wake Lin with the Miracle Dumplings.

e51300b59d1d7188.name: play_train_leaves_station
e51300b59d1d7188.doc: Train departure scene at the s02 station: fades out, steam puffs from both sides, the train and its shadow pull away 6000 units over 210 frames, then the screen fades out and the player is restored.

e52717a48d94fde3.name: restart_first_gaspard_fight
e52717a48d94fde3.doc: Restarts the first fight: plays BGM 190 and places monster 512.

e531ed4d2c5adfec.name: place_player_for_talk
e531ed4d2c5adfec.doc: Starts a talk with an NPC: places the player 30 units in front of the NPC, faces them, and frames the talk camera. The third parameter is unused.

e532e1798474115d.name: block_demo_and_keep_music
e532e1798474115d.doc: At progress 100 shows the demo message. If flag 304 is set and 305 is not, skips the next BGM load.

e53d0d626ed88fec.name: ask_girl_about_kid
e53d0d626ed88fec.doc: Talks to a girl, asking about the red-headed kid, and gets a reply that she does not know.

e55032f92c83c0e1.name: place_player_and_wait_for_press
e55032f92c83c0e1.doc: Places the player at a fixed spot and waits for pad button 64.

e5514e95956a71a7.name: play_event_283
e5514e95956a71a7.doc: Event 283 at the s02 rock: sets the Sindain departure seen flag, Max or Monica, their partner and Starble stand in a group and a voiced order to move out plays, then the screen fades and control returns behind the player. Skippable.

e562ddc1b35acaf0.name: play_dawn_camera_scene
e562ddc1b35acaf0.doc: Skippable scene that plays the dawn camera pan with the player hidden, then restores the player and clears flag 56. Returns 0.

e5658ab049942751.name: ask_give_white_windflower
e5658ab049942751.doc: Shows a hint box suggesting giving Lao Chao a White Windflower for his miracle dish and asks with a button prompt. Returns 1 if the player picked the menu button, else 0.

e5690ff2f56f7e08.name: warp_to_s17_event_308
e5690ff2f56f7e08.doc: Clears the scene, resets flag 308 and loads map s17 with the event script for event 308.

e569241406c37ec3.name: talk_to_shigura_villager
e569241406c37ec3.doc: Finds which villager map part (adults, children) was talked to. Without the Shell Talkie the player cannot understand; baru first gives the Secret Dragon Remedy and plays his scene; others get the greeting.

e570e14c023df820.name: start_spheda_stage_5
e570e14c023df820.doc: Loads the d05f02 Spheda course (mstage5), gives items 305 and 306, sets up Spheda with hole 5, places Max and opens the Spheda score view.

e5979678e8d08963.name: fade_out_and_play_lighthouse_arrival
e5979678e8d08963.doc: Program 502 (touching the e348 point): disables the e348 point, hides map part p07_d03b01, fades out the music and screen over 30 frames, then plays the lighthouse arrival scene.

e599bc15fe4dbba4.name: use_condor_perch
e599bc15fe4dbba4.doc: Interaction with a condor perch. The player offers Giant Meat (item 341) and chooses whether to be carried to the next floor; on yes it clears monsters, plays the carry-away scene, shows any medal results, updates the floor info and starts the next floor. The companion characters (2 and 3) just comment.

e5b6d4e05a0ea9d8.name: play_golem_army_march_scene
e5b6d4e05a0ea9d8.doc: Event 540 (sets flag 540). A hundred golems are placed in ten rows at night and all march toward the camera over the p03_s55 map part.

e5c9c093915080a5.name: ask_move_to_square_event
e5c9c093915080a5.doc: Asks whether to move to the fishing contest or Gyorace venue, depending on the current square event. On yes the player runs out of the map and 1 is returned, otherwise walks back and returns 0.

e5ec16a919166df7.name: find_hiding_corinne
e5ec16a919166df7.doc: Quest 18: the first time you find Corinne she hides again (counter 11 goes to 1); the second time she joins the party and the quest is cleared.

e5f723f5aecec064.name: play_find_new_lab_scene
e5f723f5aecec064.doc: Event 460: Monica notices another lab in the distance and they run in to see if anyone is home, then the player is put back on the map.

e5fcc4245b2bab72.name: place_player_arriving_from_map_22
e5fcc4245b2bab72.doc: Places the player at (225, 0, 280) facing the camera.

e60a97be1eb65500.name: talk_gordon
e60a97be1eb65500.doc: Picks Gordon's conversation: the early talk until the Geostone plan scene is done, then by quest 0 state the quest offer, the holy water reminder (accepted) or the joined talk (done). Returns 0.

e61880b68549f27b.name: remove_rock_scene_actors
e61880b68549f27b.doc: Shows Max and deletes the three characters of the rock throwing scene.

e628840d60430a57.name: play_victory_crowd_cheering_alt_scene
e628840d60430a57.doc: Another event 824 crowd variant with forty villagers from the opening models. Sets flag 824.

e62ebba233a80743.name: play_narration_line
e62ebba233a80743.doc: Streams the letter line with the given voice id, shows its text and holds it for the given number of frames.

e63d624d2781073a.name: can_play_event_552
e63d624d2781073a.doc: Returns 1 when event 552 can play: analysis flag 406 is set and the event has not been seen.

e641ffdedf77259f.name: jump_to_station_map
e641ffdedf77259f.doc: Jumps to the station map for the station number in counter 1, with a separate map for each station id. Returns 0.

e66a709a376a3a38.name: give_gold_paint_to_parn
e66a709a376a3a38.doc: Quest 1 hand-in: asks for the Gold Paint item. With it Parn paints Julia into life, joins the party, Julia joins too and the quest is cleared. Other items get a rebuke, and Monica only gets a remark.

e67542f499e44db6.name: leave_train_by_door_a
e67542f499e44db6.doc: Turns the player to the side door and, if that door can be opened, fades out, sets counter 15 to 1 and jumps to the station map. Otherwise the player shakes their head.

e69e4c1602ffbe3c.name: setup_boss_floor_3
e69e4c1602ffbe3c.doc: Fades out over 20 frames, plays the boss intro play_monster_intro_e219e, disables the 3f marker, raises map parts p11_d06b02-4 and -5 by 200, places Black Dragon (monster 605) and the player at their start positions and fades in.

e69eb77e00caf299.name: start_spheda_debug_course
e69eb77e00caf299.doc: Debug entry: loads d02f01, plays the arrival scene and starts a Spheda game.

e6a3c72ed778b0c5.name: play_cedric_invention_hints_scene
e6a3c72ed778b0c5.doc: Event 105 part b: Cedric gives Max hints about the Energy Pack parts. Saves the camera, loads the picture sprites, plays the two shot functions and restores the camera and characters. Sets flag 105.

e6d55fc2c6fe46d8.name: show_bubble_choice
e6d55fc2c6fe46d8.doc: Shows a speech bubble message and returns the index the player picks from option_count choices.

e6d8f6f672ca7928.name: play_fire_order_scene
e6d8f6f672ca7928.doc: Sets the golem army march seen flag. In the Paznos hall Galen Agaris (the phorn model) gives the order to fire as the golems arrive, with a sound and a fade out. Skippable; loads and removes its own models.

e6e789f4d294dbf0.name: play_gaspard_death_scene
e6e789f4d294dbf0.doc: Sets flag 536. Gaspard is beaten for the last time, light flares around him, he speaks his last words to Max and Monica and dies, ending in a white fade.

e6f344b64d354e68.name: play_chase_scene_and_go_to_m08
e6f344b64d354e68.doc: Event 155: plays the chase scene, resets the camera ids and jumps to map m08 with event 152.

e6f38a3e1debc358.name: open_key_door
e6f38a3e1debc358.doc: Cutscene of opening a star key door in dungeon 4: the minimap door opens, the camera turns behind the player, the lever tilts and the door's wall pieces scale away (the set used depends on whether the door faces north-south or east-west), then the camera resets.

e6f918af1511fbe0.name: play_gaspard_returns_home_scene
e6f918af1511fbe0.doc: Event 536. Gaspard comes home and tells his mother he did not find what she asked. His mother's words fade in over a white screen, ending with Welcome home. Sets flag 536.

e706759b4eadc136.name: show_ruined_world_image
e706759b4eadc136.doc: Shows the first story image and narrates that fifteen years ago the world was laid to waste and only Palm Brinks remained.

e708da8574435c80.name: advance_to_next_floor_if_confirmed
e708da8574435c80.doc: If the party confirms leaving, hides the floor NPC, moves to the next dungeon floor and loads the d03 event script.

e70b870d86ae68b1.name: show_message_at_button2
e70b870d86ae68b1.doc: Shows message mes_no and waits for input with Square also accepted. extra_pressed[0] is set to 1 when Square ended it. Returns the frames waited.

e725228d4d014497.name: play_palace_falls_then_jump_to_s30
e725228d4d014497.doc: Plays the scene where the palace begins to fall and jumps to map s30 at entry 640. Returns 0.

e726e350d347cb0a.name: get_chest_item_scale
e726e350d347cb0a.doc: Writes into scale[0] the scale for showing an item above the chest, fit to the character size.

e74fa11b56ca119f.name: leave_train_by_left_door
e74fa11b56ca119f.doc: If the left-side door is open, unlocks map movement, sets counter 15 to 0 and goes to the station map.

e782179c227c9823.name: handle_locked_chest
e782179c227c9823.doc: Menu for a locked treasure chest: open it with Donny if he is the party NPC, use the Treasure Chest Key item (297), force it, or give up. Forcing triggers the trap bits of chest_type: bit 8 poisons the active character and cuts HP by 70 percent, bit 16 blows up the chest, bit 32 wrecks both weapons' durability. Clears lock bit 2 when unlocked. Returns 1 when the chest stays closed.

e79033a2e82be9b9.name: finish_spheda_shot_and_give_prize
e79033a2e82be9b9.doc: Runs a shot. A hole gives a Swan (item 11) and the White Windflower, a miss counts toward ten tries after which Monica takes over and gives a Turkey (item 10), otherwise play continues with the ball reset.

e79272102c90a72e.name: play_monster_gives_sundrop_scene
e79272102c90a72e.doc: Sets flag 290. The talked-to monster says it has too many Sundrops and gives one, with a Monica magic charge effect, and the item get message for the Sundrop is shown.

e79f627fef74ff7a.name: play_both_scenes_then_jump_to_g05
e79f627fef74ff7a.doc: Plays the hide and seek scene and then event 748, then jumps to map g05 at entry 560. Returns 0.

e7c0fb54d619d4ef.name: talk_aunt_polly_quest_offer
e7c0fb54d619d4ef.doc: Aunt Polly's quest offer: she agrees to come along but first asks Max to deliver bread to Morton, gives him 20 Crunchy Bread (and opens the overflow menu if needed), sets quest 8 to accepted and counter 12 to 0.

e7c154e48a400404.name: play_touch_vine_scene
e7c154e48a400404.doc: Event 256. Max and Monica talk about touching the vine, grab it and are pulled upward as the screen fades out. Sets flag 256.

e7cfa7451d4e1ce1.name: place_player_reset
e7cfa7451d4e1ce1.doc: Places the player at x, y, z with the given yaw, restarts the stand motion and resets cloth physics.

e7df3c447696952e.name: play_firbit_meeting_then_flashback
e7df3c447696952e.doc: Plays the Firbit meeting scene, fades out and jumps to s46 (Max's Room flashback).

e7ebf5f611d88ba5.name: talk_fabio_early
e7ebf5f611d88ba5.doc: Fabio's talk before the first quest is cleared: fishing is his hobby and he dreams of catching a Mardan Karayan.

e7f0aae3e99d44ce.name: unload_event_250_actors
e7f0aae3e99d44ce.doc: Restores the active character, deletes the Max or Monica copy and the extra event models.

e7f3c0eb18d0a264.name: run_voice_lipsync
e7f3c0eb18d0a264.doc: Runs the lip sync for a voice stream. Starts the talk motion and animation, follows the stream's audible state, and stops after max_frames (or when the stream ends if -1). Closes the message window at close_frame. Returns the frames spent.

e811d62f5f6a1ce7.name: play_winged_creature_night_scene
e811d62f5f6a1ce7.doc: Test scene at night: a winged creature spreads its wings with an effect, two moons drift, four glowing fireflies hover and the camera eases in until a button is pressed.

e816483a8362f149.name: play_jurak_reward_effect
e816483a8362f149.doc: Jurak thanks the party, his nose blasts out a puff of air and a sparkle floats down to Max and Monica.

e81cfd04638eec25.name: warp_to_s31_event_520
e81cfd04638eec25.doc: Clears the scene, hides the party members and status bar and starts event 520 on map s31.

e82578d5b997da31.name: talk_stewart_to_monica
e82578d5b997da31.doc: Stewart's talk when Monica is the active character: he says she reminds him of Elena. Chapter 8 swaps in a warning about Zelmite Mine.

e833298147e927ee.name: start_npc_talk
e833298147e927ee.doc: Starts an NPC talk: makes the player and npc turn to face each other (with the talk camera when set_camera is set). With restore set it returns the NPC's original yaw so finish_npc_talk can turn it back; otherwise the returned value is unset.

e8391c8bac51fb3e.name: play_holly_may_be_mother_scene
e8391c8bac51fb3e.doc: Max says that the Holly the Firbits describe may be his mother, and that finding her is another reason he wants to see the world.

e84692be960f73c8.name: open_item_chest
e84692be960f73c8.doc: Treasure chest opening sequence: camera pushes in, the lid shakes and opens, and the item jumps out (nothing when item is -1). Adds item up to the bag limit and shows the item message, or a no-room message if none fit; with item -1 it shows an empty-chest message instead. Opens the item overflow menu when the bag is over its limit.

e85b63d4ce66db5f.name: play_train_rush_then_go_to_moonflower_stop
e85b63d4ce66db5f.doc: Plays the train rush scene, then jumps to map s31, the Moon Flower Palace Stop.

e869819013c33929.name: play_receiver_call_scene
e869819013c33929.doc: Sets flag 102 and plays the receiver call cutscene on arriving at the next dungeon floor. Pauses monster AI during the scene, which can be skipped, then returns to the dungeon view.

e86f4c6ea8b053d2.name: start_train_sounds
e86f4c6ea8b053d2.doc: Plays sound effects 2 and 8 of the train sound set held in train_sound_id.

e872c2b2c858ba09.name: play_paznos_transform_then_go_to_stonehenge
e872c2b2c858ba09.doc: Plays the Paznos transformation scene and jumps to map s66 (Kazarov Stonehenge). Returns 0.

e888433023798df3.name: ask_to_leave_tournament_venue
e888433023798df3.doc: Asks whether to leave the venue. On yes it cleans up and jumps to map s45 (Palm Brinks Square).

e8a1e5f907e051b9.name: play_shot_steve_walks_through_doors
e8a1e5f907e051b9.doc: Shot in Cedric's house: Steve walks toward the open doors as the two door actors swing aside and the camera pulls back with a widening zoom while fading out. Restores the projection. Returns 0.

e8eae71a6c4b28f6.name: restore_after_event
e8eae71a6c4b28f6.doc: Cleans up after the train rock scene: reactivates the player at a fixed spot, deletes scene characters 34 to 36, shows map part handles 6 to 10 and reactivates characters 8 to 10.

e8efda0ff6cf92c4.name: ask_to_enter_dungeon_d03
e8efda0ff6cf92c4.doc: Program 520: when talking to the revival NPC as Steve or Ruby it shows their line; otherwise asks the question and on yes fades out and loads dungeon script d03/d03.stb.

e8f23145594ebf33.name: play_rococo_scene_and_reload_map
e8f23145594ebf33.doc: Plays the Rococo house scene, fades in and reloads the g01 map.

e911a50d5aacb348.name: run_elder_gift_scene_test
e911a50d5aacb348.doc: Debug entry that plays the elder gift scene.

e925e488ac2fd229.name: can_play_any_story_event
e925e488ac2fd229.doc: Returns 1 when any of the story events 270, 272, 275, 280 or 285 is ready to play, otherwise 0.

e950c5fc6fba8d43.name: play_mother_farewell_flashback
e950c5fc6fba8d43.doc: Event 532. Gaspard's dying mother tells him not to hate anyone and to keep searching for something worth protecting, and he cries over her. Time of day is frozen at noon during it.

e958cbee063f0e25.name: press_panel_row1_col0
e958cbee063f0e25.doc: Presses the puzzle switch for the panel at row 1, column 0, toggling it and its neighbours.

e965eca3eccf46ee.name: choose_train_car_to_board
e965eca3eccf46ee.doc: After the board prompt sets counter 1 to 5 and jumps to the engine car (s08), the middle car (s07), or in chapters 6 and 7 to Ixion (s37 engine room, s38 guest room).

e97607b0f9fdb2f8.name: play_lighthouse_bombardment_scene
e97607b0f9fdb2f8.doc: Cutscene at the top of the Cape lighthouse: Lin and her master Crest talk about the Moon Crystal, Gaspard's battleship appears and, on Emperor Griffon's orders, fires on the lighthouse. Ends by loading the dungeon floor.

e9850f1935d7b1f2.name: reset_camera_behind_player
e9850f1935d7b1f2.doc: Puts the camera behind the player.

e98fab49c76f5bc1.name: open_clown_chest
e98fab49c76f5bc1.doc: Clown chest event with item counts: the chest opens and a clown pops out holding two boxes holding item_a and item_b in random order. The player picks one, receives as many as the bag limit allows (or a no-room message), and the item-over menu opens if the bag overflows.

e9a974df42cff779.name: on_geostone
e9a974df42cff779.doc: Plays the scene of Max or Monica picking up a geostone and shows the item get message for the Cooking Stove (item 358). It cannot be done in the Ridepod or a monster form.

e9b7485ca65c2eb5.name: load_e280_scene_characters
e9b7485ca65c2eb5.doc: Loads Max, Monica, Conda, Noam, Zak, Wicky, Mogri, Tobo and Rococo models and the e280b message file, setting globals 0 and 1 to the two player chara slots.

e9c1900542146dcf.name: play_crest_reunion_scene
e9c1900542146dcf.doc: Story event 372, part 1. Max and Monica find Lin, now the Great Sage Crest, at the top of Starlight Temple; after the surprise and banter she offers to show them Griffon's past, chants a spell and the scene jumps to map s33 (Moonflower Palace). Sets flag 372 and plays temple music.

e9cfdbc4b04af8e5.name: enter_contest_grounds
e9cfdbc4b04af8e5.doc: Entrance to the contest grounds. Closed unless an event is running; otherwise asks to enter the fishing contest grounds (i03h03) or the Finny Frenzy races (i03h04).

e9e1ec0b0d3554ce.name: unload_event_villagers
e9e1ec0b0d3554ce.doc: Cleans up after the fish race hall scene: resets three sound ports, removes the extra motions and characters 8 and 24 to 30, and allows map movement again.

e9e44666ea4bec76.name: play_opening_parts_3_and_4
e9e44666ea4bec76.doc: Plays opening parts 3 and 4 in order.

e9e5e47f1125df77.name: play_run_out_of_room_scene
e9e5e47f1125df77.doc: Short scene: the player character runs from the room back toward the entrance and the screen fades out.

e9f45a24f36afc82.name: enter_boss_room
e9f45a24f36afc82.doc: Entry event for the boss room. The first time (flag 10 unset) it closes door01, shows the barrier map piece and plays the long Halloween intro; later it plays the short entry scene.

ea019f24898676dd.name: talk_to_resident
ea019f24898676dd.doc: Runs the shared town NPC or special talk handler.

ea136875362d404b.name: open_treasure_chest
ea136875362d404b.doc: Opens a dungeon treasure chest according to its type bits. A mimic chest (256) spawns a mimic, after party NPC 9 warns and asks whether to open it anyway. Locked (2) and trapped (4) chests run their handlers first and may abort. Empty (512), clown (128) and plain chests then open with the right sequence. Returns the first item id when opened, else 0.

ea1554332bc5e464.name: play_energy_pack_payment_scene
ea1554332bc5e464.doc: Hides Cedric and plays scene 2, the payment of 400 Gilda for the invention.

ea2222bef1bafac6.name: place_star_item_at_d02_socket
ea2222bef1bafac6.doc: Program 340 on the d02 floors. Runs place_star_item_in_socket, the star item socket interaction.

ea2807ec149db248.name: play_andrea_calms_sirus_scene
ea2807ec149db248.doc: Event 728. Sirus grieves for Alexandra and wants the humans destroyed; Andrea answers that humans also carry something precious worth passing on, and Sirus cannot accept it. Memory pictures flash during the speech.

ea292d6f22554cba.name: place_player_on_workshop_entry
ea292d6f22554cba.doc: Sets up the map objects and elevator platforms, plays whichever of the 548, 552 and 556 scenes is due, and puts the player at the position that matches the previous map (the gate counter selects the transfer gate).

ea325581748d2e7a.name: play_monica_takes_over_after_many_misses_scene
ea325581748d2e7a.doc: Event 315. After ten misses Monica takes the stick and demonstrates the shot with the scripted demo. Sets flag 315.

ea3ca17d0634e84d.name: play_room_2_monster_intro_scene
ea3ca17d0634e84d.doc: Intro for the second room: monster e220e (sound EN_287) falls in beside the party and plays its attack and play motions under title card 2, then the scene fades out.

ea4ba6776f064b10.name: talk_rosa_joined
ea4ba6776f064b10.doc: Rosa's line once she has joined. The text depends on whether the chapter is 8.

ea4fb2c508fd2859.name: start_shigura_village_map
ea4fb2c508fd2859.doc: Chooses the scene on entering the village: arrival scene with or without the Shell Talkie, the Gaspard marionette scene and arena with the ring of monsters, or the normal entry. After loading a save it just places the player.

ea7bc353e2aa1a2f.name: set_event_pause
ea7bc353e2aa1a2f.doc: Switches the room into or out of event mode: pauses weapon drawing, hides the party, blocks character swapping and map moves while paused, and restores the default motion when unpaused.

ea8abc4bac8ad01e.name: setup_s08_after_event
ea8abc4bac8ad01e.doc: Runs the s08 map setup without locking map movement and fades in.

ea9532bfea7cff6d.name: play_boy_of_two_eras_scene
ea9532bfea7cff6d.doc: Event 640. The crew talk about Max, a boy with blood from two different times, who may be the one to save them. Sets flag 640.

eaac1ac52da53484.name: show_crest_farewell_title_card
eaac1ac52da53484.doc: Shows a black title card for the end of event 356 (Guiltoni beaten, parting with Crest, continued) between fades.

eaba4d1305bb017a.name: check_spheda_club_equipped
eaba4d1305bb017a.doc: Returns 1 with an explanatory message when someone other than Max is active or Max has no Spheda club (items 9 to 14) equipped. Otherwise sets the club and returns 0.

eabb843e280a00c6.name: show_numbered_message
eabb843e280a00c6.doc: Shows the given message number in window 0 and waits.

eabe3f6fafb0f440.name: talk_aunt_polly_to_monica
eabe3f6fafb0f440.doc: Aunt Polly's two-part talk to Monica about Max being a good man, with an offer of bread in chapter 8.

eac510077c3ea75d.name: play_griffon_challenge_scene
eac510077c3ea75d.doc: Event 640 (sets flag 640). Griffon with closed wings mocks the heroes' puny fortress and tells them to let the battle begin; then control passes to map s32.

ead1e76be7ca7883.name: on_board_train
ead1e76be7ca7883.doc: Asks whether to board the train. On yes sets counter 1 to 3 and goes to the engine (s08) or, in chapters 6 and 7, the Ixion engine room (s37) for the front car, or the train interior (s07) or Ixion guest room (s38) for other cars.

eae09b01b34e0df6.name: use_floor_exit_door
