eae09b01b34e0df6.doc: Door at the end of the floor (Japanese text). Before flag 7 it only shows a refusal. After that it refuses Ride Pod characters, otherwise asks to go on. On yes it marks the floor cleared and enters the next floor (or starts Georama edit mode 12 the first time).

eae688d692b9f857.name: report_scoop_photos
eae688d692b9f857.doc: The scoop photographer's report at the station. With no Inside Scoop Memo he asks the player to buy one (returns 0). Otherwise reports new conditions known and scoops photographed, or that none are left, then returns the result of check_scoop_prize.

eae72973cf7b7f00.name: ask_to_enter_underground_waterway
eae72973cf7b7f00.doc: Asks whether to move to the underground waterway. On yes the player runs off, fades out and the dungeon menu opens (returns 1); on no they step back (returns 0).

eae982b0076e355b.name: play_dark_ruler_flurry_scene
eae982b0076e355b.doc: Event 728 variant that shows a title card and the dark ruler's flurry of blows, then fades out and starts music 39. Skippable.

eafa1f9a1a5cdcc1.name: unload_gaspard_confrontation_actors
eafa1f9a1a5cdcc1.doc: Removes the actors loaded for the Gaspard confrontation, re-enables the normal function points and shows the status bar again, then finishes the event.

eb093ff94087f6e3.name: play_palace_falls_scene
eb093ff94087f6e3.doc: Plays part three of event 640: the cannon hits, then the palace is seen falling toward Palm Brinks.

eb0a1895f5b1331b.name: talk_bruno
eb0a1895f5b1331b.doc: Priest Bruno's talk dispatcher. Quest 0 not yet at state 2 gives his idle talk; after that quest 13's state picks the quest offer (0), the candle check (1) or the joined talk (2). Returns 0.

eb10231bdcc5d78d.name: play_gate_walk_in_scene
eb10231bdcc5d78d.doc: Short scene: the gate parts turn and slide while the player walks forward, then control returns. Skippable.

eb185bcd89f457ea.name: open_item_chest
eb185bcd89f457ea.doc: Opens an item treasure chest: the lid shakes and opens, the item pops out, and the item is added with the item get message. If the bag is full a no room message shows instead, and an overflow menu opens when the bag is over the limit. Passing a negative item opens the chest with only the effect.

eb1ab56c664ff55c.name: play_e206_scene_then_jump_to_s02
eb1ab56c664ff55c.doc: Sets the engine part motion, plays the e206 train scene and jumps to map s02.

eb24eeae55342504.name: play_geostone_reactor_scene
eb24eeae55342504.doc: The elder feeds a Geostone into the reactor and explains Geostone data, the Analyse command and Polyn limits, then says he will wait in the last train car and offers Georama materials.

eb287e5d115609b1.name: play_walk_through_gate_scene
eb287e5d115609b1.doc: Max walks forward through the gate while the camera cuts and fades out.

eb2fb093f954a864.name: play_griffon_challenge_and_jump_to_s32
eb2fb093f954a864.doc: Plays the Griffon challenge scene and jumps to map s32 (Moon Flower Palace) with script 600.

eb4c1b29c9a9622b.name: talk_ferdinand_quest_offer
eb4c1b29c9a9622b.doc: Ferdinand's quest offer: the confectioner is trying to make a sweet needing a nut like the pointed maron, but the town has sold out because the mayor bought them all, and he asks the hero for help. Marks quest 3 accepted.

eb57c5731bf01695.name: play_room_3_monster_intro_scene
eb57c5731bf01695.doc: Intro for the third room: monster e219e (sound EN_288) falls in beside the party under title card 3, then the scene fades out.

eb621cf77869f963.name: talk_blinkhorn_after_joining
eb621cf77869f963.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's chatter after he has joined the party, praising Max's speed. Chapter 8 swaps in an offer of help.

eb644f6579dd0b73.name: check_photo_rewards
eb644f6579dd0b73.doc: Checks the photographer's reward state on the shop menu: returns 1 when a reward count is waiting; otherwise shows the 'bring more scoops' reply (state 1) or the explanation of photography levels (state 2) in window, and returns 0. In map 22 the talk uses the NPC's own window, elsewhere a centred one.

eb69e806d7828ace.name: face_npc_and_show_message
eb69e806d7828ace.doc: Turns Max toward the given character slot, then shows the queued message window at that character.

eb745e01953d896f.name: press_panel_row1_col1
eb745e01953d896f.doc: Presses the puzzle switch for the panel at row 1, column 1, toggling it and its neighbours.

eb846ba2faf20be2.name: play_camera_received_shot
eb846ba2faf20be2.doc: Shot of Max receiving the Camera: plays the get-camera motion and sound effects, then shows how to equip and use the Camera and the Inside Scoop Memo item message.

eb86073481c7d8d4.name: use_floor_gate_2
eb86073481c7d8d4.doc: Uses the floor gate with index 2.

ebb0e6af3b5a866a.name: run_timed_message_with_voice
ebb0e6af3b5a866a.doc: Runs a message for up to a given number of frames with talking animation and voice, ending early when the player dismisses it, then closes the window. Returns the frames elapsed.

ebd20bd1a0455f41.name: show_train_parts_normal
ebd20bd1a0455f41.doc: Swaps the train's pieces for the normal look: hides the pieces of train09, train10, train12, train14 and train15 variant 0 and shows the matching variant 1 pieces.

ebd32d4f99a15f53.name: play_dark_element_awakens_scene
ebd32d4f99a15f53.doc: Cutscene that sets flag 728. The Dark Element screams of its new power as the moon falls, calls Max and Monica foolish humans and hurls its staff at an ally who is badly hurt, and Max or Monica kneel beside the fallen friend before the final fight.

ec06d3212c81623d.name: play_conda_grape_juice_scene
ec06d3212c81623d.doc: Event 209: Conda warns Max and Monica about the Rainbow Butterfly in the forest and gives them Grape Juice to attract Firbits. Includes a magic effect at the flower. Sets flag 209.

ec09b4a514342892.name: start_dream_spiral_fight_1
ec09b4a514342892.doc: Applies the debug loadout and starts the first dream spiral boss event on map d06b02.

ec14395de4bdf121.name: load_toryon_models
ec14395de4bdf121.doc: Loads Toryon, its two trees, the leaf and focus line effects as inactive models, binding the sound bank to Toryon.

ec20282673701e1f.name: announce_results_and_clean_up
ec20282673701e1f.doc: Shows the tournament results and removes Max's extra motions.

ec331b994dca8c50.name: setup_s14_sound_and_lapis_point
ec331b994dca8c50.doc: Stops the BGM, loads sound set 3694 and hides the Lapis point once event 628 has been seen.

ec653b079ffcd03b.name: restart_metal_flotsam_fight
ec653b079ffcd03b.doc: Program 151: starts the Metal Flotsam fight again through start_metal_flotsam_fight.

ec7074776d203a0e.name: set_station_gate_visible
ec7074776d203a0e.doc: Shows or hides the p10_s48 map part.

ec7127b339ae36a3.name: say_claire_is_at_square
ec7127b339ae36a3.doc: At story progress 100 the resident says they do not know where Claire is and that she may be at the square drinking tea.

ec7b3298e93f9b9b.name: play_doctor_dell_diagnosis_scene
ec7b3298e93f9b9b.doc: Plays event 306. The duck doctor examines Lin and says toxic mist has hit her, and that only a miracle dish from Lao Chao's Bistro in Starlight Temple could cure her. The party plans to collect Geostones in Starlight Canyon.

ec904d67668d55ea.name: play_robot_breakdown_scene
ec904d67668d55ea.doc: Player-dead program; it only plays the robot breakdown sequence.

ec9f51a7c8087c32.name: talk_to_villager
ec9f51a7c8087c32.doc: Runs the shared villager talk handler.

eca73aa03785ab33.name: play_sea_dragon_boss_intro_scene
eca73aa03785ab33.doc: Boss intro: the sea dragon monster (e54e) idles in the water room, then attacks, dodges and attacks again under a title card, with BGM 190, before fading out.

eca92aa64b5a251c.name: play_gate_opening_scene
eca92aa64b5a251c.doc: Raises the gate map piece with sound effects after the Key Handle has been used.

ecbf3a91e76d7ffe.name: play_event_201_with_starter_items
ecbf3a91e76d7ffe.doc: Gives the first chapter starter items, plays event 201 and updates the train event point.

ecc7db5d26a645a0.name: setup_halloween_boss_battle
ecc7db5d26a645a0.doc: Boss start program: stops the music, loads the boss music (30), places Max in battle stance at a fixed spot, loads and places the boss monster 500, fades in and unpauses monster AI.

ece4fe6f88e70764.name: play_floor_arrival_door_scene
ece4fe6f88e70764.doc: Cutscene played on arriving at a floor: shows the dungeon logo or transition map while a pair of door pieces swings open and the character steps through, then explains any red, blue or white seal on the floor.

ecf5f012fb457726.name: monica_lets_go_of_rococo
ecf5f012fb457726.doc: Monica lets go of Rococo's beard and Rococo plays the matching release motion.

ecf785af8554e53e.name: enter_house_i01h01
ecf785af8554e53e.doc: Enables a function point, runs play_dawn_camera_scene, places the player and camera and goes inside house i01h01 at entrance 500.

ecfbc33475d8a4f1.name: play_shot_elephant_and_flotsam_appear
ecfbc33475d8a4f1.doc: Scene shot: an elephant stands in the room and Flotsam floats down from above.

ecfd475acbf183f9.name: clear_floor_after_monsters_defeated
ecfd475acbf183f9.doc: Runs the shared floor clear sequence when all monsters are defeated.

ed0c630efd56faef.name: play_colossus_mode_then_go_to_s32
ed0c630efd56faef.doc: Plays the Colossus mode scene and jumps to map s32 (Moon Flower Palace under attack by Paznos) at event 630.

ed27e671f5bb995e.name: check_strokes_left
ed27e671f5bb995e.doc: Checks the strokes left. When none remain it deletes the Spheda characters, stops the game and plays a sound if a bank is given.

ed31f4d24c746cb0.name: play_walk_scene_and_enter_i03h01a
ed31f4d24c746cb0.doc: Plays the Cedric walking-away camera scene, then enters interior i03h01a at entry 500.

ed583a2cce329325.name: warp_to_d06e01_event_610
ed583a2cce329325.doc: Clears the scene and starts event 610 on map d06e01.

ed625a9238403a9c.name: play_gaspard_home_then_d05b01
ed625a9238403a9c.doc: Plays the Gaspard returns home scene and loads dungeon d05b01 with event 571 without reloading the BGM.

edacdfd8b80de152.name: play_golem_slope_charge_left_columns
edacdfd8b80de152.doc: Variant of the slope charge in which only columns 0 to 2 of the golems run up the slope.

edad357927a606c5.name: test_talk_to_donny
edad357927a606c5.doc: Debug entry that sets flag 4 and runs the talk with Donny.

edba8f1f0108912d.name: play_walk_through_doors
edba8f1f0108912d.doc: Opening shot: the camera, with a wide projection restored afterwards, sees two actors walk through a pair of doors that swing open, with door sounds from sound_id. Returns 0.

edbcfaeac28600a4.name: restart_first_gaspard_fight
edbcfaeac28600a4.doc: Retry hook: restarts the first fight music (BGM 190) and places boss monster 512 at the origin.

edd6cbaad06da5ab.name: show_lift_robomb_hint
edd6cbaad06da5ab.doc: Event program in the Halloween boss room that pauses monsters and the player and shows a hint box on lifting the RoBomb by holding the R1 button and pressing the circle button.

edd86d0513385ab2.name: play_camera_lesson_and_give_camera
edd86d0513385ab2.doc: Event 500: hides Cedric, sets flags 18 and 21, plays the first lesson, sets progress to 3 and adds the Camera item to the inventory, then returns to the shop's normal script.

ee3ae58699598771.name: debug_play_mardan_scene
ee3ae58699598771.doc: Debug entry: plays the Mardan hooked scene, sets counter 3 to 5, refreshes the pond and shows the story points.

ee41a467c16208d1.name: on_debug_test
ee41a467c16208d1.doc: Debug entry that plays the Griffon curse scene.

ee4efe6e1df90710.name: pick_up_item_386
ee4efe6e1df90710.doc: The player walks to the event position and turns to it, then receives item 386 with a get message and the item limit menu opens.

ee57e2b914332166.name: start_boss_room_event
ee57e2b914332166.doc: Map start of the boss room. If the two treasure boxes are not both taken it plays the intro once (bit 8 of counter 20) and places the monsters. Then places the player and fades in.

ee5c3c9a8dd1043b.name: play_garek_scene_from_event
ee5c3c9a8dd1043b.doc: Plays the Garek Time Bomb scene.

ee6f49d7d6337559.name: ask_to_jump_to_paznos_bridge
ee6f49d7d6337559.doc: Asks whether to move to Paznos, Bridge. On yes it plays the sun warp effect, fades the party out and jumps to map s30.

ee7a94f1e8b5a96d.name: talk_aunt_polly_to_monica
ee7a94f1e8b5a96d.doc: Aunt Polly's two-part talk to Monica about Max being a good man, with an offer of bread in chapter 8.

ee836dd0022438a4.name: set_lao_chao_active
ee836dd0022438a4.doc: Shows or hides the Lao Chao character (found by id 200) in the restaurant by setting it active or inactive.

ee851ed038f0cae1.name: place_npc_group_and_wait_for_button
ee851ed038f0cae1.doc: Test scene: frames a fixed camera, places the player, seven event/nanahige tp02 models (slots 8 to 14) in their idle motion and Monica (slot 15) around them, then waits until Cross is pressed. Does not finish the event.

ee9d03ea620bb7b5.name: talk_mina_before_lesson
ee9d03ea620bb7b5.doc: Mina's two-part talk before the Spheda lesson flag is set: she feels unwell and the doctor found nothing wrong.

eea54fcfba67ab18.name: talk_to_npc_or_start_paznos_launch
eea54fcfba67ab18.doc: Handles talking. Galen Agaris (NPC 400) with flag 536 set and 540 not set asks if the heroes are ready, and on yes starts the Paznos launch. Anyone else gets the workshop villager talk handler.

eeaac83250daec81.name: play_rock_throw_scene_then_go_to_s71
eeaac83250daec81.doc: Plays the rock throw scene and jumps to map s71 (Moon Flower Palace Stop) at entry 590.

eec414032cd4b2dc.name: talk_ferdinand_early
eec414032cd4b2dc.doc: Ferdinand's talk before the first quest is cleared: he compares his cooking research to Max's machine discoveries.

eedfa39cc385539d.name: ask_leave_for_town
eedfa39cc385539d.doc: Asks whether to leave for town. Yes fades out and returns 1, no returns 0.

ef31c92598db8827.name: take_gate_exit_1
ef31c92598db8827.doc: Gate 1 handler: interacts with the second exit.

ef3c2d20ce4a3543.name: spawn_corinne_for_hide_and_seek
ef3c2d20ce4a3543.doc: Map start: runs the Corinne placement.

ef3d4f18e600ad58.name: play_lure_golems_closer_scene
ef3d4f18e600ad58.doc: Event 540. The golems approach and Lord Agaris says to wait and lure them closer. Sets flag 540.

ef9856a045e5416f.name: play_face_down_motion
ef9856a045e5416f.doc: Plays actor 1's face down motion into its loop. The parameter is not used.

efafc8ffa0bac2ea.name: play_alexandra_lament_scene
efafc8ffa0bac2ea.doc: Sets flag 724. A dejected figure walks alone and laments that he is without Alexandra, that humans fought and killed each other over shiny stones, and wishes they had never existed.

efb7010d4f3adb1d.name: give_bread_delivery_quest
efb7010d4f3adb1d.doc: Aunt Polly asks you to deliver 20 loaves of bread to Morton's shop and gives you the bread (item 300). Accepts quest 8 and resets counter 12.

efcc1a6ededcae54.name: ask_enter_or_depart
efcc1a6ededcae54.doc: Asks whether to go inside the train or leave. Cancelling returns 0; choosing leave fades out, opens the world map move menu and returns 0; choosing go inside returns 1.

efd5c61552e5c1ae.name: play_spikes_rise_scene
efd5c61552e5c1ae.doc: Sets flag 612. Spikes rise out of the ground at two places with sand dust and a shaking camera, then the scene fades out.

efd6211f66fb8b8d.name: play_nova_driver_cannon_talk_scene
efd6211f66fb8b8d.doc: Part of event 640: the party looks up and learns Paznos will use its strongest weapon, the Nova Driver Cannon.

efd73acb797338a6.name: play_event_508
efd73acb797338a6.doc: Event 508: sets the Time Bomb given flag. Max or Monica, their partner and Garek the plant manager talk on the Heim Rada workshop; Garek explains the Fire Squall, then hands over the Time Bomb (item 372) with the item get jingle and message. Fades out, restores the villager and places the player in town. Skippable.

efd8616a95663080.name: play_nova_driver_fire_and_go_to_s32
efd8616a95663080.doc: Plays the Nova Driver firing and jumps to map s32 at event 620.

efdd244ab4469798.name: start_yorda_tree_map
efdd244ab4469798.doc: Map start: if flag 300 is set and 332 is not, plays the Yorda Tree arrival scene; if 332 is set plays the meat grab scene. Then places the player and fades in.

efdda3de192c983a.name: setup_boss_617_arena
efdda3de192c983a.doc: Plays the boss awakens with flame scene (flag 724), then puts the player at (0, 0, -200) with the camera behind, shows the partners and status bar, loads and places Emperor Griffon form 617 at (0, 0, 150) facing the player and fades in.

efde66e9dd8d71c5.name: play_shot_crew_talk
efde66e9dd8d71c5.doc: Shot in the opening: the train crew gathers, Cedric asks if everything is set and the others answer. sound_id is unused.

efe2e0f4cde1b7d0.name: load_ixion_scene_actors
efe2e0f4cde1b7d0.doc: Loads the actors, images and sprites for the Ixion explanation scene: Max, Monica, Chap, Elena's hologram, Jaming's grandson and a researcher, plus seven story images. Party slots go in max_slot and monica_slot.

efe44a62b6c3ad8c.name: enter_f03i04_from_save_point
efe44a62b6c3ad8c.doc: Save point program: turns the player to face south, fades out, sets map counter 2 to 0 and jumps to map f03i04.

efefb990ce55e175.name: talk_aunt_polly_bread_return
efefb990ce55e175.doc: Aunt Polly after the bread errand. While counter 12 is under 3 she asks the player to wait and whether they visited Morton. Otherwise she gives up on the dispute, swaps 20 of item 300 for item 299, joins the party and quest 8 is marked cleared.

f006812a1260dba3.name: use_star_gate
f006812a1260dba3.doc: Handles the star-shaped gate. With the Fairy Saw menu open, using item 362 unlocks it: the star map piece is hidden and a star key model grows in view. Otherwise shows a hint message.

f02175a97fad59e5.name: place_player_on_map_start
f02175a97fad59e5.doc: Map start: places the player and fades in. After loading a save the player stands at the south start, from map 109 at the north entrance, otherwise at the south.

f024e40526583337.name: use_starglass_at_lighthouse
f024e40526583337.doc: Examining the spot offers the item menu; using the Starglass disables the event point, shows the title card and loads dungeon floor d03b02. Other items get a refusal reaction.

f02790276a4b9106.name: use_station_door_side_1
f02790276a4b9106.doc: Event 200: if door side 1 is open, plays the door sound, fades out, sets counter 15 to 1 and jumps to the station map; otherwise plays the refuse sound and motion.

f029d209baacd6fb.name: leave_station_for_moon_flower_palace
f029d209baacd6fb.doc: Asks to leave the station and jumps to s68 (Moon Flower Palace), or to g05 once flag 700 is set.

f02c376ee75d874b.name: poll_message_advance_input
f02c376ee75d874b.doc: Per-frame check of confirm and cancel while a message shows: plays the button sound, advances a paged message, cuts a scrolling message short (setting a1[0] to 2), and returns 1 when the final page is dismissed.

f038ae0f93e52f5b.name: can_play_event_556
f038ae0f93e52f5b.doc: Returns 1 when event 556 can play: analysis entry 410 is set and the event has not been seen. Otherwise 0.

f03c3f3ced78664a.name: talk_to_parn
f03c3f3ced78664a.doc: Picks Parn's reaction from the quest states: the plain greeting, the quest offer, the Gold Paint delivery or the afterwards talk.

f05ae91dabdd6e2e.name: play_voice_message_hold
f05ae91dabdd6e2e.doc: Plays a voice message with its text, then keeps the window open for the given hold frames before closing.

f073297d87104d2d.name: play_utan_moves_boulder_scene
f073297d87104d2d.doc: Sets flag 253. Max and Monica ask the recovered Master Utan to move a boulder blocking the way. He lifts it, hurts his back and sits down to rest while they thank him and go on.

f088d052df7eafa3.name: show_julia_joined_message
f088d052df7eafa3.doc: Shows the message that Julia joined the party and went to the train. Returns 1.

f09eaaeeaeaa3875.name: try_open_or_pass_gate
f09eaaeeaeaa3875.doc: Gate interaction. A closed gate asks for the Key Handle item (337); opening it plays the opening scene. An open gate asks whether to go to the next floor and then walks through. When the active character is 2 or 3 it only shows a short bubble line, and the first gate on floor 5 triggers the Mayor's Office event (flag 9).

f09f1482db22a5d3.name: play_lin_poison_diagnosis_scene
f09f1482db22a5d3.doc: Sets flag 306. Dr. Dell examines Lin and finds toxic mist poisoning that ordinary medicine cannot cure. Monica suggests the legendary chef Lao Chao, whose bistro will be in Starlight Temple, and the pair set off to restore it. Saves progress 5 and shows the chapter 3 title.

f0c12f23b4258e48.name: play_chrono_union_scene
f0c12f23b4258e48.doc: Event 640: Max and Monica walk forward while the Chrono Union takes effect and they see Paznos appear. Sets flag 640.

f0eb4e9c82df35d6.name: play_event_608_scene
f0eb4e9c82df35d6.doc: Calls play_emperor_griffon_reveal_scene, the Max and Monica scene for event 608.

f0efb9d3d4c4f9e2.name: play_scene_then_go_to_s66_620
f0efb9d3d4c4f9e2.doc: Plays play_paznos_cannon_hits_palace_scene (sets flag 640) and jumps to map s66 at event 620.

f0f8a118cf8297fc.name: confirm_leaving_tree_area
f0f8a118cf8297fc.doc: Checked before moving on. While Max or Monica is active it asks (or after flag 340 asks an item question) whether to go on; returns 1 and fades out if the party proceeds. Otherwise the character walks back a few steps and says Lin is worrying or suggests resting at the sacred tree.

f0fa91c731e85cb2.name: play_ridepod_departure_scene
f0fa91c731e85cb2.doc: Plays event 106 (sets flag 106): loads Max, Cedric and Steve, asks if Max is ready, and if so plays the ride-out cutscene on Steve. Restores the camera afterwards and returns 1 if they left.

f1308893af2e7c3e.name: talk_gordon_joined
f1308893af2e7c3e.doc: Gordon's talk after joining: Monica gets a polite greeting, Max a reminder to keep the holy water secret from his father, and in chapter 8 a remark about unknown plants. Then talk_to_npc.

f133a72f5e388763.name: play_retry_challenge_scene
f133a72f5e388763.doc: Event 108 variant (sets flag 108): asks to retry the challenge and, if accepted, plays the departure and sets flag 56. Returns 1 if the player is going.

f1497af0ea1ac788.name: show_string_substitution_test
f1497af0ea1ac788.doc: Debug test that sets message string 16 to a word and shows a sentence containing it.

f14a325d918f93d2.name: jump_through_door
f14a325d918f93d2.doc: Starts the door transition, waits 10 frames and runs the pending map jump.

f14b9314d82a0406.name: replay_mardan_meeting_scene
f14b9314d82a0406.doc: Story event 240: plays the Mardan meeting scene and sets the story counter to 5.

f14ef52bf3682cac.name: ask_bridge_jump_from_spot_2
f14ef52bf3682cac.doc: Sets counter 13 to 2 and asks about jumping to Paznos Bridge.

f177e09d9bb92147.name: play_broken_flower_scene
f177e09d9bb92147.doc: Event 704 (flag 704): a short voiced scene about a flower whose stem is broken and may die, and what to do with the flowers; ends by pointing out an item to the player.

f17d6f4d6fc2b695.name: check_scoop_reward
f17d6f4d6fc2b695.doc: Checks the photographer reward state. Returns 1 when rewards are waiting; otherwise says that more scoops are needed or how the photographer level is set, according to the hint type, and returns 0.

f17f589262b53d96.name: ask_if_ready_for_counterattack
f17f589262b53d96.doc: Turns the player and NPC to face each other, then the NPC says the counterattack on Griffon is about to start and asks if the player is prepared. Returns 1 on Yes; on No the NPC warns that the Golem Units are close and it returns 0.

f18641964818f0a2.name: open_item_chest
f18641964818f0a2.doc: Opens an item treasure chest: the lid shakes and opens, the item pops out, and the item is added with the item get message. If the bag is full a no room message shows instead, and an overflow menu opens when the bag is over the limit. Passing a negative item opens the chest with only the effect.

f19d48aadc6fe84d.name: take_gate_exit_0
f19d48aadc6fe84d.doc: Gate 0 handler: interacts with the first exit.

f20b2c6c18ee2d43.name: warp_to_s50_event_708
f20b2c6c18ee2d43.doc: Clears the scene and starts event 708 on map s50.

f2271f5eb2fca9ff.name: depart_for_veniccio_station
f2271f5eb2fca9ff.doc: Story event 360: plays the all aboard scene and the train leaving, then opens the world move menu and jumps to map s09 (Veniccio Station).

f22bd44deccf4478.name: setup_room_on_map_start
f22bd44deccf4478.doc: Pauses events, sets the room objects for the story flags and plays the run-in scene.

f23c4139ac4d5362.name: setup_cedric_house
f23c4139ac4d5362.doc: Sets up the house map: activates Cedric and, when the story progress is 3 and flag 7 is clear, loads Steve with his backpack depending on flags 107 and 20.

f240441c2291e57f.name: ask_to_leave_finny_frenzy
f240441c2291e57f.doc: Asks whether to leave the Finny Frenzy, warning that the tournament ends if a race was started. In extra mode offers saving and a return to the title screen. If yes, returns to Palm Brinks Square (s45).

f249826230a84448.name: use_second_floor_gate
f249826230a84448.doc: Uses the second exit of the floor.

f25845b93d3dc974.name: play_ride_pod_tip_shot
f25845b93d3dc974.doc: Shot where Cedric cheers that Steve can fight longer, followed by the tip on using the Ride Pod from the Main Menu or the R3 button.

f27693b341a78a76.name: run_s60_event_and_exit
f27693b341a78a76.doc: Runs play_ending_movie_with_captions, sets the exit flag and returns 0.

f276e02f14c5026b.name: trigger_silent_game_over
f276e02f14c5026b.doc: Runs the dungeon game over sequence with no voice line and revive 0, so a defeat without a switchable partner sets the exit flag.

f2826ccde5755cb5.name: play_time_gate_scene_then_load_script
f2826ccde5755cb5.doc: Fades out, plays the Time Gate scene and loads the g01 event script.

f2a1c471dd1310c4.name: play_need_scene_then_pierrot_fight
f2a1c471dd1310c4.doc: Plays the Mayor Need scene and then the opening Pierrot fight.

f2af8e4825f39257.name: show_lift_robomb_hint
f2af8e4825f39257.doc: Event program in the Halloween boss room that pauses monsters and the player and shows a hint box on lifting the RoBomb by holding the R1 button and pressing the circle button.

f2b0359ba024b029.name: arrive_by_lift_then_enter_d06
f2b0359ba024b029.doc: Plays the arrival warp scene then loads dungeon d06e01 at entry 508.

f2dba95c3f3db856.name: walk_to_next_train_car
f2dba95c3f3db856.doc: Program 203: unless already in the last car (counter 0 is 3), moves to the next car by raising counter 0, reloading its NPCs and placing the player at its entrance.

f2dcc449cab59544.name: play_ending_moon_scene
f2dcc449cab59544.doc: Ending cutscene (flag 732): Max and Monica talk about Sirus, Emperor Griffon being an illusion of men's evil, the single moon in the sky and how people will forget the adventure.

f3090f49b9469a31.name: load_osmond
f3090f49b9469a31.doc: Loads Osmond (model p00_31a) as the station villager at a fixed spot facing back, with character id 301.

f31f49ad03d72435.name: talk_to_station_npc
f31f49ad03d72435.doc: Talks with the NPC the player interacted with: Cedric asks about departure and returns 1 if the player agrees, the others are Borneo the mechanic, Erik the bomber and Osmond waiting.

f3269bd2c4728c03.name: can_play_event_285
f3269bd2c4728c03.doc: Returns 1 when Sindain's event 285 can play: the town is 100 percent restored, the event has not been seen, and the party can switch to character 1 (Monica). Otherwise 0.

f3311695e040032a.name: load_world_explained_actors
f3311695e040032a.doc: Loads Max, Cedric, Vorneo, Tom, the coal pile, a map piece and four story images for event 203.

f344a6b93e26369d.name: play_halloween_defeat_scene
f344a6b93e26369d.doc: Event 600 of the boss floor: only runs the Halloween boss clear cutscene (flag 111 set, Max hands over to Mints and the Halloween actor collapses and explodes).

f3484cfbd992bec9.name: play_circus_opening_part_two
f3484cfbd992bec9.doc: Second part of the circus opening: the elephant and the finale acts, ending by deleting the performers and stopping the sounds.

f34bc65045573a56.name: play_electric_worm_scene
f34bc65045573a56.doc: Event 412 at Dr. Osmond's lab. Max and Monica wake the sleeping Osmond and ask how to free the controlled sea dragon (Shigura). He gives them an Electric Worm (item 360) and explains it must be fed to a fish in an Aquarium; his hint depends on whether the player owns an Aquarium (item 309) or has its invention plan. Sets flag 412.

f356a0a044787c8a.name: play_dr_dell_recruit_scene_on_entry
f356a0a044787c8a.doc: Map start: when flag 304 is set and 305 is not, hides the Dr. Dell villager, plays the scene where Max asks Dr. Dell to come help a sick girl, restores the villager and walks outside to map m05.

f35b9efab638823f.name: play_sirus_hug_then_jump_to_d06b03
f35b9efab638823f.doc: Plays the Sirus hug scene and jumps to map d06b03 at entry 510.

f35f4c5b70b06a2e.name: play_golem_slope_charge_right_columns
f35f4c5b70b06a2e.doc: Variant of the slope charge in which only columns 6 to 9 of the golems run up the slope.

f360f2a7199d28c9.name: run_voice_message
f360f2a7199d28c9.doc: Runs a voice message window: lip sync follows the stream, the message ends when the player confirms or, with captions off, when the stream finishes. Stops the stream and returns the frames waited.

f3640c0b1d236801.name: start_shop_talk_for_aunt_polly
f3640c0b1d236801.doc: Sets the event character to Aunt Polly in slot 24; when story progress is 100 greets the player and opens the shop, otherwise runs the normal villager talk.

f3782524818e191d.name: play_lighthouse_on_fire_scene
f3782524818e191d.doc: Cutscene that opens the Gaspard fight. Max and Monica arrive at the burning lighthouse, recognise Gaspard, and Crest tells Lin to wait while he goes to use the crystal.

f39afc379c0e2264.name: talk_aunt_polly_after_joining
f39afc379c0e2264.doc: Aunt Polly's chatter after the bread delivery quest is cleared, asking where to go next. Chapter 8 swaps in an offer of bread.

f3a277dffdc69460.name: talk_claire_monica
f3a277dffdc69460.doc: Claire's talk to Monica: greets her as Max's girlfriend and compliments her hair.

f3ba3814adc30908.name: play_moon_mural_scene
f3ba3814adc30908.doc: Plays event 408, in which Max and Monica examine a mural called Moon of Destruction.

f3cc451188bce35b.name: choose_dungeon_floor_and_enter
f3cc451188bce35b.doc: Opens the dungeon 1 floor map. Cancel runs Max back in, option 6 jumps to map s05 (Fish Monster Swamp), and anything else starts that dungeon floor.

f3d0f2baccd6435e.name: play_voice_message_text_timed
f3d0f2baccd6435e.doc: Opens and prepares a voice stream, shows its message and runs the lip sync for up to the given frames.

f3dc409e725b139b.name: play_utan_poison_apple_scene
f3dc409e725b139b.doc: Event 230: Max and Monica find Master Utan frozen after eating the Forbidden Fruit. He explains about the Holy One, a fish said to live in the swamp, and they head there. Sets flag 230.

f3ef8d4a68cdb39f.name: play_npc_talk_turning_both
f3ef8d4a68cdb39f.doc: Turns the player and NPC toward each other, shows the message, optionally turns the NPC back to its original yaw (a3) and ends the event, with a crossfade when a2 is set.

f3f882279e97bf5c.name: ask_to_change_floor
f3f882279e97bf5c.doc: Asks whether to proceed to the next floor (or return to the previous one). Returns 1 and fades out on yes, 0 on no.

f405a1130e3a62b1.name: talk_to_contest_judge
f405a1130e3a62b1.doc: The contest judge. Max can weigh a caught fish, hear the rules, view the weight list or Total Up. Weighing opens the fish menu, shows a scale animation with the weight and length digits, and comments on the size. Monica or other characters only get a short explanation.

f41382d1c450ddd4.name: show_message_for_chara
f41382d1c450ddd4.doc: Shows system message 60 plus chara in window 1. Returns 1.

f42410f38e09c466.name: talk_blinkhorn_busy_away
f42410f38e09c466.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk when he is not at his post by the gate: he says he is busy gathering materials for the town's safety and asks Max to come back tomorrow.

f42a4643c10b812a.name: show_windflower_hint_check_menu
f42a4643c10b812a.doc: Shows the hint to give a White Windflower to have a miracle dish made, with a prompt to press the menu button. Returns 1 if the player pressed the menu button (to open the item menu), otherwise 0.

f44053b87d6b72cd.name: show_villager_chatter
f44053b87d6b72cd.doc: Shows the idle line for a villager by their character number. In chapter 8 it shows the late-game party member line instead. Cedric has a different line the first time (flag 57).

f442c30a8661bbcd.name: play_geostone_lesson_then_go_to_sindain
f442c30a8661bbcd.doc: Plays the Geostone lesson and jumps to map g01 entry 506.

f44a0286620cfb43.name: show_game_over
f44a0286620cfb43.doc: Plays one of two voiced game over lines while the Marionette fight is on, otherwise the silent game over.

f45c4dbcbfecea0f.name: setup_map_fade_in
f45c4dbcbfecea0f.doc: Setup program: allows dungeon map movement and fades in.

f46552a2536b6378.name: play_fire_rain_source_scene
f46552a2536b6378.doc: Sets flag 512. Max and Monica run into view of the source of the fire rain; Max points and says that is it, and they decide to destroy it. Skippable.

f46c9e885626a3f5.name: start_s02b_script_503
f46c9e885626a3f5.doc: Program 503: starts an event and loads script s02/s02b_1.stb as program 503.

f4807f3b0e74be9d.name: talk_adel_after_joining
f4807f3b0e74be9d.doc: Adel's chatter after the clothing quest is cleared, asking how the garment fits. Chapter 8 swaps in a prayer for safety.

f49f14c46b76a46d.name: replay_murals_scene
f49f14c46b76a46d.doc: Story jump: sets earlier story flags, clears 408 and replays event 408, then opens Pau's House in Georama.

f4a68dcd3a7e6421.name: play_twin_nail_burst_intro_scene
f4a68dcd3a7e6421.doc: Intro for the twin Nail Burst room: two Nail Bursts (model e202d) stand in the room, attack once while their caption card fades in, then the scene fades out and the models are removed.

f4ad0019ffafcd87.name: play_back_golems_march_shot
f4ad0019ffafcd87.doc: Variant of the golem march in which only golems 60 to 99 march toward the camera.

f4afa134af8ef2c8.name: play_event_548
f4afa134af8ef2c8.doc: Event 548, the arrival at Heim Rada: Max and Monica walk in and talk about the Great Workshop (Gundorada), with camera flybys of the settlement, the mountain and the site where Paznos was built. Sets the seen flag. Skippable.

f4b35cc99e4f69d1.name: talk_villager_by_kind
f4b35cc99e4f69d1.doc: Calls the generic villager talk when the talked-to character number is below 100 or above 1000; other characters are handled elsewhere.

f4b83c842280cbbe.name: leave_for_operations_room
f4b83c842280cbbe.doc: Fades out and jumps to the Operations Room (s39).

f4c5d2820837be0f.name: cleanup_event_207
f4c5d2820837be0f.doc: Tears down the event 207 actors. Keeps the active player's character, deletes the other's scene model and extras, and removes the sprites and image.

f4d0ae882304c828.name: play_cannot_understand_shigura_scene
f4d0ae882304c828.doc: Event 436 variant played when the player talks to a Shigura without the Shell Talkie: Max and Monica cannot understand them.

f4e3191191998a39.name: play_s47_scene_and_fade_in
f4e3191191998a39.doc: Runs the s47 scene and fades in.

f4e3b0e75d1f0a05.name: setup_bonus_room
f4e3b0e75d1f0a05.doc: Plays the intro scene once (counter 20 bit 1), places the two monsters while a chest is still unclaimed and puts the player at the south end of the room.

f4e4111a58486dfd.name: pan_camera_over_arena
f4e4111a58486dfd.doc: Freezes monsters and the player and holds a high camera shot for 300 frames.

f4eb3a39f50cb0c0.name: play_train_arrival_cutscene_debug
f4eb3a39f50cb0c0.doc: Debug test program; it only plays the short train arrival cutscene.

f4fdf16cab9d10fc.name: show_cedric_scolds_mayor
f4fdf16cab9d10fc.doc: Cedric shouts at Need for being an ignoramus and a poor mayor.

f52c7a8a489e1dd5.name: enter_dungeon_from_channel
f52c7a8a489e1dd5.doc: Dungeon entrance. Before the story scene it plays the Donny hint. Otherwise it asks to enter, opens the dungeon tree map and starts the chosen floor; floor 3 with flag 102 unset goes to edit mode 41 (Maximilian's Room) instead.

f53187deeb45c32b.name: leave_for_luna_lab
f53187deeb45c32b.doc: Plays the red time gate warp with the party check and jumps to map f03 (Luna Lab).

f53df3debb583e62.name: play_crest_lecture_then_go_to_station
f53df3debb583e62.doc: Sets up the doors, plays the Crest lecture scene and then jumps to map s04 (Balance Valley Station).

f541cb4592ff3be6.name: play_rococo_encounter_scene
f541cb4592ff3be6.doc: Event 208: Max and Monica find Rococo asleep on a roof, wake him and he runs away. Sets flag 208, uses the g010701 edit part as the world origin and ends with the party back under player control.

f5567b7ff6fb9791.name: play_sea_story_scene_then_start_dungeon_4
f5567b7ff6fb9791.doc: Plays the sea story scene and starts dungeon d04 on floor f02.

f563d507053c8466.name: show_stop_hint
f563d507053c8466.doc: Shows the Italian hint text that the spinning meter is stopped with the button, in message window 1 at the bottom, without waiting.

f56ce6b7268adff0.name: play_train_departure_event
f56ce6b7268adff0.doc: Opening-scene cutscene of the train leaving the station: sets the departure-seen and train-running flags, loads the crew (Starble, Borneo, Tom), Need and the train effects, and plays the shots in order (crew talk, Tom's reply, the call to depart, the crew running, lights, doors, engine start, pulling out, Need watching it go). Skippable; cleans up and fades back in at the end.

f5798de93aff00a2.name: talk_to_swamp_elder
f5798de93aff00a2.doc: Talk with the swamp elder: his lines about the Holy One depend on flags 240 and 253.

f5806256103706ee.name: talk_milane
f5806256103706ee.doc: Milane's talk dispatcher. Max gets his own talk. Otherwise quest 0 not yet at state 2 gives her early talk; after that quest 10's state picks the quest offer (0), the sword check (1) or the joined talk (2). Returns 0.

f58d1102ee3da380.name: talk_rosa_early
f58d1102ee3da380.doc: Rosa's line before the player has progressed far enough: she says she is hard of hearing.

f58f1117a8fa16a7.name: play_debug_camera_scene
f58f1117a8fa16a7.doc: Debug entry that plays the camera flyover test scene.

f591db0121c9d6d0.name: play_train_pass_shot
f591db0121c9d6d0.doc: Cuts to a low camera as the train runs past it.

f5bd38a52dcea53f.name: play_train_doors_open_arrival
f5bd38a52dcea53f.doc: Short entrance scene with a longer train: six door parts swing open, the player runs out of the train onto the platform and the camera moves behind them.

f5be1456cc7d21c7.name: play_lin_tribute_ending_short_copy
f5be1456cc7d21c7.doc: Copy of the shorter tribute ending, used by the helper-based lecture scene when analysis flag 207 is not set.

f5bf7f84441088b8.name: play_dark_genie_intro_scene
f5bf7f84441088b8.doc: Program for story event 816: plays the scene where Max and Monica find Zelmite ore and the Dark Genie appears.

f5da02872bdeb881.name: talk_blinkhorn_to_monica
f5da02872bdeb881.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk when Monica is the active character: a remark about women with swords, or an offer of help in chapter 8.

f5ddc9cb00ebe70c.name: talk_aunt_polly_joined
f5ddc9cb00ebe70c.doc: Aunt Polly's talk after joining: suggests setting off, or in chapter 8 invites the player to come for bread. Then talk_to_npc.

f5e0bc636a46e096.name: play_donny_second_call_scene
f5e0bc636a46e096.doc: Event 102: sets flag 102, stages Max with the receiver at the floor entrance and plays Donny's call, then returns control with the camera behind the player.

f5e72a295115521f.name: debug_play_seed_scene
f5e72a295115521f.doc: Debug entry that plays the Lafrescia Seed scene.

f5ed365490fbdea2.name: talk_stewart_after_joining
f5ed365490fbdea2.doc: Stewart's chatter after the book auction quest is cleared, about the book he got. Chapter 8 swaps in a warning about Zelmite Mine.

f5f2f9f8b54d69ae.name: talk_blinkhorn_early
f5f2f9f8b54d69ae.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's talk before the first quest is cleared: he complains that the town is too peaceful to give him any work.

f60cd2ebd6e1232e.name: play_paznos_cannon_hits_palace_scene
f60cd2ebd6e1232e.doc: Sets flag 640. Paznos fires its cannon and the shot hits the left side of the Moonflower Palace with an explosion, smoke and a shaking camera, then the scene fades out.

f60eee66cfb2f067.name: cleanup_toryon_scene_cast
f60eee66cfb2f067.doc: Removes the extra characters loaded for the Toryon scene (event 616), keeps the active party member, finishes the event and waits a frame.

f61ea5f8ebede178.name: play_parn_quest_offer_scene
f61ea5f8ebede178.doc: Cutscene where Parn explains that magical artists can bring drawings to life only with Gold Paint made from a Golden Egg, and asks Max to bring some in return for his new power.

f64bd1e845c0a04e.name: play_crying_child_camera_pan
f64bd1e845c0a04e.doc: Test shot from event 102: hides the player, places the crying child and Eina (e102 models) at the same spot playing the cry motion, freezes time at noon and slowly turns the camera's look-at point around a fixed camera position for 700 frames, then waits 300 more before giving control back.

f6697bde6b1b566a.name: leave_for_g05_if_confirmed
f6697bde6b1b566a.doc: After a confirmation, jumps to map g05 (Moon Flower Palace).

f6726946fbc70e33.name: setup_fishing_tournament
f6726946fbc70e33.doc: Resets the image and sound globals, blocks map movement, spawns the villagers, loads the tournament prizes, shows map part p16_i03h03, loads the fishing tournament sound bank (EN_903) on the enemy port, places the player and fades in.

f673909c3755e14d.name: start_s06c_1_event_500
f673909c3755e14d.doc: Starts event 500 in the s06 06c_1 script.

f67eddf4607e42db.name: play_beam_hits_paznos_then_go_to_stonehenge
f67eddf4607e42db.doc: Plays the beam hitting Paznos and jumps to map s66 (Kazarov Stonehenge). Returns 0.

f6838875b070b122.name: load_s05b_event_501
f6838875b070b122.doc: Initialises the event and loads event script s05b_1 with event 501.

f6d6cfc3f79e456d.name: play_chase_toward_sea_scene
f6d6cfc3f79e456d.doc: Event 404 (sets flag 404). The party sees someone heading toward the sea and decides to follow.

f6db0fa0f3cd6d36.name: party_looks_at_each_other
f6db0fa0f3cd6d36.doc: Monica looks at Max, then Max looks at Monica, with pauses between.

f6e075b0d37d60fc.name: jump_to_m02_at_entrance
f6e075b0d37d60fc.doc: Jumps to map m02 and places the player at the entrance position. Returns 0.

f6fb6c1e85770c32.name: show_plain_pending_event_notice
f6fb6c1e85770c32.doc: Calls show_pending_event_notice without the alternate text.

f71358d14a66f5d8.name: warp_to_d02b02_point_2600
f71358d14a66f5d8.doc: Clears the scene and loads dungeon d02b02 at event code 2600 plus 10000.

f71cd5f06f59d9b4.name: ask_waiting_npc_if_ready_to_depart
f71cd5f06f59d9b4.doc: Asks the partner who waits at the station whether they are ready to go. The first time the partner explains Chrono Unions; later the event 648 voiced prompt is used. Returns 1 if the player chose to go.

f72421ecdf591a39.name: play_far_view_shot_without_golems
f72421ecdf591a39.doc: Event 540 variant: a fixed camera looks at the p03_s55 map part at night for about 70 frames with no golems.

f751d4353228ddc9.name: play_far_view_shot_without_golems
f751d4353228ddc9.doc: Event 540 variant: a fixed camera looks at the p03_s55 map part at night for about 70 frames with no golems.

f75db31b4bbe3239.name: show_time_travel_caption
f75db31b4bbe3239.doc: After flag 612 is set, shows a white screen with a caption that the party jumped to the future (or returned to the present) with the Ixion's time-travelling mechanism. Returns 0 without showing anything before that flag.

f7602275695d9fb6.name: show_georama_progress_2_title
f7602275695d9fb6.doc: Shows the caption card for Georama progress 2, the flower garden complete.

f76c5fc51b5c50ae.name: play_floor_clear_sequence
f76c5fc51b5c50ae.doc: Runs the floor cleared scene: the active character strikes a victory pose, the camera returns to the last view, medal messages for a fast clear or the floor challenge are shown, and any red, blue or white seal on the floor is lifted with a message.

f772338682c5b57f.name: unload_lafrescia_light_scene
f772338682c5b57f.doc: Ends the Lafrescia light scene: reactivates the player's character, deletes the temporary actors and effect scripts and unloads the message file.

f772f7f0a3c61e1d.name: run_game_over_in_dark_genie_fight
f772f7f0a3c61e1d.doc: Player-dead handler: during the Dark Genie fight (flag 816 set and 820 clear) picks one of two voiced game over lines at random, otherwise runs the silent game over.

f77cf9c4b15fc640.name: play_earth_gem_get_scene
f77cf9c4b15fc640.doc: Sets flag 624 and plays the Lapis pickup scene: the character gasps, the lapis appears and the Earth Gem item message shows.

f77db6a4e275d4d6.name: start_villager_conversation
f77db6a4e275d4d6.doc: Starts a conversation with the villager the player is facing.

f785d78947307f51.name: play_arrive_without_talkie_scene
f785d78947307f51.doc: Event 436, sets flag 436: Max and Monica reach Shigura Village without the Shell Talkie and wonder how to find the medicine.

f7909dc12e156805.name: start_lapis_room_event
f7909dc12e156805.doc: Map start of the Lapis room. Before the Lapis is taken it plays the guardian intro, disables the lapis point, places monster 609 and blocks map movement. Then places the player and fades in.

f798473bb76567a1.name: use_condor_perch
f798473bb76567a1.doc: Handles the condor's perch exit. Offering Giant Meat (item 341) calls the condor, then asks to be carried to the next floor, showing any medal result. Declining gives the meat back. Other party characters just comment.

f79f8a796949c0f6.name: cleanup_event_209
f79f8a796949c0f6.doc: Cleans up after event 209: re-activates whichever of Max or Monica is the active character, deactivates and unloads the other and its extra motions, and deletes the event characters 33 and 36 to 46.

f7b46dd12c6fe0c7.name: play_floor_clear_sequence
f7b46dd12c6fe0c7.doc: Floor clear event (Spanish text version): pauses pickups, clears monsters, plays the victory pose, opens the exit door, marks the floor cleared in the floor info, shows the medal messages, announces any broken seal and the Spheda sub-game messages, and offers to move to the ball.

f7bc33df2cb75b8f.name: setup_station_map
f7bc33df2cb75b8f.doc: Sets up the s09 station map: swaps the map part once flag 448 is set, hides the train steps and places the station villagers.

f7c8e33e7cbaef37.name: ask_to_travel_to_past
f7c8e33e7cbaef37.doc: Talk to the time spot. Without a Starglass (item 371) shows hints about getting back to the past and the Stella Temple shop. With one, asks to use it and returns 1 if the player agrees.

f7d03788cc852d4a.name: start_six_town_character_motions
f7d03788cc852d4a.doc: Gives the six town NPC actors their idle motions: stand, stand, walk, run, sit, walk.

f7d4ea1141006176.name: play_lin_tribute_ending_with_star_copy
f7d4ea1141006176.doc: Copy of the tribute ending with the shooting star, used by the helper-based lecture scene when analysis flag 207 is set.

f7e5cc2e529fc26b.name: set_barrier_visible
f7e5cc2e529fc26b.doc: Shows or hides the s19_02 map part.

f7ea467eebe8cea9.name: play_intro_then_wait_for_confirm
f7ea467eebe8cea9.doc: Plays the intro scene and then waits for the confirm button.

f7ea5a60871d414b.name: hide_map_part_if_flag_372
f7ea5a60871d414b.doc: Hides map part p09_s04 once flag 372 is set.

f8277583ce096252.name: show_station_parts_late
f8277583ce096252.doc: Swaps the train's station part pieces from the early set to the later set by hiding some and showing others.

f828d55b42e14281.name: play_sea_dragon_intro_scene
f828d55b42e14281.doc: Plays the sea dragon boss introduction scene.

f8344103ebe0e97b.name: place_elevator_platforms
f8344103ebe0e97b.doc: Sets the height of the elevator (p09) and platform (p24) map parts of f04 from counter 14: floor 0, 1 or 2 puts them at y 0, 1160 or 2320.

f83c9e6520be0521.name: show_notice_or_party_cancel_letter
f83c9e6520be0521.doc: At progress 100 shows the notice message and resets the edit event, otherwise shows the party cancel letter.

f83e097943db4f50.name: enter_forest_if_confirmed
f83e097943db4f50.doc: Asks about the forest exit and opens the dungeon floor menu if confirmed.

f8477a68f7ea2a01.name: offer_ball_reset
f8477a68f7ea2a01.doc: Spheda golf: asks whether to move the ball to the player's feet (yes/no). On yes it puts the ball and its two characters 3 units above the player, uses up a stroke and crossfades.

f85232adb71395e0.name: examine_egg_for_gold_paint
f85232adb71395e0.doc: The first time, gives the Gold Paint (item 376) from the egg. After that it only says it wonders what the egg will hatch.

f856d9b3c8dfe0dc.name: talk_blinkhorn_early
f856d9b3c8dfe0dc.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's early talk: he complains the town is too peaceful for him to be of use.

f85f08be3948829f.name: can_play_event_448
f85f08be3948829f.doc: Returns 1 when analysis flag 305 is set, event 448 has not been played and the party can switch characters.

f86c66387fc75bae.name: play_voice_message_close_at
f86c66387fc75bae.doc: Plays a voice line from a stream with its text shown and the lip sync running, closing the message window at close_frame.

f86ff5ddbca3a9a2.name: turn_to_face_chara
f86ff5ddbca3a9a2.doc: Turns character chara smoothly to face character target, sets the exact yaw and the stand motion.

f87fd3495b6c4d7c.name: show_stop_button_hint
f87fd3495b6c4d7c.doc: Shows a hint at the bottom of the screen that (O) stops it, in Japanese or English depending on the language.

f8aea02360ef06fa.name: play_train_passing_demo
f8aea02360ef06fa.doc: Debug demo: a train and the player character run past the camera on the tracks, then waits for a pad press.

f8d4ed1baaec9785.name: talk_parn_after_joining
f8d4ed1baaec9785.doc: Parn's chatter after the gold paint quest is cleared, about his new power. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about the depth of painting.

f8f12bd3bab2c998.name: play_holly_goodbye_scene
f8f12bd3bab2c998.doc: Event 280: Holly's recorded farewell, the Firbits say they knew she was not human and want to join the journey, and the scene returns to map s02.

f8f37a18258e2f3e.name: cleanup_e202_charas
f8f37a18258e2f3e.doc: Cleans up after event 202: re-activates Max, deactivates and unloads character 9 and its motions, and deletes character 10.

f8f63ae23e7fd69c.name: replay_story_event_376
f8f63ae23e7fd69c.doc: Story program for event 376: sets the Georama analysis flags 0 to 9 and the story event flags 364, 368, 372 and 376 (0 for the one to replay) and jumps to map 26.

f8fffd8c2092b540.name: load_potato_pie_scene_actors
f8fffd8c2092b540.doc: Loads the actors for the potato pie scene: the mother and child, the pies and a plate, plus the message file.

f930b62425cf0427.name: show_rainbow_butterfly_clue_hint
f930b62425cf0427.doc: Shows a hint that nothing works against the Rainbow Butterfly and that the Lafrescia flower, which bloomed just before it appeared, may hold the clue.

f931e100ac52ebf3.name: talk_gerald_after_joining
f931e100ac52ebf3.doc: Gerald's chatter after the gun quest is cleared, warning that guns are not toys. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about rebuilding the world.

f9460a6fa7092ebd.name: play_farewell_then_jump_to_i04h01
f9460a6fa7092ebd.doc: Fades out, plays the final farewell between Max and Monica and jumps to map i04h01 at entry 530.

f94e190351768a1d.name: talk_olivie
f94e190351768a1d.doc: Olivie's talk dispatcher. Quest 0 not yet at state 2, or the tournament cycle flag unset, gives her early talk; after that quest 16's state picks the quest offer (0), the race-won talk (1) or the joined talk (2). Returns 0.

f95e25a097ccb6b1.name: play_party_withdraws_scene
f95e25a097ccb6b1.doc: Sets flag 410 and plays event 410: after seeing Shingala controlled, the party decides to come up with a plan.

f96a417dc60c0ad5.name: open_seaside_dungeon_menu
f96a417dc60c0ad5.doc: Before event 404 only steps back from the cave. Afterwards asks to enter the cave, opens the dungeon tree map for stage 3 and loads the chosen floor. Floor 20 goes to Shigura Village (d04b01) when flags 438 and 444 do not call for the dungeon.

f96b1b9084f588c0.name: play_ticket_snatch_scene
f96b1b9084f588c0.doc: Plays the opening scene: the character hands over a ticket at the gate, a boy snatches it and runs off, the character gives chase, loses him and sighs. Then it shows the hint to find the boy and ask people in town.

f96cd194dc0dc305.name: board_train_by_car
f96cd194dc0dc305.doc: Asks whether to board. It sets counter 1 to 2 and jumps to the locomotive (s08, or s37 Ixion engine room in chapters 6 and 7) or to the train cars (s07, or s38 Ixion guest room).

f96cf98c0a1a9607.name: play_beam_hits_paznos_scene
f96cf98c0a1a9607.doc: Event 640 cutscene variant with the Paznos model. Used by program 620, which jumps to map s66 (Kazarov Stonehenge). Sets flag 640.

f96db45264270757.name: wait_bg_load_done
f96db45264270757.doc: Waits until the background load has finished.

f9720caaba2db24b.name: show_julia_joined_message
f9720caaba2db24b.doc: Shows the system message that Julia joined the party. Returns 1.

f97772356410c764.name: restart_s05_story_script
f97772356410c764.doc: Fades out, deletes the forest characters, plays the scene where Utan moves the boulder, sets counter 3 to 8, shows the story points, sets the forest characters up again and loads event script s05/s05_1.stb.

f97a4c85be5c7a57.name: play_floor_arrival_scene
f97a4c85be5c7a57.doc: Cutscene played when arriving on a floor: a condor drops the character off carrying Giant Meat. It shows either the dungeon logo or the transition map, then if the floor has a red, blue or white seal explains what it prevents (switching to a character, or healing).

f9893ffc0800cffa.name: unload_event_372_scene
f9893ffc0800cffa.doc: Ends event 372: reactivates the player's character and removes the temporary characters.

f9a95d9cb839bb31.name: setup_and_play_first_sea_scene
f9a95d9cb839bb31.doc: Story 402 program: sets up the map objects and plays the first sea scene.

f9b66b8a278fb89f.name: open_treasure_chest_event
f9b66b8a278fb89f.doc: Opens a treasure chest: for a chest with one item shows the normal chest opening, and for two items plays the Happy Clown two-chest scene. Ridepod forms get the matching stand motion first.

f9b9d0de24279e4d.name: show_slot_bubble_message_with_anim
f9b9d0de24279e4d.doc: Same as show_bubble_message_with_anim but also selects the message window slot during the message.

f9bfd94d1c998984.name: play_camera_pan_at_entrance
f9bfd94d1c998984.doc: Hides the player and the battleship and pans the camera's look-at point in an arc around a fixed camera position for 600 frames before returning control.

f9c72a35ef59e4c3.name: play_beam_escape_scene_then_go_to_s26
f9c72a35ef59e4c3.doc: Plays the Moonflower beam escape scene and jumps to map s26 (Carpenterion Outer) at entry 550.

f9e2345577d7ef78.name: play_golem_slope_charge_right_columns
f9e2345577d7ef78.doc: Variant of the slope charge in which only columns 6 to 9 of the golems run up the slope.

fa07b7a8498b249a.name: play_paznos_becomes_robot_scene
fa07b7a8498b249a.doc: Sets flag 640. Max and Monica look up in surprise as Paznos transforms into a robot, with music 33.

fa098c0b211ecac7.name: play_paznos_appears_then_enter_bridge
fa098c0b211ecac7.doc: Plays Paznos appearing and jumps to s30 (Paznos bridge) at entry 610.

fa0e3317e37255f5.name: jump_to_event_280
fa0e3317e37255f5.doc: Sets the Georama analyze flags and story flags 270 to 285 so that only event 280 is still pending (its flag cleared to 0), then jumps to map 25 and waits. Also sets flag 260.

fa0e56ebfb338530.name: play_atlamillia_glow_scene
fa0e56ebfb338530.doc: Sets flag 523. Max watches his Atlamillia activate and glow, then the scene waits for a button press and fades out.

fa1b5f08eb34afa9.name: start_holly_thanks_scene
fa1b5f08eb34afa9.doc: Story trigger for event 260: plays Holly's thanks scene.

fa378f05ab52b981.name: restore_party_after_scene
fa378f05ab52b981.doc: Cleans up after the final boss cutscenes: reactivates the active party member, deletes the other scene characters and equipment models, shows the handles and status bar, and finishes the event.

fa5a3cf28b3fa87d.name: ask_enter_dungeon
fa5a3cf28b3fa87d.doc: Asks whether to enter the dungeon. On yes the player runs along a short path, the screen fades out and it returns 1; on no the player steps back, walks away and it returns 0.

fa6487d4390edfc7.name: setup_s20_and_play_arrival
fa6487d4390edfc7.doc: Runs setup_s20_map, then plays event 512 if flag 508 is set and 512 is not, otherwise the plain run-in scene.

fa7dfe8827b02dff.name: play_monster_pack_intro_scene
fa7dfe8827b02dff.doc: Intro cutscene of the room: six e216d monsters appear and attack in the room while a banner image fades in, then the player returns and the scene fades back in.

fa7eb86432ad6619.name: ask_to_go_to_balance_valley
fa7eb86432ad6619.doc: Asks whether to move to Balance Valley. On yes Max runs up the path and the screen fades out and it returns 1; on no he steps back and it returns 0.

fa95a681be968847.name: offer_gladius_upgrade_quest
fa95a681be968847.doc: Milane gives Monica a Gladius (item 44) and tells her to build it up by 2 levels. Accepts quest 10.

fa9fea6cce3e42bf.name: use_west_jump_gate
fa9fea6cce3e42bf.doc: Opens the jump gate menu from the west gate.

faa0751f0450d6fa.name: play_welcome_scene_and_enter_palace
faa0751f0450d6fa.doc: Story jump to 700: plays the palace welcome scene and jumps to map g05 (Moon Flower Palace) at entry 500.

faba1244920e65ff.name: restore_party_after_rococo_scene
faba1244920e65ff.doc: Reactivates the player's character and removes the other scene characters and extra motions loaded for the scene.

facf74f179d8a79a.name: press_panel_row1_col5
facf74f179d8a79a.doc: Presses the puzzle switch for the panel at row 1, column 5, toggling it and its neighbours.

faebd028101d02d8.name: ask_move_to_spheda_ball
faebd028101d02d8.doc: Asks whether to move the player to the Spheda ball (yes/no, worded for Monica when she is active). On yes it finds the point nearest the ball, moves away from any treasure chest there, places the player facing the ball and resets the camera behind them.

fb08b3ea5f67b7eb.name: play_event_109a_start_dungeon
fb08b3ea5f67b7eb.doc: Plays event 109a and then starts dungeon 0 from the talk handler.

fb0afd46d4d21474.name: greet_and_open_shop
fb0afd46d4d21474.doc: Shop greeting for an NPC. Says a welcome plus a line for the speaker (Bruno, Donny, the Georama merchant, and the three stand-in shopkeepers whose first meeting sets their met flags), talks to the NPC, then opens the shop for the character number: 18 shop 15, 12 shop 1, 4 shop 6, 15 shop 0, 33 shop 4, 34 shop 31, 1012 shop 35, 1015 shop 36, 1018 shop 37.

fb1289da3272fb38.name: announce_tournament_results
fb1289da3272fb38.doc: Shows the final ranking after Total Up: it makes up five rival scores, places the player's best weight among them and displays the board in three steps, then awards the prize item for the rank reached. Rival names are random villagers.

fb49972d4f5d907e.name: ask_to_go_forward_a_floor
fb49972d4f5d907e.doc: Next-floor exit: blocked during the fight; otherwise asks and, on yes, moves the dungeon to the next floor and loads the d04 script.

fb6838dec350d6d5.name: start_lapis_garter_fight
fb6838dec350d6d5.doc: Places the boss monster 611 and starts the battle music.

fb873763f75d617b.name: talk_parn
fb873763f75d617b.doc: Picks Parn's conversation by quest state: until quest 0 is cleared the early talk, then by quest 1 the quest offer, the golden paint reminder (accepted) or the joined talk (cleared). Returns 0.

fb894abe6e7553eb.name: play_fish_up_the_holy_one_plan_scene
fb894abe6e7553eb.doc: Event 235: Monica suggests fishing out the Holy One, since they have a fishing rod, Poison Apples and bait. Max is surprised but agrees, and a tutorial on casting with the Fishing Rod is shown. Sets flag 235.

fbc0f23b21de531c.name: play_sea_story_memory_scene
fbc0f23b21de531c.doc: Plays event 406, a memory of Eina reading a story about Tak the sea turtle and Max asking what the sea is like.

fbc6543d283420c2.name: return_to_course_menu
fbc6543d283420c2.doc: Opens the subgame save menu and then loads the first hole's course menu script. Returns 0.

fbf15a8099b0ccdf.name: play_meat_grab_scene
fbf15a8099b0ccdf.doc: Event 308: a character grabs a piece of meat and leaps across the scene while the camera follows, ending with the player's character landing.

fbfe0148931a9412.name: play_camera_lesson_scene
fbfe0148931a9412.doc: Plays the first lesson (event e105a, sets flag 105): the pendant conversation, the Energy Pack idea, the camera, and sending Max to take photos. It restores the camera and music afterwards.

fc147731adb85f38.name: play_short_train_arrival_cutscene
fc147731adb85f38.doc: Fades in on the train rolling into the station, then cuts to Max running off the platform. Station workers 9 and 10 are hidden until flag 448 is set. Not skippable.

fc22b03848e0c493.name: press_panel_row0_col5
fc22b03848e0c493.doc: Presses the puzzle switch for the panel at row 0, column 5, toggling it and its neighbours.

fc232c02d4acaa7e.name: talk_stewart_early
fc232c02d4acaa7e.doc: Stewart's talk before the first quest is cleared: he tells the player to come to him with any problem.

fc275fc4fae0ce80.name: talk_to_cedric_or_trigger_scene
fc275fc4fae0ce80.doc: Talk entry for the house: talking to Cedric runs his talk handler. A talk with no character while flag 6 is set and flag 7 is clear starts event i01h01c at 520.

fc2bd6873a214f1d.name: talk_stewart_joined
fc2bd6873a214f1d.doc: Stewart's talk after joining: he admits he has not read the book he won at auction, or in chapter 8 warns about the Zelmite mine. Then talk_to_npc.

fc2c920803408106.name: play_max_meets_monica_on_train_scene
fc2c920803408106.doc: Sets flag 206 and plays event 206: Max on a burning, runaway buggy-train is saved by Monica's fire magic, a bomb-throwing villain is beaten, and Max recalls how he met Monica. Skippable.

fc3faa7319e7b7cd.name: load_e728_scene_actors
fc3faa7319e7b7cd.doc: Loads the e728 scene actors (Sirus, Andrea, the memory frame) and four full-screen images with the message file.

fc4e6c3fc7d654c6.name: leave_station_for_s04
fc4e6c3fc7d654c6.doc: Plays event 283 and the train leaving the station, opens the world move menu 4 and jumps to map s04.

fc51553bd3ac1359.name: talk_rosa_early
fc51553bd3ac1359.doc: Rosa's talk before the first quest is cleared: she apologizes for being hard of hearing and asks to be spoken to slowly.

fc51c7f0a6cb700e.name: talk_facing_each_other
fc51c7f0a6cb700e.doc: Conversation staging: turns the player and the NPC to face each other (walking if they are not already facing), waits 20 frames, runs the NPC's talk with lip sync, then turns the NPC back to its original facing. Second parameter is unused.

fc5b9fb42406d7d6.name: play_paznos_launch_scene
fc5b9fb42406d7d6.doc: Sets flag 540 and plays the launch of Paznos: preparation scene, then four movie clips (E54001 to E54004) each followed by a scene (horn orders, soldier turns, fire order, Eina embrace), then jumps to s29 (Paznos Observatory).

fc5c23dc3ded46ba.name: talk_to_donny_before_leaving
fc5c23dc3ded46ba.doc: Donny asks what Max will do next. If Max chooses the water channel the leaving scene plays and it returns 1; otherwise Max says he will stay a bit and it returns 0.

fc63bf13029916cf.name: talk_blinkhorn_after_joining
fc63bf13029916cf.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's chatter after he has joined the party, praising Max's speed. Chapter 8 swaps in an offer of help.

fc762c5deba1eb57.name: ask_to_move_to_veniccio
fc762c5deba1eb57.doc: Asks whether to move to Veniccio. On yes the player runs off and it returns 1; on no he walks back a few steps and it returns 0.

fc9e434b15558d1f.name: go_to_i03h01a
fc9e434b15558d1f.doc: Runs play_cedric_walks_away_scene and jumps to map i03h01a entrance 500.

fcb725d4cab0b307.name: play_rococo_house_scene
fcb725d4cab0b307.doc: Sets flag 208 and plays the scene where Max and Monica find a lone house, meet the Firbit Rococo from Sindain, annoy him by asking for a favour, and watch him storm off. Skippable.

fcb92b58174d545f.name: talk_blinkhorn_after_joining
fcb92b58174d545f.doc: Sheriff Blinkhorn's chatter after he has joined the party, praising Max's speed. Chapter 8 swaps in an offer of help.

fcca37eea2f47ec3.name: talk_donny_joined
fcca37eea2f47ec3.doc: Donny's talk after he has joined: outside chapter 8 Monica gets her own talk and Max hears he is impressed about the coins; in chapter 8 he asks about the Zelmite search.

fcf43185095ca91f.name: talk_olivie_after_joining
fcf43185095ca91f.doc: Olivie's chatter after the race quest is cleared, hoping to stand on the winner's podium. Chapter 8 swaps in a remark about Fabio's single interest.

fd04966e1da68088.name: play_sea_memory_door_scene
fd04966e1da68088.doc: Story event 406 cutscene. Max stands at a door gate, which swings open as the camera pans, and he recalls a story read to him about a Turtle who travelled the Seven Seas. Sets flag 406 and forces Max as the active character.

fd08740a83344d8d.name: play_e616_placeholder_event
fd08740a83344d8d.doc: Placeholder for event 616 (a short return home on Eina's orders): sets flag 616 and shows a title text instead of the scene.

fd158947579c1958.name: talk_rufio_after_joining
fd158947579c1958.doc: Rufio's chatter after the moon photo quest is cleared, thanking the player. Chapter 8 swaps in a line about the Blackstone Railroad.

fd232bc1b0844108.name: spawn_chest_mimic
fd232bc1b0844108.doc: Cutscene for a mimic treasure box: pauses monster AI and pickups, crossfades to a camera on the chest at the treasure box event point, plays the closed and appear motions, then removes the chest actor and places the given monster at that spot at the given level and gives control back.

fd297d121b1d7fa0.name: slide_train_to_stop
fd297d121b1d7fa0.doc: Plays a sound and moves the train along z with constant deceleration over 90 frames until it stops, then waits 60 frames.

fd2a9d7e98d609df.name: setup_map_program
fd2a9d7e98d609df.doc: Setup program: runs the shared map object setup.

fd42fce8fa8ce952.name: play_run_out_to_entrance_scene
fd42fce8fa8ce952.doc: The player runs from inside the room back to the entrance while the screen fades out.

fd648cdf2ea3d044.name: spawn_rewards_after_fight
fd648cdf2ea3d044.doc: After the fight spawns a Diamond chest (item 189) for each of counter 17 bits 256 and 512 not yet taken, starts BGM 193 and marks the floor cleared.

fd89678ab3a25dba.name: show_cedric_fade_in
fd89678ab3a25dba.doc: Fades the scene in on Cedric's NPC visit: sets message and villager AI for slot 24, activates charas 0 and 24, puts the camera behind and fades in.

fdc7fbbfd523c0b6.name: talk_milane_after_joining
fdc7fbbfd523c0b6.doc: Milane's two-part chatter after the sword quest is cleared, about the beauty of a well-made sword. Chapter 8 swaps in a question about tough guys in the mine.

fdc860ed259ab129.name: hide_memo_on_enter
fdc860ed259ab129.doc: Prints a debug line and hides the memo if the player owns it.

fdf602e2d6ebace8.name: load_toryon_scene_models
fdf602e2d6ebace8.doc: Loads the Toryon models for the scene.

fdf69c7b5a413187.name: warp_to_d02b01_point_2551
fdf69c7b5a413187.doc: Clears the scene and loads dungeon d02b01 at event code 2551 plus 10000.

fdfb30ac9eb52951.name: play_shot_tom_reply
fdfb30ac9eb52951.doc: Shot in the opening: Tom looks at Borneo and says it is good to be back, Borneo says there is twenty percent more coal today, and Tom answers. sound_id is unused.

fe115b735b928c02.name: animate_lips_until_voice_ends
fe115b735b928c02.doc: Drives the speaking mouth animation while a voice stream plays, restarts the eating mouth when the motion loops and stops when the message is dismissed or ends. Returns the number of frames waited.

fe3a5cd57248d2c7.name: can_play_event_548
fe3a5cd57248d2c7.doc: Returns 1 when event 548 can play: analysis flag 403 is set and the event has not been seen.

fe4dae42e5c396e8.name: ask_to_leave_village_and_run_out
fe4dae42e5c396e8.doc: Asks the leave-the-area question. On yes the player runs out and the screen fades; returns 1. On no the player steps back and the camera follows.

fe6ba63a10ec41d9.name: refresh_analysis_doors_and_npcs
fe6ba63a10ec41d9.doc: Re-enables the analysis doors and updates the NPCs.

fe6dc33ea62b8221.name: talk_claire_monica
fe6dc33ea62b8221.doc: Claire's talk to Monica: asks whether she is Max's girlfriend and compliments her hair.

fe8e651277b48350.name: talk_to_parn_or_villager
fe8e651277b48350.doc: Talking to Parn runs his quest dialogue, anyone else uses the shared villager talk handler.

fe93ecf12ba1f1b5.name: talk_to_jurak_villager
fe93ecf12ba1f1b5.doc: Talks to a villager. Each villager (Yuran, Luseh, Raulah, Falujn, Estof and Perille, ids 100 to 105) says different lines depending on whether Jurak has been revived (flag 280) and on the Griffon quest (flag 640), and three of them open a shop afterwards (Luseh shop 25, Raulah shop 24 with the Monster Transformation Badge talk, Falujn shop 26).

fe9f86adda6e2dcd.name: play_train_departure_and_go_to_stonehenge
fe9f86adda6e2dcd.doc: Event 590: plays the train departure scene and jumps to s11 (Kazarov Stonehenge) event 502.

fea0fddae6768bb1.name: get_jump_velocity
fea0fddae6768bb1.doc: Writes the launch velocity vx, vy, vz needed to travel from (x0, y0, z0) to (x1, y1, z1) in frames steps under gravity.

feab9c33385f28a4.name: show_aim_for_head_hint
feab9c33385f28a4.doc: Pauses the game and shows a hint to aim for the head.

feac0b0d61294a85.name: play_stream_message_for
feac0b0d61294a85.doc: Opens the stream by id, shows its message and plays it for at most the given number of frames.

fead4a3251d6a315.name: examine_bookshelf
fead4a3251d6a315.doc: Shows a message that there is an important book whose meaning is not clear yet.

feb2528669100496.name: ask_to_go_to_sindain
feb2528669100496.doc: Asks whether to move to Sindain. On yes Max runs off and fades out (returns 1); on no he walks back a few steps and it returns 0.

feb70e52d04e5828.name: ask_to_enter_dungeon_d05
feb70e52d04e5828.doc: Handles the dungeon entrance. Companions only comment. Max is asked whether to enter (no question once flag 516 is set and editing is not blocked); on yes he runs through and the screen fades out. Returns 1 when entering, otherwise 0, optionally with a Ridepod reminder.

fed7c107c266b4b4.name: talk_stewart_auction
fed7c107c266b4b4.doc: Stewart's auction errand, stepped by counter 9. Step 0 needs 1000 gilda in hand and then says the price rose to 1200 and asks for 1500; step 1 needs 1500 and raises it to 2000; step 2 needs 2000 and asks the player to hand it over (yes takes 2000 gilda, Stewart leaves for the auction). Step 3 returns 600 gilda change and Stewart joins via recruit_talk_npc. Returns 0 on the early paths.

fede1dc92658fd27.name: open_bonus_score_menu
fede1dc92658fd27.doc: Cleans up Spheda, loads dungeon floor d02f01, gives the Map and Magic Crystal, sets up a one-hole Spheda course, fades in and opens the Spheda score view menu.

fef35bb5fb3f62dd.name: play_morning_ticket_scene
fef35bb5fb3f62dd.doc: Opening scene in the morning: Max, soaked, shows a ticket for Flotsam's Circus Troupe, mentions the old item his father told him to always wear, and is sent off to repair Gable's vacuum. Skippable.

fef90a3dd77d6583.name: play_spheda_course_0
fef90a3dd77d6583.doc: Opens the Spheda menu on the first course. If the player chooses result 18 it loads d01f01 stage 0, places Max, sets up Spheda and shows the score view; otherwise it leaves the event.

fefee3648bcb2ed4.name: talk_stewart_after_joining
fefee3648bcb2ed4.doc: Stewart's chatter after the book auction quest is cleared, about the book he got. Chapter 8 swaps in a warning about Zelmite Mine.

ff1667b344a0447a.name: play_empty_shot
ff1667b344a0447a.doc: Empty shot used as a placeholder; does nothing and returns 0.

ff17020962d7afa5.name: play_lapis_beam_scene
ff17020962d7afa5.doc: Scene where Lapis fires a beam at the palace and the final stage begins. Sets the final stage started flag first, loads event 640 actors and swaps in Monica or Max as the second party member.

ff1ac74c91411725.name: place_shigura_villagers
ff1ac74c91411725.doc: Until flag 438 is set, places Bal, adult and child Shigura models at fixed spots around the village.

ff266c5412f6601f.name: can_play_event_280
ff266c5412f6601f.doc: Returns 1 when event 280 may play: analysis flag 103 is set, the d02 boss defeat flag is set, event 280 has not been seen and character 1 (Monica) can be switched to; otherwise 0.

ff2eab8321757fde.name: ask_if_ready_to_depart
ff2eab8321757fde.doc: The waiting NPC says the Chrono Union worked (the first time, flag 55) or that everything is ready, and asks whether to leave. Returns 1 if the player says yes.

ff3796d104b6019d.name: inspect_gable_vacuum
ff3796d104b6019d.doc: Interaction with Gable's unfinished vacuum. Without the Wrench (item 382) the player is told to look in the cabinet; with it they are asked whether to start fixing it (the choice flips if they have the Notebook), and yes plays the vacuum repair scene and jumps to map m06 (Palm Brinks).

ff447a8006a949fb.name: finish_dark_genie_chapter
ff447a8006a949fb.doc: After the boss, clears monsters, restores the main characters, hides the boss area parts, plays the defeat scene and the ending movie, then sets the exit flag.

ff4482cf46f4dd1e.name: show_flotsam_image
ff4482cf46f4dd1e.doc: Shows the fourth story image and the line that Griffon's henchman Flotsam made Mayor Need search for the stone.

ff622a899808494b.name: show_help_tutorial_messages
ff622a899808494b.doc: Pauses the dungeon and shows a series of tutorial messages (2620 to 2623), ending with a pointer to Help in the Main Menu.

ff991483bf9b9fde.name: play_paznos_turns_into_robot_scene
ff991483bf9b9fde.doc: Plays the last part of event 640: the party reacts to Paznos turning into a robot.

ffa067bf8ff3435d.name: play_receiver_advice_dialogue
ffa067bf8ff3435d.doc: Dialogue played on Max's return to the dungeon (event e102): the receiver voice asks how it is going, warns that monsters get stronger deeper in, says weapons need strengthening and points to Help on the Main Menu.

ffa35bd66325b023.name: choose_floor_and_enter_dungeon
ffa35bd66325b023.doc: Opens the dungeon tree map for stage 5 and enters the chosen floor. Returns 0 after fading in when the player backs out. Skips the BGM reload when floor 26 is picked.

ffd7783dde371889.name: play_rock_barrage_scene
ffd7783dde371889.doc: Cutscene of Toryon, hovering with its propeller, hurling a series of rocks along two alternating arcs. Skippable.

ffdd2861ed41c7bb.name: play_find_building_scene
ffdd2861ed41c7bb.doc: Event 456, sets flag 456: Max and Monica spot a building from the hill and run to check it out. Plays when analysis flag 301 is set and the party can switch characters.

ffe51428ee9c69ad.name: play_lighthouse_arrival_scene
ffe51428ee9c69ad.doc: Sets flag 348 and plays event 348: Max, Monica and Lin walk in and look up at the Lighthouse.

ffe8ebeaa84cb580.name: play_geostone_scene_and_jump_to_s47
ffe8ebeaa84cb580.doc: Marks a floor flag, plays the Geostone scene and jumps to map s47 (Sindain event) at program 505.

fffb5ef99847a655.name: talk_erik_at_station
fffb5ef99847a655.doc: Talking to Erik at a station. If Erik is the partner he gives a demolition quip and, in chapters 2, 3 and 4 before the chapter's story event, an extra line, then the normal NPC talk. Otherwise it opens the party member menu for him with mode 3. Returns 0.

fffd6784a9c77e51.name: open_blocked_passage_with_item
fffd6784a9c77e51.doc: Blocked passage: with Donny in the party he opens it for the player, otherwise the player must use the required item.

ffffede444af5aac.name: enter_square_event_venue
ffffede444af5aac.doc: Asks to enter the current event venue and jumps to i03h03 (fishing contest) or i03h04 (Finny Frenzy). When no event is running it shows a closed-for-removal notice.
